36501.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド&パール ギラティナと氷空の花束 シェイミ

36502.title: Theatrical Pokémon DP: Zoroak, the Overlord of Phantom
36502.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド&パール 幻影の覇者 ゾロアーク

36522.title: Cells at Work! Code Black
36522.description: Alcohol, smoking, and stress—in the body subjected to these irritants, the cells responsible for maintaining life seem to fight a war that never ends. Due to a severe shortage of workers, Red Blood Cell AA2153 has to quickly learn to deliver oxygen and collect carbon dioxide, even in dangerous conditions. Meanwhile, White Blood Cell U-1196 has to do her part by dealing with germs and viruses during life-threatening situations. In the midst of these crises, they have to work together to keep the body healthy, despite not knowing if their sacrifices will be worthwhile.

36523.title: Cells at Work! S2
36523.description:
Inside the human body is a world where countless cells are working very hard for you.

One day, White Blood Cell (Neutrophil) and Red Blood Cell meet Ordinary Cell, who rescued a lost Lactic Acid Bacterium. In order to reunite Lactic Acid Bacterium with its friends, Ordinary Cell heads to the intestines with White Blood Cell (Neutrophil). But awaiting them there is a dreadful enemy long thought defeated!

“Now, let's decide once and for all...which of us is on the side of justice.”

With the return of Cancer Cell and harmful bacteria ravaging the intestines, the body is in a crisis!

“Cancer Cell, don’t do this!!” 

To protect their world, White Blood Cell (Neutrophil) along with all the other cells wades into a desperate battle!

36533.title: The Legend of Leopard Head King

36534.title: Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki
36534.description: Tomozaki is one of the best gamers in Japan, and in his opinion, the game of real life is one of the worst. No clear-cut rules for success, horribly balanced, and nothing makes sense. But then he meets a gamer who's just as good as him, and she offers to teach him a few exploits...

36536.title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend .flat
36536.description:
After finally completing the first route of his visual novel, Blessing Software's producer Tomoya Aki is optimistic about the future of his team and achieving their goal of creating the best game of the season.

However, they still have a long way to go. For one, Megumi Katou still has an incredibly flat personality and is unable to fit the role of Tomoya's ideal heroine. The other members of Blessing Software, Eriri Spencer Sawamura, Utaha Kasumigaoka, and Michiru Hyoudou, often forget she is even there due to her lack of presence and character.

Throughout the development of their game, Blessing Software learns the struggles of working in an industry where deadlines must be met and edits are made constantly, and the hardships of working in a group setting.
36536.originName: 冴えない彼女の育てかた ♭

36537.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
36537.description:
Chise Hatori, a 15-year-old Japanese girl, was sold for five million pounds at an auction to a tall masked gentleman. Abandoned at a young age and ridiculed by her peers for her unconventional behavior, she was ready to give herself to any buyer if it meant having a place to go home to. In chains and on her way to an unknown fate, she hears whispers from robed men along her path, gossiping and complaining that such a buyer got his hands on a rare "Sleigh Beggy."

Ignoring the murmurs, the mysterious man leads the girl to a study, where he reveals himself to be Elias Ainsworth—a magus. After a brief confrontation and a bit of teleportation magic, the two open their eyes to Elias' picturesque cottage in rural England. Greeted by fairies and surrounded by weird and wonderful beings upon her arrival, these events mark the beginning of Chise's story as the apprentice and supposed bride of the ancient magus.

36538.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets ∬
36538.description: Uesugi Fuutarou, a high school second-year from a poor family, receives a highly appealing offer to work part-time as a tutor... but his students turn out to be girls from his own class! What's more, they're quintuplets... and all five are beautiful, but happen to be problem students who have borderline grades and hate studying! Looks like his first assignment will be to win all the sisters' trust?! Every day is a wild party in this rom-com centering around the quintuplet sisters of the Nakano household!

36568.title: Gekidol
36568.description: Set five years after the mysterious disaster of a city's sudden disappearance, a group of girls fascinated by the "Theatrical Material System" using 3D holograms aims to brighten the stage during the city's post-apocalyptic recovery.

36569.title: Armored Girls
36569.description:
The story is set in Tokyo in a different world, and tells the girls' battle against a mysterious enemy "Mimesis."

The Year 2051, where all the young LBX players all over the world cooperate to resolve the Mizel Crisis. The Seto-50's explosion within the Mizel Trouser is contained within the Grand Sphere, but the energy released tore open a dimensional rift, thus splitting the world into two.

This is the story of another world parallel from the LBX-hobby world of Danball Senki, a story about how the children's hobby was converted into military technology following the crisis aftermath.

The worlds' governments are troubled over future large-scale terrorism due to the remnants in what Mizel left behind. In order to counter what's in store, the world's science R&Ds reverse-engineered the LBX technology into over-tech powered suits to which the user unites with their LBX. This is called the "Little Battle Counter System (LBCS)"

3 years after, the worse has been realized as a terrorism act has occurred around Japan's metropolitan areas. To counter the same national crisis, the government assigned elite female squadrons to subjugate the Mizel Remnants "Mizerem". A new battle for the fate of humanity has begun anew,

36570.title: Heaven's Design Team
36570.description: In Heaven's Animal Design Department, designers create a variety of new animals daily while contending with the unreasonable requests of their client: God. Funny, interesting, and full of useful information, this series answers questions such as, “Why can't unicorns exist?”, “What makes an animal taste delicious?”, “What's the most powerful creature in the ocean?”, and, “Bird versus snake: who would win?” You won't believe it's a manga series when you read up on the featured animals in the included encyclopedia entries. Heaven's Design Team will make your next trip to the zoo or aquarium 100 times more fun!

36571.title: A Mortal's Journey
36571.description: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

36572.title: God troubles me S2
36572.description: In the 21st century, due to the rapid development of human society, the originally stable three realms of human, gods and demons lost their balance. The gods and Demons urgently launched the salvation plan and decided to send a group of gods and monsters to the human world to find the key of saving world. Su Moting is a young woman with the status of "the son of the god and demon". After being invited out of the house by her parents for the reason of "independence and self-improvement", Su Moting met the handsome little cute gods, Tianjixing and Dikui, a mysterious calm cool cat demon. Under the guidance of the land god, the three formed a salvation group and began to perform the funny and heartbreaking nonsense daily life.

36574.title: Beanie's Daily
36574.description: The main character of this show is a little red bean who dreams of being eaten.

36578.title: Beanie's Daily Extra Story: Don't Forget Me
36578.originName: 请吃红小豆吧！外传 莫相忘

36598.title: The Promised Neverland
36598.description: Emma, Norman, and Ray are the three most brilliant children the Grace Field House has produced in decades. Unlike in a typical orphanage, they, and their fellow children, eat well and are given an intensive education. However, despite living in a peaceful environment with fun games and a caring mother, there's something not quite right. When six year old Connie is "adopted" by foster parents, she forgets her favorite stuffed rabbit, and Emma and Norman sneak out to return it to her. When they arrive at the scene, the two realize exactly why they had always been isolated from the outside world.

36600.title: DARLING in the FRANXX
36600.description: In the distant future the land is ruined and humanity establishes the mobile fort city Plantation. Pilots produced inside Plantation live in Mistilteinn, also know as the "birdcage." Children live there knowing nothing of the outside world or the freedom of the sky. Their lives consist of battling to carry out missions. Their enemies are mysterious giant lifeforms known as Kyōryū, and the children pilot robots called Franxx to face off against them. For the children, riding the Franxx proves their existence. A boy named Hiro is called Code:016, and he was once known as a prodigy. However, he has fallen behind, and his existence seems unnecessary. Not piloting a Franxx is the same as ceasing to exist. One day, a mysterious girl known as "Zero Two" appears before him. Two horns grow out of her head
36600.originName: ダーリン・イン・ザ・フランキス

36601.title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
36601.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ～2人の英雄～

36604.title: Hunter x Hunter Movie 2: The Last Mission
36604.description: Some tens of years ago, chairman of the Hunters Association Isaac Netero sealed away Jed, a man representing the "shadow" of the association that had began to make use of the power "on." "On," being another side of the coin of "nen," derives its power from the user's pure hatred at the cost of their life. Although he thought he had sealed Jed and "on" away, a team of on-using warriors appears at Heaven's Arena's Battle Olympia Tournament. Gon and Killua, who had come to cheer on Zushi, along with Kurapika, who attends the tournament to protect his boss Neon, are forced to find the source of a violent invasion of the tower and defeat it. However, this may not be so easy, as their foes use the power of hatred as they wish for the death of all Hunters.

36605.title: Hunter x Hunter Movie 1: Phantom Rouge
36605.description: One day, Kurapika spots a child who looks very similar to his childhood friend, Pyro. However, when he catches up to him, the boy steals Kurapika's eyes with some kind of magical power. Gon, Leorio, and Killua promise to help find who took his eyes and get them back, but Killua is having his own problems when he is forced to face his past and whether he really is worthy to have Gon as a friend.

36606.title: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dead Apple
36606.originName: 文豪ストレイドッグス DEAD APPLE

36607.title: Zombieland Saga
36607.description:
Sakura Minamoto dreams of becoming an idol. Unfortunately, reality hits her like a truck, and she dies in a sudden traffic accident. Ten years later, she wakes up in Saga Prefecture, only to find herself a zombie with no memory of her past. While still coming to terms with her demise, she meets a man named Koutarou Tatsumi, who explains that he has resurrected her and six other zombie girls from different eras for the purpose of economically revitalizing Saga by means of an idol group. Assuming the role of an abrasive manager, Koutarou begins scheduling events; the girls go along with it, eventually deciding to name their idol group Franchouchou.

An absurdly comedic take on the idol genre, Zombieland Saga tells the story of Franchouchou's heartwarming struggle to save Saga Prefecture while hiding their zombie identities and rediscovering their past lives.

36609.title: Nisekoi
36609.description:
Raku Ichijou, a first-year student at Bonyari High School, is the sole heir to an intimidating yakuza family. Ten years ago, Raku made a promise to his childhood friend. Now, all he has to go on is a pendant with a lock, which can only be unlocked with the key which the girl took with her when they parted.

Now, years later, Raku has grown into a typical teenager, and all he wants is to remain as uninvolved in his yakuza background as possible while spending his school days alongside his middle school crush Kosaki Onodera. However, when the American Bee Hive Gang invades his family's turf, Raku's idyllic romantic dreams are sent for a toss as he is dragged into a frustrating conflict: Raku is to pretend that he is in a romantic relationship with Chitoge Kirisaki, the beautiful daughter of the Bee Hive's chief, so as to reduce the friction between the two groups. Unfortunately, reality could not be farther from this whopping lie—Raku and Chitoge fall in hate at first sight, as the girl is convinced he is a pathetic pushover, and in Raku's eyes, Chitoge is about as attractive as a savage gorilla.

36610.title: Nisekoi:
36610.description:
Despite having seemingly quelled the war between their respective gangs, Raku Ichijou and Chitoge Kirisaki still carry on with their fake relationship. Eventually, as Chitoge's perception of Raku slowly changes, she even begins to see him as a little charming.

Chitoge struggles to come to terms with her newfound feelings for Raku, as a new girl joins the slew of Raku's admirers and the competition among those vying for the yakuza heir's attention grows even fiercer. And amidst all this, Raku's search for his first love and the contents of the mysterious sealed locket continues in Nisekoi:, which picks up where the first season left off.

36611.title: My Love Story!!
36611.description:
With his muscular build and tall stature, Takeo Gouda is not exactly your average high school freshman. However, behind his intimidating appearance hides a heart of gold, and he is considered a hero by the boys for his courage and chivalry. Unfortunately, these traits do not help much with his love life. As if his looks are not enough to scare the opposite sex away, Takeo's cool and handsome best friend and constant companion Makoto Sunakawa easily steals the hearts of the female students—including every girl Takeo has ever liked.

When Takeo gallantly saves cute and angelic Rinko Yamato from being molested, he falls in love with her instantly, but suspects that she might be interested in Sunakawa. With his own love for Yamato continuing to bloom, Takeo unselfishly decides to act as her cupid, even as he yearns for his own love story.

36612.title: Eromanga Sensei
36612.description:
One year ago, Sagiri Izumi became step-siblings with Masamune Izumi. But the sudden death of their parents tears their new family apart, resulting in Sagiri becoming a shut-in which cut her off from her brother and society.

While caring for what's left of his family, Masamune earns a living as a published light novel author with one small problem: he's never actually met his acclaimed illustrator, Eromanga-sensei, infamous for drawing the most lewd erotica. Through an embarrassing chain of events, he learns that his very own little sister was his partner the whole time!

As new characters and challenges appear, Masamune and Sagiri must now face the light novel industry together. Eromanga-Sensei follows the development of their relationship and their struggle to become successful; and as Sagiri slowly grows out of her shell, just how long will she be able to hide her true persona from the rest of the world?

36613.title: Kakushigoto
36613.description:
Kakushi Gotou is a somewhat popular manga artist whose works are known for inappropriate content. Because of this raunchiness, when his daughter Hime was born, he vowed to keep his profession hidden from her, believing that she will be disillusioned if she finds out.

This paranoia-induced belief leads Kakushi into hectic situations. Despite being a single father, he does his best and often resorts to extreme ends just to protect his secret, such as guising as a salaryman every day or holding emergency drills in case Hime somehow finds her way to his workplace.

Kakushigoto tells the story of a father and daughter living side by side, maintaining their peaceful existence as the father attempts to preserve the status quo. However, there is a saying: "there are no secrets that time cannot reveal." In time, Hime must learn the reality behind the things she took for granted as she grew up.

36621.title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku
36621.description: When Narumi, an office lady who hides the fact that she is a yaoi fangirl, changes jobs, she is reunited with Hirotaka, her childhood friend who is attractive and skilled but is a hardcore gaming otaku. They decide to start dating for now, but being otaku, both of them are awkward so a serious romantic relationship is rather difficult for them...

36622.title: InuYasha the Movie 3: Swords of an Honorable Ruler
36622.description: Izayoi and Inu no Taishou, Inuyasha's parents, are having problems with a human named Setsuna no Takemaru. Sou'unga a magical sword that has been sealed away for 700 years is found. Now everyone is after the sword and its powers but it seems the sword has something else in mind.
36622.originName: 犬夜叉 天下覇道の剣

36623.title: Inuyasha the Movie: Affections Touching Across Time
36623.description: Inu-Yasha has mastered the ultimate attack of the Tetsusaiga and continues his battle for the Shikon Jewel shards with Kagome, Shippo, Sango, and Miroku. Unfortunately, a freak occurance with a jewel shard has brought to life an incarnation of a demonic enemy sealed by Inu-Yashas' father. Inu-Yasha must surpass his father and destroy this demon or every soul in Japan will be consumed.
36623.originName: 犬夜叉 時代を越える想い

36624.title: Maou Gakuin no Futekigousha: Shijou Saikyou no Maou no Shiso, Tensei shite Shison-tachi no Gakkou e
36624.description:
In the distant past, a war between humans and demons brought about widespread chaos and bloodshed. To put an end to this seemingly endless conflict, Demon King Anos Voldigoad willingly sacrificed his life, hoping to be reborn in a peaceful future.

In preparation for their king's return, the demon race created the Demon King Academy, an elite institution tasked with determining Anos' identity when he reawakens. He reincarnates two millennia later, but to his surprise, he soon learns that the level of magic in the world has drastically waned during his absence. Moreover, when he enrolls at the academy to reclaim his rightful title, he finds out that demonkind remembers him differently. His personality, his deeds, and even his legacy are all falsified—masked beneath the name of an impostor. This "lack" of common knowledge renders him the academy's outlier—a misfit never before seen in history.
36624.originName: 魔王学院の不適合者 ～史上最強の魔王の始祖、転生して子孫たちの学校へ通う～

36630.title: Tokyo Ghoul
36630.description:
Tokyo has become a cruel and merciless city—a place where vicious creatures called “ghouls” exist alongside humans. The citizens of this once great metropolis live in constant fear of these bloodthirsty savages and their thirst for human flesh. However, the greatest threat these ghouls pose is their dangerous ability to masquerade as humans and blend in with society.

Based on the best-selling supernatural horror manga by Sui Ishida, Tokyo Ghoul follows Ken Kaneki, a shy, bookish college student, who is instantly drawn to Rize Kamishiro, an avid reader like himself. However, Rize is not exactly who she seems, and this unfortunate meeting pushes Kaneki into the dark depths of the ghouls' inhuman world. In a twist of fate, Kaneki is saved by the enigmatic waitress Touka Kirishima, and thus begins his new, secret life as a half-ghoul/half-human who must find a way to integrate into both societies.
36630.originName: 東京喰種トーキョーグール

36631.title: Tokyo Ghoul JACK
36631.description:
Former baseball player turned delinquent Taishi Fura accidentally witnesses the man-eating "ghoul" known as Lantern injuring his old friend and murdering another. Before the situation gets any worse, Fura's classmate Kishou Arima arrives―as he is actually an undercover investigator for the Commission of Counter Ghoul (CCG)―and forces the ghoul to flee.

Seeking revenge for his friends, Fura joins forces with Arima to hunt down ghouls in the 13th Ward—ultimately aiming to bring down Lantern.
36631.originName: 東京喰種トーキョーグール［JACK］

36632.title: Full Metal Panic! The Second Raid
36632.description: The third impact of the All Metal Frenzy series "The Second Raid of All Metal Frenzy" is a youth drama that combines funny, fighting, love, and friendship. The characters in the plot follow the first two works, and the protagonist is still Sosuke Sagara, fighting The stage was transferred to Hong Kong, and the popular character Tessa's brother Leonard finally appeared on the stage, taking his new body to challenge Sagara, which made the relationship between the characters more and more complicated. Because of his addition, Sagara The triangle relationship with Xiaoyao and Tessa has become four corners. In addition, three negative roles have been added one after another. The beautiful assassin has two sisters, and Xia Yulan and Xia Yufang will all appear as disciples of Kowloon.
36632.originName: フルメタル・パニック! The Second Raid

36633.title: The three sisters from the south family have another bowl
36633.originName: みなみけ おかわり

36634.title: The King of Magic Bullets and Sen Hime
36634.description: In the Kingdom of Breunu, there is Alsace, a small land on the border, and the leader here is a noble boy Tegelwilmud von Lun, who is easy to go. Because of the kingdom’s recruitment, Tiegl was forced to go to the battlefield. The difference in the number of the two sides was five times faster. He originally thought that this was a must-win war. However, his opponent was one of the "Seven Fighters" in Gista, Eleonora Vertalia, who has the title of "Silver Girl of Wind", defeated the Breunu army under her unexpected strategy. In the chaos of the war, although Tiegel tried to use her best bow to kill the enemy general, she was defeated by her superb sword skills. Just when Tegel was desperately ready to die. "You will be my person from now on." Because of the other party's unexpected sentence, Tiegel's future destiny will be completely rewritten.

36637.title: K-On!
36637.description:
A fresh high school year always means much to come, and one of those things is joining a club. Being in a dilemma about which club to join, Yui Hirasawa stumbles upon and applies for the Light Music Club, which she misinterprets to be about playing simple instruments, such as castanets. Unable to play an instrument, she decides to visit to apologize and quit.

Meanwhile, the Light Music Club faces disbandment due to a lack of members. This causes the club members to offer anything, from food to slacking off during club time, in order to convince Yui to join. Despite their efforts, Yui insists on leaving due to her lack of musical experience. As a last resort, they play a piece for Yui, which sparks her fiery passion and finally convinces her to join the club.

From then onward, it's just plain messing around with bits and pieces of practice. The members of the Light Music Club are ready to make their time together a delightful one!

36639.title: Sword spirit
36639.originName: ブレイドアンドソウル

36640.title: Recorded horizon
36640.description: After the veteran online game "Myth of Illusion" introduced the twelfth expansion of the expansion "Kaiyu Zhiyu", 30,000 users in Japan were locked in the game. In a world where reality and games are wonderfully integrated, the actor Shiroe fought on the stage of Akihabara Street.

36641.title: Unbreakable Machine-Doll
36641.description: During the early 20th century, along with technological advancements, scientists were able to develop sophisticated magic. The combination of science and sorcery was Makinot, circuits made from spells that were put into objects to bring them to life and even gain a personality. It was developed as a military weapon and has now spread throughout the world. Akabane Raishin is now attending the Royal Academy to become the best in the world. Accompanied by the lovely teenage girl Yaya, who is actually Raishin’s puppet weapon, he plans on rocketing to the top of the class. However, his test scores come nearly dead last although his combat skills and determination are second to none. Raishin has to compete with the deadliest of classmates if he wants to come out as the king.
36641.originName: 機巧少女は傷つかない

36649.title: Ace Pitcher Raises His Arms ~ Summer Conference~
36649.originName: おおきく振りかぶって～夏の大会編～

36652.title: Astra Lost in Space
36652.description:
In the year 2063, space travel is feasible and commercially available. As the cheerful Aries Spring arrives at the spaceport to attend a camp on the distant planet McPa, her purse is suddenly snatched by a reckless thief. Luckily, the athletic Kanata Hoshijima is able to retrieve it for her, and Aries soon discovers that he is among the group of teenagers who will be travelling with her on the excursion as team B-5.

Upon arriving at their campsite, the group's trip takes a turn for the worse when a strange sphere of black light sucks them into the vast reaches of outer space. Stranded with seemingly no hope, they find an abandoned ship nearby that provides them with the means to return home. However, they soon discover that they are not as close to their campsite as they initially thought, but are in fact thousands of light-years away from home.

With this realization, the nine members must cautiously manage their resources, maintain their strength, and unite as one to conquer the darkness of space together. While the reason behind their trip's sudden obstruction remains unknown, they nevertheless embark on the treacherous voyage back home aboard their new ship, the Astra.

36684.title: Hypocritical masks
36684.originName: うたわれるもの 偽りの仮面

36687.title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon
36687.description: As Kobayashi sets off for another day at work, she opens her apartment door only to be met by an unusually frightening sight—the head of a dragon, staring at her from across the balcony. The dragon immediately transforms into a cute, busty, and energetic young girl dressed in a maid outfit, introducing herself as Tooru.
36687.originName: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン

36689.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime S2
36689.description: With the help of Queen Ramiris, the children are now in stable condition and should lead normal lives, much to Rimuru’s relief. But all is not well… In fact, there are forces of humankind in this fantasy world that do not look kindly upon a slime-led nation of monsters. And now, insidious threats to Rimuru and the country of Tempest may be lurking around every corner!
36689.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第2期

36690.title: Mushoku Tensei jobless reincarnation
36690.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.
36690.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～

36691.title: Suppose a Kid from the Last Dungeon Boonies Moved to a Starter Town
36691.description: Lloyd is a novice adventurer whose dream is to discover "true strength" in the capital he's always admired, despite growing up with neighbors who always considered him weak. The story starts with him departing from his hometown, which just so happens to be located right next to...one of the most dangerous dungeons in the world?! Lloyd may think of himself as powerless, but when he goes to the city that serves as the starter town for adventurers, the difference between him and everyone else couldn't be starker!
36691.originName: たとえばラストダンジョン前の村の少年が序盤の街で暮らすような物語

36692.title: The Promised Neverland S2
36692.description: The one adored as the mother is not the real parent. The people living here together are not actual siblings. The Gracefield House is where orphaned children live. An irreplaceable home where 38 siblings and Mom live happy lives, even with no blood relations. However, their everyday life suddenly came to an abrupt end one day...
36692.originName: 約束のネバーランド 第2期

36695.title: Tokyo Ravens
36695.description:
Domimon Haruho came from the famous gate of Yin and Yang Tao, the branch of Domi. However, he has not inherited any "damn" aura, and he has no desire to become an onmyoji.

But all this changed after he met Natsume Domimon, the next head of Domimon. By accident, Haruto Domimon enters the academy for cultivating Onmyojis-Onmyoji. The wonderful story starts from here.

36700.title: Black Butler II OVA
36700.description:
According to the Kuroshitsuji website, there are 6 OVAs included in the DVD releases.

DVD 2: Ciel in Wonderland (Part 1)
This re-imagines the cast of Kuroshitsuji II as characters in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland story.

DVD 3: Welcome to the Phantomhive's
This is meant to be like a simulation game. Elizabeth invites a lady (perhaps the viewer) to join her at a ball held at the Phantomhive mansion.

DVD 5: The Making of Kuroshitsuji II
This is a Hollywood style documentary with behind the scenes interviews with Sebastian, Ciel, Claude and Alois etc.

DVD 6: Ciel in Wonderland (Part 2)
This re-imagines the cast of Kuroshitsuji II as characters in Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland story.

DVD 8: The Tale of William the Shinigami
William and Grell have to train new shinigami and reminisce about when they were training partners.

DVD 9: The Spider's Intention
The life in Trancy household and how those work under Alois is caring for him.

36703.title: Grimgar OVA of Ash and Fantasy
36703.description:
Why do we do this...? 
 
 Harshiro recovered, only to find that he was in the darkness. He had no idea where he was or where this place was. 
 
 Around him are a group of men and women who have lost their memories like him and only remember their own names; and after leaving the ground, what awaits everyone is a "like a game" world. 
 
 In order to survive, Har Shilo formed a team with his friends in the same situation, learned skills, and stepped into this world-"Grimgar" as a volunteer trainee. 
 
 No one knows what will be encountered in the future... All of this is the adventure story born from the ashes.
36703.originName: 灰と幻想のグリムガル OVA

36705.title: Hortensia Saga
36705.description: Hortensia Saga is a medieval fantasy tale of war and chaos. Three years ago, the king was betrayed and murdered by one of his dukes who then rebuilt the kingdom into his own. But now, the original heir to the throne has secretly come of age. Hiding in the guise of a man, she and her loyal band begin the quest to save her homeland.
36705.originName: オルタンシア・サーガ

36709.title: SK8 the Infinity
36709.description:
Reki, a high school sophomore and skater, is addicted to "S," a highly secret and dangerous downhill skateboarding race that takes place in an abandoned mine. The skaters are especially wild about the "beefs," or heated battles that erupt in the races.

Reki takes Langa, a transfer student returning to Japan after studying abroad, to the mine where the races are held. Langa, who has no skateboarding experience, finds himself pulled into the world of "S"...

36710.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
36710.description:
The world where the Hero and the Demon King continue to oppose each other. The grand magic from the Hero and the Demon King cross over worlds and exploded in the classroom of a certain high school.

The students who died in the explosion will be reincarnated in a different world. The protagonist, who has the lowest reputation in the class, was reincarnated into a spider. Nevertheless, she adapted quickly to the present condition with strong willpower.

This is a story of she who has become a spider trying whatever she can to live.

36711.title: Dr. Ramune Mysterious Disease Specialist
36711.description:
As long as hearts exist inside people, there will always be those who suffer.
When something "strange" enters their mind, a strange disease will manifest itself in their body.
The illness, which is called a "mystery disease" is unknown to most, but it certainly exists.
There is a doctor and an apprentice who can fight the disease, which modern medicine cannot cure.

His name is Ramune.
He acts freely all the time, is foul-mouthed, and doesn’t even look like a doctor!
However, once he is confronted with the mysterious disease,
he is able to quickly uncover the root cause of his patients' deep-seated distress and cure them.

36716.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Wan!
36716.description: The peaceful days of the very popular work Bungou Stray Dogs are here. The characters of the Armed Detective Agency and the Mafia are in miniature form?! Due to Atsushi and co. becoming cute, this is a different experience to the original work—a pleasant gag manga!
36716.originName: 文豪ストレイドッグス わん！

36717.title: Re:ZERO - Starting Life in Another World S2 Part 2
36717.description: Even after dying countless times, Subaru finally ended the threat of the White Whale and defeated the Witch Cult's Sin Archbishop representing sloth, Petelgeuse Romaneeconti. But only shortly after overcoming a tragic ending and reuniting with his beloved Emilia, Subaru learns that Rem has been erased from this world, having fallen victim to the White Whale's Fog of Elimination in the midst of Subaru's death loop. With the White Whale now gone, Subaru and Emilia are forced to confront a reality they never dreamed would happen.
36717.originName: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 2nd season

36718.title: Armor Shop for Ladies & Gentlemen
36718.description: Kautz was looking for a job and suddenly he gets hired by an armor shop. But it's not your run of the mill armor shop, it's an adult armor shop. An ecchi comedy showing the shopkeeper side of selling sexy battle armor.

36727.title: Movie Pokémon Super Wish: Chief Rem VS Holy Swordsman Kailudio
36727.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ キュレムVS聖剣士 ケルディオ

36728.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon Super Wish-The Final Chapter -: The awakening of the super dream of Genosect
36728.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター ベストウイッシュ 神速のゲノセクト ミュウツー覚醒

36729.title: Pokemon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
36729.originName: ポケモン・ザ・ムービーXY 光輪の超魔神 フーパ

36730.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon: the dreamy Pokémon Rogia bursts out
36730.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 幻のポケモン ルギア爆誕

36732.title: Pokémon theatrical version: Sherabi's encounter in time and space
36732.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター セレビィ 時を超えた遭遇

36733.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon: Ladias and Ladias, the patrons of the water capital
36733.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 水の都の護神 ラティアスとラティオス

36734.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon Super Generation: Seven Nights' Wishing Star Kiraki
36734.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター アドバンスジェネレーション 七夜の願い星 ジラーチ

36735.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon Super Generation: The visitor of the rift, Deoxys
36735.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター アドバンスジェネレーション 裂空の訪問者 デオキシス

36736.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon Super Generation: Lucario the Hero of Dream and Bird
36736.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター アドバンスジェネレーション ミュウと波導の勇者 ルカリオ

36737.title: Theatrical version of Pokémon Super Generation: Pokémon Conservator and Prince Mana Fei of Canghai
36737.originName: 劇場版ポケットモンスター アドバンスジェネレーション ポケモンレンジャーと蒼海の王子 マナフィ

36738.title: Crayon Shin-chan: The Legend Called: Dance! Amigo!
36738.originName: クレヨンしんちゃん 伝説を呼ぶ 踊れ!アミーゴ!

36749.title: Tsurune: Kazemai Koukou Kyuudoubu
36749.description: "Tsurune"—It's the sound made by the bowstring when an arrow is released, and the sound that inspired Minato Narumiya to learn Kyuudo, a modern Japanese martial art focusing on archery. However, an incident during his last middle school tournament caused him to quit the sport.
36749.originName: ツルネ -風舞高校弓道部-

36752.title: One semester tutoring
36752.originName: スクールランブル 一学期補習

36760.title: Detective opera girl Sherlock Holmes summer special
36760.originName: 探偵オペラ ミルキィホームズ サマー・スペシャル

36769.title: Slow Start
36769.description:
Hana Ichinose, a girl who is afraid of having children, is about to enter the first year of high school this spring. 
 For some reason, she separated from her parents who lived in the city and came to live in the apartment "Temari Heights" (てまりハイツ) where her cousin Shion was the caretaker. 
 wonderful encounters that happen in the new high school, every new day. 
 Flower name slowly opened her heart to the people around her, spending a happy and shining time. 
 Hilarious like a child, heartbeat like an adult... 
 Lovely, full and heart-warming leisurely growth story.

36773.title: Super heartbeat! Art star
36773.description:
The story takes place in a world where art can be turned into magic. Magic artists are a group of people who can use magic art to bring people various touches. They are active in various commercial exhibitions. 
 Private Star Forest Magic Art High School is a school that specializes in training magic artists. The protagonist is a transfer student who came here as a special case. 
 Shortly after the transfer, he was appointed as the executive committee member of the traditional culture festival "Star Forest Summer FES.", and will start an exciting campus life with 6 different men who will become magic artists in the future. 
 Finally, can they successfully hold the cultural festival and be selected as the annual best male and female partner "Magic Artist Prince & Princess"?
36773.originName: マジきゅんっ！ルネッサンス

36779.title: Mobile New Stories Team Moe Sword
36779.originName: 機動新撰組 萌えよ剣

36797.title: Crayon Shin-chan: The Hidden Treasure of the Buri Buri Kingdom
36797.originName: クレヨンしんちゃん ブリブリ王国の秘宝

36798.title: Crayon Shin-chan: Action Mask vs. Leotard Devil
36798.originName: クレヨンしんちゃん アクション仮面VSハイグレ魔王

36799.title: Crayon Shin-chan: Pursuit of the Balls of Darkness
36799.originName: クレヨンしんちゃん 暗黒タマタマ大追跡

36800.title: Crayon Shin-chan: Unkokusai's Ambition
36800.originName: クレヨンしんちゃん 雲黒斎の野望

36807.title: The Twelve Kingdoms
36807.description: Nakajima Youko is your average somewhat timid high school student. One day, a strange man named Keiki appears before her, swearing allegiance. Before she could properly register what was happening, demon-like creatures attack Youko and her friends, after which they are pulled into a different world. A world unlike what she has ever known. Separated from Keiki, Youko and her friends must do whatever they can if they wish to survive in this new world.

36812.title: Angel Beats!
36812.description: The story begins with the actor waking up from the "world after death" after the death of the hero. In the school in the "world after death", he and a man named Yuri (ゆり) lead a "world after death". Girls from an organization called "Shinda (Shinda) World (Sekai) Front (Sensen)" for short "SSS" met. The main purpose of "SSS" was to fight against the angels who gave them the sad fate of their lives and their messengers. In front of the angels' supernatural powers, "SSS" could only use guns to resist. Just like this, a super war story that took place in the school of "the world after death" began...

36815.title: Anime-Gataris
36815.description: After dreaming about an anime she used to watch as a child, Minoa Asagaya could not forget a particularly memorable scene. However, despite her best efforts, she cannot recall the name of the show. Due to this, Minoa asks for help from her fellow classmates at Sakaneko High School. Her conversation is overheard by Arisu Kamiigusa, the most popular and wealthy girl in class who is also a hardcore otaku. Yet even with her vast knowledge, Arisu does not recognize the show.

36816.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
36816.originName: 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ

36817.title: Puella Magi Madoka Theatrical Version [Part 1] The beginning story
36817.originName: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [前編] 始まりの物語

36818.title: Theatrical version of Puella Magi Madoka Magica [New Edition] Rebellious Story
36818.originName: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [新編] 叛逆の物語

36819.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica theatrical version [Part 2] Forever Story
36819.originName: 劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [後編] 永遠の物語

36820.title: Blue Spring Ride
36820.description: Futaba Yoshioka used to be an attractive and popular middle-schooler—well liked by the opposite sex, but ostracized by the girls. Nevertheless, she was able to brush all that off, because the only opinion that truly mattered to her was that of Kou Tanaka, a classmate with whom she shared a shelter from rain once, followed by quite a few other precious and significant memories. She even succeeded at making plans to meet with the quiet and innocent boy at the summer festival, but a simple misunderstanding, and Tanaka's subsequent disappearance, left her walking the halls of her school friendless.

36827.title: Plunderer
36827.description: In a post-apocalyptic world dominated by the so-called "Numbers," each human will have their identity branded with their own "Count," which could define any number related to their life. May it be one's walked distance or amount of compliments given to them by others, this Count could lead them to the abyss when it has dropped to zero. In the year 305 of the Alcian calendar, Hina has inherited a mission from her Mother, whose Count has depreciated to zero, to search for the Legendary Red Baron. In her adventure, she meets a half-masked swordsman named Licht who tries to hide his identity, as he is known as a degenerate for having an incredibly low Count.

36844.title: The gift of memory to the mountain
36844.originName: ヤマノススメ おもいでプレゼント

36860.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO
36860.description:
In 1972, the Apollo 17 moon landing plan discovered on the moon the "hyperspace gate", an ancient civilization heritage linking the earth and Mars. Then the Earth sent a survey mission headed by Dr. Reliegalia to Mars. Discover the "Aldnoah" technology of ancient Martian civilization on Mars. With the process of Mars colonization and technological monopoly claims, the friction between Mars pioneers and the earth has increased. 
 In 1985, Dr. Reliegalia established the "Viser Empire" on Mars and proclaimed himself emperor. In 1986, the Earth formed a coalition government to fight Mars. In 1999, the second emperor Kirzelia, the son of Reliegalia, declared war on the earth, but died during the aggression from the disaster "Heaven's fall" that destroyed the moon due to the loss of control of the hyperspace gate. In 2000, Mars and the Earth ceased war. 
 In 2014, the Earth and Mars, which have been in a truce for more than ten years, are undergoing peace talks. On the other hand, based on the assumption that the earth and Mars will fight again, fighting skills and humanoid combat weapons have entered the earth’s compulsory education. High school Inaho Kaizuka, who lives in Shin-Awara, Japan, is one of those who grew up in Sri Lanka. 
 At the same time, the princess of the Visser Empire, Ethelam Visser Eleosia, visited the earth as a goodwill ambassador, and the one who watched her leave behind her was born on the earth and grew up on Mars. Young Slein Troyette. However, her parade convoy was subsequently attacked by missiles from the Visser Empire spy in Shin-Awara City. The Martian knights on the front line regarded it as a declaration of war on the earth, and they will be stationed on the earth...

36872.title: The clumsy Ueno
36872.description:
This is the science room of a middle school————. 
 Ueno, the head of the science department, is a girl in love who admires Tanaka, the school’s younger brother. 
 She uses whimsical inventions that are too genius to try to attract Tanaka's attention by various means. Yamashita, a member of Grade 
 , also supported Ueno with calm and calm support! 
 Can Ueno's romance succeed? ?

36886.title: The Princess and the Pilot
36886.originName: とある飛空士への追憶

36894.title: Saint Tail
36894.originName: 怪盗セイント・テール

36903.title: Active Raid-Mobile Assault Room Lesson 8-2nd
36903.originName: アクティヴレイド -機動強襲室第八係- 2nd

36913.title: Tianyuan Breakthrough Honglian Luoyan Honglian Chapter
36913.originName: 劇場版 天元突破グレンラガン 紅蓮篇

36914.title: Tianyuan breaks through the red lotus snail rock
36914.originName: 劇場版 天元突破グレンラガン 螺巌篇

36915.title: Theatrical version of Delusional Student Union
36915.description: The movie version of "Seitokai Yakuindomo", which is an animated version of the popular gag manga by Tozen Ujiie serialized in "Weekly Shonen Magazine", and the first period of the series was broadcast on TV in 2010 and the second period in 2014. Due to the declining birthrate, the school was co-educated from high school girls, and the ratio of males and females was 28: 524. Became the chairman and portray the school life with unique student organization members. The director is Hiromitsu Kanazawa, following the first and second seasons of the TV series. The cast will also include members of the TV series, including Shintaro Asanuma, Yoko Hikasa, and Satomi Sato.
36915.originName: 劇場版 生徒会役員共

36920.title: My First Girlfriend is a Gal
36920.description:
Following a prank pulled by his perverse friends, Junichi Hashiba asks a gal out in an attempt to change the fact that he's a hopeless virgin. Yukana Yame, the girl in question, is disgusted by Junichi's groveling. However, through a series of teasing remarks, she soon finds herself bonding with him and ultimately accepting Junichi's confession, much to his surprise.

Hajimete no Gal follows Junichi as he overcomes his lack of self-confidence and suppresses his sexual urges, all while thrust into a whole new school life full of lively girls and unpredictable mayhem.

36921.title: From a calm tomorrow
36921.description:
People in the past lived in the world in the sea, and could breathe and live in the sea. However, people who longed for land abandon the sea and the feather garments given by the sea god. Humans are gradually divided into humans living in the sea and humans living on land. People who originally communicated with each other in the same way have different ideas as time goes by. 
 Four young girls living in the sea-Hikari Maeshima, Aika Mukai, Chisaki Hiragira, and Isaki. They were transferred to Mihama Middle School on the land because of the abolition of Boro Middle School of Shikao Haimura, where they met a boy born on land, Kihara Bosu, and they met.

36929.title: Muscle girl: How many kilograms can you lift with dumbbells?
36929.originName: ダンベル何キロ持てる？

36934.title: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
36934.description: Noir is the son of a minor noble with very little to his name other than a job offer—which is canceled before he can even start his first day. He does possess one rare trait, though: the magical ability to consult with a great sage, even if using the skill gives him terrible headaches! Unsure of what his future holds, he accesses the sage for advice on how to move forward and is directed to a secret dungeon filled with rare beasts and magical items. It is here that Noir will train, compiling experience and wealth, until he's powerful enough to change his fate.
36934.originName: 俺だけ入れる隠しダンジョン

36935.title: Redo of Healer
36935.description:
"Healing magicians cannot fight alone."

Keare, who was bound by this common knowledge, was exploited again and again by others. One day, he noticed what lay beyond healing magic, and was convinced that a healing magician was the strongest class. However, by the time he realized that potential, he was deprived of everything. Thus, he used healing magic on the world itself to go back four years, deciding to redo everything.

This is a heroic tale of one healing magician who became the strongest by using knowledge from his past life and healing magic.

36936.title: World Witches Take Off!
36936.description: Countries all over the world formed an alliance to counter the emerging enemy of mankind "Neuroi," whom only girls with special powers could counter. However, the Neuroi never appeared. Instead of fighting, the witches spend their days idly. This time following not only unit 501, but also unit 502 known as "Brave Witches!" The 2nd volume of the comical daily drama of the witches who do not fight Neuroi begins!
36936.originName: ワールドウィッチーズ 発進しますっ！

36937.title: Project Scard: Scar on the Praeter
36937.description:
Project Scard depicts the encounters and battles of those who have tattoos which possess the sealed powers of divine beasts and gods. The story is set in the Akatsuki Special Zone, a lawless zone in Tokyo.

"Helios" are those who use the ability of the tattoos to protect the city, "Artemis" are committed to maintain security and control, whilst having a strong commercial motive, and the "Public Security Special Service" are Scard Staff of the metropolitan police department. They live through the turbulent days to keep on going.

36938.title: Non Non Biyori Nonstop
36938.description: The third season of Non Non Biyori.
36938.originName: のんのんびより のんすとっぷ

36944.title: Toward the mountain S2
36944.originName: ヤマノススメ セカンドシーズン

36951.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
36951.originName: 荒ぶる季節の乙女どもよ。

36970.title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann
36970.description:
Simon boy who lives in an underground village is used to the all-day-digging life in the underground village until Kamina, a free-spirited loose cannon bent on making a name for himself.

One day while excavating the earth, Simon stumbles upon a mysterious object that turns out to be the ignition key to an ancient artifact of war, which the duo dubs Lagann. Using their new weapon, Simon and Kamina fend off a surprise attack from the surface to wander the world above.
36970.originName: 天元突破グレンラガン

36971.title: Tanaka-kun is Always Listless
36971.description: For high school student Tanaka, the act of being listless is a way of life. Known for his inattentiveness and ability to fall asleep anywhere, Tanaka prays that each day will be as uneventful as the last, seeking to preserve his lazy lifestyle however he can by avoiding situations that require him to exert himself. Along with his dependable friend Oota who helps him with tasks he is unable to accomplish, the lethargic teenager constantly deals with events that prevent him from experiencing the quiet and peaceful days he longs for.
36971.originName: 田中くんはいつもけだるげ

36978.title: Shomin Sample
36978.description: Kimito Kagurazaka is a commoner with a fetish for men's muscles—or at least that's the lie he must keep telling if he wants to keep himself out of trouble at the elite all-girls school, Seikain Academy. Kidnapped by the school under the assumption that he prefers men, Kimito is made to be their "commoner sample," exposing the girls to both commoner and man so that the transition to the world after school is not jarring. Threatened with castration should his sexual preferences not match the school's assumptions, Kimito keeps up the facade to protect his manhood.
36978.originName: 俺がお嬢様学校に「庶民サンプル」としてゲッツされた件

36980.title: OreShura
36980.description:
The infidelity of Eita Kidou's parents not only made his family fall apart, but also made him skeptic of love. Having no intention to delve into romance, Eita devotes his entire high school life to his studies in order to become a doctor.
It did not take long for the beautiful and popular Masuzu Natsukawa to notice Eita's apathy. Tired of being the object of people's affection, she asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend, as she too feels disgusted at the notion of love. Eita, however, refuses—yet Masuzu has one trick left up her sleeve: Eita’s journal and threatening to post the embarrassing content online if he does not comply.
36980.originName: 俺の彼女と幼なじみが修羅場すぎる

36981.title: The tale of the headless horseman
36981.description:
Tokyo, Ikebukuro. 
The young Ryanomine Teijin who yearned for urban life accepted an invitation from his friend Masaomi Kida, who had played with him since childhood, to leave his hometown and come to Tokyo to enter Ikebukuro Raira Academy. 
And in Ikebukuro, there are a few people who can't provoke, especially Shizuo Heiwajima, who is known as the "strongest" and Rinya Orihara, who runs the information house. In addition, there is an unidentified violent organization called "Dollars" in Ikebukuro. 
 However, on the first day in Beijing, Teijin, who was disturbed by the complicated relationship in Ikebukuro, witnessed the urban legend "Headless Horseman"-Selti Stroud, riding a black motorcycle through the streets. Elson. 
 So, as the slasher incidents occurred one after another in Ikebukuro, Heiwajima Shizuo, Orihara Rinya, Dollars, Headless Horseman, Slasher, Yellow Turban, etc. gradually surfaced around the "Who is the strongest in Ikebukuro". The topic, Ikebukuro is facing collapse, a series of abnormal but straightforward stories began.

36982.title: Servamp
36982.description:
When a stray black cat named Kuro crosses Mahiru Shirota's path, the high school freshman's life will never be the same again. Kuro is, in fact, no ordinary feline, but a "servamp" - a servant vampire.

While Mahiru's personal philosophy is one of non-intervention, he soon becomes embroiled in an ancient, altogether surreal conflict between vampires and humans.

36983.title: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
36983.description: The Servamps and their pact-bound "Eves" are finally getting back to their normal lives as they recover from their injuries from the previous battles. However, when it starts snowing in the middle of summer, one of the Eves, Mahiru Shirota, suspects vampiric interference. Concerned by the strange phenomenon, he sets out to gather the group once more to try and solve the mystery; however, they suddenly lose contact with Misono Arisuin, the Eve of the Servamp of Lust.
36983.originName: 劇場版 SERVAMP -サーヴァンプ- Alice in the Garden

36985.title: Love song dedicated to a certain pilot
36985.originName: とある飛空士への恋歌

36997.title: Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san
36997.description:
Once a hot springs inn, now a boarding house with extraordinarily cheap rent, Yuragi-sou is virtually uninhabited save for a few peculiar residents. As rumor has it, it is haunted by a vile ghost which scares away all potential tenants. Therefore, it is the perfect refuge for Fuyuzora Kogarashi—a broke, homeless psychic seeking an affordable roof to stay under and ghosts to exorcise.

Kogarashi prepares for a face-off against the ghost, only to find out it is not as malicious as the rumors made it out to be. Instead, it is the ghost of a beautiful, silver-haired girl whose only recollection of her life before death is her name: Yuuna. Even more baffling is that the other tenants of Yuragi-sou not only are able to see Yuuna as well, but each has their own supernatural ability.

Amidst the chaos caused by his quirky fellow residents, Kogarashi attempts to uncover the regret that keeps Yuuna anchored to the world of the living, lest she become an evil spirit sentenced to spend her afterlife in hell.

36998.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life
36998.description: Gen Kudou, a koto maker, believes that his delinquent grandson Chika would never understand the profoundness of the traditional musical instrument. In an attempt to make up for his naivety and understand the words of his late grandfather, Chika tries to join the Tokise High School Koto Club.

36999.title: One Week Friends
36999.description: Kaori Fujimiya is always alone because all of her happy memories, including time spent with her friends, disappear every Monday. Deciding that he wants to be friends with her anyway, Yuuki Hase tries to get close to Kaori each week, wishing that she would one day call him "a friend."

37001.title: Ginga Kikoutai Majestic Prince Movie: Kakusei no Idenshi
37001.description: In the latter half of 21st century, humans leave the Earth and begin to live in space. In order to adapt to the environment in space and deal with the hostile aliens in Jupiter, genetically engineered children called "Princes" are artificially raised and trained to be pilots of armed robots "AHSMB (Advanced High Standard Multipurpose Battle Device). This is a story about one of the teenage "Princes," Hitachi O Izuru, who studies in an academic city Grandzehle.
37001.originName: 劇場版 マジェスティックプリンス 覚醒の遺伝子

37002.title: The Legend of Galactic Heroes Die Neue These Encounters
37002.originName: 銀河英雄伝説 Die Neue These 邂逅

37006.title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light

37011.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil
37011.description: On the front lines of the war, there is a little girl. Blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain white skin, she commands her squad with lisping voice. Her name is Tanya Degurechaff. But in reality, she is one of Japan's most elite salarymen, reborn as a little girl into a world of magical warfare after angering a mysterious being who calls himself God. Tanya resolves to ascend the ranks of her country's military as it slowly plunges into world war, with only Being X proving to be the strongest obstacle in recreating the peaceful life she once knew. But her perceptive actions and combat initiative have an unintended side effect: propelling the mighty Empire into becoming one of the most powerful nations in mankind's history.

37013.title: K-On!: Ura-On!
37013.description: The seven Blu-ray disc volumes of K-ON! have an extra short anime "Ura-ON!"

37014.title: Tamako Love Story
37014.description: As she edges toward the end of her high school life, the energetic but generally clueless third-year Tamako Kitashirakawa has only one major concern: pulling off a stunning baton performance at the Usagiyama Marching Festival. But all too soon, she is confronted by the reality that all her friends have big plans for their futures; she, on the other hand, just operates with the moderate goal of continuing to work at her family's restaurant. Under the same brilliant sky, Mochizou Ooji intends to study at a university in Tokyo, leaving behind his family, friends, and most importantly, his first and only love Tamako. Unfortunately, the shy admirer cannot bring himself to declare his love, and Tamako is yet unaware that she is the source of such anguish. With time quickly running out, Mochizou must confess his feelings to Tamako soon, or his dream of romance will never be fulfilled.
37014.originName: たまこラブストーリー

37020.title: The Pet Girl of Sakurasou
37020.originName: さくら荘のペットな彼女

37025.title: Black Rock Shooter
37025.originName: ブラック★ロックシューター

37028.title: Citrus
37028.description: Yuzu, a high school gyaru who hasn't experienced her first love yet, transfers to an all-girls school after her mother remarries. She's beyond upset that she can't land a boyfriend at her new school. Then, on her first day, she meets the beautiful black-haired student council president Mei in the worst way possible. What's more, she later finds out that Mei is her new step-sister, and they'll be living under the same roof! And so the love affair between two polar opposite high school girls who find themselves drawn to one another begins!

37046.title: Yuri!!! on Ice
37046.description:
Reeling from his crushing defeat at the Grand Prix Finale, Yuuri Katsuki, once Japan's most promising figure skater, returns to his family home to assess his options for the future. At age 23, Yuuri's window for success in skating is closing rapidly, and his love of pork cutlets and aptitude for gaining weight are not helping either.

However, Yuuri finds himself in the spotlight when a video of him performing a routine previously executed by five-time world champion, Victor Nikiforov, suddenly goes viral. In fact, Victor himself abruptly appears at Yuuri's house and offers to be his mentor. As one of his biggest fans, Yuuri eagerly accepts, kicking off his journey to make it back onto the world stage. But the competition is fierce, as the rising star from Russia, Yuri Plisetsky, is relentlessly determined to defeat Yuuri and win back Victor's tutelage.

37048.title: Melancholy things
37048.description: The task of returning the monsters who were supposed to be in the "hidden world" but ended up staying in the "present world" for various reasons is what is referred to as the "elimination of demons." By using accidentally found contact information, a high school student named Ashiya Hanae who was under the influence of a monster visited the store "Mononokean," where monsters are exorcised. There was Harusai Abe, the displeased shop owner. For some reason, Ashiya began serving the government. Here, the tale of the monsters and the demon union of Abe and Ashiya began.
37048.originName: 不機嫌なモノノケ庵 續

37093.title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
37093.description: Suddenly, clusters of ancient dynastic ruins called "DUNGEON" appear one after another in the world. Legend has it that this contains magical items called "DJINN goldware" "and mountains of gold and silver treasures sleeping forever. In the desert city of Oasis, Alibaba, a young man working in Qishan, is one of those who dream of gaining a lot of money because of the "labyrinth". One day he meets up with Aladdin, a young man with incredible powers. The adventure of Aladdin and Alibaba now begins.
37093.originName: マギ The labyrinth of magic

37097.title: Magic Sister
37097.description:
"I met her..., and the cute but'weird' senior!" 
 likes conjure, but because of stage fright, the failure rate is 100%! ? 
 was forced to join the magic club by such a "senior sister", but was used as an "assistant"... 
 The busker sisters and brothers "A Saki" and "A Masa" and "Maa" from the chemistry department are involved. The senpai is also full of energy today, with a little bit of color and a big failure! 
 picture is too beautiful to watch but still want to watch the clumsy trick funny animation!

37104.title: Do you like the mother who can attack all the people and can attack twice?
37104.description: Masato Oosuki is a teenager who is usually annoyed by his overly doting mother, Mamako, until both are teleported to a fantasy-themed world inside an online game.
37104.originName: 通常攻撃が全体攻撃で二回攻撃のお母さんは好きですか？

37109.title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪: Maji Love 2000%
37109.description:
Entering her Master's course, Nanami Haruka is facing an even more difficult time. And she isn't the only one. The main six members of Starish are assigned new seniors to watch over them! But the seniors aren't having the best attitudes about it.

Watch Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love 2000% and find yourself completely engaged in a whole new adventure mixed in with comedy and romance!
37109.originName: うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪ マジLOVE2000%

37110.title: Magic Kaito
37110.description: Kid, the strange thief known as "Heisei Lupin," no matter how tightly guarded the diamond jewelry is, it is easy for him. He has always been the nightmare of Zhongsen Yin's third-class police officer, but his identity has always been a mystery. A second-year high school student Kuroba Kuaito is a handsome boy from a family of magicians. He flirts with his childhood sweetheart Aoko Nakamori and enjoys it all day long, which causes a lot of trouble. By chance, he found a secret room behind the portrait of his father, Kuroba Teiichi. Not only did he discover various sophisticated equipment, but also discovered that his father, who died in an accident 8 years ago, was inextricably related to Kid... A few days later, Kidd, who had disappeared for many years, issued a notice that he would steal the jewel Moon Eye from the Tokyo City Art Museum. A new war between police and thieves begins...

37111.title: Magic Kaito 1412
37111.description: "Magic Kaito 1412" is a TV anime series adapted from the manga "Magic Kaito" created by Japanese cartoonist Aoyama Gosho. It is the TMS version of "Magic" that was broadcast intermittently as a special chapter of "Detective Conan" After "Quick Fight" animation, an independent animation series broadcast.

37114.title: One Piece: Dead End
37114.description: The crew of Luffy and his ship have arrived at Anabaru's harbour. An enormous monetary reward awaits the first person who reaches the finish line first in a competition organized by the local casino. The competition is an exciting opportunity for Nami, so she decides to participate. It turns out that there is a conspiracy behind the competition, which is helmed by Gasparde, an ex-military commander. It is his plan to lure all the pirates to the military base and send them all to their deaths there. This dead-end adventure requires Luffy and his friends to overcome numerous tests and tribulations along the way.
37114.originName: ONE PIECE THE MOVIE デッドエンドの冒険

37116.title: One Piece: The Curse of the Sacred Sword
37116.description: As part of his quest to find the world's most expensive sword, Luffy and his crew head to an island. The crew was soon split by attacking marines and beautiful maidens. As Zoro betrays the crew to help an old friend, Luffy and Usopp wander through a cave, and the rest help a village fight marines, they help the crew defend their village from the marines. The sacred pearls Zoro takes during his defeat of Sanji are the only defense against the evil sword that will plunge the world into darkness.
37116.originName: ONE PIECE 呪われた聖剣

37118.title: One Piece: Clockwork Island Adventure
37118.description: Trump Kyoudai (Trump Siblings) who have established a base on Clockwork Island have stolen his ship, according to the Thief Brothers. The Going Merry's Captain, Monkey D. Luffy, works with his crew to recapture their ship on Clockwork Island - Usopp, Zoro, Sanji and Nami.
37118.originName: ONE PIECE ねじまき島の冒険

37120.title: One Piece: The Movie
37120.description:
Woonan is the legendary Great Gold Pirate, earning the nickname after accumulating about 1/3 of the gold available in the world. Even after his disappearance, the tales of his gold being stashed away in a remote island continue to persist, a juicy target that other pirates lust for.
One of the pirates going to great lengths to attain the treasure is El Drago. He and his crew have hunted down Woonan's former crew members one by one, and along the way, they find the map that will take them to the hidden island.
The map is not all they come across; they also manage to come into contact with the straw hat pirates. After a short battle, Luffy and company are robbed and separated from one another. Now they must find a way to make it to the island before El Drago does and take the legendary treasure for themselves.

37121.title: One Piece: The Giant Mechanical Soldier of Karakuri Castle
37121.description: The Straw Hats fished out a treasure chest from a sunken ship, but they found that it didn't contain any treasures like gold or silver, but an old woman. In order to let the Straw Hats take her home, but also afraid of being hurt by the pirates, the old woman promised them that if she can return home safely, she would give them the "Golden Crown" on their Mecha Island. However, after arriving on the island, the Straw Hats were attacked by the island owner, instead of fighting back, they chose to listen to their voices and help unlock the secret of the Golden Crown.
37121.originName: ONE PIECE  THE MOVIE カラクリ城のメカ巨兵

37122.title: One Piece: Stampede
37122.description: The Pirates Festival is the largest exhibition of pirates ever put up by pirates. The host Buena Festa, also known as the Master of Festivities, extends an invitation to Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat Crew. When they arrive, they discover a location filled with opulent pavilions and a large number of pirates, including those from the Worst Generation. The atmosphere is intense.

37123.title: One Piece Luffy Special: Adventure on Palm Island
37123.description:
A TV special work following "Episode of Nami" (broadcast in August 2012). It was a special project to commemorate the release of the 12th movie "ONE PIECE FILM Z" and was broadcast on the same day as the movie's release date. 
 Unlike the previous "Episode" series, where the story is based on the original story, it is composed mainly of a completely new story. In the story, the scenes with the Red-Haired Pirates and the Alvida gang in the first and second episodes of the original are remade in the form of recollections of Luffy and Coby. Coby and Helmepo have appeared in the New World edition prior to the original manga. 
 Shizuka Kudo was in charge of the costume design for the Straw Hat Pirates, and the costume was shown in the form of a fashion show at the opening scene. 
 the "Out x Deluxe" program that was broadcast the day before, program guests Domu Narita and Keiji Yamashita will appear as villagers, and the state of Ateleco was broadcast [2] [3]. In addition, Fuji TV announcer Midori Matsuo also appears as a guest in the role of a clerk. 
 On March 22, 2013, Blu-ray Disc and DVD were released.
37123.originName: ONE PIECE エピソードオブルフィ 〜ハンドアイランドの冒険〜

37124.title: One Piece: Episode of Merry - The Tale of One More Friend
37124.description: Starting with the duel between Luffy and Usopp, to the disappearance of Robin, and finally the crew saying goodbye to their ship in tears, the chapter of the first ship of the Straw Hat crew, the Golden Merry, was completely reset in the movie. When Luffy, Zoro, Nami and the rest of the crew set sail to find the legendary treasure One Piece, the Golden Merry is also seen as a member of the Straw Hat Pirates on their adventure together.
37124.originName: ONE PIECE エピソードオブメリー 〜もうひとりの仲間の物語〜

37125.title: One Piece: Strong World
37125.description: Once hearing the news that several islands in East Blue are being destroyed, Monkey D. Luffy and his friends immediately go to investigate. On their way, however, an outlandish pirate ship appears out of the sky, which is under the control of the infamous pirate Shiki, namely, "the Golden Lion", the man who ate the Float-Float Fruit and was the first jailbreaker from Impel Down. Shiki has a desire to defeat the World Government while lacking a useful assistant, therefore, Shiki kidnaps Nami to be his own navigator and sends the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates to his floating islands as hostages, which made her in a dilemma. Separated in a land under Shiki's absolute control, Luffy and his crew must survive the mystifying terrain in order to bring back their navigator as well as friend.

37127.title: One Piece Sapo Special Chapter Three Brothers' Bonds, Miracle Reunion and Inherited Will
37127.description: The film tells the story of Sabo as the protagonist. Sabo met Luffy and Ace when he was a child and became sworn brothers. He hated his noble family background, hated the noble education instilled by his parents, and advocated freedom. On the day when he prepared a small boat to set sail, unfortunately, he met a passing Celestial Dragons. The boat was sunk, and Sabo drowned in the sea. Fortunately, he was rescued by the revolutionary army leader, Monkey D. Dragon, and was trained by him. Later, Sabo served as the chief of staff of the Revolutionary Army, that is, the "Second Number One" of the Revolutionary Army. A few years passed, Sabo replaced Luffy in Dressrosa's arena and won the game, ate Ace's relic, and inherited the will of his brother.
37127.originName: ONE PIECE エピソードオブサボ 〜3兄弟の絆 奇跡の再会と受け継がれる意志〜

37128.title: One Piece: Episode of Chopper Plus - Bloom in the Winter
37128.description: The film is a reset of the Drum Island arc with new music and animations. Vivi has been removed from the main storyline, but Nico Robin and Franky, who boarded after the Drum Island storyline, have been added. In addition, the new ship of the Straw Hat Pirates, and the Thousand Sunny also appears in this work. According to author Oda, a new character will be created for the film, namely, Wapol's older brother, who also appears to be a Devil Fruit user...
37128.originName: ONE PIECE THE MOVIE エピソードオブチョッパー 冬に咲く、奇跡の桜

37130.title: One Piece: Chopper Kingdom of Strange Animal Island
37130.description: The Straw Hat Pirates have come to Crown Island, where animals can speak the human language, and they want Chopper to be their new king. But there are also human hunters who have landed on the island, in search of the legendary horn that gives the wielders great power. In order to protect the island and protect the animals that live on the island, Luffy and his friends must stop the hunters from destroying the animal kingdom.
37130.originName: ONE PIECE 珍獣島のチョッパー王国

37131.title: One Piece 3D2Y crosses the death of Ace! Pledge with Luffy partners
37131.description: The new story of this work is based on the timeline after the end of the Great War on the top of Malinfando. It tells the story of Luffy being photographed flying to Ruscana Island to learn domineering during the years of losing Ace forever and being separated from his companions. Characters like Silvers Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, Bucky, Perona, and more will also be featured. In addition, there will be a new enemy - Byrnndi World, who has the Devil Fruit.
37131.originName: ONE PIECE “3D2Y” エースの死を越えて! ルフィ仲間との誓い

37139.title: Chihayafuru
37139.description:
Tomboyish girl Chihaya Ayase is contented with her share in life till she meets Arata Wataya, a quiet transfer student who introduces her to competitive karuta.

Along with the prodigy Arata and her haughty but hard-working friend Taichi Mashima, she joins the local Shiranami Society. The trio spends their idyllic childhood days playing together, until circumstances split them up.

37150.title: Active Raid -Mobile Assault Room Lesson 8-
37150.originName: アクティヴレイド -機動強襲室第八係-

37179.title: Made in Abyss
37179.description: The “Abyss” is the last unexplored region, an enormous and treacherous cave system filled with ancient relics and strange creatures. Only the bravest of adventurers can traverse its depths, earning them the nickname, “Cave Raiders.” Within the depths of the Abyss, a girl named Riko stumbles upon a robot who looks like a young boy. Tantalized by the Abyss, Riko and her new friend descend into uncharted territory to unlock its mysteries, but what lies in wait for them in the darkness?

37182.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
37182.description:
Revered as heroes for their role in defending Tristain, Louise Françoise and her familiar Saito Hiraga face heavy pressure to continue protecting the Kingdom. With an uneasy peace now established within Albion, the newly crowned Queen Henrietta must deal with a political struggle brewing on the horizon. To make matters worse, a new villain has begun plotting in the shadows against the Crown.

With the continuing threats that face the Kingdom, Louise and Saito are compelled to work together once more. No longer "Louise the Zero," the young mage's newfound aptitude for Void magic gives her enough power to wipe out an entire village; however, wielding these abilities comes with its share of challenges. As more conflicts arise, the idea of placing honor above oneself is put into question—regardless of their answer, their only choice is to see it through until the end.
37182.originName: ゼロの使い魔 双月の騎士

37183.title: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of the Princesses OVA
37183.description: DVD beach episode of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo. Also known as episode #6.5.
37183.originName: ゼロの使い魔 ～三美姫の輪舞～OVA

37184.title: The Familiar of Zero F
37184.description:
Saito Hiraga and Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière go on the offensive after the events of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo. Together, they face off against King Joseph in the Holy City of Romalia with the help of two others who control the power of the “void”. But in the midst of the many conflicts ahead of them, an ancient evil begins to stir in the shadows.

Will their close bonds blossom into something more or will they be shattered through the ever increasing difficulty of the tasks that they must undertake? Zero no Tsukaima F follows the story of Louise and Saito as they face their final challenges together.

37272.title: Kamisama Kiss S2
37272.description:
Nanami Momozono and her familiars Tomoe and Mizuki have survived quite a few challenges since Nanami took up the mantle of Mikage Shrine's patron god. Naturally, the wind god Otohiko comes to invite Nanami to the Divine Assembly in Izumo, the home of the gods, and Nanami chooses to take Mizuki with her, leaving Tomoe to pose as her at school. However, she has an ulterior motive for attending the Divine Assembly: to discover the whereabouts of the missing Lord Mikage, the former god of the shrine.

After her adventures in Izumo, Nanami meets Botanmaru, a tengu child looking for someone she knows all too well—tengu turned goth idol Shinjirou Kurama. Botanmaru needs Shinjirou, their prince, to return home to Mount Kurama and stop the tyranny of Jirou, who has taken over the rule of their hometown. However, Nanami soon discovers a force much darker than Jirou is at work on the mountain.

As a fledgling god becoming more accustomed to divinity, Nanami finds herself dealing with a tengu rebellion, her blooming feelings for Tomoe, and a strange man with ties to both Tomoe's past and Nanami's future.

37275.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!: Rikka Version
37275.description: This movie serves as a bridge between the first and second seasons. It features Rikka and Yuuta's search for a new apartment for her to live in while retelling the events of the first season though flashbacks from Rikka's perspective.
37275.originName: 小鳥遊六花・改 ～劇場版 中二病でも恋がしたい！～
