However, with a dark record of being the sole survivor in every mission that results in being nicknamed "Grim Reaper," she suspects she already knows why she was chosen.

Prepared to be shunned yet again, she arrives at the Tateyama Valkyrie Wing. Little does she know, her new comrades are a bunch of oddballs who have zero intention of accepting her dreadful nickname!
1004743.originName: 戦翼のシグルドリーヴァ

1004816.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc
1004816.description:
Following the events of "Scorched Halloween," the world is introduced to a terrifyingly powerful Strategic class magician. In an effort to uncover the identity of this person, the United States of the North American Continent (USNA) dispatches the most powerful asset in its arsenal to Japan on a covert mission—the elite magician unit "Stars" and its commander, Angie Sirius.

At First High School, Tatsuya Shiba and his friends are having a farewell party for Shizuku Kitayama, who is leaving to study abroad in the USNA as part of an exchange program. In her place, the group welcomes the beautiful Angelina "Lina" Kudou Shields. Around the same time, Tatsuya is informed about the USNA's plan to uncover his true identity.

Elsewhere in Tokyo, numerous reports arise of seemingly random bodies found drained of blood. Dubbed as the works of a vampire, it does not take long for Tatsuya to connect the dots and realize that it is almost impossible for the timing of these events to be mere coincidences.
1004816.originName: 魔法科高校の劣等生 来訪者編

1004889.title: 91 Days
1004889.description:
As a child living in the town of Lawless, Angelo Lagusa has witnessed a tragedy: his parents and younger brother have been mercilessly slaughtered by the Vanetti mafia family. Losing everything he holds dear, he leaves both his name and hometown behind, adopting the new identity of Avilio Bruno.

Seven years later, Avilio finally has his chance for revenge when he receives a mysterious letter prompting him to return to Lawless. Obliging, he soon encounters the Vanetti don's son, Nero, and seeks to befriend him using the skills he has quietly honed for years.

Set during the Prohibition era, 91 Days tells the story of Avilio's dark, bloodstained path to vengeance, as he slowly ends each of the men involved in the killing of his family.

1004995.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
1004995.description:
Since childhood, Elaina has always been fascinated by the stories written within her favorite book, especially those about Nike, a renowned witch who had numerous great travels across the world. Wanting to experience the awe of adventure herself, Elaina strives to become a witch, and despite the numerous trials that come her way, she eventually succeeds.

Now a full-fledged witch, Elaina finally embarks on her long-awaited journey, in which she meets many people along the way, learning their various stories. Through all of this, she explores the world at its fullest—experiencing both its bright and dark sides—starting her legendary tale.

1005144.title: Naruto
1005144.description: In another world, ninja are the ultimate power, and in the Village Hidden in the Leaves live the stealthiest ninja in the land. Twelve years earlier, the fearsome Nine-Tailed Fox terrorized the village and claimed many lives before it was subdued and its spirit sealed within the body of a baby boy. That boy, Naruto Uzumaki, has grown up to become a ninja-in-training who's more interested in pranks than in studying ninjutsu.. but Naruto is determined to become the greatest ninja ever!

1005195.title: Naruto: Shippuden
1005195.description: It has been two and a half years since Naruto Uzumaki left Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf Village, for intense training following events which inspired his desire to become stronger. Now Akatsuki who is the mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, is closing in on their grand plan which may threaten the safety of the entire shinobi world.

1005299.title: Museum of Humanity
1005299.description: After the end of the world, there is a mysterious museum left in the world. No one knows where the collection came from. Are these seemingly funny "historical relics" proof of the existence of real humans?

1005426.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
1005426.description: Son of Naruto Uzumaki, Boruto, follows his father's footsteps along with his friends to become great ninja. Throughout all their adventures, Boruto is determined to make his mark in the ninja world and live outside of his father's shadow.

1005556.title: Legend of Exorcism S2
1005556.description: Second season of Tian Bao Fuyao Lu.
1005556.originName: 天宝伏妖录 第二季

1005700.title: No Doubt In Us
1005700.description: His Majesty comes close so handsome that flushed queen pushes him reflexively and falls with him together into the pool. Then they swap their bodies. The way to swap back is unknown. The most important thing is that the emperor is quite angry now!! Before every comes to normal, emperor has to deal with his mean imperial concubines that he never knows and the queen has to mediate between those ministeries...

1005762.title: Attack on Titan S3 (Thai ver.)
1005762.description:
Still threatened by the "Titans" that rob them of their freedom, mankind remains caged inside the two remaining walls. Efforts to eradicate these monsters continue; however, threats arise not only from the Titans beyond the walls, but from the humans within them as well.

After being rescued from the Colossal and Armored Titans, Eren Yaeger devotes himself to improving his Titan form. Krista Lenz struggles to accept the loss of her friend, Captain Levi chooses Eren and his friends to form his new personal squad, and Commander Erwin Smith recovers from his injuries. All seems well for the soldiers, until the government suddenly demands custody of Eren and Krista. The Survey Corps' recent successes have drawn attention, and a familiar face from Levi's past is sent to collect the wanted soldiers. Sought after by the government, Levi and his new squad must evade their adversaries in hopes of keeping Eren and Krista safe.

In Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3, Eren and his fellow soldiers are not only fighting for their survival against the terrifying Titans, but also against the terror of a far more conniving foe: humans.

1005888.title: Ling Cage
1005888.description: In the not-too-distant future, the human world has long been overpopulated. Humanity marched to the stars in search of a new home, and just as this was going on, the moon's alignment caused massive earthquakes to ripple across the world, lasting several decades. Humanity was demolished. When the land finally recovered, humanity reemerged to face this strange yet familiar world. Will we, who once lorded over this domain, still remain the masters of this world?

1006086.title: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 1 - Wandering; Agateram
1006086.description: An adaptation of the the Sixth Singularity, The Sacred Round Table Realm Camelot Singularity of Fate/Grand Order.
1006086.originName: 劇場版 Fate/Grand Order -神聖円卓領域キャメロット- 前編 Wandering; Agateram

1006209.title: God Troubles Me
1006209.description: In the twenty-first century, gods and demons can no longer maintain equilibrium due to the rapid development of people in society. In an effort to restore proper order, the gods began to take care of the world, for which they will send a group of gods and monsters to the world to find the "key" to salvation. Su Moting is a girl with the personality of a “demon child”. When her parents asked her to leave their house so that she could become independent, the girl meets the beautiful and charming god Tianjin and the mysterious demon cat Dukui. So begins the new hectic life of Su Moting.

1006275.title: LINK CLICK
1006275.description: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

1006354.title: Look, I Can See Your Ears!
1006354.description: The cute story of the daily life between a guy and his cat-boy roommate.

1006414.title: Look, I Can See Your Ears! S2
1006414.description: Second season of Wei, Kanjian Erduo La!.
1006414.originName: 喂，看见耳朵啦 第二季

1006548.title: Mini Dragon
1006548.description: Mini Dragon little theater, a warm and healing daily story in every episode, presented to you with sincerity

1006910.title: Rakshasa Street S2
1006910.description: Based on the Chinese Manhua. Rakshasa Street, where evil spirits are attracted to in order to destroy them. A place where spirits and humans co-exist, not all humans can enter Requiem Street. Only those rare-soul users with guardian spirits can enter. Xia Ling was just a normal university intern, but a meeting by chance changes her ordinary life... In this world full of evil spirits, can you cooperate with your guardian spirit in order to survive?

1006968.title: Natsume Yujin-cho: Ishiokoshi and Ayashiki Raihou-sha
1006968.description: The movie consists of two episodes, "Ishiokoshi" and "Ayashiki Visitor". In "Ishiokoshi", Natsume meets a small youkai named Mitsumi in the forest. Mitsumi is tasked with awakening the divine youkai "Iwatetsu" from a deep sleep. Mitsumi weighs heavily on Natsume's heart, so she sets out to help Mitsumi with her work.
1006968.originName: 夏目友人帳 石起こしと怪しき来訪者

1007109.title: DIABOLIK LOVERS
1007109.description: At the behest of her father, Yui Komori goes to live in a secluded mansion, home to the six Sakamaki brothers—Shuu, Reiji, Ayato, Kanato, Laito, and Subaru—a family of vampires. Though at first the siblings are confused as to why the girl has arrived, they soon realize that she is to be their new "sacrificial bride," not to mention their other, more carnal intentions for her. After meeting the brothers, Yui quickly begins to question why her father would have sent her here and why she feels a strange, new pain in her chest. With each brother more sadistic than the last, Yui's life as a captive takes a harrowing turn in her new home. As her days turn into endless nights, and each brother vows to make her his own, Yui falls deeper and deeper into madness and ecstasy.

1007160.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles
1007160.description: Rio is a ruthless orphan boy who lives in the slums. At just seven years old, he finds himself the reincarnation of Amakawa Haruto, a Japanese college student with a tragic past. While still reeling from this shocking epiphany, Rio also learns that he possesses extremely powerful magical abilities and uses his new powers to solve the girl's kidnapping case. Her achievements were recognized, and as a reward, she entered a prestigious aristocratic children's academy...?

1007307.title: Jujutsu Kaisen (Thai ver.)
1007307.description: Yuji Itadori, a high school student who indulges in unsubstantiated paranormal phenomena at an occult club, spends his days in the clubroom or in the hospital, visiting his bedridden grandfather. However, even in such a leisurely life, one day he encounters a cursed item. Triggering a series of supernatural events, Yuji was suddenly thrust into the cursed world, a terrifying being formed from human malice and negativity...

1007579.title: DIABOLIK LOVERS MORE,BLOOD
1007579.description: Yui Komori, still held captive by the Sakamaki brothers—pureblood vampires after her blood—experiences yet more bizarre twists to her life following her stay at their household. Though haunted by enigmatic dreams, Yui soon deciphers their meaning when caught in a car crash, which subsequently leads to meeting four new vampires: the Mukami brothers, Ruki, Azusa, Kou, and Yuuma, who themselves capture the bewildered girl.

1007631.title: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
1007631.description:
Yotsuya Yuusuke is a ninth grader who has no friends and doesn't participate in any club activities. Suddenly one day, he and two female classmates are transported to another world where they need to work together and fight for their lives.
Yotsuya was once alone and has always lived his life the way he wanted to, but now he is supposed to be a hero - how will this come about?
1007631.originName: 100万の命の上に俺は立っている

1007824.title: Golden Kamuy 2nd Season
1007824.originName: ゴールデンカムイ 第2期

1007961.title: Golden Kamuy 3rd Season
1007961.originName: ゴールデンカムイ 第3期

1008059.title: Netsuzou Trap -NTR-
1008059.description: Yuma, a sophomore in high school, has her first boyfriend and is enjoying every day. After seeking relationship advice from Hotaru, a beautiful long-time friend of hers who has had many boyfriends, Hotaru teases her immaturity and playfully does things to her that neither her boyfriend would do. As their secret relationship continues to escalate, Yuma finds himself unable to deny his feelings.

1008193.title: My Little Monster
1008193.description: Shizuku Mizutani, a girl with only school and her future plans as her interests, is the focus of the romantic comedy. She once brings printouts to the recurrently absent Yoshida. He thinks the two of them are friends after giving Yoshida the school supplies.

1008245.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she's a cutie?
1008245.description: Keiki Kiryu, an ordinary high school student who didn't have a girlfriend during his lifetime, suddenly receives a love letter, and a romantic comedy begins. The letter does not contain the sender's name, but the letter does contain white panties. In addition to finding the pervert peculiar, Keiki was desperate to have him participate in the perverted behavior of these several girls who surround him...
1008245.originName: 可愛ければ変態でも好きになってくれますか？

1008351.title: The New Prince of Tennis: Hyoutei vs. Rikkai - Game of Future
1008351.originName: 新テニスの王子様 氷帝vs立海 Game of Future

1008561.title: Sword Art Online Alicization War of Underworld
1008561.description:
Quinella, the pontifex of the Axiom Church, was defeated, but the situation does not appear to have yet calmed down. Kazuto "Kirito" Kirigaya learns that Rath's mega-float, the Ocean Turtle, was raided after making communication with the outside world. The invaders trigger a sudden short-circuit that damages Kirito's fluorescent light and renders him unconscious. Alice, despite her expulsion due to an unresolved crime, brings the comatose Kirito back to their village of Rulid Village because she is uneasy about the people at the Axiom Church. Now that Kirito has fallen asleep, Alice is leading a routine, calm existence close to the hamlet.
Tragically, Alice discovers that the Dark Territory has already begun to encroach into the Human Empire. She assumes her former identity, Alice Synthesis Thirty, and vows to destroy the Dark Territory in order to save the world that Kirito and Eugeo have fought so hard to safeguard.
1008561.originName: ソードアート・オンライン アリシゼーション War of Underworld

1008675.title: Sword Art Online Alicization War of Underworld Part 2
1008675.description:
Six months have passed since two sword repairers and an integrated knight defeated the High Priest.
With the battle over, Alice enjoys a quiet and peaceful life in her homeland. Beside her is Kirito, who has lost his best friend, his arm and his heart. "Tell me, Kirito ...... what am I supposed to do?"
However, in the depths of the "Dark Realm", the Dark Lord has risen. He led the armies of the Dark Empire and began to attack the Human World. Peace was shattered and chaos reigned.
1008675.originName: ソードアート・オンライン アリシゼーション War of Underworld -THE LAST SEASON-

1008817.title: Attack on Titan:The Final Season (Thai ver.)
1008817.description:
Gabi Braun and Falco Grice have been training their entire lives to inherit one of the seven titans under Marley's control and aid their nation in eradicating the Eldians on Paradis. However, just as all seems well for the two cadets, their peace is suddenly shaken by the arrival of Eren Yeager and the remaining members of the Survey Corps.
Having finally reached the Yeager family basement and learned about the dark history surrounding the titans, the Survey Corps has at long last found the answer they so desperately fought to uncover. With the truth now in their hands, the group set out for the world beyond the walls.
1008817.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season

1008929.title: City Hunter: Death of the Vicious Criminal Saeba Ryo
1008929.originName: シティーハンタースペシャル 緊急生中継!?凶悪犯冴羽リョウの最期

1009063.title: City Hunter: Goodbye My Sweetheart
1009063.originName: シティーハンタースペシャル グッド・バイ・マイ・スイート・ハート

1009171.title: City Hunter: The Secret Service
1009171.originName: シティーハンタースペシャル ザ・シークレット・サービス

1009223.title: City Hunter: Bay City Wars
1009223.originName: シティーハンター ベイシティウォーズ

1009309.title: City Hunter: Million Dollar Conspiracy
1009309.originName: シティーハンター 百万ドルの陰謀

1009436.title: City Hunter: 357 Magnum
1009436.originName: シティーハンター 愛と宿命のマグナム

1009563.title: I'm standing on 1,000,000 lives S2
1009563.originName: 100万の命の上に俺は立っている

1009621.title: The House Spirit Tatami-chan
1009621.originName: ざしきわらしのタタミちゃん

1009786.title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S
1009786.description:
With Tooru continuing his quest to become the best maid and Kanna Kamui fully immersed in life as an elementary school student, there are no dull days in the Kobayashi family when mischief is a daily staple. A large-scale landslide occurs on the hill where Tohru and Tohru met for the first time. When none of the dragons they know claim responsibility, the perpetrators themselves descend from the sky. Llulu, who is a radical Chaos Dragon with immense power that rivals Tooru.

Tired of Tooru's engaging with humans, Ilulu resorts to the typical dragon way of resolving conflicts: mortal combat. Despite such behavior, she is intrigued by Kobayashi's ability to befriend dragons, and instead decides to observe why Kobayashi is so special. A quirky life with a dragon maid becomes more and more fun.
1009786.originName: 小林さんちのメイドラゴンS

1009917.title: The Dungeon of Black Company
1009917.description: Kinji, who has no work ethic, is lazy in modern times. One day he finds himself transported to another world, but not the epic fantasy of a hero who was welcomed with open arms. After being enslaved by an evil mining company, Kinji is really trying to learn what it means to work hard!
1009917.originName: 迷宮ブラックカンパニー

1009992.title: Kageki Shojo!!
1009992.description: Like the Takarazuka Revue Company, young women who attend Kouka Kageki High School, an arts high school, perform musicals regardless of gender. Ai Narada plays a female role as an exhausted former idol. Sarasa Watanabe, a country girl with sparkling eyes, plays the male role of her roommate. From school to stage, there is no challenge that can't face in her passion for acting.

1010094.title: Life Lessons with Uramichi-Oniisan
1010094.description:
"Hello, kids! Do you like guys with more than one side to them?"

31-year-old Omota Uramichi is a gymnastics coach on the children's TV educational program "Together with Mama". A glimpse of the adult darkness of Mr. Uramichi, who is gentle on the surface but emotionally unstable, scares both boys and girls. This is a tragic tribute to all the "boys and girls" who have grown up!

1010375.title: Peach Boy Riverside
1010375.description: Saltorine Aldike, or called Sari, is a bright and cheerful princess who is bored with her tiny little castle in the countryside and wants to go on an adventure. One day, a horde of evil demons called "Oni" knocks on her doorstep, threatening the lives of everyone in the kingdom. She is saved by a lonely traveler named Mikoto Kibitsu who kills her. Shocked by the dangers of the outside world, Sari decides to embark on a journey of her own. Little does she know that a chain of events that will determine the fate of this magical world will begin.
1010375.originName: ピーチボーイリバーサイド

1010520.title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! X
1010520.description:
Most people would prefer to be the protagonist of a world full of adventure. After being reborn in an alien world, a certain girl regains her memory and realises that she has entered the game she once played, Fortune Lover.
Her reincarnated character, Catarina Claes, faces utter doom in each ending. Using her extensive knowledge of the game, the girl tries to free herself from the shackles of this cursed fate.
However, this is not an easy task, especially as she needs to act with caution so as not to trigger the death mark. How the story will unfold.
1010520.originName: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった…X

1010573.title: Tsukimichi -Moonlit Fantasy-
1010573.description:
A fantasy about Makoto Misumi, an ordinary high school boy summoned to another world as a hero. Unfortunately, the Goddess of the World disparagingly said, "so ugly face," stripped him of his title, and banished him to the farthest reaches of the wilderness.
While wandering the wilderness, Makoto encountered dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves, and all sorts of other non-human species. Due to differences in the environment from his home world, Makoto now exhibits extraordinary powers in magic and combat. Thus, he survives in this world while dealing with various encounters. The curtain rises on the alternate-world social reform fantasy of a boy forsaken by gods and humans.

1010783.title: Mother of the Goddess' Dormitory
1010783.description: Nagumi Koushi, a 12-year-old boy, was abandoned by his father after their house caught fire, leaving him wandering the streets penniless. One day, a girl named Minerva finds him lying on the sidewalk and takes him to a women's college dorm known for housing troublesome residents, and asks him to be their "dorm mom." Surrounded by older women and forced to deal with their idiosyncrasies, Koushi starts his new (and somewhat erotic) life!

1010919.title: The Detective is Already Dead
1010919.description:
Trouble seems to follow Kimizuka Kimihiko everywhere, whether it'sT getting caught up in a murder scene or unintentionally witnessing a narcotics transaction.  Therefore, It comes as little surprise when his otherwise routine aircraft abruptly enters emergency mode and a detective is urgently required on board. Unfortunately, a stunning female with silver hair who goes by the code name Siesta foils his efforts to stay out of trouble. She unceremoniously brings Kimihiko into the investigation as her helper while posing as an investigator.
This incident is the start of an international journey exceeding his wildest fantasies. The two eliminated criminal organisations, averted tragedy, and saved thousands of people while taking risks with their lives. But three years later, Siesta passed away suddenly, bringing a start to their remarkable voyage.
1010919.originName: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。

1011004.title: The aquatope on white sand
1011004.originName: 白い砂のアクアトープ

1011123.title: The Case Study of Vanitas
1011123.description:
This is the story of the vampires who are gradually heading towards destruction.
In the 19th century, humans and vampires exist together in France. Noé, a young vampire, embarks on a journey to Paris to find the "Book of Vanitas", a magic book that spreads curses to vampires.
Suddenly, an incident occurs. During the chaos, Vanitas appears in front of Noé, a human doctor who claims to be a specialist in treating vampires. In his hand is the book Noé is looking for ......
A chance encounter between the two opens the door to a story of damnation and salvation.

1011204.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
1011204.description:
A sizable bungalow is hidden deep inside the wilderness outside the town. There was a death god.
Here is a young master of a certain aristocrat was formerly despised by all around him due to a witch's spell that "everything you touch will die".
This young master is currently most bothered by his maid "Alice"'s reverse sexual harassment.

Being sexually harassed makes this young master who cares about her very happy, yet being unable to touch her hurts.
The young master could not hold Alice's hand, despite the fact that she appeared to care about him. Will their love ultimately be successful?
1011204.originName: 死神坊ちゃんと黒メイド

1011416.title: The Honor Student at Magic High School
1011416.description:
It's been 100 years since legendary magic, true magic, returned to the world. During spring, the season of new beginnings, the first high school attached to the National Magic University, commonly known as the first high school, was about to begin a new semester.

Tatsuya's younger sister, Miyuki Shiba, draws the original story with the naked eye of the popular light novel series "The Irregular at Magic High School". The life of an honor student is full of expectations...and unexpected hidden thoughts!?

1011658.title: Drugstore in Another World: The Slow Life of a Cheat Pharmacist
1011658.description: Reiji, the company slave, is suddenly sent to another world one day. He used his skills to the fullest to create better potions, earning a lot of money with it, and with that money, he built a drugstore! Give him some eye drops! The dragon you're always unleashing unintentionally breathes fire? Don't worry, we've got cough medicine for you! A new fun slow life for pharmacist Reiji, who works at a village drugstore, begins now!
1011658.originName: チート薬師のスローライフ～異世界に作ろうドラッグストア～

1012153.title: Girlfriend, Girlfriend
1012153.description: Mukai Naoya has loved Saki Saki since elementary school, and he is happy when she finally acknowledges his affection. However, Minase Nagisa, a gorgeous girl, confesses to him one day! Naoya decides to go out with both of them since she doesn't want to pick only one over the other. What will become of this morally dubious love triangle?

1012276.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
1012276.description: The Great Jahy, the Dark Realm's second-in-command, cuts a frightening figure, feared and revered by all. But when a run-in with a magical girl results in the destruction of the precious mana crystal, the Dark Realm falls, transporting the newly tiny and powerless Jahy to the human world! Unfortunately, plotting the revival of the Dark Realm from a cramped, crumbling one-room apartment is no easy feat when you have rent to pay and a job to keep!
1012276.originName: ジャヒー様はくじけない！

1012596.title: Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden (TV) 2nd Season
1012596.originName: マギアレコード 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ外伝 2nd SEASON -覚醒前夜-

1013069.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime S2 Part 2
1013069.description: Ordinary corporate employee Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer and reborn in an alien world in the form of a slime. He enters this new world with the name Rimuru Tempest. Through agreements and deals with neighbouring countries, the gentle ideal of [a nation where humans and demons roam together] is gradually realised. However, real life still has its obstacles and his new adventure as a slime monster with unique abilities begins.
1013069.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第2期 2

1013285.title: R.E.D (Rescue Eternal Desert)
1013285.description: After a disaster destroyed the planet, Jiu led a group of armed escorts and traveled around the red wasteland to find the method to heal the planet.

1013371.title: The Unparalleled Black & White
1013371.description: A story about two young demons who are always slacking off at work, a place that happens to be an organization that vows to keep the balance between the worlds of the living and dead by killing humans!

1013552.title: Epic of Divinity Light
1013552.description: Centuries ago, the land of China was full of magical spirits. Those who could utilize the power of spirits were called Exorcists. Their duty was to prevent the Great Diablo, a demon showed up once every millennium, from plaguing the world. In Han Dynasty, however, in a catastrophe known as The Oblivion, all magical spirits vanished overnight. Having lost their powers, Exorcists became a thing in the past. Later, during the incessant war between Qin and Jin kingdoms, the resentful spirits of those who died in vain became the nutrients triggering the revival of the Great Diablo. In order to stop the demon, Chen Xing, the last surviving Exorcist, starts a journey with "Lamp of the Heart", a magical artifact that lives in his soul. He is to travel to Xiangyang City to find Xiangshu, who is destinied to join him to expel the demon.

1013660.title: The Unparalleled Black & White S3
1013660.description: Xiaohei (Wang Heng) and Xiaobai (Yan Liang) are an ordinary team of Black Guard & White Guard (the soul collector) in the underworld. Xiaobai, who has shocking secrets and a huge amount of hidden power, has been targeted by all the beings from three realms. As the brother of Xiaobai, Xiaohei cannot but become the most ferocious fighter to protect his sister and the safety of heaven and earth. Xiaohei and Xiaobai, who are in jeopardy, embark together on a journey into the unforeseeable future.

1013869.title: Fairies Albums S2
1013869.description: Tao Yao is a doctor with a combination of angel and demon in her character. She travels around the world with a young monk named Moya. It isn't long before Gungun the fox, Prince Liu the snake devil and others join their adventure. They show their skills, treat miscellaneous diseases for monsters, and also help humans along their journey.

1013953.title: Great Journey of Teenagers S2
1013953.description:
Second season of Shaonian Ge Xing.
Don't be afraid of failure. Don't waste your youth. After Xiao Se and Lei Wujie came to Snow and Moon City, Sikong Changfeng forcibly took Xiao Se as his apprentice. Lei Wujie and Li Hanyi recognized each other. As Xiao Se entered Snow and Moon City, other princes of Tianqi were eager to seek allies. A battle between princes slowly started at the hero banquet in Lei Jia Bao.
1013953.originName: 少年歌行 风花雪月篇

1014031.title: Salted Fish
1014031.description: This is a story of a preserved fish called Mr. Salted Fish who lives at a seafood restaurant on an island and makes a living by working multiple part-time jobs. Due to his unique way of dealing with things, he frequently finds himself in a survival crisis. That's why he takes up a lot of different jobs on the island. In this way, Mr. Salted Fish gets to know the islanders, who are strange at first. But once he learns about their stories, they become friends, and even family. As the annual Fish God Festival approaches, hilarious incidents around Mr. Salted Fish also begin.

1014088.title: The Defective
1014088.description: Year 270 of the Nova Calendar, General Lin of the Star Alliance is framed and banished to the edge of space. Five years later upon the invation of interstellar pirates, Lin has to start the interstellar adventure and expose the mastermind behind the conspiracy with his "defectives".

1014195.title: Fairies Albums
1014195.description: Tao Yao is a doctor with a combination of angel and demon in her character. She travels around the world with a young monk named Moya. It isn't long before Gungun the fox, Prince Liu the snake devil and others join their adventure. They show their skills, treat miscellaneous diseases for monsters, and also help humans along their journey.

1014306.title: Kakushigoto Movie
1014306.description:
An omnibus of the TV series including new scenes and alternate viewpoints that were not made into TV animation.

Kakushi Gotou is a somewhat popular manga artist known for his inappropriate content. Because of this filthiness, when her daughter Hime was born, he vowed to keep his profession hidden from her, believing that she would be disillusioned if she found out.

This paranoia-induced belief leads Kakushi into hectic situations. Despite being a single father, he tries his best and goes to extremes, such as pretending to be an office worker every day and conducting emergency drills in case Hime finds a way to get to work, just to keep his secret. It often appeals to a purpose.

Kakushi goto is the story of a father and daughter living side by side, maintaining a peaceful existence while the father tries to maintain the status quo. But there is a saying, "There is no secret that time cannot reveal." Eventually, as the princess grows up, she must learn the reality behind what she took for granted.
1014306.originName: 劇場編集版かくしごと ―ひめごとはなんですか―

1014445.title: Dropkick on My Devil!! Dash
1014445.originName: 邪神ちゃんドロップキック’

1014941.title: The Anthem of the Heart
1014941.originName: 心が叫びたがってるんだ。

1014998.title: Magi: The Kingdom of Magic
1014998.description: After the celebration of their victory, Aladdin and his friends leave the continent of Sindria. Hakuryuu and Kougyoku are instructed to return to their homeland, the Kou Empire. Simultaneously, Aladdin has announced that he is required to travel to Magnostadt - a mysterious country ruled by magicians. He will investigate the mysterious events taking place in this new kingdom.
1014998.originName: マギ The kingdom of magic

1015132.title: Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet
1015132.originName: 翠星のガルガンティア

1015751.title: Blue Exorcist: The Movie
1015751.description: Before the grand festival that comes once every 11 years, True Cross Academy has a lively and lively atmosphere. Meanwhile, Rin Okumura is entrusted with suppressing the ferocious Phantom Train. During her mission, she meets a demon who looks like a boy.
1015751.originName: 青の祓魔師 劇場版

1016272.title: One Piece: Umi no Heso no Daibouken-hen
1016272.description: The Straw Hat Group encounter a city in the middle of a vortex called the Navel of the Sea that is being destroyed by giant monsters. These monsters are said to guard wish-granting treasures, but in the process of defeating these guardians, the crew ends up unleashing another evil.
1016272.originName: ルフィ落下! 秘境・海のヘソの大冒険

1016409.title: One Piece Special: Open Upon the Great Sea! A Father's Huge, HUGE Dream!
1016409.description: The story begins on the pirate Zap's ship. His two members of his crew, Bonnie and Max, are tired and want to run away, but unfortunately, they have no money. Three children were being held captive on the ship overheard them. The eldest, Amanda, whose father was a pro treasure hunter, knows the whereabouts of a great treasure and offers them a deal. If they help them make a clean escape, they could take all the treasure they wanted. They agree, and the five of them barely escape and make it onto a small island where they meet Luffy and his crew. Unfortunately, they were pursued and Luffy and Amanda are captured and brought back to their boss, the head of the Bayan Pirates, who is also after the treasure. Luffy and his friends must fight the Bayan Pirates and find the treasure that Amanda's father left to the children. Amanda, who has always resented adventures and treasures, finally understands his feelings, as his father kept looking for adventures and treasures.
1016409.originName: 大海原にひらけ! でっかいでっカイ父の夢

1016473.title: One Piece Special: Protect! The Last Great Performance
1016473.description:
In the past years, former Marine Lieutenant Randolph and his troupe have performed plays aboard his ship. Randolph, who lost his family to pirates, wants to give courage to those who lost loved ones to pirates. 
Unfortunately, Randolph will have to retire soon and he is currently giving his final performances. Luffy and his friends came to see the play and somehow succeeded in participating in the play themselves. But from Randolph's past comes a vengeful subordinate with a diabolical plan who has finally become commander in order to capture Randolph. Luffy and his Nakama now must prove to the people that not all pirates are scum, and protect Randolph's final farewell performance from the bitter commander.
1016473.originName: 守れ! 最後の大舞台

1016572.title: One Piece: Adventure of Nebulandia
1016572.description: The story takes place in the New World, a "Seal Island of Capable Persons" that can seal the power of Devil Fruits. After arriving in the new world where navigation is very difficult, the strength of the Silver Fox Foxy Pirates has become stronger, leading a talented strategist and two other powerful newbies to make a comeback, and with the members of the Straw Hat Pirates came a mysterious battle...
1016572.originName: ONE PIECE 〜アドベンチャー オブ ネブランディア〜

1017074.title: One Piece 3D: Straw Hat Chase
1017074.description: The straw hat that was still there last night has disappeared! Luffy once met his idol when he was a child, the big pirate red-haired Shanks. It was Shanks who gave him this straw hat and made an agreement with him to determine his life goals. For Luffy, The straw hat is a treasure that is more important than life, no matter what kind of danger it encounters, it will not be abandoned. Luffy frantically searched around and finally found a sea eagle holding his precious straw hat. At the same time, Chopper and Usopp encountered a shipwreck on their way to find the hat, and they rescued an old pirate. The pirate tells them an amazing story about the straw hat. What appeared in front of them was a naval base. Can the Straw Hat Pirates get their iconic straw hat back?!
1017074.originName: ONE PIECE 3D 麦わらチェイス

1017354.title: One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy to 4-nin no Nakama no Daibouken
1017354.description: The words spoken by the pirate king Gold Roger just before his death make the world go wild, and the world plunges into the Great Pirate Era! There is a group of young pirates who are about to set sail on the Grand Line. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber man. Roronoa Zoro aka “Pirate Hunter.” Usopp, a sniper. Sanji, a seafaring cook. And “Cat Burglar” Nami. They, the Straw Hats Group, all place a foot upon a barrel and make their vows before their next journey across the great ocean. Let's get back to the time when Luffy shouts “In order to be the King of the Pirates!”, a decade ago in the Windmill Village...
1017354.originName: ONE PIECE エピソードオブ東の海～ルフィと4人の仲間の大冒険!!～

1017411.title: One Piece: Episode of Skypiea
1017411.description: In the "Episode of" series, the special will be the first to address the Skypeia arc. More new partners will join the group as they continue their voyage.
1017411.originName: ONE PIECE エピソードオブ 空島

1017862.title: Planetarian: Snow Globe
1017862.description:
The PC game "planetarian" produced by KEY Corporation will celebrate its 15th anniversary in 2019. Beautiful and boundless starlight that will never dissipate... A sky full of stars awaits you. 
The new OVA will feature the prequel short story "Snow Globe," which debuted as part of a light novel volume that bundled with a limited-edition version of the original PC game.

1018114.title: The Heike Story
1018114.description:
"The sound of the Gion Shōja bells echoes the impermanence of all things; the color of the sāla flowers reveals the truth that prosperity must decline".
At the end of the Heian period, the Heike clan was on the verge of peak prosperity in terms of power, military power, and financial strength.
Taira Shigemori, a man who can see the spirits, meets Biwa, a magical girl who can see the future and predict the fall of the Heike family.
A historical shift of Japan from aristocratic society to samurai society, indicating the start of 15 years turbulent period.

1018181.title: Heaven Official's Blessing (JP ver.)
1018181.description: For you, I’ll become invincible! "Have you heard? The rubbish Heaven Official is having an affair with the ghost realm’s number one bigshot!" Eight hundred years ago, Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom; one who was beloved by his citizens and the darling of the world. Unsurprisingly, he ascended to the Heavens at a very young age. Now, eight hundred years later, Xie Lian ascends to the Heavens for the third time as the laughing stock of all three realms. On his first task as a god, he meets a mysterious demon who rules the ghosts and terrifies the Heavens……yet unbeknownst to Xie Lian, this demon king has been paying attention to him for a very, very long time.

1018282.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Thai Dub)
1018282.description: Lonely thirty-seven-year-old Mikami Satoru is stuck in a dead-end job, unhappy with his mundane life, but after dying at the hands of a robber, he awakens to a fresh start in a fantasy realm...as a slime monster! As he acclimates to his goopy new existence, his exploits with the other monsters set off a chain of events that will change his new world forever!
1018282.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件

1018493.title: Tawawa on Monday S2
1018493.description: The anime tells the story that a salaryman who has a chance to meet a girl named Ai on the train when she was being harassed. They begin to meet every Monday on the train, with the man serving as her bodyguard on the crowded commute while they chat. Let's enjoy the Mondays in Season 2!

1018622.title: GANBARE DOUKICHAN
1018622.description:
"Sharing a room with a colleague at a hotel!? Even though I was warned not to do anything stupid, I couldn't help but notice her legs wrapped in pantyhose..."
Unbeknownst to him, however, Douki-chan secretly has feelings for him. As Douki-chan struggles to confess her feelings, her rivals, both the junior and senior, continue to vie for his affection.
Ganbare Douki-chan realistically depicts the texture of clothes, cute expressions, and exciting situations with plenty of temptation, featuring plenty of satisfying highlights.

1018757.title: The Heike Story
1018757.description:
"The sound of the Gion Shōja bells echoes the impermanence of all things; the color of the sāla flowers reveals the truth that prosperity must decline".
At the end of the Heian period, the Heike clan was on the verge of peak prosperity in terms of power, military power, and financial strength.
Taira Shigemori, a man who can see the spirits, meets Biwa, a magical girl who can see the future and predict the fall of the Heike family.
A historical shift of Japan from aristocratic society to samurai society, indicating the start of 15 years turbulent period.

1018903.title: Tawawa on Monday
1018903.description: The anime tells the story that a salaryman who has a chance to meet a girl named Ai on the train when she was being harassed. They begin to meet every Monday on the train, with the man serving as her bodyguard on the crowded commute while they chat. Let's enjoy the Mondays!

1018992.title: My Senpai is Annoying
1018992.description: If Takeda Harumi, Igarashi Futuba's senpai, weren't such an annoyance, her new job would be fantastic! Futuba despises his chuckle, his height, and his tendency to treat her like a young child. Futuba's diminutive stature and youthful appearance do not indicate that she is a kid, and just because she spends so much time with Harumi does not imply that she finds him to be a bothersome senpai. Maybe she does!
1018992.originName: 先輩がうざい後輩の話

1019083.title: SAKUGAN
1019083.description:
It comes to the distant future. Humans live side by side in "colonies" separated by rocks. Outside the colony, there is a dangerous undeveloped area called "Labyrinth".

Those who risk their lives to develop "Labyrinths" that marks undeveloped areas are called "markers". Memempu, a girl who hopes to be a marker one day, and Gagumber, a man who used to be a marker. Mismatched father and daughter now challenge the Labyrinth

1019175.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
1019175.description: Red was once a member of the Hero's Party, a powerful group that saved the world from the evil forces of the raging Demon Lord Taraxon. That is until one of his comrades kicked him out. Hoping to live an easy life on the frontier, Red's new goal is to open an apothecary. However, keeping the secret of his former life may not be as simple as he thinks. Especially when his past adventurer, the beautiful Lit, shows up and asks him to move in with him!
1019175.originName: 真の仲間じゃないと勇者のパーティーを追い出されたので、辺境でスローライフすることにしました

1019231.title: Yuki Yuna is a Hero: The Great Mankai Chapter
1019231.originName: 結城友奈は勇者である 大満開の章

1019299.title: The Faraway Paladin
1019299.description:
A lone human infant dwells in a city of the dead that has long since been destroyed and is removed from human civilization. Will is being nurtured by three undead: Blood, a brave skeletal warrior; Mary, a graceful mummified priestess; Gus, a gruff spirit sorcerer. The three shower the kid with affection and impart all of their knowledge to him.
Suddenly, Will begins to doubt his own identity. Will needs to discover the secrets of this dead man's land and learn the hidden history of the undead. He learns the compassion and love of the kind gods, as well as the prejudice and madness of the evil ones. This young guy starts the process of becoming a Paladin.

1019369.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window
1019369.description: Kosuke Mikado, a shy bookstore clerk, has the ability to see ghosts and spirits. An exorcist whose supernatural powers are as strong as his social graces are weak, Rihito Hiyakawa seems to fear nothing, human or not. When this odd couple gets together to solve the bizarre cases that come their way, their work methods may not be entirely safe for work!
1019369.originName: さんかく窓の外側は夜

1019433.title: Takt Op. Destiny
1019433.description: The night when the black meteorite "Kuroya Meteorite" fell from the sky, everything changed silently. A weird creature created by the black meteorite, "D2", begins to invade the earth and mankind. D2 is attracted to the melody played by humans, which ultimately leads to the banning of "music". And how will the world change...

1019493.title: Mieruko-chan
1019493.description: One day, Miko unexpectedly started to see strange grotesque that no one else could see. Her response is not to run away, not to confront them, but tend to ignore them completely! Will she be able to keep a straight face and continue her daily life surrounded by terrifying monsters?

1019621.title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
1019621.description:
The best assassin on earth was the only one who had an idea about how to live as a tool for his employer. Reincarnated into a world of swords and magic by the grace of the Goddess, he has been offered the opportunity to do something different this time, but there are pitfalls...
He has to eliminate a super-powerful hero who will bring about the end of the world unless he is stopped. Now known as Lugh Tuatha Dé, the master assassin certainly has his hands full, particularly because of all the beautiful girls who constantly surround him. Lugh may have been an incomparable killer, but how will he fare against foes with powerful magic?
1019621.originName: 世界最高の暗殺者、異世界貴族に転生する

1019965.title: Daisy Meets Girl
1019965.description: It follows the adventures of 16-year-old high school student Maise Higa, who ends up working as a part-time front desk clerk at a hotel in Okinawa. The seemingly boring way of spending summer vacation changes completely with the arrival of a guest from the mainland, Ichiro Suzuki. Hotel rooftop. "Deji" is an Okinawan word that means "troublesome" or "a lot".

1020097.title: The Fruit of Evolution: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made
1020097.description:
Ugly, revolting, dirty, fat. Students at school always use these words to insult Hiiragi Seiichi.
One random day, the radio announces that the whole school is about to be transported to an alternate world. In this fantasy world, everyone will have their own rank and skills.
Each class forms groups and waits to be transported, but Seiichi is left out and alone. As such, he is summoned to a completely different area and begins his journey alone.
1020097.originName: 進化の実: 知らないうちに勝ち組人生

1020289.title: Tokyo Revengers (Thai ver.)
1020289.description: Takemichi Hanagaki's life is at an all-time low. Just when he thought it couldn't get worse, he finds out that Hinata Tachibana, his ex-girlfriend, was murdered by the Tokyo Manji Gang: a group of vicious criminals that has been disturbing society's peace for quite some time.
1020289.originName: 東京卍リベンジャーズ

1020506.title: Moon, Laika, and the Bloodsucking Princess

1021540.title: Let's Make a Mug Too
1021540.originName: やくならマグカップも 二番窯

1021643.title: Tsuritama
1021643.description: Yuki is a high school student living in Enoshima. Due to his exceptionally poor communication skills, he has never been good at communicating with people, let alone making a real friend. Then Haru, who claims to be an alien, appears beside him, and Haru decides to teach Yuki how to fish. Natsuki is an irascible native with a hard-tongued mouth but a warm heart. Akira is a mysterious Indian who watches every move of the Enoshima people from a distance. The four meet, fish, and are on their way to find adventure on their small island...

1021797.title: PERSONA3 THE MOVIE #1 Spring of Birth
1021797.originName: PERSONA3 THE MOVIE #1 Spring of Birth

1021864.title: PERSONA3 THE MOVIE #2 Midsummer Knight's Dream
1021864.originName: PERSONA3 THE MOVIE #2 Midsummer Knight's Dream

1022474.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha: The Movie 1st
1022474.originName: 魔法少女リリカルなのは The MOVIE 1st

1023002.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc
1023002.description: A series of mysterious disappearances have occurred on one of the trains. This attracts the attention of the Demon Slayer Corps, who decide to send a distinguished officer to destroy the demon. However, the appearance of a lesser demon delays plans to board the Mugen train. This demon targets a kindly elderly woman and her granddaughter, threatening the mechanic. Flame Pillar Kyoujurou Rengoku must eliminate this threat first.
1023002.originName: 鬼滅の刃 無限列車編

1023084.title: Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon: The Second Act
1023084.description:
A few years after the Inuyasha incident, Sesshomaru's daughter Towa is separated from her twin sister Setsuna and is stranded in modern times, where she is adopted into Kagome Higurashi's family...

The second season of Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi.
1023084.originName: 半妖の夜叉姫 弐の章

1023285.title: Hakkenden: Eight Dogs of the East

1027895.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 6
1027895.description: The stage is in London. Lupin's goal is to secretly manipulate the treasure hidden by Raven, the mysterious organization of the British government - the clue is a painting. His opponents are Scotland Yard and MI6. The Zenigata Police Department also noticed Lupin's actions and appeared. Then, the detective who appeared in front of Lupin - his name is Sherlock Holmes! "Deduction Lupin" with many mysteries is now open!

1028697.title: Kyoukai Senki
1028697.description:
Japan has lost its sovereignty as of 2061 AD. After being divided into four major trade factions and subjected to their rule, the Japanese people spend their days as oppressed citizens.
Following the deployment of AMAIM—a humanoid special mobile weapon, the nation rose to the top of the global stage.
Amou Shiiba is a young child who enjoys mechanics. One day he meets Gai, a self-regulating AI. Amou seizes the chance presented by Gai and joins the fight to retake Japan.

1028840.title: Build Divide: Code Black
1028840.description: There are many rumours about the new Kyoto and its ruler. In this world, a person's value is based on their capability in the trading card game Build Divide, where winner will be granted any wish. To challenge the king, players engage in TCG fights known as Rebuild. Teruto Kurabe, a young man who swears to overthrow the monarch, and Sakura Banka, the enigmatic girl who serves as his mentor, join the Rebuild conflict together. A new conflict starts.

1028971.title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S (Thai ver.)
1028971.description:
With Tooru continuing his quest to become the best maid and Kanna Kamui fully immersed in life as an elementary school student, there are no dull days in the Kobayashi family when mischief is a daily staple. A large-scale landslide occurs on the hill where Tohru and Tohru met for the first time. When none of the dragons they know claim responsibility, the perpetrators themselves descend from the sky. Llulu, who is a radical Chaos Dragon with immense power that rivals Tooru.

Tired of Tooru's engaging with humans, Ilulu resorts to the typical dragon way of resolving conflicts: mortal combat. Despite such behavior, she is intrigued by Kobayashi's ability to befriend dragons, and instead decides to observe why Kobayashi is so special. A quirky life with a dragon maid becomes more and more fun.
1028971.originName: 小林さんちのメイドラゴンS

1029119.title: After School Of YAKUMO (LIVE) S2
1029119.originName: やくもの放課後 二番窯

1029170.title: Drowning Sorrows in Raging Fire
1029170.description: In the current era, a small percentage of people called "Special Abilities" have skills and powers normal humans do not possess. An autonomous organization, the Deviant Control Office, keeps these Special Abilities in check. Though some wish to maintain this order and peace, some wish to take advantage of their abilities and obtain more power in this world.

1029285.title: Cinderella Chef S2
1029285.description: Ye Jiayao is a young and talented cook who dreams of becoming a renowned chef one day. As luck would have it, she's magically transported back in time to Imperial China, and in the body of an extremely useless girl. Ye Jiayao is immediately kidnapped and held for ransom, but she manages to use her wits (and her sense of humor) to get whatever she wants.

1029409.title: My ACG Parents
1029409.description:
My ACG Parents
Tong Qi, who was instilled Otaku culture by her parents when she was a child, but tried hard to keep away from "Otaku", always regarded her deskmate Yang Wei, as her idol. She never thought that one day, she heard the word "BL culture" from the "idol". The laughter life of the two dimension and the third dimension is about to begin.

1029934.title: Foodie Boy’s Classic of Mountains & Seas
1029934.description:
What is "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" actually talking about? A gourmet called "Bu Bai Chi" back in the days of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas", exploring the famous mountains and seas in the books and actually found that it is all so amazing! 
It turns out that the mermaids in Chinese fairy tales are not at all beautiful girls! The ancient people have already given employees the meat of "Changfu" birds to keep them working eternally! The Queen Mother of the West is not an elegant girl but an eccentric old lady! Yu the Great has combated the water goblins when he controlled the flood! 
All the most interesting stories of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" are in the Foodie Boy’s Classic of Mountains & Seas!

1030026.title: Ancient Girl's-Frame
1030026.description:
At the end of the 21st century, the discovery of a new energy source called "DG energy" (short for "divine grace energy") has revolutionized Earth's economy and allowed humanity to colonize space. However, when the initial expedition reaches Pluto, they are attacked by a mysterious, giant life-form known as "Nergal."

The Earth Alliance Army fights back by creating an "AG Unit" using ancient robot weapons known as the "G's Frame" which were excavated from archaeological sites all around the world. Girls with special qualities known as "Ancient Girls" can pilot these robots against the Nergal. However, the first AG Unit suffers heavy casualties in the Jupiter Trojan campaign, and the pilot of Unit 04, Minamiya Reiu, goes missing-in-action...

Years later, Minamiya Reika, the younger sister of Reiu, enlists with the AG Unit to search for her sister and to protect the Earth from the Nergal. A story of friendship, ancient robot weapons, and battles to the death with the Nergal ensues.

1030330.title: The Best Friend
1030330.description: The story mainly tells that from 2007 to 2008, a group of young girls with different personalities met because they entered the same university. Due to their different growth backgrounds, they gradually open their hearts and become good friends from not understanding each other.

1030615.title: LADY TOUGH
1030615.description: Liu Lian is a 30-year-old single woman who doesn't behave according to common sense. Her mother's accidental death broke her original happy life.  Liu Lian didn't know how to deal with this sudden change, so she simply went on a short holiday. She ridiculed her life with humor and disdain, but actually she tried to make it up with her mother and herself in her deep memories.

1030730.title: Strike the Blood
1030730.description: The Fourth Primogenitor, who is the world's strongest vampire that only exists in legends. Accompanied by twelve Kenjuu and spreading calamity, rumor says that this phantom vampire appeared in Japan finally. For the purpose of observation and obliteration, the government and Lion King organization decided to dispatch an attack mage known as a Sword Shaman. However, for some reason, the one chosen for the observation was an apprentice Sword Shaman girl, Himegari Yukina. Wielding the strongest anti-primogenitor spirit spear, Yukina arrived at Demon District, Itogami City. So what is the true identity of Akatsuki Kojou, the 4th Progenitor she meets!?
1030730.originName: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド

1030787.title: Strike the Blood II
1030787.description: The Fourth Primogenitor, who is the world's strongest vampire that only exists in legends. Accompanied by twelve Kenjuu and spreading calamity, rumor says that this phantom vampire Akatsuki Kojou appeared in Japan finally. For the purpose of observation and obliteration, the government and Lion King organization decided to dispatch an attack mage known as a Sword Shaman. However, for some reason, the one chosen for the observation was an apprentice Sword Shaman girl, Himegari Yukina. Wielding the strongest anti-primogenitor spirit spear, Yukina arrived at Demon District, Itogami City. So what is the true identity of the 4th Progenitor she meets!? The second season of Strike the Blood adapts three arcs from the 9th, 11th, and 12th light novel volumes.
1030787.originName: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド II

1030837.title: Strike the Blood: Kingdom of the Valkyria
1030837.originName: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド ヴァルキュリアの王国篇

1030968.title: Strike the Blood III
1030968.originName: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド III

1031027.title: Strike the Blood IV
1031027.description:
It's a new stage of this story!
A new battle of the memoryless fourth primogenitor!!
under the moonlight
Dawn Ancient City.
In front of the monk-like clothes
The figure of a girl with white hair.
"Finally found it, Akatsuki Kojou.
My name is Kasugaya Shizuri Castiella
"I'm your watchdog"
1031027.originName: ストライク・ザ・ブラッド IV

1031356.title: CAT'S TEA
1031356.description: Jasmine, a 15-year-old girl, has just entered high school. On her first day of being a high school student, she was struck by lightning and came to the Tea continent. In a daze, she was picked up by a gentle boy, Longjing, and brought home. She woke up and accidentally touched the ear of her savior and then was identified as a rare magician (with multi-attribute magic). Jasmine meets red fox Keemun, samoyed Pu'er, and other partners one after another in this half-orc world, and starts her wonderful adventure!

1031938.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S2
1031938.description: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn't care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadowed stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.
1031938.originName: 仙王的日常生活 第二季

1032081.title: Raccoon Town in the Phone S2
1032081.description: This is a story about a group of cute little animals that live in human cell phones and work hard to keep cell phones functioning properly so that people can maintain communication with others, keep in contact with the world, and gain a sense of happiness. The raccoon town in the cell phone is like a miniature human society, where there are various institutions and systems such as police stations, hospitals, entertainment venues, restaurants, air transport, public transport, etc., and of course, there is culture and festivals as well.
1032081.originName: 手机里的浣熊小镇 第二季

1032377.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Thai Dub)
1032377.description:
Since ancient times, rumors have abounded of man-eating demons lurking in the woods. Because of this, the local townsfolk never venture outside at night. Legend has it that a demon slayer also roams the night, hunting down these bloodthirsty demons. For young Tanjirou, these rumors will soon to become his harsh reality...

Ever since the death of his father, Tanjirou has taken it upon himself to support his family. Although their lives may be hardened by tragedy, they've found happiness. But that ephemeral warmth is shattered one day when Tanjirou finds is family slaughtered and the lone survivor, his sister Nezuko, turned into a demon. To his surprise, however, Nezuko still shows signs of human emotion and thought... Thus begins Tanjirou's quest to fight demons and turn his sister human again.

1032433.title: Bilibili x The Star Idol Online Fan Event
1032433.originName: Bilibili x The Star Idol Online Fan Event

1032494.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (ID dub)
1032494.description:

1032994.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc (Thai Dub)
1032994.description:
A mysterious continuous disappearance on a certain train has caught the attention of the Demon Slayer Corps, and they have sent one of their best sword master, Kyoujurou Rengoku, to exterminate the truth. However, the plan to board the Mugen Train is delayed by a lesser demon who is terrorizing the mechanics and targeting a kind, elderly woman and her granddaughter. As the Flame Pillar, Kyoujurou Rengoku must eliminate the threat before boarding the train.

Tanjirou Kamado, Inosuke Hashibira, and Zenitsu Agatsuma enter the train prepared to fight to assist the Pillar. But their monstrous target already has a devious plan in store for them and the two hundred passengers: by delving deep into their consciousness, the demon intends to obliterate everyone in a stunning display of the power held by the most frightening villain, the Twelve Demon Moons...
1032994.originName: 鬼滅の刃 無限列車編
