1033760.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc
1033760.description: In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

1033856.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba (VN Dub)
1033856.description: Since ancient times, rumors have abounded of man-eating demons lurking in the woods. Because of this, the local townsfolk never venture outside at night. Legend has it that a demon slayer also roams the night, hunting down these bloodthirsty demons. For young Tanjirou, these rumors will soon to become his harsh reality...

1034193.title: Run For Young
1034193.description:
A story about the youth of this millennium follows a group of students who encounter ups and downs in the marathon of life. Ma Tian who comes from a well-off family and his goody-two-shoes neighbor An Ran transferred to an ordinary high school during their senior year; where they meet different kinds of people — Lao Gou (‘Old Dog’), Da Lijiao, Mimi, Da Zui (‘Big Mouth’) and Song Jie.
On his very first day at his new school, Ma Tian gets into a fight with Lao Gou and each vow to never co-exist with the other. Yet fate seems to be playing a joke on them as they are put in the same marathon team in school. From that time onwards, the two had no choice but to tolerate each other as they are forced to train together all while making each other miserable. It's the last year of high school and these young students undergo countless challenges as they grow in each other's company and mature into adults.

1034338.title: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia I: Yakusoku
1034338.originName: 劇場版 BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia

1034487.title: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia Ⅱ：Song I am.
1034487.originName: 劇場版 BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia II:Song I am.

1034588.title: Bilibili x The Star Idol Exclusive Mini Concert
1034588.originName: Bilibili x The Star Idol Exclusive Mini Concert

1034644.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2
1034644.description:
After parting from his former classmates, the protagonist Hajime Nagumo begins a new journey with the party he leads to obtain the magic of the gods.
On his journey, he encounters the imprisoned vampire Yue, the rabbit-eared man Shea, and the perverted dragon Tio, and his party grows. At the same time, the trials and difficulties faced increased.
He suffered betrayal, fell into a dungeon and came back from the dead... The adventure won't stop there. Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 2 officially opens!
1034644.originName: ありふれた職業で世界最強(第2期)

1034695.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san Season 3
1034695.description: Nishikata and Takagi have a close sit next to each other in class. Takagi enjoys teasing Nishikata with embarrassing pranks and jokes. In response, Nishikata creates plans to avenge Takagi but he fails all the time especially when she identifies his weaknesses and capitalizes on them. However, Takagi loses the challenge sometimes, even though Nishikata still does not feel like he won. Could Nishikata find Takagi's real feeling?
1034695.originName: からかい上手の高木さん 3期

1034838.title: Requiem of the Rose King
1034838.description: The British Duke of York always wants to unseat King Henry VI and let himself become the king. His son, Richard Plantagenet, who possesses characteristics of both sexes is reviled by Richard’s mother, and this leads to his adverse reaction to being called a DEMON. However, Richard believes that by helping his father become the king he can attain salvation for himself. So, will Richard's actions instead drag his family down into darkness?

1034958.title: In the Land of Leadale
1034958.description: The story begins in this Familiar Lands. After a horrific accident put her on life support, the last vestige of freedom Keina Kagami found that she was in the VRMMORPG World of Leadale. When she woke up in the body of her game avatar, though, Keina—now named Cayna—found that the worries of her old life appear to be a thing of the past, but somehow this new land didn't seem to be the same Leadale which she remembered...
1034958.originName: リアデイルの大地にて

1035102.title: My Dress-Up Darling
1035102.description: Wakana Gojou is exceptionally skilled at making clothes for Hinaningyou but he has no friends in high school as a freshman. His finesse with the sewing machine is soon discovered by his beautiful classmate Marin Kitagawa, whose boldness and honesty Gojou both admires and envies. She is interested in cosplay as characters from erotic video games but cannot sew her own costumes, which leads her to seek Gojou's expertise. Thus, despite the polar opposites, the relationship between Gojou and Marin slowly blossoms through their aptitude in helping each other.
1035102.originName: その着せ替え人形は恋をする

1035162.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt
1035162.description:
The prince of this weak kingdom has a dream: to sell his country and live a life of peace! As his achievements grew, he earned the respect and expectations of a larger population ....... This makes the dream even more difficult to achieve!
The fact that the prince doesn't realise that the biggest obstacle to this dream is his own talent cannot be ignored.
1035162.originName: 天才王子の赤字国家再生術

1035275.title: AKEBI'S SAILOR UNIFORM
1035275.description: Akebi Komichi lives with her family far from the countryside. She's got the entrance to the prestigious Roubai Academy middle school for girls and what she wants now are only two things—wearing the school's sailor uniform and making a hundred friends!
1035275.originName: 明日ちゃんのセーラー服

1035350.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
1035350.description: It's a world full of magic, the powers and future of a mage are predetermined at birth through so-called "Marks". An incredibly skilled sage with unsatisfied Marks decided to reincarnate thousands of years in the future, reborn as Mathias Hildesheimr with his desired mark. When Matthias turns 12, his unparalleled swordsmanship has ripples both inside and outside the academy. However, the ex-sages reveal signs of a dark force working in the shadows, and with humanity weakened more than ever, it's up to Matthias to thwart their evil plans.
1035350.originName: 失格紋の最強賢者 ～世界最強の賢者が更に強くなるために転生しました～

1035452.title: Salaryman’s Club
1035452.description: It's a Salaryman’s Club that is set in a badminton business group, depicting the two different aspects of daily life as a salaryman, as well as growth and conflicts as players. The anime follows Mikoto Shiratori, ace badminton player who suffers from trauma following a loss at the inter-high tournament. He becomes a salaryman at the Sunlight Beverage company and makes friends with Tatsuru Miyazumi, the best-performing player and salesman on the team. What will happen after their encounter...

1035614.title: Attack on Titan: Ilse's Journal
1035614.originName: 進撃の巨人 「イルゼの手帳」

1035690.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom 2nd Season
1035690.description: How a realist hero rebuilt his kingdom tells the story of Kazuya Sōma. Before being transported, Kazuya was a student of humanities with knowledge of realism and Machiavellianism. During a ritual, he is summoned by the kingdom of Elfrieden. Now Kazuya will have to use his knowledge from his previous life to deal with the problems of the kingdom.
1035690.originName: 現実主義勇者の王国再建記 第二部

1035799.title: Attack on Titan: The Sudden Visitor
1035799.originName: 進撃の巨人 「突然の来訪者」

1035933.title: Slow Loop
1035933.description:
A young girl named Hiyori⁠ whose deceased father taught her the joys of fishing headed out to sea for some alone time, while she never thought that she would encounter another girl there.

After a while, this girl⁠—named Koharu⁠—and her end up fishing and cooking together, and they get to know each other a bit in the meantime. During their brief time together Koharu finds out that the reason Hiyori went out to sea that day was that she was hesitant about meeting her new step-family that same evening. But what a coincidence! Koharu is also meeting her new family tonight! "No. It can't be a coincidence..." It's a story about these two 'sisters' and their new life together!

1036060.title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
1036060.description:
In a world of virtual reality, Kagami is one of the Nine Sages and has a high social status among magicians. One day, when he opened his eyes, he found himself in a completely different world. Now he has gone from being a majestic veteran to an innocent little girl.
If his true identity is revealed, the majestic image he has been building up is likely to be destroyed. To solve this problem, the excuse he came up with is...
1036060.originName: 賢者の弟子を名乗る賢者

1036136.title: RUSTED ARMORS -Dawn-
1036136.description: Due to the long war, the Muromachi shogunate gradually declined and the world entered the secret realm of mountains and seas in the Warring States Period, which advocated blood debt and blood. They work as mercenaries, galloping on the battlefield, and their name is "Saika Ikki". The person who inherited the name of the leader of the Saika Ikki is Magoichi, a young man who has drifted here from a foreign country. On the other hand, Saburo, who was the first to perceive the aggressive intentions of the European powers, was running around to protect Japan.

1036315.title: Life With an Ordinary Guy Who Reincarnated Into a Total Fantasy Knockout
1036315.description: Suddenly, a curmudgeonly old man and his best friend are summoned to another world by a goddess! However, due to the goddess' mischief, the old man is transformed into a noble and beautiful girl? In order to get his body back, he needs to join his best friend to defeat the demon king!!! The journey to another world full of madness and romance begins!!!
1036315.originName: 異世界美少女受肉おじさんと

1036431.title: ORIENT
1036431.description: Musashi and his companion Kojirou Kanemaki pledged to become samurai, create a league, and embark on demon-slaying missions five years ago. However, with demons now being exalted and worshipped, society has avoided and denigrated the samurai. Musashi conceals his swordsmanship while blending in with the town's orthodoxy because of fear that he may expose his dream. Despite striving and failing, Kojirou still sets off on a voyage with Musashi in the hopes of discovering his genuine sentiments. The pair plunges deeply into the mysterious realm of beast-slaying without knowing what their future holds.

1036504.title: Police in a Pod
1036504.originName: ハコヅメ～交番女子の逆襲～

1036717.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Tsuioku Hen
1036717.originName: 魔法科高校の劣等生 追憶編

1036815.title: The Case Files of Lord El-Melloi II: Rail Zeppelin Grace Note Special
1036815.originName: ロード・エルメロイⅡ世の事件簿 -魔眼蒐集列車 Grace note-

1037039.title: Futsal Boys!!!!!
1037039.description: In the world over a decade, after futsal has skyrocketed in global popularity, the franchise's story is set. Protagonist Haru Yamato watches the championship of the U-18 world cup and is inspired by a Japanese player whose name is Tokinari Tenōji. He joins the Koyo Academy High School's futsal team with the dream of becoming a player like Tenōji. There, he finds friends as well as their rivals.

1037281.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S1
1037281.description: “Poor Rich Travelogue Season 1” is a documentary reality‑show created by Tomohiro Yamashita and produced by his team, with exclusive streaming on Bilibili. The program adopts a group‑based format: since there are countless ways to enjoy a trip around Japan depending on your budget, the cast is divided into a “low‑budget team” and a “spend‑as‑you‑please team.” The show itself explores the same travel routes in completely different styles, presenting the various challenges they encounter along the way through quirky, offbeat storytelling. The regular cast includes Tomohiro Yamashita, Liu Muzi, Ji Ze, and Fanqie Niang. “Poor Rich Travelogue Season 1” premiered on Bilibili every Friday at 7:00 PM starting January 19, 2018, and concluded on February 9, 2018.
1037281.originName: 穷豪旅游记 第一季

1037339.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S2
1037339.description: “Poor Rich Man’s Travelogue Season 2” is a documentary reality show created by Tomohiro Yamashita and produced by his team, with exclusive streaming on Bilibili. The program features a team-based format, and this new season takes the journey to a whole new level: one car, four people, traveling from Mount Fuji to Nagoya. Along the way, there are nonstop “poor vs. rich” showdowns, with daily meals and accommodations decided through challenges—win and it’s paradise, lose and it’s hell. The core cast includes Tomohiro Yamashita, Chinese Boy Super Gorilla, the zombie with twin pigtails, and Tsugi-zawa. “Poor Rich Man’s Travelogue Season 2” premiered on Bilibili every Friday at 7:00 PM starting April 25, 2019, and concluded on February 9, 2018.
1037339.originName: 穷豪旅游记 第二季

1037587.title: budget travel VS luxury travel S3
1037587.description: Season 3 of “The Poor-but-Luxurious Travelogue,” produced by Bilibili and co-produced by Mola Culture, with production by Tomohiro Yamashita, is back! In addition to the popular UP masters China Boy, Sangmei, Huashao Bei, and the Vegetarian Lion, this season also features some unexpected mystery guests. The new journey will take you from Nagoya to Kyoto, offering an even more extreme — yet still lavish — travel experience!

1037874.title: LOVE of KILL
1037874.description:
Bounty hunter Chateau Dankworth is silent and stoic, and her target, Son Ryang-ha, who killed 18 high-class officials in a single night. To this day, his murders remain swift, efficient, and bloody. However, after Son Ryang-ha overpowers Chateau in their first encounter, he reveals his own intentions: he too is after her, aiming for her heart.
Son Ryang-ha's attempts to catch her eye are quite unique, to say the least. Son Ryang-ha offers gifts to her in the form of her current targets, tied up and battered, and will do anything he can to spend more time with this lady. Reluctantly, Chateau goes along with this act, and so begins the cat-and-mouse game of love between the two killers.

1038004.title: Sasaki to Miyano
1038004.description: Yoshikazu Miyano is a timid high school student who likes to read boys-love comics. He gets himself into trouble one day. Fortunately, it is resolved by senior Shuumei Sasaki. Miyano has secretly looked up to him ever since that day. However, Miyano realises that Sasaki is more annoying than admirable. Surprisingly, Sasaki became addicted to boys-love after reading Miyano's boys-love manga. Could it possibly grow into something bettrer?

1038400.title: Fly Me to the Moon (Thai Dub)
1038400.description: Nasa Yuzaki, a boy with a peculiar name,gets hit by a truck on the day of his high school entrance exams. He encounters and follows a beautiful girl who saves him, confessing his love for her at a bus stop. The girl, Tsukasa Tsukuyomi, agrees to become his girlfriend, but only if they are married first.

1041950.title: House of Five Leaves
1041950.description:
Masanosuke "Masa" Akitsu is a lost ronin in the tranquil Edo era of Japan. Masa is a superb swordsman, but his timid nature has earned him the title of "unreliable," and he is frequently fired without warning by his employers, which causes him to doubt his commitment as a samurai.

When Masa is at his lowest, Yaichi, a carefree man dressed in pink, approaches him and appears to employ him as his bodyguard on a whim. Masa is dragged into the group's illegal activities without realizing it since the job is not as benign as it first appears to be. Yaichi is the group's leader. Masa fights with his own morals as he grows more and more involved with the Five Leaves gang. But his curiosity drives him to investigate.

1042178.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime S2 (Thai Dub)
1042178.description: With the help of Queen Ramiris, the children are now in stable condition and should lead normal lives, much to Rimuru’s relief. But all is not well… In fact, there are forces of humankind in this fantasy world that do not look kindly upon a slime-led nation of monsters. And now, insidious threats to Rimuru and the country of Tempest may be lurking around every corner!
1042178.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第2期

1042239.title: Miss Kuroitsu from the Monster Development Department
1042239.originName: 怪人開発部の黒井津さん

1042418.title: Gintama the Very Final
1042418.description: The story happened after Tendoshuu's invasion of the O-Edo Central Terminal. Foreseeing Utsuro's return, Gintoki Sakata begins surveying Earth's ley lines for traces of the other man's Altana. Later, the regrouped Shinsengumi and Yorozuya begin an attack on the occupied Central Terminal. To fulfill the wishes of their teacher, Shouyou Yoshida's former students unite and relive their pasts one final time in an attempt to save their futures. It is for the 15th anniversary of Gintama TV series.

1042497.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE
1042497.originName: ドールズフロントライン

1042594.title: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2
1042594.description:
"Attack on Titan" tells the story of mysterious titans creature that appeared in this world inexplicably about a hundred years ago, and continued to brutally eat people. In the face of titans, tiny humans can hardly compete with them. In the end, human beings built three towering city walls with a width of 3 meters and a height of 50 meters. Human beings were protected within the walls to be safe, and no titans have been able to break through it for a hundred years. So people gradually got used to the life of being confined within the walls, and began to become numb, afraid of adventure and change. Until 845, Maria's outermost wall was pierced through the city wall by a 60m-high titan and a titan covered in armor. Countless titans poured into the wall. Eren, who witnessed the tragedy of his mother being swallowed by a titan, swears on this day to destroy all the titans.
The plot of this season mainly describes that Allen and his party will officially start war with the human beings in this country after discovering that there are not only titans but also another very developed country "Marley" outside the wall. After the titan's 13-year term expires, the story timeline will jump to five to six years. Marley's new warriors have already begun to be selected, and Eren on Parady Island has also, because of the power of the ancestor titan in his body, the world countries that are eyeing it will come, and the two sides will start an unprecedented war.
1042594.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season part 2

1042681.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc(VN Dub)
1042681.description:
Four months after the Mugen Train Incident, Kamado Tanjiro and Nezuko returned to the Butterfly House after completing their mission, and they met Tengen Uzui, who tried to forcibly take away Kanzaki Aoi. Tengen Uzui let Aoi go at Tanjiro's request, and then agreed to the request of Tanjiro, Gasai Zenitsu and Hashibira Inosuke, and let the three sneak into Yoshihara Entertainment District instead of Aoi, and split up to find his wives Suma, Makio and Hinatsuru who was missing because of the sneak investigation of the evil spirits. 

Under the investigation of the three people, it was found that the identity of Entertainment District's popular oiran was the land of the "Twelve Ghost Moons", Daki, but Zenitsu was captured by the Daki. After learning about the incident, Uzui felt guilty and asked Tanjiro and Inosuke to leave Entertainment District immediately. As Tanjirou prepared to leave and join Inosuke, he found the trail of the Daki and engages her. On the other hand, Inosuke, who couldn't wait for anyone, found a ghost hiding in the ground, so he got into the ground and found the imprisoned Zenitsu, Makio, and Suma, as well as the ghost guarding them. After rescuing them, Inosuke fought the Belt Demon with them, and the latter is also defeated by Uzui, who arrived later.

After the fight, Uzui, who was seriously injured, decided to retire; Ubuyashiki Kagaya, who learned the result of the battle, was overjoyed and believed that this generation would definitely defeat Kibutsuji Muzan. On the other hand, due to the killing of the string, Akaza and other members of the twelve ghost moons were summoned to the infinite city...

1042991.title: The Soul of Soldier Master
1042991.description:
The Soul of Soldier Master
When Li Shi was born, strange cosmic phenomena occurred and he became a vessel that held the soul fragment of the Master of Weapons. He was hunted by all the clans in the world because of it. Later, he decided to enter a clan to train and find the enemies who tried to kill him and his parents. He accidentally discovered Bai Xiang, a demon tribe formation master from the Hou Clan, who wanted to eat the various tribes of the Mountains and Seas. Ying Gou helped with the test of formation. A conspiracy was about to unfold in the city of Linhai.

1043330.title: IMMORTALITY
1043330.description:
IMMORTALITY
Fang Han, a humble family slave, always held the belief that "I would rather be a beggar than a slave", traversing the world only by himself. With an unyielding stubbornness, he cracked the mystery of supernatural powers and forged his body into an immortal body. He worked hard to step into the fairyland, and eventually became the peak king.

1043471.title: Dragon's Disciple
1043471.description:
Dragon's Disciple
The frail boy but with a strong sense of justice, under the guidance of Tang Zichen, a master of Chinese martial arts, embarks on the road of learning traditional martial arts, how to open up and surpass himself. He will experience the spirit of martial arts people who use martial arts to stop the fight and convince people with morality, and also inherit traditional martial arts and promote righteousness.

1043548.title: Tata's  Rainbow Brainstorm 2
1043548.originName: Gon的旱獭之獭獭突然想到 第二季

1043678.title: The Indomitable
1043678.description:
The Indomitable
The dream of the young man "Qian Cong" is to be able to study at school and to become "the strongest commander of hunting guards ". This is a long and challenging road.

1044072.title: SABIKUI BISCO(Thai Dub)
1044072.description:
A plague of wind blows across the dry sands of post-apocalyptic Japan. The cause of the world state of catastrophe is thought to be mushroom spores. Known as the "Man-Eating Mushroom", Biscochi is a wanted criminal archer who instantly grows mushrooms wherever his arrows go. However, he was actually a "mushroom protector", someone who spread the fungus to enrich the land and restore it to its original state.

Along with crab Akutagawa and young doctor Milo Nekoyanagi, Bisco ventures across the wastelands of Japan in search of the fabled "Sabikui" - a panacea said to devour all kinds of rust.

1044178.title: SABIKUI BISCO(Dub Indo)
1044178.description:

1044339.title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man(Thai Dub)
1044339.description:
In a world of virtual reality, Kagami is one of the Nine Sages and has a high social status among magicians. One day, when he opened his eyes, he found himself in a completely different world. Now he has gone from being a majestic veteran to an innocent little girl.
If his true identity is revealed, the majestic image he has been building up is likely to be destroyed. To solve this problem, the excuse he came up with is...
1044339.originName: 賢者の弟子を名乗る賢者

1044413.description:

1044748.title: Attack on Titan: No Regret (Thai Dub)
1044748.description:
This is a story when the young Levi struggles to survive in the capital's garbage dump, the Underground before becoming the famed captain of the Survey Corps. As the boss of his own criminal operation, Levi attempts to get by with meager earnings while aided by fellow criminals, Isabel Magnolia and Farlan Church. Due to the little hope for his future, Levi accepts a deal from the anti-expedition faction leader Nicholas Lobov, who promises the trio citizenship aboveground if they are able to successfully assassinate Erwin Smith, a squad leader of the Survey Corps.

As Levi and Erwin cross paths, Erwin acknowledges Levi's agility and skill and gives him the option to either become part of the expedition team, or be turned over to the Military Police Brigade, to atone for his crimes. Now closer to the man they are tasked to kill, the group plans to complete their mission and save themselves from a grim demise in the dim recesses of their past home. However, they are about to learn that the surface world is not as liberating as they had thought and that sometimes, freedom can come at a heavy price.

Attack on Titan: No Regret is based on the popular spin-off manga of the same name, Shingeki no Kyojin: Kuinaki Sentaku illustrates the encounter between two of this work's pivotal characters, as well as the events of the 23rd expedition beyond the walls.
1044748.originName: 进撃の巨人 悔いなき选択

1044832.title: Attack on Titan: Konnan (Thai Dub)
1044832.description: The 104th Training Corps was tasked with a horse trek into the forest. The purpose of the mission was to test how much alert they were able to maintain without a threat, but the mission seemed boring and could lead to infighting among the members. Especially one of the groups led by Marco Bott. Some want to stay true to the mission they've been given, while others would rather slack off and focus on more exciting activities. And then trouble came quietly, but most people were completely unprepared to deal with it.

1044945.title: Attack on Titan: Ilse's Journal (Thai Dub)
1044945.description: During the 49th recon mission of the Survey Corps, Hange Zoë decided to capture a titan alive as a specimen for study. Commander Erwin Smith thought it was too dangerous and did not allow it, but when Hange found a titan in the nearby woodland, she went to find the titan on horseback without permission, and regardless of her own safety, she led the way and risked her life to the titan and many questions were asked. However, the titan, who seemed to be a strange creature, behaved unpredictably, and quickly turned around and entered the woods again, leading her to a specific place. In front of Hange is the legacy of former scout Ilse Langnar, a notebook full of handwriting. Although she is long dead, she provided a valuable piece of information that may even be a breakthrough in titan research.
1044945.originName: 進撃の巨人 「イルゼの手帳」

1045018.title: Attack on Titan: The Sudden Visitor (Thai Dub)
1045018.description: Jean Kirschstein's desire to escape his boring family and his domineering mother at any cost became his ideal. Joining the Military Police Brigade after joining the army, and living and working in peace and contentment has become his ultimate goal. However, during his tenure in the 104th Training Corps, nothing developed according to Jean's thoughts, and he was full of resentment and unwillingness. After the game, he and Sasha and other teammates quarreled, and vowed to decide the winner in the next day's duel. At this moment, the drunken Commander Pixis suddenly appeared. He declared that he would act as the referee, and the content of the game was changed to a cooking showdown. In order to find the best ingredients, he and his mates went out to the wild, ready to hunt the wild boars that had harmed the village before, but Sasha and his party also followed. Sasha and the others were the first to encounter the wild boar, and the situation developed in an unpredictable direction...
1045018.originName: 進撃の巨人 「突然の来訪者」

1045084.title: Attack on Titan: Lost Girls(Thai Dub)
1045084.description:
Attack on Titan: Lost Girls is consist of two parts originating from the novel. They are "Wall Sina, Goodbye" and "Lost in the Cruel World".

Wall Sina, Goodbye
Annie Leonhart has a job to do—and a resulting absence that must stay off her record at all costs. With no one else to turn to, she asks her comrade Hitch Dreyse to cover for her. She agrees but puts forward a single condition: Annie must solve the fruitless missing person case Hitch was assigned. The case revolves around Carly Stratmann, a university graduate and the daughter of wealthy businessman Elliot Stratmann. With only a single day to solve the case and the underground of the Stohess District crawling with thugs, Annie must put her all into finding this girl. Yet, every answer she uncovers only leads to further questions—how has the illegal drug coderoin found its way to Stohess, what is Elliot hiding, and where has Carly disappeared to?

Lost in the Cruel World
With worry for Eren Yeager gripping her heart, Mikasa Ackerman begins to remember. She remembers her conversations with Armin Arlert, her concern for her friends, and most painfully, the time she had almost lost everything. As fear takes control, she begins to experience an alternate version of her past—some things can be changed, but are there events so inescapable that she can't even prevent them in her dreams?

1045224.title: My Journey in an Alternate World
1045224.description:
My Journey in an Alternate World
Young Chen Xiaofan entered an alternate world after he accidentally swallowed a Chaos Orb, and became Young Master Chen, the prettiest man in Muyun City. Although he was adored by all the ladies in Muyun City, he was useless as he was not able to cultivate. With his mind set on going back to his original world, he gave up his stable lifestyle as a young master and went against his family’s wishes, determined to walk the path of a cultivator.

1045369.title: BUSTED! DARKLORD
1045369.description: In order to better survive in this world, the devil's son, Yu Renjie, was ordered to come to the "Zhengdao Academy", which only recruits prominent disciples from distinguished families, and successfully infiltrated. Yu Renjie's goal is very simple, that is, to obtain a "good witness" that can whitewash his demonic identity. But this is actually an extremely dangerous behavior, because once the true identity of the demon is revealed, it will be met with countless justice knights on the spot, and will be brutally killed by law enforcement on the spot. Although Yu Renjie was very aware of this and was extremely careful not to disclose information, on the day of registration, Yu Renjie was embarrassed to find that his personal information had been found out, and the infiltration operation declared a failure. In desperation, in order to hide his identity, Yu Renjie gritted his teeth and decided to wear women's clothes... So the dangerous and lively campus life is about to begin!

1045618.title: Kei x Yaku - Dangerous Buddy
1045618.originName: ケイ×ヤク―あぶない相棒―

1046104.title: Fate/Grand Order: Shinsei Entaku Ryouiki Camelot 2 - Paladin; Agateram
1046104.originName: 劇場版 Fate/Grand Order -神聖円卓領域キャメロット- 後編 Paladin; Agateram

1046246.title: Attack On Titan The Final Season Part 2 (Thai ver.)
1046246.description:
"Attack on Titan" tells the story of mysterious titans creature that appeared in this world inexplicably about a hundred years ago, and continued to brutally eat people. In the face of titans, tiny humans can hardly compete with them. In the end, human beings built three towering city walls with a width of 3 meters and a height of 50 meters. Human beings were protected within the walls to be safe, and no titans have been able to break through it for a hundred years. So people gradually got used to the life of being confined within the walls, and began to become numb, afraid of adventure and change. Until 845, Maria's outermost wall was pierced through the city wall by a 60m-high titan and a titan covered in armor. Countless titans poured into the wall. Eren, who witnessed the tragedy of his mother being swallowed by a titan, swears on this day to destroy all the titans.
The plot of this season mainly describes that Allen and his party will officially start war with the human beings in this country after discovering that there are not only titans but also another very developed country "Marley" outside the wall. After the titan's 13-year term expires, the story timeline will jump to five to six years. Marley's new warriors have already begun to be selected, and Eren on Parady Island has also, because of the power of the ancestor titan in his body, the world countries that are eyeing it will come, and the two sides will start an unprecedented war.
1046246.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season part 2

1046596.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (Thai Dub)
1046596.description: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn‘t care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadow stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.

1046726.title: Estab-Life: Great Escape
1046726.description: In the future world far away from the present, human civilization is highly developed, and as a result of the use of various resources, the population on the earth has reached a peak and then began to decline, and the number of human beings has decreased significantly. Artificial intelligence was developed in response to a growing crisis, to help protect species, manage ecosystems, and conduct a grand experiment in human diversity. Through genetic engineering, the “various races”, including ordinary people, beastfolk, and magical beings, were created to live in a diverse city named "CLUSTA". Each cluster developed a unique culture, befitting the people that lived there. Their lives, and the system, are continually maintained by the AI to ensure survival.
1046726.originName: エスタブライフ グレイトエスケープ

1046793.title: LINK CLICK (Thai Dub)
1046793.description: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

1047011.title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai
1047011.description: The petite classmate Reina Aharen is quiet and cute, but it seems that her sense of distance is quite bad, and she is often inaccurate in measuring space and will have various problems. For a series of incomprehensible antics made by classmate Aharen, there is only one person trying to understand these, and he is Raidou. On this day, Raidou found that Aharen's eraser fell on the ground he leaned over to pick it up for her and handed it to her without thinking. Since then, the strange friendship between the two began to blossom. The "Sometimes Too Far" and "Sometimes Too Close" teen romance comedy kicks off!
1047011.originName: 阿波連さんははかれない

1047063.title: Ya Boy Kongming!
1047063.description:
Kong Ming, a great strategist during the Three Kingdoms period, achieved an extraordinary life through his lifelong struggles and countless battles. So when Kong Ming was dying, his only wish was to be reborn into a world full of peace and no wars... Then Kong Ming was sent directly to the modern city of Tokyo! Can a brilliant strategist like Kong Ming adapt to the modern wild beat?
Later, Kong Ming met Eiko Tsukimi in Shibuya, and Kongming, who was deeply attracted by her singing, became Eiko's military advisor. The overwhelming ingenuity of the genius military advisor led to the birth of a new legend in the music scene, and then...

1047363.title: The King of Pigs
1047363.description:
Two friends meet up and recall their experiences as victims of school bullying when they receive a message from a friend from 20 years ago and mysterious serial killings begin to occur. 
Kyung Min lives with the trauma of the school violence he experienced twenty years ago and an unexpected case causes his suppressed emotions to reappear. Meanwhile, Detective Jong Suk receives a mysterious message sent from a friend from 20 years ago which reminds him of the school violence that took place back then. Chasing the mysterious message, he tries to put a stop to the murders...

1047461.title: Heaven Official's Blessing (Thai Dub)
1047461.description: For you, I’ll become invincible! "Have you heard? The rubbish Heaven Official is having an affair with the ghost realm’s number one bigshot!" Eight hundred years ago, Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom; one who was beloved by his citizens and the darling of the world. Unsurprisingly, he ascended to the Heavens at a very young age. Now, eight hundred years later, Xie Lian ascends to the Heavens for the third time as the laughing stock of all three realms. On his first task as a god, he meets a mysterious demon who rules the ghosts and terrifies the Heavens……yet unbeknownst to Xie Lian, this demon king has been paying attention to him for a very, very long time.

1047521.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn As A Typical Nobody
1047521.description:
As the most powerful Demon Lord of all time, although Varvatos was admired, he was too powerful to be approached, so he always felt alone and decided to reincarnate as an 'ordinary' villager, Ard, in an attempt to start a new life.
No matter how much he avoids being an extraordinary presence, Ard cannot hide the fact that his power is far beyond normal people. His life is filled with people who loathe him, want to murder him, and want him to dominate the world.
Will the Demon Lord be able to live a peaceful and ordinary life?
A schoolyard hero fantasy with a twist is about to begin!
1047521.originName: 史上最強の大魔王、村人Aに転生する

1047664.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World
1047664.description: This is a heavy gamer. One day, he played video games as always, and he fell asleep in a daze... When he woke up, the changes in the surrounding environment made him pale, because he found himself in the game world, and what was even more unbelievable was that he turned into a skeleton! Although equipped with the powerful weapons and armor in the game, the appearance is still the terrifying skeleton image, and Arc must find a foothold for himself in this novel land. Then he met a beautiful elven warrior who broke his small desire to live a peaceful life and set him on a journey full of conflict and adventure...
1047664.originName: 骸骨騎士様、只今異世界へお出掛け中

1047791.title: Heroines Run The Show
1047791.description: This story mainly tells about Hiyori Suzumi, who continued to pursue track and field sports without giving up after leaving her hometown. Hiyori studied at Sakuraoka High School in Tokyo, juggling her studies and athletics, while looking for part-time jobs to meet her expenses. In the process of looking for a part-time job, Hiyori met the idol group LIPxLIP and became the apprentice manager of its members Yūjirō Someya and Aizo Shibasaki. In this way, Hiyori began to take care of school classes, extracurricular activities, part-time jobs, and the idol group LIPxLIP performing on stage at the same time, swaying the sweat called "youth".

1047893.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 2
1047893.description:
Naofumi Iwatani, a university student, is summoned to the other world as one of the Four Holy Bravehearts, the "Brave of the Shield".
Despite being persecuted for countless indiscretions, he struggled with his companions to defend people from the "wave" of disasters that threatened the world.
	However, strange happenings, such as the bat familiars and the Four Cardinal Heroes, cause the queen to doubt if the Spirit Tortoise has been reborn. The calm started to gradually be disrupted.
	What can be done to defeat this demon that has brought tremendous disaster? How to track the person who illegally awakened the spirit tortoise? Naofumi Iwatani's journey will never end！
1047893.originName: 盾の勇者の成り上がり Season2

1047987.title: RPG Real Estate
1047987.description: It has been 15 years since the Demon King was defeated and the world returned to peace, and the story of this work unfolds here. The heroine is Kotone, who has just graduated from school and successfully became a magician. To find a new residence, Kotone goes to RPG Real Estate, which belongs to the kingdom, to inquire about housing. Afterwards, RPG Real Estate also became Kotone's actual working place, where together with the lively demihuman Fa, the calm priest Rufuria, and the brave warrior Rakira, they helped the various clients consulted earlier to find a satisfactory one. new home. From this, the fantasy story of another world begins!

1048047.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Collision
1048047.description: The story takes place in Space Age Calendar 797 (Imperial Calendar 488). Both the Galactic Empire and the Alliance of Free Planets have experienced civil wars severe enough to shake the nation. In this war, Reinhard established his dominance in the empire by eliminating the nobles of the enemy country, but he also paid a heavy price, that is, he lost an irreplaceable friend. On the other hand, although a domestic coup was successfully quelled by Yang, an unprecedented danger is quietly approaching him. The next year, the Empire and the Alliance went to war again, these two geniuses met on the battlefield and sparked...
1048047.originName: 銀河英雄伝説 Die Neue These 激突

1048185.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
1048185.description:
Leon, an office worker, gets reincarnated into a dating sim game world where women take the dominant position. Moreover, men are viewed as stepping stones, except for a group of charming men led by the crown prince.
As for Leon, he has a special weapon: he can recall every detail of his previous experience in the original world, where he was forced to finish the whole game.
Initially intending to live the mundane life of a roadie in the countryside, Leon uses his understanding of the game to inadvertently join the fight against hordes of women and handsome men.
1048185.originName: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です

1048330.title: Miss Shachiku and the Little Baby Ghost.
1048330.description:
A little ghost girl gets worried when Ms. Fushihara, a corporate slave, is working till midnight and tries to make her go home. While saying "Leave now~," the ghost girl helps and brings her refreshments, healing Ms. Fushihara's heart with her preciousness. Be healed by the heartwarming daily life of the cute little ghost and the corporate slave Ms. Fushihara.

The ghost wants Miss Fushihara to get off work quickly for her health, and Miss Fushihara doesn't want to get off work because the ghost is too cute. This is a healing and lovely touching story weaved by such two people(?).
1048330.originName: 社畜さんは幼女幽霊に癒されたい。

1048404.title: The Demon Girl Next Door S2

1048471.title: Healer Girl
1048471.description:
Third Medicine, Healing, or "Sound Medicine", which heals diseases and scars by singing. Therefore, people who heal others by singing are called "healers".
Three trainee healers working at Karasumaru Sound Therapy Center. An energetic atmosphere maker, Kana Fujii. A slightly stronger eldest, Reimi Itsushiro. A steady and reliable big sister, Hibiki Morishima. After school, the three freshmen of high school are training to become independent healers at the Karasumaru Treatment Center! Returnee Yanagi Sonia, who holds a C-level healer certificate, also joined the group. The girls are marching toward their dreams, and they will sing the song of healing today!

1048554.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It r=1-sinθ
1048554.description: In the Okinawa Hejuku, on the bridge that reached the highest atmospheric value due to the cloud gap light of the rising sun, Yukimura and Himuro kissed with the highest theoretical value, but since the amount of saliva collected was not enough, it was decided to measure again. In order to visit the saliva testing experts, the group went to the School of Life Sciences of the Ministry of Science and Technology. In front of them appeared Suiu, a gorgeous woman dressed as an oiran and dressed in white, and her lover Chris. Yukimura invites Suiu and the two to help them complete the "experiment to prove their love", but because of this, they see the overwhelming aura of Suiu's love...
1048554.originName: 理系が恋に落ちたので証明してみた。r=1-sinθ

1048782.title: Kingdom Season 4
1048782.description: One of the largest battles in history against the allied forces left a gaping hole in the Qin state and China as a whole. Ying Zheng tells Prince Cheng Jiao about his ambition to become the dominant ruler of a united China.

1048837.title: SPY x FAMILY
1048837.description:
Corrupt politicians, frenzied nationalists, and other warmongering forces constantly jeopardize the thin veneer of peace between neighboring countries Ostania and Westalis. In spite of their plots, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" fulfills dangerous missions one after another in the hope that no child will have to experience the horrors of war.

In the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint, Twilight dons the alias of "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist. However, his true intention is to gather intelligence on prominent politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears rarely in public at his son's school: the prestigious Eden Academy. Enlisting the help of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar to act as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter, Loid enacts his master plan. He will enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where Loid hopes she will excel and give him the opportunity to meet Donovan without arousing suspicion.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his talents has trouble playing the figure of a loving father and husband. And just like Loid is hiding his true identity, Yor—who is an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to disclose their own secrets either. Although this picture-perfect family is founded on deception, the Forgers gradually come to understand that the love they share for one another trumps all else.

1048975.title: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー
1048975.description:
Falling in love can turn geniuses into idiots! 
At the elite school where the geniuses gather, Kaguya-sama, the vice president of the student council, and Shirogane Miyuki, the president, are recognized as a perfect match for each other. They seem to be on the verge of starting a relationship, but because of their strong self-esteem, neither of them has confessed!  In the battle of “how to make each other confess their love first”, they use all their wits ......
How will their relationship situation change by the last day of the Cultural Festival? A super romantic comedy will start again!
1048975.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい-ウルトラロマンティック-

1049041.title: Date A Live IV
1049041.description: Shidou encounters a starving woman lying on the street and ends up helping her. The woman introduces herself as Nia Honjou—a popular comic artist working under a pen name. However, Nia reveals that she is also a Spirit and is aware of Shidou's secret operation...
1049041.originName: デート・ア・ライブ　4期

1049174.title: The Dawn of the Witch
1049174.description:
The war that raged between the Church and the Witches for five centuries finally ended in peace but the embers of that age-old conflict still smolder.

A struggling student named Sable has no memories of his time before being enrolled. At the command of Headmaster Albus, he left the Kingdom to travel to the southern reaches of the continent. Accompanying him are a party of individuals strong in both ability and personality; there's the one known as the Witch of the Dawn, Roux Cristasse, who seeks the forbidden knowledge of primeval magic in the 'Grimoire of Zero', the genius girl Holtz, as well as the school's sole beast, Kudd.

Just what truth shall they uncover in their journey to the south...?

1049294.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Season3
1049294.description:
Towards a world where everyone can read!
Maine, who possesses powerful magic and incredible knowledge is secretly targeted by the nobles who find useful value in her, and the nobles who resent her. With more and more things for Maine to protect, she has to face claws and dangers...
What will happen to Maine?!

1049425.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
1049425.description: Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be... but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!
1049425.originName: 式守さんは可愛いだけじゃない

1049679.title: Love after World Domination
1049679.description: Fudou, also known as "Red Gelato", is the leader of the hero squadron "Gelato 5", whose mission is to bring about world peace. On the other hand, Desumi is the minion leader of "Gecko", a villainous organization seeking world domination. However, despite these differences, their relationship is not quite what it seems. When they are not making a show of being at each other's threats, Desumi and Fudou continue to pursue a forbidden love.
1049679.originName: 恋は世界征服のあとで

1049915.title: I'm Quitting Heroing
1049915.description:
Leo saved the world from the attacks of the Demon King's army, but this power was also a threat to the people who ushered in a world of peace. He was eventually banished, losing his status, honour and home. The wandering hero chose to join the army of the Demon King who had just experienced defeat.
Leo concealed his identity and use his abilities to solve the financial problems, assisting king to reorganise the army. Suddenly, the appearance of Echidna unleashes a new and unexpected story for Leo..

1049994.title: DEAIMON
1049994.description: When his father is hospitalised, Nagomu Irino returns to his Kyoto home for the first time in ten years. Nagomu decides to take over the Ryokushou family's Japanese sweet shop, but there is an alternate heir in the shop. As they spend time together, the two get to know each other...

1050107.title: Love All Play
1050107.description:
Ryou Mizushima has always had a great passion for badminton. After joining a badminton club in junior high school, Mizushima continued to improve himself with this effort, although he did not have the right coach to guide him.
Finally, Ebihara, the high school badminton coach, made an offer to him. However, Mizushima's indecisiveness made him hesitant to enter such a prestigious school. With a strong push from his sister Rika, he decided to go to Yokohama Minato. Will Mizushima keep winning in the high school league in the future under the guidance of a good coach?

1050167.title: BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls’ Story-
1050167.description:
Nafrece, in a particular nation in Europe.
Eve, who has a natural talent for the game, plays golf every day to support herself. One day, she met Aoi Amawashi, the elite golfer and daughter of a conglomerate, in a fatal encounter. Two brilliant people who reside in totally separate worlds. Only one bullet each into the heart. Aoi, the "innocent tyrant," who is carefree and only enjoys golf, and Eve of the "Rainbow Bullet," the bullet with a rainbow of colors. The two are drawn to one another, have an impact on one another, and alter one another. The narrative of a golf girl created by the fusion of abilities.
The first original animated television series in the world featuring a female golfer premieres!
"Spread your wings and fly to the world!"

1050301.title: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
1050301.description: The Lost Ones are wanderers from a faraway world known as "Japan" who have brought disaster and misfortune into the present day. The responsibility to destroy them, therefore, belongs to Menou, the young executioner. However, Akari appears to hinder Menou's murderous progress. An amazing journey begins when Menou sets out to find a way to defeat the immortals ......
1050301.originName: 処刑少女の生きる道(バージンロード)

1050512.title: Fanfare of Adolescence
1050512.originName: 群青のファンファーレ

1050596.title: Don't Hurt Me, My Healer!
1050596.originName: このヒーラー、めんどくさい

1050744.title: In the Heart of Kunoichi Tsubaki
1050744.description:
Akane Clan is an all-girls institution that focuses on training young martial artists in isolation. There is an unbreakable rule that "men are forbidden to associate with them because they are dangerous beings".

Kunoichi Tsubaki, as captain, is an excellent trainee. With a great future ahead of her, she begins to experience a strange feeling that the mere mention of boys is...
1050744.originName: くノ一ツバキの胸の内

1050808.title: A Couple of Cuckoos
1050808.description:
With the exception of Nagi, a solemn and shy young man who only cares about his studies, the members of the Umino family are all quite similar: they are all extremely active and enthusiastic. Like his younger sister Sachi, who is a reflection of her outgoing parents, he is the exact antithesis of that person. Therefore, it shouldn't be shocking that Nagi was switched with another child at birth.
Erika Amano, a young social media sensation, is encountered by Nagi as he travels to see his real parents. He finds out about Erika's forced marriage while spending the day with her. Later on that day, Nagi finds out that Erika's fiancé is actually him, thus they can be recognised as members of each other's families. Nagi's biological father sets up for the engaged couple to begin living together in an effort to strengthen their love! No matter what their parents do, Nagi won't agree to marry Erika. That's because he already has Hiro Segawa in his sights, who is both attractive and intelligent.

1051049.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War S2 OVA
1051049.description:
The leading representatives of the student body at the prestigious Shuchiin Academy are Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya. Miyuki, president of the student council, is regarded as the best student in the country and is well-liked by both mentors and peers. Vice president Kaguya, the oldest child of the affluent Shinomiya family, outperforms him in every sphere of endeavour. Their reputation as the ideal pair makes them the envy of the whole student body.
While having previously grown fond of each other,  both of them are hesitant to express their feelings. The first to admit defeat will be despised and seen as less than. Miyuki and Kaguya are equally motivated to prevail on the battlefield of love since their pride and dignity are on the line.
1051049.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい？～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～ OVA

1051162.title: Love Class
1051162.description: Depicts a youth drama about a first love that is full of excitement through the protagonist, who learns the meaning of family and community.

1051212.title: Shine On! Bakumatsu Bad Boys
1051212.description: When the samurai took charge of Japan, an unidentified attacker destroyed the Shinsengumi, a samurai group, and left only one survivor. As doubles for the Shinsengumi, seven convicts are picked. A doubles mythology begins to play out to safeguard Kyoto's security.

1051287.title: Rift
1051287.description: The Rift between the present world and the alternative world caused by the instability of energy is the only passage to the present world for the monsters in the alternative world. In order to block the invasion of monsters, in the present world, a group of people with special power bravely went into the Rift to defend the world.

1051510.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside(Thai Dub)
1051510.description:
A 30-year-old office worker named Liu Yinuo was unintentionally called into the virtual world.
Excellent gamer Liu Yinuo started teaching Tian Enya, an 18-year-old girl who is the gaming world's saviour, how to play games in order to return to reality.
The two ladies eventually achieved their objective in the virtual world with the assistance of other partners, and they left the virtual world with a more upbeat outlook on life.
1051510.originName: 真の仲間じゃないと勇者のパーティーを追い出されたので、辺境でスローライフすることにしました

1051576.title: Word of Honor
1051576.description: The four teenagers left the academy to find the truth and solve the mystery of their births. They experience all kinds of difficulties and dangers and finally grow into men of honor.

1051702.title: You're A Genius!
1051702.description: There are Western Continent and Eastern Continent in an alternative world. The northern part of the Western Continent is inhabited by mysterious Snow Mountain tribes, while the southern part is occupied by the Great Qin Empire. The Magic is the source of energy in the world. By the power of the Magic, the Great Qin Empire became powerful. Then a young boy with special power from the north began a journey of the practice against the Magic in the Southern Continent.

1053337.title: The Last Summoner
1053337.description: This is a fiction world of Summoners. The person who can summon the spirits of all objects is called the Summoner. Since ancient times, the legend of the Summoners has been deeply embedded in the corner of history. In the new era, there are five Summoners who awaken to fight against the mysterious power. Five friends fight shoulder to shoulder to discover the truth in the Summoner world.

1053408.title: Face on Lie
1053408.description: The ugly girl, Han Yuxi starts a new bright life after the plastic surgery. So she will have a happy life? Or hence, her life will be conspiratorially controlled...

1055718.title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon R: Make Up! Sailor Senshi
1055718.originName: メイクアップ！ セーラー戦士

1056980.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World (Thai Dub)
1056980.description: This is a heavy gamer. One day, he played video games as always, and he fell asleep in a daze... When he woke up, the changes in the surrounding environment made him pale, because he found himself in the game world, and what was even more unbelievable was that he turned into a skeleton! Although equipped with the powerful weapons and armor in the game, the appearance is still the terrifying skeleton image, and Arc must find a foothold for himself in this novel land. Then he met a beautiful elven warrior who broke his small desire to live a peaceful life and set him on a journey full of conflict and adventure...
1056980.originName: 骸骨騎士様、只今異世界へお出掛け中

1057045.title: KAGUYA-SAMA LOVE IS WAR ーUltra Romanticー (Thai Dub)
1057045.description:
Falling in love can turn geniuses into idiots!
At the elite school where the geniuses gather, Kaguya-sama, the vice president of the student council, and Shirogane Miyuki, the president, are recognized as a perfect match for each other. They seem to be on the verge of starting a relationship, but because of their strong self-esteem, neither of them has confessed! In the battle of “how to make each other confess their love first”, they use all their wits ......
How will their relationship situation change by the last day of the Cultural Festival? A super romantic comedy will start again!
1057045.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい-ウルトラロマンティック-

1057120.title: SPY x FAMILY (Thai Dub)
1057120.description: To make the operation a success, Twilight, also known as "Lloyd Forger", immediately recruits humble orphan Anya to play the role of her six-year-old daughter and future Eden Academy student. As a wife, he meets Yor Briar, an absent-minded office worker who needs a pretend partner to impress her friends. Anya is no ordinary girl on the surface; she's a psychic, the product of a secret experiment that allows her to read minds. Even though she has discovered their true identities, Anya is glad her new parents are cool agents!

1057175.title: SPY x FAMILY (VN Dub)
1057175.description: To make the operation a success, Twilight, also known as "Lloyd Forger", immediately recruits humble orphan Anya to play the role of her six-year-old daughter and future Eden Academy student. As a wife, he meets Yor Briar, an absent-minded office worker who needs a pretend partner to impress her friends. Anya is no ordinary girl on the surface; she's a psychic, the product of a secret experiment that allows her to read minds. Even though she has discovered their true identities, Anya is glad her new parents are cool agents!

1057318.title: SPY x FAMILY (Dub Indo)
1057318.description: To make the operation a success, Twilight, also known as "Lloyd Forger", immediately recruits humble orphan Anya to play the role of her six-year-old daughter and future Eden Academy student. As a wife, he meets Yor Briar, an absent-minded office worker who needs a pretend partner to impress her friends. Anya is no ordinary girl on the surface; she's a psychic, the product of a secret experiment that allows her to read minds. Even though she has discovered their true identities, Anya is glad her new parents are cool agents!

1057517.title: Dancing through the Millennia
1057517.description: "Dancing Through the Millennia" is a Chinese dance cultural variety show produced by bilibili and Henan Provincial TV. The show intends to bring the essence of China's 5,000-year history to life in front of audiences through the art of dance. The show breaks tradition as it makes the loss of the Twelve Divine Dances manuscript the basis of its story. Appointing five leading dancers, Qiao Zhenyu, Zhang Xiaolong, Hu Yang, Hua Xiaoyi and Xu Minghao (The8), it assigns then to recommend performances to restore the manuscript. Five dancers, also the five referees, will time travel to explore the most representative dances throughout history, role-playing their way through a series of plots set against the four dynasties.

1057580.title: Let Me Check the Walkthrough First
1057580.description: A 30-year-old office worker named Liu Yinuo was unintentionally called into the virtual world. Excellent gamer Liu Yinuo started teaching Tian Enya, an 18-year-old girl who is the gaming world's saviour, how to play games in order to return to reality. The two ladies eventually achieved their objective in the virtual world with the assistance of other partners, and they left the virtual world with a more upbeat outlook on life.

1057710.title: Summer refuge
1057710.description: Summer Refuge is an intergenerational observation reality show produced by Bilibili. The program, in cooperation with the China Aging Association affiliated to the State Council, invited three experienced elders who living alone in Shanghai to start a 21 day intergenerational living experience with some Shanghai floating youth who have a unique attitude towards life. By truly recording the lives of the elderly and young people under the same roof, the program allows the two generations to approach and understand each other's world, so as to explore a new way of life in the future, and create a "home" with no blood relationship but family affection in the city.

1057839.title: 90's DATING AGENCY
1057839.description: “90 Dating Agency” aims to help the post‑90s generation find a 90‑out‑of‑100 love. The show focuses on single men and women of this generation, adopting an equal and positive approach to explore and showcase healthy intimate relationships. With a female‑centric perspective, contestants navigate gamified dating challenges, getting to know multiple male suitors in search of their ideal partner. Here, guests enjoy maximum freedom in making their choices, using their own judgment to shape their destinies.

1057959.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles (Thai Dub)
1057959.description: Rio is a cold-hearted orphan who resides in the slums. At the young age of 7, he discovers that he is the reincarnation of Amakawa Haruto, a tragically deceased Japanese university student. Rio discovers he has extraordinarily powerful magical skills while still suffering from this unexpected realisation, and he utilises his new abilities to solve the kidnapping case of a little girl. His kind act is recognised, and as payment, he is accepted into... a renowned academy for noble children?

1058105.title: My Dress-Up Darling (Thai Dub)
1058105.description: Despite being a shy high school student without friends, Wakana Gojou is an extraordinarily talented dressmaker. His lovely classmate Marin Kitagawa quickly learns of his sewing prowess, and Gojou is both envious of her courage and honesty as well as his sewing skill. She enjoys dressing up as pornographic video game characters but is unable to sew her own outfits, so she seeks Gojou's help. Because of their ability to support one another, despite being polar opposites, their friendship progressively develops.
1058105.originName: その着せ替え人形は恋をする

1058219.title: Informal Talks S7
1058219.description: Informal Talks is a Chinese talk show co-produced by bilibili and Hubei Television. Every episode has 11 young men and women express their opinions on the core issues that young people are concerned about, and begins with a Culture Discussion, followed by debates related to the discussion topic. The tone of the show can range from serious to emotional to humorous. Break down our perceptions and discover new worlds!

1058326.title: Ranking of Kings
1058326.description:
The youthful Prince Bojji, who is deaf and mute, is despised by the populace of the kingdom. They mock his alleged folly, calling him "The Useless Prince."
Bojji isn't very powerful physically, but he's definitely not a coward. Instead of traumatising him, a fortuitous meeting with a shadow monster leads him to assume that he has found a friend among others who only prefer to focus on his flaws. He begins meeting with Kage, the shadow, frequently to the point that even the usually hostile animal starts to like him.
The prince's quest to overcome his anxieties and doubts is beginning to take shape thanks to the unexpected connection that Kage and Bojji have developed. Bojji decides to achieve his goal of becoming the finest monarch he can be despite the ongoing mockery he endures.

1058898.title: Bleach Movie 2: The DiamondDust Rebellion - Mou Hitotsu no Hyourinmaru
1058898.originName: 劇場版BLEACH The DiamondDust Rebellion もう一つの氷輪丸

1058985.title: Bleach Movie 3: Fade to Black - Kimi no Na wo Yobu
1058985.originName: 劇場版BLEACH Fade to Black 君の名を呼ぶ

1059383.title: TOKYO MEW MEW NEW
1059383.description: The tale of Ichigo Momomiya, a young girl who uses the Iriomote leopard cat's transformation power to change into Mew Ichigo (Strawberry) in order to save Earth from the parasitic Chimera Anima invaders.
1059383.originName: 東京ミュウミュウ にゅ〜♡

1059473.title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
1059473.description:
Ayumu Tanaka and Urushi Yaotome are both members of the school chess club, Ayumu is a freshman in high school and Urushi is her senior.
In a game of chess, Urushi beats Ayumu, and Urushi is determined to get Ayumu to admit that she likes him, but Ayumu keeps a poker face about it...
1059473.originName: それでも歩は寄せてくる

1059621.title: Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation
1059621.description: The plot centres on five girls known as the "Pentagrams," who aspire to become "true ladies worthy of the name". They often learn the arts of magic and etiquette while cultivating their overall culture in Ashram boarding school. The five pupils in question, Arsnotoria, Mell, Little Alberta, Picatrix, and Abramelin, attend lessons together, engage inactivities, and even drink tea after class in a secret chamber. The story is unfolding...

1059727.title: Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth
1059727.description: In Mask of Truth, chaos has overtaken the nation when a cunning commander forcibly assumed control of the ancient Yamato Empire. The only opponents in his path are a pair of well-known figures who must unite many kingdoms and take on the formidable Imperial army.
1059727.originName: うたわれるもの　二人の白皇

1060007.title: Extreme Hearts
1060007.description: Sports enthusiasts of all ages like the discipline of hypersport in particular. Players can employ support items and outfit themselves with particular equipment to practise it. Hiyori Hayama as a school idol has never tried the sport, but his meeting with Saki Kodaka and Sumika Maehara is likely to change his life completely...

1060127.title: The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting
1060127.description:
Kirishima Tooru is such an evil 'Yakuza' that he has earned the nickname 'The Demon of Sakuragi'. In order to control him, the boss suddenly gives him a new task - to look after his daughter!".
The heartwarming comedy of the young boss and the team leader's only daughter - A brand new daily routine for the two begins.

1060252.title: Black Summoner
1060252.description:
Kelvin discovers that during his most recent transmigration, when he awoke in a strange new location with no memory of his previous existence, he had actually traded those precise memories for new skills. With the goddess who carried him over as his first follower, he is about to enter a brand-new realm as a Summoner. After starting his new life as an adventurer, Kelvin realises that he has a hidden propensity for fighting.
He relishes the struggle against each daunting adversary, from the Black Knight of the Ancient Castle of Evil Spirits to the monster hidden inside the Hidden Cave of the Sage. Come along with this OP adventurer as he and his companions etch their names into the pages of history in this thrilling epic drama!

1060323.title: ORIENT 2
1060323.description: Musashi and his companion Kojirou Kanemaki pledged to become samurai, create a league, and embark on demon-slaying missions five years ago. However, with demons now being exalted and worshipped, society has avoided and denigrated the samurai. Musashi conceals his swordsmanship while blending in with the town's orthodoxy because of fear that he may expose his dream. Despite striving and failing, Kojirou still sets off on a voyage with Musashi in the hopes of discovering his genuine sentiments. The pair plunges deeply into the mysterious realm of beast-slaying without knowing what their future holds.
1060323.originName: オリエント orient 二期

1060402.title: The Devil Is a Part-Timer! Season 2
1060402.description:
With only one last step left to conquer the world, Satan loses to the hero Emilia Justina and flees to another world: modern-day Tokyo.
In the new world, his world-conquering skills are completely useless and he has to find a part-time job to make ends meet. The hero follows in his footsteps and comes to this world too, working in a customer support call centre. Under the new names of Maou Sadao and Yusa Emi, the two meet again.
1060402.originName: はたらく魔王さま！第2期

1060488.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2
1060488.description:
Kōdo Ikusei Senior High School is a reputable school with cutting-edge facilities where nearly all graduates go on to university or find work. Students are able to wear any haircut and bring any personal belongings they like. 
Kiyotaka Ayanokji fails his entrance examinations for some reason and is assigned to Class-D. Class-D is where the school abandons "inferior" students to ridicule them. When he meets Suzune Horikita and Kiky Kushida, things start to change.
1060488.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ第2期

1060564.title: The Lucifer and Biscuit Hammer
1060564.description: Amamiya Yuuhi is a normal student in a normal college. Everything about him is ordinary: his grades, his good looks and his breezy approach to life. One day, a talking lizard tells him that there is a giant hammer in outer space ready to split the Earth into pieces and asks for his allegiance against the forces of evil. The tranquilly is disturbed as Yuuhi hooks up with the unpredictable Princess to assemble a disparate band of allies to fight back against the villainous mage.

1060698.title: Sekai no Owari ni Shiba Inu to
1060698.description: A catastrophic event has reduced Earth to a lifeless wasteland, leaving a little girl as the lone remaining member of the human race. She has a strange companion with her as she travels through this apocalyptic setting: a talking Shiba Inu! With his clever pranks, this quirky dog Haru helps travellers cope with the isolation of the road. Haru makes sure that his owner's experience is anything from boring, whether it is by igniting philosophical debates or competing with other canines over affection.
1060698.originName: 世界の終わりに柴犬と

1060781.title: Nights with a Cat
1060781.description: A story about Fuuta's relationship with her new cat. After a long day at work, the boy enjoys nothing more than spending time with his furry friend and making fun of his typical house cat's peculiar behaviour.

1060852.title: Overlord IV
1060852.description:
Virtual reality gaming is extremely popular in 2138. 
As a well-liked online game, Yggdrasil is abruptly taken offline. Nevertheless, Momonga, a player who refuses to log-out, takes on the form of a skeleton and becomes "the most powerful wizard."
The gaming environment continued to develop as non-player characters (NPCs) started to exhibit emotions. Without family or friends in this game, Momonga must overcome various barriers to rule the game's brand-new world.

1060924.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? IV
1060924.description:
In Orario, Bell Cranel is the only adventurer of the Hestia Familia living here. He is weak compared to the senior dungeon crawlers but he possesses a special skill. 

As long as he keeps his feelings for the Sword princess Aiz unchanged, he can become powerful instantly. Moreover, with the help of his goddess Hestia, he vows to become strong enough to fight alongside Aiz and protect others!
1060924.originName: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうかIV

1061066.title: Lycoris Recoil
1061066.description: A secret is hidden in the peace of life: the DA (Direct Attack), a secret organization for crime prevention. LYCORIS, a group of young girls who work as agents, works in the LycoReco branch of the café. They take orders for everything from coffee and desserts to childcare, Japanese teachers and monster fighting. Whatever your order, leave it to LycoReco!

1061147.title: My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex
1061147.description: After a horrible middle school relationship, high school is the best place to start over. It was supposed to be a peaceful refuge where I could avoid seeing my ex again, but now it's a nightmare! My ex and I went to the same school and became step-brothers. Wherever I go, I can see her - my home, my school, my class...  Yes, we are family now. I am her older brother. Although we used to love each other, both of us eventually grew to realise that we were not suited to each other. We may remain siblings, but things will never return to the way they used to be.
1061147.originName: 継母の連れ子が元カノだった

1061248.title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World
1061248.description:
Sano Yuji is an ordinary employee employed by a black company. Suddenly, he is summoned to another world and becomes a beast tamer. Occasionally, he meets some slimes who have read magical books that help him gain magical powers and a second career, Sage. 
Despite obtaining overwhelming power, Yuji is unaware of himself. Under the unconscious, Yuji Become the strongest in the world！
1061248.originName: 転生賢者の異世界ライフ～第二の職業を得て、世界最強になりました～

1061357.title: SHADOWS HOUSE 2
1061357.description: A magnificent mansion is home to a faceless clan who poses as aristocrats. Living dolls who look after them spend their days clearing up the messes the renters make. However, there is a greater mystery at work, and the house's secret will be revealed.

1061490.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
1061490.description: The mystery of the Abyss, with all its uncanny features, has attracted many people to venture into it. Gradually, people began to refer to the adventurers who challenged the great cave many times as "cave explorers". What new stories are in store for Reg, Riko, and Nanachi?
1061490.originName: メイドインアビス 烈日の黄金郷

1061632.title: The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious
1061632.description:
This is the story of an odd maid and a lonely boy.
The maid I recently hired was pretty odd. Nobody in the real world could be so stunning, make such great cuisine, or anticipate my needs. she must be employing magic. Yes, only a spell could account for why my chest tightens up whenever I see her. I believe I need to discover what makes this maid so enigmatic!
1061632.originName: 最近雇ったメイドが怪しい

1061852.title: Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World
1061852.description: A man is looking for ways to die on the internet in an attempt to commit suicide, but a strange website attracts his attention. The website asks a variety of questions and eventually generates a character with skill and ability. When he finished setting up his character, a warning popped up "You will now be transported to a world in the setting of your choice, returning is not possible, do you still accept". Without hesitation, he pressed "yes" and travelled to another world...
1061852.originName: 異世界迷宮でハーレムを

1062124.title: Shoot! Goal to the Future
1062124.description: Former Kakegawa High School captain Atsushi Kamiya is acclaimed as the "courageous captain" of a well-known Italian soccer team. A student at the same school named Hideto Tsuji appears bored in the depleted soccer team. Their encounter marks the beginning of a new story.
1062124.originName: シュート　Goal to the Future

1062204.title: CARDFIGHT!! VANGUARD will+Dress
1062204.description:
After the Battle of Nagoya Castle, Yu-yu and his comrades were invited to competition four months later.
This "deluxe" tournament pits the best fighters against one another for the flag, including both "frontline fighters" involved in the main competition and "counter fighters" with a secretive edge like "Black Wind."
To determine who is the strongest of them all, existing characters from overDress will face off against brand-new characters from will+Dress like Raika, Michiru, and Urara.
1062204.originName: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード will+Dress

1062286.title: League of Nations Air Force Aviation Magic Band Luminous Witcheseses
1062286.description: Unlike the witches of the traditional Defence Fleet, there is this group of witches who defend everyone's smiles and fight their enemies through the healing power of music, these witches are known as the icons of Music Squadron.
1062286.originName: 連盟空軍航空魔法音楽隊 ルミナスウィッチーズ

1062349.title: Fuuto PI
1062349.description: Criminals in the city of Fuuto transform into super monsters known as "Dopants" by using USB-like gadgets called "Gaia Memories," causing chaos in an otherwise tranquil city. Shoutarou Hidari, a self-described "seasoned investigator," is one of the heroes who employ "Gaia Memories" to combat these crooks. Together with his ingenious partner Philip, Kamen Rider W, the renowned hero of Fuuto City, is created.

1062554.title: Parallel World Pharmacy
1062554.description:
After being devastated by the loss of his little sister, world-renowned medical researcher Kanji Yakutani poured everything he had into inventing new medicines. At the age of 31, the former pharmacist died on the job and awoke to find that he had been reincarnated into a medieval world as Falma, a child of the revered De Médicis family.
Falma realises that his body is the master of a medical patron saint. The boy was given mythical divine magic and the ability to instantly diagnose diseases.
