Using modern knowledge and his divine powers, Falma wins the approval of the court and is given a pharmacy of his own. But his goal does not stop there, he wants to improve the state of medical care in the S an Fleuve Empire and make it accessible to all.

1062677.title: Phantom of the Idol
1062677.description:
A scrappy idol with a miracle? Yuuya, a good-looking male idol who can't sing or dance, has no fans and no motivation, enters the entertainment industry to earn money but is fired due to his lack of enthusiasm. One day, he meets the "ghost" of the "God Idol, Mogami Asahi"! The two men, who are very different from each other, join forces to reach the top of the idol world!
This summer, the rare and dull idol Yuuya (in every sense of the word) is in the spotlight!

1062776.title: Engage Kiss
1062776.description:
On an artificial island in the Pacific Ocean, a giant floating metropolis, created by the discovery of a new energy source, is known as Veyron City.
Here begins a hilarious romantic comedy between three people who have a somewhat unusual relationship; Shuu, young and running a small business in the city, but living on a shoestring due to his mindless spending, and Kisara, a girl who often parties with Shuu. Ayano, Shuu's ex-girlfriend and a senior colleague at his former company, is working and attending high school in Veyron.

1062828.title: Love Live! Superstar!! (2nd season)
1062828.originName: ラブライブスーパースター 二期

1063023.title: Blood and heart: The legendary life of a Japanese youth in China
1063023.description: This work chronicles the legendary life of Japanese-born People’s Liberation Army soldier Sa Yuan Hui, shedding light on the little‑known true history of this unique group. Born in Kyushu, Japan, in 1933, Sa Yuan Hui moved to Northeast China with her parents at an early age. Following Japan’s defeat and surrender, unable to return home, she found herself stranded and took up the task of tending cattle for a landlord in Liaoning. In 1948, adopting the name Zhang Rongqing, she joined the People’s Liberation Army and went on to participate in the Liaoshen and Pingjin Campaigns, dedicating herself to the proletarian revolutionary cause.

1063077.title: Fairies Albums S3
1063077.description: This story told the experience between Tao Yao, Mo Ya and Childe Liu's tour in JingShi, which showed that the distance between human and human, human and fairy may not be as insurmountable as imagined. Whether the interaction between Tao Yao and Ding Sansi, or the guidance the Old Zhang told to Childe Liu about life-overstep and cooking skills, or the dilemma when Mo Ya faced Xi Nang, these let each of them acquire new growth. Meanwhile, Feng Wule, Chen Baishui and others also obtained their own redemption. It may be that the journey of life is influenced by each other in this way with all of its flavors.

1063156.title: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei
1063156.description: A 5000-year-old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoke her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.
1063156.originName: 食草老龙被冠以恶龙之名

1063218.title: War God System! I’m Counting On You!
1063218.description: Ordinary young man An Lin from the city stumbles upon a powerful cultivator, who bestows upon him the God of War System and transports him to the Spirit Realm to train. Freshly arrived, An Lin—whose talents are far from exceptional—is derided as the “strongest appointment-based recruit.” Determined to shed that stigma, the optimistic An Lin, with the system’s aid, hones his cultivation prowess. Through a series of remarkable feats, he forges bonds of lifelong camaraderie with a band of brothers who would go through life and death together, embarking on a path of triumphant resurgence.
1063218.originName: 靠你啦！战神系统（原：我修的可能是个假仙）

1063303.title: God Troubles Me Season 3
1063303.description: Su Moting is a young woman working as a corporate slave with the status of "the child of a god and demon". After being driven out of the house by her parents on the grounds of "independence and self-improvement", Su Moting meets a dumb, handsome god, Tian Jixing, and a mysterious cool cat demon, Di Kuixing. They are also exiled to the human world. Having formed a savior group under the leadership of the land god, the three began to show their heartache and funny side in daily life. Stay tuned for exciting stories from God Troubles Me the third season!

1063408.title: Master of the Star Spring
1063408.description: Su Jiu accidentally gained the power of "Star Spring" and became the master of it. For this, he set out for a cultivation journey with a fun and extraordinary experience.

1063477.title: Cinderella Chef S3
1063477.originName: 萌妻食神之欢喜追婚 S3

1063557.title: JX Online3：The Adventure of Shen Jianxin 3rd Season
1063557.description: The martial world has long since lost its peace. The Five Saints Sect, once content to hold its ground in a corner of the realm, has repeatedly fallen under attack, while the ruined village of Maple Blossom Valley has begun to stir with inexplicable unrest. The Assassin has returned to the jianghu, and newcomers Qu Yun and A Liang have made their debut… After years adrift on Clearwater Island, Shen Jianxin is suddenly ambushed. What new crisis will he face this time?

1063812.title: A World Worth Protecting
1063812.description: In the fantastic future world with rich spiritual energy, the enthusiastic and cheerful little fatty Wang Baole saw through the illusion created by the teachers in the entrance examination of the famous"Mischievous Taoist Academy", who won high scores with his outstanding performance, and obtained the special quota of "Magic Soldier Department". Later, he overcome obstacles and opened up his own way of growing. In the process of cultivating immortals and fighting monsters, he made a large number of close friends, and thus started a series of hilarious adventure stories.

1063944.title: Millenniums Of Warring States
1063944.description:
Advanced gamer and streamer, Ji Qing traveled back to the Spring and Autumn Period equipped with a cheater "Shaohao Bone". However, the historical event "The Emperor and the Assassin" somehow succeeded, and the Seven Kingdoms fought for controlling each other, thus wars continued for thousands of years. Ren Yong, a bold man with loyalty and righteousness has also participated in the race. 
Now, how will "The Eternal Life" Ji Qing show his talents in the turbulent world?

1064017.title: Fairy Mountain
1064017.description: The young man from the Eastern Kingdom, “Fantiān,” is on a secret mission when he arrives in the Central Plains and suffers a shipwreck, losing part of his memory. Fantiān is rescued by a girl named “Gōngliáng Shān” who has a leg ailment. To repay her life‑saving kindness, he agrees to Master Niányǐn’s request: to take Shān’ér and the temple’s treasured tome down the mountain in search of the immortal island described within, hoping to cure her leg. Their journey takes them through Huáncuì Bay. Meanwhile, the Central Plains general “Lǐ Mào,” acting on the Empress Dowager’s orders, heads to Huáncuì Bay to track the emperor’s whereabouts. After braving countless perils, all converge at Huáncuì Bay. Fantiān finally recovers his memories—and the mysterious treasures he stumbled upon along the way bring him tantalizingly close to becoming the most powerful man under heaven.

1064244.title: SWARM
1064244.description: A seemingly ordinary traffic accident led to multiple forces being involved. While everyone rushed to investigate the truth a series of unexpected situations broke out. The crisis hidden behind the unsettled case exceeded everybody's imagination...When human beings are busy exploring their limits, they are not aware of standing at the crossroads of evolution once again, and a magnificent Big Era began...

1064361.title: TEPPEN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!: Laughing ’til You Cry
1064361.description: Yayoi Sakamoto is a comedian and a die-hard fan of comedy shows. After entering the private Kazuki High School, she reunites with her old friend Yomogi Takahashi, with whom the two used to form the comedy duo "Konamonzu". As before, they are in the park choreographing their entry when suddenly a mysterious girl calls out to them...

1064501.title: Dr. Stone: Stone Wars
1064501.description:
Senkuu set his goal to bring back all those who had been turned into statues. However, his idea was countered by a man who believed that only the fittest of those petrified could be brought back to life.
As the snow melts and spring arrives, Senkuu and his allies in Ishigami Village complete their preparations for an attack on the Tsukasa Empire. The Kingdom of Science is ready to launch its latest plan to recruit a sizable Tsukasa army to its side. It was a race against time; for every day the Science Kingdom spent perfecting their inventions, the Empire's numbers grew rapidly. With both sides pursuing their ideal world, the Stone War has now begun!

1064738.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets Movie
1064738.description: Fuutarou, the part-time tutor of quintuplets, has paid off his efforts. The quintuplets who have become senior students in high school have completed their graduation trip, and everyone is moving toward the future. Time flies and the quintuplets have noticed their feelings for Fuutarou...Who will be Fuutarou's bride?
1064738.originName: 映画 五等分の花嫁

1064876.title: Dropkick On My Devil!! X
1064876.description:
Third season of Jashin-chan Dropkick.
Jashin-chan Dropkick is a comedy that concentrates on these two reluctant roommates and their eccentric antics.
Yurine Hanazono, a girl who has studied the occult, summons the demon Jashin-chan to Earth, but does not know how to send it back to hell, where it is trapped.
The only way for Jashin-chan to return is to kill her summoner, but that is easier said than done for this incompetent demon. As Jashin-chan is immortal and can regenerate, Yurine attacks her relentlessly with a variety of weapons. The usual tale of cat-and-mouse is played out here.
1064876.originName: 邪神ちゃんドロップキック X

1065005.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Thai Dub)
1065005.originName: メイドインアビス 烈日の黄金郷

1065102.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun (Dub Indo)
1065102.originName: メイドインアビス 烈日の黄金郷

1065233.title: My Hero Academia HLB
1065233.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア HLB

1065572.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2 (Thai Dub)
1065572.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ第2期

1065687.title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2(Dub Indo)
1065687.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ第2期

1065742.title: The Night Beyond the Tricornered Window(Thai Dub)
1065742.description: Kosuke Mikado, a shy bookshop employee, can see ghosts and spirits, a talent he wishes he didn't have because what he often sees terrifies him. Rihito Hiyakawa, an exorcist with supernatural abilities as potent as his lack of social graces, doesn't appear to be afraid of anything, mortal or otherwise. This strange duo may not always use approaches that are appropriate for the workplace when they collaborate to tackle the strange problems that come their way!
1065742.originName: さんかく窓の外側は夜

1065833.title: How A Realist Hero Rebuilt The Kingdom (Thai Dub)
1065833.description: Unexpectedly transported to another world, Kazuya Souma quickly figures out the situation in the new world and decides to become the hero that people expect. He wanted to rebuild the shaky economy, not through war and reform. This realistic hero starts to gather talented people to help him get the country back on its feet!
1065833.originName: 現実主義勇者の王国再建記

1065921.title: About Youth
1065921.description: When a self‑centered, camera‑loving elite high schooler meets a band prince who, though invisible offstage, transforms into a star on it—different backgrounds, different values—they collide in the heated race for student council president, their clash echoing like a thunderous roar at the twilight of youth. Ye Guang, the frontrunner and campus heartthrob of this year’s election; Xu Qizhang, the promising young owner of the family noodle stall and the band’s ace lead singer‑guitarist. As the campaign unfolds, Ye Guang finds himself drawn to the secret identity his rival, Xu Qizhang, has kept hidden. The outwardly glamorous but inwardly lonely Ye Guang faces the self‑marginalized yet fiercely driven Xu Qizhang: two solitary souls who heal each other, leaning on one another for support. Ye Guang’s gaze begins, almost without his knowing, to follow Xu Qizhang…
1065921.originName: About Youth 默默的我 不默默的我们

1066030.title: URUSEI YATSURA
1066030.description: The lecherous Ataru Moroboshi is unremarkable, yet his extreme bad luck stands out like the horns on an alien's head. When Earth is attacked by a fleet of Oni alien invaders, Ataru is chosen to represent humanity in a combat with one of them. It's a stroke of luck for Ataru that the duel is actually a game of tag, and that his opponent is Lum, the daughter of the Oni's chief, who prioritizes her own pride over winning—as Ataru discovers by taking Lum's bikini top and thus victory.

1066080.title: Four People and Their Respective Lies
1066080.description:
Every girl has a secret ♡.
Rika, Chiyo, Sekine and Tsubasa are the four best friends in the class. The calm on the surface doesn't mean there is no hidden truth behind them, each of them seems to have a terrible secret...?

1066147.title: Shinobi no Ittoki
1066147.description:
Ittoki Sakuraba, the main character, is an ordinary child who initially believed that ninjas did not exist. He should have led a normal, happy, and fulfilling life...
Ittoki was assassinated one day, and he discovered that it was all the work of the Kouga ninjas. Why is Ittoki being hunted down? Because he is Iga Ninja's 19th genuine heir! For many years, Iga and Kouga have been at odds, and Kouga has always desired to invade Iga. Ittoki's only option for survival is to become a ninja!
Ittoki has therefore entered the unknown world of ninjas. To become a mature ninja, you must constantly learn, fight, and face challenges. But Ittoki's cruelty is just getting started.

1066246.title: Akiba Maid War
1066246.description:
It's 1999, spring.

A young girl travels to Akihabara admiring and aspiring to be a cute maid. There are many different types of maids in the "Akiba" at the turn of the century. Today is also a working day for the maid cafe "Ton Tokoton," also referred to as "Butagoya" (Pig Hut). Because the new maid I had brought into the store with me was so unpredictable, I was in a panic. The red bat swings into action as maids, trainers, and other Akihabara life forms appear. Given to all masters and ladies, this is a complete maid's work-struggle diary. "We're waiting for you to get home, boo."

1066329.title: Love Flops
1066329.description:
Ordinary boys' high school student Kashiwagi Asahi is on the same path to school as usual. However, just as the wonderful divination played on the TV that was turned on inadvertently before going out, he encountered various disasters this morning.
In one disaster after another, Asahi and 5 teenage girls have the worst encounter ever.
When he was exhausted physically and mentally and finally arrived at the school, the figures of five girls who were transfer students and new teachers appeared in front of him again. Asahi tried to hide his face, but couldn't hide it at all...
Ijūin Yoshio, who claims to be Asahi's friend, asks Asahi about his relationship with the five.
After getting along with the 5 people, the misunderstandings between each other were solved, and the relationship was slightly harmonious.
After school, Asahi opened the shoe cabinet to go home, only to find a love letter inside.
The sender's unidentified love letter reads "Waiting for you under the cherry tree behind the school building". This is also what divination says.

1066400.title: Management of Novice Alchemist
1066400.description:
Sarasa, the next alchemist, was raised in an orphanage. Her ambition is to follow in the footsteps of her late parents and create a shop. Her owner handed her an empty shop in a remote village as a graduation gift from a training school. Sarasa is overjoyed to see her goal come true, but what awaits her is a decaying store, strange communication, and destroying monsters to collect materials!? Sarasa struggles in a new nation, arming herself with a wealth of knowledge, exceptional magic, and skilled swordsmanship.

Feelings and alchemy permeate throughout the store's management.
Meetings and relationships are formed...
1066400.originName: 新米錬金術師の店舗経営

1066507.title: The Eminence in Shadow
1066507.description:
People aspire to be great heroes and evil villains, but Cid Kagenou is not one of them. He aspires to be the true brain behind it all, pulling the strings and directing the entire plot. He was unable to attain his objectives in his prior existence in modern-day Japan. But now, resurrected into a magical world, he will demonstrate the true majesty of darkness!

As Cid poses as an ordinary mobster, he recruits members for his (false) group Shadow Garden, which aims to bring down the enigmatic cult that lurks in the shadows. Cid leads his (fictional) organization against the filthy (yet unexpectedly real) Diabolos Cult with plenty of ad-libs.
1066507.originName: 陰の実力者になりたくて！1期

1066580.title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! Double
1066580.description: A somewhat withdrawn and quiet third-year college student, Shinichi Sakurai, and Hana Uzaki, graduated from the same high school one year younger. Shinichi is often entangled in various nonsensical entanglements in the name of taking care of a lonely senior by Hana. Although it was a bit annoying at first, gradually he got used to it...
1066580.originName: 宇崎ちゃんは遊びたい!ω

1066703.title: Princess of the Bibliophile
1066703.description:
Eliana Bernstein, better known as the "Bibliophile Princess," has always preferred the company of books to that of people since she was able to read. However, it is her responsibility as a noble to find a suitor. Fortunately for her, Crown Prince Christopher Selkirk Asherald offers a deal: In exchange for protecting Eliana's free time, he will only consider her to be his legal fiancée.

Eliana learns to be more accepting of others during their years together, which are blissful. But everything good has to come to an end. Eliana shouldn't have a problem ending their pretend relationship because she loves books more than people. Eliana starts to understand that she isn't as indifferent to Christopher as she initially believed as he becomes close with another girl.

1066830.title: Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These - Intrigue
1066830.description: Thousands of years later, Humans travel through space and divide into galactic empires and free alliances; on the two planets, tyranny and democracy are practiced differently. Since 150 years ago, the two countries have engaged in a never-ending conflict across the universe's galaxies. corruption of the Galactic Empire's nobility Space years, the end of the 8th century, two geniuses propel history: Reinhard von Loengram, the genius who wins all battles, and Yang Wen Li, the Invincible Wizard, the two led the army to start an endless conflict. Crowd-rule is a drawback of the democratic idea of a free planetary alliance that eats two nations.

1066907.title: Immoral Guild
1066907.description:
This is the youth I want?

The young hunter with the most kills in the guild is Kikuru. He spent his entire childhood honing his hunting skills, and now all he wanted was to quit his job and turn back the clock to his younger years! Training his successor is Kikuru's top priority because he wants to retire as soon as possible! But for some reason, nothing but immorality has taken place under his cunning new guard!

How will the youth of Kikuru grow? The newcomers' training in Kikuru's immorality has begun!

1066991.title: Encouragement of Climb: Next Summit
1066991.description:
Together, Aoi and Hinata started to ascend mountains, first the 197-meter-high Tenran Mountain, then the 599-meter-high Takao Mountain, and finally the 1786-meter-high Mitog Mountain.
Their outdoor life was enriched by the addition of friends like Kokona, Kaede, and Honoka as they traveled around famous peaks in the Kanto region, including Tanigawa, a mountain with fond memories for both of them.
Aoi has improved her mountain knowledge, gear, and stamina in an effort to advance to higher levels.

1067050.title: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
1067050.description:
Al Wayne is a young man who has been honing his farming-related skills while living an extraordinary farmer life. The last peasant's skill level was finally increased to the highest.

But for some reason, ever since he mastered the skills required of farmers, his life has fundamentally changed the way a farmer should live.
1067050.originName: 農民関連のスキルばっか上げてたら何故か強くなった。

1067286.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: ZERO
1067286.description:
Violent misfortunes frequently occur around 16-year-old Yuuta Okkotsu, a timid victim of high school bullying. Yuuta is saddled with a monstrous curse, a power that dishes out brutal revenge against his bullies. Rika Orimoto, Yuuta's curse, is a shadow from his tragic childhood and a potentially lethal threat to anyone who dares wrong him.

Yuuta's unique situation catches the attention of Satoru Gojou, a powerful sorcerer who teaches at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Gojou sees immense potential in Yuuta, and he hopes to help the boy channel his deadly burden into a force for good. Yet Yuuta struggles to find his place among his talented classmates: the selectively mute Toge Inumaki, weapons expert Maki Zenin, and Panda.

Yuuta clumsily utilizes Rika on missions with the other first-year students, but the grisly aftermath of Rika's tremendous displays of power draws the interest of the calculating curse user Suguru Getou. As Getou strives to claim Rika's strength and use it to eliminate all non-jujutsu users from the world, Yuuta fights alongside his friends to stop the genocidal plot.

2067350.title: Legend of Mana -The Teardrop Crystal-
2067350.description:
Shiloh, a young boy who lives near the town of Domina.
One day, he began to hear a mysterious voice in a dream.
The voice told him that he had a mission...
One day, Shiloh meets two people, "Jumei".
Jumei used to be a race, they were targeted for the jewels buried in their chests, and many were killed.
Now, mysterious jewelry thieves are attacking the Jumei family one after another around the world.
2067350.originName: 聖剣伝説 Legend of Mana -The Teardrop Crystal-

2067476.title: Mob Psycho 100 Ⅲ
2067476.description: Shigeo Kageyama, a regular second-year middle school student, was dubbed a "Mob" due to his feeble presence, but he actually possesses a potent natural superpower. Mob started to believe that their superpowers were dangerous after each growth. Mob has been unconsciously repressing their emotions in order to prevent superpowers from becoming out of control. Even though all he wanted was to go about his daily business as usual, problems of every description kept happening to him.

2067599.title: Peter Grill and the Philosopher's Time - Super Extra
2067599.description:
After winning the martial arts competition, Peter Grill was crowned the world's strongest man.
Though he now believes he can wed his longtime girlfriend Luvelia, he continues to be seduced by women of various races for the sake of his offspring.

Peter has the most military might but the least amount of willpower.
He repeatedly gave in to temptation, his lower body slender.
Then word spread that a terrible goblin plague had erupted.
Peter rushes to suppress it, but the battlefield holds a surprise for him.

A village of elves, a village of dwarfs, a goblin's den... Although the scene may have changed, the temptation still exists.
The greatest saint on earth's era is about to start all over again!
2067599.originName: ピーター・グリルと賢者の時間 Super Extra

2067667.title: The Story of Fengzhi Senla
2067667.description: The precursor of the storm is about to shake the entire Wind Continent. A wedding with a lot of inside information has attracted people from all walks of life, making Xianluo City a wrestling field for the seven major sects to fight openly and secretly. The ambitious Lancelot, the outstanding swordsman Hanajiro, the mysterious and wise Kogoro, and Snow who fishes in troubled waters, ride this undercurrent, either intentionally or unintentionally, by fate, they gather in Xianluo city, and together they set off the continent of shocking wind of gigantic waves.

2067757.title: Blade of Dawn
2067757.description: Galway time-travelled to Loren land and appeared as the ancestor of the Cecil family due to an airplane accident. He broadened the territories and encouraged people to maximize their talents. However, crazy evil cultists and hidden evil tides stopped his steps...how can Galway fight against this collapsing world?
2067757.originName: 长夜开拓者（原黎明之剑）

2067830.title: Qi Refining for 3000 Years
2067830.description: Bai Qiuran, a hero refined for 66665 levels failed to build a foundation of Qi. By accident, he got a clue about a mysterious ancient stone tablet, which guided him to discover the way to build his foundation. Bai decided to leave the mountain and step on the journey!

2067971.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3
2067971.description:
He killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam when he was six years old. Wang Ling, an omnipotent agriculture wizard, had to conceal his strength in order to exist amid a bunch of common cultivators. This young man is not concerned with the things that regular people are: money, magic, magic weapons, and reputation. He will continue to pursue the crisp noodles despite the affection of his wealthy daughter Sun Rong, the sharpshooter of the top murderer of the dark stream, and the unbroken discussion of his parents.

And now comes Season3 of The Daily Life of the Immortal King!
2067971.originName: 仙王的日常生活 第三季

2068046.title: No Doubt In Us 2
2068046.description: The emperor and empress of the Great Chen Dynasty, through an unexpected twist of fate, swapped identities. Once utterly at odds with one another, they now, by stepping into each other’s shoes, came to understand the hardships of their respective roles. As the exchange unfolded, they gradually learned to empathize and trust one another. At a critical juncture when the frontier was under siege, Xiao Jinyun—actually Xu Yu—personally led the imperial army to quell the unrest on the border, ultimately returning in triumph. Just as the imperial couple had overcome countless trials and successfully restored their original bodies, the Tatar queen suddenly appeared at court. Meanwhile, within the court and among the people, the Third Prince’s ambition to seize power had become all too evident…

2068647.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
2068647.description:
The Black Cats tribe suffers the dreadful fate of being hunted, enslaved, and slain. Fran, a twelve-year-old girl of the persecuted race, yearns for vengeance for the crimes committed against her people. She fantasizes about a brighter future, one for which she is willing to get her hands filthy. A meeting with a talking sword, a reborn man yearning for a beautiful wielder, proves to be the turning point in her fate.

The young Fran plans to recover her kin's glory and honor with the help of her new comrade, chopping down all her foes along the way. She begins on a quest with her amazing sword and unwavering resolve.

2068743.title: My Master Has No Tail
2068743.description: Mameda is a Tanuki girl with shape-shifting abilities who aspires to become human one day. She transforms into a stunning woman with black hair one day and leaves for Osaka, but is quickly found! Rakugo-ka is the name of the stunning woman who keeps telling the depressed Mameda to "Go back to where you came from!" (Rakugo storyteller). Here is where your happy Taisho Rakugo fantasy begins!
2068743.originName: うちの師匠はしっぽがない

2068864.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss
2068864.description:
Due to her severe illness, a young girl spends the majority of her life in a hospital room playing otome games. One day, she finds herself in the middle of a short story from one of these games, dressed as the villainous Aileen Loren D'Autriche.
Aileen's childhood friend and the crown prince, Cedric Jeanne Elmeier, announces he is in love with Lilia Rainworth, the game's female protagonist, during the banquet to celebrate the end of the academy's winter term. Having seen ahead of her a tragic future, the young girl makes a conscious decision to change it by making her half-brother, Claude Jeanne Elmeier, fall in love with her in place of the game's final boss, "Demon King".
2068864.originName: 悪役令嬢なのでラスボスを飼ってみました

2068973.title: My Hero Academia Season 6
2068973.description:
With the intention of becoming a "hero" who can save society and the populace with his "personality," Deku enrolled in a prestigious school that fosters heroes. He grew up with his classmates in Class A of the first year of the Hero Department.
Deku goes to work as an intern at Endeavour's office along with Bakugou and Todoroki. Deku demonstrates significant hero development after plunging into the realm of the highest level, including mastering the Black Whip, a new "personality" that lurks in everyone's hearts.

Shigaraki Tomura of the Villain Alliance is engaged in combat with Re-Alien Destro's Liberation Army. Shigaraki rediscovered his lost and horrifying childhood memories while fighting Re-Destro, and he came to life. He assumed command of the Alien Liberation Army and increased its strength while also looking for new abilities for himself so he could destroy everything.

Heroes and villains Deku and Shigaraki. Total war is about to break out!
2068973.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 6

2069069.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
2069069.description:
A.S. (Ad Stella) 122―
It is an era in which a number of corporations have entered space and have built a vast economic system. The Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group, dominates the mobile suit industry with a lone girl from Mercury transferring to it. The girl's name is Suletta Mercury. She walks step by step through a new world with a scarlet light burning in her heart.
2069069.originName: 機動戦士ガンダム　水星の魔女

2069206.title: To Your Eternity Season 2
2069206.description:
Fushi was the first "ball" to be thrown to the ground. As a baby, Fushi witnessed the passing of many people, from a mother and daughter, an extraordinary brother, a friend on the battlefield, and finally an old lady.
Later he grew up and became close to a person. Decades later, the world is in turmoil once again due to the attack of his nemesis, Nokkers.
Fushi broke the long silence and stood up. But then he realized. He can fight alone, but he cannot protect everyone alone.
Will they fight, even at the cost of new sacrifices, or...?
2069206.originName: 不滅のあなたへ　第2シリーズ

2069316.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun3
2069316.description:
Iruma Suzuki, 14, has had a difficult life because he has to work while still a minor in order to support his negligent parents. He eventually learns that his parents had actually sold him to the demon Sullivan. Iruma's concerns about what will happen to him, however, are quickly allayed because Sullivan only wants a grandchild, spoiling him and forcing him to attend the demon school Babyls.

Iruma initially tries to maintain a low profile out of concern that his peers will learn that he is a human. Unfortunately, it turns out to be more challenging than he anticipated. It turns out that Sullivan is the school's chairman, and everyone anticipates that he will succeed the current Demon King as the next!
2069316.originName: 魔入りました！入間くん　第3シリーズ

2069402.title: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc Memorial Edition
2069402.description:
The film trilogy Berserk: The Golden Age Arc has a TV cut.

He has only put his faith in his own sword. Guts is a lone swordsman who works as a mercenary in a region that has been affected by the Hundred Years War. He has no family, friends, or place to go home to. Guts can handle a sword that is longer than he is tall and defeats strong foes with ease. The "Band of the Hawk's" leader Griffith has his sights set on Guts. Griffith wins a duel with Guts and brings him into the Band of the Hawk to realize his own dream. Griffith, who has great ambitions and a commanding power unimaginable given his attractive appearance.

Their friends bond as a result of their shared experiences in numerous bloody battles. Particularly between Griffith and Guts, their relationship has developed into something special. The Band of the Hawk eventually became the Kingdom of Midland's regular army, but Griffith's ascent to the top did not stop there. Guts, on the other hand, is seduced by Griffith's "dream" and starts to wonder whether his life of solely using a sword is what he really wants. However, Guts is still unaware of the terrible fate that their unending dreams have befallen them.
2069402.originName: ベルセルク 黄金時代編　メモリアル・エディション

2069487.title: BEAST TAMER
2069487.description:
Rein is a tamer who wants to help the heroes defeat the Demon Lord. But one day, his friends kicked him out of the party of heroes because they thought he was useless. Rein, who chose the path of the adventurer in order to live freely, met Kanade, a student who had been attacked by demons.
He moved in to defend Kanade, but she slayed the demon with a single blow.
Kanade is a young woman from the Cat Tribe, considered to be one of the "strongest races" with exceptional skills! Would you like to try being my master? Kanade enquires of Rein after being struck by his talent and good nature. Rein enters into a contract with the toughest cat-eared girl and embarks on an adventure-filled new life.
However, the heroes who exiled Rein eventually understood the power...
2069487.originName: 勇者パーティーを追放されたビーストテイマー、最強種の猫耳少女と出会う

2069564.title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
2069564.description:
Hitori Gotoh, “Bocchi-chan,” is a girl who’s so introverted and shy around people that she’d always start her conversations with “Ah...”
During her middle school years, she started playing the guitar, wanting to join a band because she thought it could be an opportunity for even someone shy like her to also shine. But because she had no friends, she ended up practicing guitar for six hours every day all by herself.
After becoming a skilled guitar player, she uploaded videos of herself playing the guitar to the internet under the name “Guitar Hero” and fantasized about performing at her school’s cultural festival concert. But not only could she not find any bandmates, before she knew it, she was in high school and still wasn’t able to make a single friend!
She was really close to becoming a shut-in, but one day, Nijika Ijichi, the drummer in Kessoku Band, reached out to her. And because of that, her everyday life started to change little by little...

2069614.title: BLEACH Thousand-Year Blood War
2069614.description:
By chance, Ichigo Kurosaki gained the abilities of the god of death and was dubbed the "agent Soul Reaper."
He grew up in the corpse world, the location where the spirits of those who have died in this lifetime congregate.
And at this point, the Nether Empire formally declared war on the death god.
Five days later, the "invisible empire" destroyed the corpse world.
For a millennium, fate has been the Grim Reaper's burden.
Finally, their causality and underlying truths are revealed.
It's all going to end.

The final battle of Kurosaki Ichigo begins.

2069687.title: Chainsaw Man
2069687.description:
To spend quality time with the girl he likes and lead a contented life is Denji's simple and ordinary dream. This, however, is far from the truth because Denji's fate is to be made to kill demons by the gang in order to settle his enormous debt. Turning his pet demon Pochita into a weapon, Denji will use any means necessary to make money.

Unfortunately, the demon who had a deal with the gang killed him because he was no longer needed. Pochita, in a shocking turn of events, fuses with Denji's corpse and grants him the abilities of a chainsaw demon. The revived Denji uses his newfound abilities to swiftly and mercilessly eliminate his enemies. Denji gains the ability to transform certain parts of his body into a chainsaw. When the official witcher arrived on the scene, this attracted his attention, and the witcher hired Denji to work as one of them in the Public Security Bureau. Denji now has a strategy for defeating any foe, no matter how formidable, and he will go to any lengths to fulfill his simple teenage dream.

2069747.title: Blue Lock
2069747.description: Japan had trouble getting back on track after the 2018 World Cup disaster. but constantly feel as though something is lacking? Yes, they have an unbeatable forward who can help them win. The JFA is committed to producing a striker who is hungry for both goals and victory so that he can be a key component in recovering from defeats. 300 of Japan's best players and most talented young players have been gathered for this purpose. Who will emerge as the top member of the leadership group? Will they be able to overcome everyone's biceps and egos that get in their way?

2069825.title: VAZZROCK THE ANIMATION
2069825.description:
"There is one year. Why don't you take a risk?"

These are the opening remarks made by the president of Tsukino Entertainment Productions regarding the VAZZROCK project.
These 12 artists, who come from various artistic backgrounds, ages, and genres, have been collaborating for a while.
They split into two teams, VAZZY and ROCK DOWN, and worked together as a team, good friends and rivals, squaring off to bring out the best in each other.
They undertake a variety of tasks in addition to musical ones, including performances in plays, theaters, and movies.

Even though they were troubled and hurt, they persisted so that they could shine.

A brand-new illustrious tale is about to start!

2070026.title: More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers
2070026.description: The story centers on third-year high school student Jiro Yakuin, who gets saddled with his gyaru classmate Akari Watanabe for the class's "marriage training" project about practicing to be a married couple. Jiro is the complete opposite of Akari, but the two know that if they do well they will be able to switch partners to end up with their respective crushes, and so they force themselves to act like the perfect married couple.

2070146.title: God of Deception
2070146.description: Upon exhaustion of the world's energy, people built Feith City, one of the largest cities in the world. A middle school student named Wu Minglu has been judged a villain by the system in Feith City because he has lied too many times, and he has been attacked by the evil species "karma". Wu Minglu was helped by Lian En, the lie watcher who was sent by Feith City to correct his bad habits. Upon meeting, the two were involved in various incidents, from which they gradually revealed little-known secrets...

2070216.title: Stars Fall
2070216.description: Researchers involved in the research organization code-named  "Mattamore" are frightened to death by the never-ending nightmare they are living in. Bai Xi, a university graduate who is ordinary yet unusual, and Han Zhuo, a mysterious and powerful esper who is near-omnipotent, set out with a group of steadfast friends on a spectacular path to salvation - those dark corners where the sun never reaches, always need a person to shed a tear to light the way.

2070291.title: The Furious Yama
2070291.description: What sort of experience is being the ruler of hell and having a severe phobia of ghosts? Yan Xiaoluo is my name. My deceased father made plans for me to travel to the outside world to develop my bravery because I was terrified of ghosts. However, the western hell's Satan and Lucifer might eventually stop lusting after the human world and the eastern ghost realm. The bull's head and horse face are ephemeral, and Xiaokui, who was chosen by chance, will help the king deal with them. This art will also depict heaven! That combat-only monkey, too! And occasionally the deceased father will appear to steal the show!
2070291.originName: 大王不高兴 第一季

2070355.title: Memory of Chang'An
2070355.description: I'm Emira, Princess of the Xiyue Kingdom. I was up in a time of war and have been aware of the conflicts among the three nations of Xiyue, Datang, and Nanlu since I was a young child. In the future, I hope to join the Xiyue warrior women and use my own archery prowess to protect the tribe. One day, out of the blue, the Great Khan gave me the order that Xiyue should wed Datang and that I should wed Li Qian, the ninth prince of the Tang Dynasty. How is this advantageous to me, a feisty young woman who has always been rough? But when I consider it, I feel a bit proud of myself if I can actually end the war that the people are going through.

2070486.title: Kaifeng Strange Tales: This Lord Bao is Not That Great
2070486.description: A legendary character appeared during the North Song Dynasty in ancient China at Kai Feng, the seat of the North Song. He is Zheng Bao, the governor. He is referred to as Bao Gong by the locals (Lord Bao). His extraordinary honesty, uprightness, impartiality, and courage in upholding justice set him apart in a corrupt regime and earned him the nickname "Justice Bao". According to Chinese tradition, Zheng Bao is the supernaturally gifted reincarnation of Megrez, the Chinese God of Wisdom. The Bao Gong mythology is told in a brand-new way in Kai Feng Story.
2070486.originName: 开封奇谈 这个包公不太行

2070579.title: Vertical World
2070579.description: The "forbidden love" between elementary school students with incredibly long tails and large white dogs, the fairy tale world where axes fly horizontally, the cat-eared lady who travels less and less, dinosaurs with no volume kindergartens, animation studios that don't do animation—all of these things exist in the vertical world. This vertical world will feature all of these stories.
2070579.originName: 垂直世界之地中海美少年

2070635.title: Fusé: Memoirs of a Huntress
2070635.description: Eight samurai serve the Satomi clan in Kyokutei Bakin's classic Japanese epic novel Nansou Satomi Hakkenden during the turbulent Sengoku (Warring States) era of Japan. The souls that Princess Fuse mothered with a dog named Yatsufusa are reborn as the Edo-era samurai. The female hunter Hamaji visits her brother in Fuse Gansaku: Satomi Hakkenden to hunt Fuse. Thus, the long-running karmic cycle of vengeance that started with the Satomi family restarts.
2070635.originName: 伏 鉄砲娘の捕物帳

2070762.title: [C] The Money of Soul and Possibility Control
2070762.description: The Sovereign Wealth Fund saved the Japanese government from a financial meltdown. But for its residents, life hasn't gotten any better; unemployment, crime, suicide, and hopelessness are all too common. Kimimaro is a scholarship student whose main desire is to have a steady, regular life. He was raised by his maternal aunt after his father vanished and his mother passed away. He runs into a man one day who offers him a large quantity of money in exchange for letting his "future" be kept as collateral. His future is drastically changed from that point on after being dragged into the mysterious Financial District, where he must participate in weekly competitions known as "deals" in order to keep his money and his life.

2070862.title: Foreordination
2070862.description: Cosmic wanderer Li Yuesu inadvertently discovers the “Shangjia,” an interstellar colony ship that vanished years ago, and witnesses terrifying anomalies… Gradually, humanity comes to realize a colossal threat looming ever closer. After much turmoil, the various powers in the Konil Stellar Region are ultimately forced to unite against a formidable foe. Yet the alien enemy proves immeasurably more powerful than anyone could have imagined. With the human forces on the brink of total annihilation, they have no choice but to dispatch Li Yuesu to seek aid from the mighty human civilization at the Galactic Heart.

2070950.title: Date A Live IV(Thai Dub)
2070950.description: Shidou encounters a starving woman lying on the street and ends up helping her. The woman introduces herself as Nia Honjou—a popular comic artist working under a pen name. However, Nia reveals that she is also a Spirit and is aware of Shidou's secret operation...
2070950.originName: デート・ア・ライブ　4期

2071003.title: Ya Boy Kongming!(Thai Dub)
2071003.description:
Kong Ming, a great strategist during the Three Kingdoms period, achieved an extraordinary life through his lifelong struggles and countless battles. So when Kong Ming was dying, his only wish was to be reborn into a world full of peace and no wars... Then Kong Ming was sent directly to the modern city of Tokyo! Can a brilliant strategist like Kong Ming adapt to the modern wild beat?
Later, Kong Ming met Eiko Tsukimi in Shibuya, and Kongming, who was deeply attracted by her singing, became Eiko's military advisor. The overwhelming ingenuity of the genius military advisor led to the birth of a new legend in the music scene, and then...

2071087.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War(Thai Dub)
2071087.description:
From a good family? Check! A good personality? Check!
Shuchiin Academy is where all these elite students with bright futures flock to.
As the two leaders of the student council, Shinomiya Kaguya and Shirogane Miyuki have supposedly fallen in love...
But after almost half a year, nothing has happened!?
They both have too much pride and can’t be honest.
Things have gotten troublesome, and they are now caught in a war of "How to get the other to confess their love first."

This is a whole new romantic comedy, following an outbreak of cunning warfare between two elite students in love.
2071087.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～

2071214.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War 2(Thai Dub)
2071214.description:
At the renowned Shuchiin Academy, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya are the student body's top representatives. Ranked the top student in the nation and respected by peers and mentors alike, Miyuki serves as the student council president. Alongside him, the vice president Kaguya—eldest daughter of the wealthy Shinomiya family—excels in every field imaginable. They are the envy of the entire student body, regarded as the perfect couple.

However, despite both having already developed feelings for the other, neither are willing to admit them. The first to confess loses, will be looked down upon, and will be considered the lesser. With their honor and pride at stake, Miyuki and Kaguya are both equally determined to be the one to emerge victorious on the battlefield of love!
2071214.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～2

2071309.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War (Dub Indo)
2071309.description:
From a good family? Check! A good personality? Check!
Shuchiin Academy is where all these elite students with bright futures flock to.
As the two leaders of the student council, Shinomiya Kaguya and Shirogane Miyuki have supposedly fallen in love...
But after almost half a year, nothing has happened!?
They both have too much pride and can’t be honest.
Things have gotten troublesome, and they are now caught in a war of "How to get the other to confess their love first."

This is a whole new romantic comedy, following an outbreak of cunning warfare between two elite students in love.
2071309.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～

2071395.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War 2 (Dub Indo)
2071395.description:
At the renowned Shuchiin Academy, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya are the student body's top representatives. Ranked the top student in the nation and respected by peers and mentors alike, Miyuki serves as the student council president. Alongside him, the vice president Kaguya—eldest daughter of the wealthy Shinomiya family—excels in every field imaginable. They are the envy of the entire student body, regarded as the perfect couple.

However, despite both having already developed feelings for the other, neither are willing to admit them. The first to confess loses, will be looked down upon, and will be considered the lesser. With their honor and pride at stake, Miyuki and Kaguya are both equally determined to be the one to emerge victorious on the battlefield of love!
2071395.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～2

2071587.title: TONIKAWA: Over the Moon For You -Uniform-
2071587.description: In the Arisugawa family, Tsukasa and Nasa are enjoying their first year of marriage. Although the two did have their fateful encounter, they did not have the typical high school experience of falling in love and uniform dating; instead, Tsukasa put on a uniform with the help of Aya. Nasa couldn't contain his excitement when he saw Tsukasa wearing a uniformed secretary. What dramatic event will befall the two individuals?
2071587.originName: トニカクカワイイ ～制服～

2071786.title: The Infinitors
2071786.description: An affluent white-collar worker receives a mysterious invitation: "Would you like to know what life is about?" "Would you like to live your life fully?" It is sent into the unpredictable space of the Lord God, and future human beings will invite and challenge the present world, and the different challenges that humans face during the era of great universe development will be simulated as copies as well. The "copies" will guide the selected people to overcome many traps, meet life-and-death comrades, and become leaders. All of this is in the interest of human evolution, survival, and infinite futures!

2071910.title: Carp Reborn 3rd Season
2071910.description: Wang Sheng woke up in the modern world, everything was so real and dreamlike. Emergence of the imperial city, appearance of the young master of Family Dai confused the situation. Through a gambling game, Wang Sheng gradually realized it was not just an argument between him and the young master of Family Dai. As a result of the feast, people from all over the world gathered together, and Wang Sheng was once again called to stand in front of the stage. Although Wang Sheng knew that the fights on the field were far less than the dark tide under the field, he didn't realize that the people of the world were quietly becoming another gambling chip ... Even though the dream appeared to wake him suddenly, the key to breaking the situation remained hidden. The inscription nine words wheel is also quietly dialing...

2071979.title: Chillin' in My 30s after Getting Fired from the Demon King's Army
2071979.description: The 30-year-old dark soldier Dariel who can't use magic while in an army of demons was fired for his insufficient capacities. Moreover, his desperate second life has begun in a human village where Dariel has arrived!
2071979.originName: 解雇された暗黒兵士（30代）のスローなセカンドライフ

2072093.title: SPY x FAMILY (English Dubbed)
2072093.description:
Corrupt politicians, frenzied nationalists, and other warmongering forces constantly jeopardize the thin veneer of peace between neighboring countries Ostania and Westalis. In spite of their plots, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" fulfills dangerous missions one after another in the hope that no child will have to experience the horrors of war.

In the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint, Twilight dons the alias of "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist. However, his true intention is to gather intelligence on prominent politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears rarely in public at his son's school: the prestigious Eden Academy. Enlisting the help of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar to act as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter, Loid enacts his master plan. He will enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where Loid hopes she will excel and give him the opportunity to meet Donovan without arousing suspicion.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his talents has trouble playing the figure of a loving father and husband. And just like Loid is hiding his true identity, Yor—who is an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to disclose their own secrets either. Although this picture-perfect family is founded on deception, the Forgers gradually come to understand that the love they share for one another trumps all else.

2072182.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World
2072182.description:
After being betrayed by his companions, Haruyoshi, the strongest diviner, was on the verge of dying. Hoping to be happy in the next life, he attempted the secret reincarnation technique and was sent to another world!

Born into a family of magicians, the magic he didn't inherit paled in comparison to his previous abilities as an exorcist. "Who needs magic? I'll survive in this world with my old techniques!"
2072182.originName: 最強陰陽師の異世界転生記

2072246.title: Farming Life in Another World
2072246.description: Having died of sickness at 39 years old, Machio Hiraku is given the opportunity to go to another world. When asked what his wish is by God intends to give him strength, he requests to have a healthy body, offered a second wish, and he chooses to live peacefully. The third wish is to be able to know the local language, and the final wish is to be able to be a farmer.

2072378.title: Giant Beasts of Ars
2072378.description: The great beasts created the land, but humans stole it. Angered, the beasts began eating humans, who in turn called upon the gods to fight the beasts. In the age of the sword, heroes and mythology, giant beasts are hunted by humans for profit. Jiro, who makes his living hunting beasts, encounters Kuumi, who is being chased by someone, and at that moment decides to save her...

2072463.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (VN Dub)
2072463.description: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn‘t care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadow stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.

2072563.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
2072563.description:
Along with three other heroes, 27-year-old Mukouda Tsuyoshi is transported into a fantasy world to rescue a kingdom from an unknown threat. However, his only skill turns out to be "Food Menu", which allows him to open an interface where he can purchase and obtain food-related supermarket items from modern Japan.

Tsuyoshi's ability to create delicious dishes unknown to this world soon pays dividends, even attracting the legendary wolf Fenrir. Fenrir is so taken in by the food and formed a contract with Tsuyoshi. Followed by this whimsical mythical being, Tsuyoshi takes up a job as a merchant and adventurer, traveling and cooking up mouth-watering meals that never fail to amaze the inhabitants of this world.
2072563.originName: とんでもスキルで異世界放浪メシ

2072676.title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy Ⅱ: History's Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants
2072676.description:
The Misfit of Demon King Academy II

To put an end to the endless conflict between humans and demons, Demon King Anos Voldigoad willingly sacrificed his life, hoping to be reborn in a peaceful future.

In preparation for their king's return, the demon race created the Demon King Academy, an elite institution tasked with determining Anos' identity when he reawakens. He reincarnates two millennia later, but to his surprise, he soon learns that the level of magic in the world has drastically waned during his absence...
2072676.originName: 魔王学院的不适任者～史上最强的魔王始祖，转生就读子孙们的学校～ Ⅱ

2072737.title: The Fruit of Evolution 2: Before I Knew It, My Life Had It Made
2072737.description: High school student Hiiragi Seiichi used to be bullied by his classmates for being a "loser". One day, the entire school is suddenly transported to a video game-like world of swords and sorcery. When he accidentally eats "the Fruit of Evolution," his life as a successful "winner" begins!
2072737.originName: 真・進化の実〜知らないうちに勝ち組人生〜

2072788.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie(Thai Dub)
2072788.description: Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend: cute, fun to be around, sweet when she wants to be... but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right circumstances. And her boyfriend Izumi loves to be around when that happens!
2072788.originName: 式守さんは可愛いだけじゃない

2072897.title: Yowai 5000-nen no Soushoku Dragon, Iwarenaki Jaryuu Nintei（JPN Dub）
2072897.description: A 5000-year-old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoke her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.
2072897.originName: 食草老龙被冠以恶龙之名

2073043.title: Endo and Kobayashi Live! The Latest on Tsundere Villainess Lieselotte
2073043.description:
Otome villainess Liselotte seems foul in every way, a purely evil character. However, she was always hiding both her pain and her true feelings for Prince Siegward. While she keeps this locked away, an evil witch ultimately possesses her, leading to her demise—a tragic end for the tsundere villainess. This is how the story always goes, an end coded into the game MagiKoi.

Broadcasting club members Aoto Endou and Shihono Kobayashi decide to play this game. In another universe, Prince Siegward hears their voices, believing it to be a divine revelation from a god and goddess. These voices clue him into something he never noticed before: Liselotte is actually overwhelmingly adorable!
2073043.originName: ツンデレ悪役令嬢リーゼロッテと実況の遠藤くんと解説の小林さん

2073095.title: Spy Classroom
2073095.description:
Lily, a beautiful girl with white locks, is a student in one of the many institutions that train youths into becoming capable spies. Unfortunately, with no real-world skills to speak of, her hopes of graduating are dismal—until she is offered an opportunity to join the mysterious team "Tomoshibi" and partake in an Impassable Mission.

Lily is struck dumb when she arrives at Kagerou Palace and the true purpose of Tomoshibi and its hopeless situation comes to light. Joined by other problematic female spies along with a mysterious young man spearheading the operation, Lily realizes that this is not the ideal escapade she had pictured.

2073192.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2
2073192.description:
Second season of BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.

Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
2073192.originName: 痛いのは嫌なので防御力に極振りしたいと思います。2

2073294.title: Malevolent Spirits: Mononogatari
2073294.description:
Tsukumogami, spirits, or "marebito" can possess objects of considerable age and gain a physical form. Although he is part of the Saenome clan that is in charge of peacefully sending them back to their own world, Hyouma Kunato despises them because one took away what was very precious to him. 

To cure him of this loathing, Hyouma's grandfather sends him to live with Botan Nagatsuki, a girl who is the master of six "friendly" tsukumogami and lives with them as a family.

2073410.title: Saving 80,000 Gold in Another World for my Retirement
2073410.description:
Mitsuha Yamano falls off a cliff, at which point she finds herself transported to some sort of medieval European fantasy world! While there, during a battle with some wolves that almost costs her her life, she realizes that she has the ability to shuffle between Earth and this new world. 

Mitsuha decides to use this ability as much as she can. Why? To save up for retirement! She sets her sights on saving eighty thousand gold coins!
2073410.originName: 老後に備えて異世界で8万枚の金貨を貯めます

2073490.title: Ningen Fushin: Adventurers Who Don't Believe in Humanity Will Save the World
2073490.description: Nick used to be a member of a veteran adventurer party, helping his undisciplined friends with the accounts whenever he could. But what was his reward? Getting accused of embezzlement and kicked out by the leader he trusted and respected... Before long, he finds a few other jaded adventurers and kindred spirits, and together, they form their own unstoppable party!
2073490.originName: 人間不信の冒険者たちが世界を救うようです

2073540.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
2073540.description: Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy's expectations by developing "magicology", a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. Anisphia witnesses the noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom's next monarch one day. That's when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic! Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures but those of the kingdom...and the entire world!
2073540.originName: 転生王女と天才令嬢の魔法革命

2073689.title: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
2073689.description: When alien forces invade with an army of Machines, the remnants of humanity must depend on Androids of their own design—the placid 2B and the excitable 9S—to survive.

2073746.title: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
2073746.description:
High school student Junta Shiraishi has a simple goal—to live a fulfilling youth. In fact, Shiraishi's lack of presence is so severe that people think his seat in class is always empty, and mistakenly assume that he often skips school. There is even a weird rumor, claiming that those who spot Shiraishi will be blessed with good fortune.

The only person who notices his existence is Nagisa Kubo, the girl seated next to him. Unfortunately for him though, Kubo likes to tease him on a daily basis. As Kubo's playful antics continue to involve the reluctant Shiraishi, he may soon discover that his youth might not be as boring as he initially thought.
2073746.originName: 久保さんは僕を許さない

2073796.title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire
2073796.description:
From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects' well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again: a warrior's life he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power.

His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future. Goddesses work in mysterious ways—not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood!
2073796.originName: 英雄王、武を極めるため転生す～そして、世界最強の見習い騎士♀～

2073886.title: In/Spectre Season 2
2073886.description:
In/Spectre Season 2
At the young age of 11, Kotoko Iwanaga was abducted by youkai for two weeks and asked to become their "God of Wisdom", a mediator between the spirit and human worlds, to which the girl quickly agreed but at the cost of her right eye and left leg. 

Kurou Sakuragawa, a 22-year-old university student, has just broken up with his girlfriend after he fled alone when the two encountered a kappa. Seeing this as her chance to become closer to him, Kotoko immediately makes her move, hoping to get married to Kurou one day. However, she quickly realizes there is something more to Kurou. With this knowledge, she asks for his help in solving the various issues presented by the supernatural, all the while wishing her newfound partner will eventually reciprocate her feelings.

2073947.title: Bungo Stray Dogs 4
2073947.description:
Bungo Stray Dogs 4
The strange men were met by Atsushi Nakashima, a young man who was about to starve to death in the orphanage. He was busy diving and committing suicide, a man with suicidal habits, Osamu Dazai. The man with glasses looking at the notebook nervously, Kunikida alone. 

They are employees of the "Armed Detective Agency" rumored to resolve incidents in which the military and police cannot intervene. Thousands of strange literary heroes fighting with different abilities, this is the beginning!
2073947.originName: 文豪ストレイドッグス４

2074061.title: Trigun Stampede
2074061.description:
A sandstorm rages in the land. The survivors of the human race live in a barren land of writhing and deformed creatures.

In this harsh world, there is one troublemaker with a bounty of $6 million, called "Human Typhoon". Rookie reporter Meryl Stryfe, together with drunken veteran reporter Roberto de Niro, is in search of a big scoop about the human typhoon, and they arrive at a gunfighter in a crimson coat, but what they encounter is a windbag who "never kills people" and is more good-natured than anyone else!

2074202.title: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea
2074202.description:
A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high in the canopy, which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

A chance meeting between Kaina, a youth from the canopy, and Liliha, a young woman from the surface, sets off a chain of events that will change the fate of the world.

2074301.title: The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
2074301.description:
Himuro is an office worker who belongs to a race of supernatural beings with strange powers. Whenever he is deep in concentration, he subconsciously plunges his poor coworkers into a close rendition of the Arctic. Even so, Himuro is a warm and kind person. 

Himuro has a soft spot for his colleague Fuyutsuki, a calm woman who has a knack for providing simple solutions to his unconventional problems. Fueled by immense adoration and desire, Himuro is prepared to do whatever it takes to capture her heart.
2074301.originName: 氷属性男子とクールな同僚女子

2074379.title: Handyman Saitou in Another World
2074379.description: Saitou is an ordinary handyman that gets transported to another world where his skills are very useful. He starts to really understand what it means to be needed.
2074379.originName: 便利屋斎藤さん、異世界に行く

2074512.title: Sugar Apple Fairy Tale
2074512.description:
After her mother passes away, Ann decides to become a Silver Sugar Master like her mother. Ann leaves for the town of Lewiston, and in order to become a Silver Sugar Master, she has to win the top spot and receive a royal medal.

In this world, humans treat fairies as slaves and take one of their wings to control them. Ann reluctantly buys a fairy named Shall to be a bodyguard on her way to Lewiston. Ann is torn between setting Shall free and needing a bodyguard on the dangerous roads to the festival.
2074512.originName: シュガーアップル・フェアリーテイル

2074563.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
2074563.description:
After catching a cold by giving his only umbrella to a girl sitting in the rain, Amane Fujimiya only expects her to eventually return it. However, Mahiru Shiina, the "Angel" of Amane's school and his neighbor, instead gives him a lot more than that. 

The only word Mahiru finds in her mouth to describe the chaos is "unsightly". But despite her unsympathetic description, Mahiru proceeds to help the hopeless Amane. Is there anything that the Angel can not do?
2074563.originName: お隣の天使様にいつの間にか駄目人間にされていた件

2074646.title: My Life as Inukai-san's Dog.
2074646.description: The story follows the protagonist who wakes up one day transformed as Pochita, a pet dog of his cool and beautiful classmate Karen Inukai!
2074646.originName: 犬になったら好きな人に拾われた。

2074779.title: Sorcerous Stabber Orphen 3
2074779.description: Orphen is a powerful sorcerer who is notoriously lazy. Everything changes when he finds a way to save his sister, who was turned into a dragon during their days at the magic academy. Betrayed by friends who refused to help, Orphen will stop at nothing to track her down, even if he has to go it alone.
2074779.originName: 魔術士オーフェンはぐれ旅 アーバンラマ編

2074914.title: Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro 2nd Attack
2074914.description: One day, "Senpai" visits the library after school and becomes the target of a super sadistic junior! The name of the girl who teases, torments, and tantalizes Senpai is "Nagatoro!" She's annoying yet adorable. This is a story about an extremely sadistic and temperamental girl and you'll feel something awakened inside of you!
2074914.originName: イジらないで、長瀞さん 2nd Attack

2075126.title: By the Grace of the Gods Season 2
2075126.description:
By the Grace of the Gods Season 2

One day, the life of middle-aged Japanese businessman Takebayashi Ryouma came to a rather sudden and disappointing end. Ryouma had never had a blessed life, but after his death, three great gods sought his cooperation and reincarnated him as a child in another world with swords and magic! 

Receiving a most cordial and divine welcome from the gods, Ryouma decides to live leisurely on his own in the forest for the time being. Working diligently at magic and hunting, Ryouma's greatest passion comes to be researching his tamed slimes?!

2075232.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
2075232.description:
Everyone knows of the most powerful soldier, the Iceblade Magician, Ray White. After weathering through a bloody war, Ray enrolls at Arnold Academy, ready to experience a normal life—a luxury he never had. To further this goal, he keeps his identity as the Iceblade Magician a secret.

Despite being ostracized for being a commoner, Ray befriends the prideful yet kind Amelia Rose, the muscle-brained Evy Armstrong, and the shy and bookish Elisa. However, Ray is tasked with hunting down a spy whose motives remain unclear...
2075232.originName: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べる

2075361.title: Onimai: I'm Now Your Sister!
2075361.description: Mahiro Oyama was just a normal erotic-game-loving dude...until he woke up one morning as a girl! Turns out his mad-scientist little sister, Mihari, tried out one of her new experiments on him. But Mihari is as determined to study him as he wanted to go back to his shut-in and game-playing life... Life is going to get a whole lot weirder from here on out!
2075361.originName: お兄ちゃんはおしまい！

2075746.title: What's Wrong with My Big Brother
2075746.description: Dongfang Xianyun, the big brother who finally recognized himself as the "big protagonist", fell into nothingness due to Dongfang Wuxian's misunderstanding. With the help of Bu Suantian, an envoy of the Tao of Heaven who was a time traveler, Dongfang Xianyun was forced to be reborn and once again involved in the battle between good and evil. The war intensified and everyone waited for Dongfang Xianyun's efforts to turn the tide, the big brother finally became reliable.

2076133.title: The Dining of Link Lee 2
2076133.description: The small restaurant has ushered in a warm spring. The owner, Link Lee, and the cook Wu Di, who also loves cooking, have developed many new dishes for people. Regular customers come in an endless stream, and at the same time, many new faces have been attracted here with some new stories—a father and son who have an awkward relationship, college students who meet to participate in an animation competition, and a toy salesperson who speaks substandard Mandarin. They will find the taste they are most looking forward to in the small restaurant. The Dining of Link Lee season 2 now is available!
2076133.originName: 李林克的小馆儿 第二季

2076190.title: My Cat Hates Me
2076190.description: A young manga artist whose inspiration gradually runs out on the road to creation accidentally adopts two pets when he goes out to find inspiration. The cat is named Huanghuang, and the dog is named Bazahei. Although the two little guys often brought a lot of trouble to the teenager, they also gained two pieces of companionship and love at the same time. Although they are a cat and a dog, the teenager knows that they are family. And then, the noisy but warm and happy life of the teenager began.

2076392.title: X&Y
2076392.description: Yan Yuechu went back to his hometown to work and met new friends in the company he joined. After entering the XY Chamber of Secrets to play secret room games, he found himself attracted by the owner of the secret room, Xu Aiyou. However, this is the beginning of his falling into one another strange secret room illusion. At the same time, as Yan Yuechu got in touch with Xu Aiyou, more and more incidents happened around Yan Yuechu one after another, and these even involved his friends. In the process of cracking the secret room and finding the mastermind behind the incident, Yan Yuechu gradually came across the hidden truth of the incident...

2076458.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san: The Movie
2076458.description: Takagi and Nishikata's final summer in junior high is about to begin, and it's already off to a heartwarming start! When the pair find an abandoned kitten, they decide to work together and take care of their adorable new companion until they can locate its missing mother. While searching, they also got new feelings about their relationship.
2076458.originName: 劇場版 からかい上手の高木さん

2076592.title: The Last Summoner（JPN Dub）
2076592.description: This is a fiction world of Summoners. The person who can summon the spirits of all objects is called the Summoner. Since ancient times, the legend of the Summoners has been deeply embedded in the corner of history. In the new era, there are five Summoners who awaken to fight against the mysterious power. Five friends fight shoulder to shoulder to discover the truth in the Summoner world.

2076652.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. (Dub Indo)
2076652.description:
After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.

This doesn't end badly for her, however. Due to her high defense, Maple acquires overpowered skills such as Total Defense, Poison Immunity, and Devour. These skills, along with the incredibly powerful items she obtains, allow her to obliterate most enemies in a single hit. After only a few days of playing the game, Maple claims third place in a server-wide event, gaining a reputation as a player who is both unkillable and absurdly powerful.

Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
2076652.originName: 痛いのは嫌なので防御力に极振りしたいと思います。

2076900.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill(Thai Dub)
2076900.description:
Along with three other heroes, 27-year-old Mukouda Tsuyoshi is transported into a fantasy world to rescue a kingdom from an unknown threat. However, his only skill turns out to be "Food Menu", which allows him to open an interface where he can purchase and obtain food-related supermarket items from modern Japan.

Tsuyoshi's ability to create delicious dishes unknown to this world soon pays dividends, even attracting the legendary wolf Fenrir. Fenrir is so taken in by the food and formed a contract with Tsuyoshi. Followed by this whimsical mythical being, Tsuyoshi takes up a job as a merchant and adventurer, traveling and cooking up mouth-watering meals that never fail to amaze the inhabitants of this world.
2076900.originName: 拥有超常技能的异世界流浪美食家（泰配版）

2077534.title: Chainsaw Man(Thai Dub)
2077534.description:
To spend quality time with the girl he likes and lead a contented life is Denji's simple and ordinary dream. This, however, is far from the truth because Denji's fate is to be made to kill demons by the gang in order to settle his enormous debt. Turning his pet demon Pochita into a weapon, Denji will use any means necessary to make money.

Unfortunately, the demon who had a deal with the gang killed him because he was no longer needed. Pochita, in a shocking turn of events, fuses with Denji's corpse and grants him the abilities of a chainsaw demon. The revived Denji uses his newfound abilities to swiftly and mercilessly eliminate his enemies. Denji gains the ability to transform certain parts of his body into a chainsaw. When the official witcher arrived on the scene, this attracted his attention, and the witcher hired Denji to work as one of them in the Public Security Bureau. Denji now has a strategy for defeating any foe, no matter how formidable, and he will go to any lengths to fulfill his simple teenage dream.

2077638.title: Sword Art Online Alicization(Thai Dub)
2077638.description: The Soul Translator is a state-of-the-art full-dive interface which interacts with the user's Fluctlight—the technological equivalent of a human soul—and fundamentally differs from the orthodox method of sending signals to the brain. The private institute Rath aims to perfect their creation by enlisting the aid of Sword Art Online survivor Kazuto Kirigaya. He works there as a part-time employee to test the system's capabilities in the Underworld: the fantastical realm generated by the Soul Translator. As per the confidentiality contract, any memories created by the machine in the virtual world are wiped upon returning to the real world. Kazuto can only vaguely recall a single name, Alice, which provokes a sense of unease when mentioned in reality. When Kazuto escorts Asuna Yuuki home one evening, they chance upon a familiar foe. Kazuto is mortally wounded in the ensuing fight and loses consciousness. When he comes to, he discovers that he has made a full-dive into the Underworld with seemingly no way to escape. He sets off on a quest, seeking a way back to the physical world once again.
