2077751.description: The Soul Translator is a state-of-the-art full-dive interface which interacts with the user's Fluctlight—the technological equivalent of a human soul—and fundamentally differs from the orthodox method of sending signals to the brain. The private institute Rath aims to perfect their creation by enlisting the aid of Sword Art Online survivor Kazuto Kirigaya. He works there as a part-time employee to test the system's capabilities in the Underworld: the fantastical realm generated by the Soul Translator. As per the confidentiality contract, any memories created by the machine in the virtual world are wiped upon returning to the real world. Kazuto can only vaguely recall a single name, Alice, which provokes a sense of unease when mentioned in reality. When Kazuto escorts Asuna Yuuki home one evening, they chance upon a familiar foe. Kazuto is mortally wounded in the ensuing fight and loses consciousness. When he comes to, he discovers that he has made a full-dive into the Underworld with seemingly no way to escape. He sets off on a quest, seeking a way back to the physical world once again.

2077856.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (1st Half)
2077856.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2077856.originName: 「進撃の巨人」The Final Season完結編（前編）

2077925.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S2(Thai Dub)
2077925.description: At the age of six, he killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam. As an omnipotent cultivation wizard, Wang Ling had to hide his power and survive among a group of ordinary cultivation students. This young man doesn't care about the money, magic, magic weapon, reputation that ordinary people pursue. Regardless of the love of rich daughter Sun Rong, the sniper of the top killer of the shadowed stream, and the uninterrupted conversation of his parents, they cannot stop him from pursuing the crisp noodles.
2077925.originName: 仙王的日常生活 第二季（泰配版）

2078019.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S3 (Thai Dub)
2078019.description:
He killed the Demon King Swallow Sky Clam when he was six years old. Wang Ling, an omnipotent agriculture wizard, had to conceal his strength in order to exist amid a bunch of common cultivators. This young man is not concerned with the things that regular people are: money, magic, magic weapons, and reputation. He will continue to pursue the crisp noodles despite the affection of his wealthy daughter Sun Rong, the sharpshooter of the top murderer of the dark stream, and the unbroken discussion of his parents.

And now comes Season3 of The Daily Life of the Immortal King!
2078019.originName: 仙王的日常生活 第三季（泰配版）

2078154.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond
2078154.description: There is a small country to the west of Tempest called Raja. As Rimuru and his companions investigate the mysterious power of the queen, they become involved in a long-running conspiracy. During their journey, Rimuru and Benimaru meet another survivor of the ogre species, an old brother of Benimaru named Hiiro. What on earth happened to Hiiro? And what experience did he have with Benimaru...
2078154.originName: 劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 紅蓮の絆編

2078245.title: Summoned to Another World for a Second Time
2078245.description:
Eclair was called to save the planet since it was in peril due to the conflict between the Human, Beastman, and Demon races. He successfully accomplished his task and returned to the Human Land. But the Human King's trap, which was set up because he feared the Hero who had gained power would usurp him, was there to catch him. The Hero was trapped, subjected to transfer magic, and reborn as a baby in the present.

He attended high school under the name Suzaki Setsu 16 years later. Even though he was teased for being a depressing person who only reads books, he persisted in seeking a way to enter Isekai world once more. But all of a sudden, he touched down on the alien ground once more. summoned by the nation's hero this time, along with his other students.

Thankfully, he was called to Isekai five years later. After sneaking out of Humania, he made the decision to encounter characters like the venerable Demon King and the Beast King. This is the tale of the previous hero who lacks motivation, despite continuing to become entangled in evil plots.
2078245.originName: 異世界召喚は２度目です

2078321.title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
2078321.description:
Yukito Urabe's father was the patriarch of a strange group,
So Yukito was forced to accept the unreasonable practice of the religious group and then died...
impossible!
Yukito meets the popular Another World Tensei!
It was a world without the concepts of "God" and "Religion".
"Isn't this the ideal world for me!?"

But for some reason, Yukito still has to establish a "religion" in a godless world,
A Unique Another World Tensei story, Opening!!
2078321.originName: 神無き世界のカミサマ活動

2078444.title: In Another World with My Smartphone 2
2078444.description:
15-year-old Touya Mochizuki, is unintentionally killed by God. In order to make amends, God permits his resurrection; however, since he is unable to bring him back to his previous existence, he is instead reincarnated into a fantastical realm along with any particular demands. Touya asked God to modify his request so that he may take his smartphone with him into the new realm. As a result, even though Touya cannot use it to communicate with his previous world, the phone can still work normally, access data from the old world, and use capabilities that are pertinent to his new world, including the GPS function to travel to areas that are fully identified on it.

Touya's magical, mental, and physical powers are also substantially enhanced as an additional expression of God's regret for the inconvenience of having to kill him. Touya makes the most of his second chance at life by making friends with a wide variety of people, mostly women and influential figures in the new society. With his new allies, he sets off to visit several nations, resolving political conflicts and trivial objectives while casually having fun.
2078444.originName: 異世界はスマートフォンとともに（2期）

2078533.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too
2078533.description:
Yūya Tenjō, a young man has endured brutal treatment since he was young. The "portal to another realm" unlocked for him when he fought for his life! The [Big Demon Realm] is on the opposite side of the gate, and there are many ferocious monsters there.

Yūya, who had just made his maiden foray into a new planet, developed the capacity to be so powerful as to be vile. He persisted in fighting monsters, and his level continually increased. He was finally reincarnated as the strongest and most resilient youngster!

He saved the princess from the monster on a distant planet, where he was the subject of a contentious debate throughout the nation...? In the actual world, many girls started to eagerly pursue him...?

The youngster whose level has been elevated is lying in both the actual world and the other reality. This is where the fantastical tale of life-reversing action begins!
2078533.originName: 異世界でチート能力を手にした俺は、現実世界をも無双する ～レベルアップは人生を変えた～

2078586.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!
2078586.description: In Hell's Gate, Sion Bladen imprisoned the Demon King and his army. Sion returns to the fray to fight his sworn foe as the Demon King prepares to rise once more. Sadly, while trying to defend himself from the demons, farmer Touka Scott accidentally kills him in a pig trap he set. Necromancer Anri Haysworth is forced to assume the identity of Sion by putting Touka's perverse soul in his deceased body. The three mismatched protagonists, along with Touka's childhood friend Yuna Eunice, must succeed...

2078683.title: The Aristocrat's Otherworldly Adventure: Serving Gods Who Go Too Far
2078683.description: The seven gods that live there help a Japanese teenager who is murdered by a thug to become Cain Von Silford, the third son of the illustrious Von Silford family, in an alternate, fantastical universe. Cain is chosen as their Apostle and bestowed with great blessings by the gods after accepting their offer to use the knowledge from his previous life to help them better their world. He is unaware that his true duty is to defend the planet from a forgotten, evil deity that is about to awaken.
2078683.originName: 転生貴族の異世界冒険録～自重を知らない神々の使途～転生貴族の異世界冒険録～自重を知らない神々の使途～

2078782.title: KONO SUBARASHII SEKAI NI BAKUEN WO!
2078782.description: One year before a certain useless goddess and NEET extraordinaire hit the scene, Megumin, the "Greatest Genius of the Crimson Magic Clan," is hard at work. Ever since a life-changing encounter in her youth, the young wizard has dedicated her every waking moment to the pursuit of the ultimate offensive magic, Explosion! (Well...every moment not spent hustling food from her self-proclaimed rival.) And while the big sister's away, the little one will play. On a routine trip into the woods, Megumin's little sister, Komekko, finds a strange black kitten. Little does she know that this cat plays a key role in unsealing a Dark God's tomb...
2078782.originName: この素晴らしい世界に爆焔を！

2078851.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride SEASON 2
2078851.description:
Chise Hatori, a 15-year-old Japanese girl, was sold for five million pounds at an auction to a tall masked gentleman. Abandoned at a young age and ridiculed by her peers for her unconventional behavior, she was ready to give herself to any buyer if it meant having a place to go home to. In chains and on her way to an unknown fate, she hears whispers from robed men along her path, gossiping and complaining that such a buyer got his hands on a rare "Sleigh Beggy."

Ignoring the murmurs, the mysterious man leads the girl to a study, where he reveals himself to be Elias Ainsworth—a magus. After a brief confrontation and a bit of teleportation magic, the two open their eyes to Elias' picturesque cottage in rural England. Greeted by fairies and surrounded by weird and wonderful beings upon her arrival, these events mark the beginning of Chise's story as the apprentice and supposed bride of the ancient magus.

Here is the Second Season of The Ancient Magus' Bride!

2078917.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
2078917.description: Rinko Hanasaki, a retaker who lived her life in the spotlight, passed away after being knocked to the ground by someone and learning that she had also passed the university she had her heart set on attending. Yet when she finally did awaken, she discovered that she had become Raeliana McMillan, a character from the fantasy book she had been reading. Raeliana made a pact with Noah Voltaire Wynknight, the heir to the throne of Chamos Kingdom, who wields enormous power in this world, knowing that he was the son of a noble family and would betray her by killing her fiancé. Bring it up and ask him to pose as her fiancé for a six-month period. Raeliana will so reside in his mansion as Noah Voltaire's fiancée…
2078917.originName: 彼女が公爵邸に行った理由

2079053.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
2079053.description:
To explain to Hotaru Haganezuk, the master swordsmith who forged Tanjiro's sword, why his sword was so severely injured, Tanjiro had to travel to a swordsmith village. And at that time the enemy drew near Tanjiro as he awaited the swordsmith to fix his sword... ...

On the other hand, Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, is engaged in a violent struggle with the demon, but things do not seem good and the conflict is escalating. Tanjiro and Genya, another demon slayer, are needed to assist him. Fighting two upper-rank demons at once would be bad enough. Moreover, each of these two demons can split into four new bodies, each of which has the ability to regenerate almost instantaneously. Would Tanjiro and the others be able to beat such a foe?
2079053.originName: 鬼滅の刃 刀鍛冶の里編

2079139.title: Dr. STONE (Season 3)
2079139.description: A mysterious green light terrified the earth for an unidentified purpose, leading the modern society that humans had developed to cruelly retreat back to the primordial life that existed two million years before. Senku Ishigami, the story's protagonist, will use science and knowledge to recreate the tremendous scientific society in this stone world after 3,700 years have passed in order to save all of the earth's petrified inhabitants.

2079244.title: DEAD MOUNT DEATH PLAY
2079244.description:
In another world, the Corpse God is reincarnated into the body of a young person who was recently murdered in Shinjuku during a fight to the death between the Calamity Crusher and a legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God.

The only thing the Corpse God wants is to live in peace, but as long as there are people out there who still support the execution of his host, true tranquility is elusive. It becomes much more difficult when Shinjuku's inhabitants, such as the police, troublemakers, and other oddball people, start developing personal relationships with the Corpse God himself. Yet, the Corpse God is too old and patient to be so easily discouraged, and he is eager to face new enemies in order to defend fresh allies and the tranquility they bring.

But, life on both sides of the sky promises to be anything but serene with an entity simultaneously boring a hole between Earth and the Other World.
2079244.originName: デッドマウント・デスプレイ

2079301.title: Ranking of Kings: The Treasure Chest of Courage
2079301.description:
Ranking of Kings Second Season Treasure Chest of Courage

The youthful Prince Bojji, who is deaf and mute, is despised by the populace of the kingdom. They mock his alleged folly, calling him "The Useless Prince."
Bojji isn't very powerful physically, but he's definitely not a coward. Instead of traumatizing him, a fortuitous meeting with a shadow monster leads him to assume that he has found a friend among others who only prefer to focus on his flaws. He begins meeting with Kage, the shadow, frequently to the point that even the usually hostile animal starts to like him.
The prince's quest to overcome his anxieties and doubts is beginning to take shape thanks to the unexpected connection that Kage and Bojji have developed. Bojji decides to achieve his goal of becoming the finest monarch he can be despite the ongoing mockery he endures.
2079301.originName: 王様ランキング 勇気の宝箱

2079394.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-
2079394.description: The vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya and the president of the student council, Miyuki Shirogane, met in the student union of Shuzhiin Academy. After a long battle of love and brains, the two geniuses finally expressed their hearts to each other. "First kiss. However, the two still did not make a clear confession. They thought they were about to become lovers, but they still maintained an ambiguous relationship. Instead, they became more concerned about each other, and the two welcomed Christmas like this. Shirogane, who "desires to be perfect", and Kaguya, who pursues him "imperfectly", this is an extremely "ordinary" love story of geniuses
2079394.originName: かぐや様は告らせたい-ファーストキッスは終わらない-

2079519.title: Skip and Loafer
2079519.description: Mitsumi Iwakura, a high school student from a sparsely populated rural area studying in Tokyo, previously had a wonderful life plan but ran into significant difficulties on the first day. The simple countryside is entirely different from this. The dynamics of interpersonal connections are extremely complex, especially in large cities and in schools. The daily rituals of city dwellers are very intricate! Ssuke Shima, a laid-back freshman in high school and a casual gentleman, approached her just as she was becoming perplexed.
2079519.originName: スキップとローファー

2079612.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts
2079612.description:
The girl who was sacrificed as the 99th sacrifice of the King of Beast Families, Sariphi.
She attended the sacrifice ceremony after accepting her fate.
Yet she also got married as a concubine after learning the truth about the feared monarch "Leonhart" who no one dared to approach. The story between a girl and a Beast King has started...

2079737.title: A Galaxy Next Door
2079737.description:
Ichiro Kuga struggled day in and day out to raise his younger brother and sister alone when his father passed away after he graduated from high school and started working as a manga artist.

Shiori Goshiki, a god-level helper who is both competent and attractive, appears to him in this manner. Goshiki is like a lifesaver to Kuga, whose deadline is drawing near, but all of a sudden, she said, "I am the princess of the Shooting Star People, and I have concluded a marriage contract with you." A warm romantic comedy of two People who are new to love, which began with a "marriage contract," starts!

2079843.title: My Love Story With Yamada-kun at Lv999
2079843.description:
When her boyfriend cheats on her with a woman he met online, Akane Kinoshita, a female college student, is informed to break up, which is the worst thing that can happen. Akane started to play internet games to fit the subject. The character born with her boyfriend's affection is the only thing that is still at her side.
Akane lost herself in the online game's hunting grounds in an effort to release the pressure, where she accidentally encountered "Yamada" from the same guild. He heard Akane's complaints about her failed romance and sneered, "I'm not interested," in response. Akane, however, heard this statement once more during an offline gathering she attended to reconnect with her ex-boyfriend after growing more attractive.
That encounter with "Yamada" was fateful—!
2079843.originName: 山田くんとLv.999の恋をする

2079923.title: The Dangers in My Heart
2079923.description:
Kyoutaro Ichikawa may have the appearance of a typical middle schooler, but his heart is filled with murderous fantasies. It is therefore not surprising that Anna Yamada, the class idol, is constantly on his thoughts as the person he wants to kill the most.

He unintentionally starts a meeting with Yamada while reading alone in his favorite school library, and she shows up to sneakily feast on her favorite candies and sweets. Ichikawa learns how much of a ditz Yamada is via their conversations and is forced to cheer her on from the sidelines. Yamada herself can't help but tease Ichikawa nonstop because of his agitated responses.

The distant connection between the two deepens into something more than just library acquaintances as a result of a variety of touching daily interactions. Ichikawa might eventually understand that his violent fantasies have changed into something quite else.

2080019.title: 【Oshi No Ko】
2080019.description:
In the entertainment industry, lying is the weapon.
Every day, Goro, an obstetrician and gynecologist who works in a small city, leads a life unrelated to the entertainment business.
Yet, the idol Hoshino Ai that he "followed" started to move up the list of stars.
Such two realized their worst-case scenario, and from that point on, the wheels of fate started to turn.

2080092.title: Alice Gear Aegis Expansion
2080092.description:
The mechanical life form "Weiß" suddenly attacks in the future, forcing people to flee the planet and travel into the cosmos. Space Fleet SHARD created Alice Gear, a high-dimensional suit of armor that enables humans to combat Weiß, during the time of the breakout, and dubbed the excellent ladies who are suitable for using it Actress.
After being recognized by the Weiß organization "AEGiS," private enterprise actresses can eventually seek to evict Weiß, and thus marks the beginning of the tale of ladies wearing "Alice Gear" rescuing roving aliens!
2080092.originName: アリス・ギア・アイギス Expansion

2080237.title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You Season 2
2080237.description:
Nasa Yuzaki, a boy with a peculiar name, gets hit by a truck on the day of his high school entrance exams. He encounters and follows a beautiful girl who saves him, confessing his love for her at a bus stop. The girl, Tsukasa Tsukuyomi, agrees to become his girlfriend, but only if they are married first...
Let's wait and see what happens in season two!
2080237.originName: トニカクカワイイ 第2期

2080306.title: The Girl Downstairs
2080306.description: As a freshman, Yuan Juntang applied to Minsong University to get nearer to his senior Zhu Zhu, with whom he had been secretly in love. The two ended up becoming friends and approached Zhu Zhu after unintentionally running into Li Shiya, the former idol and senior sister who had left school. They come together as a trio of pals. Yuan Juntang's admiration for her was evident to Zhu Zhu, but she lacked the guts to accept and steered away from any unclear interactions with him while remaining distant from her friends.

2080367.title: OTAKU ELF
2080367.description:
The well-known temple, which can be found in Tsukishima, Chuo-district, Tokyo, has a more than 400-year history. The god it honors is a home-sleeping elf who was brought to Japan during the Edo period from a foreign world, but who now exclusively spends the day at the shrine, is terrified of social situations, and is obsessed with video games, anime, and figurines.

Koito Koganei, a Shinto family member and Shinko Miko's daughter, has struggled to serve this spirit god. A snow-white woman who appeared in front of her on a snowy day ten years ago was the object of her heart's desire...

2080459.title: Too Cute Crisis
2080459.description: Liza Luna is an alien from the advanced culture of the galactic empire Azatos, which rules over a number of worlds. Liza is sent to explore Earth as a part of the survey team in preparation for its invasion. She initially intended to destroy Earth since its culture is far more primitive than hers, but after going by a café and seeing a cat—a species that is "too cute" and cannot be found on any other planet in the universe—she starts to change her mind.
2080459.originName: カワイスギクライシス

2080597.title: Yuri Is My Job!
2080597.description: Hime is a high school student who puts a lot of effort into maintaining the image of a kind, selfless princess, but on the inside, she just cares about herself. But when she unintentionally injured Mai, the manager of a café, she is prepared to work extra hours to maintain her persona. Hime eventually finds work as a waitress at a venue that is half café, part theater, where all the waitresses pose as students at Liebe Girls Academy, a made-up all-girls boarding school. Hime is lured to another waitress at the café who shows Hime unheard-of affection and devotion in front of the customers. But, the girl appears to despise her guts in secret.
2080597.originName: 私の百合はお仕事です！

2080734.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead!
2080734.description: In Hell's Gate, Sion Bladen imprisoned the Demon King and his army. Sion returns to the fray to fight his sworn foe as the Demon King prepares to rise once more. Sadly, while trying to defend himself from the demons, farmer Touka Scott accidentally kills him in a pig trap he set. Necromancer Anri Haysworth is forced to assume the identity of Sion by putting Touka's perverse soul in his deceased body. The three mismatched protagonists, along with Touka's childhood friend Yuna Eunice, must succeed...

2080868.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Infiltration Arc
2080868.description:
Before the broadcast of Kimetsu no Yaiba: Swordsmith Village Arc, we decided to broadcast a special edition of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc!

In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

This is part of the content of infiltration into the entertainment district!
2080868.originName: 鬼滅の刃 遊郭編 特別編集版

2080982.title: Monster but Wild
2080982.description: The player Dongdong mistakenly entered the game world "Azure" and changed into the skeleton, the weakest wild creature. The unidentified Dongdong used his years of gaming experience to amass a band of wild monsters early on. He met the main character Bubble, made a deal with her to become her strongest pet, and then set off on an amusing and thrilling adventure with Bubble and his new pals in "Azure." The phenomenon of NPCs and wild monsters in the game gradually awakening and yearning for the human world was also identified at this time by Dongdong. To learn the truth and get back to your regular life. The main character group, lead by Dongdong, as well as awakened NPCs, regular players, game developers, and other entities started to debate how the two worlds were connected.

2081129.title: The Ravages of Time
2081129.description: During the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Dong Zhuo overthrew the government, kidnapped the emperor to command the princes, and held the princes' relatives captive. Following that, Lv Bu's strategy was for burning Luoyang while luring the Allied forces into the urn. The allied troops devised their own special strategies to free the hostages, amorous characters stepped on stage, and the stage of overlords and heroes is about to start.

2081246.title: Since I Wasn't the Heroine
2081246.description: An important town on the Daqi Kingdom's northern border, Baicheng, was attacked by Beiyi using a strategy. Baicheng's guard Tang Yao led his followers in a valiant effort to fight back, but they were overpowered and all fell victim to sacrifice. Tang Ying, the second daughter, was the only one to live. The fact that his father gave his life in defense of the nation but was then accused of working with the enemy only makes Tang Ying furious. Tang Yingyi traveled to the capital to replace her father but discovered that things were more complicated than she had anticipated. Is Yuan Lang, the Daqi Kingdom's second prince who has been held captive for years, connected to Beiyi? Why is the woman acting so oddly while purporting to be herself? Is Yuan Lang, the Daqi Kingdom's second prince and long-time captive, connected to Beiyi? Why is the lady who is impersonating herself so oddly similar to herself? What ever became of the unearthly individual Yao Niang from the film department was referring to? There are also some oddly familiar recollections that jitterily surfaced. For Tang Ying to solve, there are just too many puzzles.

2081315.title: My Heroic Husband
2081315.description: In an alternate reality, the commercial elite known as Yining migrated to the Wu Dynasty and took the surname Ning and the given name Yi. Yining just concealed his well-known business skills in the virtual world since he had always dreamed of becoming a generation of martial arts superstars. Unexpectedly, the world's morals are more complex than he anticipated. In addition to being involved in significant legal proceedings after becoming Ning Yi, the Su family he joined was also in danger from formidable foes.

2081531.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Decisive Battle Arc
2081531.description:
Before the broadcast of Kimetsu no Yaiba: Swordsmith Village Arc, we decided to broadcast a special edition of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc!

In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

This part is the decisive battle in the entertainment district!
2081531.originName: 鬼滅の刃 遊郭編 特別編集版

2081589.title: Reincarnated as a Sword(Thai Dub)
2081589.description:
The Black Cats tribe suffers the dreadful fate of being hunted, enslaved, and slain. Fran, a twelve-year-old girl of the persecuted race, yearns for vengeance for the crimes committed against her people. She fantasizes about a brighter future, one for which she is willing to get her hands filthy. A meeting with a talking sword, a reborn man yearning for a beautiful wielder, proves to be the turning point in her fate.

The young Fran plans to recover her kin's glory and honor with the help of her new comrade, chopping down all her foes along the way. She begins on a quest with her amazing sword and unwavering resolve.

2081760.title: My Home Hero
2081760.description: Tetsuo Tosu, an unimportant office worker who adores his only daughter Reika, first encounters Reika after she started living alone due to her job but discovers that she has bruises on her face. Tetsuo followed a man who appeared to be a prisoner after spotting him on the way home. He sneaks back to his daughter's apartment the following day, but something happens that alters their entire family's course of events. The father started along the Shura path for the benefit of his daughter and the family. A thrilling, climactic story starts.

2081843.title: Mashle: Magic and Muscle
2081843.description:
Everyone in this world takes having access to magic for granted. There is a young man who labors arduously to develop his muscles in the depths of the forest in the magical realm. Mash Burnedead is his name, and he has a secret: he is incapable of using magic.
He desired to live a tranquil life with his family, but one day he was unexpectedly targeted for death and compelled to enroll in a magic school in order to compete for the title of "Divine Visionary," the top student.
Can he use his time-honed muscles to his advantage in front of expert magicians?
The odd magical fantasy story's first line is "Brush all magic with the power of hard effort"!

2081965.title: Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury Season2
2081965.description:
A.S. (Ad Stella) 122―
It is an era in which a number of corporations have entered space and have built a vast economic system. The Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group, dominates the mobile suit industry with a lone girl from Mercury transferring to it. The girl's name is Suletta Mercury. She walks step by step through a new world with a scarlet light burning in her heart.

And now comes the second half of this story...
2081965.originName: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 Season2

2082099.title: BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls’ Story- Season 2
2082099.description: In a certain European country, there is Navres. Eve, blessed with genius golfing talent, makes a living by betting on the sport every day. One fateful day, she crosses paths with Aoi Tenzuru, the heiress of a major corporation and a golf prodigy. Two geniuses from utterly different worlds—just one swing was enough to pierce each other’s hearts. There’s Eve, whose shots are like iridescent bullets—“Rainbow Barrett”—and Aoi, the carefree “innocent‑yet‑domineering tyrant” who simply revels in the pure joy of golf. The two are drawn to one another, influence each other, and transform as they go—the tale of these golfing girls, their talents colliding in dazzling sparks.  The world’s first original anime series centered on women’s golf, now begins!  “Soar high and take flight to the world!”

2082231.title: EDENS ZERO 2
2082231.description: There are countless unsolved secrets and numerous crises lurking in this enormous cosmos. Walking alone yourself is unavoidably boring, but as the guy runs into his friends, everything starts to get interesting. The voyage to the farthest reaches of the universe is no longer a solo trek; rather, it requires a group effort to battle. This combination of brave hearts creates the power of one plus one larger than two, and a new journey is revealed to them.

2082286.title: One Piece Film Red
2082286.description:
Uta, the diva who drove the whole world insane.
Although her life history is unknown, her singing is regarded as coming "from another dimension".
She will perform this time, showing the world her true colors for the first time. Luffy and his companions, as well as numerous pirates, members of the navy, and admirers from all over the world, gathered in the venue to enjoy her music.
High-profile tunes from around the globe are set to echo here.
However, the unexpected revelation that Uta is "Shanks's daughter"? Now the story starts!

2082414.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc (Thai Dub)
2082414.description:
To explain to Hotaru Haganezuk, the master swordsmith who forged Tanjiro's sword, why his sword was so severely injured, Tanjiro had to travel to a swordsmith village. And at that time the enemy drew near Tanjiro as he awaited the swordsmith to fix his sword... ...

On the other hand, Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, is engaged in a violent struggle with the demon, but things do not seem good and the conflict is escalating. Tanjiro and Genya, another demon slayer, are needed to assist him. Fighting two upper-rank demons at once would be bad enough. Moreover, each of these two demons can split into four new bodies, each of which has the ability to regenerate almost instantaneously. Would Tanjiro and the others be able to beat such a foe?
2082414.originName: 鬼滅の刃 刀鍛冶の里編

2082554.title: The Eminence in Shadow (Thai Dub)
2082554.description:
People aspire to be great heroes and evil villains, but Cid Kagenou is not one of them. He aspires to be the true brain behind it all, pulling the strings and directing the entire plot. He was unable to attain his objectives in his prior existence in modern-day Japan. But now, resurrected into a magical world, he will demonstrate the true majesty of darkness!

As Cid poses as an ordinary mobster, he recruits members for his (false) group Shadow Garden, which aims to bring down the enigmatic cult that lurks in the shadows. Cid leads his (fictional) organization against the filthy (yet unexpectedly real) Diabolos Cult with plenty of ad-libs.
2082554.originName: 陰の実力者になりたくて！

2082636.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Aria of a Starless Night
2082636.description:
This is the tale of "Flash" and "Swordsman in Black" before their respective names were given to them.
By the Sword Art Online game's administration, the real-world death and virtual death are directly related. Following the announcement, there were bewildered yells from every participant throughout the entire game. One of them, Yuuki Asuna, a junior high school student in the third grade who had never played any online games, set out to conquer the intangible steel floating city known as "Aincrad" without having any knowledge of the laws of the outside world...
2082636.originName: 劇場版 ソードアート・オンライン プログレッシブ 星なき夜のアリア

2082744.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Progressive - Scherzo of Deep Night
2082744.description:
Since 10,000 players were imprisoned in the game's virtual reality environment for more than a month, the first VRMMORPG "Sword Art Online" has devolved into a death game.
One day, the Raiders mission appears to be going well with the assistance of a female informant Argo, but...
A shadowy person is moving about in the shadows behind the scenes.
A threat other than "The Raiders" arrived, and Asuna and Kirito were entangled in a perilous back-to-back fight with death...!
2082744.originName: 劇場版 ソードアート・オンライン プログレッシブ 冥き夕闇のスケルツォ

2082866.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc (Dub Indo)
2082866.description: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
2082866.originName: 鬼滅の刃 刀鍛冶の里編

2082964.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc (VN Dub)
2082964.description:
To explain to Hotaru Haganezuk, the master swordsmith who forged Tanjiro's sword, why his sword was so severely injured, Tanjiro had to travel to a swordsmith village. And at that time the enemy drew near Tanjiro as he awaited the swordsmith to fix his sword... ...

On the other hand, Muichiro Tokito, the Mist Hashira, is engaged in a violent struggle with the demon, but things do not seem good and the conflict is escalating. Tanjiro and Genya, another demon slayer, are needed to assist him. Fighting two upper-rank demons at once would be bad enough. Moreover, each of these two demons can split into four new bodies, each of which has the ability to regenerate almost instantaneously. Would Tanjiro and the others be able to beat such a foe?
2082964.originName: 鬼滅の刃 刀鍛冶の里編

2083094.title: Dr. STONE (Season 3) (Thai Dub)
2083094.description: A mysterious green light terrified the earth for an unidentified purpose, leading the modern society that humans had developed to cruelly retreat back to the primordial life that existed two million years before. Senku Ishigami, the story's protagonist, will use science and knowledge to recreate the tremendous scientific society in this stone world after 3,700 years have passed in order to save all of the earth's petrified inhabitants.

2083232.title: 【Oshi No Ko】 (Thai Dub)
2083232.description:
In the entertainment industry, lying is the weapon.
Every day, Goro, an obstetrician and gynecologist who works in a small city, leads a life unrelated to the entertainment business.
Yet, the idol Hoshino Ai that he "followed" started to move up the list of stars.
Such two realized their worst-case scenario, and from that point on, the wheels of fate started to turn.

2083292.title: JJ LIN “HAPPILY PAINFULLY AFTER” LIVE PREMIERE
2083292.description:
This is more than just a debut concert.
Swept into the vortex of time,
a live performance up close,
every corner alive with heartfelt faces.
Sometimes singing out loud in harmony,
sometimes listening in quiet.
Falling in an instant, then slowly rising again—
a live show where songs from the heart layer upon layer weave our lives together.

Road to JJ20:
No expectations,
dreaming inward,
gazing at the light outward.
A journey of stumbles and falls,
crafted into notes and brought to life.
Truly here, truly now.
This moment is a comma;
the future holds the courage to return to the beginning.
Happiness isn’t far away—

2083386.title: Am I Actually the Strongest?
2083386.description:
I, a Hikikomori, was suddenly reincarnated into a prince in a different realm, but because of my weak magical abilities, I was doomed to die on my very first day of existence.

I came upon a huge creature right when I thought I was alone in the far-off forest.

I attempted to use magic to fight the monster in order to defend myself, but for some reason, the monster changed into a gorgeous female and even became my servant!

In a daze, I became a "Devil King" and began a new harem life!

2083530.title: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1
2083530.description:
Ryota Sato, who works in an unethical company, has been relocated to a different planet! However, despite his best efforts, the level was only level 1.

Despite the level being unchangeable, Ryota has a super intrinsic skill with an all-S rank drop rate that can drop items that enhance power and are otherwise impossible to get.

Ryota continually develops his skills to become stronger. Despite only being at level 1, his ability value is MAX!
2083530.originName: レベル1だけどユニークスキルで最強です

2083663.title: Reign of the Seven Spellblades
2083663.description: New first-year students arrive at Kimberly Magic Academy in the spring. Oliver Horn, a young man with a burning desire to carry out a purpose, is one of this year's class. Oliver's goal is to get revenge on the Kimberly's faculty members who murdered his mother brutally, but when he meets Nanao Hibiya, a samurai girl from the far-off country of Yamatsu, he finds himself torn between his ambition and his attraction to her. Oliver meets numerous other pupils along with her, and he quickly makes friends with them. Will these friendships hurt Oliver's revenge? The fact that there has never been a single student death at Kimberly Academy was also revealed to him and the other first-years during the admission ceremony. The seven years of torment will Oliver and his friends be able to endure?
2083663.originName: 七つの魔剣を支配する

2083785.title: Classroom for Heroes
2083785.description:
The hero is a "super creature"!?
Blade, a previous hero who battled the Demon Lord and lost all of his strength. As he desired, he should have logically been an average student, but the school he attended was actually a top-tier institution for hero cultivation?
Of course, the students who attend are top-notch. While Blade was previously an "authentic" hero, he is now too heroic in terms of his "mind," "body," and "skills"!? He insulted the king in addition to destroying the majority of the school building during the practical class! He can even eat pork cutlet curry alone when the school is in a frenzy since the Dragon Clan escaped!?
Now Blade begins the bizarre, wild, careless, and utterly unnatural "Loose cannon" life by acting like a "super creature"!

2083919.title: Helck
2083919.description:
The hero defeated the Demon Lord alone in a certain nation of the Demon World.

"The demon is no longer a concern for us now," the fight for the new monarch in the world of demons is underway as people are grinning widely!

But who could ever anticipate that the man who arrives on the field is...?

Here the heroic journey of the enigmatic Helck begins!

2083981.title: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
2083981.description:
The Demon Lord was defeated by the hero Max, yet even after death, the Demon Lord is still capable of awakening.

The Demon Lord then hastily awoke after 10 years of sleep in order to defeat Max with his own hands...!

In the human society that has prospered and evolved quickly in this decade, the decadent hero and the young Demon Lord girl will...
2083981.originName: Lv1魔王とワンルーム勇者

2084055.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 2
2084055.description:
Yuuji Itadori, a high school student, spends his days passively participating in phony paranormal activities with the Occult Club in either the clubroom or the hospital where he visits his sick grandfather. His tranquil way of life rapidly becomes strange when he accidentally discovers a cursed artifact. A finger belonging to the demon Sukuna Ryoumen, the King of Curses, is shown to have been ingested after being consumed. Suddenly thrust into the frightening realm of Curses—creatures created of human hatred and negativity—Yuuji finds himself trapped there. 
Now let's stay tuned to the second season!

2084136.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2
2084136.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life. 

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
2084136.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 2期

2084237.title: Classroom of the Elite III
2084237.description:
What is true power and fairness?

Advanced Nurturing High School is the top-ranked, most prestigious institution in the nation and has nearly 100% of its students who sought higher education and jobs succeed.
Although this school seems like a paradise, its true nature is one of power dominance, where only the best students receive special care.
Ayanokji Kiyotaka was placed in the lowest class, D, where he met Horikita Suzune, a stunning student with stellar academics but a challenging disposition, and Kiku Kushida, an angelic student with compassion and gentleness. Kiyotaka's attitude progressively changed after their meeting...
2084237.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ3

2084370.title: Horimiya -The Missing Pieces-
2084370.description:
Kyouko Hori is well-liked, pretty, and smart at school. On the other hand, her classmate Izumi Miyamura, who is dull and depressing, is often portrayed as a "loser fanboy." But these two remarkably different youths learn that there are many sides to every story—and person—when Miyamura, who has numerous tattoos and piercings and is also simply handsome, shows up suddenly at Hori's door...
The sweet romance story begins again!

2084471.title: The Great Cleric
2084471.description:
The god of fate lost a wager to the overlord deity of another world and was forced to surrender ten souls to that realm—among them, I was chosen by the gods.

By an unexpected twist, I was reborn in a different world—the planet Galdaridia. Based on the skills I selected, I became a healer and seamlessly joined the Healing Guild, where I began my studies and set out on adventures.
2084471.originName: 聖者無双～サラリーマン、異世界で生き残るために歩む道～

2084600.title: Sweet Reincarnation
2084600.description:
The following lord, Pastry, was born, a lowly nobility who governs a poor realm. Pastry, who possesses a remarkable ability, once dreamed of becoming a pastry chef.

The youngster had to endure a lack of water, arid lands, merciless thieves, monsters suddenly baring their fangs, crafty and malicious aristocrats, and countless sufferings and challenges.

The dashing next ruler survives in a world of magic and swords thanks to his natural ingenuity and love of sweets.

Make people smile with treats, and strive towards a place where happiness is abundant. The young Pastry's challenge has just begun!

The regal dessert fantasy that alters the world combines the best sweets and stories.

2084676.title: LINK CLICK Ⅱ
2084676.description:
In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their superpowers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...
And what new cases await them in season 2?
2084676.originName: 时光代理人 第二季

2084824.title: Liar Liar
2084824.description:
I, Hiroto Shinohara, took part in the most rigorous Gakuen Island entrance exam in the nation and stood out with the best score ever on Gakuen Island, where students regularly duel to choose their classes. Then, on the first day I attended a new school, I vanquished Sarasa Saionji, the previous year's undisputed monarch, and took home the "7 Stars" at the top of monarch's Landing with the fastest speed in Academy Island history. Yes, of course this is all a lie.
I had to stay in charge of Academy Island even if I lied in order to accomplish my aim. I will thus use it to the very end, whether it be the deceitful scheme of the lovely female maid Himeji, or the partnership with Saionji who poses as the young woman. So let's begin the pretense of global dominance.

2084929.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
2084929.description: Due to the reclassification, Mie, who is seated next to him, is a favorite of Komura's. Komura does learn one day that Mie's eyes have changed to be exceedingly aggressive. Komura attempted to assist Mie, who was having trouble seeing well, but it turned out that she had just forgotten her spectacles. Just that Mie had more than one day without remembering to wear her spectacles. Can Komura's heart handle the pressure of having to deal with a variety of close encounters brought on by Mie's poor eyesight?
2084929.originName: 好きな子がめがねを忘れた

2085022.title: Rakshasa Street S3
2085022.description: Evil spirits are drawn to Requiem Street in order to be destroyed there. Requiem Street is a place where spirits and humans coexist; not all humans are permitted entry. Only users of rare souls who have guardian spirits are allowed inside. Xia Ling was simply an ordinary university intern until an unexpected encounter changed everything in her life. Can you work with your guardian spirit to survive in this world filled with malevolent spirits?

2085159.title: IMMORTALITY 2
2085159.description: Immortals and demons are at war in the vast world of Xuanhuang. Ten sects of immortality separate the immortal, while the demonic route is divided into seven branches for the demon. Since ancient times, there have been constant disputes all the time. These days, the immortals rule the wealthy secular world and several dynasties, while the demons congregate in isolated areas like underground and beyond the borders. Immortals and mortals have lived very separate lives since the beginning of time, yet mortals can also become immortal with enough practice. After that, though, there will be a greater world, and the path to development is arduous and never-ending.

2085227.title: Trip to the Abyss
2085227.description: The blind adolescent Su Yun was raised in Tianmen Town, the Sky City, Yuanshuo Country, in an outlying rural wasteland. He followed a fox to study the ancient texts. Su Yun, encouraged by Qiu Shuijing, left Tianmen Town to study at Shuofang City, but unintentionally became entangled in a plot that had been hatched 150 years earlier. The Seven Great Families, the Old Master of Shuobei, the Sage of Shuofang, the Great Emperor of the Eastern Capital... Let's witness how Su Yun topples this "chessboard" and defends one side of the people when numerous forces are competing for control and profit and putting the populace in peril.

2085283.title: Monster but Wild 2
2085283.description: The player Dongdong mistakenly entered the game world "Azure" and changed into the skeleton, the weakest wild creature. The unidentified Dongdong used his years of gaming experience to amass a band of wild monsters early on. He met the main character Bubble, made a deal with her to become her strongest pet, and then set off on an amusing and thrilling adventure with Bubble and his new pals in "Azure." The phenomenon of NPCs and wild monsters in the game gradually awakening and yearning for the human world was also identified at this time by Dongdong. To learn the truth and get back to your regular life. The main character group, lead by Dongdong, as well as awakened NPCs, regular players, game developers, and other entities started to debate how the two worlds were connected.
2085283.originName: 区区不才，在下野怪 第二季

2085349.title: Blader Soul
2085349.description: Two kids who lived in the shadow of an aristocratic family yearn for the fabled Penglai fairyland. The warlocks arrived, the Gan Shi star passed by, and the star stone cast a tripod, waking the power buried within each of their bodies as well as their hitherto unseen yearning.

2085460.title: Agate
2085460.description: The immortal witch once again lost her treasure things. Tears could not be suppressed and even drowned in hell. The witch, this time, decided to move her head!

2085533.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Infiltration Arc（Thai Dub）
2085533.description:
Before the broadcast of Kimetsu no Yaiba: Swordsmith Village Arc, we decided to broadcast a special edition of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Arc!

In pursuit of a demon that has been terrorising Yoshiwara's red light district, Tanjirou, Zenitsu, and Inosuke head to the entertainment district with the help of Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui.

This is part of the content of infiltration into the entertainment district!
2085533.originName: 鬼滅の刃 遊郭編 特別編集版

2086168.originName: 鬼滅の刃 遊郭編 特別編集版

2086241.title: Bungo Stray Dogs Season 5
2086241.description:
Six days remain till the country's destruction by "The Decay of the Angel" attempt.
Before that, is it possible to annihilate the leader Kamui, who hasn't been seen yet, and seize the "page" from their hands?
Is this how you plan to survive?

The man behind the scenes was finally seen for who he truly was.
The past, the present, and the partners. One by one, everything is for the future.
2086241.originName: 文豪ストレイドッグス５

2086292.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
2086292.description: Initially, Akira Tendo was a dreamer and a passionate young guy. After three years of toiling away in a vile business, he was reduced to the status of a clockwork man who had lost all desire to survive. Akira discovered the city to be overrun with zombies when he went to the management office to pay the parking ticket one morning. Even the boss, Otori, who Akira fell in love with at first sight, became into a zombie, which is when the tale of the man who was reborn as a result of the zombie began!
2086292.originName: ゾン100～ゾンビになるまでにしたい100のこと～

2086366.title: Undead Girl Murder Farce
2086366.description:
Why were eternal vampires put to death?

The investigator who specialized in monster cases is known as "Birdcage Messenger".

There are werewolves, vampires, androids, rippers, werewolves, phantom thieves, and a detective. Human-friendly vampires were killed by being tortured with silver stakes during the end of the 19th century in Europe, where the aliens had relocated. Aya Rindo, a special investigator who specialized in handling "monster cases" that people avoid, and Tsugaru Shinuchi, a man with an odd birdcage, arrived to solve the case. From the remaining hints and the traits of monsters, they deduced conclusions. Here begins a comedy that is as mysterious as a nightmare!
2086366.originName: アンデッドガール・マーダーファルス

2086476.title: Malevolent Spirits: Mononogatari 2nd half
2086476.description:
Tsukumogami, spirits, or "marebito" can possess objects of considerable age and gain a physical form. Although he is part of the Saenome clan that is in charge of peacefully sending them back to their own world, Hyouma Kunato despises them because one took away what was very precious to him.

To cure him of this loathing, Hyouma's grandfather sends him to live with Botan Nagatsuki, a girl who is the master of six "friendly" tsukumogami and lives with them as a family.
2086476.originName: もののがたり　後半

2086616.title: Spy Classroom 2nd season
2086616.description:
Lily, a beautiful girl with white locks, is a student in one of the many institutions that train youths into becoming capable spies. Unfortunately, with no real-world skills to speak of, her hopes of graduating are dismal—until she is offered an opportunity to join the mysterious team "Tomoshibi" and partake in an Impassable Mission.

Lily is struck dumb when she arrives at Kagerou Palace and the true purpose of Tomoshibi and its hopeless situation comes to light. Joined by other problematic female spies along with a mysterious young man spearheading the operation, Lily realizes that this is not the ideal escapade she had pictured.
2086616.originName: もののがたり　後半

2086747.title: TenPuru: No One Can Live on Loneliness
2086747.description:
Due to the reputation of his ancestors and his father's promiscuous behavior, college student Akemitsu Akagami, who had long insisted on chastity, accidentally encountered young girl Yuzuki Aoba and immediately fell in love with her.

Akemitsu made the decision to give up eating, put his studies on hold, and become a monk in order to get rid of his distracting thoughts. Unexpectedly, the nunnery where Yuzuki resided was the temple he went to.

2086833.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid Season 2
2086833.description:
A sizable bungalow is hidden deep inside the wilderness outside the town. There was a death god.
Here is a young master of a certain aristocrat was formerly despised by all around him due to a witch's spell that "everything you touch will die".
This young master is currently most bothered by his maid "Alice"'s reverse sexual harassment.

Being sexually harassed makes this young master who cares about her very happy, yet being unable to touch her hurts.
The young master could not hold Alice's hand, despite the fact that she appeared to care about him. Will their love ultimately be successful?
2086833.originName: 死神坊ちゃんと黒メイド　2期

2086976.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets Specials
2086976.description: The final summer break is set to start as Fuutarou and the five sisters finish their last half year of high school. Fuutarou informed the five sisters that he had quit his work as a tutor during the summer break even though they had come together to study for exams. The five sisters unexpectedly got a call from Fuutarou as they were mired in despair over being unable to see Fuutarou.
2086976.originName: 五等分の花嫁 ∽(スペシャル)

2087103.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Separation
2087103.description:
By chance, Ichigo Kurosaki gained the abilities of the god of death and was dubbed the "agent Soul Reaper."
He grew up in the corpse world, the location where the spirits of those who have died in this lifetime congregate.
And at this point, the Nether Empire formally declared war on the death god.
Five days later, the "invisible empire" destroyed the corpse world.
For a millennium, fate has been the Grim Reaper's burden.
Finally, their causality and underlying truths are revealed.
It's all going to end.

And now the second part Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Separation begins.
2087103.originName: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-訣別譚-

2087178.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead! (Thai Dub)
2087178.description: In Hell's Gate, Sion Bladen imprisoned the Demon King and his army. Sion returns to the fray to fight his sworn foe as the Demon King prepares to rise once more. Sadly, while trying to defend himself from the demons, farmer Touka Scott accidentally kills him in a pig trap he set. Necromancer Anri Haysworth is forced to assume the identity of Sion by putting Touka's perverse soul in his deceased body. The three mismatched protagonists, along with Touka's childhood friend Yuna Eunice, must succeed...

2087285.title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
2087285.description:
When I regained my senses, I discovered that I had been reborn as the princess in the video game who was 8 years old and would eventually take the throne.
I would have brought bad luck to all around me as the ultimate BOSS against the players and would have perished, or is it preferable for me to die sooner?
However, because the plot can be altered, I must fully utilize my ability to "predict the future" in order to avert tragedy and save everyone.
This is the story of the queen, the final boss of the antagonist, who secretly won the hearts of all.
2087285.originName: 悲劇の元凶となる最強外道ラスボス女王は民の為に尽くします

2087353.title: The Gene of AI
2087353.description:
In the near future, the world will soon be very technical, with humanoid robots—a technology that was once only a dream—becoming a reality.

They completely ingratiate themselves into daily life, but they also give rise to fresh contradictions.

They can "get sick" and have various "treatment" options than humans, just like humans can.

Here is where the story of the novel sort of doctor Sudō begins, close to these troubled AIs!

2087474.title: Genjitsu no Yohane: SUNSHINE in the MIRROR
2087474.description:
The story of her, known to all yet unknown to most—
Numaz, a port city surrounded by mountains and seas, bathed in breathtaking scenery. Yoha, a girl who has never quite felt at ease with the world around her since childhood, lives keeping her distance from everyone in town.
What I want to do, my true place of belonging—that is—
Together with a girl who cannot bring herself to be open, wander through the wondrous world you know so well.
“Yoha of the Sundogs – SUNSHINE in the MIRROR”
Now, another sun has appeared.
2087474.originName: 幻日のヨハネ -SUNSHINE in the MIRROR-

2087595.title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout The Animation
2087595.description:
The story is set in Rasenboden, a village on Kurken Island, a lake island. Rysa is a resident of the village.
She got together with her closest friends to discuss her aspirations because she was unhappy about the monotonous existence in the village. In search of excitement, she then devised a plan to tour the community.
Rysa and her group finally decided to embark on their first trip, and they traveled to the banned opposite side of the floating island one day. Then I met a man who was skilled in alchemy and has amazing strength.
Rysa and her group left their monotonous daily lives behind and traveled to unusual locations they had never been to fulfill their aspirations after pleading with a teacher for years to teach them the power of alchemy.
Meanwhile, on Kurken Island, a crisis is developing…
2087595.originName: ライザのアトリエ 〜常闇の女王と秘密の隠れ家〜

2087725.title: Heaven Official's Blessing Season 2
2087725.description:
When Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom eight hundred years ago, he was adored by his subjects and the darling of the entire world. Unsurprisingly, at a very young age, he entered the Heavens. Eight hundred years later, Xie Lian makes his third ascent to the Heavens while being derided by all three kingdoms. He encounters a frightening monster who controls ghosts and terrorizes the Heavens while doing his first assignment as a god.… But Xie Lian has no idea that this demon king has been observing him for a very, very long time.
Let's stay tuned in season 2!

2087858.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2(Thai Dub)
2087858.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
2087858.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 2期

2087990.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2(Dub Indo)
2087990.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
2087990.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 2期

2088104.title: Zom100: Bucket List of the Dead(Thai Dub)
2088104.description: Initially, Akira Tendo was a dreamer and a passionate young guy. After three years of toiling away in a vile business, he was reduced to the status of a clockwork man who had lost all desire to survive. Akira discovered the city to be overrun with zombies when he went to the management office to pay the parking ticket one morning. Even the boss, Otori, who Akira fell in love with at first sight, became into a zombie, which is when the tale of the man who was reborn as a result of the zombie began!
2088104.originName: ゾン100～ゾンビになるまでにしたい100のこと～

2088182.title: Zom100: Bucket List of the Dead(Dub Indo)
2088182.description: Initially, Akira Tendo was a dreamer and a passionate young guy. After three years of toiling away in a vile business, he was reduced to the status of a clockwork man who had lost all desire to survive. Akira discovered the city to be overrun with zombies when he went to the management office to pay the parking ticket one morning. Even the boss, Otori, who Akira fell in love with at first sight, became into a zombie, which is when the tale of the man who was reborn as a result of the zombie began!
2088182.originName: ゾン100～ゾンビになるまでにしたい100のこと～

2088314.title: The Devil Is a Part-Timer! Season 2 Part 2
2088314.description:
With only one last step left to conquer the world, Satan loses to the hero Emilia Justina and flees to another world: modern-day Tokyo.
In the new world, his world-conquering skills are completely useless and he has to find a part-time job to make ends meet. The hero follows in his footsteps and comes to this world too, working in a customer support call centre. Under the new names of Maou Sadao and Yusa Emi, the two meet again.
2088314.originName: はたらく魔王さま！第2期　後半

2088416.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond (Thai Dub)
2088416.description: There is a small country to the west of Tempest called Raja. As Rimuru and his companions investigate the mysterious power of the queen, they become involved in a long-running conspiracy. During their journey, Rimuru and Benimaru meet another survivor of the ogre species, an old brother of Benimaru named Hiiro. What on earth happened to Hiiro? And what experience did he have with Benimaru...
2088416.originName: 劇場版 転生したらスライムだった件 紅蓮の絆編

2088534.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too(Thai Dub)
2088534.description:
Yūya Tenjō, a young man has endured brutal treatment since he was young. The "portal to another realm" unlocked for him when he fought for his life! The [Big Demon Realm] is on the opposite side of the gate, and there are many ferocious monsters there.

Yūya, who had just made his maiden foray into a new planet, developed the capacity to be so powerful as to be vile. He persisted in fighting monsters, and his level continually increased. He was finally reincarnated as the strongest and most resilient youngster!

He saved the princess from the monster on a distant planet, where he was the subject of a contentious debate throughout the nation...? In the actual world, many girls started to eagerly pursue him...?

The youngster whose level has been elevated is lying in both the actual world and the other reality. This is where the fantastical tale of life-reversing action begins!
2088534.originName: 異世界でチート能力を手にした俺は、現実世界をも無双する ～レベルアップは人生を変えた～

2089090.title: Heaven Official's Blessing Season 2（Thai Dub)
2089090.description:
When Xie Lian was the Crown Prince of the Xian Le kingdom eight hundred years ago, he was adored by his subjects and the darling of the entire world. Unsurprisingly, at a very young age, he entered the Heavens. Eight hundred years later, Xie Lian makes his third ascent to the Heavens while being derided by all three kingdoms. He encounters a frightening monster who controls ghosts and terrorizes the Heavens while doing his first assignment as a god.… But Xie Lian has no idea that this demon king has been observing him for a very, very long time.
Let's stay tuned in season 2!

2089176.title: Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch I - Koudou
2089176.description:
The Holy Britannian Empire is a powerful nation that uses its military strength to expand its rule, and the small island nation of Japan is yet another victim. During a worldwide conflict in 2010 known as the Second Pacific War, the once-proud country was reduced to rubble and mockingly renamed to Area 11.
However, one student plans to free Japan from Britannia's control through an extraordinary rebellion. His name is Lelouch Lamperouge, and he is fueled with hatred for the Empire, plotting to wipe its accursed name off the face of the planet. Lelouch's malicious plans are unexpectedly accelerated upon meeting the mysterious woman C.C., who grants him a supernatural ability known as Geass that makes anyone Lelouch commands unable to defy his will.
Now armed with a devastating power, Lelouch assumes the persona of Zero, a revolutionary figure who carries the hopes and dreams of the oppressed around the world. He vows to restore the glorious nation of Japan and deliver divine retribution to Britannia.
2089176.originName: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ I 興道

2089246.title: The Eminence In Shadow 2nd Season
2089246.description:
Cid Kagenou is not one of those people who aspires to be heroic heroes or terrible villains. He wants to be the actual mastermind, the one who controls everything and plots the entire scheme. In his previous life in present-day Japan, he was unable to accomplish his goals. But now that he has been revived in a fantastical realm, he will show off the true power of the night!

Cid recruits members for his (fake) group Shadow Garden, which seeks to dismantle the mysterious cult that hides in the shadows, while assuming the persona of an everyday mobster. With a lot of improv, Cid leads his (fantasy) group in battle against the evil Diabolos Cult, which turns out to be unexpectedly real. Let's stay tuned for the 2nd Season!
2089246.originName: 陰の実力者になりたくて！ 2nd season

2089369.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Rebellion
2089369.description: His vision will upend the world—Lelouch, as the masked rebel Zero, steadily strengthens the anti‑Britannian Black Knights; meanwhile, Kallen is appointed as the personal knight of the Third Princess, Euphemia. Each has found their own stage to wield their power, yet at this moment, a fateful turning point quietly approaches. As Deputy Governor of Area 11, Euphemia announces the establishment of the administrative zone “Japan”; however, if that zone comes to fruition, the very reason for the Black Knights’ existence will vanish. To break the deadlock, Lelouch resolves to meet with Euphemia. Determined to protect what he holds dear, Lelouch has long since accepted his resolve. Yet the price of the Geass grants him only a flicker of hope, one soon eclipsed by the weight of age‑old ambition, as the gears of fate inexorably grind toward tragedy.
2089369.originName: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ II 叛道

2089489.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Emperor
2089489.description:
Lelouch Lamperouge's dreams of destroying the Holy Britannian Empire are slowly crumbling. His sister, Nunnally, has been kidnapped by Schneizel el Britannia, and Suzaku Kururugi is ignoring his desperate pleas for assistance. The Black Knights are slowly losing faith in Lelouch as their leader, and the United Federation of Nations has declared global war on Britannia.
Having suffered numerous betrayals, a significant loss of power, and an ever-growing resentment towards Emperor Charles zi Britannia, the crippled Lelouch makes a final decision: if he can't destroy the Empire from the outside, he will take it for himself from within.
2089489.originName: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ III 皇道

2089635.title: Code Geass Lelouch of the Re;surrection
2089635.description: The story unfolds several years after the events of Season Two’s “Zero Requiem,” in the year 2019. The world revolves around the reconstituted United Federation, celebrating peaceful days. Yet this peace is suddenly brought to an end. As Zero, heading to a refugee camp with Nunnally to offer support, Suzaku is defeated by a mysterious Knightmare Frame—and the two are abducted.  Acting on Schneizel’s secret orders, Kallen, Lloyd, and Cecile infiltrate the “Kingdom of Warriors,” the nation of Jyrkstan, only to be attacked by a shadowy Geass user. And there, among them, is C.C.—referred to by her assailant as “the Former Lord.”  Set against the backdrop of an invincible kingdom that once vanquished the armies of the Holy Britannian Empire, what dreams do its people harbor: hope or despair? What lies in the hearts of those within the Jyrkstan royal court who know of Geass—and what, ultimately, does C.C. intend? …
2089635.originName: コードギアス 復活のルルーシュ

2089728.title: GOBLIN SLAYER II
2089728.description:
"I don't save the world, just kill the goblins."

It is stated that crustling goblins are the only ones who have risen to the silver level (ranked third) in this frontier guild....a divine officer I joined the team for the first time after becoming an adventurer and experienced a crisis during the trip. And it was this man known as the "goblin killer" who rescued her.
He is not afraid to labor hard and solely focuses on sweeping goblins. The tossing goddess officer, the counter girl who is grateful for him, and the cowherd girl who is waiting for his childhood sweetheart are all standing behind him. When a Mori (fairy) girl learned of his exploits, she came to entrust her with a mission.
October 2023, Season 2 starts!
2089728.originName: ゴブリンスレイヤー2期

2089849.title: Demon's Sword Master of Excalibur School
2089849.description: According to this tale, the demon king Leonis imprisoned himself for a thousand years to get ready for the decisive fight, but when he emerged, he discovered that he was now inhabiting the body of a 10-year-old kid. Then, a stunning student from the Holy Sword Academy by the name of Riselia asks him, "Why were you imprisoned in such a place? Now everything is OK; your big sister will take care of you." Leonis, who is under Riselia's custody, is dismayed to discover how drastically things have altered. Leonis finds himself enrolling in the Holy Sword Academy, bewildered and puzzled. What gonna Leonis do?

2089932.title: Shangri-La Frontier
2089932.description: Gaming on a monitor is out of date, and immersive VR games are already widely available. The market is overrun with "trash games," which are games that have superb imaging technology but whose systems can't keep up, in contrast to the extremely few masterpieces. And then there are those (perverts) who simply like engaging in this sort of "trash trick" that is detested by the general populace. One of them—the "trash trick hunter"—is Rakur Hizutome. Rakur Hizutome attacked the masterpiece "Shangri-La Frontier" this time in an effort to alter his taste. He had numerous weird adventures and met many different partners while playing the game, and that is where the job started.
2089932.originName: シャングリラ・フロンティア〜クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす〜（前半）

2090049.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 2
2090049.description:
Corrupt politicians, fervent nationalists, and other warmongering elements regularly undermine the fragile peace between Ostania and Westalis. Regardless of their designs, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" completes risky missions one after the other in the hope that no kid will have to witness the horrors of war.

Twilight assumes the alias "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist, in the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint. His genuine purpose, however, is to gather intelligence on important politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears in public on rare occasions at his son's school, the elite Eden Academy. Loid enacts his master plan by enlisting the services of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter. He'll enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where he expects she'll succeed and allow him to see Donovan without raising suspicions.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his abilities struggles to portray the role of a loving father and spouse. And, just as Loid is keeping his true identity hidden, Yor—an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to reveal their own. Despite the fact that their picture-perfect family is built on lie, the Forgers gradually realize that their love for one another is more important than anything else. Now let's stay tuned for the Season 2!

2090146.title: Butareba: The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig
2090146.description:
I am a lowly otaku who fainted after eating raw pork liver.
I thought I was reborn into another realm, but instead I became a pig!
I was lying in a pig pen when Jess, a girl who is reputed to be able to see into people's emotions, came to my rescue.
Huh! So adorable! The immaculate white from the hem of the skirt can be seen from the perspective of a pig...
"Well, I think I can hear your inner voice..." Oops! "Desire has been revealed!"Take a peek if you really want to—" Hey, wait a minute...!
I am willing to accept my animal-like needs (despite my shyness), and a life of being cared for by such an innocent girl. that, being a pig isn't that horrible, is it?
This story, or so it should be, describes our tremendous adventure.
But, Jess, why do people keep attempting to murder you?
2090146.originName: 豚のレバーは加熱しろ

2090240.title: A Playthrough of a Certain Dude's VRMMO Life
2090240.description:
Taichi Tanaka, a regular company employee who enjoys gaming, has entered the realm of "One More Free Life Online," a new sort of VRMMO with a great degree of freedom.

In a world where you can fight enemies with all your might or take risks at your leisure, he chose an unobtrusive gaming technique that required him to develop talents that were deemed useless!

He occasionally creates a slew of labor-intensive remedies, occasionally creates extremely tasty feasts, and occasionally creates incredible weapons with his own hands to enjoy hunting monsters!

Today, the humble uncle continues to forge his own path in the fantasy VRMMO!
2090240.originName: とあるおっさんのVRMMO活動記

2090295.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
2090295.description:
The account of the day after the heroic troop defeated the Demon King - the "after that" story.
Frieren, being a magician, is an elf who is distinct from the other three.
I have a different perspective on what it's like to live and feel in the "after" world...
Beginning with "The End of the Adventure," the remaining people in the world weave stories of funerals and prayers.

2090371.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent S2
2090371.description:
Sei, a 20-year-old office worker, is transported to a whole different universe. Unfortunately for Sei, the ceremony that summoned her—meant to generate a "Saint" who would dispel the bad magic—brought over two persons rather than one. And everyone likes the other girl to Sei?! But this is great with Sei, who quits the royal palace to open a shop selling potions and cosmetics made with her newly discovered power. Business is growing, and life may not be that awful after all...as long as her purported Sainthood doesn't come back to haunt her.
And in October 2023, the Season 2 is available!
2090371.originName: 聖女の魔力は万能です2

2090442.title: Berserk of Gluttony
2090442.description: Fate, the gate guard, is compelled to live at the bottom of a planet where talent quality is absolute. In summary, Fate's skill "Gluttony" merely makes people hungry and has no other consequence. However, everything changes as he accidentally kills a thief who has infiltrated the city. That's true, Fate's skill "Gluttony" holds an extraordinary power that can deprive opponents of their skills and powers. Fate's fate, which could only plummet to the ground, began to shift silently and fast.
2090442.originName: 暴食のベルセルク～俺だけレベルという概要を突発する～

2090572.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
2090572.description: "I won't let my loved ones die again now that I'm back!" The Shadow Labyrinth is the most terrible situation humanity has ever encountered. One of the six human survivors still alive is Desir Arman. The six made an effort to escape the last stage of the labyrinth, but finally were unsuccessful, and the world ended.
