But just when Desir believed he was going to die, the world is revealed to him. it was thirteen years ago? Desir is transported back in time to the period when he joined in Havrion, the best magic school in the country. In order to rescue the planet and his loved ones, he is ready to alter the history after being reunited with his cherished pals. There are still three years till the Shadow World appears. Change the past and assemble strong allies to save humanity!
2090572.originName: 帰還者の魔法は特別です

2090634.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me
2090634.description:
"I, I like you!" "Eh... you like me?"
Ryuto Kajima is a high school student with an odd attitude.
He also admired Runa Shirakawa, who made her love declaration while they were playing punishment games, and they were both at the top of the school hierarchy pyramid.
But I received a surprising response: "Well, I'm single now anyway."
and got serious about her.
Ryuto pursues Runa once more and overhears the attractive football club player confessing to her.
Runa, who had recently begun dating her, led her back to her room.
Live each day astounded by the contrasts between one other, accepting each other's days, whether they are two people with utterly dissimilar friends or pastimes. Then...the two grew up and gradually united.
This is where a heartwarming love tale starts for everyone who reads it!
2090634.originName: 経験済みなキミと、 経験ゼロなオレが、 お付き合いする話。

2090761.title: Ragna Crimson
2090761.description: Ragna, along with his partner, the strongest dragon hunter Leonica, is a dragon hunter. Despite his lack of skill in dragon hunting, he had made the decision to give her his entire life. He was nevertheless shown by his future self how true sadness would feel if he continued to be as weak as he is right now. The reaper of the dragons now appears to have emerged earlier than the original history, but will this be sufficient to alter the future?

2090858.title: My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer
2090858.description:
Belgrieve, who led an adventurous life in the countryside near his home, nurtured his daughter Angeline after discovering her in a forest and sent her to the city.
I learned that my daughter, who I hadn't seen in a while, was going to visit her hometown soon. However, she hasn't yet arrived, and as each day passed, my concern increased.
The guild's highest rank "S-Class" member, however, Angeline, longs to see her adored father again but wonders when she will be permitted to do so.
2090858.originName: 冒険者になりたいと都に出て行った娘がＳランクになってた

2091000.title: THE FARAWAY PALADIN　The Lord of the Rust Mountains
2091000.description:
A single human infant lives in a city of the dead, long since devastated and far from human civilization. Will is being raised by three undead: Blood, a lusty skeletal warrior, Mary, a graceful mummified priestess, and Gus, a crotchety spirit sorcerer. The three shower the boy with affection and teach him everything they know.
But one day, Will wonders, "Who am I?" Will must solve the riddles of this faraway dead man's country and uncover the undead's hidden histories. He must learn the good gods' kindness and mercy, as well as the bad gods' intolerance and craziness.
The youngster will start down the path toward becoming a Paladin once he has gained all of the necessary knowledge.

"As I had promised. I'll tell you everything, but it will take some time. This is the tale of the many heroes that perished. You were born here, and this is the tale of how we passed away.
2091000.originName: 最果てのパラディン 鉄錆の山の王

2091131.title: I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness
2091131.description:
I will teach you how to be happy from this point on, regardless of how unhappy you were in the past. But first, I have to raise you to be white and obese.
Allen, a magician who despises social interaction and lives in a remote area of the forest, is not only referred to as the "Devil King," but everyone in the area is also terrified of him.

Living alone, he once found his daughter Charlotte lying on the side of the road. She was falsely charged, she even regretted her marriage, and she escaped to this country from her native country.
Aaron thought back on his painful experience of being misled by a member he thought was his partner after hearing the entire tale.

Allen's decision was made after learning that she was only 17 years old and had been subjected to oppression.

Allow her to reside in your house and instill in her a variety of negative yet positive values.
2091131.originName: 婚約破棄された令嬢を拾った俺が、イケナイことを教え込む

2091236.title: Tearmoon Empire
2091236.description: The self-centered princess of the defunct Tearmoon Empire, Mia, looks at the dying sun for one final time before the guillotine blade descends while being surrounded by the hate-filled gazes of her people. only to return to consciousness as a 12-year-old! She embarks on a mission to make up for the numerous wrongs that plague the failing Empire when time is reversed and a second chance of life is presented to her. corrupt leadership? Check. Border issues? Check. Disasters caused by nature and economic unrest? Check. Wow, it sounds like a lot of work. Mia doesn't do well with hard work, so she enlists the help of others, starting with her dependable maid, Anne, and the wise pastor, Ludwig. They work together nonstop to rebuild the Empire. Their constant efforts gradually start to alter the flow of history, propelling the entire continent toward a different destiny. You may be wondering why the conceited princess changed her mind. It's easy—she didn't. She simply hates the guillotine. They hurt so bad, and Mia despises suffering more than she despises job.
2091236.originName: ティアムーン帝国物語〜断頭台から始まる、姫の転生 逆転ストーリー〜

2091313.title: Girlfriend, Girlfriend Season 2
2091313.description: Mukai Naoya has been in love with Saki Saki since elementary school, and he is overjoyed when she finally admits his feelings. However, one day, Minase Nagisa, a beautiful girl, confesses to him! Naoya decides to go out with both of them because she doesn't want to choose between them. What will happen to this morally ambiguous love triangle? What will happen in the second season?

2091388.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You
2091388.description: Aijou Rentarou has an excellent reputation among females but has never been able to find a girlfriend because every lady he had a crush on has categorically rejected him. Since junior high, he has gone through 100 heartbreaks. The other day, the Love God appears while Aijou prays in a shrine and predicts that she will meet 100 soulmates in high school. All the girls would pass away due to various bad circumstances if their connection with him fails. Aijou must now make the choice between love and death.
2091388.originName: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女

2091454.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S4
2091454.description: The monks used all available resources to pursue the three thousand ways of heaven throughout the era of popular scientific culture in order to catch a glimpse of the reality of heaven. The modern sword master Yi Jianchuan and his younger brother, the wicked sword god Chen Nanxuan, went in a completely different direction to seek the ultimate swordsmanship, one of the three thousand heavenly ways. Wang Ling is concerned with which heavenly road to follow today in order to have a serene daily existence, while the rest of the world is concerned with how to nurture a heavenly path.

2091582.title: Transcending the Nine Heavens
2091582.description:
Chu Yang ultimately falls victim to an ambush set up by specialists who are after the fragments of the Nine Tribulations Sword he has in his hands after spending a lifetime aiming for the top of the martial arts world. The one time he regretted leaving Mo Qing Wu, the only lady he had ever loved, was in his last moments. He wished he could have loved her more. Chu Yang was reincarnated as fate would have it in his sixteen-year-old body. When given a second opportunity, he is determined to alter his course and prevent Mo Qing Wu from dying too soon.
Reborn in order to honor a prior existence. For the benefit of martial arts, reborn. For the sake of the Nine Tribulations Sword, Chu Yang was under attack. Chu Yang was surrounded by looters and was so trapped. He unexpectedly returned to this world after 16 years between life and death. If given a second shot at life, he will rule the skies and traverse all nine of them.

2091717.title: Great Journey of Teenagers 3
2091717.description:
When rumors of a golden coffin began to circulate throughout the world following the strange death of Wangyou, Master of the Hanshui Temple, it set off conflicts within the martial arts community. Join a group of young people as they embark on an adventure to solve the mystery of the golden coffin, including Lei Wujie, Xiao Se, Tang Lian, Sikong Qianluo, and Heavenly Maiden Rui.
Youths and Golden Coffin 3, are waiting for you in October 2023.

2091834.title: The Invincible
2091834.description: The world was in disarray and the people were in grave difficulties in the desolation of Doomsday, the third year of King Shizong's rule. The Demon Gate Demon Party lurks in the shadows, wreaking havoc. The gangs attack each other, causing mayhem. Various sects developed one after the other in the pandemonium, battling for resources and territory and establishing their own control. There are ambitious people who want to rule the globe and create a dynasty, and there are good people who wish to help the common people. Wei He carries the realm-breaking bead, which allows him to travel through tumultuous periods and construct his own mythology step by step.

2091953.title: Spirits In Chinese Brushes
2091953.description: When the Epang Palace was burned to the ground two thousand years ago, the School of Naturalists' ancestors lamented that Qin Shihuang had degraded Confucians and burned books, saying that "if you don't teach the world, all the talents will be wasted." When the literati died, he started to concentrate their souls. To ensure that his skills are passed down to future generations, finish the Chinese brush. A normal college student named Luo Zhongxia accidently acquired Li Bai's Qinglian posthumous Chinese brush two thousand years later, and ever then, he has held the superpowers provided by the brush spirit. The happy times did not endure, however, as other forces were drawn to the potent influence of Qinglian's works, which frequently put Luo Zhongxia in danger. Luo Zhongxia dedicated himself to finding a way to retract his essay in order to prevent conflicts, but he kept running across roadblocks. He instead developed a strong bond with the "Seven Lords in charge of the city"...

2092089.title: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
2092089.description:
"...Huh? W-what?"
Terakomari, a young girl known as "Mari" who spends the day at home, gets elevated to the rank of imperial general when she wakes up!
Mari also commands a force that is brutal, bloodthirsty, and filled with criminality.
Mari was born into a well-known vampire family, but she cannot utilize magic, has motor issues, and isn't tall enough due to her hatred of blood.
When she was at her wits' end, her (alleged) trusted maid Villhaze offered this advice: "Plz leave it to me. I'll see to it that they don't misunderstand!"
Mari wins numerous conflicts by using bluff and good fortune, and a happy fantasy tale is born!
Despite spending the entire day at home, Mari is "a kid who can do anything if he works hard"?
2092089.originName: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々

2092228.title: THE LITTLE MASTER'S BETTER LIFE
2092228.description: Humans are little, but not inferior, in the wild. They are all putting in a lot of effort and growing rapidly in their own ways, whether it be Shennong and his people in the human sphere or the many clans in Beiye. Despite being bewitched and restrained by the Star God, he would mount a tenacious resistance against the Star God in order to safeguard his tribe, family, and blood in the tribe.

2092348.title: Thirty-six Cavalry
2092348.description: Emperor Ming of the Han Dynasty gave Ban Chao, a member of the Shi Family, the bronze swallow talisman and instructed him to travel to the Western Regions in search of the golden Buddha he had dreamed of as well as the secret to immortality. Ban Chao looked for 36 people, including the masters who were hiding in the capital, the Mo family's descendants, the Pirates' descendants, and the Gu master of Yelang who was traveling with him. Along with granting the emperor's wish, he also sought to learn the history of the Shi family and identify the murderer who had falsely accused his father.

2092542.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 3
2092542.description:
University student Naofumi Iwatani is called to the other realm as one of the Four Holy Bravehearts, the "Brave of the Shield".
He struggled with his allies to protect people from the "wave" of catastrophes that threatened the globe, despite being prosecuted for many transgressions.
The queen questions whether the Spirit Tortoise has been revived due to odd events like the bat familiars and the Four Cardinal Heroes. Gradually, the tranquility began to be disturbed.
What can be done to stop this beast that has caused such great harm? How can the person who forcibly awoke the spirit tortoise be found? The journey of Naofumi Iwatani never ends!
2092542.originName: 盾の勇者の成り上がり3

2092663.title: Berserk of Gluttony(Thai Dub)
2092663.description: Fate, the gate guard, is compelled to live at the bottom of a planet where talent quality is absolute. In summary, Fate's skill "Gluttony" merely makes people hungry and has no other consequence. However, everything changes as he accidentally kills a thief who has infiltrated the city. That's true, Fate's skill "Gluttony" holds an extraordinary power that can deprive opponents of their skills and powers. Fate's fate, which could only plummet to the ground, began to shift silently and fast.
2092663.originName: 暴食のベルセルク～俺だけレベルという概要を突発する～

2092788.title: I Shall Survive Using Potions!
2092788.description:
One night after Kaoru Nagase abruptly passed away while returning home from her office job, she finds herself in front of a white-clad man. The man identifies himself as God and expresses regret for the error that led to her premature death. He promises to make it up to Kaoru by reincarnating her in a different planet. The goddess of the next world, Celestine, repairs Kaoru's body and grants her all the requests she makes, including, among other things, the body she had when she was 15 years old, the capacity to create potions with specific effects, and a box with limitless storage.
However, Kaoru soon discovers that, unlike what she had been told, this new medieval world lacked much in the way of magic, making her potions highly sought after by rapacious nobility. She could, however, be able to use her potions to survive in this world by drawing on the information she gained from her prior existence.
2092788.originName: ポーションたのみで生き延びます

2092885.title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions
2092885.description: Totomaru Isshiki aspires to investigate murders and help people despite his lack of abilities for his post on the Metropolitan Police Department investigating squad. He goes out to recruit the help of the reclusive Ron Kamonohashi on the advise of one of his seniors. Ron was the most promising detective from the prestigious Detective Training Academy Blue five years ago, but he faded into obscurity for reasons unknown to the world... ...
2092885.originName: 鴨乃橋ロンの禁断推理

2093006.title: The Family Circumstances of the Imbalanced Witch
2093006.description: A baby abandoned by its parents was discovered by a small, witch named Alissa who has been living alone in the forest. She chose to raise the child and give her the name Viola. 16 years later, Viola has gotten so much bigger than her adoptive mother that anyone would mistake their relationship. The narrative follows Alissa, Viola, and those nearby as they lead peculiar daily lives!!!
2093006.originName: でこぼこ魔女の親子事情

2093085.title: Shangri-La Frontier (Thai Dub)
2093085.description: Gaming on a monitor is out of date, and immersive VR games are already widely available. The market is overrun with "trash games," which are games that have superb imaging technology but whose systems can't keep up, in contrast to the extremely few masterpieces. And then there are those (perverts) who simply like engaging in this sort of "trash trick" that is detested by the general populace. One of them—the "trash trick hunter"—is Rakur Hizutome. Rakur Hizutome attacked the masterpiece "Shangri-La Frontier" this time in an effort to alter his taste. He had numerous weird adventures and met many different partners while playing the game, and that is where the job started.
2093085.originName: シャングリラ・フロンティア〜クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす〜

2093234.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 2 (Thai Dub)
2093234.description:
Corrupt politicians, fervent nationalists, and other warmongering elements regularly undermine the fragile peace between Ostania and Westalis. Regardless of their designs, renowned spy and master of disguise "Twilight" completes risky missions one after the other in the hope that no kid will have to witness the horrors of war.

Twilight assumes the alias "Loid Forger," an esteemed psychiatrist, in the bustling Ostanian city of Berlint. His genuine purpose, however, is to gather intelligence on important politician Donovan Desmond, who only appears in public on rare occasions at his son's school, the elite Eden Academy. Loid enacts his master plan by enlisting the services of unmarried city hall clerk Yor Briar as his wife and adopting the curious six-year-old orphan Anya as his daughter. He'll enroll Anya in Eden Academy, where he expects she'll succeed and allow him to see Donovan without raising suspicions.

Unfortunately for Loid, even a man of his abilities struggles to portray the role of a loving father and spouse. And, just as Loid is keeping his true identity hidden, Yor—an underground assassin known as "Thorn Princess"—and Anya—an esper who can read people's minds—have no plans to reveal their own. Despite the fact that their picture-perfect family is built on lie, the Forgers gradually realize that their love for one another is more important than anything else. Now let's stay tuned for the Season 2!

2093311.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End (Thai Dub)
2093311.description:
The account of the day after the heroic troop defeated the Demon King - the "after that" story.
Frieren, being a magician, is an elf who is distinct from the other three.
I have a different perspective on what it's like to live and feel in the "after" world...
Beginning with "The End of the Adventure," the remaining people in the world weave stories of funerals and prayers.

2093414.title: THE KINGDOMS OF RUIN
2093414.description: In the wake of the “Gear Expansion era”, witches, who once bestowed their wisdom and magic upon humanity, are now hunted down. They are deemed as obstacles to the advancement of society by the new scientific civilization. Among the great purge of all witches, Chloe, who had tutored a human boy named Adonis, met her tragic end. Bereaved of his beloved mentor, Adonis is consumed by despair and hatred towards humanity. But on his road of vengeance, where would his “salvation” lie?

2093524.title: Am I Actually the Strongest? (Thai Dub)
2093524.description:
I, a Hikikomori, was suddenly reincarnated into a prince in a different realm, but because of my weak magical abilities, I was doomed to die on my very first day of existence.

I came upon a huge creature right when I thought I was alone in the far-off forest.

I attempted to use magic to fight the monster in order to defend myself, but for some reason, the monster changed into a gorgeous female and even became my servant!

In a daze, I became a "Devil King" and began a new harem life!

2093577.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Slime: Visions of Coleus
2093577.description: Rimuru completes a unique task that Yuuki Kagurazaka assigns him. The struggle for the throne among the royal family has started as the King of the Kingdom of Coleus is getting older. First Prince Sauzer, supported by the nobles, and Second Prince Aslan, supported by the local Free Guild branch that has turned rogue and pledged allegiance to him, are the leading contenders. Rimuru must go undercover as the Great Phantom Thief Satoru to enter the Kingdom of Coleus and handle the situation while also revealing a plot that is simmering beneath the surface...
2093577.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 コリウスの梦

2093692.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (2nd Half)
2093692.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2093692.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season 完結編（後編）

2093782.title: Demon Slayer: Brother and Sister's Bond
2093782.description: Despite his father's death, Tanjiro used to live harmoniously with his family. However, one day, he finds his family slaughtered and his sister Nezuko Kamado, who was the only survivor, is turned into a Demon. Ever since, Tanjiro is determined to embark on a journey to avenge the death of his family and restore his sister's humanity.
2093782.originName: 鬼滅の刃 特別編集版 兄妹の絆

2093890.title: Demon Slayer: Asakusa Arc
2093890.description: After joining the Demon Slayer Corps, Tanjiro ventures to Asakusa, Tokyo for his second mission. On his journey, he encounters two powerful demons who are sent to kill him and claim to be serving Muzan, who is responsible for the tragedy that happened to Tanjiro's family.
2093890.originName: 鬼滅の刃 特別編集版 浅草編

2093946.title: Demon Slayer: Tsuzumi Mansion Arc
2093946.description: Tanjiro ventures south-southeast and encounters a cowardly young man named Zenitsu. They arrive at a mountain where they are assigned to investigate a mysterious house that is rumored to be haunted by demons. Being entrapped in this mansion, what and who will they be faced with?
2093946.originName: 鬼滅の刃 特別編集版 鼓屋敷編

2094005.title: Demon Slayer: Mt.Natagumo Arc
2094005.description: Teamed up with Zenitsu and Inosuke, Tanjiro is assigned to investigate the mountain Natagumo, which is rumored to be dominated by demons. During their exploration, they gradually find out that they have already stepped into the territory of the spider-shaped demon family...
2094005.originName: 鬼滅の刃 特別編集版 那田蜘蛛山編

2094085.title: Demon Slayer: The Hashira Meeting Arc
2094085.description: After the fight on Mt.Natagumo, Tanjiro Kamado and his sister Nezuko, who is a demon, are captured by the Demon Slayer Hashira, the top warriors of the Demon Slayer Corps. Tanjiro is put on trial for breaking the rules of the corps by traveling with a demon and fighting alongside her. To demonstrate his innocence, he must prove that Nezuko is not a threat to humans and that he is determined to turn her human again.
2094085.originName: 鬼滅の刃 特別編集版 柱合会議・蝶屋敷編

2094139.title: The Eternal Strife
2094139.description: In an attempt to understand the fundamentals of martial arts, a common young man in a small town is duped by someone, goes through a terrible romantic relationship, and becomes embroiled in a disagreement within the martial arts community. Others wrong him because of who he is. He sets off on a quest to battle the heavens while fighting to survive and gradually regains memories of his past existence. He gains the most priceless love and the deepest friendship along this journey. He endures innumerable hardships and the possibility of dying, yet he never wavers from who he is. No matter how formidable his opponents are, he never backs down in his struggle for justice, himself, and his destiny.

2094245.title: My Hero Academia UA Heroes Battle
2094245.description: My Hero Academia UA Heroes Battle
2094245.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア「雄英ヒーローズ・バトル」

2094301.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure(Thai Dub)
2094301.description: At the end of the 19th century, the British aristocrat Jonathan Josda was a teenager who aimed at the spirit of a gentleman; Dior (DIO), who was born in the lower class, was a handsome man who tried to seize Josda's property and pretended to be a good person outside. After he was adopted as an adopted son, Jonathan was persecuted everywhere. In order to defeat DIO, who was turned into a vampire by accidentally obtaining a mysterious stone ghost mask, Jonathan learns immortality-ripple qigong from a myst
2094301.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険

2094410.title: One Piece: Jango's Dance Carnival
2094410.description: On the pursuit of Jango, a hypnotist, the Marines also encounter the Straw Hat Pirates on the Mirror Ball Island. To get rid of the Marines, Jango imposes his powerful hypnosis on a giant disco ball. However, the power of his hypnosis turns out to be uncontrollable, making everybody on the island start to dance the night away...
2094410.originName: ONE PIECE ジャンゴのダンスカーニバル

2094552.title: one piece Dream Soccer King!
2094552.description: To stand out in the legendary competition of the Grand Line Cup, soccer- lovers assembled from all over the world, and the two teams that enter the final are Monkey D. Luffy's Straw Hat Pirates and Buggy's Villain All-Stars. Competing fiercely, the two teams fight to draw, so the game goes to a penalty shootout. In this cruel shootout, who will eventually be the winner?
2094552.originName: ONE PIECE 夢のサッカー王!

2094678.title: One Piece: Take Aim! The Pirate Baseball King
2094678.description: The Pirate Baseball King kicks off on a huge baseball stadium ship and is announced by Bon Clay and Buggy. As the major challenger, Luffy's Straw Hat Pirates are now confronting the Fish-men Pirates led by Arlong. In the face of countless tricks and enemies' skills, will Luffy's team be able to defeat Arlong's team?
2094678.originName: ONE PIECE めざせ!海賊野球王

2094739.title: ONE PIECE 3D! Trap Coaster
2094739.description: Luffy continues his grand adventure with the Straw Hat Pirates. However, his joyous journey takes an unexpected turn when he encounters Captain Trap, one of the most cunning officers in the Marines. The captain, who is determined to capture Luffy, sets up various dangerous traps he designed on the Thousand Sunny in order to send them to the prison.
2094739.originName: ONE PIECE 3D 激走!トラップコースター

2094874.title: An Angel Flew Down to Me! Precious Friends
2094874.description: Hana, Hinata, Noa, Koyori, and Kanon are getting along together as usual and having a friendly sweets party at home with Miyako's homemade sweets. While they are having fun, the flower-shaped cookies remind the hair ornaments granted to her by her grandmother. Therefore, they decide to visit Hana’s grandmother’s house together, as a practice for their upcoming school trip. This marks the beginning of their first-ever group outing, promising a heartwarming adventure filled with friendship and nostalgia.
2094874.originName: 私に天使が舞い降りた！プレシャス・フレンズ

2095013.title: The Eminence In Shadow 2nd Season (Thai Dub)
2095013.description:
Cid Kagenou is not one of those people who aspires to be heroic heroes or terrible villains. He wants to be the actual mastermind, the one who controls everything and plots the entire scheme. In his previous life in present-day Japan, he was unable to accomplish his goals. But now that he has been revived in a fantastical realm, he will show off the true power of the night!

Cid recruits members for his (fake) group Shadow Garden, which seeks to dismantle the mysterious cult that hides in the shadows, while assuming the persona of an everyday mobster. With a lot of improv, Cid leads his (fantasy) group in battle against the evil Diabolos Cult, which turns out to be unexpectedly real. Let's stay tuned for the 2nd Season!
2095013.originName: 陰の実力者になりたくて！ 2nd season

2095155.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Slime: Visions of Coleus (Thai Dub)
2095155.description: Rimuru completes a unique task that Yuuki Kagurazaka assigns him. The struggle for the throne among the royal family has started as the King of the Kingdom of Coleus is getting older. First Prince Sauzer, supported by the nobles, and Second Prince Aslan, supported by the local Free Guild branch that has turned rogue and pledged allegiance to him, are the leading contenders. Rimuru must go undercover as the Great Phantom Thief Satoru to enter the Kingdom of Coleus and handle the situation while also revealing a plot that is simmering beneath the surface...
2095155.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 コリウスの梦

2095224.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (Dub Indo)
2095224.description: At the end of the 19th century, the British aristocrat Jonathan Josda was a teenager who aimed at the spirit of a gentleman; Dior (DIO), who was born in the lower class, was a handsome man who tried to seize Josda's property and pretended to be a good person outside. After he was adopted as an adopted son, Jonathan was persecuted everywhere. In order to defeat DIO, who was turned into a vampire by accidentally obtaining a mysterious stone ghost mask, Jonathan learns immortality-ripple qigong from a myst
2095224.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険

2095338.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (Dub Indo)
2095338.description: The year is 1987 and 17-year-old Jotaro Kujo finds himself suddenly plagued by a ghost-like entity. Jotaro’s grandfather Joseph Joestar, a veteran of a fight to save humanity fifty years prior, arrives with his own supernatural aura and explains that this power, known as a “Stand,” physically manifests its user’s spirit and can be controlled by its user at will. The sudden emergence of these Stands is revealed to be caused by the revival of the megalomaniacal vampire DIO (the Joestar’s longtime enemy) whose awakening from his century-long slumber has triggered Stands to awaken down the Joestar family line, including in Jotaro’s mother whose uncontrollable Stand will ultimately kill her in a few weeks’ time. Jotaro, Joseph, and their allies have fifty days to locate DIO (using their Stands to thwart DIO’s network of devoted Stand-user minions along the way) and eliminate DIO himself in order to save Jotaro’s mother and prevent DIO’s ambitions of world domination.
2095338.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スターダストクルセイダース

2095415.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable (Dub Indo)
2095415.description: It's the year 1999, 11 years after Jotaro Kujo's desperate fight against Dio in Egypt. Jotaro meets with Josuke Higashikata, the illegitimate son of his grandfather Joseph Joestar. He discovers that Josuke also has the same "Stand" power and that a new threat is surfacing in Morioh City.
2095415.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 ダイヤモンドは砕けない

2095491.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind (Dub Indo)
2095491.description: Fresh from surviving his adventures in Morioh, Stand user and Joestar ally Koichi Hirose is touching down in Naples, Italy to discover a man known as Haruno Shiobana, who may well be the inheritor of a truly terrifying legacy. Though he now calls himself Giorno Giovanna and makes a living from petty thievery, there is no mistaking the regal bearing and cunning that mark his bloodline, or the natural Stand affinity that he's already begun to harness. Whatever he may call himself, Giorno Giovanna's parentage mark him as a true threat - for he is the son of Dio Brando, and no son of Dio could possibly live quietly on this earth.
2095491.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 黄金の風

2095613.title: Metallic Rouge
2095613.description:
In this universe, people and artificial humans coexist.
One day, Rouge, the android girl, and her partner Naomi were assigned to a mission to Mars.
The mission's objective is to "kill 9 androids who are hostile to the government."
So begins the war saga of the robotic female Rouge.

2095663.title: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside Season 2
2095663.description:
Season 2 is incoming! Welcome to the countryside~
Red used to be a part of the Hero's Party, a formidable organization that defended the planet from the terrible forces of the ferocious Demon Lord Taraxon. That is, until he was expelled by one of his allies. Red's new objective is to open a pharmacy in the hopes of leading a simple life on the frontier. But maintaining the anonymity of his past life might be more difficult than he imagines. especially when the lovely Lit, his former adventurer, turns around and wishes to move in with him!
Let's stay tuned for the new stories!
2095663.originName: 真の仲間じゃないと勇者のパーティーを追い出されたので、辺境でスローライフすることにしました 第2期

2095811.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered
2095811.description:
The Sage who brought Yogiri Takatou's school bus to another planet demonstrates to the children how terrible both the world and she are by murdering the adults for trivial reasons and instructing them to become sages in order to battle demons. She leaves the others to perish, taking only the skilled. 
Yogiri seeks to return with his classmate Tomochika Dannora, but Tomochika becomes uneasy due to Yogiri's indifference to the strangeness. Yogiri is actually not your typical child; he has the ability to willfully kill everything.
2095811.originName: 即死チートが最強すぎて、異世界のやつらがまるで相手にならないんですが。

2095912.title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
2095912.description: Usato, Kazuki, and Suzune are transported to another dimension. However, it was Kazuki and Suzune who were hailed as heroes, leaving Usato in the midst. Usato, who has learned healing magic, is assigned to the Lifesaving Team. The lifeguards, on the other hand, train their bodies while repairing their own wounds with healing magic, and utilize their trained bodies to sprint around the battlefield quicker than anyone else, taking in and treating injured individuals and, in certain cases, eradicating the sources of injuries on their own. That was the desire of a group of brain muscles.
2095912.originName: 治療魔法の間違った使い方

2095969.title: A Sign of Affection
2095969.description: Yuki Itose is a university student with hearing loss whose entire life has been silent. With the exception of Rin Fujishiro, her best friend, she has spent her entire life in the same home. One day, while commuting, she runs upon Rin's common acquaintance, the multilingual and silver-haired Itsuomi Nagi. When Itsuomi finds out about Yuki's disability, unlike most others, he doesn't waver; this, together with his travels overseas, intrigues and moves her. Her affection for him begins to blossom after they separate ways. As Yuki and Itsuomi get to know one another and their disparate lifestyles, a whole new world starts to open up for them.

2096070.title: URUSEI YATSURA S2
2096070.description: The lecherous Ataru Moroboshi is unremarkable, yet his extremely bad luck stands out like the horns on an alien's head. When Earth is attacked by a fleet of Oni alien invaders, Ataru is chosen to represent humanity in a combat with one of them. It's a stroke of luck for Ataru that the duel is actually a game of tag, and that his opponent is Lum, the daughter of the Oni's chief, who prioritizes her own pride over winning—as Ataru discovers by taking Lum's bikini top and thus victory. And now comes the S2, the story goes on...
2096070.originName: うる星やつら　後半

2096149.title: Sasaki and Peeps
2096149.description: Sasaki, a regular company employee (a wage slave) who is nearly forty years old and relatively unnoticed, was persuaded by his colleagues who had pets and chose to maintain dogs. He acquired a Java sparrow Peeps after meeting it unexpectedly in a pet store. Peeps, on the other hand, is the reincarnation of a sage from another world with the unique capacity to speak with people. As a result, Sasaki and Peeps started a new story about traveling between the other worlds and the real world.

2096264.title: Ringing Fate
2096264.description: This is a young girl's story. She is naive and enquisitive about the world. However, a tragic accident altered her life. Her loved ones abandoned her, leaving her alone and despondent. She adopted boxing as a means of expressing her inner pain. But she had no idea how tough and hazardous this journey would be.

2096339.title: No. 7 West Mars St.
2096339.description: Tickets were in low supply during the intergalactic Spring Festival travel surge. To get to Earth for an interview, comic artist Li Ha had to take an interplanetary cab that couldn't even close the door. Accidents occurred regularly on this trip due to an unusual combination of circumstances, and Li Ha unexpectedly married his beloved wife and gave birth to two children in one day. They are Damei, the eldest sister who is roving the galaxy, Nana, the Iron Fist girl, and Xiaodang, the robot. This wonderful life lasted ten years. As a mystery family member of an interplanetary agent, he frequently irritates alien weirdos, forcing them to repeatedly tumble into catastrophic dilemmas.

2096429.title: The Unwanted Undead Adventurer
2096429.description: Adventurer Rentt Faina, 25, has spent the last ten years chipping away at creatures. Despite his lack of skill for the position, Rentt finds himself in the Labyrinth of the Moon's Reflection, where he stumbles onto an apparently unexplored passage. At the end of the path, though, is a fabled dragon that quickly devours him whole! A little while later, Rentt wakes up to discover that he is nothing more than a pile of bones—not quite dead, but also not particularly alive! Rentt, a newly reborn Skeleton, sets off on a mission to accomplish Existential Evolution with nothing but his trusty sword, tool belt, and gothic new appearance in the hopes of eventually returning to civilization in a more human form.

2096556.title: Blue Exorcist -Shimane Illuminati Saga-
2096556.description:
The third season will focus on the enigmatic Illuminati society, who have ties to demons. The ultimate aim of this cheerful organization is to bring Satan back to life, but in the interim, they are experimenting on human zombies and creating an elixir that can bring demons back to life anywhere in the world. The strongest Demon is Lucifer, also known as the King of Light. Still, the abilities of a certain ExWire must be forced in order to create the ideal potion.
At the conclusion of Ao no Exorcist Season 2, Rin's brother Yukio defeated the demonic Illuminati agent, while their member, the treacherous Saburota Todou, departed in an ashed form due to his regenerative powers. It's possible that Yukio received his powers from his father, Satan, but he kept this information from Rin and the ExWires.
2096556.originName: 青の祓魔師　島根啓明結社篇

2096674.title: Mob Psycho 100 Ⅲ (Thai Dub)
2096674.description: Shigeo Kageyama, a regular second-year middle school student, was dubbed a "Mob" due to his feeble presence, but he actually possesses a potent natural superpower. Mob started to believe that their superpowers were dangerous after each growth. Mob has been unconsciously repressing their emotions in order to prevent superpowers from becoming out of control. Even though all he wanted was to go about his daily business as usual, problems of every description kept happening to him.

2096817.title: Mob Psycho 100 Ⅲ(Dub Indo)
2096817.description: Shigeo Kageyama, a regular second-year middle school student, was dubbed a "Mob" due to his feeble presence, but he actually possesses a potent natural superpower. Mob started to believe that their superpowers were dangerous after each growth. Mob has been unconsciously repressing their emotions in order to prevent superpowers from becoming out of control. Even though all he wanted was to go about his daily business as usual, problems of every description kept happening to him.

2096950.title: Chained Soldier
2096950.description: Yuuki Wakura observes the destruction of Earth by opposing supernatural forces. Mato serve as entry points to alternate dimensions and as routes for dangerous monsters to flee. Women are given peaches as resources, which endows them with abilities. Kyouka Uzen, the chief of the Anti-Demon Corp's Seventh Unity, shows in to save Yuuki from a monster. Unexpectedly, Yuuki has the ability to boost the Peaches' potency. However, Yuuki has to be prepared to serve Kyouka both at home and on the battlefield if she is to save the planet.

2097049.title: Fairies Albums 4
2097049.description:
The story still goes on.
This narrative described the experiences of Tao Yao, Mo Ya, and Childe Liu during their tour in JingShi. It suggested that the gaps between people and between people and fairies might not be as great as people thought. Whether it was through Tao Yao's relationship with Ding Sansi, Old Zhang's advice to Childe Liu regarding life mistakes and cooking techniques, or Mo Ya's predicament when confronted by Xi Nang, these experiences allowed each of them to mature. Concurrently, Feng Wule, Chen Baishui, and additional individuals also achieved their personal atonement. It's possible that everyone has an impact on one another throughout life's path, in all of its flavors.
Please stay tuned for the 4th season!

2097184.title: The Richest Man in Game
2097184.description: A special reporter recently held an exclusive interview with Tenda Group President Pei Qian. Tenda Group's present capitalization exceeds $100 billion, and its operations span games, the Internet, digital devices, cultural media, catering, and other industries that have drastically altered people's lives. However, when questioned by reporters, Pei Qian stated, "I'm not a business wizard."My achievement is entirely due to chance! My initial goal was to simply lose 50,000 yuan. That's all..."

2097299.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2
2097299.description:
Kyoutaro Ichikawa may look to be your average middle schooler, but his heart is filled with violent thoughts. It's not unexpected that Anna Yamada, the class idol, is continually on his mind as the person he most wants to kill. While reading alone in his favorite school library, he unwittingly starts a meeting with Yamada, and she shows up to discreetly feast on her favorite candies and sweets. Ichikawa learns from their chats how much of a jerk Yamada is and is obliged to cheer her on from the sidelines. Yamada herself can't stop teasing Ichikawa due of his furious answers. As a result of a number of touching daily experiences, the two's remote connection grows into something more than just library acquaintances. Ichikawa may soon realize that his violent fantasies have evolved into something entirely else.
Now season 2 is coming soon!
2097299.originName: 僕の心のヤバイやつ 第2期

2097389.title: Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki 2nd Stage
2097389.description:
The top player from Japan in the online game Attack Families, also referred to as "Tackfam," is Fumiya Tomozaki. Even with such a noble title, he struggles in his regular high school life due to a lack of friendliness and social skills. He claims that the complicated rules and unjust mechanics of life are to blame for his lack of friends, which forces him to give up and declare himself to be a lowly character in this "game."

Fumiya is horrified to learn the true identity of another elite Tackfam player, Aoi Hinami, a popular, intelligent, and gregarious classmate who is the exact antithesis of himself, after a fateful meeting. Aoi chooses to help Fumiya win what she refers to as the "greatest game of them all" after being shocked by how terrible he is at everything save Tackfam. Through the horrific experiences of relationships and social interactions, Fumiya starts moving up the ranks in the magnificent game of life.

Let's see what interesting story would happen in 2nd stage.
2097389.originName: 弱キャラ友崎くん 2nd Stage

2097469.title: The Witch and the Beast
2097469.description: The city where "witches" gather people's worhship is the stage. A man carrying a coffin and a female with eyes like a beast appeared. "Witches" are their prey! And not a single thing more. The famine-stricken "beast" and the malevolent "witch" square off in a spectacular and intense combat!

2097526.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady With the Lamp
2097526.description:
Among Korean surgeons, Dr. Song Jihyun is revered as a genius for her ability to save patients in any state. In her previous existence, as the ill-tempered emperor's wife Elise de Clorance, her greed and jealousy had caused her to lose loved ones and, finally, to die. She promised herself that from now on, she would save lives rather than take them.

Following a catastrophic aircraft accident, Elise finds herself back in her old body. With this life's opportunity to atone for her past transgressions and her prior understanding of contemporary medicine, she is resolved to serve the empire as a physician. Elise had loved Prince Linden de Romanoff to the point of her own death, but would she be able to escape getting engaged to him?

2097613.title: The Demon Prince of Momochi House
2097613.description: Momochi Himari, an orphan, unexpectedly inherits the old Momochi family land on her 16th birthday. Despite the warnings of the house being haunted, she decides to move there regardless because she has nowhere else to go. When she arrives, she discovers that the house is unlawfully occupied by three gorgeous young guys named Aoi, Yukari, and Ise. The three promptly warn the unsuspecting Himari that she must leave the house as soon as possible, citing the ghosts and curses, but she refuses to leave. She soon learns that what she had been told was true: her house seemed to sit on the boundary between the spirit and human realms, and she had been meant to serve as their protector, but Aoi had already assumed that responsibility.
2097613.originName: 百千さん家のあやかし王子

2097690.title: Pon no Michi
2097690.description: After being ejected from her home, Nashiko Jippensha, a high school student in Onomichi City, Hiroshima Prefecture, found herself in danger. She stated, "I don't have a place to hang out with my friends..." Naoko made the decision to renovate her father's former parlor into a gathering spot as soon as she discovered it was empty.

2097804.title: Kingdom Season 5
2097804.description:
The conflict for Koku You Hill and the Qin vs. Zhao army are seen in the fifth season.
General Kan Ki is the commander-in-chief in this fight, with Shin and the Hi Shin Unit taking part as reinforcements.
What sort of combat will Shin and the Hi Shin Unit engage in with the Kan Ki Army, and can they prevail over Zhao in that conflict?

2097863.title: Solo Leveling
2097863.description: In a world where humans with special talents known as hunters must fight deadly creatures to save humanity from probable extinction, Sung Jinwoo, a famously weak hunter, finds himself in an apparently never-ending battle for survival. A mysterious program known as the System selects him as its lone player one day after he barely survives an incredibly strong double dungeon that almost wipes out his entire party. In exchange, the System grants him the incredibly rare ability to level up in strength and turn anyone he kills into a devoted minion known as a shadow. Jinwoo then embarks on a quest to learn the truth about the origins of his talents and the mysteries of the dungeons, facing out against a variety of human and monster foes.
2097863.originName: 俺だけレベルアップな件

2097987.title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- Season 2
2097987.description:
Makoto Misumi, an ordinary high school guy called to another world as a hero, is the subject of this fantasy. Unfortunately, the Goddess of the World derisively referred to him as "so ugly face," stripped him of his title, and sent him to the wilderness's most remote reaches.
Makoto encountered dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves, and a variety of other non-human species while exploring the forest. Makoto now possesses amazing magical and martial abilities as a result of environmental variations from his native world. As a result, he survives in this realm while dealing with a variety of situations. The curtain opens on a boy abandoned by gods and humans in an alternate-world social reform fantasy...
Season 2 will be available in January, stay tuned!
2097987.originName: 月が導く異世界道中 第二幕

2098042.title: Tales of Wedding Rings
2098042.description: Ten years ago, Satou fell in love with Hime, his neighbor and childhood friend, after they unexpectedly appeared with her grandfather. She's a stunning, mysterious high school beauty now, and she makes it harder and harder for him to admit his love. When their first-anniversary approaches, will he have the guts to make their friendship more than just a friendship? Or will this close-knit couple meet a very different end?

2098140.title: The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil
2098140.description:
A demon named Akutsu Masatora has gained access to a human high school. His mission is to locate potential allies for Hell to battle the angels of Heaven, their natural adversaries. Taking a seat next to Lily Amane, a recent transfer student, Akutsu is drawn to her attractiveness and chooses to enlist her in his mission.

However, Lily is more complex than meets the eye, and Akutsu may have been romantically involved with her in addition to finding himself an accomplice to one of the same adversaries he is meant to vanquish.
2098140.originName: 愚かな天使は悪魔と踊る

2098275.title: The Strongest Tank’s Labyrinth Raids-A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero’s Party-
2098275.description:
Rud, the tank with a record-breaking [9999] defense value, serves as the valiant team's shield as it sets out to conquer the maze.
This is an expedition to uncover the famous secret treasure that may grant any wish and cure Manicia's ailment.
Rud, however, was kicked off the team due to the hero's hubris. The explanation is that "Rud's skills are of no use at all."

On the journey back home, the girl he saved revealed skills that even he was unaware of. That is a highly powerful ability! The adventure story of the strongest tank Rud begins under the safety of [Highest Defense Value 9999] and [Unique Skills]!
2098275.originName: 最強タンクの迷宮攻略

2098363.title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
2098363.description: At thirty, Ando is still a virgin—and thanks to that, he’s been granted an unremarkable magic: the ability to read the thoughts of anyone he touches. One day, he happens to eavesdrop on the mind of his handsome coworker, Kurosawa. To his surprise, Kurosawa has long harbored deep affection for him—what?! Thanks to this strange magic, the cool, suave guy’s love for the awkward virgin seems ready to spill out. A 200% pure love story begins!
2098363.originName: 30歳まで童貞だと魔法使いになれるらしい

2098427.title: Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss but I'm Not the Demon Lord
2098427.description:
In the Varschein Kingdom, black hair is stigmatized to an abnormal degree, according to an otome RPG. Eumiella Dolkness is the count's daughter, despised from birth due to her pitch-black hair—and she is also the hidden boss! Eumiella, at the age of five, recalls recollections of her previous life in Japan. Uninterested in the original game's romance, she devotes herself to mastering her uncommon dark-type magic.
Eumiella has clear objectives despite this: she wants to avoid taking the stage and avoid being the unseen boss. But when she discovers that she is a level 99 student at the magic academy, it rocks the kingdom to its core. Her powers are unrivaled, and when combined with her striking black hair, she stands out like a sore thumb in both physical combat and magical dueling. Worse, the original heroine starts to believe she is the demon lord! Is the stoic aristocratic girl going to get her wish of a quiet life fulfilled?
2098427.originName: 悪役令嬢レベル99 ～私は裏ボスですが魔王ではありません～

2098526.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (Thai Dub)
2098526.description: The year is 1987 and 17-year-old Jotaro Kujo finds himself suddenly plagued by a ghost-like entity. Jotaro’s grandfather Joseph Joestar, a veteran of a fight to save humanity fifty years prior, arrives with his own supernatural aura and explains that this power, known as a “Stand,” physically manifests its user’s spirit and can be controlled by its user at will. The sudden emergence of these Stands is revealed to be caused by the revival of the megalomaniacal vampire DIO (the Joestar’s longtime enemy) whose awakening from his century-long slumber has triggered Stands to awaken down the Joestar family line, including in Jotaro’s mother whose uncontrollable Stand will ultimately kill her in a few weeks’ time. Jotaro, Joseph, and their allies have fifty days to locate DIO (using their Stands to thwart DIO’s network of devoted Stand-user minions along the way) and eliminate DIO himself in order to save Jotaro’s mother and prevent DIO’s ambitions of world domination.
2098526.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スターダストクルセイダース

2098674.title: Time Limit
2098674.description: Shen Xiao Xiao confesses to her crush Chen Kai and gets rejected. You Li has doubts about her boyfriend Bai Zi. The two frustrated girls join a "time limit match and date" campaign, where they get mismatched to each other's partner. Now the big question is, who is whose true Mr. Right?

2098809.title: The Battle of the Thousand Kings
2098809.description: King of the casino world, Lin Jia Tai's quick success attracts the jealousy of his peers, who falsely accuse him and send him to jail. After facing much toil and humiliation, his grand return becomes the story of a legend among legends.

2098948.title: Lost in the Stars
2098948.description: A beautiful lady with a mysterious past is here for her revenge. Abandoned by her wealthy ex-husband, she changes her face and returns once again.

2099038.title: Boss and the Bird
2099038.description:
Yun Xin is a spoiled rich girl with a princess complex, so her guardian god curses her to transform into a bird at every sunset to teach her a lesson. To lift the curse, she has to reach 3 goals in 3 months, or she will turn into a bird forever:
1, Be kind, act kind
2, Be grateful and think of others
3, Get a true love's kiss from Mr. Right
Desperate, Yun Xin tries to lift her curse with training from the handsome president Tian Han. Slowly, she becomes a better person, and the couple goes from hating to loving each other... As they move closer and closer to the end of the 3 months, will Yun Xin get a true love's kiss from Tian Han? Is he her Mr. Right?

2099175.title: Back to the Golden Age
2099175.description: Tenthai suffers a broken family after his wife commits suicide with their daughter. But he gets a second chance when one day he falls unconscious and wakes up to the year 1990... In this golden age full of opportunities, Tenthai tries to reunite with his family, while building his business empire step by step to become a tycoon.

2099295.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (1st Half) (Thai Dub)
2099295.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2099295.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season

2099362.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (2nd Half) (Thai Dub)
2099362.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2099362.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season part 2

2099454.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (1st Half) (Dub Indo)
2099454.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2099454.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season

2099504.title: Attack on Titan The Final Season Part3 (2nd Half) (Dub Indo)
2099504.description: Outside of Paradis Island, where Eren and the others reside, there is another planet with human habitation. One of the "Marley" nations is at war with another another. They made the decision to attack Paradis Island and take the " Founding Titan" while engaged in a bloody conflict. While another set of kids struggle frantically to survive...
2099504.originName: 進撃の巨人 The Final Season part 2

2099900.title: The First Sequence
2099900.description: Having endured a nuclear winter, humanity is no longer the master of this world. Species have mutated, and survival resources are scarce, leaving people to face an unpredictable future and environment fraught with constant crises. To protect themselves, humans have erected countless fortifications, yet many still live beyond the walls, eking out a meager existence by hunting in the wild. The protagonist, Ren Xiaosu, and his younger “brother,” Yan Liuyuan, are among them—bound not by blood but by a shared fate, the two grow ever stronger through sheer willpower, and at an unexpected moment, they awaken to superhuman powers. Driven by the need to make a living and safeguard his family, Ren Xiaosu leaves the town where he has always lived and ventures into the Border Mountains. Along the way, he faces attacks from wolf packs, man‑faced insects, and mutant creatures, all while his newfound abilities begin to unfold. Can Ren Xiaosu survive the dangers that lie ahead?

2100117.title: 1st Kiss
2100117.description: Eight years ago, the mother of the childhood protagonist, Gu Chi, and the father of the female lead, Jiang Lan, both died in a car accident. Seeing Gu Chi’s shared sorrow, Jiang Lan couldn’t bear to leave him to fend for himself and took him in as her own. Now, Gu Chi, who has become a rising model, and Jiang Lan, a supermodel, find their relationship evolving further in the cutthroat world of fashion…

2100244.title: a sheep in wolf's clothing
2100244.description: Web novelist Lai Xiaoguang unwittingly enters a virtual world known as “The Hand of God.” In this fantastical realm, she transforms into the werewolf Daniu and finds herself drawn into a case of national treasure theft. To uncover the truth, she is forced to embark on a journey alongside the Sheep King Wangcai.

2100521.title: M&S Organization
2100521.description: In the future, as natural disasters and cosmic calamities grow ever more frequent, a mysterious organization known as “Shanhai Jihui” has issued a deadly ultimatum to Earth’s governments, intent on destroying and replacing modern humanity. The protagonist, Lei Qi, joins Crisis Unit One and assembles an exoskeletal combat squad to engage this enigmatic technological faction on multiple fronts. Thus begins a sci‑fi saga of mystery, pitting reality against the realm of dimensions, and setting civilizations from different eras at odds…

2100668.title: Four-Panel Heroes
2100668.description: In the year 952 of the Cartlan Era, in the northern reaches of the Central Continent, the Demon King Kroding, along with the Four Heavenly Kings of the demon race, led the Demon Army in an assault on the Kingdom of Cartlan. As the war reached a stalemate, the human hero Zhide Dofen single-handedly stormed the Demon King’s fortress, vanquishing the Four Heavenly Kings and slaying the Demon King Kroding. Zhide had believed this would bring the war between humans and demons to an end, but trouble soon piled upon trouble—forcing him to confront the dark secrets lurking behind the Kingdom of Cartlan.

2100729.title: Fabulous Beasts
2100729.description: Pipi, a legendary beast from ancient mythology, made his way to human civilization. He ran away to the deer shop that his friend Si Buxiang, who specialized in aiding mythological beasts, opened to avoid being persecuted by humans. In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people.

2100874.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.(Thai Dub)
2100874.description:
After an enthusiastic invitation from her friend, Kaede Honjou reluctantly agrees to try New World Online: a very popular VRMMO played by thousands of people across Japan. Naming her in-game character Maple, she sets out on her journey. As a complete novice to such games, she allocates all of her stat points into vitality, desiring to not get hurt. With not a single point in any other stat, Maple has extraordinarily high defense, but she can't move quickly or hit hard.
This doesn't end badly for her, however. Due to her high defense, Maple acquires overpowered skills such as Total Defense, Poison Immunity, and Devour. These skills, along with the incredibly powerful items she obtains, allow her to obliterate most enemies in a single hit. After only a few days of playing the game, Maple claims third place in a server-wide event, gaining a reputation as a player who is both unkillable and absurdly powerful.
Despite her overpowered character, Kaede has much to learn. As she progresses through the game, she meets new friends and acquaintances, helping her complete new levels and events. Through all of her adventures, she may even pick up some other crazy skills that exceed all expectations.
2100874.originName: 痛いのは嫌なので防御力に极振りしたいと思います。

2100972.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.(Dub Indo)
2100972.description:

2101027.title: Classroom of the Elite(Thai Dub)
2101027.description: Kōdo Ikusei Senior High School is a leading prestigious school with state-of-the-art facilities where nearly 100% of students go on to university or find employment. The students there have the freedom to wear any hairstyle and bring any personal effects they desire. Kōdo Ikusei is a paradise-like school, but the truth is that only the most superior of students receive favorable treatment. Kiyotaka Ayanokōji is a student of D-class, which is where the school dumps its "inferior" students in order to ridicule them. For a certain reason, Kiyotaka was careless on his entrance examination, and was put in D-class. After meeting Suzune Horikita and Kikyō Kushida, two other students in his class, Kiyotaka's situation begins to change.
2101027.originName: ようこそ実力至上主义の教室へ

2101106.title: Classroom of the Elite (Dub Indo)
2101106.description: Kōdo Ikusei Senior High School is a leading prestigious school with state-of-the-art facilities where nearly 100% of students go on to university or find employment. The students there have the freedom to wear any hairstyle and bring any personal effects they desire.
