2101106.originName: ようこそ実力至上主义の教室へ

2101213.title: Made in Abyss(Thai Dub)
2101213.description: The “Abyss” is the last unexplored region, an enormous and treacherous cave system filled with ancient relics and strange creatures. Only the bravest of adventurers can traverse its depths, earning them the nickname, “Cave Raiders.” Within the depths of the Abyss, a girl named Riko stumbles upon a robot who looks like a young boy. Tantalized by the Abyss, Riko and her new friend descend into uncharted territory to unlock its mysteries, but what lies in wait for them in the darkness?

2101267.title: Made in Abyss(Dub Indo)
2101267.description: The “Abyss” is the last unexplored region, an enormous and treacherous cave system filled with ancient relics and strange creatures. Only the bravest of adventurers can traverse its depths, earning them the nickname, “Cave Raiders.” Within the depths of the Abyss, a girl named Riko stumbles upon a robot who looks like a young boy. Tantalized by the Abyss, Riko and her new friend descend into uncharted territory to unlock its mysteries, but what lies in wait for them in the darkness?

2101317.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn As A Typical Nobody (Thai Dub)
2101317.description:
As the most powerful Demon Lord of all time, although Varvatos was admired, he was too powerful to be approached, so he always felt alone and decided to reincarnate as an 'ordinary' villager, Ard, in an attempt to start a new life.
No matter how much he avoids being an extraordinary presence, Ard cannot hide the fact that his power is far beyond normal people. His life is filled with people who loathe him, want to murder him, and want him to dominate the world.
Will the Demon Lord be able to live a peaceful and ordinary life?
A schoolyard hero fantasy with a twist is about to begin!
2101317.originName: 史上最強の大魔王、村人Ａに転生する

2101397.title: Classroom of the Elite III(Thai Dub)
2101397.description:
What is true power and fairness?

Advanced Nurturing High School is the top-ranked, most prestigious institution in the nation and has nearly 100% of its students who sought higher education and jobs succeed.
Although this school seems like a paradise, its true nature is one of power dominance, where only the best students receive special care.
Ayanokji Kiyotaka was placed in the lowest class, D, where he met Horikita Suzune, a stunning student with stellar academics but a challenging disposition, and Kiku Kushida, an angelic student with compassion and gentleness. Kiyotaka's attitude progressively changed after their meeting...
2101397.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ3

2101487.title: Classroom of the Elite III(Dub Indo)
2101487.description:
What is true power and fairness?

Advanced Nurturing High School is the top-ranked, most prestigious institution in the nation and has nearly 100% of its students who sought higher education and jobs succeed.
Although this school seems like a paradise, its true nature is one of power dominance, where only the best students receive special care.
Ayanokji Kiyotaka was placed in the lowest class, D, where he met Horikita Suzune, a stunning student with stellar academics but a challenging disposition, and Kiku Kushida, an angelic student with compassion and gentleness. Kiyotaka's attitude progressively changed after their meeting...
2101487.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ3

2101547.title: Chained Soldier(Thai Dub)
2101547.description: Yuuki Wakura observes the destruction of Earth by opposing supernatural forces. Mato serve as entry points to alternate dimensions and as routes for dangerous monsters to flee. Women are given peaches as resources, which endows them with abilities. Kyouka Uzen, the chief of the Anti-Demon Corp's Seventh Unity, shows in to save Yuuki from a monster. Unexpectedly, Yuuki has the ability to boost the Peaches' potency. However, Yuuki has to be prepared to serve Kyouka both at home and on the battlefield if she is to save the planet.

2101607.title: Sasaki and Peeps(Thai Dub)
2101607.description: Sasaki, a regular company employee (a wage slave) who is nearly forty years old and relatively unnoticed, was persuaded by his colleagues who had pets and chose to maintain dogs. He acquired a Java sparrow Peeps after meeting it unexpectedly in a pet store. Peeps, on the other hand, is the reincarnation of a sage from another world with the unique capacity to speak with people. As a result, Sasaki and Peeps started a new story about traveling between the other worlds and the real world.

2101665.title: Blue Exorcist -Shimane Illuminati Saga-(Thai Dub)
2101665.description:
The third season will focus on the enigmatic Illuminati society, who have ties to demons. The ultimate aim of this cheerful organization is to bring Satan back to life, but in the interim, they are experimenting on human zombies and creating an elixir that can bring demons back to life anywhere in the world. The strongest Demon is Lucifer, also known as the King of Light. Still, the abilities of a certain ExWire must be forced in order to create the ideal potion.
At the conclusion of Ao no Exorcist Season 2, Rin's brother Yukio defeated the demonic Illuminati agent, while their member, the treacherous Saburota Todou, departed in an ashed form due to his regenerative powers. It's possible that Yukio received his powers from his father, Satan, but he kept this information from Rin and the ExWires.
2101665.originName: 青の祓魔師　島根啓明結社篇

2101785.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable (Thai Dub)
2101785.description: It's the year 1999, 11 years after Jotaro Kujo's desperate fight against Dio in Egypt. Jotaro meets with Josuke Higashikata, the illegitimate son of his grandfather Joseph Joestar. He discovers that Josuke also has the same "Stand" power and that a new threat is surfacing in Morioh City.
2101785.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 ダイヤモンドは砕けない

2101898.title: The Age Of Cosmos Exploration
2101898.description: As Earth faces an existential crisis triggered by the arrival of neutron-star debris, a special forces unit known as Black Star Squad, led by Yao Yuan, takes on the mission to secure humanity’s future. Aboard the starship Hope, they evacuate vast numbers of civilians from the planet and set out into the cosmos in search of a new home. Along the way, amid peril and battle, Yao Yuan and his comrades uncover the existence of a far‑higher‑order cosmic civilization—and come to grips with a chilling truth: the universe is no paradise, but a dark and treacherous unknown realm, teeming with death and dread.

2101982.title: A Thousand Days of Tortured Love Letters (Thai)
2101982.description: Chairman Zhou dies in an unexpected accident, and his eldest daughter, Zhou Yue, is framed by the rising star Zhou Mengqi in a bid to seize the entire Zhou family fortune. Mo Jinye, the president of the Imperial Capital Group, announces an arranged marriage with Zhou Mengqi due to health concerns. Little does anyone know that Zhou Yue, who had been drugged by Zhou Mengqi and handed over to an older man, ends up sharing a one‑night stand with the drunken Mo Jinye. Seizing the opportunity, Zhou Yue blackmails him into helping her reclaim the Star‑Raising Group from Zhou Mengqi—only to be coldly rebuffed. From that moment on, their fates become inextricably entwined, setting off a tormented love–hate relationship filled with wit, courage, and relentless conflict.

2103782.title: A Thousand Days of Sadistic Love Letter
2103782.description:
This is the drama of two CEOs whose lives tangle up in a love-hate relationship.
After Zhou Yue’s father dies from an accident, popular movie star Zhou Mengqi plots to take over the Zhou family company, leaving nothing for Zhou Yue the eldest daughter and rightful CEO.
Mo Jinye, the CEO of Dijing Group, plans to marry Mengqi for personal health reason. But he ends up having a one night stand with Zhou Yue who was drugged by Zhou Mengqi. Yue and Mo form a forced alliance to take back Yue’s company. Their sadistic fights turn into love somehow.

2103848.title: Gods' Games We play
2103848.description:
Troubled by their excessive amount of free time, the gods finally grew bored. Thus, the challenging battles of wits between gods and humanity began. Only a few top players called “apostles” can meet the gods to beat them.

  Awakened after sleeping for thousands of years, a former god named Leshea desires to meet “this era’s very best player.” Fay, an acclaimed rookie apostle, is to whom she is introduced. Together, they plan to challenge the gods and win the ultimate prize, but this is a goal that no human in history has ever achieved before. The gods are cruel, witty, capricious, and even invincible. In the face of absurdity, how can the apostles obtain their seemingly impossible triumph?
2103848.originName: 神は遊戯に飢えている

2103910.title: WIND BREAKER
2103910.description: Haruka Sakura is only interested in the most powerful of the strong; he has no desire to connect with weaklings. He recently enrolled in Furin High School, a filthy educational institution defined exclusively by physical prowess, which they use to deter evildoers from their town. But Haruka only wants to fight his way to the top; he doesn't care about being a hero or a member of any group!

2104024.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
2104024.description:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
2104024.originName: 転生したら第七王子だったので、   気ままに魔術を極めます

2104111.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2
2104111.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
2104111.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 2期

2104174.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc
2104174.description: Demon attacks have stopped ever since Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight was made public. The Demon Slayer Corps is aware that a fresh and deadly conflict is imminent since Muzan Kibutsuji is preparing to kidnap her. All of Kagaya's members—including the Hashira—are subjected to rigorous training in the quiet before the storm, and Tanjiro uses the demanding curriculum to improve himself and gain some further knowledge about the group's most formidable Demon Slayers.
2104174.originName: 鬼滅の刃　柱稽古編

2104310.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3
2104310.description:
After Clayman is vanquished, Rimuru formally assumes the throne as the Demon King, extending his domain to encompass the entirety of the Great Jura Forest.
Anticipating a deluge of race representatives, Rimuru chose to make use of his attendance to consider using the "Foundation Festival" as a means of attracting new people to "Destiny City".
Distinguishing actual adversaries and allies and pursuing the concept of the "Sphere of Co-Prosperity between Humans and Demons," Rimuru's new adventure is about to begin. Rimuru made this decision after learning that Hinata was traveling to the Destiny City.
2104310.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 3期

2104387.title: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
2104387.description: Every year, hundreds of heroes from other planets are called to battle in the Magical Kingdom of Klyrode against the Dark One and his army of formidable demons. One of those heroes, Banaza is called upon from the Paluma Royal Capital, but something is wrong because Banaza is just a regular shopkeeper. In addition to lacking fighting prowess and magic, his stats are awful. Even worse, an accident prevents him from going home! Banaza's fate appears to be rather grim: he is despised as a hero and left trapped on a different planet, abandoned to the outer corners of the kingdom by a ruthless ruler who simply wants him dead. What will happen, though, when the failed hero candidate reaches level two and discovers he has super cheat powers?
2104387.originName: Lv2からチートだった元勇者候補のまったり異世界ライフ

2104493.title: Re：Monster
2104493.description:
After an untimely demise, Tomokui Kanata was reincarnated as Goburou, the weakest goblin. But Goburou has undergone an odd transformation, kept the memory of his former life, and become powerful enough to use food to elevate his social standing.

Events in this other reality of survival of the fittest take place with capable allies and subordinates, a charming example of the tail-wagging dog...

2104633.title: Black Butler -Public School Arc-
2104633.description: Being the most esteemed public school in Britain, Weston College is so exclusive that it won't even accept help from the government. So, when several of the pupils at the school—including Derrick Arden, the cousin of Queen Victoria's son—refuse to return home and stop communicating with their families, Ciel Phantomhive is forced to enroll in Weston College in order to look into the matter. As Sapphire Owl's new housemaster, Sebastian Michaelis has joined the team.

2104781.title: A Condition Called Love
2104781.description: Despite being loved by her family and friends, first-year high school student Hotaru Hinase is unsure of what love is. She happened to see the attractive boy Hananoi from the nearing class being turned away one day. With a nonchalant gesture, Hotaru handed over the umbrella to Hananoi, who was standing by himself in the park. This little mishap developed into a chance. With a public confession to Hotaru, Hananoi pleaded, "Please date me." What does "like" mean? Furthermore, what is "love"? Hotaru was taken aback by the abrupt revelation, but Hananoi declared, "I will do anything for the people I love." He was continuously expressing his affection. The preface to their first love starts here: a clingy boy whose love is inexplicable and a high school girl who doesn't understand love.

2104888.title: THE NEW GATE
2104888.description: Tens of thousands of people play the life-or-death game "The New Gate" online. The most accomplished veteran player, Shin, is the reason the other players will eventually be let go from the game. After taking down the final boss, Shin feels like he can finally make it out until a strange burst of light blinds him. When he wakes up, 500 years have passed and he is back in the game's world! Thus starts a new chapter in the life of the greatest player of all time!

2104964.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
2104964.description: Yumiko Satō and Chika Watanabe are new idol voice actresses who have been in the voice acting business for a while and were classmates in the same high school. Their managers later scheduled a radio program for the two who don't know each other to discuss their school days. They have to maintain their friendship within the program even though they fight frequently outside of it.
2104964.originName: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ

2105032.title: Immortality 3
2105032.description: How can the hero Fang Han use his own strength to traverse the vast fantastical world? By clinging to an unwavering refusal to accept defeat, he cracked the code of supernatural abilities and transformed his mortal body into an immortal one. Fang Han will reveal a new and prosperous world filled with immortals, demons, and mortals, along with countless innovative magic weapons. In addition, Fang Han will encounter conflicts between immortals and demons, love and hate. It will eventually lead to success.

2105082.title: Mom, I'm Sorry
2105082.description: When Cuican Dong eventually found out that his mother had a fatal illness, everything in his world collapsed. They had each other and nothing else in the world, after all. It was too late to make up for the fact that he had always taken his mother's affection for granted. Was it, or was it not? On his mother's bedside, an enigmatic guy approached him and offered to give his mother a new life at the expense of his own life expectancy. The 50-year-old Jinyu Yan was granted a second chance at life when the desperate Cuican struck the arrangement. The drawback? Now, she was younger than her own son!

2105159.title: The Charm of Soul Pets
2105159.description: The main character, Chu Mu, was the heir to the Chu Clan, but he was banished to the island and faced an almost certain death as a result of a planned assassination. He danced on the brink of death, fighting for his life with a little Moonlight Fox he had captured. He had to exhale when he was finally free of the demonic foremen on his island. However, he was unaware that this was just the start of his destined trip with his tiny Moonlight Fox.

2105298.title: DON'T GIVE UP
2105298.description: A numb and bored office worker named Men Ke unintentionally found himself in the predicament of "being bored to death" and began attempting to save himself with the assistance of the alien Yasen.

2105385.title: Purgatory Walkers
2105385.description: Li Yan, a gifted martial artist, has a few months to live due to a deadly illness. In a desperate state, he met a man by chance who went by the name "Tapir" and was taken to a "Jambu Fruit Tree" fruit. In order to get Jambu points—which may be used to buy potions that can treat fatal illnesses—Li Yan needs to finish three chores given by the system within the allotted time. She can also earn money by boxing contests. Li Yan became increasingly interested in the conflicts within the Longyuan Walled City as he gained more knowledge about it. He also saw that other Jambu were covertly vying for his business. Li Yan overcame numerous obstacles to ultimately accomplish the task and gain a new life.
2105385.originName: 从姑获鸟开始之龙城风云

2105512.title: Villain Initialization
2105512.description: After 35 years as a villain, Ling Chen "initialized" his reset-rebirth to 17 years old during his final conflict with Ye Muxue! What? Do you believe he longs to revert to humanity? Speak less! Naturally, since Ye Mu wasn't superpowered at the moment, it was time to murder him!

2105623.title: Back to the Great Ming
2105623.description: Zheng Shaopeng, a high school student, dozed off during a history lesson. When he awoke, he discovered that he had changed into the impoverished scholar Yang Lin and had traveled to the Danzhu Dynasty in the history textbook. Initially, Yang Lin struggled to adjust to life in the past, but when he applied contemporary ideas to create a few modest innovations, he won the villagers' affection and eventually discovered a feeling of identity of his own. Yang Lin lived through a time of both internal and exterior unrest, experiencing battles and seeing the agony of the populace. By relying on his knowledge and abilities to acquire access to the court, he eventually oversaw the Danzhu Dynasty's efforts to combat internal corruption and repel formidable adversaries.

2105688.title: Fabulous Beasts 3
2105688.description: Pipi, a legendary beast from ancient mythology, made his way to human civilization. He ran away to the deer shop that his friend Si Buxiang, who specialized in aiding mythological beasts, opened to avoid being persecuted by humans. In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people. And now let's see what will happen in season 3!

2105746.title: SUPER XIANG
2105746.description: Pinxiang, the "strongest embryo" developed to save Blue Star, is confident he can save the world with a single kick in a football match that is scheduled for a specific time and location! But he picked the incorrect talent and became proficient in a variety of other areas aside from football.

2105814.title: Mythical Creatures Are My Dinners
2105814.description: A type of creature known as "Mythical Creatures" can be found in the realm of mountains and seas. The mythical creatures can become demons through practice and spiritual knowledge acquisition. But because of the chaos of history, mankind and demons have always been at odds. The top disciple of the immortality-focused Tianji Sect is Mo Bai. Despite his great talent, he has no desire to cultivate immortality. All he wants to eat is good food from all around the world. Mo Bai, the monster chef Xiao Hei, and his younger sister in sect Xing Hong met by coincidence and went on to establish a gourmet team that toured the globe in quest of unusual cuisine. But in the process, they unintentionally learned the key to the conflict between humans and monsters...

2105874.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered (Thai Dub)
2105874.description:
The Sage who brought Yogiri Takatou's school bus to another planet demonstrates to the children how terrible both the world and she are by murdering the adults for trivial reasons and instructing them to become sages in order to battle demons. She leaves the others to perish, taking only the skilled.
Yogiri seeks to return with his classmate Tomochika Dannora, but Tomochika becomes uneasy due to Yogiri's indifference to the strangeness. Yogiri is actually not your typical child; he has the ability to willfully kill everything.
2105874.originName: 即死チートが最強すぎて、異世界のやつらがまるで相手にならないんですが。

2105997.title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions 2nd Season
2105997.description: Ron Kamonohashi, once hailed as a genius at the world-renowned Detective Training Academy Blue, had his qualification to become a detective revoked due to a fatal “flaw”. After enduring a period of unappreciated talent, his destiny was greatly altered by his encounter with Totomaru Isshiki from the Metropolitan Police Department's First Investigative Division, who is nicknamed “Toto”. Ron takes on the role of solving mysteries, while Toto is in charge of investigation. Together, they consecutively crack difficult cases and gradually become a famous partnership.
2105997.originName: 鴨乃橋ロンの禁断推理（2期）

2106066.title: A SALAD BOWL OF ECCENTRICS
2106066.description: A destitute detective named Sousuke Kaburaya encounters Sara, a princess with magical abilities from another world. One day they move in together, and Sara swiftly adapts to modern Japanese living. Livia, the female knight who teleported with Sara, was unexpectedly joyful despite living in homelessness. The optimistic and resilient attitude of these two extraterrestrials not only influences Sousuke but also a host of peculiar personalities that reside here, including ruthless attorneys, love-breakers, and pious scholars...

2106176.title: An Archdemon`s Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
2106176.description:
Zagan is referred to be the evil magician. He may not speak well and have a fierce demeanor, but he practices magic seriously every day and chases out robbers from his territory.
Later, Zagan encountered the white-haired elf maiden Nephy, who was up for auction as a Demon King relic, fatefully when his friend Barbaros accompanied him to an illicit auction one day.
Zagan used all of his belongings to entice Nephy to return to his castle. But he was not adept with words and had never really interacted with people, so he didn't know how to talk to Nephy or even carry on a regular conversation.
2106176.originName: 魔王の俺が奴隷エルフを嫁にしたんだが、どう愛でればいい？

2106311.title: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again
2106311.description:
They have been blissfully married for as long as they can remember, Shouzou and Ine Saitou. Their priceless bond shows how strong their love is even in their advanced years, when their limbs are crumbling and their faces are wrinkled. Then, one day, out of the blue, they awaken to discover they had returned to youth!

Even with their newfound youth and beauty, Shouzou and Ine are still the same. The elderly couple is followed by Jiisan Baasan Wakagaeru as they go about their everyday activities, spend time with family, and defy the expectations of the younger generation.
2106311.originName: じいさんばあさん若返る

2106453.title: Tonbo!
2106453.description:
The main character, Ooi Tonbo, was raised by her grandfather, Gonji Ooi, a fisherman on the island of Kagoshima in the Tokara Islands, after she lost both of her parents in a car accident when she was a little child. The three golf courses on the island were designed by the locals, and Tonbo learns the game while utilizing her father's No. 3 iron.

Tonbo first encounters Kazuyoshi Igarashi, a former professional golfer who has traveled to Kagoshima in quest of employment, at the start of the story.

2106675.title: Date A Live V
2106675.description: At least 150 million people lost their lives in the devastating "spacequake" that struck the core of Eurasia thirty years ago. Smaller earthquakes have been sporadically plaguing the Earth ever since. At the epicenter of a seismic event, Shido Itsuka, a seemingly normal high school student, discovers from his sister Kotori that the enigmatic girl he encountered is one of the "Spirits," who, when they materialize in the world, are the true source of seismic activity. Additionally, he finds out that Kotori is the commander of the airship Fraxinus, which is manned by the Ratatoskr organization. Kotori is hired to use his unexplained ability to seal the Spirits' abilities, preventing them from posing a threat to humanity. However, he has to make her fall in love with him and kiss him in order to seal a Spirit's power.

2106744.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! S3
2106744.description: Kazuma is over it, so even though the abnormal party has returned, they might soon be without a member. His desire to become a monk is thwarted by Aqua, Megumin, and Darkness, who reject his lack of adventure. But the conflict over careers is put on hold when a princess asks to hear all of their stories. Will this be their farewell tour or will the taste of fame at the royal castle keep them together?
2106744.originName: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！3

2106884.title: The Irregular at Magic High School 3
2106884.description: After the Offshore Tower incident, a new year begins at Magic High School. Tatsuya, who transferred to the Magic Engineering course, started his second year, planning to lead a peaceful life with his younger sister Miyuki. However, despite the familial love between the brother and the sister, new dangers are approaching clandestinely. In the face of the villains' dire and dangerous schemes, can Tatsuya overcome the difficulties and protect his cherished sister?
2106884.originName: 魔法科高校の劣等生 第3シーズン

2106937.title: My Hero Academia 7th Season
2106937.description: Deku, students in the United States of America, professional heroes, are resolved to fight together rather than alone after an all-out war and a solitary battle with the enemy "Villains," and a massive evil spirit that is aiming for Deku's "Quirks," One For All, who is facing them. But the hope for victory in the last conflict between Shigaraki and the other villains was destroyed...
2106937.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 第7期

2107061.title: Kaiju No. 8
2107061.description: Japan has one of the greatest rates of kaiju emergence worldwide, meaning that fatal monster attacks are common there. Here comes the Japan Defense Force, a military force assigned to destroy kaiju. Kaiju-corp cleanup man Kafka Hibino has always wanted to join the force. But he has an unforeseen metamorphosis when given another chance to fulfill his childhood ambition. Now that he has turned into a kaiju himself, how can he battle them?

2107265.title: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
2107265.description: High school student Tarou Tokumitsu, who lives alone, meets Towa, a nice and innocent girl, on his balcony. However, who exactly is she...? As Miss Beelzebub Likes author Matoba gives you the newest adorable and innocent romantic comedy!
2107265.originName: ワンルーム、日当たり普通、天使つき

2107399.title: Yao-Chinese Folktales
2107399.description: The animated short‑film anthology “Chinese Tales” comprises eight self‑contained stories rooted in traditional Chinese culture: “The Summer of the Little Demon,” “Goose, Goose, Goose,” “Linlin,” “The Village Bus Carried Away Wang Hair and the Immortal,” “Xiaoman,” “Jade Rabbit,” “The Corner Store,” and “Birds and Fish.” Spanning ancient times to the present and looking toward the future, these tales range from rural nostalgia to technological fantasy, from existential themes to reflections on human nature, showcasing a distinctly Chinese imagination while embodying China’s cultural heritage and philosophy.

2107489.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
2107489.description: When a Japanese salaryman passes away and reincarnates as Ars Louvent, the heir of an aristocratic family, he learns that he is also capable of evaluating the abilities and talents of others. In order to prepare for the impending battle for the throne's succession, Ars uses his unique abilities to find and persuade strong people who excel in a variety of fields, from magic and swordplay to strategy and diplomacy, to join his allies and servants.
2107489.originName: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる

2107574.title: Welcome Home
2107574.description: Masaki Fujiyoshi is a parent and spouse who stays at home. As an omega, which is a secondary gender that permits one to give birth regardless of gender, he has battled for a very long time with sentiments of burdening his devoted husband, Hiromu, because of the challenges they had in achieving domesticity. The family relocated to a more child-friendly region after the birth of their son, Hikari.

2107660.title: My Hero Academia Memories
2107660.description: Deku, students in the United States of America, professional heroes, are resolved to fight together rather than alone after an all-out war and a solitary battle with the enemy "Villains," and a massive evil spirit that is aiming for Deku's "Quirks," One For All, who is facing them. But the hope for victory in the last conflict between Shigaraki and the other villains was destroyed...

2107794.title: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time l Summarize Season l
2107794.description: Lonely thirty-seven-year-old Mikami Satoru is stuck in a dead-end job, unhappy with his mundane life, but after dying at the hands of a robber, he awakens to a fresh start in a fantasy realm...as a slime monster! As he acclimates to his goopy new existence, his exploits with the other monsters set off a chain of events that will change his new world forever!
2107794.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件

2107936.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S4 (Thai Dub)
2107936.description: The monks used all available resources to pursue the three thousand ways of heaven throughout the era of popular scientific culture in order to catch a glimpse of the reality of heaven. The modern sword master Yi Jianchuan and his younger brother, the wicked sword god Chen Nanxuan, went in a completely different direction to seek the ultimate swordsmanship, one of the three thousand heavenly ways. Wang Ling is concerned with which heavenly road to follow today in order to have a serene daily existence, while the rest of the world is concerned with how to nurture a heavenly path.

2108017.title: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time I Summarize Season 2
2108017.description: With the help of Queen Ramiris, the children are now in stable condition and should lead normal lives, much to Rimuru’s relief. But all is not well… In fact, there are forces of humankind in this fantasy world that do not look kindly upon a slime-led nation of monsters. And now, insidious threats to Rimuru and the country of Tempest may be lurking around every corner!
2108017.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第2期

2108130.title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?! (Thai Dub)
2108130.description: At thirty, Ando is still a virgin—and thanks to that, he’s been granted the rather unremarkable magic of reading the thoughts of anyone he touches. One day, he happens to eavesdrop on the mind of his handsome coworker, Kurosawa. To his surprise, Kurosawa has long harbored deep affection for him—what?! Thanks to this strange magic, the cool‑headed heartthrob’s love for the awkward virgin seems ready to spill out. A 200% pure love story begins!
2108130.originName: 30歳まで童貞だと魔法使いになれるらしい

2108217.title: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
2108217.description: "I have no interest in real girls!" As usual, Okumura, the Manga Study Club manager, is by himself in the club room, calling out the name of his favorite 2D character, Liliel, who is reflected on the screen. Amano Ririsa, a real girl who declares, "I want to be Liliel," is the person who comes to Okumura. She has been fascinated with the sexy and adorable "costumes" of manga girls. She is an otaku companion who has the same level of affection for Liliel as Okumura! Ririsa shows Okumura her hidden interest in cosplay and presents him with a collection of "ROM" that includes images and videos of cosplay. "I...I want to create something similar to this!" Then, just the two of them start the cosplay activities in the club room! Okumura is even astounded by how authentic Liliel appears on Ririsa! With a burst of enthusiasm, Okumura snatches a camera!? With their genuine and passionate feeling towards cosplay, a youth story about cosplay that “tells the love for something crazily” for all otakus begins now!!

2108435.title: Kurayukaba & Kuramerukagari
2108435.description:
This town's purple mist is a faint dream, which consists of enigmatic rumors.
And now, detective Soutaro takes on the enigmatic "mass disappearance" that has everyone perplexed!
It was unclear what the aim was, and there were no witnesses...
What's the real story behind the "creepy ruts" that constantly seem to follow them?
The detective enters the city's underground "Kuragari" area covertly in search of clues.
Then there is a sudden encounter between the commander of the Black Iron's armored train and it.
And this had a significant impact on the detective's fate!

2108574.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind (Thai Dub)
2108574.description: Fresh from surviving his adventures in Morioh, Stand user and Joestar ally Koichi Hirose is touching down in Naples, Italy to discover a man known as Haruno Shiobana, who may well be the inheritor of a truly terrifying legacy. Though he now calls himself Giorno Giovanna and makes a living from petty thievery, there is no mistaking the regal bearing and cunning that mark his bloodline, or the natural Stand affinity that he's already begun to harness. Whatever he may call himself, Giorno Giovanna's parentage mark him as a true threat - for he is the son of Dio Brando, and no son of Dio could possibly live quietly on this earth.
2108574.originName: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 黄金の風

2108642.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability (Thai Dub)
2108642.description:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
2108642.originName: 転生したら第七王子だったので、   気ままに魔術を極めます

2108789.title: Re：Monster (Thai Dub)
2108789.description:
After an untimely demise, Tomokui Kanata was reincarnated as Goburou, the weakest goblin. But Goburou has undergone an odd transformation, kept the memory of his former life, and become powerful enough to use food to elevate his social standing.

Events in this other reality of survival of the fittest take place with capable allies and subordinates, a charming example of the tail-wagging dog...

2108891.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 (Thai Dub)
2108891.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
2108891.originName: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～ 2期

2109001.title: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers (Thai Dub)
2109001.description: Every year, hundreds of heroes from other planets are called to battle in the Magical Kingdom of Klyrode against the Dark One and his army of formidable demons. One of those heroes, Banaza is called upon from the Paluma Royal Capital, but something is wrong because Banaza is just a regular shopkeeper. In addition to lacking fighting prowess and magic, his stats are awful. Even worse, an accident prevents him from going home! Banaza's fate appears to be rather grim: he is despised as a hero and left trapped on a different planet, abandoned to the outer corners of the kingdom by a ruthless ruler who simply wants him dead. What will happen, though, when the failed hero candidate reaches level two and discovers he has super cheat powers?
2109001.originName: Lv2からチートだった元勇者候補のまったり異世界ライフ

2109079.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability (Dub Indo)

2109463.title: ATRI -My Dear Moments-
2109463.description:
An unexplained sea level rise in the near future has submerged most of human civilization. After experiencing a difficult life in a large city, Ikaruga Natsuki, a young man who lost one of his legs in an accident a few years prior, returns home only to discover his former rural home partially submerged under the ocean. With no family left, all he has left is the ship and submarine his oceanologist grandmother gave him, along with her debts.

He sets out to explore the underwater remnants of his grandmother's laboratory in an attempt to retrieve his "lost future" and the rumored treasure she hid there. However, what he discovers is Atri, a strange girl, dozing off at the bottom of the ocean in what appears to be a coffin. Although she is a robot, anyone seeing her would mistake her for a real person because of the vividness of her appearance and emotions.

She declares to Natsuki that she wants to carry out her master's last directive as an expression of gratitude for being saved. Until she fulfills it, she'll be Natsuki's leg. An incredible summer is about to begin for this boy and this enigmatic robot girl in a small town that is gradually being engulfed by the sea.

2109720.title: THE NEW GATE (Thai Dub)
2109720.description: Tens of thousands of people play the life-or-death game "The New Gate" online. The most accomplished veteran player, Shin, is the reason the other players will eventually be let go from the game. After taking down the final boss, Shin feels like he can finally make it out until a strange burst of light blinds him. When he wakes up, 500 years have passed and he is back in the game's world! Thus starts a new chapter in the life of the greatest player of all time!

2109857.title: THE NEW GATE (Dub Indo)
2109857.description: Tens of thousands of people play the life-or-death game "The New Gate" online. The most accomplished veteran player, Shin, is the reason the other players will eventually be let go from the game. After taking down the final boss, Shin feels like he can finally make it out until a strange burst of light blinds him. When he wakes up, 500 years have passed and he is back in the game's world! Thus starts a new chapter in the life of the greatest player of all time!

2109911.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3 (Thai Dub)
2109911.description:
After Clayman is vanquished, Rimuru formally assumes the throne as the Demon King, extending his domain to encompass the entirety of the Great Jura Forest.
Anticipating a deluge of race representatives, Rimuru chose to make use of his attendance to consider using the "Foundation Festival" as a means of attracting new people to "Destiny City".
Distinguishing actual adversaries and allies and pursuing the concept of the "Sphere of Co-Prosperity between Humans and Demons," Rimuru's new adventure is about to begin. Rimuru made this decision after learning that Hinata was traveling to the Destiny City.
2109911.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 3期

2110141.title: PSEUDO HAREM
2110141.description:
A harem with only one heroine?!
Eiji Kitahama, the drama club senior, who aspires to have a harem like in the manga series, and Rin Nanakura, who cannot help but act as other characters in front of her senior Kitahama.
Tsundere and Teaser, Clingy and Cool, as well as Ladylike, the more characters she plays, the more emotion she loses control of for her senior.
Is it possible that Nanakura expresses her true self to her senior, who is somewhat silly and thick-headed?

2110277.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World Season 2
2110277.description: A great war has raged for years between the scientifically advanced Empire and Nebulis, the realm of the witches―until the youngest knight ever to receive the title of the Empire's strongest meets the princess of the rival nation. Though they are sworn enemies, the knight is taken by her beauty and dignity, and the princess is moved by his strength and way of life. Will the fighting between them ever be allowed to end? Just look forward to Season 2!
2110277.originName: キミと僕の最後の戦場、あるいは世界が始まる聖戦SeasonⅡ

2110402.title: MASHLE MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc
2110402.description:
It is now public knowledge that Mash Burnedead possesses powers following his battle with Magia Lupus. After Mash is called before a group of Divine Visionaries by the Bureau of Magic, the brief celebration comes to an end when they decide that Mash will die as a result of their actions. But a sinister shadow group known as Innocent Zero seizes control of the investigation and demands that Mash be living.

Even after Mash demonstrates his ability to handle Innocent Zero, the Divine Visionaries' conclusion is upheld. Fortunately, Mash meets two unlikely allies in Headmaster Wahlberg Baigan and Divine Visionary Rayne Ames, who work together to postpone Mash's execution until Innocent Zero is vanquished. Mash's current permit to live is contingent upon his being chosen by the end of the year to be the Divine Visionary nominee.
2110402.originName: マッシュル-MASHLE- 神覚者候補選抜試験編

2110510.title: Whimsical Wish
2110510.description: A cat accidentally brought college graduate Wei Ran into a world he had no idea existed. He discovered that the only train that could return him to the human world only runs once every six months while he was trying to find a way to get home. All he could do was move in with YaYa, the cat who owned Whimsical Wish, temporarily. Wei Ran unexpectedly discovered that the dragon scales would always appear wherever he went, just when things seemed to be stabilizing. And each time the dragon scale materialized, it had an entirely unique, bizarre effect.

2110564.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc (Thai Dub)
2110564.description: Demon attacks have stopped ever since Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight was made public. The Demon Slayer Corps is aware that a fresh and deadly conflict is imminent since Muzan Kibutsuji is preparing to kidnap her. All of Kagaya's members—including the Hashira—are subjected to rigorous training in the quiet before the storm, and Tanjiro uses the demanding curriculum to improve himself and gain some further knowledge about the group's most formidable Demon Slayers.
2110564.originName: 鬼滅の刃　柱稽古編

2110643.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc (Dub Indo)
2110643.description: Demon attacks have stopped ever since Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight was made public. The Demon Slayer Corps is aware that a fresh and deadly conflict is imminent since Muzan Kibutsuji is preparing to kidnap her. 2110869.title: LINK CLICK
2110869.description: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

2110991.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
2110991.description: This is an adventure story about a determined young man named Will Serfort. He makes up his mind to fulfill a childhood promise to his friend by becoming a Magia Vander, who sit at the top of the Tower of Wizards. However, Will has still struggled to perform even the most basic spells. To compensate, he delves into dungeon battles to earn credits at the prestigious Regarden Magic Academy. Despite his magical shortcomings, Will possesses extraordinary swordsmanship skills, which is a legacy from his enigmatic past. Amidst the competitive Magic Academy, Will must confront perilous trials and rivalries while endeavoring to unlock his magical abilities.
2110991.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア

2111077.title: Suicide Squad Isekai
2111077.description: Amanda Waller, the leader of A.R.G.U.S., gathers a gang of infamous criminals in the crime-ridden city of Gotham, including Clayface, Deadshot, Deadshot, Harley Quinn, and King Shark, for a mission into an otherworldly realm that is connected to this world through a gate. Here, orcs rampage and dragons rule the skies in a world of swords and magic known as "ISEKAI." Following their arrival in ISEKAI, Harley and her friends are taken prisoner by the soldiers of the Kingdom and imprisoned while wearing bombs around their necks. Is Harley Quinn's group able to overcome this dangerous realm?
2111077.originName: 異世界スーサイドスクワッド

2111356.title: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
2111356.description: Kaito Takagi was originally a high school student with a low status! By day, he explored the mystical dungeons around Japan, hunting slimes to make ends meet. One day, Kaito's world took a remarkable turn when he triumphed over a rare golden slime. In its aftermath, he discovers a priceless treasure, a mysterious card capable of summoning mythical beings! A warrior maiden with unparalleled beauty appears after he uses the card. Then a series of marvelous adventures begins……
2111356.originName: モブから始まる探索英雄譚

2111442.title: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human
2111442.description: Right now, the humans are engaged in a fierce battle with the Demon Lord Army, among which the most striking member is the commanding magician of the Immortal Brigade, Ike. Although celebrated as the trusted aide of the Demon Lord Army, Ike hides a secret from surrounding demons, that is, he is actually a human, a mere mortal reincarnated from Japan!
2111442.originName: 魔王軍の最強魔術師は人間だった

2111552.title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
2111552.description:
Masachika Kuze is seated next to Alya-san, who consistently gives him the cold shoulder.
Though occasionally she will speak to him in Russian and blurt out a few flirtatious phrases.
No word of it escapes Masachika's notice. That is because Masachika can listen to Russian at a native level!

Alya-san occasionally blurts out sweet words while acting as though he does not understand.
Masachika acts as though he does not understand the meaning.

Where will their tale of love—which makes you smile—take them?
2111552.originName: 時々ボソッとロシア語でデレる隣のアーリャさん

2111677.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells
2111677.description: High school student Touga Mimori, who is invisible in class, and his peers are unexpectedly called by a goddess to take on heroic roles in a fantastical world. Although the majority of them demonstrate remarkable abilities with S-rank, A-rank, and so forth, Mimori only possesses an E-rank, the lowest rank. Mimori is banished to a dungeon where there is almost no chance of survival because the goddess believes he is useless. But as it happens, his abilities are more unusual than they first appear to be. Then, this insignificant adolescent decides to take revenge on the goddess with giving up his nature.
2111677.originName: ハズレ枠の【状態異常スキル】で最強になった俺がすべてを蹂躙するまで

2111784.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
2111784.description:
The newest and strongest old man wants to be an adventurer!
"It is better to follow your dreams while you are still young."
That is the general consensus. However, some adults never give up.

In a world where teens are expected to become adventurers,
Rick Gladiator, a thirty-year-old guild clerk, dreamed of being an adventurer.
He has been training with the members of "Orihalcon Fist," a legendary group that assembles the toughest adventurers on the continent, for the past few days in an unimaginable world.
however, he possesses the fighting prowess of an S-rank, the highest rank, despite being a rookie F-rank!?
2111784.originName: オッサン冒険者、最強パーティに死ぬほど鍛えられて無敵になる。

2111844.title: I PARRY EVERYTHING
2111844.description:
A young child named Noor is unjustly judged as having no talent at all. He wants to be an adventurer and see the world, battle monsters, and save people. However, he understands that if he lacks talent, all he needs to do is work harder than anybody else, and as a result, he has mastered [Parry], the most basic skill that deflects attacks, and after more than ten years of practice, he eventually becomes extremely proficient.

Though Noor has managed to obtain the strongest power in the world, his skill level is still insufficient to qualify him as an adventurer, but he does not know that because he works odd jobs in the city during the day. Then, one day, when he unintentionally saves Princess Lynne from a monster's attack, Noor's destiny starts to move in an unexpected way!
2111844.originName: 俺は全てを【パリイ】する

2111933.title: Bye Bye, Earth
2111933.description: Belle Lablac was the sole human born into a world where animals had human traits. She was nicknamed "Faceless," and because she lacked scales, fur, or fangs, she endured a lonely existence and could not relate to anybody else. "I'd like to integrate with the world...." She resolves to travel to find her roots with the Runding, a magnificent sword that is as tall as she is, and a tremendous deal of longing in her heart. She has no idea how many challenges are ahead for her...

2112079.title: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring
2112079.description:
Because of a mistake that God made, Takumi Kayano lost his life and was reincarnated.
After being endowed with a variety of abilities, he was transported to a different planet and dropped into a perilous forest rife with monsters.
Takumi finds a young child and girl in the forest who look to be twins. He names them Alan and Elena and takes them under his protection. Astonished by the ease with which the two vanquish monsters with their martial arts prowess, Takumi arrives in town and joins the adventurer's guild in order to support himself.
He thus takes care of Alan and Elena as they grow up and begin a carefree life filled with adventures!
2112079.originName: 異世界ゆるり紀行　子育てしながら冒険者します

2112216.title: Twilight Out of Focus
2112216.description:
Mao has made the decision to film the lone wolf and troublemaker Hisashi at the film club.
The two eventually become sweetly bonded through the "promise" they make when living together in the dorm.
Junior Giichi is envious of Jin, the president of the popular film club.
Even though they do not get along, the two wind up falling in love.
Shion is a new member of the club who joins out of season, and Rei is the reserved, unsociable, but trustworthy vice president.
With an unplanned kiss, the two start their "relationship."

Via the lens, they all come to understand love!
2112216.originName: 黄昏アウトフォーカス

2112349.title: FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST
2112349.description: After a year of triumphing over the evil forces of Zeref and Acnologia, the Fairy Tail guild sets out to explore the northern continent of Guiltina. There, Natsu Dragneel accompanied by Lucy Heartfilia, Gray Fullbuster, Erza Scarlet, Wendy Marvell, as well as the exceeds Happy and Charlés, they find the employer of the 100 Years Quest and are given an almost unfathomable task: to lock up the Five Dragon Gods, a group of people with such immense power that, if left unchecked, could wipe out the entire human race. As this is going on, Fairy Tail recruits Touka, a passionate new member. There appears to be more to her than meets the eye, despite the fact that her intense passion and lively energy make her ideal for the guild.

2112427.title: Plus-Sized Elf
2112427.description: Just before he leaves for the day, massage therapist Tomoatsu Naoe is assigned an odd patient. This stunning woman was raised in a forest, and she has pointed ears and emerald eyes, everything about her suggests that she is an "elf". She seems to have left her world, but she still enjoys all the junk food that in humans world, and now her obsession is making it difficult for her to go back home. Is it possible for Tomoatsu Naoe to assist this endearing elf girl in losing weight and keeping it off?
2112427.originName: エルフさんは痩せられない

2112512.title: Quality Assurance in Another World
2112512.description: The island of Clayborne, though it lies far south of the continent of Felnarc, is actually composed of five small nations that are incessantly at odds with one another. A girl named Nikola lives a modest life in a small village in the most remote parts of the Kingdom of Bayle, the island's smallest and most tranquil nation. She is going about her daily business of gathering firewood when she is confronted one day by a large dragon, a species thought to only exist in the highest alpine regions. The village is about to be attacked when a man by the name of Haga dashes into view. Haga is a member of the top-secret investigative team known as the King's Seekers. After meeting Haga, Nikola is so captivated by him and his travels that she decides to venture out on her own and discover the real nature of her world. Despite the fact that every day is essentially the same, Nikola has never once felt bored with her peaceful life...
2112512.originName: この世界は不完全すぎる

2112761.title: CAGED CHARACTER
2112761.description: Suddenly, Fei Xingkong and Si Rui discovered that they were confined to a comic book cage. Their desire was to return to the real world. But in the world of stories that never stops changing, they were forced to escape the total control of the "author"...

2112857.title: My Three-Body
2112857.description: Dr. Cheng Xin, an aerospace specialist, oversaw the Ladder Plan for active reconnaissance of the Three-Body fleet and launched Yun Tianming's donated brain into space in order to combat the impending invasion of Earth by the Three-Body people. Cheng Xin went into hibernation after discovering that Yun Tianming had given her a star and had loved her all her life. After waking up two centuries later, Cheng Xin gave the star to the United Nations, which led to her being chosen as the sword bearer to thwart the Three-Body. However, her generosity provoked the Three-Body to launch a full-scale attack, putting human civilization in jeopardy...

2112939.title: Fabulous Beasts 4
2112939.description: Pipi, a legendary beast from ancient mythology, made his way to human civilization. He ran away to the deer shop that his friend Si Buxiang, who specialized in aiding mythological beasts, opened to avoid being persecuted by humans. In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people. And now let's see what will happen in season 4!

2113079.title: Into the Mortal World
2113079.description: The anime tells the tale of a god who is in charge of "herding stars" and his mischievous sister. This anime creatively connects weaving with the celestial bodies above, retaining the mythological aspects of traditional Chinese culture while also introducing some new ideas.

2113162.title: WIND BREAKER (Thai Dub)
2113162.description: Haruka Sakura is only interested in the most powerful of the strong; he has no desire to connect with weaklings. He recently enrolled in Furin High School, a filthy educational institution defined exclusively by physical prowess, which they use to deter evildoers from their town. But Haruka only wants to fight his way to the top; he doesn't care about being a hero or a member of any group!

2113308.title: The Magical Girl and The Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
2113308.description:
Everything is destroyed by the Evil Organization's invasion. This is the ruthless and crafty lieutenant, the king's right-hand man and the brains behind the operation. The magical girl Byakuya, cursed, is the one responsible for fending off the invasion of Earth. The evil lieutenant Mira is meant to confront the girl, but instead she unexpectedly falls in love at first sight.
This is the tale of the once-enemy magical girl and the evil lieutenant. What would happen to the couple as they refuse to kill as well as love each other?
2113308.originName: かつて魔法少女と悪は敵対していた。

2113390.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
2113390.description:
"Losing heroine" refers to a girl who was not chosen to be her beloved's girlfriend.

Anna Yanami, the gluttonous childhood friend style heroine.
Lemon Yakishio, the vibrant sports style heroine.
Chika Komari, the shy and endearing animal-style heroine.

Become entangled with those somewhat tragic losing heroines,
and here starts a brand-new, chaotic tale about youth!
The losing heroines, just shine in your defeat!
2113390.originName: 負けヒロインが多すぎる！

2113508.title: The Richest Man in Game (Thai Dub)
2113508.description: A special reporter recently held an exclusive interview with Tenda Group President Pei Qian. Tenda Group's present capitalization exceeds $100 billion, and its operations span games, the Internet, digital devices, cultural media, catering, and other industries that have drastically altered people's lives. However, when questioned by reporters, Pei Qian stated, "I'm not a business wizard."My achievement is entirely due to chance! My initial goal was to simply lose 50,000 yuan. That's all..."

2113626.title: Delico's Nursery
2113626.description:
Dali Delico, an aristocrat from the prestigious Delico family and a promising elite member of the Blood Pact Council, faces a significant mission assigned by the Council, the highest governing body of vampires. However, Dali bluntly refuses the task.

Frustrated, his fellow council members, Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique, visit him and try to persuade him, only to find Dali himself caring for a young child.

Meanwhile, a series of mysterious murders targeting vampires are happening in the streets. 
There appears to be a past connection between Dali and the anti-social organization Pendulum, believed to be behind these crimes...

"With all our blood and pride, let's prove that we can balance and achieve both duty and childcare!"

This is a story of the noblesse oblige childcare struggles of vampire aristocrats. 

Can the grand Gothic world coexist with the chaotic but proud act of raising children!?
2113626.originName: デリコズ・ナーサリー

2113722.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible (Thai Dub)
2113722.description:
The newest and strongest old man wants to be an adventurer!
"It is better to follow your dreams while you are still young."
That is the general consensus. However, some adults never give up.

In a world where teens are expected to become adventurers,
Rick Gladiator, a thirty-year-old guild clerk, dreamed of being an adventurer.
He has been training with the members of "Orihalcon Fist," a legendary group that assembles the toughest adventurers on the continent, for the past few days in an unimaginable world.
however, he possesses the fighting prowess of an S-rank, the highest rank, despite being a rookie F-rank!?
2113722.originName: オッサン冒険者、最強パーティに死ぬほど鍛えられて無敵になる。

2113799.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible (Dub Indo)
2113799.description:

2113927.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells (Thai Dub)
2113927.description: High school student Touga Mimori, who is invisible in class, and his peers are unexpectedly called by a goddess to take on heroic roles in a fantastical world. Although the majority of them demonstrate remarkable abilities with S-rank, A-rank, and so forth, Mimori only possesses an E-rank, the lowest rank. Mimori is banished to a dungeon where there is almost no chance of survival because the goddess believes he is useless. But as it happens, his abilities are more unusual than they first appear to be. Then, this insignificant adolescent decides to take revenge on the goddess with giving up his nature.
2113927.originName: ハズレ枠の【状態異常スキル】で最強になった俺がすべてを蹂躙するまで

2114075.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells (Dub Indo)
2114075.description: High school student Touga Mimori, who is invisible in class, and his peers are unexpectedly called by a goddess to take on heroic roles in a fantastical world. 2114145.title: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring (Thai Dub)
2114145.description:
Because of a mistake that God made, Takumi Kayano lost his life and was reincarnated.
After being endowed with a variety of abilities, he was transported to a different planet and dropped into a perilous forest rife with monsters.
Takumi finds a young child and girl in the forest who look to be twins. He names them Alan and Elena and takes them under his protection. Astonished by the ease with which the two vanquish monsters with their martial arts prowess, Takumi arrives in town and joins the adventurer's guild in order to support himself.
He thus takes care of Alan and Elena as they grow up and begin a carefree life filled with adventures!
2114145.originName: 異世界ゆるり紀行 ～子育てしながら冒険者します～

2114220.title: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring (Dub Indo)
2114220.description:
Because of a mistake that God made, Takumi Kayano lost his life and was reincarnated.
