2114333.title: DAN DA DAN
2114333.description:
Born into a family of mediums, high school girl Momo Ayase and her classmate, the occult maniac Takakura Ken, start talking after Momo helps Ken out of a bullying situation in class. However, they quickly find themselves in a heated argument—Momo, who believes in ghosts but denies the existence of aliens, and Ken, who believes in aliens but is skeptical about ghosts.

To prove the existence of what the other denies, Momo decides to visit an abandoned hospital known as a UFO hotspot, while Ken heads to a haunted tunnel. There, both of them encounter overwhelming supernatural phenomena beyond their comprehension. In the midst of this crisis, Momo awakens her hidden powers, and Ken gains the power of a curse, allowing them to face the approaching horrors together. And perhaps, a fated romance begins as well!?

Thus begins their occult battle and youth story!

2114391.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
2114391.description:
A year has passed since the liberation of the "Sanctuary," where Subaru Natsuki fended off Elsa and her relentless attacks and fulfilled a contract with Beatrice in the battle against the Great Rabbit. The Emilia camp, united and strengthened, was enjoying peaceful days as they prepared for the Royal Selection. However, this peace was abruptly shattered by the arrival of a single letter delivered by a messenger. The letter was an invitation addressed to Emilia from Anastasia, one of the Royal Selection candidates, inviting them to Priestella, one of Lugnica's five major cities, known as the Watergate City.

Accepting the invitation, Subaru and his companions set out for Priestella, where they were met with various reunions: one unexpected, one unintended, and one inevitable. Beneath the surface, malicious forces were stirring, and an unprecedented crisis loomed over them. Once again, the boy must face a harsh and unforgiving fate.
2114391.originName: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 3rd season

2114520.title: Roommates
2114520.description: Bai Junyan, a girl with a delicate charm and pure demeanor, like a gentle white lotus, and Luo Ben, with her sophisticated elegance and high standards, a true socialite. These two drama queens end up sharing the same dorm and joining the same drama club. Then, they meet Gao Shu, a cool and distant sophomore heartthrob, and his mysteriously introverted roommate, Ou Yang. With all the key players now on stage, will they reveal their true selves and build genuine connections, or will they engage in a dramatic campus showdown full of intrigue and rivalry?

2114594.title: Senpai is an Otokonoko
2114594.description:
Makoto Hanaoka is a boy who loves cute things and often dresses up as a girl, frequently appearing in school in a feminine guise. One day after school, something unexpected happens: Saki Aoi, a junior who has always mistaken him for a girl, suddenly confesses her love to him. In response to her heartfelt confession, Makoto honestly reveals, "Actually, I'm a boy." However, this rejection doesn't deter Saki; instead, she becomes even more determined, declaring, "I like you, whether you're a boy or a girl!" and boldly proclaiming, "I want to be your first love!"
Meanwhile, Makoto's childhood friend and closest companion, Ryuuji Taiga, quietly stays by his side, secretly harboring feelings for him.
The three of them form an intriguing yet slightly bittersweet romantic drama, as they embark on a poignant story about love, friendship, and growth.

2114739.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets＊
2114739.description: The five beautiful sisters, who once faced the risk of repeating a grade and hated studying, were eventually able to "graduate" successfully with the help of their part-time tutor, Futaro. Although each sister has started pursuing her own dreams, they all seem to have some worries. At this time, Futaro and the sisters planned a honeymoon-like trip to Hawaii. However, just as the trip was about to go smoothly, a certain event was suddenly exposed, throwing everyone into chaos! To make matters worse, during their trip to Hawaii, they also got caught up in various troubles…!?

2114860.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword (Thai Dub)
2114860.description: This is an adventure story about a determined young man named Will Serfort. He makes up his mind to fulfill a childhood promise to his friend by becoming a Magia Vander, who sit at the top of the Tower of Wizards. However, Will has still struggled to perform even the most basic spells. To compensate, he delves into dungeon battles to earn credits at the prestigious Regarden Magic Academy. Despite his magical shortcomings, Will possesses extraordinary swordsmanship skills, which is a legacy from his enigmatic past. Amidst the competitive Magic Academy, Will must confront perilous trials and rivalries while endeavoring to unlock his magical abilities.
2114860.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア

2114999.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword (Dub Indo)
2114999.description: This is an adventure story about a determined young man named Will Serfort. He makes up his mind to fulfill a childhood promise to his friend by becoming a Magia Vander, who sit at the top of the Tower of Wizards. However, Will has still struggled to perform even the most basic spells. To compensate, he delves into dungeon battles to earn credits at the prestigious Regarden Magic Academy. Despite his magical shortcomings, Will possesses extraordinary swordsmanship skills, which is a legacy from his enigmatic past. Amidst the competitive Magic Academy, Will must confront perilous trials and rivalries while endeavoring to unlock his magical abilities.
2114999.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア

2115133.title: FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST (Thai Dub)
2115133.description: After a year of triumphing over the evil forces of Zeref and Acnologia, the Fairy Tail guild sets out to explore the northern continent of Guiltina. There, Natsu Dragneel accompanied by Lucy Heartfilia, Gray Fullbuster, Erza Scarlet, Wendy Marvell, as well as the exceeds Happy and Charlés, they find the employer of the 100 Years Quest and are given an almost unfathomable task: to lock up the Five Dragon Gods, a group of people with such immense power that, if left unchecked, could wipe out the entire human race. As this is going on, Fairy Tail recruits Touka, a passionate new member. There appears to be more to her than meets the eye, despite the fact that her intense passion and lively energy make her ideal for the guild.

2115243.title: FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST (Dub Indo)
2115243.description: After a year of triumphing over the evil forces of Zeref and Acnologia, the Fairy Tail guild sets out to explore the northern continent of Guiltina. There, Natsu Dragneel accompanied by Lucy Heartfilia, Gray Fullbuster, Erza Scarlet, Wendy Marvell, as well as the exceeds Happy and Charlés, they find the employer of the 100 Years Quest and are given an almost unfathomable task: to lock up the Five Dragon Gods, a group of people with such immense power that, if left unchecked, could wipe out the entire human race. As this is going on, Fairy Tail recruits Touka, a passionate new member. There appears to be more to her than meets the eye, despite the fact that her intense passion and lively energy make her ideal for the guild.

2115356.title: Demon Lord, Retry! R
2115356.description:
Akira Oono, who became Kunai Hakuto upon reincarnating into the game, along with the mysterious girl Aku, the saint Luna, and other allies he met in the game and the other world, steadily built up his influence in this new realm. Now, he sets out on a new journey to find a way back to the real world.

The story revolving around the "Demon Lord" begins to move forward once again...!

2115457.title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 2
2115457.description:
As past and present converge, a new chapter of the Isekai fantasy begins!

Rio, a boy who witnessed his mother’s murder and became an orphan in the slums, had his life completely turned upside down at the age of seven. On that day, the memories of Haruto Amakawa, a Japanese university student who had died in a tragic accident, resurfaced within him, awakening a vast magical power.

Having experienced many encounters and farewells, Rio swore an oath of vengeance against the nemesis who killed his mother, vowing to avenge her in the homeland of his parents.

After several years of travel, Rio returns to the Strahl region, where he rescues his mentor, Celia, from a forced political marriage. However, immediately after, he is guided by a pillar of light that suddenly appears, leading him to a shocking reunion with Miharu Ayase—the girl who was Haruto Amakawa’s first love in his previous life.

2115522.title: Negative Positive Angler
2115522.description:
Sasaki Tsunehiro, a university student burdened by significant debt and given only two years to live by his doctor, is engulfed in despair. His life takes a turn when he is pursued by debt collectors and falls into the sea.

He is rescued by Hana, a fishing enthusiast, and her fishing partner Takaaki and others. This encounter leads Tsunehiro to try fishing for the first time. Despite his ongoing struggles, he begins to bond with Hana and Takaaki and starts working part-time at their convenience store.

As he faces the challenges of complex fishing terms and the smell of live bait, Tsunehiro finds himself increasingly drawn to the sport. The sensations of the bites on his line give him a tangible sense of life.

In a life marked by constant downfall and merely looking up at the world, what does Tsunehiro discover through fishing?

2115664.title: The Most Notorious “Talker” Runs the World’s Greatest Clan
2115664.description: Noel longs to be a Seeker like his heroic grandfather, slaying the beasts that emerge from Abysses and exploring far-off lands. Unfortunately, it turns out he's nothing but a measly Talker–a job with no combat skills whatsoever. Undaunted, Noel sets out to establish the strongest clan in all the land, using his silver-tongued Talker skills to unite assassins and heroes under his leadership.
2115664.originName: 最凶の支援職【話術士】である俺は世界最強クランを従える

2115714.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Conflict
2115714.description:
The blood war between Soul Reapers and Quincies intensifies after the Wandenreich’s second wave of attack transforms the Seireitei into a dimension known as the Schatten Bereich.
Undaunted, the Thirteen Court Guard Squads reclaim their stolen Bankai to strike back and defeat several of the Stern Ritter’s most powerful members, the Wörtlich.
As the battle wages on, Renji Abarai, Rukia Kuchiki, and finally Ichigo Kurosaki each complete their training at the Royal Palace and return to the Seireitei to help the Soul Reapers with their newly acquired powers and abilities.
However, Ichigo’s attempt to stop Yhwach is thwarted by Uryu Ishida. A shocked Ichigo demands Uryu to explain his true intention for pointing his weapon toward his friends. But the only answer he gets from Uryu is a rain of arrows to signal the end of their friendship.
With Uryu and the Royal Guards at his side, Yhwach successfully breaks past the Soul Shield Membrane barrier and finally sets foot into the sacred realm of the Royal Palace.
But the Quincies’ advance seemingly ends after facing Squad Zero, who use their awesome powers to defeat Yhwach and the rest of the uninvited guests. However, the real battle and despair have yet to start…
2115714.originName: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-相剋譚-

2115780.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 2
2115780.description:
When a Japanese salaryman passes away and reincarnates as Ars Louvent, the heir of an aristocratic family, he learns that he is also capable of evaluating the abilities and talents of others. In order to prepare for the impending battle for the throne's succession, Ars uses his unique abilities to find and persuade strong people who excel in a variety of fields, from magic and swordplay to strategy and diplomacy, to join his allies and servants.

And now the new chapters start...
2115780.originName: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる 第2期

2115894.title: DEMON LORD 2099
2115894.description: Shinjuku, the cyberpunk metropolis, is a vast city-state covered in tall skyscrapers, neon signs, and the newest cutting-edge technology. The fabled Demon Lord Veltol is creating his second coming five centuries here, in the year 2099 of the Fused Era. However, this terrain is quite different from the one he overcame all those years ago since magic and engineering have come together to bring civilization to previously unheard-of heights. Though Veltol may have become little more than a historical footnote, this bright new world will be all his to claim!

2116038.title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire
2116038.description:
For those who brave great risks to search for glory by breaking into treasure vaults across the globe, the era of opportunity has arrived. Achievers will gain unimaginable riches, notoriety, and influence.

"Come on, let us find treasure!"

When young Krai discovered he was missing a treasure-hunting bone in his body, this promise between Krai Andrey and his friends came to an unfortunate end. However, for some reason, Krai's reputation and the risk to his life both kept rising. Krai masterfully mastered the art of pleading and begging, while his friends turned into even more rapacious beasts!

See the prosperity and suffering of a man who merely desires retirement.
2116038.originName: 嘆きの亡霊は引退したい

2116146.title: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su 2nd Season
2116146.description:
Gaming on a monitor is out of date, and immersive VR games are already widely available. The market is overrun with "trash games," which are games that have superb imaging technology but whose systems can't keep up, in contrast to the extremely few masterpieces. And then there are those (perverts) who simply like engaging in this sort of "trash trick" that is detested by the general populace. One of them—the "trash trick hunter"—is Rakur Hizutome. Rakur Hizutome attacked the masterpiece "Shangri-La Frontier" this time in an effort to alter his taste. He had numerous weird adventures and met many different partners while playing the game, and that is where the job started.

You can look forward to the second season in October 2024! Stay tuned!!!
2116146.originName: シャングリラ・フロンティア～クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす～ 2nd season

2116217.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest Season 3
2116217.description:
Hajime and his allies thwart the demon tribe's invasion of the royal capital and vanquish God's apostle Noint.
They choose to accompany Princess Liliana to the imperial capital in order to request assistance from the Hoelscher Empire for the damaged Heiligh Kingdom, prior to conquering the other two great labyrinths.
Hajime swears to utilize his skills liberally for Shea's benefit after finding out that the empire has imprisoned Cam, the leader of the tribe!!

"Well, let's get the party started!"
2116217.originName: ありふれた職業で世界最強　第3期

2116309.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii
2116309.description:
If it weren't for the fact that Yoshino Somei is the granddaughter of the head of the Somei Group, the biggest yakuza organization in the Kansai region, centered in Osaka, she would have been an ordinary high school student. When Yoshino learns one day that the Somei and Miyama groups, the two largest syndicates in Kanto have united, she rushes home. The story claims that this will lead to the grandchildren of the leaders getting married, including Yoshino herself! Yoshino is forced to travel to Tokyo to see her fiancé, Kirishima Miyama, who is surprisingly kind and charming, despite her best attempts to cancel the arrangement. 
After meeting, Yoshino gets entangled in a series of circumstances that make her want to move to Tokyo and, six months later, she's living with the Miyama group. She quickly learns that Kirishima is highly well-liked at school, and as a result, her friendship with him incites the wrath of his fangirls and leads to bullying. Adding insult to injury, Kirishima was born into a yakuza family, thus he was the furthest thing from her ideal partner.

2116452.title: Loner Life in Another World
2116452.description: The acerbic loner Haruka isn't too interested in traveling, but he wouldn't mind having some cool powers when he and his class are transported to another world. Unfortunately, Haruka has no decent options remaining by the time it's his turn because he is last in line when the magic cheat skills are distributed. Haruka will now have to face this fantastical world head-on, by himself, with a jumble of odd abilities! Can this quiet guy step in and save his classmates when there's mayhem and infighting?
2116452.originName: ひとりぼっちの異世界攻略

2116509.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online II Edit
2116509.description:
Squad Jam is a survival match between squads of up to six people.
Many GGO players take part in this tournament, which is well-liked by maniacs; some come to battle to fight to the death, while others gather to seek fame, retribution, or a worthy opponent.
After an intense battle, the Second Squad Jam (SJ2) concluded three months ago, and it was finally decided to hold the Third Squad Jam (SJ3).
Llenn, along with Pitohui, Em, and Fukaziroh, has formed a new team called "LPFM." They set out for a small island that will serve as the tournament's battlefield, only to find themselves in a difficult situation that includes "a field that sinks into the sea over time," "an [UNKNOWN] area lurking in the center of the map," and "the collusion of unknown teams."
And thus begins the third carnival, in which the pride and resolve of every team are at stake!
2116509.originName: ガンゲイル・オンライン 2

2116570.title: Good Bye, Dragon Life
2116570.description:
A long time ago, one human defeated the oldest and strongest dragon alive. Even the gods were afraid of this dragon because of its strength, but it chose to meet its demise on its own. The dragon then abruptly awoke to a new existence as Dolan, a man who lived in a remote village.

Dolan now lives a normal life, toiling away in the fields and going on food quests. He finds happiness in the village, despite its simplicity, which he had never experienced as a dragon.
2116570.originName: さようなら竜生、こんにちは人生

2116670.title: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
2116670.description:
After growing up in an orphanage, Uryu is adopted by the head priest of Kyoto's Amagami Shrine and turns into a freeloader. 
There, he will live among the three shrine maiden sisters, Asahi, Yuna, and Yae! 
He "takes over the shrine as an adopted son-in-law"!? That's the requirement for being a freeloader, right? 
Three sisters, an arranged marriage, and challenging issues that face Amagami Shrine... Will Uryu be successful in defeating them?

A miraculous romantic comedy created by Mikos who shared the same home!

2116759.title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? V
2116759.description: The fruit festival known as Goddess Festival is what breathes life into the maze-like city of Orario. The altar contains images of fertility goddesses, including the Goddess of Beauty. After emerging alive from the shadowy depths of the dungeon, Bell Cranel is all set to revel in the excitement of the Goddess Festival. That is, until he gets a letter from a girl in a little Orario bar saying, "To Mr. Bell: Would you kindly take us out on a date at the next Goddess Festival? From Syr." Syr's unwavering resolve will make Bell and the maze-like city go insane. The Einherjar, a group of fighters who pride themselves on being the "strongest," are suddenly in motion in the meantime.
2116759.originName: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうかV

2116889.title: Mecha-Ude: Mechanical Arms
2116889.description:
Aeons ago, extraterrestrial organisms arrived on Earth and began to fuse with human beings, giving rise to the moniker "Mecha-ude," because of the remarkable resemblance of the fused organisms to mechanized limbs. Hikaru Amatsuga, an ordinary middle school student, is forced to work in unison with the incredibly rare and unique Mecha-ude Arma. The resistance organization ARMS assigns the dual Mecha-ude user Aki Murasame to follow Alma wherever he goes in order to protect him, but she is also searching for a mysterious Snake-Type Mecha-ude wielder, who has left many of her allies in a critical condition.

In the background, a group called the Kagami Group is looking for the fabled "Trigger Arm," a Mecha-ude that is supposed to give unrestricted power. Hikaru and Alma must work together to muster the strength to fight back when this organization threatens Aki's life. Along the way, Hikaru will realize that his life will never be the same.

2117053.title: Tales of Herding Gods
2117053.description: In Can Lao village, there lived nine enigmatic elders and the young Qin Mu who was raised by the elders. One day, the cow that Qin Mu was herding surprisingly spoke human language.Since then, Qin Mu has become more aware of the dangers and enchantments of the forsaken land of Da Xu: demons descend with the darkness, divine bones dance in the ruins, dragon bones protect their young, and a giant ship drags the sun... No matter what kind of danger he faces, Qin Mu is fearless. He integrates the skills passed down by the nine elders and vows to carve out his own realm with a peerless and domineering physique.

2117186.title: Link Click Bridon Arc
2117186.description: In order to save the deceased Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang returned to the beginning and started anew along the path of destiny. However, a photograph carrying clues about Cheng Xiaoshi's parents appeared at the Time Photo Studio. To uncover the truth, Lu Guang, with a heart full of anxiety, went to Yingdu with Cheng Xiaoshi. Facing people with different purposes, such as the seemingly friendly popular model Xia Fei, the eccentric leader of Chinatown Vein, and the mysteriously appearing Liu Xiao... can Lu Guang break the destined dead end?
2117186.originName: 时光代理人 英都篇

2117266.title: One Way or Another
2117266.description: In the village hidden within the Chaotian Continent, Jing Jiu unexpectedly takes in Liu Shisu, a child prodigy with a natural Taoist seed, as his book attendant. The two of them come to Qing Shan Sect by chance, yet Jing Jiu, who is considered ordinary, actually serves the prodigy Liu Shisu as his servant, which draws criticism from others. At the Sword Inheritance Conference, Jing Jiu also meets Zhao La Yue, the girl from Shen Mo Peak. “Lazy” Jing Jiu just wants to cultivate in peace, but little does he know that fate will pull the three of them into a huge dispute in the martial world...

2117403.title: Rakshasa Street S4
2117403.description: Cao Yanbing and his group are framed by the God Martial Spirit Legion led by Huangfu Longdou after the destruction of the Reed Catkins Tower, and they are all wanted by the Spirit World. Later, in order to find out the whereabouts of his mother, Cao Yanbing deliberately gets captured in the death prison “Qianji Black Rakshasa”, which is guarded by Hall of Fame. To save Cao Yanbing, his companions gather support from various sides, and all forces converge on Hall of Fame, launching an extraordinary battle of the elite.

2117502.title: Great Journey of Teenagers 4
2117502.description:
After bidding farewell to the immortal mountains, Mo Yi and Bai Li Dongjun, two peerless masters, retreat from the world. Xiao Se's hidden meridians have been restored, and he returns to Heavenly Phase. Lei Wujie and others have also received gifts from immortals, and their strength has been enhanced to varying degrees. Everyone is determined to head to Tianqi City. After a farewell in the martial world, they will meet again in the court. The three major forces of Yong'an Prince Xiao Se, the White Prince Xiao Chong, and the Red Prince Xiao Yu gather together, and the struggle for the throne officially begins. Who will ascend to the position of the Tianqi Emperor?
With a single spear, Xiao Se returns to Tianqi City. Watch how Xiao Se turns dangers into safety and reverses the situation.

2117650.title: A War between Humans and AI
2117650.description: On an unknown continent, there is a city called Satellite City No. 9. In this city, a screw straightening worker named Rui Li at the screw factory gradually realizes the unreality of the city in her monotonous daily work. With the help of a mysterious character named “Anull”, Rui Li gains the superpower of “transformation” and becomes the thief “Sirius”, secretly taking action to escape from here. When the truth of the world finally unfolds before her eyes, Rui Li discovers that her real battle has just begun...

2117727.title: A Herbivorous Dragon of 5,000 Years Gets Unfairly Villainized S2
2117727.description: The vegan dragon, who wanted nothing more than to live a peaceful life away from the world's strife, encountered the melodramatic girl named Reiko. Unable to dissuade her from her determined path towards death, no matter how gently it tried to persuade her, the desperate dragon had no choice but to fabricate a lie to keep Reiko alive. Under the lies woven by the “Evil Dragon”, Reiko embarked on a journey to conquer the Demon King's army, alongside the strongest "Evil Dragon" she believed in.
2117727.originName: 食草老龙被冠以恶龙之名 第二季

2117802.title: Tiger Crane
2117802.description: The frank and straightforward wandering hero, Hu Zi, and the outwardly aloof yet kind-hearted noble man, Qi Xiaoxuan, become acquainted through conflict. From mutual disdain to becoming friends like "tiger and crane," they unite with a group of partners who are "adorably naive foodies" and "smiling with a sinister heart." In the end, they uncover the royal sorcerer's conspiracy, eliminate evil, and uphold justice in the human world.

2118081.title: BLUE LOCK VS. U-20 JAPAN
2118081.description: In order to cultivate a forward who can lead the Japanese team to win the World Cup, the Japan Football Association has devised a plan called “Blue Lock”. 300 school students are summoned here, and all of them are forwards. They will undergo a rigorous selection and training process in this plan. Gambling on their respective football careers, who exactly is the forward that can bring about a revolution in Japanese football?
2118081.originName: ブルーロック VS. U-20 JAPAN

2118206.title: The Healer who was Banished from his Party is in fact the Strongest
2118206.description:
One of the many labyrinth cities in the world is called Martat. There lived a man named Raust, who was a healer by trade. Due to his incompetence, other adventurers rejected, used, and discarded him. 

Raust went through this cycle repeatedly until one day a girl named Narsena, a martial artist, appeared in front of Raust. Narsena asked Raust, who had just been kicked out of a party, "Big brother, would you like to form a party with me?"
2118206.originName: パーティーから追放されたその治癒師、実は最強につき

2118294.title: How I Attended an All-Guy's Mixer
2118294.description: A girl from the same seminar group named Suou extends an invitation to Tokiwa, a university student, to a matchmaking party. He excitedly heads to the izakaya with his two friends, Asagi and Hagi, who are also attending a matchmaking party for the first time. Sensing that the women have already reached the bar, he quickly makes his way to his seat so as not to delay them. However, he discovers three strikingly attractive men there...
2118294.originName: 合コンに行ったら女がいなかった話

2118373.title: TSUMASHO
2118373.description:
After losing his wife ten years ago, Keisuke Niijima, a loving husband, has been living in despair.
However, Marika Shiraishi, an elementary school student, shows up one day and introduces herself as his late wife Takae.
And so, with his wife taking the shape of an elementary school student, Niijima Keisuke's life starts to move again...

2118497.title: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
2118497.description:
Teacher Abe Haruaki is a shy and overly sensitive newcomer.
Although he is thrilled to have attained his goal of becoming a teacher, his joy is short-lived!
Hyakki Academy, the institution to which he has been assigned, is exclusively run by and for monsters!
Why had the principal of the school hired Haruaki, a timid, weak-willed human being?

Thus, it is a comedy that shows the odd and colorful everyday lives of Haruaki, the eccentric human teacher, and his varied group of youkai instructors and students—each with their own unique personalities!
2118497.originName: 妖怪学校の先生はじめました！(前半)

2118582.title: DAN DA DAN (Thai Dub)
2118582.description:
Born into a family of mediums, high school girl Momo Ayase and her classmate, the occult maniac Takakura Ken, start talking after Momo helps Ken out of a bullying situation in class. However, they quickly find themselves in a heated argument—Momo, who believes in ghosts but denies the existence of aliens, and Ken, who believes in aliens but is skeptical about ghosts.

To prove the existence of what the other denies, Momo decides to visit an abandoned hospital known as a UFO hotspot, while Ken heads to a haunted tunnel. There, both of them encounter overwhelming supernatural phenomena beyond their comprehension. In the midst of this crisis, Momo awakens her hidden powers, and Ken gains the power of a curse, allowing them to face the approaching horrors together. And perhaps, a fated romance begins as well!?

Thus begins their occult battle and youth story!

2118645.title: Blue Exorcist -Beyond the Snow Saga-
2118645.description:
The world of humans, Assiah, and the world of demons, Gehenna. Though these two dimensions should never meet, the demons are now encroaching on the material world because they possess all material substances. However, among the human race, there are those who can exorcise such demons: the Exorcists.
There is an episode in Beyond the Snow Saga where Kirigakure Shura faces his fate and the dark side of the True Cross Order is revealed.
2118645.originName: 青の祓魔師 雪ノ果篇

2118856.title: Spy x Sect
2118856.description: A legendary hacker, hunted to death by the system’s AI in a desperate bid to save humanity, unexpectedly awakens as the sect master of the foremost clan in another world. Yet, faced with an inner circle riddled with spies and the systemic crisis that came along with him, Chen Ning resolves to lie low and bide his time. But like a sharp point revealed within a pouch, even with his cold‑blooded resolve and a heart devoted to all living things, he finds himself entangled in every bloom he brushes past. Ultimately, with the aid of the system’s agent, Jiang Que, Chen Ning shakes off his humble guise, and friend and foe alike bow before his kingly might. The world’s hidden truths tumble forth, one after another, as he at last unravels the apocalyptic threat and saves existence itself.
2118856.originName: 宗门里除了我都是卧底

2118988.title: DAN DA DAN (Dub Indo)
2118988.description:
Born into a family of mediums, high school girl Momo Ayase and her classmate, the occult maniac Takakura Ken, start talking after Momo helps Ken out of a bullying situation in class. To prove the existence of what the other denies, Momo decides to visit an abandoned hospital known as a UFO hotspot, while Ken heads to a haunted tunnel. There, both of them encounter overwhelming supernatural phenomena beyond their comprehension. In the midst of this crisis, Momo awakens her hidden powers, and Ken gains the power of a curse, allowing them to face the approaching horrors together. And perhaps, a fated romance begins as well!?

Thus begins their occult battle and youth story!

2120664.title: Xyrin Empire
2120664.description: Chen Jun, an aimless wannabe otaku, suddenly became the Emperor of a multiverse-spanning kingdom. The Empress Sandora, the Empire's 1.2-meter-tall female general Pandora, and the Supernatural Bureau's Big Sis Lin Xue have all said they're not up to the task. Even Chen Jun's childhood sweetheart, the energetic Xu Qianqian, also said he must become the Emperor. Chen Jun did not have a choice and started his busy life by saving the world from Monday to Friday and playing games during the weekends.

2121327.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 (Thai Dub)
2121327.description:
A year has passed since the liberation of the "Sanctuary," where Subaru Natsuki fended off Elsa and her relentless attacks and fulfilled a contract with Beatrice in the battle against the Great Rabbit. The Emilia camp, united and strengthened, was enjoying peaceful days as they prepared for the Royal Selection. However, this peace was abruptly shattered by the arrival of a single letter delivered by a messenger. The letter was an invitation addressed to Emilia from Anastasia, one of the Royal Selection candidates, inviting them to Priestella, one of Lugnica's five major cities, known as the Watergate City.

Accepting the invitation, Subaru and his companions set out for Priestella, where they were met with various reunions: one unexpected, one unintended, and one inevitable. Beneath the surface, malicious forces were stirring, and an unprecedented crisis loomed over them. Once again, the boy must face a harsh and unforgiving fate.
2121327.originName: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 3rd season

2121431.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3 (Dub Indo)
2121431.description:
A year has passed since the liberation of the "Sanctuary," where Subaru Natsuki fended off Elsa and her relentless attacks and fulfilled a contract with Beatrice in the battle against the Great Rabbit. The Emilia camp, united and strengthened, was enjoying peaceful days as they prepared for the Royal Selection. However, this peace was abruptly shattered by the arrival of a single letter delivered by a messenger. The letter was an invitation addressed to Emilia from Anastasia, one of the Royal Selection candidates, inviting them to Priestella, one of Lugnica's five major cities, known as the Watergate City.

Accepting the invitation, Subaru and his companions set out for Priestella, where they were met with various reunions: one unexpected, one unintended, and one inevitable. Beneath the surface, malicious forces were stirring, and an unprecedented crisis loomed over them. Once again, the boy must face a harsh and unforgiving fate.
2121431.originName: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 3rd season

2121485.title: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su 2nd Season (Thai Dub)
2121485.description:
Gaming on a monitor is out of date, and immersive VR games are already widely available. The market is overrun with "trash games," which are games that have superb imaging technology but whose systems can't keep up, in contrast to the extremely few masterpieces. And then there are those (perverts) who simply like engaging in this sort of "trash trick" that is detested by the general populace. One of them—the "trash trick hunter"—is Rakur Hizutome. Rakur Hizutome attacked the masterpiece "Shangri-La Frontier" this time in an effort to alter his taste. He had numerous weird adventures and met many different partners while playing the game, and that is where the job started.

You can look forward to the second season in October 2024! Stay tuned!!!
2121485.originName: シャングリラ・フロンティア～クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす～ 2nd season

2121610.title: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su 2nd Season (Dub Indo)
2121610.description:
Gaming on a monitor is out of date, and immersive VR games are already widely available. The market is overrun with "trash games," which are games that have superb imaging technology but whose systems can't keep up, in contrast to the extremely few masterpieces. He had numerous weird adventures and met many different partners while playing the game, and that is where the job started.

You can look forward to the second season in October 2024! Stay tuned!!!
2121610.originName: シャングリラ・フロンティア～クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす～ 2nd season

2121697.title: Blue Exorcist -Beyond the Snow Saga(Thai Dub)
2121697.description:
The world of humans, Assiah, and the world of demons, Gehenna. Though these two dimensions should never meet, the demons are now encroaching on the material world because they possess all material substances. However, among the human race, there are those who can exorcise such demons: the Exorcists.
There is an episode in Beyond the Snow Saga where Kirigakure Shura faces his fate and the dark side of the True Cross Order is revealed.
The truth about the "Blue Night" and the mystery surrounding Okumura Rin and Yukio's birth are revealed in "The End of the Night."
The central mystery of "Blue Exorcist" is ultimately revealed in the story.
2121697.originName: 青の祓魔師 雪ノ果篇

2121835.title: To Be Hero X
2121835.description: This is a world where heroes are created by people's trust, and the hero who has received the most trust is known as - X. In this world, people's trust can be calculated by data, and these values will be reflected on everyone's wrist. As long as enough trust points are obtained, ordinary people can also have superpowers and become superheroes that save the world. However, the ever-changing trust value makes the hero's path full of unknowns...

2121892.title: Flower and Asura
2121892.description: About 600 people live on the little island of Tonakijima, where Hana enjoys reading to the kids. Mizuki, the head of the school's broadcasting club, invites Hana to join the group after noticing her ability to captivate audiences with her stories. With the members of the broadcasting club, Hana has tried many things for the first time as she starts her new journey, which further enhances her love of reading.

2121960.title: I Have a Crush at Work
2121960.description: Masugu Tateishi and Yui Mitsuya are not just any coworkers, they are completely smitten with one another. Her cuteness makes him smile foolishly, and his helpful but modest demeanor makes her excited. The problem is that they're trying to keep their new relationship under wraps to avoid making things awkward at work. But with every day that goes by at work, they run the risk of revealing their little secret because they can not keep their hands off each other.
2121960.originName: この会社に好きな人がいます。

2122082.title: I Left my A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
2122082.description: The red wizard Yuke Feldio recently departed his adventurer A-Rank group and shouted "I can no longer do this". He finally lost it after five years of being teased and humiliated as a handyman! And thus began his life of unemployment and desolation... or so he believed! Yuke is fortunate enough to be accepted into an all-female adventurer group made up of his former pupils! They eventually uncover Yuke's real strength as they conquer dungeon after dungeon! This crimson magician turns out to have remarkable abilities and powers!
2122082.originName: Aランクパーティーを離脱した俺は、元教え子たちと迷宮深部を目指す

2122155.title: Beheneko: The Elf-Girl’s Cat is Secretly an S-Ranked Monster!
2122155.description: After being killed in combat, a proud knight is brought back to life and reincarnates as a terrifying behemoth. This turn of events has left him even more perplexed—apparently, behemoth cubs resemble cute kittens! His honor as a brave warrior and his might as an unbeatable S-ranked monster will be tested as he battles to save the lovely elf who has adopted him as her pet, despite the fact that the rest of the world views him as soft and cuddly.
2122155.originName: Sランクモンスターの《ベヒーモス》だけど、猫と間違われてエルフ娘の騎士（ペット）として暮らしてます

2122270.title: I’m Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi!?
2122270.description:
The brilliant kunoichi Shizuri Ideura has established a master-servant contract with Tsukasa Atsumi, an ordinary office worker, on the condition that she let him reside with her in order to protect him from demons.
Shizuri is an otaku and NEET who spends all of her time playing video games, despite her stylish appearance while she battles demons.
Shizuri lives a sedentary existence with Tsukasa, who spoils her, while a bunch of kunoichi with distinctive personalities congregate around her.
Here's a romantic comedy about cohabitating with a NEET and otaku genius kunoichi!
2122270.originName: ニートくノ一となぜか同棲はじめました

2122339.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four!
2122339.description: Dennosuke Uchimura is a typical salaryman who aspires to advance in his career. The Demon Overlord then summons him to a horrific fantasy world and offers him a new position with all the perks of a Heavenly King in his army! Even though Uchimura lacks magic and physical strength, he has the intelligence and talents of an office worker. Are they able to be sufficient to sustain him?
2122339.originName: サラリーマンが異世界に行ったら四天王になった話

2122416.title: Honey Lemon Soda
2122416.description:
Middle school was the most difficult time of Uka Ishimori's life at the age of 15. Because of her constant freezing in front of others, she was nicknamed "stone" and endured constant bullying as a result. She has an opportunity to start over and better herself now that she is in high school. Kai Miura, a flamboyant guy with lemon-colored hair, accidentally soaks her with the juice during her first week.

Kai appears to be everything that Uka is not: popular, distant, and self-assured enough to express his opinions. Despite their divergent personalities, Kai supports her in gradually emerging from her shell and lends a helping hand when others were reluctant to do so. Uka has come to terms with her genuine feelings—she has fallen in love with Kai—despite her original desire to make friends. The lives of Uka and Kai would soon be permanently altered by what began with a lemon soda.

2122554.title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
2122554.description:
He used to be a 52-year-old civil servant named Kenzaburou Tondabayashi in contemporary Japan, but now he is the evil! Kenzaburou is somewhat perplexed after being reborn as Grace Auvergne, the drill-haired villain from an otome game his daughter used to play.

Kenzaburou understands he should be a haughty aristocratic girl based on the facts he has, but the well-behaved elder guy can not act like that. He befriends the heroine because of his serene and compassionate demeanor, which further makes him adored by the student body as the epitome of style. Kenzaburou will need to use his years of job experience, impeccable Japanese etiquette, and family-oriented values to blend in with the other children while attempting to keep the plot moving forward.
2122554.originName: 悪役令嬢転生おじさん

2122949.title: Everything is Fine with the Emperor
2122949.description: Yao Ji has reincarnated as the form of a fairy! To locate the sacred stone, she needs Liu Ling, the unloved prince who can see immortal to help her. They come to an agreement and find concubines who can teach them specialized talents. Successfully, Liu Ling assumes the role of crown prince. He suddenly discovers that he has some affections for Yao Ji during the days when they get along...

2123062.title: The Legend of Princess Chang-Ge
2123062.description:
Prince Li Jiancheng and his supporters were put to death following the Xuanwu Gate Incident, and all six of his sons—aside from one who passed away too soon—were implicated. Only the records of "the second daughter Wenxi County Lady Li Wanshun, courtesy name Wangniang, married Liu Yingdao" and "eldest daughter Li" remained in the historical record, nevertheless.

The Yongning Princess Li Changge, whose parents had an unexplained and perplexing relationship with Li Shimin, emerged in these Li's mysteries. After learning of her mother's suicide and her father's murder following the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Changge fled the palace with bitterness and assumed the identity of a man in order to conceal her identity and bring troops back to Chang'an to exact revenge on her parents.

2123158.title: The Destiny Ruler
2123158.description:
Since ancient times, Dahe Shenzhou has been a land where virtue and evil have been at odds. Numerous justice-related sects have banded together to combat the evil's twelve irresponsible sects. The justice Jinyi Sect's low-level supernatural power is Li Wannian, who possesses ordinary cultivation. He wants to live a life of peace and quiet, lying flat in the Jinyi Sect and receiving a salary.

He unexpectedly learned, however, that he possessed the eternal capacity to instantly resurrect at the point of life-or-death crisis while completing a task to deal with the transfer. More significantly, he can improve his cultivation after each resurrection by receiving incentives in the form of points based on his overall performance at the time of his beheading. To put it another way, Li Wannian has to make a valiant sacrifice, and in a way that inspires and motivates others if he hopes to advance his cultivation.

2123406.title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
2123406.description:
The work is completely safe. Additionally, the position is stable because it is public work.
She smiles as she leads explorers through the counter while wearing a nice uniform.
She casually finishes her paperwork after reception hours are finished and leaves for home at the appointed time.
Unwind at her cherished house and return to work with renewed vigor the next day.
It should have been so perfect for Alina Clover's work.
But, the situation was anything but perfect.
The counter becomes crowded if the dungeon strategy is halted.
Adventurers sometimes request problematic answers.
There will be a ton of paperwork to deal with even if Alina manages to get past a problematic customer while grinning and crying within.
It will be even more difficult if Alina waits until tomorrow, but she is currently lacking motivation.
And as a result, Alina is putting in enormous amounts of overtime every day.
2123406.originName: ギルドの受付嬢ですが、残業は嫌なのでボスをソロ討伐しようと思います

2123536.title: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I'm Actually the Strongest
2123536.description: Ein's job as "Appraiser" has placed him as far from the "hero" pedestal as possible in a mythical world where "jobs" are divinely assigned from birth. Heroes are born, not created. After being mistreated and subsequently left behind by his fellow explorers, Ein concludes it is simply not worth continuing. However, Ein is fortunate that the end may also be the beginning—and a fresh start. His "worthless" work might actually be the secret to becoming a hero after all.
2123536.originName: 不遇職鑑定士が実は最強だった

2123611.title: Blue Exorcist -The Blue Night Saga-
2123611.description:
The truth about the "Blue Night" and the mystery surrounding Okumura Rin and Yukio's birth are revealed in "The End of the Night."
The central mystery of "Blue Exorcist" is ultimately revealed in the story.
2123611.originName: 青の祓魔師 終夜篇

2123726.title: Solo Leveling Season 2 -Arise from the Shadow-
2123726.description:
It has been more than ten years since gateways, or "Gates," that connect other dimensions to our world started to appear all over the world. These Gates brought with them a constant battle between superhumanly powerful people, or "Hunters," and the monsters that lurk in the dungeons beyond. Normally, a Hunter's abilities do not increase or change rank after awakening, but during a raid in a rare double dungeon, low-ranked Hunter Sung Jinwoo, who was formerly known as "The Weakest Hunter of All Mankind," gained the extraordinary ability to "Level Up."
Jinwoo refined his skills through unrelenting combat and ultimately finished a "Job Change Quest," earning the title of "Shadow Monarch," which grants him command over an army of shadow troops. Jinwoo now embarks on a new quest to gather supplies for the "Holy Water of Life" in the hopes of healing his sick mother.
2123726.originName: 俺だけレベルアップな件 S2

2123789.title: Dr. STONE Season 4
2123789.description:
Senku and his allies make it back to the Science Kingdom safely after the intense battle on Treasure Island.
After putting Tsukasa to sleep, they are able to bring him back to life with the help of the petrification apparatus they acquired.
As a result, Tsukasa joins the Science Kingdom!
After learning that Whyman, the genius behind the petrification of humanity, has its headquarters on the moon, Senku and his comrades decide to go there!
They take on the ambitious task of creating a starship from the ground up in this stone world.
In order to collect supplies for the spaceship from all across the world, Senku and his pals promptly set sail on the ocean in the Perseus.
Their first goal is the Americas, where they seek vast amounts of corn, the raw material for the Revival Fluid.
At the conclusion of this incredible journey that will put their bravery, solidarity, and scientific prowess to the test, Senku and his pals will face a terrifying threat!

2123859.title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
2123859.description:
The only pastime of Kazuhiro Kitase is sleeping. From an early age, he would dream about exciting adventures and inhabit a wonderful world. An excursion he embarks on with an elf girl he made friends with in his dream world is abruptly cut short as a dragon's breath scorches them both! When he awakens from his dream, he sees a familiar sleeper—the elf girl he has been dreaming about!

With Ms. Elf, accompany Kazuhiro on his latest travels across Japan!
2123859.originName: 日本へようこそエルフさん

2123944.title: TASOKARE HOTEL
2123944.description: There is no difference between day and night at the Tasokare Hotel, which is completely enveloped in twilight throughout the day. As a transitional space between life and death, it serves as a haven for souls who are unsure whether to go to the afterlife or stay in this world. Without knowing who she is or why she is there, the main character, Neko Tsukahara, wanders into the Tasokare Hotel. The hotel staff leads her to her room. "Items in the room that are associated with the customer's recollections should be there. These could be hints that help the client remember things. As she looks for a means to get back to the present and recall who she is, she comes across a particular incident.

2124074.title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
2124074.description:
Mizuho, a high school sophomore, is experiencing the worst 17th birthday imaginable.
She won’t get the chance to grow closer to the senior she admires, and her parents have completely forgotten her special day.

On top of that, Mizuho feels she’ll never truly experience a “sparkling youth,” as a mysterious infectious disease has led to the cancellation of all club activities and school trips.

Just then, Kizuki, her childhood friend, suddenly declares himself as one of her potential boyfriends!

Mizuho Nishino, the heroine of this school-life tale, has now started dating four childhood friends with whom she’s practically grown up like family!
2124074.originName: どうせ、恋してしまうんだ

2124185.title: MOMENTARY LILY
2124185.description: All life was wiped off by robotic invaders, but Renge uses her abilities to fight for survival. She wanders about the city without any memories until she meets five other young ladies, each of whom has special skills. They spend their best lives together, preparing delectable dinners in between encounters with mechanical monsters. Their bond becomes stronger as they learn more about their pasts and abilities.

2124244.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
2124244.description:
Saito Hōjō, a high school student, married his classmate, Akane Sakuramori, who is his archenemy and the person he despises the most at school.
"If you tell anyone in class that you are married to me, I will murder you." "I also do not want my marital status to be known. It has no advantages."
Due to their frequent arguments and general disdain of one another, marital life is hard for these two. But as their everyday lives become increasingly intertwined, they spend more time together enjoying themselves and eventually learn to understand one another.

Saito discovers Akane's adorable side, which he had never seen before, and Akane slowly starts to realize the feelings she has been keeping hidden in her heart. The heart-pounding new life of these two, who appear to be able to be honest with one another but are unable to, starts here!
2124244.originName: クラスの大嫌いな女子と結婚することになった

2124364.title: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I'm Actually the Strongest(Thai Dub)
2124364.description: Ein's job as "Appraiser" has placed him as far from the "hero" pedestal as possible in a mythical world where "jobs" are divinely assigned from birth. Heroes are born, not created. After being mistreated and subsequently left behind by his fellow explorers, Ein concludes it is simply not worth continuing. However, Ein is fortunate that the end may also be the beginning—and a fresh start. His "worthless" work might actually be the secret to becoming a hero after all.
2124364.originName: 不遇職鑑定士が実は最強だった

2124502.title: I Left my A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!(Thai Dub)
2124502.description: The red wizard Yuke Feldio recently departed his adventurer A-Rank group and shouted "I can no longer do this". He finally lost it after five years of being teased and humiliated as a handyman! And thus began his life of unemployment and desolation... or so he believed! Yuke is fortunate enough to be accepted into an all-female adventurer group made up of his former pupils! They eventually uncover Yuke's real strength as they conquer dungeon after dungeon! This crimson magician turns out to have remarkable abilities and powers!
2124502.originName: Aランクパーティーを離脱した俺は、元教え子たちと迷宮深部を目指す

2124576.title: I Left my A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!(Dub Indo)
2124576.description: The red wizard Yuke Feldio recently departed his adventurer A-Rank group and shouted "I can no longer do this". He finally lost it after five years of being teased and humiliated as a handyman! And thus began his life of unemployment and desolation... or so he believed! Yuke is fortunate enough to be accepted into an all-female adventurer group made up of his former pupils! They eventually uncover Yuke's real strength as they conquer dungeon after dungeon! This crimson magician turns out to have remarkable abilities and powers!
2124576.originName: Aランクパーティーを離脱した俺は、元教え子たちと迷宮深部を目指す

2124709.title: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I'm Actually the Strongest (Dub Indo)
2124709.description: Ein's job as "Appraiser" has placed him as far from the "hero" pedestal as possible in a mythical world where "jobs" are divinely assigned from birth. Heroes are born, not created. After being mistreated and subsequently left behind by his fellow explorers, Ein concludes it is simply not worth continuing. However, Ein is fortunate that the end may also be the beginning—and a fresh start. His "worthless" work might actually be the secret to becoming a hero after all.
2124709.originName: 不遇職鑑定士が実は最強だった

2124801.title: Blue Exorcist -Beyond the Snow Saga-(Thai Dub)
2124801.description:
The truth about the "Blue Night" and the mystery surrounding Okumura Rin and Yukio's birth are revealed in "The End of the Night."
The central mystery of "Blue Exorcist" is ultimately revealed in the story.
2124801.originName: 青の祓魔師 終夜篇

2124917.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2
2124917.description:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

2125013.title: The Beginning After the End
2125013.description: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale.  Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone.  One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby.  Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends.  But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...
2125013.originName: 最強の王様二度目の人生は何をする？

2125152.title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
2125152.description:
Life hasn't been kind to Zenos. He was born in the slums, and his dirt-poor background has denied him almost every opportunity. After an encounter with a healer, he throws himself into studying to become one and finally catches a break when an adventurer invites Zenos into his party. Zenos is thrilled—so thrilled, in fact, that he's willing to put up with his teammates treating him like garbage. They fail to appreciate his talents and ultimately kick him to the curb, claiming he's outlived his usefulness to them.

Now bereft of money and out of options, Zenos decides to put his self-taught skills to use elsewhere and opens an underground clinic. Word quickly spreads about the brilliant healer working incredible magic in the city's shadowy underbelly. Even the royal palace is taking notice...

Can Zenos buck the odds and carve out a life for himself in a world that's spit in his face? And can he save the lives of the patients who wind up on his doorstep in the process?
2125152.originName: 一瞬で治療していたのに、 役立たずと追放された天才治癒師、 闇ヒーラーとして楽しく生きる

2125241.title: The Shiunji Family Children
2125241.description:
In the prestigious residential district of Setagaya, Tokyo, stands the grand estate of the Shiunjike family.
The seven siblings who reside there are renowned for their intelligence and beauty, and among them, the five eldest sisters—born in consecutive years—are particularly famous for their breathtaking looks.

Living under the same roof with a group of beautiful sisters—an enviable situation for anyone.
However, the eldest brother, Arata, is constantly at the mercy of his five uniquely eccentric sisters, leaving him hopelessly awkward around any other girls.
Though he deeply values his family, he can’t help but fantasize about a life without his five overbearing sisters...

2125304.title: Aharen-san wa Hakarenai season 2
2125304.description:
And then the new semester comes, now the distance to the transfer student is indecipherable!?

During their time at school, Aharen-san and Raidou-kun frequently encountered "too far" and "too close" distances when they began dating. 

It's an "indecipherable" close relationship in many respects? 
The youthful romance comedy restarted!!
2125304.originName: 阿波連さんは測れない２

2125392.title: Kowloon Generic Romance
2125392.description:
In the nostalgia-filled streets of Kowloon Walled City, Reiko Kujirai works at a local real estate agency. She finds herself got a crush on her senior colleague, Hajime Kudo.
One day, as she becomes fully aware of her feelings, she stumbles upon a photograph—revealing that Kudo once had a fiancée. But the shocking truth is that this woman looks exactly like her.
The existence of another Reiko Kujirai forces her to confront a chilling realization—she has no memories of her past...
2125392.originName: 九龍ジェネリックロマンス

2125525.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
2125525.description:
This is a story set years before the events of My Hero Academia!
In a superhuman society where approximately 80% of the population possesses supernatural abilities, the world is constantly teetering on the edge of chaos. Amidst it all, there exists a chosen profession—Heroes—those who protect people from accidents, disasters, and the misuse of Quirks.
But there are also those who, even without being "chosen," can't help but step in to save those in need.
This is the story of one such hero—an off-duty officer who refuses to turn away.
2125525.originName: ヴィジランテ -僕のヒーローアカデミア ILLEGALS

2125658.title: Black Butler -Emerald Witch Arc-
2125658.description:
By order of the Queen, Sebastian and Ciel set out to investigate a series of mysterious deaths occurring in Germany.
Their search leads them to the dreaded "Forest of the Werewolf", a place whispered to bring death to any who dare enter.
As they delve deeper into the truth behind the legend, a horrifying curse descends upon them—

2125743.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2
2125743.description:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.
She longs for a slow, quiet life, determined to avoid the deadly overwork that killed her in her last life. To make a little extra for her daily expenses, she nonchalantly slays slimes as a regular routine—for 300 years.
Before she realizes it… she has achieved MAX level, becoming the strongest being in the world!
2125743.originName: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました2

2125837.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
2125837.description:
Aspiring to become a true samurai, Yaiba Kurogane devoted himself to intense training deep in the jungle.
By a twist of fate, he returns to Japan and finds himself staying with the Mine family, who have ties to his father, Kenjuurou.
While Sayaka Mine, the family's daughter, struggles to adjust to Yaiba’s wild and reckless nature, they begin living together.
One day, when Yaiba visits Sayaka’s school, he has a fateful encounter with Takeshi Onimaru, a skilled kendo practitioner.
As Yaiba and Onimaru repeatedly clash, their relentless pursuit of strength awakens an ancient power, setting their destinies into motion.

2125980.title: Your Forma
2125980.description:
In an alternate 2023, Your Forma—a magical “smart fiber” technology—has become a staple of everyday life after being created to treat a widespread outbreak of viral encephalitis. The invasive feature of these handy gadgets is that they record every sound, image, and even sensation experienced by the user.

Searching for evidence to solve the most difficult cases and probing people’s memories through Your Forma are all part of the workday for electronic investigator Echika Hieda. The problem is, she’s so good at her job that her assistants are literally losing their minds trying to keep up with her. Eventually, the higher-ups assign Echika an equal partner, Harold Lucraft, a smart but cunning android, after adding too many assistants to the hospital. Can this unlikely couple overcome their shared anxieties and stop a deadly technological disease from spreading across the world before it's too late?

2126246.title: The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei: He Just Solves All the Mysteries
2126246.description:
School x Supernatural x Mystery. This story takes place before the exorcist Kyougokudou opened up a used bookstore...

Our setting is in Tokyo in 1948, just right after the war. Kanna Kusakabe had just become a second-year at a high school when she meets the new language teacher, Akihiko Chuuzenji. Mysterious supernatural things keep happening around Kanna. Once again today, Kanna is going to open the doors to the library prep room to seek help from the surly Chuuzenji-sensei who is waiting inside.

A high school supernatural mystery featuring the unlikely duo between a teacher and a high school girl is about to begin!
2126246.originName: 中禅寺先生物怪講義録

2126386.title: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentoushou
2126386.description: Young Jinta and his sister are forced to leave their house during the Edo period and take sanctuary in a mountain village. Years later, Jinta has become an expert swordsman and has vowed to defend the rural shrine's maiden. Jinta faces the evil beast in the forest after being charged with killing a demon that poses a threat to the shrine, only to discover a startling reality. The demon describes what will happen in a century and seventy years, when Jinta will have to face the demon. As Jinta hunts a demon through time and has to confront his own evil side, an epic fantasy odyssey spanning several eras begins.

2126479.title: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
2126479.description:
Born into a noble Count family governing the frontier of the Algland Empire, Liam is a reincarnated soul who, at a young age, inherits his family’s title.
Having spent his previous life constantly exploited due to his kindness, Liam reflects on his past mistakes and makes a bold decision—this time, he will become a ruthless, corrupt lord who oppresses his people!
Despite his best efforts to act like an evil lord, the people continue to praise and admire him—and his reputation only keeps rising!?
2126479.originName: 俺は星間国家の悪徳領主！

2126598.title: SHIROHIYO - Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother With Memories From My Past Life
2126598.description:
In this sparkling, fantastical world, elegance and wonder abound!
Graceful and beautiful elves, gods beyond human comprehension, the power of magic—everything feels like a dream.
And most importantly, there’s the fluffy little "chick" and the adorable younger brother, Regulus, who loves his Big-bro more than anything.
But beneath this dazzling surface, hidden tensions brew within the noble Kikunoi family, while the corruption of the imperial aristocracy continues to spread…
2126598.originName: 白豚貴族ですが前世の記憶が生えたので ひよこな弟育てます

2126684.title: WITCH WATCH
2126684.description:
Moruji Otogi, a high school student with the power of an oni, suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his childhood friend, Nico, who is currently training to become a witch—as her familiar!

While Nico is thrilled to reunite with her childhood friend, Moruji has a greater mission—to protect her from a prophesied calamity as her destined familiar.

With Nico’s unpredictable magic causing all sorts of unexpected trouble, and the complications of a teenage boy and girl living together…

Their days ahead are bound to be chaotic, mysterious, and anything but ordinary!

2126777.title: TO BE HERO X (Dub CN)
2126777.description: This is a world where heroes are made by people's trust. The hero who receives the most trust is honored as “X”. People’s trust can be statistically measured here, and these values are reflected on everyone’s wrists. As long as one accumulates enough trust points, an ordinary person can also gain superpowers and become a superhero to save the world. However, the constantly changing trust points make the path to becoming a hero full of uncertainties...

2126837.title: The All-devouring Whale: Homecoming
2126837.description: Fan Lingxiao, a spiritual pet master with exceptional talents, was plotted against during the Level-A sect promotion competition and was devoured by Kun, his own spiritual pet. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named “Liu Fengmang” and was imprisoned in the White Mansion’s dungeon. Meanwhile, his own sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was in a perilous state. To uncover the truth of being devoured by Kun and revitalize his sect, Fan Lingxiao, accompanied by his existing spiritual pets, embarked on a brand-new adventure journey with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

2126939.title: Word of Honor S2
2126939.description: Xie Kanhua was about to be executed in the Shanglin Celestial Palace. When Su Baiyi was rescuing him, the Shanglin Celestial Palace disintegrated, and Su Baiyi was taken away by Su Jian, the Demon Lord who had voluntarily confined himself in the secluded prison for twenty years. Then the Hero Conference of Xuanwei Town is held again, Bai Jile lures Divine Official Xue, the second-best martial artist in the world to participate, plunging the martial arts world into chaos. In order to save the injured Nangong Xi'er, Su Baiyi went to the North Kunlun with Su Jian to pay a visit to Su Suomo, the ancestor of the Su family, while Yuling and Feng Zuojun respectively headed to Qingcheng Mountain and the Demon Town to learn martial arts. Under the latent tension, the Yingzhou Immortal Island reappeared. The invaders from the island issued a provocation to the martial artists, saying that those who submit will prosper, while those who resist will perish...

2127114.title: LINGCAGE 2
2127114.description: As the world has long been overcrowded, the action of venturing into the universe to seek a new homeland becomes a matter of great urgency. While everything is advancing in an orderly manner, the lunar phases suddenly undergo abnormal changes and the ground beneath erupts intense geological changes that last for decades. As a result, humanity is left with only a handful of survivors in this catastrophe. When people step onto this familiar yet strange land again from the ruins and abysses after everything returns to peace, they start to wonder if they can still dominate this world as they used to.

2127253.title: GoWest：Overworked
2127253.description: Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by the “Hun Dun”. Murong Qiong established the Demon Sect to resist it, but they couldn’t manage to win despite arduous battles. The Divine Messenger Yi Zhihua descended and taught everyone the cultivation method of demonization, and they finally managed to defeat the Hun Dun. However, after the Divine Messenger left, the cultivation method went out of control as it spread in the martial arts world. Disappointed, Murong Qiong retired and his subordinate Yu Huabing seized the power, improved the cultivation method, and created an era of Punk True Qi, making the martial arts world thrive. But the price of prosperity was that all the cultivators became “Overworking fanatics”. Dongfang Sheng, harboring an idealistic and sincere aspiration, found Murong Qiong secluded in the GoWest Restaurant. He hoped that Murong Qiong would assist in restoring the glory of the martial arts world. The comical story thus began...

2127400.title: Fire Force Season 3
2127400.description:
A scorching dark fantasy guided by flames—
The final chapter begins!

After fierce battles over the "Pillars" and the investigation mission into the Nether,
Shinra and his comrades have drawn closer to uncovering the great secrets of the world.

In response to their efforts, other Special Fire Force companies have pledged their support,
uniting as one to prevent the Great Cataclysm.

Now, the final battle begins, as Shinra—the hero—and the firefighters stand together to protect the world!
2127400.originName: 炎炎ノ消防隊　参ノ章

2127455.title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
2127455.description:
"Make me put the underwears on." 
As the head of the school caste system, Takamine-san, the president of the student council, is unquestionably a deity! 

However, Shirota-kun, who lacks friends and a sense of presence, has changed his school life once he catches a glimpse of Shirota-kun's nude breasts one day...

Surprisingly, Takamine-san is a girl who can take off her panties and travel through time with her "Eternal Virgin Road" ability.
"Please put them on, Takamine-san!" is what Shirota-kun can't stop saying at such moments.
2127455.originName: 履いてください、鷹峰さん

2127532.title: Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive?
2127532.description:
In a rural middle school, a boy and a girl vowed eternal friendship.
Bound by a shared dream, their bond remained unchanged for two years—without any romantic development…!
Himari Inuzuka, an outgoing girl who has never experienced first love, and Yuu Natsume, a quiet boy who loves flowers, continued their peaceful days as best friends in their small, two-person gardening club, even as they entered their second year of high school.
However, when Yuu unexpectedly reunites with his past first love, the balance between them begins to shift!
After discovering the feeling of love, can Himari  break free from the role of the "ideal best friend"?
2127532.originName: 男女の友情は成立する（いや、しないっ!!）

2127666.title: Once Upon a Witch's Death
2127666.description:
Meg Raspberry, a young and inexperienced witch cursed with the "Death Sentence"—a fate that left her with only one year to live.

There was only one way to break the curse:
She had to create the legendary "Seed of Life", an artifact said to grant immortality to its bearer.

However, the key ingredient for the Seed of Life was something unexpected—fragments of emotion, specifically, the tears of joy shed by people in moments of happiness.
And so, Meg sets out on a journey, encountering all kinds of people in her quest to gather a thousand tears of joy—a journey that will change her fate forever.

2127764.title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
2127764.description: Philia comes from a family that has a reputation for producing generations of saints, and she is no different. She is so incredibly talented that many people find her unbearable, earning her the title of most powerful saint of all time. Her fiancé abruptly ends their engagement after deciding he can no longer stand her. He sells her to a foreign nation in desperate need of a saint of their own since he is so keen to never see her again. Philia now prepares for the future, fully anticipating more wretched treatment. She would be surprised, after all, to find that everyone would embrace her.
2127764.originName: 完璧すぎて可愛げがないと婚約破棄された聖女は隣国に売られる

2127847.title: The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl
2127847.description:
In a world where everyone receives a blessing from an animal god upon turning 16, the timid Count’s daughter, Sophia Leeler, hopes for a peaceful school life. However, fate has other plans—she ends up receiving the blessing of the Gorilla God, said to be the strongest in combat!

As she struggles to keep a low profile, her rare and overwhelming power draws attention, leading to a scout offer from the Royal Knights as a squire. Despite her efforts to hide her strength, she quickly earns respect and admiration. Among those watching over her is the kind and dependable Louis Scarrel, an older squire attending the same academy, along with other promising young knights.

Thus begins an unexpected, heart-throbbing romantic comedy—born from the unstoppable power of a gorilla!
2127847.originName: ゴリラの神から加護された令嬢は王立騎士団で可愛がられる

2128013.title: MAEBASHI WITCHES
2128013.description:
Being a Maebashi witch—doesn’t that sound super aesthetic!?
This is Maebashi City, Gunma Prefecture.
For first-year high school student Yuina Akagi, life was just “normal, I guess”, a little too ordinary...
Until one day...
"Then how about you try becoming a witch?"
With the sudden appearance of a mysterious frog named Keroppe, everything changes!
Her closet door now leads to a strange and magical space…

2128139.title: My Senior Brother is Too Strong
2128139.description: Cultivator Lv Shaoqing’s accidental acquisition of the immortal treasure “Spring and Autumn Ring” led the righteous immortal alliance to label him as a world-destroying demon and hunt him to death. But by some strange twist of fate, he was sent back a thousand years in time and found himself sharing a body with the very enemy who had killed him. Trapped within the enemy's lair, Lv Shaoqing fought wits and courage to reclaim control of the body for survival as well as anticipating the enemy’s actions to collect rare treasures. Eventually, through his remarkable intelligence and courage, Lv Shaoqing became the most despised playboy of the righteous path. At the same time, the hidden secrets of the cultivation world began to come to light. Lv Shaoqing counted with his fingers, and suddenly realized that the course of history had already been changed!

2128207.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 2
2128207.description:
After her fierce conflict with Adonis and the brutal battle against Evil, Bell had shut herself away in her room. However, thanks to the unwavering support of her companions, she finds solace and reaffirms her determination to become a Nomad of the Journey once more.

As the Maiden of Reason, Bell delves deeper into the great mysteries of this world.

Meanwhile, consumed by despair, Adonis is taken in by the Hunger Alliance. Under the guidance of Drambuie, a figure lurking in the darkness of the alliance, and Bell’s own master, Cyan, Adonis is forged into the One Who Questions, a being who longs for the world’s end.

"Can you strike me down…?"
"Can you transcend me… and even the gods?"

What does the inevitable clash between Cyan’s two disciples—Bell and Adonis—truly signify?

And at the end of all battles, what reason will Bell uncover in this world?

2128308.title: WITCH WATCH(Thai Dub)
2128308.description:
Moruji Otogi, a high school student with the power of an oni, suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his childhood friend, Nico, who is currently training to become a witch—as her familiar!

While Nico is thrilled to reunite with her childhood friend, Moruji has a greater mission—to protect her from a prophesied calamity as her destined familiar.

With Nico’s unpredictable magic causing all sorts of unexpected trouble, and the complications of a teenage boy and girl living together…

Their days ahead are bound to be chaotic, mysterious, and anything but ordinary!

2128377.description:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.
She longs for a slow, quiet life, determined to avoid the deadly overwork that killed her in her last life. To make a little extra for her daily expenses, she nonchalantly slays slimes as a regular routine—for 300 years.
Before she realizes it… she has achieved MAX level, becoming the strongest being in the world!
2128377.originName: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました2

2128510.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2(Dub Indo)
2128510.description:
A goddess's intervention allows Azusa to be reincarnated as an immortal witch in a different world.

2128510.originName: スライム倒して300年、知らないうちにレベルMAXになってました2

2128656.title: Tales of Herding Gods(Thai Dub)
2128656.description: In Can Lao village, there lived nine enigmatic elders and the young Qin Mu who was raised by the elders. One day, the cow that Qin Mu was herding surprisingly spoke human language.Since then, Qin Mu has become more aware of the dangers and enchantments of the forsaken land of Da Xu: demons descend with the darkness, divine bones dance in the ruins, dragon bones protect their young, and a giant ship drags the sun... No matter what kind of danger he faces, Qin Mu is fearless. He integrates the skills passed down by the nine elders and vows to carve out his own realm with a peerless and domineering physique.

2128776.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2(Dub Indo)
2128776.description:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

2128863.title: The Beginning After the End (Thai Dub)
2128863.description: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale. Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone. One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby.
