Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends. But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...
2128863.originName: 最強の王様二度目の人生は何をする？

2128948.title: Fairies Albums Luoyang Arc
2128948.description: Fairies Albums Luoyang Arc follows Tao Yao, Mister Liu, Moya, and Gun Gun as they set out on a quest to find the missing Fairy Album in Luoyang City. Jiang Jun, Xian Shu, Fo Yan, Xuan Jiao, Ying Yuan, Ren Qu, and Xia Guai are among the many unusual and enigmatic creatures they meet along the route. They also face off against the formidable ultimate boss behind the Fairy Album in an exciting battle of cunning. There's a voyage of mystery, legend, and imagination ahead!

2129061.title: Back as Immortal Lord
2129061.description: Yun Qingyan, a teenage warrior, was dragged into the fairy world for three thousand years before vanishing from the planet three years ago!  He became one of the 10 great fairy emperors, the Yun Emperor, thanks to his remarkable talent.  However, he made the decision to return to the human world at all costs because he missed his family and was fed up with the intrigues in the fairy realm.  His parents and sister mysteriously vanished when he returned to the human world, and he lost his magic weapon and nearly zeroed out his cultivation as a result of an occurrence that occurred during the journey from the fairy world to the human world.  He was pursued by major forces throughout this time...

2129115.title: Psychic Princess S2
2129115.description: The prime minister of Guyu Kingdom's eldest daughter, Qian Yunxi, possesses superhuman abilities.  Since childhood, she has been viewed as unlucky, and she is compelled to marry into the Ye Palace.  When the prince Ye Youming sees how sincere and nice she is, he employs hundreds of tricks to demonstrate his generosity.  Because she believes the prince is malicious, Qian Yunxi argues with him.  Cohabitation turns into a tumultuous existence.

2129264.title: The new chronicles of extraordinary Beings: Preface
2129264.description:
Hao Ren was a typical young man from a small city who was barely making ends meet while living in an old house. However, via a strange turn of events, he becomes a "universe police officer." A problem is developing in his domain, the Dream Plane Universe, as he struggles to oversee a home inhabited by strange, non-human residents that his enigmatic superiors have assigned him.

As he investigates further, Hao Ren discovers a link between the remnants of a vanished civilization in the Dream Plane and the strange species on Earth. Hao Ren quickly learns that slacking off is no longer an option when long-buried horrors, fallen deities, and ancient cataclysms reappear.

2129353.title: The Most Powerful Vendor
2129353.description:
Some people developed extraordinary talents after waves of spiritual energy were released by enigmatic "Spiritual Ruins Gates" that arose all over the planet twenty years ago. Spirit Warriors, who possessed supernatural abilities, were the name given to these talented individuals.

Particularly after demonstrating their unparalleled strength during the devastating Beast Tide Disaster, the uncommon "Space series" fighters were the most elite among them.

From his early years, Jiang Nan, an orphan who grew up in Jiangcheng, Lingzhou, had aspirations of becoming the greatest Spirit Warrior. He awakens as Lingzhou's second-ever space-type warrior at the age of sixteen, with the rarest and most potent ability of all.

Here's where his incredible journey starts...

2129416.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2
2129416.description:
The conversation starts when Momo Ayase, a high school student from a family of mediums, intervenes to shield her classmate Ken Takakura, also known as "Okarun" and a devoted occultist, from bullies in the classroom.

 Momo believes in ghosts but not aliens, whereas Okarun believes in aliens but not ghosts. Nevertheless, the two quickly clash.
 In an attempt to disprove one another, they place a daring wager: Okarun enters a spooky tunnel, while Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where UFOs have been reported.

 So begins a strange and exciting supernatural battle between the unknown, aliens, and ghosts!

2129492.title: My Dress-Up Darling Season 2
2129492.description:
Wakana Gojo and Marin Kitagawa become closer through the cosplay community following a destined experience.
They still have a ton of roles they want to play and costumes they want to construct.

Marin and Gojo's world keeps growing as they strengthen their relationships with their peers and make new friends who are also cosplayers.
And what about Marin's intense romantic interest in Gojo? Could this be the turning point for her?
2129492.originName: その着せ替え人形は恋をする2

2129562.title: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
2129562.description:
Despite his remarkable abilities, Hero Toto is unable to organize a party due to his excessive shyness, which keeps him stranded in the town where his adventure started.

 One day, three stunning women—Ciel, Anemone, and Gore—instantly ask him to a party.  Toto is giddy with anticipation at finally embarking on an adventure, but he is unaware that these women are determined to murder him!

 The socially nervous hero, who faints from the simple joy of being around ladies, is the target of three lethal companions, each of whom has their own motives for wanting him gone, in this deadly harem romcom!

2129668.title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
2129668.description: Early sickness claimed Ira Takuto's life, and he was ultimately reincarnated in a world reminiscent of the fantasy turn-based strategy game Eternal Nations. He not only reincarnated as his favorite gaming character, but also as the god in charge of the malevolent Mynoghra society. Nothing, not even legendary race qualities, would prevent Mynoghra from reviving their civilization with his lovely hero unit, Sludge Witch Atou, at his side!
2129668.originName: 異世界黙示録マイノグーラ

2129796.title: Why Does the Boss Want a Contract Marriage
2129796.description: A professional bride meets a groom pretending to be disabled. After their contract marriage, the couple plays an elaborate charade together. In the process, they both unexpectedly find sweet, genuine love.

2129940.title: The Revenge of the Ultimate Beauty
2129940.description: She was bullied by everyone after her miscarriage, and was designed by her mother-in-law to take unseemly photos, just because she was a lowly status lobster seller woman, not realizing that her father's gambling owed loan sharks she was forced to shoot all kinds of small videos, desperate, she began to fight back...

2130027.title: The Son-in-Law's Rise
2130027.description: Despite his powerful background, he chooses to become a live-in son-in-law for her sake, marrying into Jenna's family. As the new addition to the household, he faces a series of challenges and hardships. His wife's sister and mother look down on him, and he even endures physical bullying. Yet, in the face of these obstacles, neither he nor Jenna give up. Instead, they choose to stand together and weather the storm...

2130147.title: Reborn as the Richest Man
2130147.description: A CEO falls victim to a plot by his subordinate and wife, only to find himself transported back to the '90s, inhabiting the body of a poor young man. Determined to change his family's circumstances, he starts selling marinated eggs at the local market.  His business savvy catches the eye of a local tycoon who offers to invest in him. As he navigates his dealings with the wealthy investor, he realizes there's more to this situation than meets the eye...

2130265.title: Marrying a Tyrant as Son-in-Law
2130265.description: Our love story began with a marriage contract, but was soon threatened by sinister plots. As I faced death, I expressed no regrets. He swore to avenge me. We're reborn in modern times, joining forces to seek revenge and reclaim our happiness together.

2130384.title: Divine Doctor and Martial Son-in-law
2130384.description: A divorce agreement slams onto his desk, shattering a five-year relationship—all because he's seen as 'average.' But the moment he signs those papers, it's showtime. He's about to prove to everyone that he's not just another Joe Schmoe. When this underdog decides to stop playing it cool, the whole world's in for a wild ride—because he's about to turn everything upside down!

2130440.title: Divine Doctor: Immortal Master
2130440.description: Betrayed by the woman he loved and left to rot in prison, he thought his life was over—until the night a dying god’s spirit chose him. Now, with bones reforged and vengeance in his veins, he’s no longer the pawn in their game… but the nightmare they never saw coming

2130546.title: A Fall into Great Fortune
2130546.description: All it took was one clumsy slip in the bathtub—while scrolling on his phone—to change his life forever. Next thing he knew, he'd isekai’d straight into a fantasy game world… and woke up in a princess’s bath! Facing execution for trespassing, he quickly realizes: she’s obsessed with poetry. Good thing he’s a walking Tang Dynasty anthology. Now, if he can charm her with verses, maybe he’ll survive… and even win her heart?

2130633.title: The Emergence of the Dao God
2130633.description: After mastering forbidden arts, he descends the mountain with vengeance in his heart—only to seek refuge with the woman he was once promised to marry. Hiding his true power, he starts anew by her side, using his magic to shield her from every threat. But as enemies close in and their bond deepens, he faces a choice: reveal his dark past… or let love rewrite his destiny.

2130773.title: Love after divorcing with a child and falling in love with the boss
2130773.description: Married for six years, she took her daughter to live in the scum husband a family of calculations, insatiable scum husband but want to take action on their own baby daughter, she decided to fight back, on the day of the divorce, in the evil mother-in-law demeaned taunting punches and kicks, was passing by the president to save, the president even proposed to take care of her and the bullied daughter, flash marriage to open a common life...

2130898.title: Rebirth: Exchanged Lives
2130898.description: A stolen identity. A life of lies. The butler's daughter grew up as a billionaire's beloved child, while the true heiress endured hell. But fate intervenes when the real daughter escapes her cruel fate and crosses paths with the woman who should have been her mother. As secrets unravel, a vicious battle begins—one fighting for justice, the other desperate to keep her stolen crown.

2131016.title: Little Bao's Wife Hunt
2131016.description: I accidentally time-traveled to the modern era and discovered that my seven wives from ancient times have all arrived in the present. Watch how I win the hearts of these seven wives!

2131126.title: Disappearing real and fake mummy
2131126.description: A woman's scam, she who was hidden away, returns five years later with a baby. Will the male lead, who was lured into the trap, be able to discern the truth? Once twins, yet with two mothers, are these two children one or two separate individuals? Can love triumph over the deception?

2131274.title: Invincible Imperial Master
2131274.description: General doesn't bow. Not to the Emperor. Not to anyone. The most feared warrior in the empire has spent his life cutting down challengers. But when the corrupt elite come for his family, they awaken something far more dangerous than a soldier - they awaken a son seeking vengeance. Now, the imperial court will drown in the blood of those foolish enough to provoke a dragon.

2131362.title: Working as a maid in the enemy's house
2131362.description: From Victim to Vigilante: A Decade of Vengeance Bullied at school, her life spirals into chaos when her father is falsely accused of rape and her mother brutally murdered. Ten years later, she returns as a mysterious stranger. How far will she go to serve cold, hard justice? Binge this gripping revenge thriller and witness a masterclass in payback!

2131491.title: Future Diary: Can I Change My Destiny?
2131491.description: He obtains a magical diary that records future events. Can he use this magical diary to change his destiny?
2131491.originName: 未来日记，我能逆天改命

2131573.title: Master Goes Crazy for His Wife
2131573.description: Lu Chen, the enigmatic master, shattered Meng Xiaopo's magic array with a single strike. Testing his disciples' progress, he imparts the legendary Eight Desolations Scripture—but commands them to act as strangers in public. After all, true power thrives in secrecy...
2131573.originName: 为师太疯狂开大追师娘

2131715.title: The Temptation of the Substitute
2131715.description: He stole a billionaire's life. He didn't steal his sins. When a homeless man takes over an amnesiac tycoon's identity, the luxury turns lethal - police want him for murder, and the real mogul is coming back with a plan. To survive, he must solve the twisted truth behind their identical faces...

2131818.title: Four Seas
2131818.description: Given a second shot at life, he's determined to right his past wrongs. Once a gambling addict who destroyed his family, he's now focused on one thing: giving his loved ones the happiness they deserve. This time, he's all in on being the perfect husband and father, ready to bet everything on love and redemption.

2131883.title: The Twin Technique
2131883.description: Gentle elder sister Li Yajing and wild younger sister Li Yating—this pair of twins with vastly different personalities accidentally traveled to another world, where they discovered the “Dual-Plant Mantra” that could rewrite their destinies. To uncover the secrets, they had to adapt to their new identities, confront unknown forces, and rediscover each other through their adventures. When the sisters' powers truly awakened, they changed not only that world but also their own destinies.

2132031.title: Love after a body-swap and flash-marriage
2132031.description: Body Swap Romance: When the CEO Becomes Her A sassy girl agrees to a one-year marriage contract with an arrogant CEO. But when lightning strikes, they swap bodies! Now he's dealing with cramps, mood swings, and a whole new perspective on life. As the year ends, will this changed man let her go? Hilarious, heartwarming, and totally binge-worthy!
2132031.originName: 交换身体后的闪婚爱恋

2132163.title: Flash-marriage to a life-saver
2132163.description: She accidentally slept with the CEO after being drugged, only to discover that they knew each other from childhood. The CEO fully cooperated with her plan for a quick marriage, and in a surprising turn of events, they stumbled upon true love.

2132249.title: Forgetting Mother After Marriage
2132249.description: Li Guilan became a widow in middle age and raised her three children through great hardship. Her eldest son, Qingshan, didn't get married until he was 35 due to poverty. At that time, his twin siblings, Qing'an and Qingqing, were both admitted to university. Li Guilan scrambled to gather the dowry and tuition fees, but Qingshan secretly used the tuition money to buy gold jewelry. During an argument, he accidentally injured Qingqing's hand, shattering her dreams of attending an art academy. In anger, Qing'an left home.

2132352.title: The Return of the Heiress: A Discerning Eye
2132352.description: Lin Xiangwan, a wealthy young lady, was betrayed by her husband, Chen Yue, and her cousin, Lin Xinyue. She was expelled from her home and her company was taken over, with the two even attempting to kill her. Fortunately, Lu Sicheng, the CEO of Xirui Group, came to her aid. Determined to seek revenge, she ultimately finds her own happiness in the process.

2132529.title: Wife's Betrayal
2132529.description: In just 24 hours, Lin Ziyang's world crumbled. Before he could finish signing the bankruptcy papers for his company, he walked in on his wife and her lover in a compromising situation. The final blow came when he saw his elderly mother being humiliated by the same woman, who was still trying to make amends for his sake. At his wit's end, Lin Ziyang decided to gather evidence to ensure his wife received the punishment she deserved.

2132582.title: Twins help parents fall in love
2132582.description: Their marriage, devoid of genuine affection, ended due to a misunderstanding. She then embarked on a new life overseas with their baby, drifting and exploring. However, her career took her back to the country, and by a twist of fate, the two crossed paths again.

2132664.title: Female Boss's Personal Master
2132664.description: Special Forces soldier Duan Fei is assigned to protect a female CEO and is also engaged to her in a pre-arranged marriage. Initially, the two are at odds with each other, but they gradually learn to work together, facing various challenges and dangers in the business world. Over time, they overcome their prejudices and ultimately find love.

2132783.title: Dragon's Descent to the Mortal World
2132783.description: He was sent down the mountain by his master to marry the eldest Miss Tang, but he was jilted and humiliated. By chance, he formed a bond with her. With his extraordinary medical skills and wisdom, he rose to fame in the city. Faced with numerous crises and provocations, he struck back forcefully and eventually became a powerful figure who could command the wind and rain, achieving both career success and love.

2132904.title: The Comeback of Dragon Prince
2132904.description: This is a story of a man who faces humiliation from his future in-laws over dowry issues and sees his fiancée being framed. After being betrayed at the wedding, he makes a stunning comeback.

2132964.title: Reverse Scale
2132964.description: After his family's death and completing his studies, he's determined to make everyone involved pay the ultimate price!

2133056.title: You Are My Trump Card
2133056.description: This story tells of the romance between a young male CEO and a cold-blooded assassin. The two become entangled in a complicated case by chance.

2133115.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
2133115.description: Xia Yi originally had a perfect family. However, Jiang Shu, who returned to the country, fabricated a fake paternity test report to slander Xia Yi in order to get Fu Yan, leading to Fu Yan's misunderstanding of her. After going through many hardships, Xia Yi finally regained her life with the help of Ji Nanfeng.

2133244.title: Mis Na has escaped again
2133244.description: A famous fashion designer enters competitions to become one of the world's top designers, during which he develops a love affair with the CEO. After becoming famous, she announces that she has canceled her contract with the president and is working with her competitors instead. The president uses various means to recover his beloved wife, alternating between sweet favor and sadistic love.

2133296.title: The Hand Behind the Curtain
2133296.description: At an auction, Ye Lao suddenly passed away. His grandson, noticing suspicious signs, launched a series of investigations within the Ye family. Eventually, the truth was uncovered...

2133415.title: Munchkin Takes Me to My Husband
2133415.description: ER Romance: From One Night to Forever During a late shift, a dedicated nurse saves a mysterious CEO's life, leading to an unexpected passionate encounter. Years later, their paths cross again, thanks to her clever toddler who seems determined to play matchmaker. Will this surprise family find their happily ever after? Watch as they navigate love, parenthood, and second chances in this heartwarming romantic drama!

2133556.title: The Runaway Princess is Hard to Chase
2133556.description: Three years after their marriage, Prince Ye Mufeng broke his agreement with the prime minister by forcibly taking in a courtesan named Qianqian as his concubine. He favored Qianqian so much that he neglected his wife, Qin Wan'er, and even allowed Qianqian to harm and kill their child. Heartbroken, Qin Wan'er, with the help of the newly appointed top scholar Gu Lingyun, faked her death and fled the prince's mansion. It was only later that Ye Mufeng realized that Qin Wan'er was his childhood savior, and thus he embarked on a difficult journey to win her back.

2133689.title: The Legend of Luo Ying
2133689.description: The love and hate entanglement between Meng Luoying and Zhu Xiaochen. Meng Luoying, the daughter of General Meng, grew up with Zhu Xiaochen as childhood sweethearts. After Zhu Xiaochen ascended to the throne, their relationship plunged into an abyss due to misunderstandings. Meng Luoying, in an attempt to save Zhu Xiaochen, was labeled a traitor. She silently guarded him until he awoke, only to be forgotten by him.

2133767.title: Mirage City
2133767.description: The story tells of Ma Ji's fantastic experience after he accidentally traveled through time to the Kingdom of Rakshasa. In this strange land, Ma Ji encountered a series of extraordinary adventures, including interactions with the local people and experiences of their unique customs.

2133829.title: Dragon Soaring Across Four Seas
2133829.description: I became foolish due to my ex-wife's betrayal, then witnessed my daughter being taken away by my ex-wife and her lover. I'll do everything to save my child!

2133904.title: Lucky Dragon Year: Heaven-Sent Talent
2133904.description: The story of deliveryman Hao Qiong and the God of Wealth, who was demoted to the mortal world. The God of Wealth was mistaken for a mental patient after being banished by the Jade Emperor. It wasn't until he met Hao Qiong that he accidentally began a journey to help Hao Qiong achieve happiness.
2133904.originName: 龙年行大运之天降之才

2133967.title: Awakening of the Dragon King
2133967.description: Ye Lingtian was initially a commoner, but he was later ennobled as the King of War for his military achievements. However, during the war to protect the country, he was betrayed and lost his memory for many years. With the help of his loyal guard Qinglong, he gradually regained his memory and embarked on the path of the Awakening of the Mad Dragon.

2134027.title: My Stunning Girlfriend is a Celestial Master
2134027.description: Qian Kui is a powerful sorcerer with deep magical abilities. However, her senior fellow disciple, Qian Jie, out of jealousy, repeatedly tries to harm her. Amidst these entanglements with her senior fellow disciple, Qian Kui accidentally meets him, who is just a minor character in the story. Gradually, the two develop feelings for each other due to fate and join forces to confront Qian Jie, who has already succumbed to evil.

2134121.title: The Dark Realm Commander
2134121.description: After years of guarding her master's tomb on the mountain, Mu Qing emerged from seclusion and led her four powerful followers—Hua Tuo, the divine physician; Wang Xizhi, the Sage of Calligraphy; Li Yuanba, the mightiest warrior of the Sui and Tang dynasties; and Gao Changgong, the war god of Northern Qi—down the mountain to fulfill her master's last wish.

2134210.title: A Light in the Darkness: A Mother's Love
2134210.description: Twelve years ago, Zhang Meng, a five-year-old blind girl, was sold to human traffickers by her father, Zhang Lei. In a fit of fury, her mother, Wang Shufen, injured Zhang Lei and fled. Twelve years later, Wang Shufen stumbled upon her daughter, who had changed her name to Li Meng, and recognized her by a birthmark. Determined to seek justice for her daughter, Wang Shufen embarked on a quest for retribution.
2134210.originName: 黑暗里的一束光之妈妈的爱

2134268.title: Dragon's Return: A New Year's Homecoming
2134268.description: Ma Yiming, who appears to be an ordinary person, soars to the peak of life. He is fought over by two peerless beauties, which brings out two lingering relationships with separations and reunions. Through hard struggle, emotional entanglement, and dealing with human relations, as one person finishes performing, another begins. See how this "cockroach" who can't be killed makes a comeback to the top!

2134368.title: After Returning, I Became the Goddess's Personal Expert
2134368.description: After fighting on the battlefield, I discovered there was more to my comrade's death. I hid my identity and pretended to be a bodyguard, unexpectedly falling in love with a female CEO.
2134368.originName: 归来后，我变成女神的贴身高手

2134448.title: Construction Site Stories
2134448.description: He was unjustly denied his wages, and after demanding what was rightfully his, he was brutally beaten into unconsciousness. Witness how he stages a desperate counterattack and exacts revenge on all those who have wronged him!

2134499.title: Give Me a Hug
2134499.description: Eighteen years ago, in order to get some money, Jiang Cheng heartlessly abandoned his five-year-old daughter Jiang Ruonan. When Jiang Ruonan was about to be kidnapped by human traffickers, she was luckily rescued by the convenience store owner, Zhou Chunxia, who risked her life to save her and gave her a new name, Jiang Mingzhu. Eighteen years later, Jiang Mingzhu, now an adult, joined Jiang's Group and encountered difficulties from Jiang's adopted daughter, Jiang Sinan. Jiang's mother and her brothers, in order to protect Jiang Sinan, repeatedly humiliated Jiang Mingzhu.

2134555.title: The Dark-hearted Actress
2134555.description: She discovered that her actress sister had died unexpectedly. Through the diary left behind, she uncovered the truth behind her sister's death. She decided to seek revenge by putting herself in danger...

2134636.title: Taboo: Pregnant with My Fiancé's Uncle's Baby
2134636.description: One Wild Night with My Fiancé's Uncle?! On the run from assassins, I spent a steamy night with a hot stranger. Plot twist: He's my fiancé's uncle! Now he can't stop thinking about me, and I'm caught between duty and desire. Will I choose family obligations or follow my heart?
2134636.originName: 禁忌、怀了未婚夫叔叔的孩子

2134741.title: Urban Little Doctor
2134741.description: Urban Little Divine Doctor" is an urban-themed short drama. The story revolves around the protagonist Lin Yi, a young doctor from a family of traditional Chinese medicine practitioners. Lin Yi learned traditional Chinese medicine from his grandfather since childhood and developed exceptional medical skills. As an adult, he moved to the bustling city and opened a small clinic, determined to help more people with traditional Chinese medicine. In the city, Lin Yi encountered various complex cases and met several patients with different personalities, including Su Yao, a wealthy young woman with a rare disease, and Zhao Tie, an ordinary worker who was disabled due to a work injury. Lin Yi won the trust and respect of his patients with his medical skills and kindness. He also developed a deep relationship with a Western medicine doctor named Li Wei. The collision of Li Wei's modern medical knowledge and Lin Yi's traditional Chinese medicine concepts led to mutual learning and growth. Ultimately, Lin Yi not only successfully cured several patients of their difficult and complicated diseases but also joined hands with Li Wei to combine traditional Chinese medicine with modern medicine, creating a new medical model that brings health and hope to more people.

2134831.title: Crafty Commoner Wang Xiao'er
2134831.description: Naughty Villager Wang Xia'er" is a comedy short drama. The story revolves around Wang Xia'er, a clever and somewhat mischievous common villager living in a small village during the Ming Dynasty. Despite his humble origins, Wang Xia'er often outwits the wealthy villagers and officials with his intelligence and sense of humor. He not only skillfully resolves various disputes in the village but also helps the villagers escape from the unfair treatment of the authorities. In an unexpected turn of events, Wang Xia'er gets involved in a dispute over a treasure. With his wisdom and bravery, he ultimately finds the treasure and uses it to improve the lives of the entire village. This short drama showcases the power of intelligence and courage, as well as the indomitable spirit of ordinary people in the face of adversity through the story of Wang Xia'er.

2134971.title: Emperor's Pride
2134971.description: Su Chunping was paralyzed while protecting Ye Wudao. Twenty years later, Ye Wudao returned after completing his studies, with his primary mission being to return to the Chen family to avenge his mother. On the path to uncovering the truth, he overcame numerous obstacles and dispelled layers of confusion, gradually exposing the perpetrators. Relying on his intelligence, bravery, and acquired skills, Ye Wudao skillfully unveiled the truth that had been concealed beneath multiple layers. He engaged in fierce confrontations with the dark forces within the Chen family. Throughout this process, he continuously grew and overcame difficulties. Ultimately, he successfully brought justice for his mother, revealed the truth to the world, and achieved his own transformation and sublimation.

2135033.title: Ice Queen CEO 2
2135033.description: Is an urban-themed short drama. The female protagonist, Lin Yue, is a cold and ruthless CEO who manages her company with an iron fist, demanding strict performance from her employees and showing no mercy to her competitors. However, in an unexpected encounter, she meets Li Chen, a warm-hearted and kind barista. Li Chen's sincerity and enthusiasm gradually melt Lin Yue's "ice queen" exterior, prompting her to reevaluate her life and values. Influenced by Li Chen, Lin Yue becomes more humane, learns to care for others, and gradually finds warmth in her heart. Meanwhile, internal power struggles within the company and challenges from competitors continue to escalate. Lin Yue must maintain her company's competitiveness while balancing her emotional life. In the end, Lin Yue successfully overcomes all crises and develops a sincere love with Li Chen, achieving a double harvest in both career and love.

2135175.title: Heavenly Master Descends
2135175.description: Divine Ruler Descends" is a fantasy-themed short drama. It tells the story of the Divine Ruler Mo Yuan, who is forced to leave the heavenly realm and descend to the mortal world due to an accident. In the human world, he encounters a kind-hearted village girl named Su Yao. Su Yao is intrigued by this mysterious stranger and decides to help him. With Su Yao's assistance, Mo Yuan gradually adapts to life in the mortal world. He also discovers that an evil force is threatening the peace of the people. Determined to protect humanity, Mo Yuan decides to use his divine powers to combat the evil. In the process, he and Su Yao develop a deep bond. Ultimately, Mo Yuan successfully dispels the evil force, safeguards the peace of the human world, and decides to stay in the mortal realm to spend the rest of his life with Su Yao. This short drama showcases the bravery and kindness of the Divine Ruler, as well as the perfect combination of love and responsibility.

2135252.title: Fast-married wives have hidden identities
2135252.description: A stunning spy marries a CEO for revenge. The twist? She wants his baby... now!

2135346.title: Empress from a Military Family
2135346.description: Queen from a General's Family" is a historical costume short drama. It tells the story of the female protagonist, Lin Yue, who was born into a prominent military family and was exceptionally intelligent and skilled in martial arts from a young age. Due to a palace coup, Lin Yue's family was framed, and she lost everything overnight. In order to avenge her family, Lin Yue disguised herself as a man and infiltrated the palace, becoming a guard. Inside the palace, she repeatedly化解危机with her wisdom and bravery and gradually won the emperor's trust. At the same time, she developed a deep affection with the crown prince, Xiao Yi. After learning the truth about Lin Yue's identity, Xiao Yi decided to help her uncover the truth and clear her family's name. Through a series of investigations and struggles, Lin Yue ultimately cleared her family's name and married Xiao Yi, becoming the queen. This short drama showcases the resilience and intelligence of the female protagonist, as well as the power of love and justice.

2135422.title: Husband's Revenge
2135422.description: "Hubby's Revenge" is a short drama filled with emotional entanglements and elements of revenge. It tells the story of the male protagonist, Lin Hao, a successful businessman, who decides to take revenge after discovering that his wife, Su Wan, and his friend, Zhao Qiang, have betrayed him. After suffering a double blow to his career and marriage, Lin Hao remains calm on the surface while secretly planning a series of retaliatory actions. Using his intelligence and resources, he gradually uncovers the conspiracy of Su Wan and Zhao Qiang and makes them pay for their actions. In the process, Lin Hao unexpectedly develops a deep relationship with a female lawyer named Li Wei. Li Wei's kindness and understanding help Lin Hao emerge from the shadow of revenge and ultimately find inner peace and happiness. This short drama showcases the complexity of human nature, the power of emotions, and the possibility of finding hope in adversity.

2135551.title: Return of the War God
2135551.description: It tells the story of the God of War, Ye Yun, who, after a mysterious time-space穿越，accidentally arrives in a modern metropolis. In this unfamiliar environment, Ye Yun quickly adapts and demonstrates extraordinary abilities with the tenacious will and exceptional martial skills he honed on the battlefield. He not only fights crime and protects the innocent in the dark corners of the city but also gets inadvertently involved in a struggle involving multiple forces over business and power. With his unique charm and formidable strength, Ye Yun wins the support of many friends and allies. Through a series of challenges, Ye Yun gradually uncovers the secrets behind the time-space穿越and also finds a way to return to his own world. In the end, Ye Yun leaves his legend in the modern metropolis and successfully returns to his world, continuing his journey as the God of War.

2135800.title: Su Ranran's Husband Chase
2135800.description: Su Ranyan's Husband Chasing Chronicles" is a short drama set against the backdrop of a martial world's grievances. Su Ranyan, a second-generation royal niece and junior female disciple , was betrothed by her emperor uncle to the second son of the national guardian general, Qin Lang . However, she was reluctant to marry Qin Lang and was racking her brains to escape from her sect. The two met by chance on the road, but Qin Lang mistook Su Ranyan for his cousin Liang Tian and was attracted to this "Liang Tian." However, upon learning that the beauty had already been promised to Lou Xuan the young master of Lou Family Fortress, Qin Lang was filled with distress. Su Ranyan admitted that for three years, she had been dreaming of a man every night but could never remember who he was. On the eve of the wedding, Qin Lang suddenly eloped, causing a sensation in the capital. Unable to bear the gossip, Su Ranyan left home under the pretext of "finding Qin Lang". After a series of bizarre events, Su Ranyan regained her memory. It turned out that she had long been in love with Lou Xuan and was poisoned with the "Red Beauty Toxin," making her the next "Fading Beauty". In the end, Su Ranyan married Lou Xuan, and the lovers were finally united

2135945.title: Rags to Riches
2135945.description: The protagonist, Ah Bao, falls deeply in love with Dui Dui. However, their love faces opposition from Dui Dui's father, leading the couple to elope. By chance, Ah Bao secures a job at a major company, and their lives begin to improve. As Ah Bao's career takes off and he becomes increasingly busy, Dui Dui becomes a stay-at-home wife. The growing gap between them, both in terms of their daily lives and mutual understanding, eventually leads to conflicts. In the end, Ah Bao builds a new house in their hometown, and the couple is reunited, symbolizing a fresh start and the enduring power of love.

2135995.title: Fake daughter becomes a global favourite
2135995.description: I was abandoned by everyone at my wedding ceremony. Fortunately, my three brothers stayed by my side to protect me. Unexpectedly, but my brothers fell in love with me...

2136136.title: Prosperity 2003
2136136.description: In a previous life, Li Yuan, driven by his desire for a life of luxury and indulgence, forced his wife to work at a KTV. Tragically, the KTV caught fire, and his wife perished in the blaze. Their daughter subsequently developed depression and, on the anniversary of her mother’s death, committed suicide by jumping into the sea. Li Yuan, unable to dissuade her, was overwhelmed with guilt and followed his daughter into the sea. Miraculously, he was reborn on the day of the fire. Armed with the foreknowledge from his past life, he changed the tragic fate of his family. This is the story of how he used his second chance to lead his family to a happy life.

2136208.title: Mr. Gu's richest ex-wife
2136208.description: From Ashes to Riches: A Wronged Woman's Revenge Falsely accused of infidelity and nearly burned alive, she vanishes without a trace. Years later, she returns as a billionaire tycoon with one goal: sweet, cold revenge. Watch her take down her enemies one by one in this gripping tale of justice and retribution. Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned!

2136332.title: The Revenge of the Bride
2136332.description: Revenge of the Heiress: From Glam to Vengeance, Binge this addictive drama! She married into wealth, even accepting a disabled husband, all to avenge her mother. Watch her transform from socialite to mastermind as she makes everyone pay. Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned!

2136419.title: Divorce for a Night's Husband
2136419.description: The CEO spent millions hiring me for a divorce case, only to discover I was his fiancée. He was devastated.
2136419.originName: 一夜激情后离婚的丈夫

2136553.title: Seduced the Boss
2136553.description: After a passionate night with her "convenient" husband, the girl flees in a panic. She hides her identity and becomes his personal secretary, innocent yet alluring, unknowingly captivating the CEO's heart. Little does he know, she's the wife he's been married to for six years!

2136682.title: Hooker Is Ex-Girlfriend
2136682.description: The CEO thought Cinderella was selling her body for money. He loved her but tormented her! By the time he realized she was his true love and tried to win her back, it was already too late!

2136793.title: Queen of Law
2136793.description: The business world is in turmoil, the queen has returned, who dares to challenge her power? She was once a chess piece being played, now she has become the master on the chessboard! In the middle of the shopping mall, vengeance and power go hand in hand, and the path of the Queen, step by step!

2136924.title: Jilted and  Married: The CEO's Comeback
2136924.description: On my wedding day, my fiancé slept with my best friend. I just grabbed a random waiter to get through the wedding, only to find out he was a powerful tycoon. On our wedding night, he pampered me so much that I couldn't get out of bed.
2136924.originName: 被抛弃的她闪婚总裁的逆袭

2136985.title: Twins' Revenge, Love Twist
2136985.description: The heroine seeks revenge for her sister by impersonating her and marrying into the Qin family to find the murderer. Throughout the story, she methodically investigates and identifies suspects one by one. As she delves deeper into the truth, she gradually develops feelings for the hero. In the course of her search, she makes a shocking discovery: the child her sister was carrying was not fathered by her brother-in-law!

2137061.title: Love Night, Unexpected
2137061.description: In order to save the president's young master, she willingly sacrificed herself, and the young master promised to be responsible for her, but her identity was replaced by her poisonous best friend. The young master realizes that something is not right, and after all the temptations and investigations, he finally clears the heroine's name.

2137146.title: Passionate Night: Who's the Father?
2137146.description: To raise money for her mother’s medical treatment, she had no choice but to sleep with the CEO. Years later, she returned as an internationally renowned designer—only to run into him again by chance.
2137146.originName: 暗夜激情谁是孩子爸爸

2137215.title: My Dream Princess
2137215.description: The domineering CEO was drugged and mistook Cinderella for an antidote. The next morning, seeing the bloodstained sheets, he fell completely in love with her.

2137354.title: Surprise Hottie Husband
2137354.description: Cinderella deliberately dressed in a quirky, non-mainstream style for her blind date with the CEO. To her surprise, the CEO saw through her act but didn’t expose her. Instead, he played along—and over their dates, he fell in love with her.

2137411.title: Desperate Housewife Strikes Back
2137411.description: The grieving widow discovered her husband murdered her father—then watched him defile the wake with his sister-in-law. When she tried to expose the truth, they dragged her into a nightmare of captivity and cruelty. But the delicate bride they underestimated is crafting her revenge from the shadows. As blood debts entwine with dark secrets, the hunter and the hunted switch roles in a deadly game where love and vengeance bleed into one.

2137471.title: Runaway Bride, Love Night
2137471.description: After fleeing her wedding, Cinderella spent a passionate night with a strange man. Rumors had it that the top tycoon, a billionaire CEO, was not only a useless and disabled person but also allergic to women. To everyone's surprise, he was inexplicably and irresistibly drawn to Cinderella alone!

2137600.title: The Mute's Contract Bride
2137600.description: After a one-night stand, the mute woman suddenly found herself a "mrs." of a powerful dynasty, only to face abuse from the household manager. Though skeptical about her identity, the CEO kept helping her in secret. After a decade of searching, fate brought her back to him—this time, he vowed not to let her go. "My wife, you're not escaping me again."

2137723.title: The Billion-Dollar Marriage Contract of a Secret Agent Wife
2137723.description: A top secret agent in Jinghai accepts a 50-million mission to marry the cold-faced CEO Huo Muze. To test her fiancé, she plans a fake kidnapping, which unexpectedly awakens Huo Muze's buried memories. It turns out she was the one who saved his life when they were children! After a lightning-fast wedding, the agent plans to complete her mission quickly, but gradually develops feelings under Huo Muze's gentle pursuit. However, a priceless painting becomes an invisible barrier between them. When her identity as a secret agent is about to be exposed and the Zhou family suddenly appears, how will she choose between truth and love?

2137863.title: Baby Attack: Mom is Hard to Please
2137863.description: Su Bei crosses paths with Fu Yunshang due to an accident, but she is bullied by villains and leaves town. Five years later, she returns with her cute child. Fu Yunshang once misunderstood that he was betrayed, but at a banquet, he appears in time to deal with the villains who bullied Su Bei and her child. Su Bei takes revenge and schemes to ruin Ding Junhui, while Fu Yunshang uses this opportunity to solve the suburban project issues, bringing them closer. During a design competition, the villain Su Xi causes trouble multiple times, but Fu Yunshang always helps Su Bei. However, when Su Bei is falsely accused during the competition, she decisively withdraws. The male lead pretends to be sick to draw out the main villain Fu Lian, and a business war quietly begins. In the end, all the villains are defeated, all previous grudges and conspiracies are resolved, and Fu Yunshang and Su Bei find sweet love.

2137917.title: Cunning Female Secretary
2137917.description: A female secretary destroyed the protagonist's family. After growing up, the protagonist becomes this female CEO's secretary, pretending to seduce the CEO's husband and manipulating her son to successfully get revenge. However, she unexpectedly falls in love with the CEO's son and discovers that her revenge target is actually her birth mother. A story of revenge, painful love, and repeated struggles and suffering, from beginning to end.

2138008.title: Genius Baby: Bringing Mommy Home to Be Spoiled
2138008.description: After Miss Tong Yao's father dies, she accidentally has a relationship with the male lead Lu Yuanshen. The next day, her cousin Tong Rou'er catches them. Tong Rou'er lies that Tong Yao seduced a beggar, bringing shame to the family, and decides to kill Tong Yao. Considering Tong Yao's father's shares, she decides to lock Tong Yao in the basement. Tong Rou'er impersonates Tong Yao to get close to the noble Lu Yuanshen, trying to climb up the social ladder. A drama of conspiracy and chaos begins.
2138008.originName: 天才萌宝，拐个妈咪回家宠

2138131.title: Hidden Glory
2138131.description: Jiang Ruoning was separated from her twin sister Jiang Ruoyun since childhood. When she returned to her country, she only received news of her sister's death, while her sister's husband could claim a huge compensation because of it. Jiang Ruoning's intuition tells her that her sister's death is suspicious. So she disguises herself as a blind person, takes her sister's identity and returns to her husband's side, determined to avenge her sister.

2138275.title: Oh No! I'm Surrounded by Handsome Men
2138275.description: Designer Jiang Zhiwan discovers her boyfriend cheating with her company executive's daughter. After being framed, she's forced to leave her job. During this period, she meets various handsome men. Through her interactions with them, Jiang gradually reaches the peak of her career while developing deeper emotional connections with these attractive men...

2138376.title: Bound to Your Body, My Soul
2138376.description: Zhong Yun is a small-time streamer who lives with her new roommate, Ji Cang. Due to her job, Zhong Yun frequently disturbs the peace, and Ji Cang can't stand it anymore. Though living under the same roof, they are constantly at odds. Unexpectedly, they accidentally swap souls. A series of funny and chaotic events follow, and through these incidents, they come to understand each other's feelings and decide to be together. However, before their souls can switch back, Ji Cang dies while in Zhong Yun's ailing body. The whole world mourns the quirky female streamer, but the real Zhong Yun remains trapped in Ji Cang's healthy body, privately mourning the truly deceased Ji Cang. She is confined not only by Ji Cang's body but also by his love. From then on, she becomes him, flowing with his blood, beating with his heart, and honoring his soul.
2138376.originName: 执于你的躯体我的魂灵

2138449.title: Princess Marries the Young Marshal
2138449.description: At her sickbed, she is reborn as her grandmother in the Republic of China era. She helps her grandmother escape an arranged marriage and falls in love with the Young Marshal. Using her modern wisdom, she helps the Young Marshal overcome numerous challenges, and they eventually fulfill their wish to live a happy life together.

2138555.title: Reborn Heiress's Revenge
2138555.description: The story follows Gu Qingtian, a high-level perfumer who is reborn to seek revenge. In her previous life, she gave up her career for Chu Shangxu, only to be betrayed and abused to death. After being reborn, she is determined to stay away from toxic people and embark on a journey of success. Gu Qingtian first exposes Gu Ruxi's plot to steal her fragrance formula, causing her to lose face in front of Mr. Xu. She also discovers Zhao Suyuan's affair and the secret that Gu Ruxi is not her father's biological daughter, successfully driving them out of the Gu family. While building a business with Lin Xiao, her relationship with Chu Shangxu also changes. Eventually, Chu Shangxu learns the truth and breaks up with Gu Ruxi, even getting injured while saving Gu Qingtian. The two resolve their misunderstandings, and Gu Qingtian successfully takes control of the Gu corporation, gaining both love and career success.

2138620.title: My Corner Store Connects to Heaven
2138620.description: The ultimate corner store with a backdoor directly to the heavenly realm! Lovestruck Han Li plans to sell his late father's store to marry his girlfriend, only to discover she's cheating on him. What?! An ice cream exchanged for a jade worth a billion? A bottle of liquor traded for immortality pills worth three billion? Han Li embarks on a journey to turn his life around!

2138732.title: Absolute Devotion
2138732.description: Qiao Wanxia lost contact with her biological father since childhood and was suddenly kidnapped to marry a disabled young master, Jiang Yuhan. Initially, she planned to play along and deal with it later, but Jiang Yuhan wouldn't let her go. After marriage, Qiao Wanxia found everything going smoothly, thinking her luck had turned around, but in reality, Jiang Yuhan was quietly supporting and spoiling her behind the scenes. It turns out this seemingly powerless rich husband was actually hiding his true capabilities all along.

2138840.title: The Raging Elite Sister-in-Law
2138840.description: When her husband's company faces a financial crisis, the quiet and modest housewife suddenly produces a large bag of money. It turns out she is actually the daughter of a billionaire. Five years ago, she gave up her identity to marry down, hoping to find happiness, but instead received increasingly unbridled hurt. Unable to tolerate it anymore, she decides to reveal her true identity and make those who looked down on her regret it!

2138973.title: Love After Mistaken Identity (Express Delivery Marriage to the Billionaire CEO)
2138973.description: During her graduate studies, Zhou Yan has a drunken one-night stand with Lin Yichu, CEO of Lin Group, and secretly leaves. She gets pregnant, drops out of school, and raises her child. Six years later, working as a delivery person, Zhou Yan mistakes Lin Yichu for her blind date, rekindling their relationship. Also pressured to marry, Lin Yichu hides his identity and they quickly wed. They deliver packages together and face her former classmates. When Zhou Yan nearly loses her job, Lin Yichu dramatically intervenes. He recommends her for a position at Lin Group, where they work together to confront her brother and a hypocritical woman at her mother's birthday party. At work, Lin helps Zhou overcome colleagues' hostility. After various twists, Zhou Yan discovers Lin is the Lin Group heir, while Lin realizes she was his one-night stand and their daughter Yuan Yuan is his child. With their daughter's help, they acknowledge their feelings and become a true couple.
2138973.originName: 错认之后爱在不期而遇（外卖闪婚千亿总裁）

2139070.title: Towards a Clear Evening Sky
2139070.description: Fifteen years ago, the once-wealthy Xiang family went bankrupt overnight due to deliberate sabotage by Song Yanting, a partner of Song Group. Xiang Yiwan witnessed her father's fatal fall as a child. Her mother took her away to make a living elsewhere but later died from heart disease due to hardship. While sorting through her mother's belongings, Yiwan found a letter from her father about reclaiming the family fortune, igniting her desire for revenge. Three years later, Yiwan deliberately gets caught by loan sharks who sell her to a nightclub to auction her virginity. Drugged, she escapes and purposely approaches An Yiran, spending a night with him before strategically leaving. When An Yiran's translator is late, Yiwan appears as a replacement and helps him secure a deal, demonstrating intimate knowledge of his preferences and habits. This makes An Yiran suspect she's a spy from a rival company, so he hires her as manager of the new energy department. Despite staff protests and resignations, Yiwan single-handedly revitalizes the struggling department. Her meticulous and decisive actions help her skillfully navigate An Yiran's traps and tests. Through their repeated confrontations, An Yiran becomes attracted to her while remaining unable to discern her true intentions.

2139139.title: CEO Fan Gets a Wife from the Sky
2139139.description: CEO Fan, who has been deceived by his first love Chuchu, accidentally swaps souls with Su Wanqing on the eve of his engagement. They maintain their outward identities while punishing the cheating boyfriend, exposing the company's hidden criminals, helping Su Wanqing reunite with her biological father, and finally revealing Chuchu's true face. Despite all obstacles, CEO Fan is determined to be with Su Wanqing.

2139250.title: Rose of Vengeance
2139250.description: "Rose of Vengeance" is a gripping short drama about a rose devastated by betrayal and hurt, who is reborn from despair to become an avenging goddess. Using her wisdom as a blade and beauty as a shield, she carefully plots to seek justice from those who once caused her endless pain. In this battle of love and hate, she not only reveals the truth but also rediscovers herself, ultimately blooming into her most radiant form, showing the world the beauty and power of a flower seeking revenge.

2139377.title: She Returns with Three Children After Five Years
2139377.description: The story follows the ups and downs of the female protagonist Gu Qing's life. Gu Qing was once the secretary of the male protagonist Ji Huaifeng. After a banquet, they had a one-night stand. Gu Qing was framed by Ji's mother and the second female lead, forcing her to flee abroad where she gave birth to three children and became the famous designer 'Cline'. Five years later, she returns with her children and reunites with Ji Huaifeng, experiencing a series of twists. The second female leads Huang Ying and Xia Zhiyu repeatedly try to harm Gu Qing. While investigating the truth, Ji Huaifeng gradually recognizes Gu Qing's identity and true feelings. Their relationship deepens as they overcome various crises together. Eventually, they successfully resolve the conspiracies, punish the villains, hold their wedding, and live happily together as a family.
2139377.originName: 五年后她携三宝强势回归

2139453.title: The Return of the Heiress
2139453.description: Ten years ago, Sheng Yunxi lost her memory after being pushed off a cliff by her best friend and was adopted by a kind couple. Ten years later, she faces bullying from classmates and pressure from her boss at a restaurant, but is rescued by Sheng Jingyuan. When her adoptive father falls critically ill, Sheng Jingyuan confirms her identity through DNA testing. Sheng Yunxi then faces betrayal from her boyfriend, bullying and framing by her best friend, putting her life in danger.

2139538.title: Parallel Universe
2139538.description: Dr. Ning Ruke researches parallel worlds and successfully travels through dimensions, exchanging identities with her alternate self. She faces hospitalization for a miscarriage and endures a cold, abusive marriage where only her mother-in-law shows compassion. Ning not only breaks free from her marriage constraints but also wins deeper love from her mother-in-law. Ruan Manting, harboring resentment, repeatedly sets traps, but through their battle of wits, Ning ultimately achieves a happy life.

2139682.title: Fire God War King
2139682.description: Lin Tian and Fang Jiatong are in love, but face opposition from the Fang family because he is an orphan whose family was massacred. The Fang family forcibly separates them, and Lin Tian angrily travels to the Western Border, eventually becoming the War King. When he returns, he protects his wife and daughter while discovering the true reason behind his parents' murder...

2139803.title: Rebirth of a Son-in-law with Superpowers
2139803.description: Once a fallen rich man's son, he accidentally becomes the son-in-law of the Gao family. While constantly being humiliated, he is also brutally murdered. Just when he feels life is unfair, heaven gives him a chance to be reborn. In this new life, he changes his weak personality, makes a fortune to become the richest man, takes revenge on those who wronged him, and builds his own power. He thinks he will smoothly complete his new life journey and marry his ideal...

2139882.title: The Untold Secret
2139882.description: Su Monian was a teacher in North City. Her boss wanted to keep her as a mistress after seeing she was alone, but when rejected, he fired her out of anger. After being fired, Su Monian came to teach at a rural school where she met her student Xinxin. Upon seeing the scars on Xinxin's body, Su was reminded of her own childhood experience with domestic violence, felt sympathy, and wanted to help Xinxin. Su Monian kept trying to find evidence of Xinxin being abused, even following Xinxin's stepfather and mother, but they hid it well. Xinxin also seemed very close to her mother. Just as Su decided to give up and return to work in the city, Xinxin found Su and asked her to take her away. After an internal struggle, Su took Xinxin and they began their journey as fugitives.

2139990.title: Baby's Strategy in Progress
2139990.description: The story follows An Youqi's tumultuous life journey. Once the eldest daughter of the An family, she was schemed against by her stepmother and exiled abroad, becoming the elite assassin 'Poppy' for a secret organization. During her final mission, she had a one-night encounter with Fu Yunzhou. Six years later, she returns with her son Mobao, whose voice can heal Fu Yunzhou's mother. An Youqi is pursued by her former fiancé Fu Ziyan, and to protect her son, she cooperates with Fu Yunzhou. Throughout this process, they face schemes from An Ran, Song Wenran and others, as well as pursuit from 'Sky Wolf'. Eventually, with Mobao's help, An Youqi and Fu Yunzhou resolve their misunderstandings, successfully get revenge, overcome numerous difficulties together, hold their wedding and welcome new life, living happily ever after.

2140065.title: Legend of the Princess
2140065.description: Princess Jiang Ruohan from Shaoyang was a brilliant talent, who became the top scholar and martial artist in the Great Xia Dynasty. Due to her outstanding abilities, the paranoid emperor sent her to fight against the Huns. Despite being outnumbered, she fought bravely for a year and returned with honor, only to find that treacherous officials had falsely accused her family, resulting in their execution, while she was sentenced to death. With resentment and humiliation, she was reborn as Jiang Ruohan, a daughter of a modern wealthy family. Upon awakening, she discovered that her husband was Xia Zeyuan, the husband she had failed in her previous life, her former parents became her in-laws, and even her enemy, the Great Xia Emperor, was reincarnated as Shangguan Lie, a business rival of the Xia family. To make up for the regrets of her previous life, Jiang Ruohan vowed to protect the Xia family in this peaceful modern era. She used her extraordinary skills to adapt to modern culture, win back her husband's love, and help the struggling Xia family regain its former glory. Finally, she fulfilled her wish to protect her family and lived a happy life.

2140124.title: Shadow Under the Eaves
2140124.description: "Shadow Under the Eaves" tells the story of Wang Tao who discovers the truth behind his parents' death when he returns to his hometown. Upon arrival, Wang Tao notices villagers acting strangely toward him and rumors about his old house being haunted. During his investigation, he finds suspicious clues like rat poison packaging and his aunt's odd behavior, making him suspect she was involved in his parents' death. As he digs deeper, a woman named Alin appears, manipulating a mentally challenged person to pretend to be a ghost to guide Wang Tao toward the truth. Eventually, his aunt reveals that she protected Alin by sending her away, and explains the real circumstances of his parents' and uncle's deaths. Alin reconciles with her past and reunites with the aunt, while Wang Tao resolves his misunderstandings with his aunt, allowing everyone to begin a new chapter in their lives.

2140214.title: Dear You
2140214.description: Wenhao, who focused on work and neglected his family, eventually divorced his wife Xiayi. After his business failed, he ran a grocery store to take care of his son Wenwen. Tragically, Wenwen was kidnapped in an accident, and Wenhao and Xiayi embarked on a six-year journey to find their son. During this time, they were scammed out of their savings, got their car stuck in mud, and accidentally rescued Mrs. Lin who was in a similar situation, helping Lin Qi reunite with his family. The couple supported and encouraged each other, overcoming numerous difficulties. Finally, with the help of kind people, they reunited with Wenwen, and their once-broken family was made whole again. Justice prevailed as the criminals were caught.

2140333.title: I Am Not a Quack Doctor
2140333.description: In Chengxin Private Hospital's cardiac surgery department, there are two doctors with very similar names: Niu Lianlian and Niu Lianlian. Despite their similar names, their achievements and status are worlds apart. Niu Lianlian is a world-class cardiac surgeon and the pillar of Chengxin Hospital, the top-ranked private hospital in the country. Niu Lianlian, however, is an incompetent doctor who got the job through connections. When the old hospital director Gao Mingda goes abroad to study, his son Gao Sheng takes over Chengxin, confuses the two doctors, and confidently fires the 'pillar' Niu Lianlian...

2140440.title: I Lost the Twins
2140440.description: Lin Zhilan, daughter of a local wealthy family, gives birth to twins. Shortly after, her husband dies. Her sister, Shen Shiqing, wanting her own daughter to inherit the family fortune, secretly abandons the twins on the roadside and tricks Lin Zhilan into 'adopting' her biological daughter. Later, the twins are found by an old garbage collector who names them Tuantuan and Yuanyuan. After the old man's death, the children must beg on the streets while searching for their birth mother. While begging, they are falsely taken in by a cruel boss, Hu Cheng, who encourages them to steal. Surprisingly, they end up stealing from their biological mother's home. Their mother, unaware of their true identity, takes pity on them and takes them in.

2140516.title: The Return of the War God: Don't Bully My Wife (Glory Return)
2140516.description: When Zhang Yaorong's parents were extorted by Liu Shihao while running their stall, Zhang Yaorong intervened and injured him. As revenge, Zhang was detained, but with help from his parents, Zhou Qingqing, and villagers, he escaped danger. Three years later, Zhang Yaorong returns home to repay their kindness. Zhou Qingqing, fulfilling her three-year promise, willingly marries into the Zhang family. Liu Shihao, using the Zhang family's property deed, threatens to demolish their house and attempts to force himself on Zhou Qingqing. At this critical moment, Zhang Yaorong returns, eliminates the bully, and saves everyone.
2140516.originName: 战神归来娇妻不可欺（荣归）

2140595.title: Love in Progress
2140595.description: "Love in Progress" revolves around the love story of Manman and Xiaolong. Manman defies her family's opposition for love and follows Xiaolong to the countryside. In the rural setting, their relationship faces numerous challenges, including constant mother-in-law conflicts and troubles with Xiaolong's vegetable shed business. The situation becomes more complicated with the appearance of Wang Tao and Meiying - Wang Tao pursues Manman, while Meiying has a complex history with Xiaolong, causing frequent misunderstandings and on-and-off relationship between Manman and Xiaolong. Later, Xiaolong starts a barbecue restaurant business with Wang Tao and his older brother, experiencing many ups and downs. Five years later, Xiaolong becomes successful in his career, Manman returns, they reunite, and the story reaches its conclusion after many twists and turns.

2140675.title: Private Tutor to the Duke’s Daughter
2140675.description: Allen, a bright young sorcerer, wants nothing more than to go back to a modest existence in the country after failing the last exam for his ideal position at the royal court. Regretfully, he is unable to pay for the train fare! Getting a job is his only option, but his one lead is anything but humble—Duke Howard, one of the most influential nobles in the realm, seeks a private tutor for his daughter, Tina. Even though Tina is a brilliant student, she cannot cast a single spell. Even worse, magical aptitude is required for the elite Royal Academy's entrance tests, which are quickly approaching! Can Tina overcome her magical impairment—a riddle that has eluded even the best sorcerers in the kingdom—with Allen's special kind of spellcasting?  Does the Duke, her father, even want him to?

2140736.title: Uglymug, Epicfighter
2140736.description: Shigeru Yoshioka, 34, gets wrongfully accused of a crime, loses everything, including his faith in women, and becomes a reclusive recluse who withdraws from society. He discovers a means of traveling to a different universe one day.  Shigeru gives up his appearance in order to obtain an overwhelming 100 trillion and 5,100 parameters when a suspicious status panel appears on his computer.  After being reincarnated as an "Absolute God," he starts a new life on a different planet.

2140840.title: WIND BREAKER Season 2 (Thai Dub)
2140840.description:
The lone delinquent high schooler, Sakura, arrives at the infamous Furin High, known as the ultimate school for delinquents, aiming to rise to the top through sheer strength.
However, the Furin is no longer the lawless battleground it once was, which now called "Bofurin", it has transformed into a group dedicated to protecting the city.
As a member of Bofurin, Sakura gradually bonds with the people of the town. Through fierce battles against the Shishitoren Gang, he begins to grow.
Now, as class leader, he faces a brand-new enemy—ready to fight once again!

2140899.title: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
2140899.description: A white wizard named Lloyd gets expelled from the hero's group one day. By coincidence, Lloyd, who has lost his job, goes on a mission with an S-rank group. Nobody realized at the moment that Lloyd would become famous and the hero's party would fall apart. This is the tale of an outstanding support magic user who, oblivious to how he ultimately becomes unmatched, believes he is normal and turns into an adventurer.
2140899.originName: 勇者パーティーを追放された白魔導師、Sランク冒険者に拾われる

2141024.title: Clevatess: The King of Devil Beasts, The Baby and the Brave of Undead
2141024.description: Alicia, who had longed to be a hero since childhood, was chosen by the king and became one of the thirteen heroes. Carrying the legendary sword, they set out on a journey to vanquish Clevatess, the King of Demon Beasts. However, this rash bravery has brought about a disaster that could wipe out all of humanity on the Continent, triggering the most severe crisis ever. Now, the last glimmer of hope left in the world lies with an infant entrusted to the King of Demon Beasts.
2141024.originName: クレバテス-魔獸の王と赤子と屍の勇者- 1期

2141222.title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
2141222.description:
Living beneath her sister's shadow, a poor baron's daughter has never had anything. She has only ragged work clothes, no dresses, and her hair is full of hairballs. A wealthy and powerful aristocrat shows interest in her sister, but she passes away en route to her wedding.

Marie is sent to replace her sister as a bride because the baron is unable to pay the earl back for the dowry that has already been sold.  But isn't that impossible? Was the proposition, first of all, misunderstood? An intelligent earl and a fallen baron's daughter have a lovely and joyful love story.
2141222.originName: ずたぼろ令嬢は姉の元婚約者に溺愛される

2141353.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7TH PRINCE so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My MAGICAL ABILITY 2nd Season
2141353.description:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
2141353.originName: 転生したら第七王子だったので、   気ままに魔術を極めます

2141413.title: Kaiju No. 8 Season 2
2141413.description:
Although Kafka Hibino is spared from being weaponized thanks to Defense Force Director Shinomiya’s judgment, he remains in confinement. As the new Third Division recruits head off to their assignments, Kafka is confronted by Gen Narumi—the formidable leader of the First Division and the Defense Force’s strongest soldier.

Narumi sees no value in Kafka as a team member, forcing Kafka to prove his worth by facing the immense power of Kaiju No. 8 head-on. Meanwhile, in the shadows, the sinister threat of Kaiju No. 9 draws ever closer…

2141466.title: TOUGEN ANKI
2141466.description:
People who have Oni and Momotarou blood in their veins have a long-standing feud. The Momotarou defend the human world from the unruly Oni, who are reckless, impetuous, and chaotic. Shiki Ichinose is a careless and reckless adolescent who is proud of his expulsion from school and conscious of his disobedience. Shiki's foster father, Tsuyoshi, loves him despite his disobedient demeanor.
Soon after, when a Momotarou storms in seeking Shiki, Tsuyoshi's unselfish love is demonstrated in a dramatic episode. Being a Momotarou himself, Tsuyoshi has been concealing Shiki's Oni ancestry from him for years. The first time Shiki's Oni blood emerges, he becomes an untamed beast filled with anger and a desire for vengeance as he sacrifices his life to save Shiki and confesses everything in his final breath.
A instructor of Oni at the Rakshasa Academy, a facility for young Oni who need to learn and hone their abilities, Naito Mudano, notices Shiki's brief outburst. Shiki must to overcome his own demonic blood and learn to restrain his impulsive and stubborn personality before he can exact revenge on his father.

2141581.title: Gachiakuta
2141581.description: Rudo resides in a floating town's slums, where the impoverished struggle to make ends meet while the wealthy have luxurious lives and just throw their trash into the abyss.  One day he is wrongfully convicted of murder and sentenced to an unthinkable punishment: banishment off the edge with the rest of the trash.  Rudo will have to learn a new power and join a group called the Cleaners who fight the giant trash beasts of the Pit if he hopes to have any chance of learning the truth and getting revenge on those who cast him into Hell. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has produced vicious monsters!

2141683.title: Let's Go Karaoke!
2141683.description: Nothing worries Satomi Oka more than the upcoming final choir competition of his middle school career—right up until he is accosted by a stranger from the shadows who demands, "Let's go karaoke!" As a yakuza, Kyouji Narita doesn't scare easily, but a terrifying prospect has driven him to seek Satomi's help. The boss is holding a karaoke contest, with the loser forced to get a tattoo to be selected and torturously applied by the boss himself! Oka has been to many vocal rehearsals over the years, but never one-on-one karaoke sessions with a gangster!!

2141768.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...
2141768.description: In an effort to become a popular and gregarious high school student, awkward and introverted Amaori Renako is leaving her lonely middle school life behind. Renako's complete opposite is the glamorous, self-assured Oduka Mai, who is rich, carefree, and a real fashion model. In spite of everything, the two females click right away. Before Mai's love revelation throws Renako's heart into a tailspin, she believes she may have found the best friend of her life.  Mai is adamant that they are meant to be lovers, despite Renako's attempts to show her that being best friends is preferable to being a girlfriend.
2141768.originName: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!

2141863.title: Detectives These Days Are Crazy!
2141863.description:
Keiichirou Nagumo was once a high-school detective who could swiftly solve any case and unravel every mystery. But now, plagued by back pain, failing eyesight, fragile nerves, he's become a total middle-aged man abandoned by the times—he can't even use a smartphone!
"It's not that my talent has withered—just that I've lost a bit of youth," he claims.
Yet one day, a vibrant high-school girl named Mashiro suddenly shows up at the Detective Agency, asking to become his assistant.
 It seems she aims to be a detective...!?
The exciting daily life of a middle-aged detective and his quirky high-school girl assistant is about to begin!
2141863.originName: まったく最近の探偵ときたら

2141965.title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
2141965.description: Hyakuan Momoyumi, a mystery "self-proclaimed sage" who has been barred from the afterlife, is Mogura. In order to get back, he travels the world and gathers ghost "lamps" for his lantern. But there is a unique benefit to meeting him: the capacity to perceive odd occurrences.

2142092.title: A Couple of Cuckoos Season 2
2142092.description:
Erika Amano and Nagi Umino were unintentionally born together; one was brought up as the daughter of a hotel magnate, while the other was raised as the son of a diner owner. Their adoptive and biological parents propose an arranged engagement after they find out the truth. Now that they share a home, Nagi's already complex existence attracts his classmate Hiro, his sister Sachi, who is not connected by blood, and soon even his childhood first love.

In this romantic comedy, which is based on a case of mistaken identity, Nagi is surrounded by a complicated web of relationships, including a childhood friend, stepsister, crush, and fiancée. Fate takes an even more drastic turn this summer!

2142229.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 4
2142229.description:
As the Four Guardian Beasts' resuscitation draws closer, the Shield Hero Naofumi Iwatani attempts to bring the frequently at odds Four Legendary Heroes together. Peace seemed to be achievable following the confrontation and reconciliation with the other three.

But because of a misinterpretation, some people think Raphtalia wants to take a kingdom, which makes her a target for assassins from the Kutenrou nation. Naofumi goes to Siltvelt, a demi-human country that reveres the Shield Hero, to put an end to the issue.  Despite being widely embraced, not all Siltvelt factions support him.  Kutenrou is experiencing political turmoil at the same time, and Raphtalia is viewed as a symbol of revolution. Can Naofumi be the beacon of light his friends need as the tensions rise and chaos spreads?
2142229.originName: 盾の勇者の成り上がり4期

2142375.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
2142375.description:
New experiences come with a new stage.

Sakuta Azusagawa, a university student now, and his girlfriend, actress Mai Sakurajima, start a new chapter in their lives after he once encountered the peculiar consequences of Adolescence Syndrome. He meets Touko Kirishima, a girl dressed as Santa, at Yokohama University and quickly becomes entangled in more enigmatic events.

The strange keeps happening, from enigmatic online singers to precognitive dreams and spectral poltergeists.
Troubled girls' hearts falter once more since adolescence never really ends.
2142375.originName: 青春ブタ野郎 大学生編

2142430.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
2142430.description: Subaru Ayase's son, Yuu Ayase, attends the prestigious Saika Academy, which is renowned for its development of potential. The Mikadono sisters, Miwa, Nico, and Kazuki, are all prodigies in shogi, martial arts, and performing arts, but Yuu is nothing compared to his mother. Yuu, in fulfillment of his mother's last desire to "build a happy family," moves in with her old acquaintance, who also happens to be the father of the sisters. Despite the sisters' chilly and alone state brought on by their extreme devotion to their crafts, Yuu's generosity and perseverance gradually start to heal their damaged relationships and unite the family.
2142430.originName: 帝乃三姉妹は案外、チョロい。

2142577.title: April Showers Bring May Flowers
2142577.description: Notwithstanding what her name would imply, Hana Tabata is not at all like a flower. Her limbs are far from thin, and her eyes are too tiny. Since she is "ugly," she is aware that she cannot have a fairy tale romance or cute stuff. Despite this, she continues to daydream every morning while caring for the lovely flower beds at the school that contrast with her appearance. Tabata meets her classmate, Yousuke Ueno, who is recognized for being both attractive and incredibly nice, during a chance meeting one day. Why would a well-liked student hang out with a minor character like her?  Although Tabata finds the scenario inexplicable, can Ueno demonstrate to her that appearances aren't everything?

2142708.title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
2142708.description:
Dennis has been banished from the Silver Wings Battalion, one of the most powerful guilds in the area, after being betrayed by people he thought were his friends. However, he doesn't give it much thought because he is eager to use his level 99 cooking abilities nonetheless. He chooses to open a diner in the country instead of staying in the city for this reason.

Dennis encounters Atrielle, a girl banished from her aristocratic family and forced into slavery, until he rescues her, as he is chasing his goal. Together, the two open the diner, and their first customer is... a knight in exile from another guild?  The legend of Dennis and his cafe, the town's talk of the town, begins here!
2142708.originName: 追放者食堂へようこそ！

2142833.title: Secrets of the Silent Witch
2142833.description: The world's only unchanted magecraft user is Monica Everett, the Silent Witch, a real hero who vanquished a fabled black dragon on her own. In reality, though, this young genius is incredibly bashful! True enough: In order to avoid speaking in front of others, she learnt to cast spells silently. Despite her power, she lacks confidence.  Monica has now been assigned to protect the second prince in secret. Can she maintain her composure in the face of the prince's persecutors and the social interaction fears?
2142833.originName: サイレント・ウィッチ

2142992.title: Captivated, by You
2142992.description: As he counts the stairs in the school, takes pictures of street signs, and dries sweet potatoes on the classroom balcony, Hayashi's candid, unapologetic manner subtly attracts the attention of both classmates and outsiders.  Hayashi is refreshingly and unabashedly authentic to himself in a society where conformity is the norm. Nikaidou, on the other hand, has put a lot of effort into creating a grim, dismal persona that puts his friends at bay.
