Even though a large portion of the school views Nikaidou negatively, one student manages to see behind the mask and, unfazed by tales of misfortune and supernatural abilities, starts to dismantle Nikaidou's meticulously constructed character...

Momo believes in ghosts but not aliens, whereas Okarun believes in aliens but not ghosts. Nevertheless, the two quickly clash.
In an attempt to disprove one another, they place a daring wager: Okarun enters a spooky tunnel, while Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where UFOs have been reported.

So begins a strange and exciting supernatural battle between the unknown, aliens, and ghosts!

2148153.title: Love You All Along
2148153.description: Lin Zhiai gets drunk at a party and accidentally spends the night with lawyer Leng Qingsong. When her family faces bankruptcy, she asks him for help. Despite obstacles trying to keep them apart, he helps her find evidence to win the lawsuit and save her family business. In the end, they fall in love.

2148290.title: Love Awakens
2148290.description: Jiang Nuannuan is forced by her mother to marry her sister's fiancé Mu Tingxiao, who is rumored to be disabled but isn't. On their wedding night, he pretends to be his cousin and calls her ugly. Through various events, their relationship slowly grows as he pampers her. When she's drugged and taken to a KTV, he saves her. Her appearance transforms dramatically, she exposes her sister's schemes, excels at work, survives a kidnapping, and after recovery, they decide to hold their own wedding ceremony.

2148405.title: Love When Stars Shine Bright
2148405.description: A woman drunkenly calls her boss by mistake, confessing her love and anger about betrayal - words meant for her ex-boyfriend. When she sobers up, she realizes her mistake. Her boss thinks she was confessing to him and gives her a chance to pursue him, leading to a funny romantic misunderstanding and the start of their sweet love story.

2148531.title: Dark Desire
2148531.description: A passionate game of love and hate unfolds between Nan Ye Jue and Rong En. Their beginning has no love, only passion. He seeks intense pleasure from her, endless nights of desire, yet it remains merely physical intimacy.

2148602.title: The Perfect Love Substitute
2148602.description: On her wedding day, a wealthy young lady has a car accident and falls into the sea, losing her memory. She is rescued by coastal villagers. When her husband finds her, he mistakes her for another woman. Will they recognize each other?

2148671.title: Goodbye Mama's Boy, I'm Flash-Marrying a Rich CEO
2148671.description: Qin Zheng and Lin Xing meet by chance at a restaurant. He was rejected by a blind date for having no house or car, while she broke up with her boyfriend who bought a house but wouldn't put her name on it. Both feeling embarrassed, they decide to help each other and agree to a flash marriage. As they live together, Lin Xing discovers Qin Zheng's mysterious identity - he can handle her troublesome ex-boyfriend and seems to have incredible luck. The two are drawn to each other's secrets while also being pushed apart, constantly getting closer and farther until the truth is revealed and they find happiness together.
2148671.originName: 拜拜妈宝男我闪婚豪门大佬

2148754.title: Bodyguard Dad
2148754.description: Young entrepreneur Shu Tianjun is successful in business, but he doesn't know that his father Shu Zhihao, who appears to be just a simple bodyguard, actually has powerful connections in the business world. When evil businessman Lei Changdong sets a trap to harm Tianjun, his father comes out of hiding to protect his son and girlfriend, engaging in an epic business battle.

2148804.title: The Hit Heroine is the Ultimate Mouthpiece
2148804.description: A female lead accidentally travels into a script world. Once timid, she now becomes the ultimate mouthpiece. Through sweet daily banter with the domineering male lead, they develop feelings for each other. Just when they're about to get their happy ending, the female lead gets stabbed by her stepmother. Can she return to the real world? What will happen to her romance with the male lead? Zhang Zenzen, an actress immersed in her script, accidentally falls into a bathtub during late-night practice and gets transported into the story world. She wakes up as the weak female protagonist but transforms into a bold, outspoken top star. Facing the cold male lead Dongfang Mo, their sweet arguments lead to mutual attraction. But just as happiness seems within reach, danger strikes.

2148865.title: Divine Lord of the North
2148865.description: When the male lead was young, his parents were murdered and he barely escaped death. A master took him to train in the mountains for years. After completing his training, his master assigned him two smart, brave, and beautiful female assistants to help him investigate the truth. After returning to the world, he found his biological sister and successfully took revenge on those who had wronged his family.

2148937.title: Betrayal
2148937.description: In her past life, Qiao Xingyu was betrayed by her boyfriend Huo Kai and the scheming Xia Yanyan, and was murdered. After being reborn, she decides to take revenge on the scumbag and the manipulative woman. During her revenge, she unexpectedly meets Huo Huaiye, the CEO of the Huo family. The two help each other and fall in love.

2149085.title: Without a Thought
2149085.description: Gu Changyou, the younger twin sister, decides to disguise herself as a man and return to the imperial court in place of her brother after learning he was severely injured in battle. She knows this is extremely risky, but for her family's honor and her brother's safety, she proceeds without hesitation. The young emperor, who grew up with Gu Changyou, is both surprised and delighted by her return, but gradually begins to notice something unusual about her. Meanwhile, the cunning prince is more perceptive and sees through her disguise from their first meeting. In the political struggles of the court, Gu Changyou carefully navigates complex situations, facing both the emperor's suspicion and the prince's tests and pursuit. When her identity is eventually exposed, she faces serious consequences for deceiving the emperor. However, she uses her wisdom and courage to resolve the crisis by honestly explaining her motives and providing valuable political insights. Ultimately, both the emperor and prince are moved by her sincerity and intelligence, leading to her pardon and appointment as a high court official.

2149203.title: Super Treasure Hunter King
2149203.description: Five years ago, Xiao Ye was wrongly accused of stealing the national treasure Qianlong Zun and imprisoned. After his release, he gained mysterious powers and became the King of Beihai. Returning to Qingyu City, Xiao Ye uses his special abilities and strong sense of justice to protect the Mo and Ye families. Meanwhile, other powerful clans fight over the treasure, leading to their mutual destruction.

2149262.title: After Becoming Queen, I Punish Bad Men
2149262.description: Xia Zhiqiu, a modern woman, accidentally travels back in time and becomes the queen of a women's kingdom. To test the loyalty and sincerity of potential consorts, she disguises herself as an ordinary woman named Qiu Niang during the selection process. Through various tests and challenges, she observes their true nature while also participating in the trials herself. Eventually, when her true identity as queen is revealed, she chooses a loyal and wise consort to rule alongside her, beginning a new chapter for the women's kingdom.
2149262.originName: 成女王后，我疯狂斩渣男

2149331.title: After Becoming My Brother-in-Law's Bride (Mother-in-Law vs Daughter-in-Law Battle)
2149331.description: After learning about her sister's sudden death, Qin Ke is filled with doubt and grief. To uncover the truth behind her sister's death, she decides to marry her brother-in-law. Facing an extremely stingy and harsh mother-in-law, Qin Ke shows extraordinary resilience and wisdom, engaging in a battle of wits with her mother-in-law, determined to reveal the truth and seek justice for her sister.

2149472.title: Riding the Waves: My Father and I as Brothers
2149472.description: A young man grows up in a single-parent home, always ashamed of his weak and helpless father. He feels embarrassed by him at home and at school. But when his father falls down the stairs while trying to help him, the son finally realizes his mistakes and feels deep regret.
2149472.originName: 乘风破浪之我和父亲做兄弟

2149540.title: Love Too Late
2149540.description: Five years ago, Lin Wan betrayed her first love Gu Yuan to save her dying mother, taking money and leaving him. Gu Yuan thought she abandoned him for money and grew to hate her. Five years later, they meet again when Lin Wan begs him to save their daughter, revealing they once had a child together. But the bitter Gu Yuan doesn't believe her and humiliates her repeatedly. Lin Wan endures everything to save her daughter. Until Gu Yuan's mother appears again, forcing Lin Wan to disappear forever with little Lin Guoguo. This time, Gu Yuan loses his mind... He hates Lin Wan, but realizes he loves her beyond hope.

2149681.title: The Ugly Girl Luo Wuyou (The Fierce Ugly Girl Shakes Things Up)
2149681.description: Beautiful graduate student Luo Wuyou accidentally travels to a parallel world during an experiment, where she becomes an ugly woman. In this new world, she marries a prince and finds love. Using her medical skills, she transforms herself to become more beautiful. Watch how an ugly duckling rises to power and rules the prince's mansion.

2149755.title: After Prison, I Became My Brother-in-Law's Beloved
2149755.description: The Sheng Group and Su Group are famous rivals in the business world. The Sheng family's second branch daughter, Sheng Xinran, caused a car accident that killed Sheng Xia's parents to seize control of the company. The two Su family sons, Su Ruichen and Su Yibai, both loved Sheng Wan, but Su Ruichen forced an engagement. To get Su Ruichen and prevent Sheng Wan from marrying into the Su family, Sheng Xinran blackmailed Sheng Xia into taking the blame for a crime, then arranged for men to assault Sheng Wan, leading to her death. Three years later, Sheng Xia is released from prison and learns the truth from Su Yibai. She seduces Su Ruichen using her resemblance to her dead sister, ruins his wedding to Sheng Xinran, and begins her revenge plan.
2149755.originName: 出狱后，我成了妹夫的心尖宠

2149823.title: Boss Mommy Dominates the World After Prison
2149823.description: Nan Yi, a skilled doctor with a secret identity, went to prison for her father's crime. After her release, her father threatens her with her twin sons to marry Si Mohan for good luck. When she learns her younger son has died, she discovers that Si Mohan's son has the exact same birthmark as her child.
2149823.originName: 出狱后大佬妈咪飒爆全球

2149969.title: I Transmigrated into the Drama to Fight Back for the Weak Heroine
2149969.description: Jiang Nanxi, a weak heroine in a tragic drama, is used by her adoptive mother Zhao Shufen as collateral to pay debts to Ji Yunchuan, heir of the Ji family. Ji Yunchuan keeps her around because she resembles his first love Su Wanwan, but constantly humiliates her. His mother and sister also abuse her physically. When the first love returns, she uses the Gu family's young master to destroy Jiang Nanxi's reputation, leading to her suicide. A strong-willed woman from the real world gets furious watching this drama and vows to fight back for the heroine if she could enter the story. Suddenly, lightning strikes and she really transmigrates into the drama as Jiang Nanxi. Now with a completely opposite personality and knowledge of the plot, she's determined to turn the tables for the original weak heroine.
2149969.originName: 穿剧中，我替窝囊女主战翻全场

2150109.title: When the Sea Wind Blows Over My Grave
2150109.description: This drama explores modern young people's desire for perfect love. It tells the story of Gu Hanbei and Lin Nanzhi's relationship journey, showing that true love is not just physical attraction or casual romance, but about taking responsibility, building trust, and staying committed through life's challenges. The story presents a warm and realistic view of love - from meeting to knowing each other, falling in love, and staying together. It delivers positive messages about the true meaning of love and marriage, resonating with young audiences today.

2150189.title: Top Star's Stand-in Revenge: Sister, You Are the Real Stand-in
2150189.description: Su An'an was abandoned as a child. Her mother and sister deceived her by claiming her sick adoptive mother was sent abroad for treatment, but her sister had actually unplugged the oxygen machine, causing her adoptive mother's death. After discovering the truth, Su An'an begins her dark path of revenge. Everything that was lost, her sister must pay back.
2150189.originName: 顶流替身复仇姐姐你才是替身

2150304.title: Eastern Suburb No. 8 (Midnight Housekeeping)
2150304.description: Fu Tao, an ordinary housekeeping worker, receives a mysterious phone call offering him 20,000 yuan to complete a simple task at Villa No. 8 in the suburbs. Despite his unease, financial pressure drives him to accept. Upon arriving at the rundown villa, he discovers it's filled with eerie phenomena and dark secrets. As strange sounds echo through the dusty rooms, Fu Tao finds an old diary revealing the villa's tragic past. When he tries to leave, he realizes he's trapped. To escape this cursed place, he must uncover all the hidden truths and face the supernatural forces that lurk within.

2150363.title: Urban Hidden Dragon: The Invincible Mechanic
2150363.description: The male lead's fiancée cheats on him and demands 1 million yuan as dowry before agreeing to marry. Unable to tolerate these harsh demands any longer, he reaches his breaking point. At the critical moment, Su Qingmo, the heiress of Su Group, steps in to support him. Watch how the protagonist turns his life around and shakes up the world...
2150363.originName: 都市隐龙之无敌修车工

2150488.title: It's All Performance's Fault
2150488.description: Hu Fei, as the boss's successor, has been working diligently as a newcomer at Pioneer Manufacturing Group, solving problems for the company and eliminating rivals, successfully taking the company public.

2150601.title: The Mind Reader
2150601.description: At the city's most famous Baoli Gold Dance Hall, Xu Xiaomeng lands a job using his mind reading abilities. With his telepathic skills, Xu Xiaomeng thrives at the dance hall. By chance, he meets his true love Manna, and together they overcome various crises at the dance hall.

2150706.title: Mind Reader
2150706.description: Chen Ming is a mind reader who can see into people's thoughts through their eyes and travel through their memories. One day, a female assassin named You Zi comes to him, forcing him into a dangerous game surrounded by killers. The person behind this wants to find something hidden in the memories of Yu Wensuo, a man with depression, but only has clues about what it might be. When Chen Ming finally discovers what they're looking for, he's shocked - it's the very thing that gave him his mind-reading powers. The mastermind's real target is him all along. Now Chen Ming faces two choices: give up his mind-reading ability to save Yu Wensuo and Xiao Qi, or stay out of it and let them die. When the dust settles and he discovers who the mastermind really is, he realizes everything was meant to be.

2150773.title: Deadly Black Widow
2150773.description: A sweet and innocent girl is actually a cold-blooded killing machine. In this age of advanced technology, humans begin studying mutants, and the female lead is one of the failed experiments. After losing her memory, she accidentally meets the male lead, who never looks down on her confusion but patiently teaches her the right path, awakening the humanity deep in her heart. Together they save more 'test subjects' and successfully destroy the secret research facility.

2150833.title: Second Marriage to a CEO: Ex-Husband's Brother Becomes Son-in-Law
2150833.description: At her wedding, her husband caused her father's death, and the male lead's goddaughter forced her to jump into the sea. Though saved by the male lead, her company was stolen by her ex-husband. Her ex-husband married the male lead's goddaughter, believing she was dead. But she married the male lead instead. She later reclaimed her company through her own strength and found true love with the male lead.
2150833.originName: 二婚嫁总裁，前夫哥竟成了女婿

2150979.title: Extraordinary
2150979.description: Chen Fei'er is the world's top assassin, but she returns to Dragon Country to repay Snow Aunt's life-saving grace and fulfill her marriage contract with Chu Yifan from the Chu family. On the plane back, Qinglong disguises as a flight attendant to seduce her, but she easily handles him. When they discover she is the Sword Bearer, both Qinglong and Zhuque are shocked. At the airport, Chen Fei'er hugs Chu Yifan, making Liu Mengli jealous and angry. On the way home, Chen Fei'er and Liu Mengli fight, witnessed by Qi Yunyun who becomes jealous and demands an explanation. Chen Fei'er fights back and forces Qi Yunyun to retreat. Filled with hatred, Qi Yunyun cuts off Linya Group's supply chain for revenge. When Linya Group and Father Chu learn about this, they decide to fight back. Qi Yunyun tries to take Chu Yifan by force, leading to a struggle until Qinglong arrives to resolve the crisis. Unwilling to give up, Qi Yunyun unites various forces to destroy Chen Fei'er and marry Chu Yifan. However, Chen Fei'er has become invincible in Dragon Country and easily defeats all of Qi Yunyun's schemes, driving the villains out of the country and finally ending up with Chu Yifan.

2151032.title: The Loser Young Master's Comeback Life
2151032.description: A 20-year saga of family inheritance disputes that shows how people use dirty tricks for personal gain, but ultimately proves that only honest methods bring true respect and success. Xu Chuan, a simple delivery guy, gets caught up in wealthy family drama while trying to pay for his sister's medical treatment. Despite his life changing dramatically, he stays humble and grateful to Ye Chenjun, fighting against the corrupt Ye Xuchen who wants to destroy the family for personal profit. Finally, Xu Chuan uses his forgotten professional skills to achieve his comeback, showing the power of gratitude and positive thinking.

2151105.title: Demon Sealing
2151105.description: After a thousand years, the story of demon witch Jun Mo Xie has become a legend on Demon Sealing Mountain. Despite being misunderstood and imprisoned by the old Heaven Emperor, Mo Xie's heart never surrendered. Her dedication to justice and desire for freedom burned like an eternal flame. When the new ruler of the underworld, a powerful and wise leader, steps into Demon Sealing Mountain, fate turns once again. He senses Mo Xie's unyielding soul and her remaining pure power, deciding to rescue this wronged witch and form an alliance to fight against those in heaven who oppress others with prejudice and power. The underworld ruler extends his help, breaking her seal and restoring part of her cultivation. Facing his sincerity, Mo Xie feels complex emotions but realizes this might be her only chance to break the status quo and clear her name. Though initially shocked by the marriage proposal, she gradually understands this is not just a marriage, but a union of two worlds fighting for justice and peace. Together, they plan to expose the old Heaven Emperor's mistakes born from suspicion and prejudice, using their alliance to restore balance among the three realms and protect innocent beings from war.

2151200.title: Don't Run My Lady, Baby's Back
2151200.description: Five years ago, Yan Zhu was framed by her sister abroad and accidentally met Fu Boyan. Despite family opposition and misunderstanding, she bravely gave birth to their child, which led to her disgrace and banishment from the Yan family. Yan Zhu was forced to raise her child alone. Fu Boyan, heir to the Fu Group and a wealthy family leader, has been searching for her since their fateful encounter. Five years later, they meet again. Despite family feuds, rival interference, and various obstacles, their love remains strong. They face family conspiracies, career crises, and betrayals together. When Yan Zhu's dignity is tested, Fu Boyan stands by her side, helping her overcome family schemes. Together they face love's trials in this tale of passion and revenge among the wealthy elite.

2151343.title: Father's Burning Love
2151343.description: Five years ago, security guard Gu Liangyuan accidentally killed a man while protecting a mother and daughter from domestic abuse. He gave his college-bound daughter Gu Ting her tuition money before going to prison. After his release, he visits his daughter with gifts but faces cold rejection. Gu Ting has hidden her father's past from her in-laws due to social discrimination. Despite the pain, Gu Liangyuan chooses to understand his daughter. Eventually, father and daughter overcome social prejudice and reconcile.

2151402.title: Revenge Girl
2151402.description: Zhu Xiaoxuan was bullied at an elite school by Chen Xuanyue, daughter of the powerful Chen Group. Her family suffered greatly - her adoptive mother left home, and her father tried to kill himself but became a vegetable instead. For ten years, Xiaoxuan endured Chen Xuanyue's revenge. The final blow came when her father died because they couldn't afford his medical treatment. Desperate and broken, Xiaoxuan jumped from a building to end her life. But fate played a cruel joke - she was reborn as Chen Xuanya, daughter of the Chen family, ten years in the past. She hoped to prevent the tragedy, but discovered that her past self had also committed suicide ten years ago, and the Chen family had covered it up by killing her parents. Realizing that kindness and patience only invited more cruelty, Xiaoxuan decided to change her approach. With revenge burning in her heart, she became a goddess of vengeance, determined to destroy the entire Chen family.

2151475.title: Revenge Game: The Beautiful Wife's Temptation
2151475.description: Xu Mengxi is deceived into engagement by Lin Huaiyuan, who is actually lustful and greedy. He has an affair with Xu Mengxi's half-sister Xu Yicha, who deliberately causes the family's bankruptcy and father's death. On the funeral night, Xu Mengxi discovers their affair and learns the truth about her father's death. When she tries to report to police, she is kidnapped by them. Already pregnant, Xu Mengxi is humiliated, disfigured and thrown into the sea. Lin Huaiyuan steals her dowry and marries Xu Yicha. Xu Mengxi is rescued, undergoes plastic surgery and returns for revenge.
2151475.originName: 复仇游戏之娇妻的诱惑

2151619.title: The Heiress Seeks Revenge After Rebirth
2151619.description: In her past life, the female lead trusted lies that destroyed her family. Luckily, heaven gave her a second chance. Now reborn, she's determined to take back everything that belongs to her.
2151619.originName: 复活后千金想要教训人

2151686.title: Mr. Fu, Don't Interfere, I Can Handle It Myself
2151686.description: Gong Binglan, heiress of Gong Corporation, loses her memory in an accident and is framed by a third party, then kicked out of her home. The CEO of Fu Corporation, who has loved Gong Binglan since childhood, learns of her return and begins pursuing her. Her scumbag ex-husband tries to destroy Gong Corporation by any means, but the Gong and Fu families join forces to defeat him.
2151686.originName: 傅总别插手，我自己能行

2151807.title: The Cunning Queen Defeats the Time Traveler
2151807.description: Xie Wanying is the eldest daughter of a general's family in the Yan Dynasty, but she was framed by her maid Zhou Xuanxuan. After ten years of training at the border, she takes on a new identity as Si Qing and begins her revenge, gradually becoming the strongest woman of her time.

2151930.title: CEO Gu's Dramatic Girlfriend
2151930.description: Zhao Yimeng is pressured by her mother to find a husband. Her mother arranges for her to meet a wealthy young man from the Gu family at a wedding. At the wedding of Bai Weiwei and Meng Ziqian, Zhao Yimeng likes the groom while the mysterious Gu young master likes the bride. Together, they disrupt the wedding. The Gu heir pretends to be poor to win over Zhao Yimeng, who doesn't know his true identity. They fall in love while working together at his company, where she thinks he's Li Zefeng. When they meet his grandmother, she loves Zhao Yimeng, though his mother disapproves of her humble background. Eventually they decide to marry, and only when registering their marriage does Zhao Yimeng discover his real name is Gu Zefeng, not Li Zefeng.

2152018.title: CEO Got It Wrong, Your Wife Is Your Employee
2152018.description: Lu Shuyi accidentally sleeps with her drugged CEO Gu Mingyuan after getting drunk. Panicking, she runs away and drops her cousin's ID card. The CEO finds the ID and asks his secretary to search for the woman, not knowing the person he's looking for is right in front of him.
2152018.originName: 顾总找错了，夫人是您手下牛马

2152136.title: The Imperial Concubine Becomes an Internet Star
2152136.description: Qiao Yin, a concubine in the Dragon Kingdom, was framed by the empress and died with Commander Lu. She transmigrates to modern times as the wife of CEO Lu Chuan, who looks exactly like Commander Lu. Though their marriage exists in name only, Qiao Yin adapts to modern society with her strong will. She overcomes challenges from scheming rivals and becomes a popular internet celebrity, winning both her career and Lu Chuan's love through her charm and abilities.

2152227.title: Scholar from a Poor Family
2152227.description: A modern professor's soul travels back to ancient times into the body of a poor scholar. Through poetry battles with learned men and brilliant writing, he proves himself to those who once looked down on him. Step by step, he rises in ancient society. Who says the poor cannot become top scholars?

2152371.title: The Doctor Son-in-Law of a Wealthy Family
2152371.description: Chen Xiu, a poor young man, accidentally awakens an ancient family treasure while trying to save his mother. With newfound powers, he begins his journey of revenge.

2152486.title: Where Do I Belong
2152486.description: Middle-aged CEO Gu Chengfeng desperately searches for his lost love and daughter, unaware that his negligence caused his wife's death. At a spa, while looking for his daughter, he unknowingly sends his own unrecognized daughter Qin Yinyin to another man's bed. After discovering the truth, how will Qin Yinyin take revenge on her biological father? And how will Gu Chengfeng face the daughter he has deeply hurt?

2152580.title: After Soul Swap with CEO: Marriage First, Love Later
2152580.description: Small-time actress Song Wanxing accidentally swaps souls with the CEO of Fu Group. To find a way back to their own bodies, they must agree to marry. Through their constant bickering, these two enemies gradually fall in love. Eventually, Song Wanxing becomes a top actress and finds true happiness with Fu Jinyan.
2152580.originName: 和总裁互穿后，先婚后爱

2152656.title: Hidden Dragon in the Black Kiln
2152656.description: Duan Tianlu is framed and imprisoned in a black kiln where he endures humiliation and suffering. By chance, he receives guidance from a master who teaches him cultivation methods. Growing stronger through fire trials, he becomes unbeatable in the kiln and turns his former bullies into followers. After escaping, his first mission is to avenge his old boss Feng. Amid heavy shadows, he accidentally saves Xu Kuohai and his daughter, rescues Xiaoxiao from villains, and finally brings down all the bad guys together.

2152748.title: Prison Doctor
2152748.description: In this drama, the battle between good and evil, and the clash between justice and power, unfold before the audience with thrilling intensity. Follow the protagonist's journey through countless battles of rescue and revenge, rekindling hope in the darkness.

2152814.title: Love Switch
2152814.description: Beautiful but struggling actress Zhong Yi gets drunk at a party and accidentally falls into a pool with Lu Jinxing, causing their bodies to swap. When Lu Jinxing wakes up, he discovers someone plotted against Zhong Yi and leaves the hotel. Zhong Yi wakes up in an old mansion. After discussing together, they decide to attend the Lu family dinner, leading to hilarious situations. Finally, they switch back to their own bodies and enter marriage.

2152945.title: Desert War God
2152945.description: Dongfang Poxiao, a skilled bounty hunter, discovers a treasure smuggling organization called Solomon while chasing a thief. He learns about King Shuo's five secret treasures and teams up with explorer Ouyang Xue to uncover ancient desert ruins. They obtain one treasure and must find the other four. His ex-girlfriend Suna and Lei Zu betray him, joining Solomon for revenge. As the story unfolds, a conspiracy involving three major families and the smuggling ring is revealed, all seeking the King Shuo's treasures for power. Dongfang Poxiao must face dangerous challenges and betrayals to protect the ancient secrets.

2153034.title: Back to Ancient Times to Rule the World
2153034.description: A modern special forces soldier travels back in time into the body of a useless ancient emperor. He outsmarts court officials, reforms the government to help the people, and wins the hearts of 4 beautiful women.

2153169.title: Marriage War
2153169.description: Jin Youmei accidentally discovers her husband is cheating. To find the other woman, she starts looking for evidence. She then discovers her husband not only betrayed her but also plans to take all her money. To protect her daughter and property, she begins collecting proof of her husband's affair.

2153292.title: The Ultimate Fake Eunuch
2153292.description: A man accidentally travels through time to become a young commander, recovers his past memories and secretly infiltrates the palace with his men to seek revenge.

2153383.title: A female demon has come to my home.
2153383.description: In the fantastical tale crafted by manga artist Tang Shan, the accidental cross‑dimensional journey of the character Hua Ran not only shatters the barrier between worlds but also plunges Tang Shan and his life into an unprecedented adventure. At first, he simply hoped to help Hua Ran quickly find a way back to her book‑world. Yet as the story unfolds, he is stunned to discover that Hua Ran is far from the only one who has crossed over; behind a series of seemingly random events lies a meticulously orchestrated conspiracy.  As more characters from the books arrive, the fragile balance of the real world begins to teeter. Armed with the powers and memories of their native realms, these interlopers spark societal upheaval and stir the ire of powerful forces. Tang Shan realizes that to set things right, he must uncover the true cause of the rifts and stop the shadowy mastermind pulling the strings.  In their quest for the truth, Tang Shan, Hua Ran, and the other displaced characters form an ad‑hoc alliance. Drawing on their unique skills, they embark on one thrilling escapade after another—solving ancient riddles, confronting sinister factions bent on wielding the books’ magic to upend reality—each step fraught with uncertainty and peril.  As their investigation deepens, they gradually unveil a shocking secret: it was all the work of a scientist consumed by envy and greed for the book‑worlds. Driven by an ambition to rule, he sought to seize control of its inhabitants’ powers. Facing such a formidable foe, Tang Shan and his companions must stand united, relying on wit and courage to wage a battle that spans the very boundaries of reality.  In the end, after a fierce showdown, they vanquish the scientist and thwart his scheme. And with Tang Shan’s help, the unwitting travelers each find their way home. Though their journey was marked by countless trials, this adventure has left Tang Shan, Hua Ran, and the others with bonds of friendship as deep as the chasms they bridged—

2153448.title: Picking Up a Princess as a Nanny
2153448.description: The story follows Zhang Xingxing, an ordinary delivery man who accidentally saves Xiao Wan, a kidnapped rich heiress, and brings her home. This chance encounter becomes a turning point in his life when he discovers his true identity - he is the long-lost heir of the powerful Zhang family in Dragon City. Meanwhile, Xiao Wan transforms from a wealthy heiress into a fallen princess, bullied by her stepmother and stepbrother, who even steal her father's company and kick her out of the house. After living in poverty for over twenty years, the poor delivery guy suddenly becomes heir to a trillion-dollar fortune. When he returns home as a domineering CEO, he reunites with Xiao Wan and uses his newfound power to help her reclaim her family fortune, ultimately winning her heart.

2153528.title: A Female CEO Arrives at the General's Mansion
2153528.description: Qin Wanqing, the daughter of the Qin family, and her mother are driven out by Yang Manxi, her father's new concubine. To eliminate future troubles, Yang Manxi hires assassins to kill them both and throws their bodies into a well. At this moment, a modern female CEO named 'Qin Wanqing' travels back in time. The CEO agrees to the original soul's request for revenge and personally stages an elaborate revenge plot.

2153629.title: Sister, Don't Do This
2153629.description: A young man experiences an amazing life, surrounded by four beautiful sisters...

2153708.title: Endless Joy
2153708.description: In the ancient land of Jiuli, there is a legend about a miraculous grass that can bring the dead back to life. This magical plant has caused wars between nations who all want to possess it. Chang Huan, the female ruler of the Jiuli tribe, has been chosen to protect this sacred grass since childhood. She must feed it with her own blood to keep her people safe, but as punishment, she can never leave Jiuli city. Jin Ran, a brave general from the Central Plains, stays by her side as her protector. He fights enemies outside the city and provides her with companionship inside. Their peaceful life is suddenly disrupted when a mysterious man from the Central Plains enters the city with evil intentions toward the miraculous grass. Jin Ran must use his wisdom to uncover the man's plot and protect both Chang Huan and their people. Together, they face this new threat and discover their unbreakable bond while defending their homeland.

2153855.title: CEO Jin's Endless Love
2153855.description: Li Qianluo gets drunk and is framed by her best friend, ending up in Si Jinheng's room. After her father's suicide and her fiancé's betrayal with her best friend, Si Jinheng saves her. As they spend time together, love grows between them, and he helps her reclaim her family's company.

2153985.title: Kowloon Ice House: Dragon Among Men
2153985.description: Nan, once a powerful figure in Hongtai City, was betrayed by his backer Tianyang and nearly became a scapegoat for Tianyang's money laundering scheme. To stop Tianyang from continuing his evil deeds, Nan uses his own methods to expose Tianyang's illegal business to the public.

2154123.title: Nine Realms War Emperor
2154123.description: Nine Realms War Emperor tells the story of an ordinary young man who faces countless challenges in the Nine Realms Continent and grows to become the strongest War Emperor. The drama features thrilling battle scenes and hilarious comedy moments, along with touching emotional storylines. With its fast-paced plot full of twists and turns, it delivers an exciting viewing experience.

2154205.title: The Deadly Pianist
2154205.description: To investigate her sister's death, the female lead pretends to be blind to get close to Qin Lang. During a family music concert, she witnesses a murder. Li Muzi tries to use her fake blindness as cover, but the suspects keep testing her, forcing her to stay calm under pressure.

2154256.title: After Terminal Illness, My Cheating Husband Finally Loves Me
2154256.description: Song Nuan is diagnosed with cancer, but when she returns home, she finds chaos instead of care. Her mother-in-law insults her, her son despises her, and her husband brings his mistress home while ignoring her completely. So she decides to leave her role as a housewife behind. Eventually, Meng Jichuan realizes Song Nuan's true worth and desperately tries to win back his wife.
2154256.originName: 绝症后，渣男老公偏宠我

2154403.title: The Princess Marries and My Cover is Blown
2154403.description: Princess Su Qi of Su City is forced to marry Lu Ming, son of a neighboring city lord, to protect her city and mother. On her wedding day, she is still hunted by Lu Ming's men. General Qi of Su City helps her escape, but they are caught. The general is injured protecting her, and she falls into a lake. Instead of dying, she travels through time to the modern world.
2154403.originName: 郡主嫁到我的马甲兜不住了

2154487.title: Meeting the Beautiful CEO
2154487.description: Business genius Chu Lingfeng lost everything due to betrayal. After ten years of growth, he returns with wisdom and power to shake up the business world. He engages in an intense rivalry with CEO Mu Yuhe that turns into romance, and together they build a business empire and become a legendary couple.

2154601.title: Look, I Found a CEO Husband in the Trash Can (Alternative title: Sorry Mr. Yan, Did I Block Your Path to Wealth?)
2154601.description: Working girl He Qingqing accidentally gets involved in Jiang Shuihuan's attempt to kill Yan Jinghuai. Both are killed but are reborn with magical abilities through A-Xi's help. He Qingqing gains an indestructible body but is cursed with eternal poverty - anything expensive she touches explodes. Yan Jinghuai is luckier, gaining mind-reading abilities. After a car accident brings them together again, Yan Jinghuai uses his power to understand He Qingqing's situation and takes her in out of guilt. As they work together, their relationship grows despite the chaos caused by her abilities and the comedy from his mind-reading. Jiang Shuihuan continues plotting against He Qingqing, but Yan Jinghuai helps her overcome each trap until the truth is revealed and Jiang goes insane. The biggest trouble comes from Su Ruofei, whose second personality involves them in murder plots, but He Qingqing's powers backfire on him. After discovering He Qingqing resembles his sister, Su Ruofei's feelings change, leading to jealousy with Yan Jinghuai. When Su Ruofei's twisted mind plans to eliminate both of them, Bai Yan, Mrs. Su, and Mrs. Yan arrive just in time to reveal long-buried secrets, leading to a happy reunion.
2154601.originName: 看，我在垃圾桶里翻出了总裁老公

2154744.title: Mad Dragon Descends the Mountain
2154744.description: The hero learns that Evil Valley's men are fighting each other. He arrives just in time to punish them. His master is so impressed that he finally agrees to let him leave the mountain.

2154806.title: The Arrogant Young Medical Saint
2154806.description: Ten years ago, a top family in Jiang City was destroyed by four second-tier families. The male lead nearly died in a fire but was saved by the female lead Lin Wanqiu. He then wandered to the Southern Wasteland where he was rescued and trained by a medicine valley master as his direct disciple. After becoming a king in the Southern Wasteland, he returns to Jiang City and learns that his savior was disfigured while saving him ten years ago. She has been bullied, abandoned by her family, and no one dares to marry her. With invincible power, he returns to repay her kindness and discovers that the current four top families in Jiang City were behind his family's destruction. He seeks revenge to destroy all four families!

2154927.title: Found a Billionaire Under the Bridge
2154927.description: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend, Ji Xiaoyun accidentally travels back to the 1990s into the body of a woman with the same name. Forced to leave her theater dormitory after being fired, she ends up marrying the honest and simple Qiao Zhijie. Using her modern knowledge and his family wealth, they eventually buy the theater troupe and preserve the traditional puppet show art. Qiao Zhijie becomes her strongest supporter, and his ordinary life becomes colorful because of Ji Xiaoyun's arrival.
2154927.originName: 廊桥下捡了个千亿富豪

2155015.title: Heaven Gave Me 49 Days
2155015.description: Yan Jia and her 7-year-old daughter get into a car accident. She crawls out covered in blood and rushes to her unconscious daughter, only to discover her spirit has left her body. She can see her own body lying unconscious in the car while her daughter is outside. The car is about to catch fire, but she cannot physically save her daughter. In desperation, she throws herself in front of an approaching car to stop it. The driver saves her daughter. Both are taken to the hospital, where Yan Jia's body remains in a deep coma.

2155125.title: The Amazing Lady
2155125.description: CEO Qiao Yong'en, bedridden with illness, accidentally discovers poison in her medicine and uncovers a deadly plot by her husband Zhang Haibei and his mistress, the nanny, to murder her for money. She pretends to be unconscious while secretly gathering evidence. With help from her friend Gu Zifeng, she engages in a dangerous battle of wits against the evil pair, determined to bring them to justice. When her mother-in-law Wang Limin arrives unexpectedly, Qiao cleverly uses her to regain control of her company. Through a carefully planned scheme, she lures Zhang Haibei into her trap and ultimately awakens the mistress's conscience, achieving an incredible comeback victory.

2155217.title: After Divorce, I Became a Top Tycoon (Urban System)
2155217.description: Yang Chen is a poor young man working three jobs but still can't pay for his mother's medical bills. Crushed by debt and despair, he tries to end his life. But fate gives him a second chance - he's reborn with a magical point system that lets him exchange points for knowledge, skills, and wealth. Through hard work and the system's help, Yang Chen transforms from a struggling worker into a successful businessman. He pays off all debts, saves his mother, and becomes a respected tycoon. His story shows that with hope and determination, anyone can change their destiny and reach the top.
2155217.originName: 离婚后，我成为顶级神豪

2155343.title: After Divorce, I Sent My Cheating Husband to Prison
2155343.description: When Shen Qianqian's daughter suddenly falls ill and needs hospitalization, she tearfully begs her husband to come to the hospital, but he claims to be too busy with work and hangs up on her. When she returns home to get her bank card, she accidentally discovers her husband has given her a big 'gift' - he's cheating on her. Shen Qianqian hates her own weakness and lacks the courage to confront her husband. To save her marriage, she decides to infiltrate the other woman's life and seek revenge. While Shen Qianqian secretly prepares for divorce, Li Fei'er doesn't know she's become the mistress. Filled with grief and anger, she decides to cooperate with Shen Qianqian to help her leave Lu Huai with nothing. Together, Shen Qianqian and Li Fei'er officially begin their journey of revenge while collecting evidence against the cheating husband.
2155343.originName: 离婚后我让渣男牢底坐穿

2155446.title: CEO Li's Pampered Little Wife
2155446.description: Li Shenxing had a crush on Wen Chuchu in college but went abroad and never saw her again. When he learned his grandfather arranged his engagement to Wen Chuchu, he excitedly returned to China. However, he saw her intimately talking with a man in his 40s and misunderstood her behavior, developing mixed feelings of love and hate. A year later, Li Shenxing was drugged while Wen Chuchu was also tricked by her sister Wen Beibei. They ended up together in hotel room 206, but Wen Beibei took Wen Chuchu's place the next morning. Li's grandfather secretly registered Li Shenxing and Wen Chuchu's marriage. Due to past misunderstandings and Wen Beibei's schemes, Li Shenxing remained conflicted but always protected Wen Chuchu when needed. As they spent time together, Li Shenxing realized Wen Chuchu wasn't what he thought, his misunderstandings cleared, and he began to cherish her deeply. He eventually exposed Wen Beibei's deceptions and schemes. Li Shenxing and Wen Chuchu lived happily together and had a daughter.

2155565.title: Heart Hunter Adventure (Elite Soldier King)
2155565.description: Gao Yang returns to Tang Hai city after military service. At a barbecue restaurant, he helps Zhao Yuanyuan and Shen Qiao who were being harassed by Li Ye. When he gets home, he discovers his father has remarried. His stepmother Shen Man has moved in with Zhao Yuanyuan, Zhao Xishan, and Shen Qiao. Gao Yang learns that his military discharge was arranged for a secret mission to eliminate the Heaven's Chosen organization that has infiltrated Tang Hai city, and this organization is connected to his mother's death.

2155707.title: Deep Forest, Sweet Fragrance
2155707.description: At a company dinner, drunk Lin Yumo accidentally enters her boss's room, leading to a passionate night. Rumors say Qin Muchuan is ruthless and cold to women, and any woman who gets involved with him meets a bad end. Fearing for her life, Lin Yumo decides to hide what happened that night. However, her former friend takes her place and moves into a luxury mansion. Two months later, looking at her pregnancy test, Lin Yumo's first thought is: Run! She runs, he chases - she can't escape!

2155830.title: Dragon Scale
2155830.description: A tourist group on a trip is hijacked by gangsters. The male lead can't stand their bullying and decides to help rescue them. However, his master reveals that his father is connected to a top-level assassin organization. Determined to find his father, the male lead embarks on the dangerous path to become a high-level assassin.

2155893.title: Mommy Don't Be Afraid, Four Little Heroes Strike Back
2155893.description: Shen Qingyan is forced by her family to take the blame for her half-sister Shen Huan's crime. While escaping, she encounters the injured CEO Mo Shijun and they spend a night together. Mo leaves behind a jade pendant, which Shen Huan steals to impersonate Qingyan. Ten months later, Qingyan gives birth to quadruplets, but Shen Huan takes them away and frames Qingyan for their death, sending her to prison for five years. After release, Qingyan is sold to a club, but her genius children rescue her and help her reunite with their father Mo Shijun. Through clever schemes and DNA tests, they expose Shen Huan's lies and crimes. In the end, the family reunites and justice is served.

2155954.title: Twin Dragons (The Fake War God)
2155954.description: The nation's Dragon Commander goes missing in battle. His general Qingfeng finds a look-alike named Fang Xiaolong to impersonate the commander and protect the ruler. Though constantly questioned and humiliated, Fang Xiaolong discovers he naturally knows the commander's skills, making him doubt his identity. At the state banquet, villain Yun Junyang exposes Fang as a fake. Just when all seems lost, the real Dragon Commander appears, defeats the enemy, and reveals the truth - Fang Xiaolong is actually his younger brother.

2156004.title: Adorable Baby Strikes
2156004.description: Prince Jing was drugged by a minister's daughter, but accidentally spent a night with maid Hua Shang. When he woke up, only a jade pendant remained - the same one worn by his childhood savior. Hua Shang gave birth to a son named Tuan Tuan but soon lost her memory after being framed. Years later, Prince Jing finally found Hua Shang, and with their son's help, their love grew stronger as they faced challenges together. However, the minister's daughter, driven by jealousy, gave the prince a love-forgetting potion and kidnapped Hua Shang.

2156123.title: Cute Baby Strikes, Amnesiac CEO Wants to Be My Stepfather
2156123.description: Five years ago, Yu Shuyun was betrayed by her stepsister and fiancé. After a night with drunk Li Huaiyu, she became pregnant and fled abroad to give birth to An'an. Five years later, she returns with her cute baby for revenge and to investigate her mother's death. She reunites with Li Huaiyu, but he has lost his memory due to injury. To let An'an experience fatherly love, she pretends Li Huaiyu is her hired nanny. During their investigation, Li Huaiyu gets injured again protecting Yu Shuyun and recovers his memory, but hides this fact while secretly trying to do a DNA test. Yu Shuyun intercepts the test results twice. As they spend time together, they develop feelings for each other. An'an realizes Li Huaiyu has recovered his memory and teams up with him to win over his mother. Yu Shuyun discovers that someone else killed her mother, and this person is interested in her mother's belongings and her son An'an. After various schemes and revelations, they learn they share a common enemy - their mothers were best friends who were both killed for investigating illegal experiments. After joint revenge, Li Huaiyu proposes to Yu Shuyun.
2156123.originName: 萌宝来袭，失忆总裁想当我后爹

2156243.title: The Cute Baby Comes Home, CEO Husband Regrets It
2156243.description: Jiang Nuan desperately needed money for her mother's surgery, so she agreed to a deal with Cheng Wanrou - selling her virginity for the operation fee. Jiang Nuan slept with Qin Muyuan in place of Cheng Wanrou, but when she rushed to the hospital with the money, her mother had already died. Heartbroken, Jiang Nuan was forcibly sent abroad by Cheng Wanrou's bodyguards. Months later, Jiang Nuan discovered she was pregnant, which gave her hope. But Cheng Wanrou found out and, wanting to win Qin Muyuan, faked her own pregnancy. When Jiang Nuan gave birth, Cheng Wanrou bribed the doctor to steal the baby and told Jiang Nuan it was stillborn. Five years later, Jiang Nuan returned as a top designer, unaware her child was alive or that Qin Muyuan was the father. She moved next door to Qin Muyuan and met him and his son Qin Xiaoyan. Since Cheng Wanrou only used the child as a tool and treated him poorly, Qin Xiaoyan hated her, and Qin Muyuan refused to marry her despite giving her the title of fiancée.
2156243.originName: 萌宝找上门，夫人总裁他后悔了

2156330.title: The Fog: Her Disappearance
2156330.description: Lin Qian arrives at a suburban guesthouse where the female guests seem strange and mysterious. With midnight roommates, eerie photos, and a terrifying atmosphere, Lin Qian gradually becomes involved in a bizarre case from three years ago. As the truth unfolds, the dark side of human nature is revealed.

2156449.title: Republic Detective: The Murder Chase
2156449.description: A poor man who just got fired from his job suddenly travels into a novel he was reading called 'Republic Detective: The Murder Chase' and becomes the famous detective Zhou Chenlong. A murder case occurs in Dongping City where a dancer named Zhu Manyu from Phoenix Dance Hall dies mysteriously. Detective Zhou investigates the case and discovers it's connected to another murder from six years ago. Watch how this ordinary man transforms into a renowned detective to solve these crimes.

2156574.title: Doomsday Game
2156574.description: In his past life, Zhao Yu chose to be kind to others even when the apocalypse came, but his kindness was exploited by villains led by He Xiangming, ultimately leading to his and his friend's death. Before dying, Zhao Yu was unexpectedly reborn one day before the apocalypse and retained his previous memories. After rebirth, to survive in the apocalypse, Zhao Yu uses game activities to take revenge on the villains including He Xiangming.

2156647.title: His Hidden Agenda
2156647.description: When Qiao's company is taken over, Qiao Ran tries to steal the acquisition contract from Gu Huai to save her father's business, but gets caught. Gu Huai tells her she must make him happy if she wants the company back, which she refuses. Her childhood friend Ji Chen returns and proposes to her, making Gu Huai jealous. Qiao Ran feels hurt seeing Gu Huai close with another woman. When Qiao Ran tries to leave the city with Ji Chen and her father, Gu Huai stops them and reveals his true identity. Her father collapses from the shock and dies, asking Gu Huai to take care of his daughter. Overcome with grief, Qiao Ran tries to take her own life but is saved by Gu Huai, who begins to question if his actions were right.

2156727.title: The Divine Doctor: Dragon Soars Nine Heavens
2156727.description: While his master is in seclusion, Hu Xuan, a disciple of the Ghost Needle Sect in Medicine King Valley, is expelled by the villain Cao Wan. After a car accident transforms him from a fool to a normal person, Hu Xuan awakens with powerful abilities and gradually becomes stronger. He helps Dragon Xia, CEO of Dragon Xia Group, cure his chronic illness. After overcoming many hardships, he marries Long Lan'er and eventually avenges his master.

2156850.title: Life Reversal to the Top
2156850.description: A delivery driver catches his girlfriend Li Yanran cheating with his cousin Tang Jun. After getting beaten up, he receives a returned phone that unlocks a girlfriend simulation game, targeting Shen Jiaojiao. While delivering milk tea, he gets scammed out of 1400 yuan but discovers the system returns 10 times what he spends on his target. After helping Shen Jiaojiao with a car accident by paying 20,000 yuan, he receives 200,000 yuan back. He wins 5 million in lottery using a skill card, buys a Ferrari with cash, and faces his ex at a 4S store. At a class reunion with Shen Jiaojiao, people mock him thinking his car is rented. When the truth comes out that he owns the only Ferrari in the city, everyone apologizes, but he throws the keys away in disgust.

2156940.title: The Maid's Revenge
2156940.description: After her family was destroyed by enemies, Mu Xue grows up and enters a manor as a maid to seek revenge. During her satisfying revenge journey, she meets the kind-hearted son of the manor's mistress. Despite their opposing identities, they fall into a complex love-hate relationship. In the end, the male lead stands against his mother to protect Mu Xue and dies saving her.

2157073.title: The Queen's Elite Delivery Man
2157073.description: A delivery guy travels back in time to ancient days. Using modern knowledge, he amazes everyone, wins the queen's heart and a noble lady's love, living freely and changing his destiny!

2157136.title: Don't Overthink, Female Lead
2157136.description: Ye Fan, an ordinary young man who accidentally falls into a coma and enters a web novel through hallucinations. Facing powerful villains, he changes the original story for the first time and gains the ability to hear the male protagonist's inner thoughts, allowing him to pursue the female leads in the novel.

2157247.title: Chasing Dreams with You
2157247.description: Song Qingqing, a college student who grew up in difficult times, enters university full of dreams and hope. Like all students, she builds deep friendships and finds pure love on campus. Facing graduation separation and the gap between dreams and reality, Song Qingqing and Huang Xiaoming, who fell in love from their first meeting, must decide their different paths for the future. During a graduation trip, Song Qingqing and her friends accidentally stumble into a criminal deal, turning their journey into a life-or-death adventure.

2157315.title: The Contract Wife is the Real Heiress
2157315.description: Lin Xiaoxiao becomes Fei Jin's contract wife to earn money for her seriously ill mother's medical treatment. What started as just a way to make money unexpectedly turns into real love, and she discovers that everything was Fei Jin's plan all along - and that she is actually the long-lost heiress the Fei family has been searching for.

2157447.title: When Twilight Snow Meets White Hair
2157447.description: Ye Muxue is forced into marriage with Yun Yi but faces manipulation from others, eventually becoming heartbroken and deciding to start a new life with a different identity.

2157556.title: The Rich Lady's Peace Always Gets Disturbed
2157556.description: Lin Xi's fiancé was stolen by her sister. She found out she wasn't the real daughter of the Lin family and was kicked out. Her adoptive parents took her away, and she vowed to take back everything she lost.
2157556.originName: 千金小姐的平常心总被打扰

2157623.title: A Thousand Years of Waiting, Princess Please Forgive My Blindness
2157623.description: A thousand years ago, General Xiang Yan fought against enemies. His fiancée Princess Fei Xue burned herself to forge a divine sword to help him win. The sword protected him from death for a thousand years. Now in modern times, Xiang Yan searches for the princess's reincarnation. He mistakes Xia Ning for his beloved princess while ignoring Liu Yiyi, who is actually the real reincarnated princess. Meanwhile, the evil Curator Tu manipulates everything behind the scenes, using Xia Ning as a spy to steal Xiang Yan's immortality secret. Through trials and heartbreak, Xiang Yan must overcome his mistakes to find true love and redemption.
2157623.originName: 千年等待，群主请恕我眼拙

2157721.title: Battle of Gambling Kings
2157721.description: After rising to fame as a gambling master, he faces jealousy and persecution from the industry. Imprisoned for three years, he is released for good behavior only to find his family destroyed. In 1996 Hong Kong, prison bully Lao San loses everything including his leg to inmate A-Tai's superior gambling skills. A-Tai is released early and returns home to find his wife Xiao Ying has left him for wealthy Wei Shao and demands divorce and property. After signing the divorce papers, Lin Jia-tai uses his gambling fortune to buy new property and begins his revenge plan against those who framed him. He joins Kang Shao's casino, earning trust through victories, but secretly sets traps that eventually expose Kang Shao's cheating, causing him to lose everything and a hand. Lin Jia-tai disappears and later meets Meng Meng, whose parents initially despise him but accept him after he proves his worth. His enemies discover he is the legendary gambler 'Green Python.' Sister Miao and her goddaughter Cui Xi challenge him to establish themselves as gambling royalty. Though they poison him and cheat, Lin Jia-tai wins and exposes their tricks. The retired gambling saint Wei Zhao-min appears as the final boss, leading to an ultimate showdown. Despite nearly losing hope, encouraged by Meng Meng, Lin Jia-tai defeats Wei Zhao-min and is recognized as the new gambling king. However, tired of the gambling world's deceptions, he retires with Meng Meng to live peacefully.

2157854.title: My Ex-Wife's Temptation (You Are My Ex-Wife)
2157854.description: The male and female leads meet by chance. She discovers he is her fiancé who disappeared three years ago. Due to others' schemes, they divorced. After learning she is pregnant, he begins his journey to win her back.

2157985.title: Love Till We Grow Old Together
2157985.description: In her past life, Sheng Wanwan was betrayed by her beloved and step-sister, used as their stepping stone. She witnessed her grandfather's murder and died tragically. Only after death did she discover it was all a conspiracy from the start. Su Mingzhe had schemed to make her lose her innocence just to marry her, and his only goal was to get the Shengshi Group.

2158111.title: Deep Love and Tender Care: Mr. Fu's Cherished Love
2158111.description: A woman sells herself for 1 million to raise medical fees for her sick mother and brother, only to discover the buyer is Fu Yancheng. Five years later, they meet again in an unexpected way.

2158211.title: The Whole World Knows I Love You
2158211.description: Sheng Ziyu, heir to a major aviation company, is arranged to marry the eldest daughter of the powerful Chu family. Rebellious Sheng Ziyu doesn't want to marry for business reasons. While riding his motorcycle, he meets his true love Lin Keyu, who mistakes him for a taxi driver. Sheng Ziyu falls in love at first sight, knowing only that Lin Keyu is the adopted daughter of a Sheng family maid. He doesn't realize that Lin Keyu is actually the Chu family's eldest daughter he's supposed to marry. Despite family opposition and external challenges, the two lovers eventually end up together after many separations.

2158291.title: Puppy Mom, Cat Dad
2158291.description: Five years ago, Zhao Ling'er accidentally became pregnant with Gu Zichen's child. During a difficult birth with severe bleeding, Gu Zichen's subordinate bribed a nurse to take away the twins. Zhao Ling'er was told her babies didn't survive. Five years later, to escape harassment from Wang Buren at a jewelry store, Zhao Ling'er pretends to be married with children. Her friend Zhang Miaomiao helps arrange a blind date. At the coffee shop, Gu Zichen's twins Gu Pingping and Gu An'an overhear the conversation and pretend to be the blind date's children. When Gu Zichen arrives and discovers the situation, he's mistaken by Wang Buren's demands for money as Zhao Ling'er being a gold digger. After consideration, they go to register their marriage. Through various encounters and misunderstandings, including identity investigations and romantic complications with Jiang Yiyi, Zhao Ling'er eventually discovers Gu Zichen's true identity as a wealthy businessman and demands divorce. However, Jiang Yiyi discovers Zhao Ling'er is the twins' biological mother and tries to cover it up. After Gu Zichen's persistent pursuit, Zhao Ling'er forgives him and learns the truth about their children, leading to a final confrontation with the antagonist Zhao Guo.

2158367.title: Hot-Blooded Heroine
2158367.description: Female protagonist Shen Qingyan is commissioned to investigate the secrets behind a mysterious park. Through her journey, she rises to become a powerful leader and confronts the corrupt inspection team. Using her exceptional combat skills, she defeats the criminal forces within the park, uncovers the truth behind missing girls cases, and ultimately brings the corrupt officials to justice. Shen Qingyan is a righteous and brave woman who goes undercover to solve crimes and wins the support of many followers.

2158500.title: Missing You Every Day
2158500.description: Yun Xiuhe accidentally travels back in time and becomes a candidate for crown princess. She must find a jade pendant to return home. After being captured by villains and the crown prince, she is saved by Xiao Lian, and they fall in love. Together they travel south, face multiple assassination attempts, and fight against the crown prince's evil schemes to protect the dynasty. They eventually have a child together and reunite in the modern world.

2158649.title: Trading Beauty for Life
2158649.description: Xia Chaoyan and Tang Jinchuan are exploring in the mountains when Tang Jinchuan ignores her warnings and recklessly puts himself in danger, falling off a cliff. When Xia Chaoyan finds him, he's bleeding and covered in wounds, barely alive among the rocks. To save Tang Jinchuan, Xia Chaoyan uses a secret spell that leaves terrible scars on her face while healing him. Exhausted, she collapses beside him. When Tang Jinchuan wakes up, he discovers their remaining supplies are only enough for one person to survive the journey out of the forest.

2158778.title: Supreme Master of Confucian Way
2158778.description: Thousands of years ago, chaos ruled the world until Confucius descended to bring peace and help humanity flourish. As Confucian teachings later declined, Qin Muci, a poor student at White Deer Academy, had his poetry stolen by the dean's son. After being wounded, he inherited the ancient Chinese literary tradition. When his servant girl was kidnapped and he became entangled in academy conflicts, he embarked on the path to sainthood for dignity and survival, striving through hardships to restore the glory of Confucian teachings.

2158887.title: Entering the World
2158887.description: Twenty-five years ago, the evil Rakshasa Soul Hall invaded Yunzhou, causing great bloodshed. Four major families - Lin, Tang, Chen, and Gao - suffered heavy losses and sought help from the World Association. Leader Nangong Chengfeng led his forces to defeat the invaders, then retired to Dragon Cloud Mountain. On his way, he found an abandoned baby boy and named him Lin Fan, raising him as his final disciple. Twenty years later, Lin Fan grew up but remained naive due to his sheltered life. The four families sent their children to learn martial arts as repayment. Nangong Chengfeng, overwhelmed, left Lin Fan in charge and went traveling. Lin Fan taught students including the outstanding Tang Lingxue, Han Shuyao, and Chen Xuan, but learned bad habits from them, causing chaos in the sect. When Nangong Chengfeng returned upon hearing that Rakshasa Soul Hall had secretly returned, he was furious at the disorder. He sent the students home, sealed Lin Fan's powers for one year as punishment, then left to investigate the enemy. After two years without his master's return, Lin Fan grew worried and decided to enter the world to find his former students and search for Nangong Chengfeng.

2159015.title: Kill the Lies
2159015.description: At a mysterious dinner party filled with secrets, entertainment industry insiders are forced to face the truth when a producer introduces a 'truth serum' game. As the night unfolds, hidden scandals emerge one by one - from corrupt deals for roles to fake public images. The tension peaks when conflicts arise between an actor and his agent over a female actress's suicide case. Trapped in this web of lies, the guests must work together to uncover the complete truth behind the tragedy. Only by revealing all secrets can they escape this nightmare and learn to stay true to themselves in a world full of deception.

2159097.title: My Flash Marriage Husband is Amazing
2159097.description: A girl working in the big city faces a series of challenges due to her family's old-fashioned ideas, leading to deep reflections on family, marriage, love, and relationships.

2159213.title: Don't Hurt Me, CEO Lu
2159213.description: A woman is framed and misunderstood, falling into a passionate yet painful romance with a powerful CEO.

2159348.title: Divine King's Order (Flaming Hidden Dragon)
2159348.description: In a time of crisis, Hua Country faces two major threats. Death row prisoner Tang Long escapes from prison, causing panic across the nation. Meanwhile, a mysterious enemy called the Underworld King challenges the country from abroad. The Supreme Leader of Hua Country uses both strength and wisdom to fight these threats. Through intense battles, Tang Long is captured and brought to justice, while the Underworld King is defeated and retreats. This crisis, though damaging, unites the people and leads to national prosperity. Under wise leadership, Hua Country emerges stronger, with rapid development in economy, culture, and military, becoming a major world power.

2159472.title: The Divine Doctor's Hunt
2159472.description: Jin An enters Jishi Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital as a security guard to search for his missing brother Yuan Zhou. During his time there, he demonstrates his medical skills, resolves medical disputes, outsmarts Lu Yuntian, and becomes entangled in romantic complications with Qiao Xiaoyu and Yun Mengyi. A massive conspiracy seems to be hidden behind the hospital. He is framed by Qiao Xiaoyu and others, leading to his downfall. After experiencing many setbacks at the Chen family, he finally uncovers the conspiracy, punishes the villains, and joins hands with Chen Yao.

2159559.title: My Amnesiac Puppy Husband
2159559.description: The female lead enters a contract marriage with a CEO for three years while hiding her identity. Due to rumors and misunderstandings, she believes he loves someone else and doesn't expect much from their fake marriage. When divorce is suggested, she agrees to let go. On the way to get divorce papers, the male lead has a car accident and loses his memory. When he wakes up in the hospital, he believes she is his true love.

2159614.title: Senior Sister Can't Hold Back
2159614.description: Li Xingchen's family was destroyed by four powerful clans. After training in martial arts, he returns to seek revenge with help from his beloved Zhou Lingxi and senior sisters. As he defeats each clan, he discovers they were just pawns. The real enemy is Tianshan Tongmu, who destroyed his family to steal a sacred fruit that grants ultimate power. She tricked Li Xingchen into training at her sect, planning to steal his special energy. Now in disguise as the beautiful Liu Ruoxi, she approaches him for the final betrayal, but Li Xingchen has no idea who she really is.

2159675.title: Imprisoned Love
2159675.description: Lin Mo once dreamed of growing old with Gu Shen, but fate changed everything when she accidentally pushed his mother down the stairs. The man who once promised to protect her sent her to prison for three years. After her release, she tried to start fresh with a new partner, but on her wedding day, Gu Shen appeared to threaten her new family. However, Lin Mo refused to submit. She confronted him with evidence of his crimes, threatening to send him to prison if he continued his threats. In the end, Gu Shen was arrested and Lin Mo finally found her freedom and happiness.

2159813.title: The Strongest Young Marshal in History
2159813.description: Ye Shaolong travels back in time with his phone into a Republican-era novel he was reading, becoming Shanghai's wealthiest young marshal. Upon waking, he overhears that his father, the marshal, will be ambushed. The completed novel on his phone mysteriously updates in real-time with his current situation. He discovers that his father's butler and aide are spies, and one wrong move could lead to death. Facing warlord conflicts and foreign invasions, how will he secure his position as young marshal?

2159962.title: The Strongest Eunuch in History
2159962.description: A car accident sends a man back in time. To hide his identity, he pretends to be a eunuch. This gives him the chance to get close to the empress. He falls in love with her at first sight, but how will he escape the limits of his fake identity?

2160092.title: You're the Only One in the World
2160092.description: Three years ago, after an accident, the female lead had a relationship with Jiang Ye and they got married. The CEO has a first love in his heart, but she's a manipulative woman who constantly schemes against the female lead. What will be the fate of these three people...

2160177.title: The Billionaire Returns to Village to Fight Three Evils
2160177.description: Billionaire Boss Jiang returns to his rural hometown and faces various relationships and human nature, embarking on a journey of turning the tables on others.

2160287.title: The Billionaire Returns Home
2160287.description: Wei Chu was sold to a factory by his uncle and aunt when he was young. Through hard work, he became a wealthy company president and sent money back to his village. After 5 years, he returns home only to find his relatives care only about money, his girlfriend Liu Ruyan was killed by village bully Wu Gang, and his sister was sold by his uncle. Wei Chu decides to take back all his investments and punish the evil people.

2160400.title: Two-Faced Beauty
2160400.description: In family conflicts, Chen Lili uses fearless courage and wisdom to face numerous challenges and protect her family's interests, ultimately winning the love and trust of the male protagonist Cheng Jinfeng and becoming the matriarch of the Cheng family.

2160505.title: My Sweet Princess Life 1/2 (Reborn as Emperor's Beloved Concubine)
2160505.description: A modern girl mysteriously travels back to ancient times and becomes Imperial Concubine Jin. She discovers memories of the concubine being bullied in the palace and decides to fight back. While winning the love of both the Emperor and a Prince, she gradually transforms from an innocent girl into the master of the royal harem through palace intrigue and competition.

2160595.title: My Beloved Across Two Worlds
2160595.description: Su Ningxue accidentally travels back to ancient times after jumping into a lake to get her phone. She arrives at a rain ceremony where the royal advisor believes she's the chosen one. Using modern knowledge and technology, she helps the emperor solve the people's water problems, saving her life and winning the emperor's heart with her wisdom.

2160732.title: Why is Secretary Su Like This
2160732.description: Su Wanruo desperately needs money for her brother's leukemia treatment. After being harassed at a bar where she works, she's rescued by Ling Yun and Fang Mu but loses her job. Ling Yun offers her a contract as his 24-hour personal secretary with ten times her current salary - working as secretary by day and warming his bed at night. With no choice, Su Wanruo accepts this unequal contract and lives as his contract lover for five years, gradually falling in love with him. However, Ling Yun only sees her as a contract partner and agrees to marry Xu Jiao, daughter of the Xu Group, arranged by his mother. When Su Wanruo decides to leave for a stable life, Ling Yun refuses, believing money is all she cares about. She discovers she's pregnant but becomes more determined to leave. Xu Jiao, jealous of the rumors, humiliates Su Wanruo publicly and conspires with Ling Yun's adopted sister Ling Yuyan to kidnap Su Wanruo's brother Su Cheng. Due to a mistake, Su Cheng dies from severe injuries and Su Wanruo loses her unborn child. Determined to seek revenge, she gets help from Fang Mu, who had loved her from their first meeting but stayed away for her happiness. Seeing that Ling Yun couldn't make her happy, Fang Mu becomes her strong support, helping her with revenge and teaching her self-protection skills. With Fang Mu's help, Su Wanruo returns to Rongcheng's business world, systematically destroying everyone who hurt her. After completing her revenge, she chooses independence over any man, establishing her own company to prove women's independence and capability.

2160836.title: Silent Witness
2160836.description: In the 1980s, rich girl Liu Jin falls in love with poor driver Ma Dahai. Despite her father's strong opposition, they marry and have daughter Ma Yiyan. With Liu Jin's support, Ma Dahai becomes successful but then has an affair with Li Ping. Both women get pregnant and give birth to daughters. Li Ping, greedy for Liu Jin's wealth, convinces Ma Dahai to switch the babies and tries to kill her own daughter, but the crazy mother Zhen Feng saves the child. Years later, the switched daughter works as a maid in Liu's house and is bullied by the fake daughter Ma Yinuo. After many obstacles preventing her reunion with Liu Jin, the truth finally comes out. The real mother and daughter reunite, while Ma Dahai, Li Ping, and Ma Yinuo are punished and sent to prison. The mother and daughter live happily with Zhen Feng.

2160962.title: She Blooms in the Cold Wind
2160962.description: Tang Mujun, who lives with her mother, catches the attention of fashion mogul Du Hanfeng with her outstanding clothing design talent at a graduation show. Du Hanfeng not only appreciates her talent but also invites her to join his company's fashion competition because she resembles his first love. Tang Mujun shines at the elegant fashion show and wins the competition. However, her mother is tragically framed and dies during this time. This motivates Tang Mujun to seek the truth. While facing various challenges, she discovers her true identity and returns to the Du family. In the end, Tang Mujun brings the villains like Ke Wenxin to justice and becomes a manager at the fashion company.

2161081.title: My Dad is the Richest Man
2161081.description: A man separated from his family as a child becomes an orphan and is adopted by the He family. He marries into the family but faces constant humiliation. While selling vegetables, he meets his biological father, but his mother-in-law misunderstands the situation. When he returns home to share the good news with his wife, he discovers her affair. He cuts ties with the He family and learns his father's true identity as a wealthy businessman. His father wants revenge against the He family, but the son stops him, choosing to succeed on his own merit. He meets a female lead and helps her escape an arranged marriage, earning her love but making enemies. Unknown to him, his father secretly buys the company where he works. On his first day, someone impersonates him, but he uses this to expose corruption in the company. When the female lead's family approaches him, he doesn't reveal his identity. Later, when his father's company faces revenge from enemies, he saves both the company and the female lead, winning her heart. Together, they choose to live quietly behind the scenes.

2161135.title: Agent Phoenix
2161135.description: Zhai Ling takes her sister to visit her best friend, but the friend betrays them and sells them to local criminal forces in the Northern Triangle. Both sisters are brutally abused, and their parents are killed while trying to rescue them. This tragedy plants the seed of revenge in Zhai Ling's heart. She meets the former Phoenix, who sees similarities in their experiences and takes her as his disciple. Zhai Ling grows to become the new generation female warrior of the Northern Triangle, destroying the criminal forces and rescuing her sister.

2161213.title: Substitute Marriage Love
2161213.description: A man and woman saved each other as children and promised to marry, exchanging love tokens. Years later, they marry as arranged by their families but don't recognize each other. The man's childhood friend, knowing their past promise, tries to replace the woman and constantly creates problems between them. Finally, with help from an unlikely ally, the man discovers the scheme and finds happiness with his true love.

2161322.title: After the Substitute Marriage, I Became the Boss's White Moonlight
2161322.description: Su Yanran marries Li Yunyang as a substitute for Su Qiaoqiao, but she doesn't know that Li Yunyang has died in an accident. The man she actually married is his childhood friend Fu Hansheng. Will Fu Hansheng be able to recognize his beloved...
2161322.originName: 替嫁后我成了大佬的白月光

2161374.title: The Substitute is My First Love
2161374.description: Mu Xiaomian and Jin Yichen were childhood sweethearts, but a second woman who secretly loved Jin caused an accident. Everyone thought Mu Xiaomian died, but she survived with memory loss, only remembering the orphanage. The second woman got plastic surgery to look like Mu Xiaomian and approached Jin. During her recovery, she made a deal with the real Mu Xiaomian to be her substitute beside Jin. Gradually, Jin realized she was the real Mu Xiaomian. When the jealous woman kidnapped Jin, they rescued each other, recovered their memories, confessed their love, and got married.

2161487.title: Substitute Bride: CEO Lu's First Beloved Wife
