2161487.description: To raise money for her mother's medical bills, she agreed to become Miss Mu's substitute and got involved with the Lu family's young master. Unexpectedly, he recognized her true identity.
2161487.originName: 替身新娘陆总的第一宠妻

2161603.title: Divine Punishment
2161603.description: Five years ago, Wang Yan was a feared street boss known as the King of Hell. But a conspiracy destroyed everything - his parents were killed, his pregnant wife Song Jiayi lost their baby, and she divorced him in anger. After five years of living in despair, Wang Yan only wants to find peace working at a car repair shop. However, when he witnesses injustice around him, he's forced to fight back once again.

2161726.title: Heaven-Sent Baby: CEO Daddy is Amazing
2161726.description: Five years ago, Jiang Mengyao was framed by her half-sister Jiang Yuqing and got pregnant by accident. She was told that due to her special condition, abortion would make her unable to have children forever. With no choice, Jiang Mengyao had to leave home and live abroad to give birth. After secretly returning to China, she built her own design brand and became successful in the industry.
2161726.originName: 天降福宝总裁爹地超给力

2161869.title: Peerless Beauty (The Hidden Master)
2161869.description: Ye Wushuang was once the powerful Commander of the Punishment Division, but she gave up her position to live quietly in the city and protect her sister. When Japanese forces cause trouble at the border and form the Black Mountain Society to create chaos, the current Division Master Jade Raksha asks Ye Wushuang to return, but she refuses to disturb her sister's peaceful life. However, her sister Ye Xiaoxue joins the high-ranking Gao family but suffers abuse. Her husband Gao Qisheng betrays the country and even offers Ye Xiaoxue as a gift to his Japanese allies. When Jade Raksha reveals the truth, Ye Wushuang finally decides to return to action. At a banquet, enemies try to humiliate her, but she reveals her true identity as the Grand Commander. To save her sister, she sacrifices her own power and nearly her life. Enemies continue to challenge her identity and bring the rival Imperial Division against her. She must prove herself by drawing the sacred Phoenix Blood Sword, but the sword is damaged and breaks when drawn. After defeating the Imperial Division Master, she faces her nemesis, the Sword Saint Yagyu, in final battle. With help from allies who sacrifice themselves, she awakens the Phoenix Blood Sword and defeats the Sword Saint. The story culminates with revelations about her true heritage as the lost daughter of the overseas Tianjiao Palace Master.

2161959.title: Master of Dragon Hall
2161959.description: Qi Tian, the young master of Dragon Hall, possesses chaotic true energy and can fight a hundred enemies alone. To find his true love from a past encounter, he hides his identity and silently supports his wife. He saves his brother-in-law but Zhang Shao takes the credit, leading to humiliation from his wife's family and forced divorce. After cutting ties with love, he becomes the Dragon Hall Master and defeats arrogant rich kids, only to discover his childhood friend has been by his side all along. His ex-wife, relying on being saved by the masked Qi Tian before, tries to climb up to Dragon Hall while insulting the 'useless' son-in-law. When the truth is revealed and he becomes Dragon Hall Master, his ex-wife's family regrets deeply but it's too late.

2162055.title: The Divine Healer
2162055.description: In a bustling city, the renowned Li family of doctors faces an unprecedented crisis. Their legendary healing arts, passed down through generations, have been lost to time with only fragments remaining. While the Li family desperately searches for the heir to these ancient medical techniques, Lin Yi lives quietly as an ordinary househusband, unknown to the world. Despite appearing to depend on his wife, Lin Yi secretly possesses the very medical skills the Li family seeks. When fate brings them together, the Li family initially doubts this seemingly ordinary man could be their long-sought master healer. However, when Lin Yi effortlessly solves medical mysteries that have puzzled them for years, all skepticism vanishes. Recognizing true talent lies not in appearance but in wisdom and skill, the Li family supports Lin Yi in combining ancient healing arts with modern medicine. Lin Yi transforms from an unknown househusband into a rising star in the medical world, working with the Li family to spread these miraculous healing techniques and benefit humanity.

2162187.title: Public Trial
2162187.description: The emotional conflicts of five siblings unfold in a globally broadcast public trial. Is it unbearable suffering or hidden secrets? This is a story about family bonds. Childhood memories flash by like a speeding tape. The brother's protection becomes an obstacle in his sisters' eyes. When silently enduring everything can create four shining sisters in the spotlight, he finally understands how precious life and family can be.

2162282.title: Falling for Love
2162282.description: A wealthy heiress becomes a victim of arranged marriage for business. She gives up on herself and gets involved with three different men. She thinks her life is terrible, but she's actually being loved and pampered beyond measure.

2162426.title: Trapped in the Same Day for a Thousand Years
2162426.description: The male protagonist was stuck repeating the same day for a thousand years. After finally breaking free from the time loop, he used his wisdom to become the company leader despite pressure from his younger brother and stepmother.

2162568.title: I Became a Female Star's Contract Boyfriend (Stand-in Actor's Fake Love Turned Real)
2162568.description: When famous actress Lin Yueyue's affair with wealthy heir Zhao Guangyao is exposed by reporters, he hires delivery worker Wang Feng as his stand-in at high pay to handle the scandal. Out of spite, Lin Yueyue agrees to become Wang Feng's contract girlfriend. Unexpectedly, their fake relationship becomes real and spirals out of control.
2162568.originName: 我成了女明星的契约情侣

2162674.title: My Ugly Wife is Beautiful as a Painting
2162674.description: The male lead's wife is humiliated by the Wang family. The male lead reveals his identity to seek revenge for his wife. However, he doesn't tell his wife his true identity. In the days that follow, his wife faces repeated humiliation, and the male lead begins his journey of protecting his wife with dominance.

2162738.title: My Rich Heir Life
2162738.description: Male protagonist Bai Ziming is awakened by a phone call from a bank manager, who tells him his father left him a billion-dollar inheritance with the condition to spend 100 million within a month. He shares this situation with Sister Dong, whose company faces bankruptcy due to financial problems. Ziming eventually solves Sister Dong's financial crisis, they fall in love, and he returns to inherit the family business.

2162873.title: My Mother is a Royal Guard
2162873.description: Set in Feng City on the southern border of Great Xia Dynasty, near the Eastern Yi Kingdom. Chu Qiaoyu, the founder of the Royal Guards and known as the Venerable Master, retreats to Feng City with her daughter Chu Ruoyun after her husband's death. They live quietly running a meat shop until years later when Royal Guards supervisor Mu Yuanshuang comes to visit.

2163003.title: My Phone Connects to Heaven
2163003.description: Security guard Xu Tao is beaten by thugs and near death when he activates a magical app. He must complete 100 tasks to become a god in heaven. While doing tasks, he makes an enemy of rich young master Zhao Zixuan. Zhao also gets a mission - kill Xu Tao and his family to gain immortality. The two men battle each other. Just when Xu Tao is about to win, Zhao kidnaps his father and destroys his company's plans. Xu Tao fails his mission and faces death.

2163091.title: My Vampire Lord
2163091.description: In this story that blends sci-fi and fantasy, geneticist Qin Mu's extraordinary actions challenge scientific boundaries and begin a thousand-year contract and adventure. Qin Mu, a talented gene researcher, discovers ancient legends about vampire Li Sheng and a mysterious method to reverse his immortality. Out of scientific curiosity and pursuit of justice, she decides to revive and help this legendary vampire. Li Sheng, a thousand-year-old vampire noble, was sealed until Qin Mu's appearance. Initially shocked by the world's changes, he's surprised when Qin Mu proposes a deal: help him become human again in exchange for his protection and assistance investigating her parents' murder. Despite inner conflict, Li Sheng's desire for freedom and admiration for Qin Mu's spirit leads him to accept. The two form an unusual partnership, with Qin Mu using science to break Li Sheng's ancient curse while he provides crucial help with her investigation. They navigate between modern cities and ancient ruins, uncovering secrets and facing various threats. Through their journey, they develop deep friendship and eventually expose the truth behind her parents' death - linked to an evil organization seeking to use ancient powers to overthrow the world. Together, they stop the conspiracy, Li Sheng finds a way to become human again, and both gain freedom and new beginnings.

2163187.title: My Blind Date is a Robot
2163187.description: Li Zhien, an overweight and unattractive heiress who graduated from Columbia University, marries Lu Hao, a low-level employee at her family's company, against her father Li Xuming's wishes. However, after her father's death, Lu Hao takes over the family business and immediately reveals his true cruel nature. His mother and sister brazenly move into the Li family home, taking over everything and constantly targeting Li Zhien.
2163187.originName: 我的相亲对象是机器人

2163316.title: My CEO Daddy, She Is My Real Mommy
2163316.description: Wen Jin sold her innocence to save her mother, then was sent abroad after her mother's death. When she discovered her pregnancy, her child was stolen by Wu Xiuya. Five years later, Wen Jin returns as a designer and meets Lu Tingxiao and his son Lu Xiaoyu. After overcoming misunderstandings and challenges, Wen Jin rescues her child and exposes Wu Xiuya's conspiracy. Following a paternity test, Wen Jin reunites with her child, Lu Tingxiao proposes successfully, and the family finds happiness.
2163316.originName: 我的总裁爹呀，她才是我妈咪

2163459.title: I'm the Boss's Stand-in
2163459.description: Xu Songtao becomes a stand-in for Song Shaocong due to their similar looks. After passing many tests, he gains the right to inherit the company. However, before his wedding, Song Shaocong kidnaps him and puts his life in danger. It turns out Song Shaocong just wants to enjoy the benefits without effort. But his fiancée Guo Yating immediately notices something is wrong, and the battle between the real and fake second young master of the Song family officially begins...

2163594.title: My Name is Ye Shengling
2163594.description: In the prosperous land of Jiangdong, Wang Kexin is the unique daughter of the wealthy Wang family who refuses to be bound by family traditions. Facing an arranged marriage, she declares: "I'd rather marry a beggar than let my parents arrange my marriage!" In defiance, she actually chooses a young beggar from the street. However, fate is full of surprises. This beggar turns out to be Ye Shengling, the sole heir of a hidden billionaire family. To protect his wife Wang Kexin, Ye Shengling decides to reveal his true identity and reconcile with his grandfather to become the rightful heir of a business empire. He successfully defeats the conspiracy of Jiangdong's four major families against the Wang family and shows extraordinary talent in business. But when he thinks he can live peacefully with Wang Kexin, greater dangers approach. Unknown forces threaten to overthrow the entire business empire. Facing this crisis, Ye Shengling and Wang Kexin must work together. Through trials, their love grows stronger, and together they write a legendary story of a business empire.

2163714.title: I'm Actually the Richest
2163714.description: Luo Xiaoyue, a talented woman from a wealthy family, escapes an arranged marriage by impulsively marrying what she believes is an ordinary construction worker. Little does she know, her new husband is secretly the richest man in the country who chose to live a simple life to escape the corporate world. As they spend time together, Luo Xiaoyue discovers warmth and genuine love she never experienced before. When his true identity is revealed, she realizes she not only found true love but also became the wife of the wealthiest man. This unexpected marriage teaches them both that love transcends social status, and sometimes the most beautiful surprises happen in the most unexpected moments.

2163831.title: I Can Receive Calls from the Future
2163831.description: Chu Feng, an ordinary and desperate office worker, was about to end his life when he accidentally connected with his future self. With guidance from his future self, Chu Feng transforms his life, regains confidence, succeeds at work, and meets the independent Su Jin. As Chu Feng rises in the business world, he gets involved in conflicts between the Gao, Su, and Zhou families. He befriends Gao Yuanlong through antiques but attracts dangerous enemies. When the Moke Group threatens to control all three families, Chu Feng teams up with the Gao and Su families to fight back. Using his ability to communicate with the future, he predicts enemy moves and defeats the villains. After eliminating traitors and conspirators, Chu Feng and Su Jin overcome all obstacles to be together, with his future self continuing to guide him toward endless possibilities.

2163883.title: I Am the Boss's Woman
2163883.description: Li Shishi, a minister's daughter, marries the crown prince and becomes the crown princess. On her wedding night, she faces assassination. At the moment of life and death, she unexpectedly travels through time to a modern society called Dragon Country. Before she can adapt, she finds a man who looks exactly like the crown prince helping her escape from criminals. She doesn't understand why she came here or how to return to her own time.

2163976.title: I Am Your Younger Grandmother
2163976.description: After an accident, a plain girl is reborn in the body of a wealthy woman, only to discover she's now the step-grandmother of her high school crush. In her beautiful new body, she battles wits with her rebellious step-grandson while they eventually join forces against external enemies.

2164072.title: I Am Everyone's Heartthrob
2164072.description: Qi Tian, the young master of the Qi family, the most powerful family in Dragon City, returns home after retiring from special forces. Because he dislikes business conflicts, he chooses to work as a security guard at his own family's company.

2164142.title: I Am the Phoenix
2164142.description: A period drama about a reborn medical concubine who marries her prince husband's enemy. A Harvard medical doctor is killed and reincarnates, only to be killed again by a scheming woman. After rebirth, she saves the prince's uncle from a sword attack, and he recognizes her as someone he met before. A story of love, friendship, and second chances.

2164200.title: I Am the Demon Lord
2164200.description: Four God Emperors attack the demon realm to seize the Demon Lord's divine weapon 'Phoenix Cry Spear'. Yaoguang God Emperor kidnaps demon princess Shangguan Yue to force the Demon Lord to kill himself. The Demon Lord's soul travels to Blue Star and possesses the body of Ming Ye, a recently deceased young master from the Ming family. After absorbing memories, he discovers the original owner was a despised wastrel who was framed by relatives and slept with Xia Qingxue, the fiancée of Duan Qingtian. Duan Qingtian killed Ming Ye and threw his body in the wilderness, giving the Demon Lord's soul a chance to possess it. After possession, Ming Ye subdued everyone. Just as Ming Ye is about to marry Shangguan Yue, Yaoguang captures Canglong, forcing Ming Ye to abandon Shangguan Yue and others to rescue him.

2164264.title: My Shopping System
2164264.description: The male protagonist suddenly gains an unexpected shopping system while working at a construction site. Using this system, he continuously counterattacks and defeats everyone, gradually developing mutual affection with the female protagonist, and finally achieves a happy ending.

2164329.title: I Am a Puppet Prince in Ancient Times
2164329.description: Feng Tianqi is betrayed and shot by his men at a swimming pool, then travels back in time to become a crown prince in the Da Qian dynasty. Though he holds the title, he has no real power as the court is controlled by the Grand Tutor and Empress Dowager. With help from Eunuch Hai, he secretly builds his own forces, recruits the Lingyun Gang, plants his concubine as a spy near the Grand Tutor, and befriends General Dong Beihai. He gains the people's support through disaster relief work and successfully reclaims his throne when the Grand Tutor attempts to rebel.

2164388.title: My Life as a Princess in Ancient Times
2164388.description: Modern woman Luo Yunqing accidentally travels into a book and becomes the princess consort of Prince Xiao Chengjin. With her knowledge of the original story, she knows why the prince favors his side consort Liu Yanran and neglects her. She also knows that Liu Yanran killed the original princess because of her phoenix destiny. To survive, Luo Yunqing searches for a way back to the modern world while fighting against Liu Yanran. When the plot changes due to her arrival, she teams up with Prince Xiao Chengjin. She meets another time traveler, He Sheng, who tells her the way home is hidden in the royal shrine, which only opens during the crown prince ceremony. So Luo Yunqing decides to help Xiao Chengjin win the throne. Facing schemes from rival prince Xiao Chengxu, she uses her modern knowledge to fight back and successfully makes Xiao Chengjin the emperor.

2164514.title: Supreme Lord
2164514.description: After three years of hardship, Lin Fan transforms from a nobody in Jiang City to the Dragon Lord of the Northern Territory. The war god returns invincible to save his wife from danger. He defeats all powerful forces and becomes the Dragon King who protects the nation and earns everyone's respect.

2164652.title: Infinite Loop
2164652.description: Office worker Wang Zhong discovers he's trapped in a strange loop where time rewinds to 9 AM on November 1st every midnight. To get rich quick, he tries bold and risky ideas. Until one day, he meets a girl in danger and wants to go back to save her, but gets stuck in an infinite loop...

2164753.title: Martial Arts Medical Saint
2164753.description: Genius doctor Qin Feng faces constant bullying, but after saving a mysterious person, he begins his unstoppable journey to success.

2164849.title: The Vanished Housewife
2164849.description: After accidentally saving Sheng Minghao's grandfather, Ye Xinya wins the old man's favor. When he discovers her secret crush on his grandson, he forces Sheng Minghao to marry her. But Sheng Minghao's heart belongs to his first love Bai Menglu, and he treats his new wife coldly. Through Bai Menglu's schemes, Ye Xinya is led to believe she has AIDS and that her husband orchestrated it all. In despair, she jumps to her death. Five years later, she returns with a new identity as Xu Xueyuan - a world-famous surgeon and wealthy heiress - ready to take revenge on those who wronged her.

2164986.title: The Carefree Prince
2164986.description: An archaeological team accidentally discovers an ancient tomb from the Dragon Flame Dynasty, but gets mysteriously transported back in time by an ancient book and becomes a useless prince.

2165057.title: The Nanny Returns Home as a Hidden Boss
2165057.description: A country girl works as a nanny in the big city and builds her career through hard work. By chance, she meets Wang Hai, the eldest son of a wealthy Beijing family. With his investment, Lu Wanbing rises from a nanny to become CEO of Borui Beauty Group. After her success, she wants to help her hometown, but faces many challenges when she returns. Fortunately, she overcomes all obstacles and finds love with the male lead.
2165057.originName: 小保姆回乡竟是隐藏大佬

2165141.title: Little Rain Knows Wei
2165141.description: A girl's life is forever changed by her aunt's scheme, leading to a series of dramatic twists that explore themes of family, love, and relationships in modern city life.

2165231.title: New Dragon Gate Inn
2165231.description: During the Ming Dynasty's Wanli period, court politics are in chaos. Eunuch Lu Anning controls the government with dark schemes. Legend says the Queen of Luodian's tomb contains a secret medicine that can bring the dead back to life. Lu Anning wants this medicine to restore his manhood. He frames Minister Fu Yungao's family for treason to get a treasure map, leading to their execution. Fu Yungao's grandson Fu Xiaoyao escapes to Dragon Gate Town. Lu Anning uses spy Yan Pianpian to steal half the map from Fu Xiaoyao, then continues hunting him. Jin Doudou is the last holy maiden of the Luodian tribe, whose blood is needed for the secret medicine. Ten years ago, her tribe was destroyed and she found refuge at Dragon Gate Inn with innkeeper Jin Xiangyu. When Song Bailing and his grandson arrive at the inn fleeing Lu Anning, Jin Doudou helps them escape. She meets Fu Xiaoyao during a chase, and they become allies against their common enemy. After various betrayals and adventures, including being deceived by the handsome spy Yun Tianxiang, Jin Doudou and Fu Xiaoyao work together to find the treasure. They are captured by Lu Anning and forced to lead him to the tomb. Inside the dangerous tomb, after many trials and the sacrifice of their protector, they discover the treasure is just ordinary Chinese items - belongings of a Chinese princess who married into a foreign kingdom and missed her homeland. The tomb collapses, rain falls, and the two lovers return home together.

2165332.title: The Shy CEO
2165332.description: A struggling actress and a CEO accidentally kiss and swap bodies, leading to a series of dramatic romantic adventures...

2165415.title: Smart Girl's Guide to Being an Empress
2165415.description: A brilliant student named Ye Zhishuang is betrayed by jealous colleagues and transported to an ancient palace. This smart modern woman shows her wit and courage, invents amazing gadgets that shock ancient people, but gets caught in political struggles. Torn between three men, she finally wins true love with her sincere heart.

2165517.title: Hell's Decree
2165517.description: Ten years ago during the succession war: Tang Mo's family signed a 300 million financing bet with the Guo family to win the inheritance battle. However, the Guo family betrayed them by secretly cooperating with Tang Mo's rivals, Tang Tiande and his son, causing Tang Mo to lose and be expelled from the family.

2165634.title: The Divine Doctor's Revenge (Medical Son-in-law)
2165634.description: Ye Tian, heir to a legendary medical family, was destroyed by the Liu family because he used premium herbs to treat patients, threatening their business interests...

2165749.title: Touch My Husband to Level Up
2165749.description: Ten years ago, the Mo family business empire collapsed, shaking all the major families in Jiang City. Ten years later, Yan Lingyue is framed by her sister and forced to marry the fallen young master Mo Shaobai. At death's door, Yan Lingyue accidentally gains a future gene system. She and Mo Shaobai stay true to their hearts, avoid conflicts, and live a simple happy life together. However, young masters from major families start pursuing Yan Lingyue. Who is sincere and who is fake? Using her mind-reading abilities and combat skills, Yan Lingyue exposes the conspiracies of Jiang City's major families, and the truth behind the fall of the city's top family is finally revealed.

2165873.title: Everything Starts from Breaking off the Engagement
2165873.description: To find his biological parents, the male protagonist follows his master's advice and goes down the mountain to find his true fiancée according to the marriage contract, believing this will lead him to his biological parents.

2165928.title: Twin Babies, Mommy's Secret Identity Revealed Again
2165928.description: On the day of difficult childbirth, Qiao Manman was betrayed by her sister and fiancé. To save her life, she fled overseas with her only surviving son. Five years later, she returns with her child to take revenge on the cheating couple while secretly searching for her mother. When the truth is revealed, she discovers her child didn't die and her first love was someone else. Her twin sons secretly switch places behind her back.
2165928.originName: 一胎双宝，妈咪马甲又掉了

2166018.title: Court of Oblivion: Memory Trial
2166018.description: Five successful former students take Lin Han to court, where he faces memory extraction as punishment for his crimes in a live broadcast. Unknown to them, Lin Han has been reborn. In his past life, he chose to leave the mountains for scientific research, leading to tragic fates for six children. Given a second chance, Lin Han returns to the same crossroads and this time chooses to stay in the mountain village.

2166149.title: Yin-Yang General Store: Demon Hunter Chronicles
2166149.description: The Equal King, a judge from the underworld's reincarnation court, was punished and sent to the human world to experience mortal suffering and accumulate merit. Now an orphan, he grew up under his master's protection and became a Taoist priest to help souls find peace. Born with the ability to see spirits and smell ghosts, it seems fate has led him back to this supernatural path.

2166290.title: Yin Yang Grocery Store: Nightmare Town
2166290.description: Novelist Yuan Yi makes a living writing supernatural stories. One day, while saving a little girl from traffic, he gets badly hurt and falls unconscious. He then finds himself inside his own book's world - the Yin Yang Grocery Store. Yuan Yi begins running the store, solving mysteries, and helping lost souls find peace, only to wake up and discover it was all just a dream.

2166364.title: Hidden Dragon
2166364.description: After facing countless trials, the war god Si Jingchen possesses supreme divine power. With one sword strike, he defeats enemies to protect the people and safeguard the nation. He is revered across all realms. He overcomes the schemes of the main villain William, a Westerner, and rescues his beloved Shen Yunwei.

2166505.title: Listen to Mom Again
2166505.description: Shen Huiyin's husband's company goes bankrupt, leaving her pregnant and caring for three children alone. One day, she catches her youngest daughter stealing money at home. While chasing after her, she gets hit by a truck and ends up in the hospital. There, she discovers that her three children orchestrated everything to get the one million compensation from their father's death, and they even murdered their father together. Heartbroken and devastated, Shen Huiyin dies, vowing to properly raise her children if given another chance.

2166593.title: Oh No, I'm Surrounded by Wealth
2166593.description: Jiang Chen is a delivery driver who faces betrayal from his girlfriend and workplace setbacks. Unexpectedly, he inherits a fortune from an elderly billionaire he cared for three years. However, inheritance comes with a challenge - he must spend 300 million yuan within three months! While trying to spend the money, he gets revenge on his ex-girlfriend and enemies. He reunites with his childhood friend Yang Xue from the orphanage, but faces trouble from gangsters and a powerful enemy family. After losing everything and realizing that relationships are the most precious wealth, he fights back with wisdom and courage to rebuild his empire and defeat his enemies.

2166651.title: Blossom
2166651.description: At fifteen, Su Tang's family was destroyed by Xu Yin, and she crawled out of a fire to become Du Yao, a woman bent on revenge. Du Yao replaces her dead brother Su Zhe and goes abroad to plan Xu Yin's downfall. First, she approaches Xu Yin's younger brother Xu Ze, who is studying overseas. She saves him from kidnappers, drugs him during their escape, and uses the resulting pregnancy to enter the Xu family as a nanny. The awakened Xu Ze doesn't remember their night together, and Du Yao quietly leaves. Xu Ze investigates her past and becomes intrigued, allowing her to disappear. Second, after giving birth to son Du Kang, Du Yao becomes the family nanny and begins driving a wedge between Xu Yin and his wife Zhou Qian, trying to destroy the Zhou family's support. When Zhou Qian kicks her out, Du Yao uses the returning Xu Ze to get back in and discovers Zhou Qian's forbidden love for Xu Ze. Du Yao manipulates Zhou Qian's desires, suggesting to Xu Yin that his wife and brother might be having an affair, creating conflict between the brothers. She arranges for Zhou Qian to see her intimate moments with Xu Ze, driving Zhou Qian to jealous rage and a confrontation that Xu Yin witnesses.

2166729.title: The Real and Fake Dragon Commander
2166729.description: When enemy forces invade the northern border, the North Liang King agrees to a tournament battle to decide control of Yunzhou. The legendary Dragon Commander disappeared two years ago, and Master Lin is seriously injured. Lin Zhiyue finds Lin Fan, a fool who looks like the Dragon Commander, to scare off the enemy. When villains try to steal Lin Fan's jade pendant, he recovers his memory and realizes he is the real Dragon Commander. Lin Fan then pretends to be weak while secretly planning his revenge, defeats the enemy warrior, and finds those who betrayed him.

2166827.title: The Sacred Commander of the North
2166827.description: Ning Ke, the greatest warrior, led border troops for three years and defeated foreign enemies, earning the title 'Sacred Commander of the North'. His past is mysterious - four years ago, a mysterious person guided him to become the kingdom's top warrior. He quickly rose to power and became the legendary war god, highly valued by the king and ministers as a national treasure. But he secretly searches for the truth about his origins.

2166968.title: The National Guardian Master
2166968.description: An evil Japanese god is sealed within the Daxia Heaven Map, guarded by the Zhao family. When the Japanese come to steal the map, the National Guardian Master arrives to resolve the crisis. The Master attends a banquet in disguise, with no one knowing his true identity. Eventually, he eliminates the criminal forces of various families and restores peace to Daxia.

2167093.title: Supreme Golden Eye Divine Doctor
2167093.description: A repairman is mistaken for a thug and beaten by a crowd. He accidentally awakens a jade pendant and gains ancient golden eyes that can see through everything, starting his extraordinary life.

2167172.title: Fatal Countdown
2167172.description: A detective from the Investigation Bureau is murdered, and her friend is blamed for the crime. The bureau sends agents to hunt the killer while a mysterious organization also pursues Qu Xiazhi. Knowing she's been framed, Qu Xiazhi must find the real killer while running for her life. During her escape, she unexpectedly meets Lin Cheng, her lover she hasn't seen for five years. Working together perfectly, they save a seriously ill child before time runs out and finally catch the real murderer.

2167284.title: Fatal Ex-Wife
2167284.description: When Xu Jiayin discovers her beloved husband's affair, he tries to kill her and her unborn child by running her over with a car! After escaping through great hardship, Xu Jiayin recovers for two years, transforms her appearance, and returns determined to get revenge!

2167382.title: Restart 2002
2167382.description: Jiang Feng's bad habits and weakness led to his wife's death, leaving him full of regret. When he is reborn in 2002, he gets a chance to change his fate.

2167510.title: Reborn 2001
2167510.description: When his girlfriend was forced by her parents to marry his older brother instead of him, she took her own life, leaving Cheng Weiguo with lifelong regret. Given a second chance by fate, he returns to that fateful night determined to treasure her like a precious gem and give her the whole world!

2167581.title: After Rebirth, I Got Revenge on the Scumbag's Whole Family
2167581.description: Xia Ruoxing and Zhao Xu are a young married couple. Shortly after their wedding, Zhao Xu conspires with his father and brother to stage a car accident that kills Xia Ruoxing, all to steal her wealth. Given a second chance at life, Xia Ruoxing decides to expose the truth and seek justice. Her goal is to drive the three parasitic Zhao family members to ruin. In her previous life, a simple bowl of noodles became the catalyst for family conflict when Zhao's father criticized her domestic skills, leading to arguments that escalated into tragedy - Xia Ruoxing suffered a miscarriage during the fight, which later led to the fatal car accident. Reborn and knowing what's coming, Xia Ruoxing carefully avoids the traps. She arranges for wealthy woman Guo Wenxin to seduce Zhao Xu, uses her family business and money to corrupt the three men, then systematically destroys them from within. Through her carefully planned schemes, the Zhao family ends up homeless and pays the price for their greed and ignorance. Meanwhile, Xia Ruoxing takes control of the family business and begins her independent new life.
2167581.originName: 重生后我报复了渣男全家

2167697.title: Reborn Ten Days
2167697.description: Migrant worker Sun Jinquan is pressured by his landlady for unpaid rent. Zhang Shaofeng, heir to Boyu Group, takes a liking to Sun's girlfriend Xiaoli and schemes to frame him. While unconscious, Sun unexpectedly returns to ten days ago.

2167924.title: The Return of the Son-in-Law: I Am the Master of Mysterious Arts
2167924.description: A useless live-in son-in-law accidentally awakens a jade pendant and gains ancient medical skills, but no one believes him. His mother-in-law and wife look down on him. Later, he helps many people and becomes a miracle doctor, proving everyone wrong.
2167924.originName: 赘婿归来之我是奇门少主

2168013.title: The CEO's Wife
2168013.description: Lin Yang is an ordinary delivery driver struggling with unpaid rent, his mother's medical bills, and constant customer complaints. His life changes when he receives a special order from CEO Huang Qian, an arrogant and cold woman who makes him wait for hours. When he finally meets her, she demands he deliver the cake upstairs, but Lin Yang refuses to give in to her attitude. During their argument, he notices Chen Shiyu, a rich girl escaping an arranged marriage, being chased by street thugs. Lin Yang bravely helps her, and she falls in love with him at first sight. Meanwhile, despite her arrogant attitude, CEO Huang Qian is also a single mother who becomes attracted to Lin Yang's integrity and considers making him her child's father. Now two very different women - a domineering CEO and a wealthy heiress - are competing for the same man. Lin Yang must choose between them as his ordinary life takes an extraordinary turn.

2168124.title: Guilty Wife
2168124.description: Tang Yin, the adopted daughter of the Xia family, is wrongly accused by her husband Shen Nanzhou, the richest man in Country A, of arranging an assault on Xia Siyun five years ago, which led to her mental breakdown. Abandoned by Shen Nanzhou, Tang Yin endures the greatest humiliation to save her daughter who has leukemia, unleashing incredible strength that changes her family's destiny.

2168182.title: Divine Tribulation (The God's Son-in-Law and Wealthy Family Feuds)
2168182.description: Jiang Feng, who suffered endless humiliation in his past life, fell into the demonic path during cultivation and was banished to the mortal world to be reborn. Carrying memories of his previous life, he is determined to regain his lost dignity and win back his beloved wife who he failed to protect before. Through hard cultivation and growing wisdom, Jiang Feng learns that true power lies not only in strength but also in understanding people's hearts. He faces many challenges, defeats evil enemies with both wit and power, and proves that fate can be changed. Eventually, he reaches the pinnacle of the mortal world, winning back his wife's heart and earning everyone's respect. His story shows that no matter what hardships you face, as long as you have hope in your heart, there will always be a chance to turn your life around.

2168274.title: How to Dump a Hockey Star - Full Movie
2168274.description: The female lead unexpectedly marries a powerful, all‑consuming CEO, yet she is determined to break up and reclaim her freedom. She pulls out every trick in the book to escape this marriage, but the CEO remains endlessly intrigued, countering each of her moves with equal wit and resolve. In their daily battles of wits and wills, the two gradually discover each other’s finest qualities, and the heroine’s heart quietly falls. Only when she finally gets what she’s always wanted does she realize she can no longer live without him.
2168274.originName: 拜托了我想分手（菲律宾）

2168338.title: Sadness Knows No Boundaries Full Movie
2168338.description: The female lead has been repeatedly hurt in love and believes she will never fall in love again. She shuts herself off, masking her vulnerability with coldness. It isn’t until she meets someone who truly understands her and is willing to step into her heart that her frozen soul begins to thaw. Through the process of healing and being healed, she learns to let go of the past and embrace the future, coming to realize that though sorrow has its limits, love can transcend them all.

2168484.title: Make-up Sx full
2168484.description: After years of dating, a couple broke up following a fierce argument—only to end up making love in the heat of the moment. Afterwards, both were left feeling awkward and conflicted, unsure how to move forward with their relationship. After some calm reflection, they realized they still loved each other deeply; those fights had only stemmed from how much they cared. In the end, they reconciled, and their bond grew even stronger.

2168627.title: Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy Full Movie
2168627.description: A single mother raises her adorable little one all on her own, their life tough yet filled with warmth. By a twist of fate, the hospital’s aloof and self‑restrained president meets the child and is struck by the startling resemblance in their features. As they grow closer, he discovers that the little one is none other than his long‑lost son. Through time, misunderstandings between him and the mother give way to reconciliation, and in the end, the family is reunited, finding happiness together.
2168627.originName: 高冷院长是萌宝的亲爹（菲律宾）

2168741.title: Jailed Nobody to Medicine God
2168741.originName: 含冤入狱却继承药神传承（菲律宾）

2168873.title: Trash Man Saves Baby... She's a Genius Princess!
2168873.description: Early one morning, a scavenger‑turning‑elderly‑man discovered an abandoned baby girl beside a pile of trash. Moved by compassion, he took her home and raised her as his own. Living frugally, he nurtured her through every hardship. Despite the odds, the girl persevered and excelled, eventually becoming a distinguished individual. Years later, the truth about her origins came to light, and her biological parents tracked her down. Faced with the choice between blood ties and the love that had saved her life, she made a deeply moving decision.
2168873.originName: 捡破烂老头救下女婴（菲律宾）

2169021.title: Queen Never Cry Full Movie
2169021.description: From the humiliated “fat” queen to a vengeful beauty

2169165.title: The Mayor's XXL Wife Her Stunning Return
2169165.description: Frustrated by her husband’s disdain and betrayal due to her weight, the protagonist sinks into despair—only to resolve to turn her life around. She works tirelessly to shed pounds and cultivate her inner strength, undergoing a stunning transformation from a despised “fat wife” into a radiant, confident woman. Her ex‑husband is left wracked with regret, desperate to win her back, while she, in turn, meets a truly worthy man who sees her true worth. Choosing to live for herself, she embarks on a brand‑new chapter.

2169298.title: Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss - Full Movie
2169298.description: He was once a low-key tycoon, keeping his true identity hidden—until a clash forced him to reveal his hand, catapulting him into the spotlight. Only then did those around him realize that this seemingly ordinary man was, in fact, a ruthless force to be reckoned with. Faced with challenges and schemes from all sides, he struck back with unyielding authority, proving his mettle through sheer grit. Amid the dual trials of career and love, he stood firm to protect the one he cherished, ultimately earning both respect and happiness.
2169298.originName: 让开老子才是真大佬（菲律宾）

2169419.title: Cleaner Saves CEO When 100 Doctors Failed
2169419.description: The janitor at the company may seem ordinary, but her true identity is shrouded in mystery. During a crisis, the cold‑and‑ruthless CEO is saved by her unexpected intervention, and he witnesses her astonishing skills firsthand. From that moment on, he begins to see her in a whole new light, shedding his aloof superiority to become utterly obedient—like a loyal hound at her side. As they grow closer, the secrets of their pasts slowly unravel, giving rise to a delightful love story that transcends the vast gap between their social standings.
2169419.originName: 扫地阿姨一出手冷血总裁秒变忠犬（菲律宾）

2169540.title: (Tagalog Dubbed)Ex Wanted Her Back... She’s CEO’s Wife Now!
2169540.description: She was cruelly abandoned by her long‑time ex, left heartbroken. At the lowest point in her life, a top‑tier CEO appeared, slowly healing her wounds with tenderness and devotion. At first, she resisted this relationship, afraid of getting hurt again, but the CEO’s sincerity eventually won her over. Together, they emerged from the shadows, and she grew stronger and more independent, ultimately finding true happiness.
2169540.originName: 她被前任狠心抛弃却遇顶级总裁救赎宠爱（菲律宾）

2169625.title: Delivery Man? No! He's Her Future Husband!
2169625.description: A kind-hearted girl stepped in to help a delivery driver who was being unfairly treated. Little did she know that this seemingly ordinary courier was, in fact, a billionaire CEO on a secret visit, deliberately posing as a deliveryman to test people’s true nature. Her kindness touched him, and he began to get close to her under the guise of a delivery driver. As they spent more time together, their feelings grew deeper, and in the end, they revealed their true identities, forging a beautiful love story.
2169625.originName: 她好心帮了个送餐员哪知是亿万总裁的测试（菲律宾）

2169757.title: She Gave Him CPR... He Gave Her His Heart!
2169757.description: During a delivery run, delivery girl Xiaoyu unexpectedly saves a stranger who has suddenly fallen ill, using CPR to pull him back from the brink of death. Little does she know, the man is none other than the group’s CEO. Upon regaining consciousness, he becomes obsessed with his lifesaver and sets out to find her. When they meet again, the CEO is captivated by her kind and optimistic nature and launches an ardent courtship, setting in motion a serendipitous romance.
2169757.originName: 外卖小妹用吻救人（菲律宾）

2169879.title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me Full Movie
2169879.description: An ordinary girl stumbles into a world teeming with “alpha” elites, surrounded by powerful, domineering, and highly desirable men. All she wants is a quiet, stable life, yet she finds herself pursued in turn by one alpha after another. Through evading their advances and skillfully navigating the situation, she comes to recognize her true feelings and ultimately chooses the man who truly understands and respects her, completing her transformation from an ordinary girl into an independent woman.

2170004.title: Marry Me NOW!
2170004.description: A sudden accident plunges a ruthless, cold‑blooded business tycoon into a deep coma, leaving him regarded by all as a “vegetative patient.” Yet just when everyone has given up hope of his recovery, an ordinary country girl awakens him with what seems like a simple acupuncture treatment. She not only saves his life but, with her innocence, kindness, and unwavering resilience, gradually wins her way into his heart. As they spend each day together, the president shifts from initial aloofness to slowly opening up, while she, too, discovers her own courage and grows through this fateful entwining of destinies. However, the president’s past is shrouded in mystery, and her own identity appears to conceal secrets best left untold. As the truth slowly comes to light, their love will face an unprecedented test… This is a tale of love that transcends social divides, and a tender story of redemption and rebirth.
2170004.originName: 无人能救的昏迷总裁却被乡下女孩一针扎醒（菲律宾）

2170122.title: (Tagalog Dubbed)Poor Girl Saves CEO... Now He Won’t Let Her Go!
2170122.description: Country girl Amei, born into poverty, comes to the city to work in order to raise money for her sick mother’s medical expenses. By chance, she saves Lu Haotian, a corporate president who has fallen into a coma after a car accident, and is hired as his personal caregiver. At first, Lu Haotian is wary of this girl from the countryside, but as they spend day and night together, he is gradually touched by her kindness and resilience. Meanwhile, Lu’s family business is facing a crisis, and his rivals are secretly plotting to seize control of the company. As Amei helps Lu recover, she becomes entangled in this intricate corporate battle. Starting from initial misunderstandings, the two come to trust one another, eventually joining forces to overcome the crisis and find true love. With warm, healing emotions at its core, the series weaves in workplace rivalries and tests of human nature, telling the story of how an ordinary girl uses love and perseverance to change her fate.
2170122.originName: 乡下女孩照顾昏迷的总裁（菲律宾）

2170271.title: Secret Baby, Billionaire Daddy
2170271.description: After a one‑night stand, she silently bore all the loneliness and pain. Pregnant, she resolved to face it alone, keeping the secret buried deep within her heart. Years later, fate brought her back together with him—a successful but cold and distant man. By then, her child had grown up, innocently calling him “Dad.” Confronted with this sudden truth, he was torn, caught in a struggle: would he shirk his responsibilities, or confront the past? Meanwhile, she too was doing everything she could to protect her child’s happiness, unwilling to let that hidden chapter of their lives cast a shadow over his future. Their relationship simmered, fueled by a tangled mix of love and resentment, yet fraught with peril due to the gulf between their social standings and the lingering specter of the past. This is a tale of love, duty, and redemption—watch as she clings to her初心 amidst the torrent of fate, and see whether he can break free from the chains of his own heart and rediscover the happiness that once was his.
2170271.originName: 一夜情后，她偷偷生下他的孩子（菲律宾）

2170402.title: The CEO's Secret Love - Full HD Movie -
2170402.description: She, an ordinary office worker, is swept into a shocking conspiracy by an unexpected turn of events. He, a cold and ruthless CEO, seems to have everything under control—yet he harbors secrets known to no one. A chance encounter weaves their destinies together. What she once thought would be a fleeting collaboration gradually reveals a world far more complex than she imagined: behind his business empire lies a maelstrom of power and betrayal, while deep within him stirs a long-buried past. As the truth unravels bit by bit, she finds herself forced to choose between trust and danger. Meanwhile, enemies in the shadows close in, and a life‑and‑death struggle unfolds in silence. In this game of intrigue and emotion, can she uncover her own path? And will he dare confront his inner turmoil and rediscover his true self? With twists at every turn and heart‑pounding conflicts, this tale invites you on an adventure brimming with uncertainty and passion.

2170454.title: (Tagalog Dubbed)Dumped After 3 Years... Slept With CEO by Accident!
2170454.description: She had once believed that the drunken mistake of that night was nothing more than a foolish lapse, only to discover it had become a secret he’d kept buried deep in his heart. Three years ago, she was still a naive young girl, while he was the campus’s most sought‑after star. An accidental bout of intoxication robbed her of her most precious youthful memories and left him bearing an unspoken guilt. Now, when they meet again, she has grown into an independent, confident professional, while he has become a successful yet lonely, aloof man. Faced with her confusion and questioning, he has always chosen silence—until a sudden crisis once again hurls them both into the whirlpool of fate. Will he reveal the truth, or continue to conceal it? Will she forgive the past, or bravely embrace the future? A tangled web of emotions, long dormant, is rekindled by the passage of time—yet it is laced with an indescribable ache and struggle. This is a story of growth, redemption, and the intertwined forces of love and resentment, inviting you to experience the regrets of youth and the life‑defining choices made without regret.
2170454.originName: 3年青春喂了狗酒醉错睡一夜（菲律宾）

2170613.title: Fei Ren Zai 3rd Season
2170613.description: How do the “famous” spirits and monsters of classical Chinese mythology survive in modern society? They’ve become our everyday neighbors—goddess‑obsessed otaku girls, warm‑hearted guys, office workers, and even dog‑like boyfriends—enacting funny, quirky little tales about joy and friendship, and weaving an incredible, otherworldly anime‑style仙境 out of our ordinary, bustling lives.

2170719.description: Everyone mocked the handyman, especially his ex-wife—until they learned he was a business tycoon!

2181691.description: Deep within a mysterious forest, a lonely young man unexpectedly saves an injured elf. She is beautiful and enigmatic, yet bound by a curse that keeps her from fully belonging in the human world. As they grow close, day and night, the boy finds himself drawn to her gentleness and innocence, while she, too, begins to cherish this brave, kind-hearted human. But when the elven elders learn of their bond, they vehemently oppose it, warning that a love that transcends their two kinds will bring only ruin. Meanwhile, a shadowy force creeps ever nearer, seeking to harness the elves’ power for its dark ends. Amidst countless obstacles, can they break free from prejudice and the chains of fate? A misunderstanding sets them at odds, only to see their feelings slowly bloom through trials of life and death. Yet fate plays cruel tricks: her identity turns out to be inextricably linked to his sworn enemy, while his path of vengeance inexorably encroaches upon her deepest boundaries. Confronted by a destiny woven with love and hatred, what choice must they make? Will they join hands and journey to the ends of the earth, or return each to the dust from which they came? A profound entanglement that transcends status and enmity, a breathtaking tale of love and redemption—discover it all in the Thai‑dubbed version of “I Entrust My Snow‑White Years to the World.”
