2186913.originName: OGI先生，那女人不是你老婆（印尼字幕）

2187044.title: Human faces and peach blossoms glow together in the red (Vietnam)
2187044.description: Human faces and peach blossoms glow together in the rosy hue (Vietnam)

2187173.title: The Spare-Tire Bride: The One Who Turns the Tables (Vietnam)
2187173.description: The Spare-Tire Bride: The One Who Turns the Tables (Vietnam)
2187173.originName: 备胎新娘：扭转局面的人（越南）

2187223.title: Beauty’s Scheme to Seize the Throne (Vietnam)
2187223.description: Beauty’s Scheme to Seize the Throne (Vietnam)

2187279.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7TH PRINCE so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My MAGICAL ABILITY 2nd Season (Thai Dub)
2187279.description:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
2187279.originName: 転生したら第七王子だったので、 気ままに魔術を極めます

2187357.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7TH PRINCE so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My MAGICAL ABILITY 2nd Season (Dub Indo)
2187357.description:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
2187357.originName: 転生したら第七王子だったので、 気ままに魔術を極めます

2187472.title: The Revenge of the Ultimate Beauty
2187472.description: She was mercilessly bullied by everyone after suffering a miscarriage, and her mother-in-law even orchestrated the拍摄 of disgraceful photos—because she was nothing more than a lowly lobster seller. To make matters worse, the exorbitant loan her father had taken out left her with no choice but to film all sorts of vulgar short videos. With nowhere else to turn, she finally rose up in defiance…

2187748.title: When Deep Love Turns to Deep Hate (The Guilty Wife Cannot Escape)
2187748.description: At what should have been a joyful wedding, Zhu Jinhao and Zhuang Wenshu's fate takes a dramatic turn due to an unexpected incident. This was meant to be their happiest moment, walking together into marriage. However, a thoughtless prank becomes like a sudden storm, instantly tearing apart their happiness. In this absurd misunderstanding, Zhu Jinhao is mistakenly treated as a substitute bride, while Zhuang Wenshu is wrongly seen as a fake groom. Their love, dignity, and promises are questioned and insulted. This incident cuts their hearts apart like a sharp knife. The loving couple becomes enemies in each other's eyes. Their love becomes fragile, filled with suspicion and hatred. But in this complex mix of love and hate, is there still hope? Can the misunderstanding be resolved? Can their wounded hearts find each other again and rekindle their love?

2187963.title: Love When Frost Falls at Midnight
2187963.description: In her past life, Xie Wanning was betrayed by her beloved and stepsister, becoming a stepping stone for the scoundrel and his mistress. She witnessed her grandfather's murder and died tragically, only to discover that everything was a scheme from the very beginning. Su Mingzhe had orchestrated her downfall just to marry her and seize control of Shengshi Group.

2188086.title: War God of Eight Realms
2188086.description: Behind the glamorous facade of the business world, dark currents flow quietly. The male protagonist Ye Lingfeng, once the mighty War God who dominated the eight realms, was forced to sign an agreement to save his mother and the people. He sealed his powers for five years and hid his identity, forbidden from interfering in business affairs. As the five-year period nears its end, he realizes he loved the wrong person for five years and decisively turns to pursue the woman who truly saved him. The brave and resilient female protagonist defies her family's arranged marriage and agrees to his proposal. As the male protagonist's war god powers gradually return, enemies emerge one after another. With his extraordinary strength and wisdom, he fights against the forces of darkness.

2188162.title: Riding the Waves 1988
2188162.description: CEO Yu Tian accidentally travels back to 1982, an era of planned economy and gradual reform. Facing his heartbroken wife and struggling siblings, he uses his business skills to change their fate and reshape the future.

2188273.title: Mr. Cheng, Long Time No See
2188273.description: Jiang Yan and Jun An are a loving couple planning to marry after graduation. When Jun An brings Jiang Yan home to meet his family, she unexpectedly discovers that Jun An's older brother is Mr. Cheng, a man from her past three years ago. This revelation leads to emotional complications and misunderstandings. When Jun An mysteriously disappears while diving for pearls as a birthday gift for Jiang Yan, his brother Cheng Jun Nian's misunderstanding deepens. To seek revenge against Jiang Yan, Cheng Jun Nian decides to marry her in place of his missing brother, beginning a complex love-hate relationship between them.

2188368.title: The Working Millionaire
2188368.description: A young man is working hard at a factory when the beautiful factory girl brings him a towel to wipe his sweat. Just as he starts using it, his supervisor scolds him and demands he work overtime until midnight. The worker says he needs to go home early for his girlfriend's birthday, so he doesn't want to work late. This leads to a big argument with the supervisor, and in anger, the worker quits his job. When he returns home, he discovers his girlfriend cheating on him with another man. 'What? You didn't think I'd actually marry a loser like you, did you? I only stayed with you because you were obedient. The little money you make isn't even enough for my expenses. But Zhang is different - he's not only rich, but he's also better than you.' His girlfriend shows no guilt and even insults him. The worker is completely devastated and almost gets violent, but reason wins over impulse...

2188441.title: The Emperor's Command
2188441.description: This drama tells the story of the You Clan, a hidden people living on the Moonshade Islands. Their land contains valuable uranium mines that attract the attention of various forces. When the old king is assassinated amid internal conflicts, he entrusts his secret disciple Li Yeabai - the leader of the world's most renowned assassin organization, Phantom Empire - to uncover the truth and seek revenge. He also asks Li Yeabai to protect his daughter, the new queen Yu Luoshang. The story promotes patriotic spirit, showing how a hidden nation's leader fights to protect his homeland's rare resources from foreign invasion. The male lead Li Yeabai, driven by both personal revenge and the greater good, repeatedly spares his enemy brother, displaying true heroic spirit. Meanwhile, the love story between Li Yeabai and Yu Luoshang reveals the romantic entanglements of warriors under the grand theme of national duty.

2188515.title: Imperial Master
2188515.description: A giant red lightning brings a futuristic product from the metaverse, which transforms into a beautiful woman named Nanxi. She follows Ye Xuan to protect him from danger. But Ye Xuan doesn't understand why he needs protection, as he is actually a powerful imperial master. He came to Pingjiang to marry his benefactor's granddaughter as repayment for past kindness. Then Nanxi transforms into a sports car to take Ye Xuan to the Zhao family.

2188575.title: Supreme Master
2188575.description: A powerful sect leader gets injured fighting demons and falls to the mortal world to heal. Those rich people who mock and look down on him don't even qualify to be his sect's lowest disciples!

2188665.title: Urban Warrior King
2188665.description: Elite warrior Ling Feng leads his team to eliminate enemy terrorists, but their mission is compromised by leaked information. To investigate the truth, he hides his identity and goes to Jiang City, working as a security guard for the Jin family while uncovering the conspiracy and fulfilling Yang Bao's last wish.

2188722.title: Urban Medical Immortal
2188722.description: Young Hong Yu ventures into the mountains to gather wild ginseng to pay for his father's surgery, but accidentally gains an immortal doctor's inheritance and begins his journey as a medical immortal. He can heal people, draw talismans, read fortunes, practice martial arts, and master music, chess, calligraphy and painting. Watch how this country boy Hong Wuji rises to dominate the city and conquer the world.

2188814.title: The Ultimate Luxury Daughter-in-Law of the City
2188814.description: In this ancient family saga, rich with drama and complex emotions, Tang Yue’s fate unfolds like a mighty, surging river—turbulent and full of trials, yet revealing her unyielding resilience and deep‑hearted devotion. Orphaned of her mother at an early age and then betrayed by her own sister, she bears a burden of pain and loneliness few could endure. Yet these hardships do not break her; instead, they ignite in her a profound reckoning with her family’s destiny and a burning thirst for power. She resolves to endure ruthless trials, not merely to prove herself, but to reshape her clan’s fortunes—even at the cost of overturning its very foundations—in pursuit of the justice and ideals she holds dear.  Along this arduous path, Tang Yue unexpectedly encounters Beichen, a brave young man who rescues her from peril. He becomes not only her savior but also quietly wins her heart. Their entangled feelings, a twist of fate as tangled as a pot of black tea, brim with both dramatic tension and a pure, fervent passion. Yet the secret of their true identities looms like an unbridgeable chasm between them, leaving Tang Yue to endure her mother‑in‑law’s vexations and Zhao Xianxian’s relentless hostility within the Lu household. Still, she remains steadfast and wise, bearing it all in silence.  When, through her own grit and talent, Tang Yue rises to become one of only two heirs, she never forgets Beichen’s kindness or the love that has taken root in her heart. Faced with the company’s crisis, she extends her hand without hesitation, proving with deeds what it means to be deeply loyal and true. This selfless affection not only helps Beichen weather the storm but also cements her standing within the family.  The second round of trials, however, delivers a profound test to her soul. As the rift with her sister finally mends, she discovers the warmth and preciousness of kinship, coming to realize that unity and harmony within the clan are the bedrock of its enduring prosperity. Standi

2188896.title: The Useless Son-in-Law is a Hidden Billionaire
2188896.description: Security guard Chen Yuanlong has been married to his wife Du Meiyan for many years, maintaining a relationship where he stays home while she works. Du Meiyan seeks a better life with another man and wants to divorce Chen Yuanlong. Little does she know, Chen Yuanlong is not an ordinary person, but the son of the richest man Chen John. After being recognized by his father, Chen Yuanlong begins his legendary life.

2188946.title: The Useless Son-in-Law's Dragon God Pride
2188946.description: Five years ago, Li Jinjun was imprisoned for protecting his girlfriend Wang Jianing, but she betrayed him in court for money. In prison, he was bullied until Wang Mucheng, Jianing's cousin, helped him out of guilt. They fell in love as she supported him. Later, Li Jinjun joined the Dragon God Special Forces and became their leader, protecting the nation. Now he returns wanting a simple life with Wang Mucheng, but when Jianing causes trouble, he must reveal his true identity as the Dragon Emperor to protect the woman he loves.

2189057.title: After Breaking Up, I Became the Billionaire's Beloved
2189057.description: Miss Ning Zhi of the Ning family discovers during a delivery service that the two people in the hotel room are her fiancé of six years and her half-sister.
2189057.originName: 分手后我成了首富掌中宝

2189174.title: Wolf of Revenge
2189174.description: A man's mother is seriously ill and needs $30,000. He tries to borrow money everywhere but faces rejection. He asks his ex-fiancée to return the wedding gifts, but she insults and refuses him. Her new boyfriend is his wealthy classmate. Desperate for money, he has to borrow from this classmate. He finally gets the money, but must pay double interest and use his house as security.

2189233.title: The CEO's Guilty Love and Runaway Wife
2189233.description: Fu Sihan misunderstands that Xu Nian hurt Xu Yanran, and does many hurtful things to Xu Nian. Feeling increasingly heartbroken, Xu Nian decides to end her life, but is unexpectedly saved by Qiu Yang.

2189344.title: CEO Fu's Sweet and Wild White Moonlight
2189344.description: Because of a butterfly birthmark, Qiao Muwan meets and marries CEO Fu Yunting in a flash marriage, climbing into a wealthy family! She takes back her family power, defeats scumbag men and scheming women, and reaches the peak of life with him! Just when everything seems settled, they discover that behind the butterfly birthmark lies a complicated story about their true identities...
2189344.originName: 傅总的白月光又甜又野

2189411.title: CEO Fu's Sweet Intern Wife Arrives
2189411.description: Xiao Tangtang, the secret wife of Fu Group CEO Fu Yancheng, wants to succeed at work through her own efforts. When CEO Fu plans to acquire his wife's company to help her, employees mistake someone else as the CEO's wife. Xiao Tangtang's former classmate Liu Yixiao takes advantage of this mix-up to pretend to be the CEO's wife. The vain Liu Yixiao bullies Xiao Tangtang at work and even puts her in danger. Luckily, Fu Yancheng saves his wife in time. Liu Yixiao continues to deceive everyone, making Xiao Tangtang do her work while trying to steal credit for her achievements. At the company's annual party, Fu Yancheng finally reveals his wife's true identity and punishes the wrongdoers.

2189531.title: Construction Site Hero
2189531.description: To help his coworkers get their unpaid wages, Zhong Lin agrees to Mr. Jiang's terms and goes to prison in place of Jiang's son who caused a drunk driving accident. After 5 years in prison, Zhong Lin discovers his family has been persecuted and disappeared. To find his wife and daughter, he comes to Pi City and works as a construction worker, using every moment to search for them. However, he encounters new troubles as various crises slowly close in on him.

2189608.title: Rebirth Pills
2189608.description: A young man facing life struggles chooses suicide but is rescued and given a chance at rebirth, with the choice between a red pill to return ten years back and change his life, or a blue pill to start a completely new life.

2189718.title: Rebirth: The Dragon Rises Again
2189718.description: In his past life, Li You was betrayed by Fang Zhenxiong, his marriage fell apart, and he discovered his wife Pan Fengting's affair with his enemy. After being reborn, he decides to rise again. Through hard work and making loyal friends, he gradually builds his success. He uses his strength to prove himself and make those who hurt him pay the price, becoming a powerful and respected man.

2189854.title: CEO's Little Sweet Wife
2189854.description: The female lead is confined at home by her CEO husband. During this time, she keeps in touch with the male lead. Later, they face difficulties together and find true love.

2189905.title: Chasing My Wife
2189905.description: Xu Wanning is forced to marry the cold CEO Li Sihan because of her stepfather's debts. Due to misunderstandings, Li Sihan treats her badly and makes her life difficult. When the truth comes out, he deeply regrets his actions and tries everything to win her back and make up for his mistakes.

2190053.title: The CEO's Wife is a Princess
2190053.description: The famous CEO's wife turns out to be a princess!

2190159.title: CEO, Please Control Yourself - We're Already Divorced
2190159.description: Abandoned by her family and forced into marriage, she used her medical skills to heal a disabled CEO. But after getting pregnant, she was framed and kicked out. Years later, they meet again, and the CEO becomes a persistent pursuer she can't shake off.
2190159.originName: 总裁请自重，我们已经离婚了

2190258.title: Last Time I Love You
2190258.description: Li Jiaxin deeply loves her husband Jiang Yan, but he neither loves nor trusts her. One day, Li Jiaxin is suddenly diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer. Bai Mu, who has feelings for her, advises her to give up on Jiang Yan, but how can years of love be easily let go?

2190400.title: The Ultimate Office King
2190400.description: A retired war hero returns to the city and marries a female CEO. Using his skills and knowledge, he helps his wife grow her business and becomes her strongest business partner.

2190492.title: Love Hard to Say (Young Master Mu, Stop the Abuse)
2190492.description: Qin Muxue lies in a hospital bed when she receives shocking news - she's pregnant. What should be joyful news turns her world upside down. Through the door, she sees her husband Mu Junhao embracing another woman, ignoring her completely. Her heart breaks as she looks at her belly, knowing their love has created new life, but the child faces tragedy before birth. Seeds of revenge sprout in her heart. The other woman becomes her most shameful memory and proof of her husband's betrayal. Looking at the gray sky, she begins planning her revenge. She will take the child and make her husband face his true nature. Though the path ahead is full of thorns, she's ready to face any challenge with courage. She will use her wisdom to reveal the truth and make him pay for his betrayal. This fight is not just for herself, but for her unborn child. She believes that in the end, she will win back her dignity and happiness.

2190618.title: Princess Don't Be Afraid, I'm Here to Save You
2190618.description: Lu Yu, a Ming Dynasty royal guard, is struck by lightning while saving Princess Lin'an during a rare celestial event and travels to modern times. He's rescued by Zhu Yan, who takes him home where Lu Yu sees a photo of Zhu Yan's daughter, Zhu Lin'an, and mistakes her for the princess. However, Zhu Lin'an has been kidnapped by a fraud group while traveling. To save her, Lu Yu disguises himself as a tourist and infiltrates the criminal organization, while Zhu Yan works with Liu Sisi to negotiate ransom payments. Lu Yu eventually realizes this Lin'an isn't his princess, but decides to save her anyway. Together, they outsmart the criminals, gather evidence of their crimes, and help police destroy the fraud ring, rescuing many victims. Lu Yu chooses to stay in modern times with Zhu Lin'an's encouragement.

2190718.title: Kung Fu Girl Comes Down the Mountain
2190718.description: A skilled kung fu girl leaves her mountain home after years of training to explore the bustling city. In this new world, she faces challenges from thugs and criminals while using her martial arts skills to help others. With her strong sense of justice, she refuses to bow to evil forces and gradually learns to navigate modern society, making friends and growing stronger along the way.

2190952.title: Young Master Gu, Don't You Love Me Anymore?
2190952.description: Five years ago, Jiang Cheng betrayed Gu Tianyu for money, breaking their relationship. Now, Gu Tianyu returns with power, determined to join forces with Lin Zhimo to fight against Jiang Cheng, uncover the truth of the past, and seek justice.

2191057.title: The CEO's Contract Wife
2191057.description: After marriage, the couple lived happily for a while, but happiness was like a bubble that bursts after a moment of perfection. One day, the female lead woke up from a nightmare where a woman entered their home, holding her husband's arm and mocking her arrogantly. When she asked who the woman was, her husband coldly told her to get out, laughing wickedly with the other woman. She woke up screaming and sought comfort from her husband, desperately asking him to confirm he would never leave her. However, if it was just a nightmare, why did her husband bring home the exact same woman from her dream the next day? Framed by this woman named Wang Yuanyuan and falsely accused of sleeping with Zhao Tianqi, causing her husband to misunderstand her, how will she handle this situation?

2191130.title: CEO Gu's Contract Lover
2191130.description: Gu Shaoyan, a powerful financial mogul known as the 'Evil Emperor,' has no ties to the Gu family. When the top ten families of Zhonghai launch an attack against the Gu family, the old butler Tang Ao seeks out the young master, hoping he will save the family despite past grudges. After returning to take control, Gu accidentally becomes intimate with Qiu Ya, daughter of the Ye family, at a hotel. Given the Ye family's complex connections with the ten major families, Gu signs a lover's contract with Qiu Ya, beginning a thrilling story of love, hate, and passion.

2191279.title: Best Friend's Revenge
2191279.description: Wang Yao gave everything for her boyfriend, only to be deceived and betrayed by him. Fang Tong and Wang Yao are best friends. After being betrayed, Wang Yao moves in with Fang Tong and sees her happy marriage. This makes Wang Yao jealous as she remembers their past choices. She confesses her feelings to Fang Tong's husband Xu Xingzhe. Due to various reasons, Fang Tong is betrayed by her best friend. After suffering many hurts and betrayals, Fang Tong decides to take revenge. In the end, Wang Yao falls ill and deeply regrets her actions.

2191385.title: The CEO's Butcher Wife
2191385.description: Li Jingling, heir to a wealthy family, is injured by rivals and saved by Yan Wanwan, a pork vendor. Attracted by her kindness and honesty, he hides his identity while spending time with her. After his identity is revealed, he brings her to his family home. To fulfill his dying grandmother's wish, they enter into a marriage agreement. After marriage, Yan Wanwan faces harassment from odd relatives, rejection from the Li family, and bullying from women who admire Li Jingling. With Li Jingling's protection and favoritism, she overcomes each challenge, wins the family's acceptance, and they develop genuine feelings to become a true married couple.

2191507.title: The Rich Family's Sweet and Soft Silly Wife
2191507.description: A wealthy heiress becomes mentally impaired after a car accident. A CEO decides to marry her as her fiancé, giving her the status to enter the Shen family cemetery as his bride.

2191567.title: Dark Rules
2191567.description: A female protagonist from a comic world crosses into the real world and teams up with the author to investigate the reason behind her crossing over. In the end, they live happily together.

2191638.title: When Flowers Fall, We Meet Again
2191638.description: A man and woman, pressured to marry, hide their wealthy identities and quickly arrange a one-year contract marriage. As they help each other, they gradually fall in love. Unfortunately, the man's hereditary family illness breaks out early due to work and life pressures. To give his contract wife a perfect life, he schemes to leave her and gives away all his wealth. The woman, kept in the dark, becomes extremely angry. But after learning the truth, she regrets deeply! After years of searching, she finally finds the critically ill man...

2191708.title: Soul Swap Beauty Contest
2191708.description: Rich girl Lin Qing is forced by her father to join a beauty contest to arrange her marriage with another wealthy young man. Poor girl Huang Jialing also enters the contest hoping to change her life. During rehearsal, they get into a fight and are electrocuted, causing their souls to swap bodies. The poor girl now in the rich girl's body enjoys luxury life with hilarious results.

2191787.title: Reborn Into the Wealthy Family
2191787.description: A young man's family falls from grace and he suffers humiliation. His brothers turn against him, his fiancée betrays him. These devastating blows leave him heartbroken. Just as he plans to die with his enemies, he unexpectedly gets reborn back to the past! In this life, he vows to get revenge and reclaim everything that belongs to him, making those who betrayed him pay back double for all the pain they caused!

2191893.title: Stop Hurting Me, Mr. Huo - Miss Su Ran Away Pregnant
2191893.description: Su Muyan was once a wealthy young lady who fell in love with Huo Jingchen in college, but they broke up due to her father's interference. After her family went bankrupt and her father died, Huo became a successful young CEO. Su slept with Huo for money to pay for her mother's medical treatment but was humiliated. At the hospital, she was stopped by Su Man'er, who deliberately provoked her into fighting. Huo witnessed this and protected Su Man'er, even attacking Su Muyan. Su fainted due to a blood clotting disorder and was diagnosed with stomach cancer.

2191986.title: Blissful Life (Misplaced Life)
2191986.description: A young man comes to the city with traditional massage techniques passed down from his ancestors. Unexpectedly, all the women become fascinated by his massage skills and can't get enough...

2192093.title: Mr. Ji Refuses to Divorce Again
2192093.description: Years ago, the female lead saved the male lead but never told him. After their marriage, her best friend appears and constantly frames her, claiming she was the one who saved him. The male lead becomes cold to his wife, they divorce, but he learns the truth too late.

2192230.title: Sister, I Only Want to Be Your Leading Man
2192230.description: Bai Weiwei missed her college crush but accidentally spent a night with Song Jinghan, her friend's younger brother. Years later, they reunite as director and top star. Song Jinghan protects her secretly while Bai Weiwei gradually falls for him despite their age gap. After rejecting her old crush, Bai Weiwei realizes she loves Song Jinghan. He refuses an arranged marriage and they confess their feelings. Despite threats from rivals, Song Jinghan chooses Bai Weiwei. They end up together with successful careers, and he becomes the exclusive male lead in her TV shows.
2192230.originName: 姐姐，我只想做你的男主角

2192368.title: A Dragon Cannot Be Confined to a Small Pond
2192368.description: The Golden Scale Palace is the oldest family in Shenzhou Kingdom, guardians of the dragon veins. The young palace master was injured in battles against foreign enemies and wandered to Huaizhou. After five years, he reconnected with the Golden Scale Palace. Now living in hiding, he wants to help the people of Huaizhou but faces obstacles from four major families and five powerful forces.

2192457.title: Top Lawyer (Original: No Remarriage, Ex-Wife Get Lost)
2192457.description: At home, Li Xiaoxu anxiously waits for Wang Yuanyuan's arrival, but when she appears, she brings a divorce agreement. Li Xiaoxu tries to save their marriage, only to receive cold words from Wang Yuanyuan. For her sake, he gave up the Li Group and married into the Wang family, but after three years of trying, he couldn't warm her cold heart. He resolutely chooses to leave with nothing.

2192568.title: Hurricane Rescue: Critical 48 Hours
2192568.description: Beautiful broadcaster Luna is dragged by two men in black and thrown into a dark prison. Other prisoners want to harm her, but A Long, working for Boss Fei, takes all the captured women out and pushes them into a huge mud pit as rushing water comes toward them. A Long tries to harm Luna, but Sister Hong stops him. One day earlier, Luna was livestreaming on the street when she was suddenly kidnapped. Two children, Youyou and Tiantian, who were out playing with their mother, were also taken by the men in black. When Brother Jun arrived, the children had already disappeared.

2192620.title: The Beautiful Factory Girl Chases Me

2192742.title: The Beautiful CEO's Passionate Bodyguard
2192742.description: Lin Yang, the powerful God King, discovers a conspiracy during a deal and secretly returns home. While searching for his former subordinate Blue Snake, he accidentally meets Yu Qiuya. When the Cold family's young master tries to force himself on her by drugging her with the help of Yu family elders, Lin Yang heroically saves her. Their destinies become intertwined. After going through many hardships, will they finally find true love together?

2192805.title: Cool, My Virtual Life
2192805.description: After being betrayed, a loser accidentally gains a wealthy system where spending money on bound goddesses returns 10 times the investment, winning countless beauties, helping goddesses solve problems, and achieving life's peak.

2192892.title: Love's Twist and Return (Spending Millions, My Husband Asks Me to Handle His Divorce Case)
2192892.description: A CEO is unhappy with the marriage his grandfather arranged for him, so he fled abroad for five years. Eventually, he decides to divorce his wife and hires the most famous local divorce lawyer to fight the case. However, the CEO doesn't know that the lawyer he hired is actually his wife, whom he has never met...
2192892.originName: 老公斥资千万，请我帮他打了离婚官司

2192962.title: Honey, I Fell Into My Best Friend's Trap
2192962.description: In a family feud caused by ancient hatred, Su Mingzhu sends her children Feng Zhiqian and Wang Tao to infiltrate the Gu family to steal the Moon God Jade and gain immortal power. Gao Xun, a Moon Gate disciple and secret wealthy man, is ordered to track the jade but becomes entangled with Gu Su, a descendant of the Gu family. When Feng Zhiqian's assassination attempt causes the Moon God Jade to merge with Gu Su's body, a battle over power, revenge, and love begins.
2192962.originName: 老公我掉进了闺蜜的陷阱

2193028.title: After Divorce, My First Love and I Destroyed the Whole Family
2193028.description: Yun Yueshu, originally the girlfriend of Wen Changmo, the eldest son of the Wen family, personally caught him having an affair with her own sister Yun Luoluo. Disgusted by their shameless behavior, she slapped the cheating man and decided to divorce him. After leaving the private room, Yun Yueshu was...
2193028.originName: 离婚后我和初恋虐了全家

2193130.title: The Scumbag Regrets After Divorce
2193130.description: When Shen Li awakens from a coma, she realizes she was just a substitute for three years and her husband Gu Yan tried to use her for insurance fraud. This revelation sparks her determination to rebuild her life. She secretly gathers evidence against Gu Yan and exposes his crimes to the media. Using her intelligence and business skills, she ventures into the commercial world and achieves remarkable success. Through hard work and determination, she transforms from a victim into a respected entrepreneur, proving that anyone can overcome adversity and create their own brilliant future.

2193209.title: CEO Li, Don't Mess Around
2193209.description: An unexpected marriage pulls Ye Li into the whirlwind of a wealthy family. She thought marrying Li Junyan was just a business deal, but she gets caught up in the Li family's complicated inheritance battle. Facing her cold and ruthless husband, fake and cunning family members, and betrayal from her ex-boyfriend and cousin, Ye Li must learn to survive in this world full of schemes. However, as time passes, Li Junyan's attitude toward Ye Li seems to change subtly. Can Ye Li find her place in this wealthy family game and even turn the tables?

2193280.title: In Love with Your Lips
2193280.description: To make a living and pay for school, Jiang Ke takes a difficult path... but through this life, she meets the man who will change her destiny forever. She lives realistically and never thought she would fall in love, but when love comes, nothing can stop it. Will the love she longs for truly belong to her? You were born before I was born, I was born when you were already old. Mr. Zhuo, do you know that while I cannot choose my fate, I can love with all my heart.

2193420.title: Young Master Ling's Billion Dollar Love
2193420.description: This drama tells a story of love and wealth, featuring a rich man who deeply cherishes and spoils his beloved woman.

2193491.title: Dragon's Reign
2193491.description: The male lead lost his memory as a war god years ago after being betrayed by enemies. After recovering his memory, he hunts down the culprits and gets his revenge.

2193558.title: Mrs. Lu's Secret Identity Exposed
2193558.description: Qin Qianqian works at her own company disguised as a new employee. Lu Nanjue secretly protects her while she warns him not to reveal she's the CEO's wife. On the first day, when two new employees arrive, everyone mistakes the well-dressed Gong Meina for the CEO's wife, leading to a series of hilarious misunderstandings.

2193675.title: Song of Troubled Times
2193675.description: Young Lu Qingshan and his childhood friend Wen Shiyi are separated by war. When they reunite, Wen Shiyi has become a mute woman who joins the Lu family. Through misunderstandings and emotional struggles, Lu Qingshan recognizes Wen Shiyi, and together they face family plots and the challenges of chaotic times.

2193727.title: The Tycoon in Troubled Times
2193727.description: Set in a chaotic and unstable era, this story follows a wealthy businessman with sharp business sense and courage. In this troubled time filled with crisis and challenges, various forces fight endlessly while social order crumbles. The protagonist builds massive wealth through keen insight and bold decisions, expanding his business empire across trade, manufacturing, finance, and real estate. However, his wealth brings countless troubles and dangers as different forces covet his fortune - some try to win him over while others attempt to steal from him. He must deal with cunning politicians, greedy warlords, and ruthless gangs. Despite the challenges, he shows his humanity by helping disaster victims and building schools and hospitals. With like-minded friends, he fights against evil forces in this chaotic world. As the story unfolds, he faces increasingly difficult choices between protecting his wealth and family while bringing hope to this troubled era.

2193809.title: Storm of the Rakshasa Kingdom
2193809.description: A man travels back in time to become a founding emperor. He meets a wealthy lady who pretends to be crazy and foolish. Facing troubles from within and outside, he experiences the hardships of building a new empire.

2193938.title: The Runaway Princess is Hard to Chase
2193938.description: Qin Wan'er was a talented and beautiful noble lady before marriage, living a happy life with her loving family. After marrying Ye Mufeng, she thought she had married for love, but he proved to be cold, domineering, and confused about feelings, leaving her neglected. To protect her family mansion, she endured abuse and slander from concubine Qianqian, even losing her own child.

2194004.title: The Lawyer's Sweet Wife - A Happy Romance
2194004.description: "The Lawyer's Sweet Wife - A Happy Romance" is a light-hearted urban romance drama about young lawyer Liao Bai and her boss, a law firm partner. Liao Bai is a smart and justice-driven young lawyer who just joined a prestigious law firm. Her boss is a top lawyer - cold and shrewd. They are completely different in work style and personality. Liao Bai's optimism contrasts sharply with her boss's seriousness. Initially, they clash constantly, but through working on cases together, they begin to understand and appreciate each other. While handling complex cases, Liao Bai shows extraordinary legal talent and dedication to justice, earning her boss's respect. Meanwhile, influenced by Liao Bai, her boss begins to reflect on his work and life, showing more humanity and warmth. Over time, their work chemistry gradually turns into personal feelings. However, workplace rules and moral boundaries complicate their relationship. Through a series of funny events and misunderstandings, they eventually let go of their prejudices and honestly face their feelings. This drama presents a workplace love story with a light and cheerful atmosphere while conveying positive messages about justice and courage.

2194076.title: The Lawyer Queen
2194076.description: The female lead's parents were framed in a bridge collapse incident for taking bribes and using poor materials, imprisoned and killed by persecution. She vows to become a lawyer to fight all injustices and clear her parents' names. To overturn their case, she seeks out people connected to the original incident and helps them with their current legal troubles. Each solved case brings new clues, but a mastermind keeps misleading her investigation. Meanwhile, rival colleagues constantly create obstacles and competition, but she overcomes each challenge, successfully solves cases, and rises through the ranks.

2194166.title: Fake Cinderella
2194166.description: After being betrayed by her boyfriend and left with nothing, a girl discovers she's the granddaughter of the richest family. She transforms from Cinderella into a wealthy heiress, but faces constant doubts about her true identity. She proves everyone wrong and rises to the top on her path of revenge.

2194245.title: The Temptation of the Adorable Lady
2194245.description: The younger sister and Su Ruichen were deeply in love, but she died unexpectedly. The older sister Shengxia approaches Su Ruichen to secretly investigate who killed her sister.

2194355.title: Apocalypse Rebirth: Last Stand
2194355.description: Protagonist Yue Xun suddenly wakes up and discovers he has been reborn two days before the apocalypse filled with zombies. Only he knows about the coming disaster. He uses this chance to prepare early, struggling to survive in the apocalypse and fighting back. The story may include the protagonist awakening special powers, working with or fighting other survivors, and searching for survival resources. The specific plot may vary between versions.

2194498.title: Young Master Mu's Ways of Hurting His Wife
2194498.description: Young Master Mu Qichen is tricked by his butler into believing that his illegitimate daughter Lu Xinyi is his true love, creating conflict between him and his wife Song Zhiqian. After facing many challenges and near-death experiences, Mu Qichen finally realizes who he truly loves.

2194559.title: Southern Emperor of the Domain
2194559.description: The male protagonist was once the famous Southern Emperor, but lost his memory after being ambushed in battle. He became a son-in-law in a wealthy family, but his wife betrayed him by having an affair. When he discovered this, he became angry and accidentally recovered his memory. He vowed to find his attacker and take revenge on those who bullied him. Finally, he publicly revealed his identity as the Southern Emperor.

2194631.title: Evil Dragon Enters the World
2194631.description: Chu Fan grew up in a Taoist temple and became his master's most talented disciple. He often helps heal villagers with his skills. When he reaches marriage age, his three master's wives arrange for him to marry the eldest daughter of the Tang family. However, when the Tang daughter breaks off the engagement, it unexpectedly leads to Chu Fan meeting Xiao Wan Ge.

2194706.title: Painful Love to Marriage
2194706.description: Four years ago, Shi Wenrou painfully left Bai Hangqing to save her mother. Four years later, while trying to raise money for her mother's surgery, she was misunderstood and humiliated by Bai Hangqing. The two begin endless misunderstandings and entanglements.

2194802.title: A Woman's Revenge
2194802.description: A successful career woman who appears glamorous on the surface, but is actually despised by her mother-in-law, betrayed by her cheating husband, and even schemed against, ultimately pushed off a cliff.

2194875.title: The Queen's True Nature
2194875.description: On her wedding day, Wu Jin is betrayed by her fiancé Fang Qingcheng and pushed off a rooftop. She miraculously survives after being possessed by an ancient empress. Transformed from a weak woman into a powerful queen with sharp business skills and strategic mind, Wu Jin begins her journey of revenge while uncovering the secrets of her past.

2194941.title: The Female CEO
2194941.description: The male lead has a one-night stand with the female lead. The next day, his subordinates find him, revealing his true identity as the Dragon King, and the female lead is his fiancée he's been searching for five years. The female lead approaches him again, asking him to pretend to be her fiancé. The male lead hides his Dragon King identity and agrees to the fake engagement.

2195077.title: Oh! My General
2195077.description: In ancient times, two lovers are trapped in a cycle of tragic rebirths due to an emperor's curse. In their first life, the female lead dies saving her beloved general. In the second life, they meet and fall in love again, but she dies protecting him once more. In their third life, the general saves her when they first meet, and she pursues him passionately. They fall in love, but the general exhausts himself protecting her and his hair turns white overnight. Fortunately, their love brings forth a child who saves him, and the family of three lives happily ever after.

2195222.title: The Wife's Awakening
2195222.description: Zhong Na's story is a deep lesson about love, reality, and self-awakening. It reminds us of the importance of staying rational and independent while pursuing love. Initially, Zhong Na bravely chose Lin Qifeng for love, ignoring material differences. However, over time, reality revealed the true nature of Lin Qifeng and his family - they acted like parasites, relying on her wealth and resources without cherishing her sacrifices. Facing this situation, Zhong Na made the brave decision to divorce. Though painful, this was her path to rediscovering herself and pursuing true happiness. She was no longer deceived by false love but courageously faced reality and chose her own path. The Lin family's regret came too late - their behavior had already deeply hurt Zhong Na and destroyed her trust. Zhong Na's story teaches us the importance of maintaining rationality and independence in love. We must protect our rights and dignity, and not be used or hurt by anyone.

2195324.title: The Abandoned Princess
2195324.description: At Hong Luan's wedding to Crown Prince Ji Junze, the prince arrives with a coffin to humiliate her. Despite loving the prince deeply, Hong Luan agrees to marry him even if it means entering the coffin. However, the prince loves another woman and wrongly believes Hong Luan harmed his beloved. After marriage, Hong Luan is locked in the coffin and nearly dies, but is rescued by the Seventh Prince, causing even more misunderstandings with her husband.

2195460.title: The Abandoned Wife's Sweet Revenge
2195460.description: Han Jingxin accidentally gets entangled with her devilish brother-in-law Huo Junmo. She expected to be controlled by his power, but surprisingly discovers his unexpected tenderness and love for her.

2195537.title: The Heiress Returns
2195537.description: A billionaire's granddaughter returns from studying abroad and hides her identity to work at a small company. But when someone pretends to be her, she starts her ultimate revenge.

2195595.title: The Rich Lady's Revenge
2195595.description: A wealthy heiress marries a poor man and leaves her family to live with him. She works hard in his household but faces a cruel mother-in-law who forces her to drink harmful folk remedies during pregnancy, including rat soup, sending her to the hospital. The evil mother-in-law shows no remorse and even encourages her son to cheat while his wife is pregnant. This causes the pregnant woman great stress, leading to early labor. Finally, her own mother steps in to protect her daughter, taking both her and the baby back home, where the protagonist begins her revenge.

2195715.title: Don't Run Away, Ex-Wife
2195715.description: A chase and escape story of misunderstandings leading to a flash marriage. True love blossomed but they separated due to another misunderstanding. Now he won't let her escape - he's determined to win back their marriage. Yu Luoxi, the wealthy Yu family's daughter, lived a carefree life until fate took an unexpected turn.

2195858.title: A Chinese Ghost Story: Love at Lanruo Temple
2195858.description: On a moonlit night, weak scholar Ning Caichen hurries to the capital for exams but trips over bones in a dark forest. A white fox stares at him, and he flees in panic. While being chased by fox demon Nie Xiaoqian, he meets a wounded imperial guard. Demon hunter Yan Chixia arrives to save them both. They hide in Lanruo Temple where the dying guard writes a blood letter for Ning to deliver to Captain Zhuge Jing. After Yan Chixia drives away Nie Xiaoqian and leaves Ning a scripture book, the injured demon reports to Lord Huai, who orders her to steal the scholar's pure heart. At the imperial office, Ning's scripture book catches the attention of Kunlun sect disciple Zhiqiu Yiye, who helps him sneak in to deliver the letter. Imprisoned for trespassing, Ning is told he can redeem himself by finding the guard's body. Back at his lodging, a portrait of a beautiful woman floats in, and the woman in the painting, Nie Xiaoqian, sits by his window watching him.

2195965.title: Mrs. Qin's Comeback (The Young Lady's Comeback)
2195965.description: The female lead is an adopted daughter living under the Xu family's roof. To escape the Xu family, and because the male lead needs a suitable marriage alliance, they signed a contract marriage three years ago. When the contract expires after three years, both had already fallen for each other but never confessed. After their divorce, the male lead continues to care for and help the female lead, and their love grows deeper.

2196028.title: The Young Marshal Falls in Love with Me (Reborn for Revenge)
2196028.description: Ji Shuyu suffered cruel abuse from her fiancé in her past life, leading to mental breakdown and death. Miraculously reborn with all her painful memories, she vows to change her destiny this time. She joins forces with Gu Qingchen, the warlord's uncle who secretly loved and protected her before. Surprisingly, he seems to have been reborn too. Understanding each other without words, they share the flames of revenge and embark on a determined path to make their enemies pay.

2196153.title: How Deep is Love
2196153.description: "How Deep is Love" is a modern romance drama about Xu Yanqing, who gets a second chance at life after being reborn. In her previous life, she suffered greatly from bullying and humiliation by her sister Shen Rulan and a group of delinquents, eventually dying in despair. However, fate gives her another opportunity when she mysteriously returns to 2008, just days before her father's death. With memories of her past life, the reborn Xu Yanqing is determined not to repeat her tragic fate. She decides to protect herself and her family, realizing that she had been living under Shen Rulan's schemes, including her father's car accident which was also planned by Shen Rulan. Armed with knowledge of the future, Xu Yanqing begins a journey of revenge and finding true love. During this process, she meets the male lead Qin Donge, and they develop a deep emotional connection. The story shows how a woman can stand up again after betrayal and pain, bravely facing life with courage.

2196265.title: As You Wish
2196265.description: Song Mingzhe's company went bankrupt and owed massive high-interest loans. To pay off his debts, he sold his fiancée Zhou Qing to the underworld as a mistress.

2196412.title: Addicted to Flash Marriage: My Boss is My Husband (After Flash Marriage, Mr. Gu Forbids Divorce)
2196412.description: Six years ago, before her grandmother passed away, she entrusted Lin Shu to her best friend's grandson. The two got married immediately without ever meeting, and spent their wedding night together. Lin Shu couldn't remember what Gu Tingxiu looked like, and he left for abroad the next day. Lin Shu then raised their child alone for six years, living like a widow in marriage, almost forgetting this man existed in her life. Until six years later, Lin Shu and Gu Tingxiu meet again by chance.
2196412.originName: 闪婚成瘾，顶头上司是我老公

2196506.title: After Flash Marriage, My Bodyguard Husband's Identity Keeps Getting Exposed
2196506.description: Due to Wang Ze's betrayal, Gu Yunshuang impulsively marries her bodyguard Fu Moqian and asks him to pretend to be Mr. Long. Wang Ze and Sun Xiaoxiao don't believe their relationship and repeatedly try to expose Fu Moqian's true identity, but he cleverly handles each situation. Gu Yunshuang thought this was just her bodyguard's skill, but she never expected that Fu Moqian was actually the CEO of Longchuan Group. As the story unfolds, their relationship deepens into a sweet and complex love story.
2196506.originName: 闪婚后保镖老公马甲又掉了

2196614.title: After Our Flash Marriage, CEO Fu Spoils Me Rotten
2196614.description: The female lead and male lead only met once but agreed to get married. The male lead had his assistant give her a card with money and the password, then drove away. They never saw each other again for years until he returned to find his wife. Misunderstandings arose between them, but eventually they were resolved. In the end, the wealthy husband treasures his wife, protecting and loving her in every way.

2196684.title: Flash Marriage: My Spoiled Wife
2196684.description: A disabled man marries a woman in a contract marriage for good luck. When the contract ends, she wants divorce. He thinks she only cares about money and won't ask her to stay. After a car accident, he recovers his health and meets her again.

2196764.title: From Gamer to Billionaire
2196764.description: A young man is betrayed by his girlfriend, but discovers that game coins can be used as real money. He exploits this system glitch to win back everything he lost and becomes an industry king.

2196825.title: Rise of the Tycoon 2003
2196825.description: Honest man Zhao Feng is reborn and returns to the eve of college entrance exams, still young! This year, the young man's heart awakens to love, but he doesn't dare confess to the school beauty he's secretly loved for three years! This year, the legendary game hasn't launched yet, brotherhood burns bright, and the dream of slaying dragons remains unfulfilled!

2196972.title: My Clever Little Wife
2196972.description: 【Rebirth + Revenge】Yan Anluo loved Lu Tinghao deeply for ten years, but never won his heart until her death. Given a second chance at life, she's done with men - she just wants to get rich! She throws divorce papers at him: "Let's divorce, I'm going home to inherit the family business!" But he tears up the papers with red eyes: "You can only divorce me over my dead body!"

2197059.title: The Neurotic Detectives
2197059.description: Businesswoman Jiang Ailin is about to marry into a wealthy family and become the daughter-in-law of General Anu. Her three best friends throw her a bachelorette party at a themed hotel. At midnight, Jiang Ailin is found dead in the bedroom bathtub with a dagger in her chest. Who killed her? General Anu sends two neurotic detectives, Nan Ke and Jin Tianer, to find the murderer. The three friends each have their own secrets and suspect each other of being the killer. The neurotic detectives carefully investigate and gradually solve the mystery of Jiang Ailin's murder through each person's memories of the bachelorette party. However, after solving the case, they discover there's more to the story...

2197173.title: The Divine Doctor Son-in-Law
2197173.description: Wang Hao was framed as a child and watched his entire family die in a fire. Twelve years later, he masters divine healing arts and returns to life, beginning his journey of revenge.

2197238.title: Sacred Son Mad Dragon
2197238.description: In prison, a young man finishes his 1000th push-up. His cellmate says: 'Kid, for three whole years, I've never seen you rest for a day. Tomorrow is your release date, why are you still training? You're doing double your usual amount, aren't you afraid of hurting yourself?' The young man replies: 'My family has practiced traditional Chinese medicine for generations, I know my limits.' The cellmate continues: 'Traditional Chinese medicine is great, more reliable than Western medicine. Have you heard of Star River Group in the capital? I'm the chairman of Star River Group.' Hearing this, the young man says: 'Old man, have you been locked up too long? Are you having mental problems?'

2197344.title: After Losing My Memory, Four Men Fight Over Me
2197344.description: A girl falls from a building and loses consciousness. When she wakes up, she has no memory, but finds herself being pursued by 4 handsome young men, beginning a dramatic new life.
2197344.originName: 失忆后我被四个男人疯抢

2197440.title: The Memory-Lost Miracle Doctor
2197440.description: A hospital director loses his memory after being attacked by someone hired by a jealous deputy director. Though he forgets his past, he keeps his amazing medical skills and sharp insight. While searching for his identity, he gets caught up in complex cases and uses his wisdom and medical expertise to solve one mystery after another.

2197529.title: CEO's Stand-in Ex-Wife
2197529.description: The female lead has a terminal illness. Her family only cares about her marriage to a wealthy CEO for their own benefit, not knowing about her condition. She wants to tell the CEO the truth, but he thinks she only wants his money. When she feels hopeless, everything begins to change.

2197637.title: Holding Stars, It's Always You
2197637.description: A young nurse saves a wealthy CEO with her devotion, but her foster mother forces her to marry a man from a demolition household. The nurse isn't the smartest person, but she has a powerful weapon - kindness. Can she turn her life around with kindness?

2197740.title: Twin Dragons Cross the River
2197740.description: The male lead was framed as a child and became an orphan. He was rescued and raised by a master, gaining extraordinary abilities. While secretly investigating the truth about his past, he discovers he has a twin brother. Together, they work to expose the mastermind behind the conspiracy from years ago and finally get their revenge.

2197842.title: Twin Love That Captivates the City
2197842.description: A woman seeks revenge for her sister by impersonating her to marry into the Qin family and find the killer. As she investigates suspects one by one, she gradually develops feelings for the male lead. During her search for truth, she discovers that her sister's unborn child was not her brother-in-law's!

2197906.title: Dragon Pearl of Water and Fire
2197906.description: Su Xuan is handsome and smart, hiding his true power. He is the only heir of the Su family medical dynasty in Jiang City. After training in the mountains for 18 years with Han Tianying, he gained incredible martial arts and medical skills. One day, to find the truth behind his family's massacre, Su Xuan comes down from the mountain...

2198045.title: Four Sisters, Please Be Gentle
2198045.description: A young man comes down the mountain to deliver a wedding gift to his brother. His future sister-in-law unexpectedly pushes him into a room. Just before something happens, he pushes her away and reveals who he is. He presents a special wedding gift, but the woman suddenly becomes angry and threatens to hurt his brother. It turns out the girl who stole his wallet is actually his sister-in-law.

2198145.title: Four Seas
2198145.description: After dying tragically, the male protagonist is reborn in the 1990s. He clears his past sins and fights back powerfully, starting from a small factory to battle foreign capital, win over business tycoons, and mingle in high society. He builds a commercial empire and fulfills his promise to his wife.

2198219.title: Don't Mess with Young Madam Su
2198219.description: Republican-era chamber of commerce president Zhao Ximyue accidentally soul-swaps with modern housewife Li Yitong after being betrayed. In modern times, she uses her business talents to reform the workplace and teams up with male lead Su Yunjing to crush Su Yunrui's conspiracy to seize the company. Meanwhile, housewife Li Yitong returns to the Republican era to replace Zhao Ximyue as chamber president.

2198363.title: The Greedy Family's Heirloom
2198363.description: This drama revolves around a house and an ancestral jade bracelet left by grandparents. Two members of the Li family, an uncle and nephew, each have their own schemes and try every means to fight for the inheritance, creating a comedy of errors.

2198424.title: After Marrying in My Sister's Place, My Husband Spoils Me Alone
2198424.description: The woman kneeling on the ground is a concubine's daughter from the Shen family. They say concubine's daughters have low status, which is absolutely true. Originally, the legitimate daughter of the Shen family was engaged to the prince's son, but three years ago the prince's son fell seriously ill and was rumored to die soon. When the legitimate daughter heard this news, she naturally refused to marry him. So the father and daughter forced this concubine's daughter to marry the prince's son in her sister's place, to avoid becoming a living widow. Her sister even threatened that if she didn't agree, she would be married off to a servant. When her father asked her one last time whether she would marry or not, the woman had no choice but to compromise...
2198424.originName: 替姐姐出嫁后夫君独宠我

2198534.title: My Cute Princess from Heaven
2198534.description: A modern mortician travels back in time to become a crown princess. Facing false accusations from palace servants, she learns seduction skills from a courtesan to save her life.

2198603.title: The Heavenly Master Descends: CEO Falls for Me
2198603.description: Ye Qingyang, a genius who became a Heavenly Master before adulthood. But his heart still yearns for the mortal world, so he descends the mountain for the girl who once saved his life. Watch as this extraordinary master enters the bustling city and creates a magnificent love story in this world of endless desires.
2198603.originName: 天师下山之总裁爱上我

2198655.title: Eye Realm Transformation (Divine Eye Son-in-Law)
2198655.description: Blind Ye Cangsheng was betrayed, but accidentally awakened supernatural powers and turned out to be a young master

2198728.title: Spoiled by Three Big Boss Brothers After Breaking Off the Engagement
2198728.description: Ling Cheng is actually from the Mu family, but after her family was destroyed, she was separated from her three brothers and adopted by the Ling family. When she grows up and is about to marry Tang Fengyan, she discovers that Tang's mother prefers the wealthy heiress Chen Xinyu over her. At the wedding, Chen Xinyu steals the groom, humiliating Ling Cheng in front of all the guests. At the crucial moment, her three powerful brothers arrive: Mu Tingyu (founder of Longding Group and world's richest man), Mu Liufeng (the ghost doctor), and Mu Xingyan (from Dragon Soul Hall). Everyone is shocked and bows to them. The brothers take Ling Cheng away. Later, Chen Xinyu and Tang Fengyan try to provoke Ling Cheng, but are ultimately defeated by her and her brothers.
2198728.originName: 退婚后被三个大佬哥哥宠上天

2198848.title: Late Autumn
2198848.description: Wang Hao is framed by his mother-in-law and sent to prison for a year. When he returns home, his mother-in-law continues to make his life difficult. Wang Hao's mother suffers in silence to protect her son.

2198977.title: Dragon Master of Ten Thousand Saints
2198977.description: Gu Changge, a retired frontline warrior, spent eight years traveling the world under a false identity. During this time, he trained many disciples including war gods, miracle doctors, the world's richest man, and prison wardens - all talents who helped the rise of Great Xia. He was honored with the title 'Dragon Master of Ten Thousand Saints'.

2199060.title: The Prince's Personal Female Assassin
2199060.description: Liu Xiangxiang travels back in time to ancient Chu Kingdom as a dying assassin. She has four chances to kill Prince Mu Chunshen, or she will die from poison. To complete her mission, she disguises herself as a maid, guard, and beggar boy in the prince's palace. But unexpected events always stop her at the last moment. While fighting wits with Mu Chunshen, she gradually discovers his kindness and responsibility, and slowly falls in love with him. Eventually, she realizes there's a hidden past behind this assassination mission.

2199168.title: I Am Not Teresa Teng
2199168.description: A female singer named Xiahou Xiaoxue comes to Beijing to pursue her singing career, but chooses to end her life by jumping from a building due to life pressures. Soon after, she discovers she has entered a cosmic time loop.

2199241.title: My Wife Has Magic Powers
2199241.description: Immortal Lord Wu Heng is punished and reborn in the body of a girl named Lin Sisi. She seeks revenge against those who hurt her, including her deceitful boyfriend Fu Yankuan and the women involved with him. As she settles old scores, she returns to Liu Qingyan, the man who truly loves her, to build a brighter future together.

2199292.title: My Beautiful CEO Boss
2199292.description: Yang Feng, young master of Tianmen, comes to Linjiang City to get married as ordered by his master. His fiancée Lin Ruotong is a cold and beautiful CEO who deliberately sets two impossible challenges for Yang Feng - complete them to get married, fail and leave. Yang Feng smiles and says: I'm determined to make you my wife!

2199529.title: My Wife Brings Too Much Luck
2199529.description: Liu Xuan uses a game called 'Lucky Husband Trading Game' to win over Li Mofei, the girl he's loved for three years. The system lets him give her daily tasks like bringing breakfast or going to hot springs. Each completed task increases his charm points and unlocks rewards like better looks and singing skills. As time goes on, Liu Xuan finds love and achieves great success in his career, even winning the Nobel Peace Prize. His story proves that his wife truly brings him incredible luck.

2199671.title: I'm the Big Brother in a Rich Family
2199671.description: A security guard accidentally saves a wealthy family's illegitimate son from assassins. To pay for his sister's surgery, he risks his life by pretending to be the rich heir and returns to the wealthy family. Right after coming back and attending a reunion with his fiancée, he meets his former college crush who mocks him. Watch how the security guard plays between truth and lies to become the powerful big brother of the rich family.

2199749.title: The Hidden Boss Security Guard
2199749.description: A powerful CEO hides his true identity and works as a security guard at his beloved woman's company. When colleagues target his girlfriend, he uses his real identity to fight back and turn the tables.

2199807.title: Hidden Dragon and Rising Phoenix
2199807.description: In the bustling corporate world, two men shine like hidden gems. Man A is quick-thinking and creative, like a treasure trove of ideas. He can quickly see through complex situations and come up with brilliant solutions - a true strategist. Man B appears simple and honest, often underestimated by others, but possesses iron-strong execution power. Once he sets his target, he pursues it like a fierce tiger, never giving up easily.

2199877.title: Unforgivable
2199877.description: Jiang Muxue's daughter suddenly falls ill and is hospitalized. When she returns home to get her bank card, she accidentally discovers a terrible gift from her husband - an affair. Looking at the scattered women's clothes on the floor, a business card, and hearing intimate sounds from the room, Jiang Muxue doesn't even have the courage to open the door and confront her husband.

2199980.title: The Peerless Son-in-Law
2199980.description: A man marries into a wealthy family but pretends to be foolish while secretly investigating hidden truths. Eventually, all secrets are revealed.

2200119.title: Your Majesty Above, I Below
2200119.description: During the Jing Dynasty, Xiao Yichen was killed by Jiang Shuyu after dealing with traitor Chen Zhuo. Xiao Yichen then travels through time to the modern era and discovers Jiang Shuyu and Chen Zhuo living in this time period.

2200196.title: Sweet Little Wife: Marriage First, Love Later
2200196.description: This drama tells the story of a young couple who face family opposition and schemes from rivals trying to separate them. When the heroine's mother is poisoned, she must choose between love and money to save her. Despite her sacrifice, her mother dies. Pregnant with the hero's child, she goes to Austria where she works hard and becomes a top international wedding dress designer. Six years later, she returns with her son. After many challenges, the loving couple finally reunites as a family with a happy ending.

2200260.title: Flash Marriage with a Tycoon on My Blind Date Day
2200260.description: Qiao Qiao meets Shang Bozhong during a trip. They help each other through difficulties and become close friends. When Shang Bozhong learns Qiao Qiao is single, he wants to introduce his friend Shang Lu to her. Due to harassment from her friend's husband Chen Jun, Qiao Qiao decides to have a flash marriage with Shang Lu. After marriage, she discovers that Shang Lu, whom she thought was a small business owner, is actually the CEO of ME Group, the top company in the city.
2200260.originName: 相亲当天和豪门大佬闪婚了

2200381.title: The Divine Healer
2200381.description: A young Taoist descends from the mountain for the first time. Though he doesn't use his powers, his body is 100 times stronger than ordinary people. A luxury car suddenly stops, and out steps a woman - his dream girl. She's desperately performing CPR on her unconscious mother, but nothing works. The young man approaches and warns her that continuing will cause her mother to vomit blood and die. The woman doesn't trust this stranger at first, but three seconds later, her mother actually coughs up blood and faints. Only then does she believe him and, with no other choice, lets him try to save her mother.

2200472.title: The Missing Mommy
2200472.description: After a night of betrayal, Luo Wanwan was betrayed by her best friend who stole her unborn child and threw her off a cliff. Five years later, Luo Wanwan returns with her son to find the child's father. A man claims to be the father, but why does Luo Wanwan feel no familiarity with him? Instead, she feels strange emotions toward his brother...

2200559.title: Blood Prison Storm

2200681.title: CEO Ye, Stop the Torture - Miss Gu Returns for Revenge
2200681.description: Five years ago, CEO Ye publicly broke off their engagement and sent Miss Gu to prison. On her release day, to save car accident victim Xue Luo, he forced Miss Gu to donate her kidney despite her heart condition. During surgery, her heart stopped and she was presumed dead. However, fate gave her a second chance. She returned with a new identity, carrying a five-year-old child, and married CEO Ye's older brother Gu Chenyan, becoming his beloved wife. When CEO Ye sees her again as a happy mother and wife, he is filled with deep regret.
2200681.originName: 叶总别虐了，顾小姐杀回来了

2200755.title: A Song Returns to the Entertainment World

2200836.title: The Divine Healer Returns to Dominate the City

2200976.title: The Movie Queen's Rebirth: Don't Run Away, Master Screenwriter

She was wrongly imprisoned for three years after being framed by her stepsister Wang Qiaoqiao. Her best friend Lin Ruoxi was severely injured saving her and has been in a coma for three years, needing a kidney transplant. Fate brings them together when Wen Yuchen learns Su Muxue's kidney matches Lin Ruoxi's. To escape an arranged marriage to the notorious Zhou Qiang, Su Muxue encounters the drunk Wen Yuchen, leading to unexpected romantic entanglement. Drawn to each other's strength and kindness, they decide to face future challenges together, overcoming family conflicts and life's hardships in this story of courage, perseverance, and love.

When she discovers that Fu Chuan caused both Lin Yuexi's death and Yuan Xin's injuries, she begins planning her revenge.

2201318.title: Oh No! I'm Surrounded by Goddesses

2211947.title: Saving the Villain After Transmigration
2211947.description: Dr. Yue Wuyou, a modern medical expert, accidentally transmigrates into an ancient romance novel she was reading. Instead of becoming the beloved female lead, she becomes a cannon fodder assassin. Upon arrival, she's ordered by Prince Shang Zhiyu to kill the novel's main villain - Ye Weichi, a fake eunuch. To survive, she poisons him but then remembers that according to the plot, this cannon fodder character fails repeatedly and dies tragically. To change her fate, Yue Wuyou decides to alter the story. When Ye Weichi finds her, he doesn't kill her but makes her his concubine. Prince Shang threatens her brother's life to force her to stay close to Ye Weichi and assassinate him again. Caught between protecting her brother and changing the plot, she maneuvers between both men. Gradually, Ye Weichi develops feelings for her. Just as they're about to find happiness together, the original female lead appears...

2212023.title: Horror? I Only Sell Haunted Houses
2212023.description:
“Thriller? I Only Sell Haunted Houses” follows Huiyu, a real estate agent whose career is on the rise—until a bizarre dispute over a “haunted house” plunges him into crisis. Once a rising star in the industry, Huiyu leveraged his sharp wit and stellar performance to achieve his modest goals of buying a car and a home within just two years. Yet a seemingly routine property transaction upends his life. After moving into the house he brokered, a young couple claims it’s haunted, demanding a full refund and compensation for emotional distress. Despite insisting the home is perfectly normal, Huiyu finds himself locked in a stubborn standoff with his clients—and as the investigation deepens, he begins to uncover a web far more intricate than he ever imagined.

Meanwhile, Huiyu’s company faces mounting pressure. To quell the scandal, his boss proposes that he spend two nights alone in the “haunted house” to prove it’s safe. The challenge not only tests Huiyu’s courage but forces him to confront his long‑held skepticism—and deepest fears—about the supernatural. Through those sleepless nights, he slowly unravels the secrets hidden within the walls, coming to suspect that there may be a darker, ulterior motive behind the entire affair.

At its core, the story revolves around the enigma of the “haunted house,” blending the clash between reality and the supernatural with a moral struggle between good and evil. Huiyu’s journey—from a self‑assured real estate broker to someone compelled to face his inner fears and the harsh truth—forms the narrative’s most compelling arc. And as for those outlandish “ghost” rumors: are they mere figments of the mind, or do they point to an unsolvable mystery? With its层层递进的 plot twists and pulse‑pounding atmosphere, the tale delivers a gripping, heart‑stopping thrill ride.

2212157.title: Love Apartment Strange Tales
2212157.description:
“Love Apartment Ghost Stories” follows a group of young people in the bustling metropolis of Shanghai who, in order to make ends meet, rent an apartment shrouded in mystery. The protagonist, Hui Yu, is a recent college graduate from out of town. Faced with sky-high rents and cutthroat competition, he and his close friend Zhang Pipi move into what seems like an ordinary yet deeply enigmatic dwelling. Pipi is cheerful and always cracking jokes, while Hui Yu is thoughtful and wary of the apartment’s many strange rules. Yet as they try to live by those rules, they discover that the place is far more unsettling than they ever imagined—from late-night radio broadcasts to shadowy figures glimpsed in the hallway, every detail exudes an air of foreboding.

At the heart of the story lies the conflict surrounding the apartment’s “Nine Rules,” which, though absurd on the surface, appear to wield an irresistible force. As Hui Yu, Pipi, and their two roommates, Zhang Qian and Xu Lin, delve deeper, they begin to suspect that the apartment may conceal a chilling secret. Meanwhile, the bonds between the four grow increasingly tenuous, tested again and again by harrowing events that push their friendship, trust, and even their very humanity to the breaking point.

Blending suspense with comedy, this short series plunges viewers into a world that feels both familiar and uncanny. It not only examines the struggles of urban youth in a high‑pressure environment but also uses one bizarre incident after another to lay bare the fears and desires lurking within the human psyche. With its tight pacing and relentless twists, it offers both laugh‑out‑loud moments and spine‑chilling scares—a work that is as entertaining as it is thought‑provoking.

2212213.title: The Non-existent Stairs
2212213.description:
“The Nonexistent Staircase” tells a family story steeped in suspense and horror. Two years ago, the protagonist Hui Yu’s older brother vanished without a trace. Then, on an ordinary night, Hui Yu receives a text from him: “Don’t go up the stairs at home.” This sudden warning leaves him both baffled and uneasy. His house is only one story; there are no stairs—yet when his phone buzzes again with another urgent message, a pitch-black rosewood staircase materializes out of thin air, leading straight into an unfathomable darkness. Even more chilling, at the top lies a room that is an exact replica of his own home, down to the half-eaten apple still sitting on the dining table.

As Hui Yu digs deeper, he discovers that the staircase seems to connect to a warped, alternate reality. And just as he begins to piece together the truth, his parents grow eerily strange: his mother’s hands turn inside out, her nails sharpened like blades; his father wields a rust‑speckled cleaver, as if ready to strike at any moment. It becomes clear to Hui Yu that he has stepped into some kind of supernatural illusion, and that the real danger may be lurking behind that “nonexistent staircase.”

The story unfolds around the mystery of his brother’s disappearance, unraveling the fractures and secrets within the family to draw viewers into a terrifying world that feels both familiar and alien. Hui Yu must confront not only the unknown threats hidden on the staircase but also the fears and struggles deep within himself. With its distinctive narrative style and suffocating tension, this short drama explores the blurred lines between亲情、记忆与现实, offering audiences a gripping psychological thriller.

2212339.title: Sleepless Reaper
2212339.description:
“Sleepless Reaper” is a suspenseful, thriller‑style short series that follows a family as it gradually crumbles amid a tangled web of accidents and hidden truths. The protagonist, Xiao Qing, is an ordinary college student who finds herself drawn into a life‑and‑death mystery after a sudden car crash. Her parents were killed in an accident while on their way to pick her up, but when she returns home, she discovers that the situation is far more complicated than she imagined: not only is the front door locked and impossible to enter, but her own older brother has grown unnervingly distant, even warning her not to open the door to strangers. Even more shocking, he claims their parents are already dead, and those who insist they are “Mom and Dad” are actually “Reapers” disguised as loved ones, here to take her away.

As the story unfolds, Xiao Qing begins to realize that everything may be connected to her brother’s ability to foresee the future. It turns out he had once witnessed this tragedy firsthand and tried to alter fate, yet ultimately failed to prevent the disaster. Now, he must not only protect his sister from the “Reapers” but also confront the guilt and inner turmoil that weigh heavily on him. Meanwhile, Xiao Qing starts to wonder whether her brother can truly be trusted, and the mysterious voices that blur the line between reality and illusion plunge her into endless fear.

At its core, the narrative revolves around family bonds, trust, and the clash between life and death, with a plot brimming with twists that keep viewers on the edge of their seats. Beyond its gripping horror elements, the series delves deeply into the fragility and resilience of human nature, as well as the choices and courage we summon in the face of the unknown. Is fate truly inevitable, or can humanity ultimately shape its own destiny? All the answers lie hidden within this heart‑pounding “sleepless night.”

2212452.title: The Neighbor Who Provides Memorial Portraits
2212452.description:
“The Female Neighbor Who Offers a Mourning Portrait” tells the strange tale that unfolds between Bai Xiaotian, a young single mother, and her neighbor. Bai Xiaotian moves into a new home with her daughter; she is strikingly beautiful, and her decor exudes an ethnic flair. Most notably, a bull’s skull hangs in the living room alongside a black-and-white mourning portrait on the wall, lending the space an air of eerie mystery. The male protagonist happens to help her carry a piano one day and gradually develops feelings for her. Yet as their relationship deepens, Bai Xiaotian repeatedly displays behavior that defies explanation: she not only claims to be the double of her deceased twin sister but also frequently broaches themes of “death” and “memorial rites,” even going so far as to hang her own pre‑death photographs on the wall as if they were mourning portraits. All of this leaves the protagonist both baffled and captivated.

As time passes, their interactions grow increasingly subtle—ranging from playful banter to intimate encounters late at night—leading one to believe they are on the verge of a romantic conclusion. However, just when the plot seems to clear, Bai Xiaotian invariably shrouds it in fresh enigmas, whether by producing another black‑and‑white mourning portrait or uttering a remark about “death.” What secrets does her past hold? Why does she assume the role of a soul long gone? And can the male protagonist unravel the truth within this labyrinthine emotional game?

With its blend of suspense and emotion, this short drama explores the intricate interplay among life and death, identity, and desire, delivering a tightly woven narrative rich in twists and ripe for reflection. Bai Xiaotian’s mysterious allure and the male protagonist’s agonizing choices together form the heart of this work.

2212690.title: Strange Family
2212690.description:
“The Sinister Family” tells the story of a seemingly ordinary three-person household that harbors deadly secrets.
