The protagonist, Xiaoyu, is a sensitive and kind-hearted girl who lives in a home steeped in violence and indifference: her father is a cold‑blooded serial killer, her mother a paranoid, “sickly sweet” woman driven to madness, and her older brother a taciturn, wildly erratic figure. Within this family, Xiaoyu stands like a solitary white blossom, striving to preserve her conscience and humanity. Yet, as her father’s brutal murders mount and her mother fixates on all things “imperfect,” Xiaoyu begins to suspect that she may not be their true child after all.

At the heart of the narrative lies Xiaoyu’s desperate bid to escape this warped family. On one hand, she must confront the ever‑present threat posed by her parents; on the other, classmates who once tormented her plot to break into her home and expose the secrets she has kept hidden. Under this dual pressure, Xiaoyu must not only protect herself but also confront the chilling truths that bind her family together. As the story unfolds, the audience is drawn deeper into the dark mysteries lurking behind this household—and into the shocking enigma of Xiaoyu’s own identity. Blending suspense with spine‑tingling terror, the series explores the complex interplay of kinship, human nature, and survival, leaving viewers both pondering and riveted.

2212828.title: The Supporting Girl's Counterattack
2212828.description:
“Attack of the Female Supporting Role” tells a tale of rise and redemption. The female protagonist, Xiao Yu, was once a “white‑lotus” in the modern world, but after her mission fails, she is forced to remain in a fictional universe, where she becomes the second‑lead heroine—vulnerable and constantly bullied. Her task is to win 100 percent of the domineering CEO, Huo Jing’s, favor so she can escape this world. Yet his coldness and controlling nature drive her to the brink. In an unexpected turn, Xiao Yu finally sees through Huo Jing’s true face: outwardly gentle and considerate, he is in fact selfish and self‑centered, even treating her as a vessel for venting his frustrations.

As the plot unfolds, Xiao Yu resolves to stop playing the role of a defenseless “white lotus.” Drawing on her wit and composure, she gradually strips away Huo Jing’s hypocritical facade and ultimately takes control of the situation. Along the way, she realizes that she is no longer the weak, helpless girl she once was; she has become an independent woman who dares to resist and seeks freedom. At the heart of the story lies the conflict of how Xiao Yu breaks free from Huo Jing’s grip, alongside the intricate emotional entanglements between them. The series blends suspenseful twists with a profound exploration of human nature and emotion, offering viewers a journey of逆袭 filled with unexpected turns and surprises.

2212898.title: Horror Scream (Season 1)
2212898.description:
“Screams of Terror” is a short drama steeped in suspense and tension, following a group of college students who, during their holiday break, are plunged into fear and faced with difficult choices by a bizarre murder case. The story centers on the protagonist, an ordinary student who, unable to ignore the disturbing noises coming from the next-door dorm room, ventures to remind them in the group chat. To his horror, they reply with a chilling photograph: a woman beheaded, her blood streaming down. This image unsettles him, leaving him to wonder whether he has truly witnessed a murder. Meanwhile, another classmate confides in him via WeChat that the woman in the photo was indeed killed—but if they report it, not only will the killer go unpunished, but he himself could face disciplinary action for staying on campus illegally. Caught between morality and reality, the protagonist is torn apart by doubt.

Just as he hesitates, the man from Room 303 sends another video, attempting to prove his innocence. Yet the details within reveal the truth: the woman had already been dead, and the killer was staging the scene to evade capture. As the protagonist resolves to call the police, a knock at the door interrupts him. A voice claiming to be the woman from Room 303 begs for forgiveness and leaves behind a “gesture of reconciliation.” Through the peephole, the protagonist is stunned to see that the “dead woman” is still very much alive! This sudden twist brings him a moment of relief—yet it also deepens his confusion: was all this mere coincidence, or a meticulously crafted deception by the murderer?

As the plot unfolds, the protagonist begins to uncover a far‑reaching conspiracy hidden beneath what seemed like a simple dorm dispute. And those classmates who appeared so close may not be as trustworthy as they seemed. Caught between fear and the truth, he must make a choice—one that will alter the fates of everyone involved. With its tightly woven narrative and layer upon layer o

2213033.title: Love Guide (Season 1)
2213033.description:
“The Love Handbook” tells the story of Hu Yu, an ordinary college student, and the emotional ups and downs and personal growth he experiences during his university years. A sophomore at Jiangcheng University, Hu Yu is handsome and academically outstanding, yet his family’s poverty forces him to work weekends at the TIKO cake shop to earn living expenses. His campus life had been running like clockwork: studying, holding down a part-time job, and winning scholarships—everything in perfect order. However, with the start of the new semester, his frequent interactions with Liu Ming, the department’s belle, gradually shattered that calm. An accidental encounter in the self-study room led Hu Yu to fall into the illusion that “she likes me,” and Liu Ming’s seemingly intimate gestures only fueled his fantasies. At the same time, Hu Yu unwittingly overheard a conversation between Liu Ming and her close friend, Liu Ying, which revealed Liu Ming’s true motive for getting close to him—to exploit his naivety for personal gain. This discovery left Hu Yu deeply disheartened, but it also prompted him to take a hard look at his own emotional state.

Just as Hu Yu was feeling low, a mysterious tool called the “Love Simulation System” quietly appeared before him. Through this system, he could select any member of the opposite sex for a virtual romantic simulation and receive corresponding emotional feedback and rewards based on his choices. Yet, as the number of simulations increased, Hu Yu gradually realized that genuine love cannot be easily attained through tricks or manipulation; it requires sincerity and courage to face and nurture. Meanwhile, another coworker at the cake shop, Lin Churou, also caught Hu Yu’s attention. Pragmatic and thoughtful, Lin shares a similar outlook on life as Hu Yu, but her presence only leaves him more uncertain: is she, too, just a “target” within the system?

The story centers on Hu Yu’s inner turmoil, portraying the confusion and growth of contempora

2213098.title: We Who Fight to Survive
2213098.description:
“We Who Made It Through” is a heartwarming and humorous urban romantic short series that follows the protagonist, Xiaoxue, as she navigates a series of unexpected twists and touching moments in her everyday life. Xiaoxue is a kind and sensitive girl whose relationship with her best friend, Xiaonao, is both close and subtly complex. One late night, on a whim, Xiaonao concocts a “fake crisis” inspired by horror movies, leading Xiaoxue to believe she’s in danger—so much so that it even alerts the police. Faced with Xiaonao’s prank, Xiaoxue is at once angry and resigned, yet in the end, it’s through their playful banter that she comes to appreciate the true value of their friendship.

Meanwhile, Xiaoxue’s boyfriend, Zeng Xin, notices something amiss with her. Their shared commitment to honesty compels Xiaoxue to explain what happened. But when Zeng Xin uncovers hidden clues in Xiaonao’s messages through their chat logs, he敏锐ly points out that this may not be a simple joke after all—it could be Xiaonao’s way of expressing her feelings. As the truth slowly emerges, Xiaoxue realizes that the bonds she shares with her best friend and her boyfriend are quietly undergoing subtle shifts.

With a light, humorous touch, the series explores modern city dwellers’ reflections on friendship, love, and self-worth. It delves into the trust and misunderstandings that can arise between people, and through its delicate portrayal of emotions, it highlights the importance of staying genuine and understanding in complex relationships. The story’s appeal lies in how Xiaonao’s seemingly absurd antics conceal a deep yearning for friendship, while Xiaoxue, in handling these unexpected events, finds herself reexamining her own emotional world. The entire drama offers both laughter and heartfelt moments, leaving viewers with a sense of life’s warmth and resilience.

2213237.title: Girls' Dorm Rules
2213237.description:
“Rules of the Girls’ Dorm” is a suspense‑filled, chilling short series that follows a group of female students as they engage in a life‑and‑death struggle within a mysterious six‑bedroom dormitory. The story revolves around a set of eerie “dormitory rules”: keep the room clean, don’t turn on the lights at night unless necessary, and never look up in the bathroom… Each rule seems simple, yet harbors deadly dangers. Even more unsettling, these rules appear to be bound by an irresistible fate—violate them, and cruel death awaits.

The protagonist, Huiyu, gradually realizes that she has only three lives to spare, and each failure will cost her one of them. As the plot unfolds, she must contend not only with the conflicts and suspicions among her roommates but also with sudden attacks from “inspectors” wearing animal masks. Yet the true crisis runs far deeper: the dorm’s power system seems to be controlled by some unseen force, with late‑night blackouts, broken rules, and even attempts by outsiders to break in and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness.

Throughout the series, the girls, each with her own distinct personality, waver between fear and trust, their delicate relationships heating up with every passing moment. As the central figure, Huiyu grows stronger with each harrowing ordeal, striving to unravel the truth behind the rules. But just when she begins to piece things together, even greater mysteries emerge. Who has orchestrated this deadly game? And why did they choose her and her roommates above all others?

With its tight pacing and layer upon layer of suspense, “Rules of the Girls’ Dorm” draws viewers into a校园 world that feels both familiar and strange. It explores the struggles and choices of human nature in extreme circumstances, while using meticulous details to reveal the vulnerability and resilience of young women facing an unknown threat. This is a battle of survival and courage, and also a tragic ballad of friendship and betrayal.

2213329.title: The Knocker
2213329.description:
“The Door-Knocker” is a suspenseful short thriller that follows a woman living alone as she confronts a series of bizarre and terrifying events late at night. The protagonist, Hui Yu, is an ordinary office worker who, one fateful midnight, hears a strange flushing sound coming from the bathroom—though she had locked the door and was certain she was home alone. As the eerie noises draw closer, her fear escalates, and she even begins to hear an unfamiliar song outside her door. What’s even more unsettling is that the voice seems to belong not to a human, but to some supernatural entity. Faced with this mounting, nightmarish threat, Hui Yu must scramble for survival in sheer panic while waiting for help to arrive.

Yet when her friend Yu Ge rushes to her side with others, she finds herself in a cruel dilemma: opening the door to let them in means confronting the unknown menace lurking just beyond; staying hidden could mean never seeing rescue at all. In the end, summoning every ounce of courage, Hui Yu cracks open the door—only to discover that the truth is far more complex and dangerous than she ever imagined. With its taut, gripping plot and spine‑chilling atmosphere, this short drama explores the struggle and choices of human nature in the face of despair, leaving audiences with profound reflections on truth and fear.

2213389.title: Ghost Baby
2213389.description:
“Ghostly Baby” tells the tale of a group of university students who encounter a series of bizarre events in their dormitory lives. The protagonist, Zheng Qianfei, is an outgoing girl who one day dreams of a mysterious phone number. At the “reminder” of her roommate, Huo Qing, she adds the number as a WeChat friend. Excited to chat online with this “dream lover,” she soon discovers that he seems to be hiding a secret no one knows. Meanwhile, Huo Qing, a reclusive and perpetually gloomy roommate, repeatedly hints that Zheng Qianfei’s boyfriend is not alive—going so far as to call him a “dead man.” Her words leave Zheng Qianfei both angry and baffled, but as their interactions deepen, Zheng begins to notice strange anomalies about her boyfriend: he never makes voice or video calls, and even his photos are eerily blurred. Even more unsettling, Huo Qing appears to know every detail, as if she has long since seen through the truth.

As the plot unfolds, Zheng Qianfei’s friend Lin Anran and others become entangled in the mystery. While they try to comfort Zheng, they are shaken by Huo Qing’s remarks. She not only casts doubt on Zheng’s relationship but also keeps bringing up taboo subjects like “death” and “ghosts,” turning the dorm into an atmosphere of tension and dread. Just when everyone thinks it’s all nonsense, unexplained phenomena begin to surface: late-night knocking at the door, reflections in the mirror, and eerie messages from her boyfriend… All of this forces Zheng to reassess her situation and, in turn, uncovers the truth behind Huo Qing.

At its core, the story revolves around the boundary between reality and the supernatural. Through nuanced psychological portrayals and a suspenseful narrative, it explores fear, prejudice, and trust within human nature. Audiences will follow Zheng Qianfei step by step as she unravels the mystery and confronts the secrets lurking in the darkness. This drama is not only a thrilling suspense tale but also a mirror reflecting t

2213446.title: Call Through Time
2213446.description: “Time-Traveling Call” tells the story of a life-and-death pact that spans time. Late one night, the female protagonist, Xiaoyu, receives a call from the future. The caller claims to be her husband, Lu He, and warns her that she will fall to her death from a building in four hours. Yet when she turns to look at Lu He sleeping beside her, he appears unharmed, his phone even charging. This eerie call plunges Xiaoyu into confusion and fear. As the conversation unfolds, she begins to realize that the truth is far more complex than she imagined—Lu He mentions that he will attend her funeral a week later, where the police have ruled her death an accidental fall. Meanwhile, Xiaoyu’s close friend, Xu Qing, also calls with equally shocking news: she suspects Lu He has orchestrated a murder plot against Xiaoyu. Faced with this sudden double threat, Xiaoyu must unravel the truth within a narrow window of time while protecting herself and those around her. The story centers on an accident at a secluded mountain villa, its层层 twists drawing viewers into a world brimming with suspense and emotional entanglements. Can Xiaoyu escape this deadly conspiracy? And what are Lu He and Xu Qing’s true motives? All the answers lie hidden within this thrilling “Time-Traveling Call.”

2213544.title: WeChat Horror
2213544.description:
“Terror on WeChat” is a suspenseful short drama that follows a university student as he experiences a series of bizarre events in his dormitory. Driven by resentment over his roommate Sanmao’s long‑standing bullying, the protagonist, in a cruel prank, sends a message to his own WeChat account: “Let Sanmao die.” To his shock, the message receives a reply—and from an account that looks exactly like his own! Even more unsettling, the sender not only seems to know his innermost thoughts but also accurately predicts Sanmao’s sudden death. As the story unfolds, the protagonist begins to realize that this WeChat account, which calls itself his “future self,” may indeed come from another timeline, even warning him that his next target is another roommate, Xiaolin.

However, when Xiaolin meets with tragedy just as foretold, the protagonist starts to question the mysterious account’s true identity—is it really himself from the future, or the killer lurking within the dorm? Meanwhile, the police investigation hits a dead end, and the dorm’s security flaws are laid bare. Just as the protagonist tries to save himself and escape the crisis, he receives a text message from the deceased roommate, Xiaolin, shattering his certainties. What is the truth? Is it the cyclical nature of fate, or the dark depths of human nature at play? With its tense, gripping plot and escalating layers of suspense, this short drama invites viewers to confront the boundaries of the unknown and the fear that lies beyond.

2213634.title: Tales of Fake People
2213634.description:
“Tales of the Imposters” tells a chilling story of a seemingly peaceful city suddenly invaded by extraterrestrial beings. The protagonist, Lin Xiaoyu, is an ordinary urban white‑collar worker who one day receives a mysterious text message from “10086,” accompanied by a survival guide titled the Alien Response Manual. The manual meticulously details how to identify and deal with alien creatures disguised as humans—ranging from “juveniles” to “adults,” each harboring a deadly threat. At first, Lin Xiaoyu dismisses it as a prank, but when she spots through her telescope that the “elderly” in her neighborhood exhibit bizarre physical traits, she has no choice but to believe it’s all real.

Meanwhile, her best friend, Xu Yuan, calls in a panic, warning that the situation has spiraled out of control and hinting she’s in grave danger. Before she can finish, the line goes dead, leaving only the sound of gunfire and the jarring click of a gun being cocked. Lin Xiaoyu realizes this crisis is far more complex and terrifying than she ever imagined. Left utterly alone, she must rely on the rules in the manual to carve out a chance of survival in a hostile environment. Yet, as she begins to suspect that even those around her may not be entirely trustworthy, fear and suspicion start to erode her sanity.

At its core, the story revolves around a life‑and‑death struggle between humanity and alien invaders, as well as the fragile web of trust among the survivors. Lin Xiaoyu must confront not only the menace of the alien monsters but also navigate a maelstrom of uncertainty, discerning who is a true ally and who might be a hidden enemy. As the plot unfolds, she will gradually uncover the truth behind the alien invasion while confronting her own fears and the choices they force upon her. With a tight pace and an air of suspense, this short series plunges viewers into a world where reality and deception blur, and danger lurks at every turn, exploring the struggles and transformations of

2213750.title: The System Crashed, I Became the System (Season 1)
2213750.description:
In an unexpected accident, the ordinary young man Xu Yu narrowly avoids being struck by a shoe that falls from the sky—only to find himself swept up in a bizarre chain of events. Even more unforeseen: a mysterious entity known as the “Multidimensional Shuttle System” suddenly appears, attempting to forcibly bind him as its host. Yet with wit and tenacity, Xu Yu resists the system’s control and, in a fit of rage, causes it to self‑destruct. To everyone’s astonishment, after the system collapses, it is absorbed by Xu Yu, transforming him into its master.

Embracing his new identity and newfound powers, Xu Yu discovers he can traverse countless worlds and craft—or manipulate—their very laws. But the system’s initial functions are far from complete; many core modules remain blank. To fill these gaps, he resolves to build his own knowledge base, gradually unlocking the system’s full potential. At the same time, he must confront threats from all sides: remnants of former hosts once enslaved by the system, as well as martial artists who covet its power. Through one perilous adventure after another, Xu Yu not only seeks to unravel the system’s secrets but also to forge his own path, using his wisdom and courage to carve out a legendary life.

2213801.title: Spirit Academy
2213801.description:
“The Academy of Strange Spirits” is a campus fantasy series brimming with suspense and thrills. The story centers on a group of university students who, expecting nothing more than a carefree evening‑class life, find themselves unexpectedly drawn into a sinister game of cryptic rules. One morning, a mysterious WeChat message from a senior student shatters their peace: “Don’t attend the morning class, or you’ll die.” Yet just as suddenly, the academic advisor announces that all courses have been moved to the evening—though the official timetable still lists morning sessions. Faced with this contradiction, the protagonists are plunged into deep unease.

As the plot unfolds, they begin to uncover a brutal “world of rules” hidden behind the facade of an ordinary college. Blood stains the classrooms, classmates vanish in bizarre deaths, and those who dare defy the rules meet an even darker fate. Even more chilling, there is no such thing as a “laboratory building,” and the appearance of a red‑clad female teacher signals an even greater crisis. In one life‑and‑death decision after another, the protagonists must not only unravel these absurd yet deadly regulations but also confront their inner fears and the struggles of human nature.

Throughout the series, characters of distinct personalities step forward: the calm and rational Chen Yanci, the impulsive and reckless Fu Wen, and the studious Gu Zihan. Trapped in a desperate situation, they lean on one another while harboring secret doubts. As the truth slowly comes to light, they are forced to ask themselves: Should they obey the rules and cling to a meager existence, or risk defying them in search of a way out? And what sinister plots and long‑buried secrets lie at the heart of it all?

With its tight pacing and layer upon layer of mounting suspense, “The Academy of Strange Spirits” ushers viewers into a world that feels both familiar and uncanny, exploring profound questions about freedom and constraint, humanity and des

2213948.title: The Library You Can't Escape
2213948.description:
“Beyond the Library” tells the story of an ordinary female college student who encounters a deadly crisis on her way back to campus for winter break. The narrative begins with what seems like a routine request to add someone on WeChat, yet it harbors a grave danger. Faced with a man whose gentle exterior masks a twisted mind, she tries to protect herself by refusing—but inadvertently sets off a “prophecy” hidden in the comment section: eerie posts about a series of murders at S University’s library, as if warning her that refusal will only invite death. To save herself, she is forced to comply, even going so far as to actively cater to his demands, yet in the end she still cannot escape her fate.

Yet when she wakes up again, she finds that time has seemingly returned to the moment just before the tragedy unfolded. This time, will she be able to break the cycle of fate? Will she continue to succumb to fear, or bravely confront the truth? As the layers of the case are peeled back, she gradually realizes that the real culprit is not the apparent assailant, but the cold indifference and prejudice of a society that unjustly blames its victims. This short drama is not only a thrilling game of survival, but also a profound exploration of the complex interplay between gender-based violence, public opinion, and self‑redemption, leaving viewers deeply reflective.

2214086.title: Forced marriage? Start by marrying three noble ladies.
2214086.description: Forced marriage? Start by marrying three noble ladies.
2214086.originName: 强制配婚？开局迎娶三位贵女

2214136.title: Madam Is Wild Again
2214136.description: After returning to his homeland, Mu Jinchen inherits his father's vast fortune. Pressured by his clan and stepmother Liang Yin who covet his wealth, Mu Jinchen decides to pretend to be in a vegetative state to make his greedy relatives helpless. By chance, Liang Yin meets Li Qiongqiong at a restaurant and discovers her sharp wit and capability. She then hires Li Qiongqiong as her spy to watch over Mu Jinchen and investigate whether he is truly in a vegetative state.

2214238.title: Pride of the World
2214238.description: Zhang Dongcheng abandons his Dragon Lord identity and lives in hiding with the Shen family for five years, secretly helping them rise to greatness. However, the Shen family sees him as a useless freeloader, and Shen Wanting demands a divorce. Unable to endure anymore, Zhang Dongcheng reveals his true identity at the Shen family's promotion ceremony, crushing three major families and making all the powerful elites lose face. He returns to Dragon Hidden for his childhood friend Miss Song to attend a financing conference, where Lei Xiong's son from the Literary Hall plots against him, but Zhang Dongcheng defeats him. Lei Xiong, seeking power, falsely accuses Zhang Dongcheng of impersonating the Great Xia Dragon Lord. Zhang Dongcheng resolves all conspiracies and finally protects Great Xia's peace.

2214336.title: The Arrogant Driver
2214336.description: Chen Mo, a former special forces soldier who became a designated driver to escape his bloody past, gets caught up in a conspiracy when he picks up drunk heiress Su Wanwan. After being set up in a scandal, he finds himself involved in corporate warfare and family feuds. As he protects Su Wanwan and uncovers the truth, their relationship evolves from suspicion to love, while greater dangers lurk ahead.

2214464.title: Cute Babies Strike, Husband Spoils Me to the Bone
2214464.description: Bai Qian, the eldest daughter of Bai Group, accidentally discovers her fiancé Zhou Shengjing cheating with her half-sister Bai Yurou, and learns that her parents were killed by Bai Yurou to steal the family fortune. When Bai Qian tries to escape and call the police, she is intercepted by her fiancé's men who plan to sell her to an old man in the mountains. At the critical moment, she is rescued by Fu Youshen, CEO of Fu Group. On her parents' burial day, she marries Fu Youshen in a flash marriage to repay his life-saving grace. He disappears the day after their wedding, but Bai Qian discovers she is pregnant and gives birth to quintuplets a year later. Nine years later, the five cute babies search for their father on their own, leading to Fu Youshen and Bai Qian's reunion...
2214464.originName: 宝贝来袭，老公宠她入骨

2214546.title: Hidden Dragon
2214546.description: Steam blurred Lin Yang's vision as he rushed from the bathhouse where he worked, still with water drops under his fingernails, hurriedly putting on a borrowed old suit to attend his father-in-law's birthday banquet. Crystal chandeliers lit the banquet hall like daylight. He stood awkwardly in the corner, watching his wife Su Qing elegantly mingle with guests like a butterfly ready to take flight.  "Xiao Yang, come here," his father-in-law Su Zhengrong said, holding red wine and looking down at him condescendingly. "In three days, I'm signing a 10-billion contract with the Lu family. Qingqing being with you will affect our cooperation." The guests' gazes felt like daggers in his back. Su Qing's face turned pale, but she dared not contradict her father. Lin Yang clenched his fists, bitterness rising in his throat. To gather money for his mother's surgery, he had given up his identity as the Ye family heir, working anonymously as a bathhouse attendant, only to have his dignity trampled in the most humiliating way.  Late at night, Lin Yang sat alone in the hospital corridor when his phone suddenly vibrated. An unknown number displayed a trembling voice: "Young Master, the family head is critically ill. The Ye family needs you!" Buried memories flooded back like a tide. He remembered he was originally the heir to the powerful Ye family business empire, but was forced to flee due to a conspiracy.  When Lin Yang appeared before Su Zhengrong again, he was impeccably dressed and commanding. Su Zhengrong was shocked to discover that the "mysterious new leader of Lu Group" he was supposed to sign with in three days was actually the bathhouse son-in-law he had humiliated. "Mr. Su, do you still want to sign this 10-billion contract?" Lin Yang smiled coldly, with the Ye family's elite team behind him. Su Qing looked at this familiar yet strange man before her, tears streaming down her face. This drama caused by money and prejudice was about to have an unexpected reversal.

2214695.title: Birth of a Scandal
2214695.description: Fu Yuan enters the Yin family home and sees familiar surroundings that bring back memories of how she and her mother were humiliated by Yin Huai years ago. Fu Yuan stands before Yin Huai and Yin Jiarou, introducing herself as applying for the violin teacher position.

2214782.title: The Divine Son-in-Law
2214782.description: Qi Ruofeng, a gifted healer with supernatural vision, marries into the Chu family to fulfill his master's dying wish. From being treated like a servant to proving his extraordinary abilities, he wins over the entire Chu family and completes all his inherited missions.

2214903.title: Super Dad in the City
2214903.description: Ye Zhengyang, the master of Dragon Emperor Palace, helps the female lead Yun Hanyue defeat the Dark Sky Demon Lord in a fierce battle in the northern territory. After this legendary victory, he is immediately promoted to One-Star Commander. When Yun Hanyue awakens, she mistakenly believes it was Young Master Zhao who helped her defeat the enemy. Zhao takes credit for the victory and uses this opportunity to get closer to Yun Hanyue. At the award ceremony, Ye Zhengyang reveals his true power domain.

2214980.title: Mr. Fu, Your Wife Is on the Railway Tracks
2214980.description: After marrying Fu Shenxing, the eldest son of the Fu family, Lin Nianchu's life becomes miserable as her husband wrongly believes she is connected to his sister's death. When diagnosed with stomach cancer, Lin Nianchu decides to end her life on railway tracks. However, Fu Shenxing won't let her die, forcing her to live and atone for her supposed sins. He makes her serve as a blood donor for his childhood sweetheart and destroys her father's business. Little do they know, their conflict stems from a misunderstanding. As they hurt each other while secretly investigating the truth, they begin to realize their mistakes - but is it too late?

2215121.title: The Scheming Boss's Master Plan
2215121.description: When the Jiang family suddenly goes bankrupt, Jiang Ning attends a mysterious dinner party but dies in a car accident that same night. She is reborn two weeks before her death. As her greatest enemy, Jiang Ning can't help but blame the mysterious person for her death. She plans to save herself, but ends up being killed again. This time, she drags Shen Cheng into the time loop with her. Through this series of events, she uncovers the mystery and finally finds the real killer.

2215227.title: CEO Gu's Secret Criminal Wife
2215227.description: On her wedding day to Gu Hanlin, Chu Yunxi is falsely accused that her child is not his. After a car accident leaves her in a coma, she wakes up determined to seek revenge.

2215334.title: Cans for a Plane
2215334.description: "Cans for a Plane" is an urban drama filled with suspense and emotional entanglement, telling a story of power schemes and revenge. The protagonist, Qin Xiao, was once a notorious underworld kingpin in Jianghai City, but now finds himself pushed to the brink by a sudden crisis. Twenty years ago, he dominated the region with an iron fist, drove his old rival Lin Hao into a corner, and forced Lin Hao's sister, Lin Wanqing, to be his wife. Yet this marriage was steeped in hatred and resentment from the very beginning. Lin Wanqing never truly loved Qin Xiao; her heart held only bitterness toward him and loyalty to her family. The turning point comes when Qin Xiao's family faces utter ruin. Lin Hao returns with the fire of revenge, threatening not only to strip Qin Xiao of everything he has but also to take his life. Facing the brother who once stood by his side, Qin Xiao is forced to re-examine his past as memories of ruthless decisions and inner struggles resurface. Meanwhile, Lin Wanqing fights to survive in the narrow space between, torn between protecting herself and her family while unable to escape her complicated emotional bond with Qin Xiao. Throughout the show, the rivalry between Qin Xiao and Lin Hao drives the story forward, while Qin Xiao's moral reckoning and Lin Wanqing's quiet resistance add deeper layers to the plot. As the truth gradually comes to light, viewers will witness a moving tale of power, love, and redemption. With intense fight scenes as well as profound reflections on human nature, the series keeps audiences captivated from start to finish.

2215391.title: Dark Lotus: Phoenix Rules the World
2215391.description: Princess Lu Wanqing of the Western Regions was originally a princess of the Snow Kingdom. After the Snow Kingdom was destroyed by the Northern Kingdom and her elder brother was killed, she was adopted by the King of the Western Regions. Later, due to the Western King's ambition and conspiracy with Northern officials, she was offered as a concubine to the disabled and cruel Northern Prince. Though the world calls them a perfect match, beneath her wedding veil she smiles calmly while her heart turns cold as ice. After entering the palace, Lu Wanqing faces constant schemes from the main wife and other concubines. She thought her path of revenge would be full of danger and conspiracy, but later discovers that the real killer of her brother is someone else entirely.

2215494.title: Golden Divine Eyes
2215494.description: Chen Ze, the patriarch of the Chen family from the Old Nine Gates, accidentally unlocks his divine eye bloodline, allowing him to easily appraise the value of antiques and treasures. The eldest daughter of the Wu family seeks Chen Ze's help to collect nine treasures for the Nine Gates Governor. During this process, they meet and fall in love.

2215587.title: Back to 1994
2215587.description: Zhang Caiying confronts her gambling son-in-law Feng Yang at his home to stop his divorce from her daughter Sun Xiaoxiao. When refused, she stabs him with a dagger... Feng Yang doesn't die but travels back to 1994. Believing he knows the future, he's determined to reach the peak of success! He saves his friend Wang Shuai from a beating and learns that con man Liu Jian is pretending to be a rich businessman to marry Sun Xiaoxiao. Feng Yang exposes Liu Jian's scheme to protect Sun Xiaoxiao. He partners with Zhang Xiyan and Wang Shuai in the pager business, but Liu Jian sabotages them. Using his future knowledge, Feng Yang fixes a rare audio system for the richest man in Yongnan City, then bets on the World Cup final in Macau to earn his first fortune and eventually becomes the city's wealthiest man. Zhang Caiying and her lover Ning Laicai steal all of Feng Yang's properties through fraud. Feng Yang sets a trap to expose them and punish Ning Laicai. Using DNA testing, Feng Yang discovers Zhang Caiying and Sun Xiaoxiao aren't related - Sun Xiaoxiao was kidnapped by Zhang Caiying and Peng Guochang. Meanwhile, Sun Xiaoxiao's real father dies abroad, leaving her a huge inheritance and family mansion. Zhang Caiying tries to kill Sun Xiaoxiao for the money, but Feng Yang stops her and brings Zhang Caiying and Peng Guochang to justice. After clearing up all misunderstandings, Feng Yang and Sun Xiaoxiao finally get together.

2215649.title: Back to Ancient Times as a Prince Consort
2215649.description: In the modern world, Jack is an experienced and skilled mercenary. During a mission, he accidentally triggers a mysterious force and travels through time to an ancient dynasty. Upon arrival, he finds himself in chaos. At that moment, the palace is in turmoil as the Queen is attacked by assassins and her life is in danger. In the confusion, Jack uses his modern combat skills and sharp instincts to quickly subdue the assassins and save the dying Queen. His brave performance shocks everyone present, and the grateful Emperor immediately decides to reward him generously. Princess Emily is beautiful and intelligent. After hearing about Jack's heroic deeds, she becomes curious about this man from another world. Through their interactions, the two gradually fall in love. The Emperor notices his daughter's feelings and intends to marry the Princess to Jack. Thus, Jack transforms into a Prince Consort. However, life as a Prince Consort is not smooth sailing. In the palace, undercurrents flow as various factions are suspicious of this suddenly appeared Prince Consort. But Jack relies on the wisdom and courage he developed in modern society to resolve crises time and again. He and the Princess work together to face political struggles in this ancient dynasty, protecting their love and hard-won happiness, writing a legendary tale that transcends time and space.

2215710.title: After Marriage, My Nightclub Owner Husband's Secrets Are Exposed
2215710.description: This is a story about Ye Anzhi's rebirth and revenge. Ye Anzhi becomes a vegetative patient due to betrayal by her fiancé and best friend, but unexpectedly travels through time and is reborn. She is determined to expose the scumbag's true face and find her real fiancé Jiang Yubai. On her path of revenge, her feelings with Jiang Yuzi gradually heat up, but facing various obstacles, including her grandfather's distrust and the scumbag's schemes, she falls into a life-and-death struggle. Finally, she and Jiang Yubai fight together, overcome difficulties, and achieve both revenge and love.

2215854.title: What If I Were a Debt-Ridden Heir
2215854.description: The story follows Cheng Hao, who once sacrificed love for his career. After achieving success but falling terminally ill, he returns to 1998 on his deathbed to begin a thrilling journey of self-redemption.

2215929.title: Cursed Marriage
2215929.description: A woman brings her boyfriend home for New Year, but villagers stare at him strangely. She tells him about supernatural events in the village. They accidentally discover an unwritten rule: villagers cannot marry outsiders. Now they must either break up or die in the village.

2216000.title: Secrets the Camera Can't See
2216000.description: A husband and nanny have an affair while the wife is away, but the mother-in-law catches them. They push down and abuse the mother-in-law. When the wife returns early from a business trip, she finds a dress that isn't hers in the bedroom. The husband claims he bought it for her, but the size doesn't match, making her suspicious. After firing the nanny and discovering her mother's injuries, the wife finds her gambling husband at a casino. He threatens divorce while the pregnant nanny insults her. The wife records everything and reports them both. In their anger, the husband and nanny turn on each other, accidentally causing her miscarriage.

2216111.title: Tonight the Stars Are Like You
2216111.description: College intern Su Yao accidentally encounters Leng Yichen, the young master of Leng Group, being hunted by enemies one evening. The kind and brave girl cleverly helps him escape from the assassins. Grateful for saving his life, Leng Yichen gives Su Yao his ancestral jade pendant as a token of gratitude, promising to marry her once he settles family matters. Days pass, and Su Yao thinks it was just a dream-like experience. However, the jade pendant secretly changes her life. When Su Yao faces danger, the pendant glows mysteriously and brings Leng Yichen's assistant to help. It turns out Leng Yichen hid a tracking device in the pendant to monitor her safety. The pendant becomes their emotional bond - whenever Su Yao encounters trouble, it somehow brings Leng Yichen to her. As they spend more time together, their feelings deepen, but the complex disputes of the Leng family cast shadows over them. A story of family feuds and romantic love centered around this jade pendant slowly unfolds.

2216174.title: The Gold Coin Player's Comeback
2216174.description: Poor guy Cao Yi gets rejected by goddess He Jin whom he pursued for three years, and is cuckolded by rich boy Lu Chengtian. Frustrated, he goes home to play games. By chance, Cao Yi gains a skill that converts game coins into real money. With this power, he starts grinding monsters, leveling up, and earning coins like crazy. In real life, he begins spending wildly. When He Jin learns Cao Yi is rich, she starts chasing him back, but the now wealthy Cao Yi looks down on this gold-digger. He makes fortunes in the game while acquiring He Jin's family factory's competitor in reality, launching a crushing business war. As his business grows, Cao Yi also finds his true love...

2216272.title: The Villainess Quits Her Role
2216272.description: Xiang Wan is a system traveler who has journeyed through countless worlds with her system companion Cat Cat. Finally able to enter a retirement world without missions, she discovers the system has a bug and accidentally cast her as the villainess in a story world.
2216272.originName: 快穿恶毒女配她罢演了

2216404.title: The Wild Young Master Returns
2216404.description: On the misty Qingya Mountain, Long Yuyang sits meditating under an ancient pine tree when the red-dressed warrior goddess Tang Fenglin appears, mistaking him for the legendary immortal and begging to be his disciple. After being pestered for days, Long Yuyang uses magic to send her away. However, his cultivation becomes increasingly difficult as he starts coughing up blood. His master finally reveals a long-hidden secret: Long Yuyang's family was massacred when he was young, and his seven souls were scattered. Now, with his incomplete soul causing him to weaken, he must find his lost souls or die. Learning the truth, Long Yuyang bids farewell to his master and descends the mountain with his sword, beginning a dangerous journey to recover his souls and uncover the truth behind his family's destruction.

2216481.title: The Cold Palace Consort Strikes Back
2216481.description: A consort wrongly accused and banished to the cold palace uses her wisdom and resilience to fight back against adversity. Through careful planning, she uncovers the court's hidden conspiracies and unexpectedly wins the emperor's genuine respect and admiration. With extraordinary courage and clever strategies, she shines brightly even in the cold palace, ultimately clearing her name and securing her place in the power struggles, proving that even in desperate situations, one can turn the tide and write their own legendary story.

2216630.title: Ten Years Away from Home
2216630.description: Zhang Nuofei, now successful and wealthy, returns to her hometown Daode Village with 1 billion yuan investment to fulfill her grandfather's last wish. On the 10th anniversary of her grandfather's death, when she comes back to pay respects, her uncle's family and cousin morally blackmail her, forcing her to marry for a large dowry. After her true identity is revealed, her family and the village chief become even more greedy. The college student she once sponsored turns into an ungrateful person who tries to sell her to Myanmar. In the end, all the villains get their deserved punishment!

2216696.title: The Spoiled Son's Revenge
2216696.description: The sharp smell of disinfectant awakens his consciousness. The young master of the Chu family suddenly opens his eyes as the monitor sounds its piercing alarm. White sheets, familiar plane trees outside the window - this is the VIP room of the private hospital where he stayed before the car accident. The calendar on the bedside table clearly shows "March 15, 20XX" - the night before Chu Group's bankruptcy!  Cold sweat soaks through his hospital gown as memories from his past life flood back like a tide. His father's sudden death from a heart attack, his mother's suicide by jumping from a building, and his own death in a car accident while fleeing. Before dying, he saw his enemy's cold smile and finally understood that his family's destruction was part of a carefully planned conspiracy.  "Ding -" His phone shows a message from an anonymous account with an encrypted file containing the original data of forged Chu Group financial reports. Rebirth brings not only opportunity but also mysterious help. He grips his phone tightly, his nails almost digging into his palm.  Late at night, he sneaks into his father's study, avoiding surveillance cameras. The safe in the secret compartment contains hidden agreements with business partners - evidence that could turn the situation around, which was destroyed by his enemies in his past life. As he photographs the documents, strange noises suddenly come from outside the window.  In the darkness, two black shadows break through the window. "Worthy of being the young master of the Chu family, you're indeed smarter after being reborn." The leading man in black removes his hood - it's the mastermind who killed him in his past life. The young master smiles coldly and presses send on his phone - the police are already on their way.  The gears of revenge begin to turn. He knows that in this life, those people will pay with blood for blood.

2216795.title: Dragon Lord
2216795.description: One year ago, demons invaded the human realm. As Ye Xuan was breaking through to the ninth rank, the Demon Ancestor came to stop him. The sect master and Ye Xuan's fiancée Rong Zhi came to help, but at the crucial moment, Rong Zhi betrayed Ye Xuan and severely wounded him. For the sake of all living beings, Ye Xuan had no choice but to destroy his cultivation core to eliminate the Demon Ancestor, turning from a cultivation genius into a powerless man. One year later, Ye Xuan unlocked a system and could cultivate again, but was forced to participate in the Nalan Kingdom's martial arts tournament. At the event, Ye Xuan was repeatedly humiliated, and Rong Zhi publicly broke their engagement to marry the genius alchemist Ming Feng. However, Ye Xuan showed amazing talent again at the tournament, defeated Ming Feng, proved Rong Zhi wrong, and began his new era...

2216858.title: CEO Lu's Super Capable Little Wife
2216858.description: Ye Ziyu comes from a rural background but is strong and independent. She's sweet and kind, yet dares to love and hate. After a drunken night with stranger Lu Xingzhou, she takes responsibility and proposes marriage, thinking he's just an ordinary office worker. But his real identity is a wealthy CEO. Seven years ago, Ye Ziyu saved Lu Xingzhou's life, and he fell in love at first sight. Lu left without saying goodbye to reclaim his family company, and they sadly missed each other. After many struggles, they finally realized their true feelings and ended up together.

2216981.title: Mom, Let Me Protect You in the Next Life
2216981.description: As a child, Feng Tongtong developed a brain tumor. Her mother took her everywhere seeking treatment, but due to poverty, they couldn't afford effective care. This caused Tongtong's optic nerves to be compressed, making her blind and causing dizziness. Her father Feng Tao was an alcoholic gambler who abused his wife and child. When he owed money to a gangster named Brother Xiao, he suggested his wife pay the debt with her body. To save Tongtong, her mother agreed, but the heartless Feng Tao still sold Tongtong to others. In desperation, Tongtong's mother pushed Feng Tao and accidentally killed him, then began a life of searching for her daughter while hiding from the law. 18 years later, Tongtong was adopted by the Su family and became their second daughter, with a loving adoptive mother and a sister who wanted her dead. Though working as a street cleaner, Tongtong's birth mother never gave up searching for her daughter. One day, while Tongtong was accompanying her evil sister on a blind date, the two met. Will mother and daughter recognize each other?
2216981.originName: 妈妈，下辈子请让我保护你

2217038.title: The CEO's Ultimate Bodyguard
2217038.description: After an unexpected incident, driver Jiang Long becomes the personal bodyguard of a beautiful CEO. It turns out this was all part of the CEO's plan. But behind this scheme, Jiang Long possesses extraordinary martial arts skills that make even the richest man bow down and powerful families fear him! Jiang Long's true identity remains mysterious. Through multiple encounters with the CEO, he must hide his identity and stay close to her to solve his family's hereditary curse. During this time, various forces get involved, creating hidden dangers around the beautiful CEO, forcing Jiang Long to step in...

2217187.title: The Qilin King
2217187.description: In an ancient and mysterious kingdom, a young man with Qilin bloodline accidentally awakens the dormant power within him and transforms into the Qilin King to protect the land from dark forces. With wisdom and courage, he leads warriors from various tribes through countless challenges and difficulties, ultimately exposing and defeating the mastermind's conspiracy, restoring peace and prosperity to the kingdom. The story combines mythology, action adventure, and emotional drama, showcasing the profound themes of courage, friendship, and sacrifice.

2217314.title: Homecoming: I Will Protect You
2217314.description: The story follows Wu Yao, a girl from a rural village who, with her grandfather's strong support, finally gets accepted into her dream school Harvard University. After achieving success, she returns home to her hometown.
2217314.originName: 荣归故里之我要守护你

2217366.title: Pampered by My Rich Husband After Flash Marriage
2217366.description: "Contract Lovers in Kashgar Ancient City" is a captivating micro-drama that tells a dramatic and romantic love story. Set in the beautiful Kashgar Ancient City, it focuses on the transformation from contract lovers to true love between Uyghur young man Alimujiang and actress Ayiguli. Alimujiang is the heir to Shenghua Group, the richest company in southern Xinjiang. To resist arranged marriage and escape family pressure, he hides his identity and starts his own business. Meanwhile, actress Ayiguli falls into debt crisis and is forced to sign a contract with Alimujiang, pretending to be his fiancée. During their contract relationship, they face various challenges and conspiracies together. His ex-fiancée Mayila's revenge, business rival Halibai's schemes, and Ayiguli's former pursuer Fan Jian's threats make their relationship full of ups and downs. However, facing all these tests, Alimujiang and Ayiguli gradually develop genuine feelings, turning their fake relationship into real love, and finally overcome all difficulties to find their happiness.
2217366.originName: 闪婚后被首富老伴宠上天

2217483.title: Divine Doctor: Surrounded by Six Beautiful Wives
2217483.description: Delivery worker Luo Xiao was framed by his boss Zhang Wancheng and lost his ability to have children. After planning revenge but being discovered, he fled to another city. Three years later, he returns and opens a medical clinic. Together with his six wives, he defeats Zhang Wancheng and gets his revenge.
2217483.originName: 神医圣手之我被六个性感老婆包围了

2217573.title: The Divine Doctor's Journey: Dual Cultivation Through Tribulation
2217573.description: The divine doctor Wei Wuxuan from Tianmen and the wealthy lady Lan Jingjing were separated in their past lives when Wei Wuxuan went astray in his cultivation and Lan Jingjing sacrificed herself to save him. Now Wei Wuxuan descends from the mountain to reunite with Lan Jingjing, their destiny intertwined. Wei Wuxuan's medical skills have become even more refined, while Lan Jingjing remains as beautiful as ever. Together they advance hand in hand, writing their own legendary story. On this long journey of life, they depend on each other and move forward together.

2217668.title: Sweet Date
2217668.description: Chi Miao helps her best friend Lin Qianqian with a blind date by pretending to be the rebellious Chi Xiaoyi to meet Fu Jinyan. After the date, Chi Miao discovers that Fu Jinyan is her company's new CEO and accidentally becomes his secretary. She thought they would never meet again after one blind date, but Fu Jinyan becomes very interested in Chi Xiaoyi after discovering she wasn't Lin Qianqian, and signs a ten-date contract with her. Chi Miao is forced to work as Fu Jinyan's secretary during the day, facing difficulties from colleagues, while at night she transforms into Chi Xiaoyi to date Fu Jinyan, afraid of her real identity being discovered. Through a series of events, Fu Jinyan finally discovers that Chi Miao is Chi Xiaoyi. The two misunderstand each other and almost miss their chance. Chi Miao sadly leaves and receives a marriage proposal from Chu Cheng. When she's about to marry him in despair, she discovers she's pregnant with Fu Jinyan's child. During Chi Miao and Chu Cheng's engagement party, Fu Jinyan realizes his mistake and wins Chi Miao back. Finally, all misunderstandings are resolved and they live happily together with their adorable child!

2217733.title: Responsible Dog Owner
2217733.description: Gold-digger Yang Xue walks her dog without a leash, allowing it to bite the low-key visiting Chairwoman Cui of Cui Group. Not only does she refuse to help the injured woman, but she also claims to be the "future young mistress of the Cui family," forcing the elderly woman to kneel and apologize to the dog, even blocking the ambulance and demanding 300,000 yuan compensation. At the hospital, Yang Xue and her friend Zhang Qing escalate further, threatening to cancel the wedding unless CEO Cui Mingfu pays an additional 30 million yuan dowry, unaware that the "scamming old lady" they injured is actually her future mother-in-law.

2217860.title: Supporting My Husband's Comeback
2217860.description: Modern actress Tang Rou faces constant rejection at auditions and suddenly travels back in time to the 1980s, becoming the wife of Si Chengzhou from the Si family in Quancheng - a 'cannon fodder supporting character.' When the Si family faces bankruptcy, she uses her modern business knowledge and familiarity with the storyline to help save the family. During this process, her relationship with Si Chengzhou grows stronger, but they face schemes from villains. Eventually, the villains are caught, the Si family rises again, Tang Rou changes her fate, and she walks hand in hand with Si Chengzhou.

2218002.title: My Restaurant on Huanghe Road
2218002.description: An Xin unexpectedly rebirths to 1990, pregnant and kicked out by her family. With advanced cooking skills and unique vision, she opens a small restaurant on Huanghe Road. Facing bullies demanding protection money, competitor suppression, and gossip, An Xin responds with strength, showing amazing business sense and resilience. While running the restaurant, she takes in wrongfully accused maid Qiao Qiao and meets mysterious Tong Guangyan. As business thrives, her restaurant attracts competitors' attention.

2218111.title: Fifty-Year-Old Sister is Beautiful and Cool
2218111.description: Zhou Pandi and her twin sister Zhou Zhaodi grew up in a family that favored boys over girls. In a fire, their father Zhou Fugui chose not to save them to have a chance for a son. The sisters barely escaped death but were separated. Years later, Pandi was adopted by a wealthy family, became CEO Zhao Ruoqi, and has been searching for her sister. Meanwhile, Zhaodi struggles to care for her paralyzed mother and deal with her gambling father. One day, Zhaodi discovers the nanny Wang Guilan abusing her mother and having an affair with her father. Fearing exposure, the father and nanny plot to burn Zhaodi and her mother to death. When Zhao Ruoqi finally finds her sister, she's dying in a hospital bed and their mother is dead. Filled with rage, Zhao Ruoqi plans revenge. She disguises herself as her sister at the father and nanny's engagement party, turning it into a funeral. Then she tricks them into her house, uses her wealth and wit to make the nanny lose all her money, breaks up their relationship, and ensures all the villains face justice.

2218188.title: Immortal Returns as a Father
2218188.description: The male protagonist fell into the divine realm years ago. After cultivating immortality, he returns to the human world, vowing to find the villains who once persecuted his family. Using the medical skills and martial arts learned in the immortal realm, he saves many business tycoons, heals his daughter, and ultimately wins back his wife.

2218332.title: Deliberate Affection
2218332.description: After being betrayed by her lover, Liu Moran feels heartbroken and accepts Yu Zhan's kindness. She deliberately and intentionally tries to please and win over Yu Zhan to make him happy and satisfied, leading to a series of romantic entanglements that gradually become sweeter as they spend time together.

2218479.title: The Young Master's Substitute Bride
2218479.description: In her past life, Bai Jin trusted the wrong people - the scumbag Gu Qiujing and her sister Bai Siying. Only when they betrayed and killed her did she realize her birth mother was poisoned by her stepmother. Dying with hatred, she was reborn with deep resentment. In this life, she refuses to be a helpless victim and voluntarily takes her sister's place to marry the sickly Ye Boyi. On their wedding night, Ye Boyi is poisoned with an aphrodisiac and falls into danger. Bai Jin's timely rescue not only saves him but also gives their arranged marriage a different beginning. The next day, Ye Boyi shows his true strong nature by accompanying Bai Jin back to her family, shattering rumors of his weakness. Seeing Bai Jin's unexpected fortune in marriage, Bai Siying and her stepmother burn with jealousy and begin plotting various schemes. Bai Jin knows this is only the beginning of her revenge. How will she establish herself in this wealthy family while facing her sister and stepmother's attacks? How will she uncover the truth of her past life and achieve revenge? And what role will Ye Boyi, this seemingly weak but sharp man, play in this revenge drama? What sparks will fly between them? A story of love, hate, and conspiracy begins.

2218607.title: Tempted into the Trap
2218607.description: Housewife Chen Xintong discovers her husband's affair with their nanny and learns that her beloved adopted daughter is actually their child. After secretly regaining her sight, she pretends to still be blind and manipulates the cheating couple. When her husband and his mistress try to kidnap her for money, she cleverly switches places with the mistress and tricks her husband into massive debt while secretly transferring their assets. She meets CEO Lin Yan and falls in love. As her ex-husband and his mistress face the consequences of their actions, Chen Xintong starts a new life in Beijing and marries Lin Yan for a happy ending.

2218726.title: After I Resigned, My Former CEO Still Has Feelings for Me
2218726.description: Song Xiang served as the personal secretary to Yan Chenzhou, CEO of Yan Group, for three years. She perfectly managed his work and life, from dawn schedules to midnight document reviews, fitting into his every need like a precision gear. However, when Yan Chenzhou handed over her carefully developed project to a new secretary and dismissed all her efforts with "You should step down now," Song Xiang realized she was merely a disposable tool in his hands. Heartbroken, Song Xiang submitted her resignation and cut all ties with Yan Chenzhou. She thought she could start a new life, but unexpectedly, the usually cold and ruthless Yan Chenzhou broke his "cold-hearted devil" image in the business world and began pursuing her frantically after she left. Whether through carefully planned "coincidental" meetings or showing up at her door in the middle of the night, his persistence left Song Xiang puzzled. Facing Yan Chenzhou's sudden passion, Song Xiang held firm to her decision to leave. But through their repeated encounters, she discovered the hidden emotions beneath her former boss's cold mask. She, who was once seen as a mere tool, had now become the person Yan Chenzhou most wanted to keep. In this game that began with exploitation and ended with true feelings, who will be the first to open the other's tightly closed heart?

2218845.title: It's You All Along
2218845.description: As a child, Li Ziwei was saved by a girl named Jiang Miaomiao. Years later, they grow up and meet by chance, leading to a flash marriage. Li Ziwei, a CEO, falls in love with Jiang Miaomiao and secretly protects her while hiding his true identity. However, Jiang Miaomiao's best friend Zheng Jiani becomes jealous and tries to break them apart. In the end, they recognize each other, overcome all obstacles, and the lovers finally unite.

2218936.title: May You Be the Star and I the Moon
2218936.description: Famous actress Bai Yueqi loves drinking. During an accidental ride in an unlicensed taxi, she nearly falls victim to the driver's evil intentions. While escaping, she encounters the male lead Fu Xingchuan. Fu Xingchuan, who comes from the Wolf Star, defies taboos to save Bai Yueqi, thus beginning a forbidden love story.

2219076.title: Love Me Once More
2219076.description: Fallen heiress Luo Ning is humiliated and abandoned by groom Ye Jingchen at their wedding. After divorce, she returns to the Luo family where her parents favor sons over daughters and treat her coldly. Her ex-husband and his mistress continue to torment her, causing her to lose her unborn child. She had wanted to live well for the baby, but now her last hope is gone. Watch how she seeks revenge against her ex-husband and his mistress step by step, and how she meets a man who truly loves her.

2219147.title: Cheating Husband Loses Everything
2219147.description: The story begins with a married woman named Ding Sha. When Mao Dajun was nothing, Ding Sha married him despite her parents' objections. The house was bought by Ding Sha, and the jewelry store was opened with money from Ding Sha's parents. One day, Ding Sha went to the jewelry store and discovered a girl confronting a cheating man. She went inside and found Mao Dajun fighting with his subordinates. That night, Mao Dajun gave Ding Sha a piece of jewelry called 'Qimeng'. When will the deceived Ding Sha wake up and confront this cheating man? Stay tuned...

2219209.title: The Beauty on the Pillow
2219209.description: General Fu Li buys a dancer named Qing Zhuang from a music house. She appears to be a simple-minded beauty who can dance and sing well. He buys her because she looks like his deceased childhood love, Xin Niang. However, Qing Zhuang is actually a spy sent by enemy forces to gather intelligence and assassinate Fu Li. She pretends to be innocent while secretly carrying out her mission. As the emperor falls ill, palace intrigue unfolds involving the ambitious Prince Dongping and Princess Six. Another spy, Yun Que, arrives to monitor Qing Zhuang's progress. Through various schemes and close calls, Qing Zhuang's true identity as the supposedly dead Xin Niang is eventually revealed. Despite knowing she came to kill him, Fu Li's love remains unwavering. Together, they fake her death to uncover the mastermind behind the conspiracy, ultimately defeating their enemies and finding true love.

2219327.title: The Supreme Returns
2219327.description: After Lin Fan's family was massacred, he was hunted down but saved by the Supreme Sect Master. He mastered martial arts and inherited the Supreme Token, but regrets in his heart prevented him from reaching peak martial arts. He returns to his wife and daughter to make amends.

2219440.title: Battle of Wits Against the Clown Killer
2219440.description: On his birthday, Shen Lang mysteriously enters an infinite loop, repeatedly killed by a masked clown in a bathroom stall. After waking up on the couch multiple times, he realizes he must escape the killer to break the terrifying cycle. Through each death and rebirth, Shen Lang discovers more clues - the killer is a woman working for someone else. He uses the killer's phone calls to eliminate suspects one by one. After several attempts, Shen Lang captures the killer during a power outage and interrogates her. When friends arrive at the office, the killer breaks free and attacks. Shen Lang realizes there are actually two killers - one who shoots him and another who runs him over. Through accumulated clues, he identifies the mastermind as Liao Dazhuang, who wants the Yunhai project. After exposing Liao's plot and having him arrested, Shen Lang goes to collect surveillance evidence but realizes there's still another accomplice - the security guard approaches with a hidden knife and sinister smile.

2219504.title: Reborn: From Trash Picker to Billionaire
2219504.description: Shen Lin, chairman of Xiaorong Group, decides to donate all his wealth on his deathbed out of guilt toward his wife Lu Xiaorong. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself back in the 1990s. Armed with future knowledge, Shen Lin has a huge advantage. Using this information and relentless effort, his wealth grows like a snowball. In just a few years, he transforms from nobody to business tycoon with assets over 100 million, not only changing his own fate but also leading the trends of his era, becoming a legendary billionaire.
2219504.originName: 重生从拾破烂开始致富

2219591.title: Reborn in the 80s: My Pure Love Story
2219591.description: Middle-aged Su Qingyu's 20-year marriage is a mess. Her husband Jia Dongliang is useless, and her former best friend openly has an affair with him. The friend brings Su Qingyu's husband home and humiliates her. During their fight, Su Qingyu learns that her childhood love Gu Huaizhi died because of her 20 years ago. Heartbroken and guilty, she tries to end her life but accidentally returns to her wedding day with Jia Dongliang when she was 20. Reborn, she decides to be bold, win back Gu Huaizhi, and cancel her wedding on the spot.
2219591.originName: 重生之我在八零搞纯爱

2219705.title: Renting a CEO Boyfriend for Chinese New Year
2219705.description: Ye Xi goes home for Chinese New Year, but her parents keep pressuring her to get married. So she decides to rent a boyfriend to bring home. Unexpectedly, her fake boyfriend Xiao Bei turns out to be a wealthy tycoon. During their time together, they develop real feelings for each other. When she finally discovers his true identity as a rich man, they end up together for real.
2219705.originName: 租个总裁男友回家过年

2219820.title: Top Model
2219820.description: Behind the flashing lights of the fashion runway lies a highly competitive and challenging modeling industry. Newcomer Cheng Er, driven by her passion for fashion, throws herself into this seemingly glamorous but cruel world. Early in her career, Cheng Er faces huge setbacks. Her figure isn't outstanding in the modeling world, she fails audition after audition, and often faces mockery from peers. But she doesn't give up. To improve herself, she maintains intense daily fitness routines and strict diet control while working hard on her catwalk skills and camera presence. During a small fashion show, she accidentally falls and becomes the laughingstock, but this only strengthens her determination to succeed. From then on, Cheng Er seizes every hard-won opportunity, no matter how small, giving her all. During shoots, she can maintain her smile for hours in freezing wind; to meet designers' requirements, she repeatedly pushes her limits. Finally, her efforts are noticed by a renowned designer, earning her a chance to walk at International Fashion Week. Under the spotlight, Cheng Er proves herself to the world with confident and elegant steps. From an unknown newcomer to a sought-after model, Cheng Er writes her own brilliant chapter in the competitive modeling industry through sweat and persistence, achieving her self-worth.

2219885.title: Repaying Great Kindness with Marriage
2219885.description: An Ran, daughter of the An family, is reborn to seek revenge against her scumbag ex-husband and reclaim the An Group. In the process, she goes from "chance encounters" to "falling in love" with Jiang Jingyuan, CEO of Jiang Group. In her previous life, on her wedding day to Qin Zhe, he spent the night with her white lotus stepsister An Hao and arrived late to the wedding, failing to marry An Ran as promised. Afterward, Qin Zhe and An Hao deceived An Ran repeatedly. Under pressure from her scumbag father An Rushan and stepmother Chen Yu, pregnant An Ran endured everything until Qin Zhe and An Hao stole all her family assets, forced her to divorce, and threatened her grandfather Wei Xun's life to make her take poison. An Ran collapsed in a pool of blood. When she opened her eyes again, she was reborn on her wedding day. She vowed to get revenge and reclaim everything that belonged to her. On the wedding day, she forced Jiang Jingyuan, Qin Zhe's rival, to marry her instead. What she thought was just the first step in revenge against Qin Zhe turned into true love as this bickering couple gradually fell for each other, overcame obstacles, and ended up together while An Ran reclaimed everything that was hers.
