2246006.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 3
2246006.description:
Everybody has a side they keep hidden from others—

During this era, nations across the world were locked in fierce, covert struggles for information. For over a decade, the Westalis and the rival nation of Ostania had been entangled in a relentless cold war.

Twilight, an elite spy working for WISE—the Western Intelligence Agency’s East Division—was assigned a top-secret mission: to monitor the movements of Donovan Desmond, the leader of Ostania’s National Unity Party and a looming threat to fragile East-West peace.

The mission carried a code name: Operation Strix.

2246108.title: Tales of Wedding Rings Season 2
2246108.description:
After gathering the rings and challenging the Lord of the Abyss to a conclusive battle, Satou, Hime, and the others were able to corner their opponent and were only one step away from triumph. But Satou was so exhausted that she found herself in a perilous situation.

The group was able to temporarily reassemble after Arabasta saved them at the last second. At that moment, Morion, Hime's younger sister, emerged out of nowhere.

Satou and the princesses decided to go through training to bolster their abilities and fortify their ties in order to fight the Lord of the Abyss again; this program is called the "Bride's Trial." Through a series of hardships, Satou and Hime's bond deepened, while his relationships with Nefertiti, Garnet, Sapphire, and Amber also strengthened.

Will Satou and his friends be able to overcome the Lord of the Abyss and bring peace back this time?

This otherworldly newlywed dream is set to resurrect the "Bride's Trial"—a mission that could decide the fate of the entire globe!
2246108.originName: 結婚指輪物語 第二期

2246170.title: One-Punch Man (Season 3)
2246170.description:
For fun, Saitama turned into a hero. He developed unstoppable power via three years of specialized training, and today he is a hero who can defeat any foe with a single blow (One Punch).

Saitama starts official hero activities at the Hero Association alongside Genos, who happened to be his apprentice.

When the Monster Association unexpectedly shows up and kidnaps the executives' children, the Hero Association is forced into a crisis.  In order to free the hostages, the S-Class Heroes band together and plan to raid the Monster Association's hideout.

At the same time, the "human monster" Garou awakens inside the Monster Association's lair.

2246246.title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Trusted Companions Tried to Kill Me, but Thanks to the Gift of an Unlimited Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out for Revenge on My Former Party Members and the World
2246246.description: Light's previous allies turn against him the moment he is expelled from the Concord of the Tribes. Light just escapes this evil act of treachery, only to discover that he is in the most perilous dungeon in the realm—the deepest section of the Abyss!  He uses his one magical ability, the Unlimited Gacha, to keep from getting eaten by carnivorous beasts. However, Mei, a stunning Level 9999 warrior dressed as a maid, emerges this time, where it had previously simply generated garbage stuff! After three years, Light has established his own kingdom in this remote dungeon and called forth more stunning Level 9999 fighters who pledge unwavering loyalty to him. Light, who is now a formidable Level 9999 Overlord, intends to rise to the surface and exact revenge on his betrayers one by one!
2246246.originName: 信じていた仲間達にダンジョン奥地で殺されかけたがギフト『無限ガチャ』でレベル9999の仲間達を手に入れて元パーティーメンバーと世界に復讐&『ざまぁ! 』します!

2246336.title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
2246336.description: There is a grim past for Konoha Satou. As a teenager, she wrote self-indulgent fantasy romantic fiction, such as her Dark History. It is now a matter of life and death to remember every tiny detail, though, for she has turned into its most heinous villain. After evading the first two warning signs, Satou is abruptly abandoned when an enigmatic stranger—a character she doesn't remember creating in the original script—returns from the Lily Kingdom. Even though Yomi says she is her buddy, in such a perilous environment, can Satou really put her trust in a stranger?

2246476.title: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero’s
2246476.description: One of those guys who people forget even exists is Oda Akira. He effortlessly transitions into his new duty as a silent assassin, though, and his modest demeanor pays off when his entire class is transported to a fantastical setting. He has too many unfitting details and suspiciously high starting numbers, so Akira knows something is off. Examining royal secrets, however, is a risky endeavor, and when Akira discovers a sinister plot, he also creates a formidable foe—the same monarch who brought him into the world! Can he find the power to make things right and exact his revenge with Amelia, the elf spirit medium?
2246476.originName: 暗殺者である俺のステータスが勇者よりも明らかに強いのだが

2246609.title: Tojima Tanzaburo Wants to Be a Masked Rider
2246609.description:
The goal of Toujima Tanzaburou's life has been to become a Kamen Rider. At 40, he is almost at the point of surrendering his childhood fantasy as reality has caught up with him.

That is, until his lifelong desire becomes something far more perilous as he becomes entangled in a surge of criminal activity spearheaded by the "Fake Shocker" group.

It swiftly transforms from a fictional hero's quest into a real one. It's almost time to start the ultimate Kamen Rider fantasy!
2246609.originName: 東島丹三郎は仮面ライダーになりたい（前半）

2246667.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
2246667.description: During a ball, Scarlet's fiancé, Kyle, abruptly ends their engagement. She is wrongfully referred to as a "Villainess" and falsely accused of bullying. She is condemned by all the great families and aristocrats. She endured years of his foolishness and cruelty, but she can't stand it any longer! At the end of her rope, she requests one final favor: to punch him in the face. Scarlet's tale of retaliation against Kyle and his associates begins here! A fantasy about a fighter who is both elegant and defiant, and who refuses to be used!
2246667.originName: 最後にひとつだけお願いしてもよろしいでしょうか

2246769.title: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
2246769.description:
Luna Ishikawa is a special transfer student since she is a vampire. She has swiftly become the focus of attention in her class because to her calm manner. Normal interaction between her and Tatsuta Ootori, a perfectly normal guy, would be almost difficult. But when the two are unintentionally assigned to cleaning duties, that all changes!

Tatsuta's perception of Luna gradually changes once he and she become friends on their own: she is not the cool-headed girl everyone believes her to be. She can't even properly suck blood, in fact! Tatsuta offers to be Luna's practice partner because she is determined to help her get over her incompetence. By bringing excitement to their routine school days, the two slowly strive toward their delicious objective, honing Luna's bloodsucking abilities with each mouthful.
2246769.originName: ちゃんと吸えない吸血鬼ちゃん

2246848.title: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
2246848.description:
"This group doesn't require a weak magician who is limited to using magic for assistance. Alec Ygret, you've been fired."

Alec—a court wizard who had joined the crown prince's company to assist him in overcoming dungeons—was abruptly expelled from the group. Alec was at his wit's end when a buddy from the "magic academy" approached him. In addition, the crown prince's harassment had expelled him from the royal castle.

"Hi Alec. Do you want to join us in trying to defeat the dungeon once more?

Therefore, Alec embarks on his second trip in life with his former party buddies. It tells the tale of an abandoned former court magician who went on an adventure.

The "Lasting Period," a four-person party that was dubbed "legendary," began to gain international recognition four years ago.
2246848.originName: 味方が弱すぎて補助魔法に徹していた宮廷魔法師、追放されて最強を目指す

2246901.title: Hands Off: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun
2246901.description:
Kouyou Kotesashi is a gifted massage therapist with aspirations to work as a sports physician. He enrolls at Seiwa University Affiliated High School, a dominant sports institution, in order to obtain a scholarship to medical school.

Kouyou, who comes from a low-income household, works as a live-in employee at the school dorm to help pay his bills. But before long, he is encircled by a collection of exceptionally gifted but eccentric female athletes. His responsibilities included overseeing the dorm and taking care of the residents' physical and emotional health.

An exciting new chapter begins with a combination of rigorous training, cramped dorm living, and massage therapy!
2246901.originName: 触らないで小手指くん

2247104.title: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!
2247104.description:
In this world, the Classes and Skills granted by the Goddess shape a person’s entire future, with a Class bestowed at the age of ten.

Allele, son of the “Magic King” Leon and the “Sword Princess” Farah, was expected to inherit greatness—but instead, he was branded “Classless.” Disappointment and pity followed him everywhere.

Yet through sheer effort and unyielding will, Allele begins to gain powers beyond imagination—strength that ultimately surpasses even the talents of those blessed with a Class.

This is the tale of a boy born Classless, who through perseverance rises to be called a “Hero” and continues his pursuit of even greater power.
2247104.originName: 無職の英雄 ～別にスキルなんか要らなかったんだが～

2247196.title: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
2247196.description: One must have some acquired tastes, just like any decent noble lady. Monsters are a somewhat unusual protein that Melphiera Marchalrayd tends to crave! But don't pass judgment! Even though monster meat has a poor reputation, Melphiera is determined to change the kingdom's perception of it by demonstrating that it can be utilized in fine cuisine! Sadly, Melphiera has been having a hard time finding the right person ever since she made her social debut—that is, until she meets the bold "Blood-Mad Duke" of Galbraith!

2247268.title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
2247268.description:
Saku Chitose frequently receives insults. Known as "Class 5's womanizing scumbag," he is frequently defamed online by others who are envious of his fame. Fortunately, Saku's self-confidence is hardly affected by that. Outside of specialized online communities, his teachers trust him as a great student and his peers look up to him as a respectable person.

Saku makes new acquaintances and reconnects with his old pals, all of whom are members of the school's social elite, as his second year of high school begins. The enjoyment is interrupted, though, when Saku's homeroom teacher gives him the task of persuading Kenta Yamazaki, a classmate who has been shut out, to go back to school.  Saku goes to Kenta's residence the very following day, hoping to close things up as soon as possible. However, when he learns that Kenta is fully and solidly on the Saku hatred train, the endeavor becomes more difficult than he had anticipated. Saku needs to convince Kenta to return to school if he hopes to maintain his flawless reputation.
2247268.originName: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか

2247354.title: A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai
2247354.description: A regular guy with a typical office job, Takeru Kamishiro is called to another world. In "Madeus," a magical and sword-wielding world, Takeru begins his new life with a variety of skills at his disposal!  He has extraordinary magic skills in addition to his enhanced physical capabilities, and he can "search" for valuable objects. Using his newly acquired cheating abilities, Takeru embarks on his new journey in the new Isekai!
2247354.originName: 素材採取家の異世界旅行記

2247441.title: SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes
2247441.description: SI-VIS is a co-ed music group, led by Yosuke, shaking up the global music scene with their unmatched vocals and performances. However, they are actually heroes in disguise, battling against mysterious forces threatening the world. They convert audience energy at live performances into combat power. Luckily, the battles appear to be ordinary concerts to the public, keeping their identity a secret.

2247557.title: Dad is a hero, Mom is a spirit, I'm a reincarnator.
2247557.description:
Being a girl of both spirit and human blood, eight-year-old Ellen has power over the elements—though not the traditional four-element kind. She has the power to transform her surroundings by manipulating the elements of the periodic table. On top of that, Ellen also has a great amount of scientific knowledge due to being a scientist in her past life.

During the war against a neighboring kingdom, Rovel Vankreift, the hero of the Kingdom of Tenbahl and eldest son of house Vankreift—as well as Ellen's father—was fatally injured. However, the spirit who fought by Rovel's side, Lady Origin, brought him to her realm to save him from the clutches of death. Lady Origin, who happens to be the Queen of the Spirit Realm as well as Ellen's eventual mother, is one of the most powerful spirits in existence, making little Ellen quite powerful in contrast to her innocent looks.

But even a family as happy as this one has its fair share of problems, as Ellen and her parents are forced to reconnect their old ties to the Vankreift household in order to defend their relatives' honor—all while hiding Ellen's dangerous existence from the public to preserve their undisturbed happiness.
2247557.originName: 父は英雄、母は精霊、娘の私は転生者。

2247677.title: My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON
2247677.description:
The ultimate war between heroes and villains erupts as decades of good versus evil collide in a cataclysmic finale. Tomura Shigaraki has evolved beyond a mere successor to All For One—he now embodies the collapse of world order itself. Meanwhile, Izuku Midoriya, once a timid boy, has risen as the beacon of hope, carrying the weight of humanity’s future on his shoulders. Their fateful clash will redefine heroism and decide the destiny of all.

The Final War and Epilogue Arcs are involved in this season, delivering earth-shattering battles: All Might vs. All For One in a legendary duel, and Izuku Midoriya vs. Tomura Shigaraki.

Heroism or annihilation? The end of an era is here.
2247677.originName: 僕のヒーローアカデミア FINAL SEASON

2247821.title: GINTAMA - Mr.Ginpachi's Zany Class
2247821.description:
Here at Gintama High, Class 3-Z is everything from typical. Welcome!  As a teacher at Gintama High School, Ginpachi Sakata is the subject of the Gintama spin-off anime. As misfit high schoolers—an idol otaku, a hopeless slacker, a creepy stalker, an old-man lover, and a nasty delinquent—all jammed into one chaotic classroom, this wacky anime reimagines legendary characters.

Their homeroom teacher, Ginpachi Sakata, is in charge of this rowdy group. She is an unkempt educator with death-fish eyes who wears a lab coat that is always stained. Under his "direction," the Class 3-Z pupils transform the school into their own playground, fusing relatable juvenile pranks with Gintama's trademark craziness. Whether you're a die-hard otaku or a normie, prepare yourself for an extraordinary slice of life!

2247882.title: To Your Eternity Season 3
2247882.description:
The immortal being known as Fushi has triumphed over the Nokkers, the malevolent force that sought to annihilate humanity. Yet his duty is far from over. For centuries, he has spread his essence like roots of a tree, anchoring himself across the land to safeguard mankind.

Now, in a modern world basking in unprecedented peace, Fushi believes he can finally embrace happiness—new friends, a new home, and a life free from conflict.

But shadows of unease creep back. A lurking enemy preys on the cracks in human hearts, while the true purpose of the Beholder who created Fushi begins to unravel. A new trial is bestowed upon Fushi, and the time for a monumental choice is rapidly approaching.

The saga of the undying continues in the Modern Era Arc, where eternal life collides with the fragility of humanity.

2247986.title: Mechanical Marie
2247986.description:
Arthur Louis Zetes, a wealthy, attractive, and successful man, is all too familiar with human greed. Distrustful of people and constantly doubting those around him, he demands the perfect servant—a robot maid. But with technology still limited, his butler cannot provide one and must instead seek the closest alternative.

Enter Marie Evans, a former child martial arts prodigy known for her emotionless demeanor. Crushed by debt, she seizes the chance to pose as a robot maid. Though Arthur is often harsh toward others, he finds himself unexpectedly charmed by his “robot.” In turn, Marie is quietly moved by his unexpected kindness and genuine enthusiasm toward her.

Thus begins the lighthearted everyday life of a wealthy heir and his very human (but “robotic”) maid.

2248044.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 5
2248044.description: Wang Ling, a dry noodle-loving immortal king, now faces his greatest challenge yet! With a novelist dad, a mysterious mom, a brand-new little sister, and the sudden arrival of a powerful little sister, Wang Nuan, the Wang family’s ordinary life is turned upside down. And figuring out how to be a good older brother becomes the latest challenge for the mighty immortal king. Surprisingly, Wang Nuan’s extraordinary power doesn’t shock the Wang family. Wang Ling starts early, teaching his sister to control her immense abilities. But her power catches the attention of the sinister organization Ye Kui and Bai Zhe, a top-tier prisoner from Enchanted Prison. Faced with threats from evil cultivators, Wang Ling makes a decision that defies tradition: he’ll take his sister along to teach these villains a lesson! This season, join the immortal king and his little sister as they dive into a life filled with humor and unexpected adventures!

2248114.title: Jiang Ye
2248114.description: After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

2248232.title: The Gate of Mystical Realm
2248232.description: Shi Mu's destiny appears predestined to be different in a society that values warriors. He must travel the path of a warrior in order to discover the truth and atone for his sins because he is the adopted son of an aristocratic family. There are conflicting interests and formidable adversaries everywhere, from the four halls of Fengcheng to the conflict between sects. Every obstacle strengthens Shi Mu's resolve. Shi Mu ultimately comes to understand the influence of his ancestry, which not only alters his own fate but also has a significant impact on the futures of numerous others.

2248332.title: So You're Raising a Warrior
2248332.description: Al, the first king-killer in the demon world and a contrastingly adorable dragon, has a perfect fighting score but is ready to die and longs for a happy retirement. He meets the sly human magician Le Fei and unintentionally becomes a fantastic parent, raising Le Fei's kid Dino.  Will Dino be a typical, contented kid, or will he courageously take up the Warrior's Holy Sword and confront his own fate?

2248459.title: Reborn as a Cat
2248459.description: Myohee, who was ridiculed at work and orphaned at birth, has endured many hardships throughout her life.  However, Myohee believes she will never find a bright spot in her life after being defrauded by her one friend and being bankrupt.  She makes the decision to leap from a building to end her life, but the grim reaper stops her in mid-air, claiming that her time is not yet up.  She has been given a hundred more days to live—as a cat!  Before she realizes it, she is brought to the house of Mr. Cha, her attractive but distant boss.  If only Myohee can stay a cat, it looks like the ideal opportunity to give her the affection and attention she never experienced in her life!

2251346.description: Rudo resides in a floating town's slums, where the impoverished struggle to make ends meet while the wealthy have luxurious lives and just throw their trash into the abyss. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has produced vicious monsters!

2255529.title: (Sub ID)(Sub ID)From That Night Until Forever
2255529.description: From that night on, forever and ever

2255611.title: (Sub ID) Poor Deliveryman Insulted, Suddenly Becomes a Billionaire!
2255611.description: I have a system that can pass as genuine.

2255738.title: (Sub ID)The Return of the True Princess - High School Cultivator Takes Over
2255738.description: She thrives in the modern world through her cultivation.
2255738.originName: 她靠修仙在现代风生水起

2255855.title: (Sub ID) Starving? Lucky I have a response system, money is flowing in abundantly
2255855.description: In the lean years, tied to the quiz system, I’m busy stockpiling grain with my three wives.
2255855.originName: 荒年绑定答题系统，我带三女囤粮忙

2255974.title: (Sub ID) Magic Wall to the Ancient Times
2255974.description: Traveling through time, I’ll start turning dark today.
2255974.originName: 穿梭古今从今天开始黑化

2256107.title: (DUB ID) Salted Fish Becomes a Dragon Shaking the Heavens
2256107.description: The dried fish transforms into a dragon, shaking the nine heavens.

2256175.title: (Sub ID) 3 Years of Marriage Without Love, Only Regret After Divorce
2256175.description: The madam is too pretentious; the master’s mouth is tougher than his life.
2256175.originName: 夫人太装薄爷嘴比命硬

2256235.title: (DUB ID) That Campus Guy Is Stubborn but Makes You Fall in Love
2256235.description: The school heartthrob is as stubborn as a dead duck.

2256380.title: (Sub ID) CEO Hates Women, Falls in Love with Divorced Assistant

2256513.title: (Sub ID)The Tragedy of the Giant Shark Attack
2256513.description: Island Apocalypse: The Madman’s Prophecy Has Come True
2256513.originName: 海岛末日：疯子预言成真了

2256584.title: (DUB ID) Impotent CEO, Cured by a Village Girl Overnight

2256671.title: (Sub ID)Chased by the Crown Prince, Asked to Become Official
2256671.description: Ultimate temptation! Chased by the Beijing elite for a formal status.
2256671.originName: 极致诱惑!被京圈太子爷追要名分

2256877.title: Chasing Dreams Across the World 2
2256877.description: "Chasing Dreams Across the World 2" tells the story of Zeng Bailu and Ning Du. Zeng Bailu races through country roads on her cool motorcycle, while Ning Du appears handsomely at the sect's entrance. Ning Du is sent by Master Zhang Haoran to find the senior sister Zeng Bailu, who disappeared ten years ago, in order to retrieve the master's ring and inherit the leadership position. However, Ning Du has no interest in becoming the master and even mocks Zhang Haoran's traditional ideas. The two engage in witty banter, making the story full of drama and humor.

2256985.title: Crossing the world with cranes
2256985.description: It tells the tale of Ning Du, the adopted son of the Ning Group, and his fateful entanglement with the mysterious woman Zeng Bailu. As the Ning family’s son-in‑law, Ning Du appears to be a flamboyant, dissolute heir to the conglomerate, but in truth he bears the weight of long‑hidden secrets from his martial arts sect. An unexpected encounter with Zeng Bailu at a KTV sets off a chain of events that peels back just one layer of a decade‑old clan massacre.  At her master’s behest, Zeng Bailu has come to retrieve the amnesiac Ning Du, only to find herself swept into the Ning Group’s ruthless power struggle. Ning Tianyi, Ning Du’s betrothed, driven by jealousy, repeatedly plots against him—hiring thugs to stage a “hero saves the damsel” scenario, instructing subordinates to slip him drugs and secretly film him, and even colluding with Jiang Nan, the heiress of the Jiang Group, all in a bid to oust Ning Du from the Ning family. Meanwhile, the ailing Ning Jianghe, patriarch of the Ning clan, has brought the battle for succession to a fever pitch.  Disguised as a special assistant, Zeng Bailu infiltrates the Ning Group, facing workplace sabotage while evading assassination attempts by her own sect’s elders—and, amid it all, forging an emotional bond with Ning Du. As the story unfolds, fragments of Ning Du’s memory return: he was once Xiao Jin, the direct disciple of a reclusive martial arts sect. Ten years ago, his master’s order was brutally purged by the faction that embraced the outside world; gravely wounded and left with no recollection of who he was, he was taken in by the Ning family. Zeng Bailu is not only his fellow junior sister but also the fiancée entrusted to him on their master’s deathbed. As they join forces to thwart Ning Tianyi’s schemes, feelings begin to stir—but Ning Jianghe’s dying wish to entrust them to each other leaves them torn. When the sect’s elders join forces with business rivals to strike, Ning Du must choose between safeguarding the Ning Gro

2257046.title: Reborn to Reclaim My Billion-Dollar Fortune
2257046.description: Bai Jie was betrayed and nearly murdered by her best friend Lu Chai, who stole her identity and took over her happy life. After being rescued, Bai Jie gains new strength and fights to reclaim everything that rightfully belongs to her from Lu Chai.

2257185.title: After Rebirth, The Young Lady of Mr. Gu's Family Becomes Well-Behaved
2257185.description: The story tells of wealthy heiress Lu Zhixia who was murdered by her boyfriend Shen Ci and best friend Meng Wan'er, but miraculously reborn before her wedding to the scumbag. With memories from her past life, Lu Zhixia cleverly fights against the scumbag and the shameless woman, making them face the punishment they deserve, and successfully finds true love.
2257185.originName: 重生后，顾总家的小祖宗变乖了

2257307.title: Return to 22
2257307.description: A young man possesses a secret formula but is betrayed and murdered by his most trusted brother and girlfriend. Fortunately, fate gives him a second chance at life. They say an innocent man suffers for his treasures, but since he has the opportunity to start over, how can he just surrender? He will punish the wicked and reclaim everything he lost in this new life.

2257449.title: Deadly Revenge
2257449.description: Three years ago, Cao Lingqing was pursued by Yuan Haojing in a calculated scheme. After their marriage, he arranged a car accident and drugged her in the hospital, causing her to lose her sight. To steal his wife's fortune, Yuan Hao teamed up with his mistress to imprison Cao Lingqing in a villa for three years. The couple even targeted Cao Lingqing's mother. When Cao Lingqing was almost in despair, she fell down the stairs while being tortured by the mistress. In that moment, she suddenly saw a woman's high heels - her sight had returned! She decided to pretend she was still blind and secretly plan her revenge. Meanwhile, Lao He, a loyal employee from Cao Lingqing's company, protected her business from Yuan Hao's schemes. With her sight restored and her company safe, Cao Lingqing carefully planned each step of her revenge. In the end, justice prevailed as she personally sent Yuan Hao to prison.

2257580.title: Supreme War Wolf
2257580.description: On his engagement day, young master Ye Xingchen's fiancée is kidnapped by a mysterious young lord. The entire Ye family is massacred, with blood flowing like rivers, and only Ye Xingchen barely escapes. Nine years later, Ye Xingchen masters incredible powers and prepares to descend from the mountain. His two masters give him a Dragon God ring that commands a million soldiers and a black card containing trillions in wealth. Ye Xingchen returns as a king to shake the world. He will make that mysterious dragon lord pay in blood for destroying his family and stealing his wife! He will show the world who is the true king!

2257696.title: No Escape from Justice
2257696.description: SWAT officer A-Long excels in training and catches the attention of Captain Huang, who arranges for him to retire and become an undercover agent to gather intelligence and investigate the purpose of terrorist leader Da Tie Fei's visit to Dragon Port. After Da Tie Fei meets with A-Bao and learns that their Middle East weapons research has failed, he sends people to kidnap Xiao Qing from the Institute of Technology to threaten Dr. G into surrendering his research results. To protect the woman he loves, A-Long decides to reveal his true identity and bring this criminal organization to justice.

2257768.title: After My Movie Star Wife Divorced Me, I Became Famous Online
2257768.description: Lu Chuan, a top researcher in the Dragon Kingdom, dedicates himself to the secret Kunlun Project to protect his country. This classified project is unknown to the public, and all participants sacrifice for the nation without seeking fame or fortune. When Lu Chuan's mentor dies from overwork, the hospital room is occupied by popular star Gu Jia Yan and her fans. Lu Chuan fights to protect his teacher's body, but gets exposed online by angry fans, nearly causing the Kunlun Project to be leaked. His ex-wife Lin Wan Qiu despises his poverty, conspires with corrupt businessmen, and publicly humiliates him. To ensure that researchers don't suffer both sacrifice and heartbreak, Lu Chuan's protectors carefully arrange a banquet where they engage in open and secret battles against corrupt merchants and others who attack scientists.
2257768.originName: 影后老婆离婚后，我火遍全网

2257914.title: Bound by Love, Hearts Unchanged
2257914.description: After her divorce, actress Xie Luosheng faces her ex-husband Liao Minghao's schemes and family conflicts. She bravely stands up to expose the truth and rebuilds her career with help from her best friend Shi Weiwei. Meanwhile, she develops romantic feelings with Gu Yanchen, CEO of Changhong Industries. After many ups and downs, Xie Luosheng not only rescues her daughter Duoduo from her ex-husband but also successfully gets her revenge and reaches the peak of her career, while her relationship with Gu Yanchen gradually heats up.

2257996.title: A single thought of immortality
2257996.description: A thousand years ago, to save the woman he loved, Ye Feng ventured to Kunlun Mountain in search of a miraculous cure. There, he stumbled into an immortal’s cave and gained immortality. Over the millennia that followed, Ye Feng founded the Heavenly Dao Divine Medicine Sect, whose disciples came to be renowned healers across the realm, while he himself grew ever more detached from the world.  On her deathbed, his divine‑medicine‑master disciple, seeking to free him from his emotional bonds, arranged a betrothal between Ye Feng and a female physician named Qin Wei. Mistaking him for a mere apprentice, Qin Wei publicly broke off the engagement at a banquet.  In his second intended marriage, fate led Ye Feng to encounter a woman who bore an uncanny resemblance to the one he had lost—her name was Su Qingwan. To determine whether she held any connection to his beloved, Ye Feng resolved to become a son‑in‑law of the Su family. Yet his decision drew ridicule and resistance from all quarters of the household and the powerful clans alike.  At a commercial bidding conference, Ye Feng single‑handedly challenged the titans of the industry. His wisdom and courage stunned the assembly, securing the Su family the winning bid. But this triumph only fueled greater envy and oppression. Capitalizing on the fame of his signature prescriptions, Ye Feng had once humbled Li Zekai and others; now, those same men sought to drag the Su family down, joining forces with the Ancient Medical Association to demand the secret formulas. When Su Qingwan refused, a fake‑medicine scandal erupted, turning the family into a pariah. Believing Ye Feng’s prescriptions might indeed be flawed, the Su clan renewed its grievances against him.  Ye Feng accepted the Ancient Medical Association’s challenge to a grand medical duel three days hence. To his surprise, their appointed champion was none other than Qin Wei—who, having been expelled from the Heavenly Dao Divine Medicine Sect, had since joined their ranks.

2258067.title: Male Secretary Number One
2258067.description: Ten years ago, after graduating from college, he started a business with his friend Gao Qiwu and became the boss of Zhonghai Aquatic Group. Later, he was betrayed by Gao Qiwu, but eventually made a comeback and became a powerful tycoon.

2258210.title: Starlight Still Shines
2258210.description: Designer Shen Xingluo was about to reach her career peak when she was replaced by connected insider Zhang Xiaoli right before her promotion. Her boss and boyfriend Meng Junhao watched coldly and even secretly conspired with Zhang Xiaoli. Heartbroken, Shen Xingluo hit rock bottom until she reunited with her first love Zhou Yu'an in an alley one night - except he appeared as "Zhou Yusen," claiming to be Zhou Yu'an's brother. Though suspicious, Shen Xingluo was moved by his familiar words and actions. Zhou Yusen gradually melted her guard with gentleness and companionship, standing up for her when Meng Junhao and Zhang Xiaoli framed her, even taking harm to protect her. However, Shen Xingluo couldn't let go of her feelings for Zhou Yu'an, making Zhou Yusen's closeness both thrilling and painful. When she discovered Zhou Yusen was actually Zhou Yu'an, anger and disappointment overwhelmed her again. Zhou Yu'an had left years ago for overseas treatment of a serious illness, choosing to disappear rather than burden her. He returned as "Zhou Yusen" to make amends. When their relationship reached a deadlock, the fired Meng Junhao kidnapped Shen Xingluo for revenge. Zhou Yu'an appeared again to save her and confess his love. Understanding his struggles, Shen Xingluo forgave him. But happiness was brief - Zhou Yu'an disappeared again the next day. Desperate, she returned to their meeting alley to find him kneeling with a ring, proposing to her. This love story of deception and illness, conspiracy and redemption, finally found its perfect ending under the alley lights.

2258293.title: Rebirth (My First Half of Life)
2258293.description: Song Yan dies during a difficult childbirth when her mother-in-law Jiang Cuihua and husband Gu Wenyuan refuse to pay for surgery and cause chaos at the hospital. Reborn one year earlier, Song Yan returns to the day her daughter Yuanyuan was poisoned by expired instant noodles given by Jiang Cuihua. Song Yan vows to make them pay for their actions.

2258441.title: After the Groom Ran Away
2258441.description: Entertainment star Zhao Xinyue is caught in scandal rumors with her boyfriend Liu Jiacheng and his adopted sister Liu Chenche. On their wedding day, Liu Jiacheng abandons Zhao Xinyue to save his suicidal sister. Fed up with the drama, Zhao Xinyue decides to find a replacement groom on the spot. She approaches Jiang Xubai, Liu Jiacheng's rival who attended the wedding, and proposes a one-year fake marriage contract in exchange for starring in his movie. Surprisingly, Jiang Xubai signs the contract without hesitation. After the wedding, paparazzi force them to live together to maintain their cover. However, the paparazzi were actually arranged by Jiang Xubai to spend more time with Zhao Xinyue. When Liu Jiacheng returns and confronts them, Jiang Xubai's possessive behavior angers him further. As their fake relationship develops and the film crew arrives with Liu Jiacheng and Liu Chenche, new complications arise that threaten to expose Jiang Xubai's secret feelings.

2258578.title: A Mother's Love Journey
2258578.description: An elderly mother raises two sons through hardship, but faces neglect from her daughters-in-law and sons in her old age. A friend spreads rumors about her having valuable family treasures to help her. The two sons suddenly become filial, hoping to inherit the treasure. However, the news attracts criminals who kidnap the brothers. During the rescue, the mother bravely protects her sons and gets beaten by the criminals. Seeing their mother injured, the brothers finally wake up and fight back. With police help, they escape danger safely. The brothers realize their mistakes and sincerely repent.

2258724.title: Court is Now in Session
2258724.description: While on her way to get medical expenses for her husband Wang Wenyong, Liu Yumei is stopped by He Zhiwei, a first-day city management officer, who detains her electric bike for alleged illegal parking. Despite Liu Yumei's desperate pleas, He Zhiwei falsely accuses her of the 20,000 yuan she just withdrew from the ATM being illegal income, with bank staff also making accusations. Unable to defend herself, Liu Yumei receives urgent calls from the hospital demanding surgery payment. In desperation, she steals the officer's electric bike to escape but is arrested before reaching the hospital and sentenced to 20 years in prison. At the sentencing, Wang Wenyong miraculously awakens from his coma. As the kingdom's only royal lawyer, he not only sues the entire city management team but also brilliantly argues against multiple opponents in court.

2258863.title: The Gambling King Returns
2258863.description: After his parents accumulated gambling debts, Ye Xing was forced to go to the mountains to learn gambling skills. Years later, he returns to seek revenge, reclaim everything that belongs to him, and reach the peak of his life.

2259004.title: Midnight Last Bus
2259004.description: Liu Minghui is a cheerful, mature yet childish young man. Short on money, he takes a job as a driver for the Route 14 last bus, but gets caught up in an unavoidable conflict full of open and hidden struggles.

2259104.title: Supreme Commander
2259104.description: War God Lu Tong of the Dragon Legion was betrayed by his subordinates and fell into a coma. His fiancée stayed by his side faithfully for years. Just when his mother-in-law and brother-in-law conspired to force her to marry another man, the sleeping war god opened his eyes.

2259251.title: My Seven Fairy Sisters
2259251.description: Zhang Ming was killed by his rival Zhao Wei, who threatened his sisters' lives. After being reborn, he vows to change the tragic fate and protect his sisters. He first uses his past life memories to strengthen and spin off his eldest sister's subsidiary company. When he discovers people insulting his sisters, he takes over their family companies, one of which has ties to Zhao Wei. Zhao Wei tries to teach Zhang Ming a lesson, but with his sisters' help, Zhang Ming turns the tables. Furious, Zhao Wei attempts to kidnap the sisters, but Zhang Ming has already turned Zhao Wei's subordinates against him and exposes his crimes, finally achieving peace.

2259334.title: My Multiple Personalities Are Killing Each Other
2259334.description: Psychologist Gu Chenzhou uses hypnosis to control his patient Su Wan, causing her mental breakdown. Su Wan's best friend Lin Ruochu notices something wrong and investigates. She counter-hypnotizes Gu Chenzhou, exposing his true nature. The awakened Gu Chenzhou flies into a rage, but then the real psychologist appears, revealing that Gu Chenzhou is actually a multiple personality disorder patient who has killed many people.
2259334.originName: 我的多重人格在自相残杀

2259407.title: My 1998
2259407.description: Security guard Wang Jie, after being humiliated by his wife and severely injured by his brother-in-law, accidentally discovers a secret cave that allows him to travel back to 1988. To raise money for his sick mother's medical bills, he uses this secret passage to travel between 1988 and the present, becoming a trader. By dealing in antiques, he becomes wealthy and wins the favor of beautiful women, beginning his journey from zero to hero.

2259537.title: A Thousand Times for You
2259537.description: This drama tells the story of Shen Qingyu who, after learning she has a terminal illness with little time left, returns home to witness her husband Si He's betrayal with his mistress Pei Shuyi, and overhears their murder plot. In despair, Shen Qingyu fights with Pei Shuyi and accidentally dies. Through Shen Qingyu's experience, this drama reveals the darkness and betrayal of human nature, as well as the helplessness and struggle of terminal patients facing both fate and emotional devastation.

2259660.title: The Retired Tycoon's Relentless Pursuit (Love Before Sunset)
2259660.description: Wang Xiulian encounters Liu Caixia, a fellow former sent-down youth from thirty years ago, at a retirement community. Liu Caixia constantly bullies Wang Xiulian to help her best friend Li Guihua win back her ex-husband Li Zhenting. When crisis strikes, Wang Xiulian's first love Li Zhenting steps forward to save her from danger. Her three sons also arrive in time to protect their mother. With the help of her three sons, the former lovers reunite and finally find happiness together.
2259660.originName: 退休后豪门大佬求追不舍

2259769.title: The Strongest War God
2259769.description: The strongest war god Chen Xuanyuan is searching for the legendary treasure Linglong Heart to restore his powers. He encounters Han Mengxue who is being oppressed, so he decides to marry into the Han family to help her while secretly seeking information about the treasure.

2259839.title: Destiny - Three Wealthy Heiresses Propose After Divorce
2259839.description: Zhou Aiguo, the God of War of Great Xia, returns home victoriously after ending his campaigns and learns that his son has just been found. The God of War orders that his son must be given the finest life to make up for years of neglect. His son Lu Yu is about to be released from prison. Three years ago, Lu Yu took the blame and went to jail for his wife Su Yanran. Now released, he hoped his wife would pick him up, but no one came, and he clashed with the War Emperor of Jiangzhou. Then Yu Ling, the God of War's servant, arrives with people to teach everyone a lesson and tells Lu Yu that he is actually the son of the God of War. Now that the God of War has returned, she has been ordered to serve Lu Yu. The God of War prepared huge funds for his son to spend freely. Lu Yu wanted to find Su Yanran to share the news, but discovered that Su Yanran had already cheated with Zhou Tianqi. Faced with Lu Yu's questioning, Su Yanran and Zhou Tianqi humiliated him repeatedly. Zhou Tianqi even warned him to divorce quickly, as he would be engaged to Su Yanran in a few days. The angry Lu Yu wanted to fight on the spot but was stopped by his sister-in-law Chen Yuning. Seeing that this pair of adulterers didn't take him seriously, Lu Yu decided to reveal his identity at the engagement party. At the engagement party, Zhou Tianqi gained support from several major families of Xia Kingdom and was in great glory. Then Lu Yu arrived and disrupted the engagement party. Several major families all looked down on this seemingly 'poor boy'. Lu Yu secretly kept track of them. As the conflict escalated, Lu Yu revealed his identity as the son of the God of War of Great Xia...
2259839.originName: 天命--离婚后三大豪门女神来提亲

2259908.title: Adorable Baby from Heaven
2259908.description: When Bai Qingqing's best friend Chu Qiao is murdered, she tries to find the truth but gets framed instead. After a one-night stand with a stranger, the video falls into her fiancé Shen Yihan's hands, leading to their broken engagement. She then discovers that her own sister Bai Feifei and father Bai Zhengshan are behind everything. When exposed, they send her to a mental hospital. After being rescued by childhood friend Liu Huanyu, she spends five years abroad before returning for revenge. Back home, she repeatedly encounters Huo Group's CEO. Huo Yunchen's grandmother, in her old age, only wishes to see him married with children and even pretends to have a terminal illness. When she meets little Bai Tiantian, who looks remarkably like Huo Yunchen, he decides to enter a contract marriage with Bai Qingqing to comfort his grandmother. He helps her with revenge while she helps him...

2260013.title: The Priceless Son-in-Law
2260013.description: Ye Feng is a confident and powerful cultivator. In his past life, he was the heir to Jinxiu Group. After the company went bankrupt, he couldn't handle the blow and turned to alcohol, even abusing his wife, which led to her early death. Later, he accidentally entered the world of cultivation but died during ascension due to his inner demons. Reborn to a time when his wife was still alive, Ye Feng decides to make amends to his wife and reclaim everything that belongs to him.

2260148.title: Dignity
2260148.description: Middle-aged Chen Junyu faces unemployment and reluctantly divorces his wife. Once ambitious, he suddenly becomes an outcast abandoned by the big city. Thinking that returning to his village would be the only escape from the rat race, his pride leads to many embarrassing situations. With Xia Lin's help, he eventually joins the rural revitalization movement. At that moment, he finally understands life's true meaning: what holds us back is never our environment, but our narrow mindset.

2260248.title: The Double-Faced Hero
2260248.description: After a car accident, the protagonist's soul transmigrates into Chu Tian, a foolish son-in-law. When he awakens, he witnesses his wife Xiao Sirou having intimate interactions with Tang Hanyong (Young Master Tang), who speaks frivolously and humiliates Chu Tian as a "fool". Tang Hanyong's cousin Tang Tianao holds great power in Tang Group and is pushing forward a mysterious plan. Finding himself in this strange and complex environment, Chu Tian doesn't wallow in self-pity. Using wisdom from his previous life, he secretly investigates the truth behind the car accident and the Tang brothers' conspiracy. During his investigation, Chu Tian discovers many interconnected clues that seem to hide a huge chain of interests. While dealing with the Tang brothers and protecting his wife, Chu Tian gradually uncovers shocking secrets and completes his transformation from a foolish son-in-law to a powerful hero.

2260358.title: The Illegitimate Daughter
2260358.description: At his engagement party, CEO Pei Linchuan publicly abandons his fiancée Lin Yuwei and chooses Shen Zhiwei, an illegitimate daughter from her family. Unknown to him, she is a pawn planted by Lin Yuwei. The two develop real feelings while using each other and work together against Lin Yuwei's schemes. In the end, Shen Zhiwei exposes Lin Yuwei's crimes. In despair, Lin Yuwei stabs Shen Zhiwei to death before taking her own life, leaving Pei Linchuan heartbroken.

2260479.title: The Crossdressing Master
2260479.description: Song Xiaoxiao and Gu Cheng are forced into marriage by their grandmothers, but both escape the wedding for their first loves. Song Xiaoxiao asks her gay best friend Qin Ran to dress as a bride to replace her, while Gu Cheng accidentally escapes in a bridesmaid dress. Meeting in the basement without recognizing each other, Song Xiaoxiao even helps Gu Cheng escape. Unbeknownst to them, they are each other's childhood sweethearts. Two years later, Gu Cheng returns with three missions: find his first love, divorce Song Xiaoxiao, and find a suitable international relief supply company. To prevent their divorce, grandmother lies that Song Xiaoxiao is pregnant, making Gu Cheng think she cheated. Through multiple encounters, Gu Cheng mistakes Song Xiaoxiao for the person who helped him escape, not knowing she's his wife. He eventually mistakes Qin Ran for his wife. Song Xiaoxiao discovers the company she's competing with is Gu Cheng's and hides her identity while refusing divorce. As their relationship becomes ambiguous, just when they're about to recognize each other, Jiang Mei poses as Gu Cheng's first love at a bidding dinner, making Song Xiaoxiao retreat. When the fake pregnancy is exposed, Gu Cheng is happy. His lie about liking men is also exposed, clearing up the misunderstanding about Qin Ran and recognizing Song Xiaoxiao as his bride. When they're about to be together, Jiang Mei's fake identity stands between them again. Gu Cheng exposes Jiang Mei's lies and plans to remarry Song Xiaoxiao, but she has gone abroad for international rescue work. Gu Cheng chases her to a war zone where they reunite. In the chaos, Song Xiaoxiao is injured and Gu Cheng saves her, leading to their wedding. However, the truth is that Gu Cheng's eyes were injured in the bombing, causing blurred vision. He didn't save Song Xiaoxiao but a foreign woman in similar clothes. The final wedding is just Gu Cheng's fantasy, while Song Xiaoxiao sacrificed herself for the great rescue mission.

2260597.title: Divine Eye Medical Immortal
2260597.description: Gambling addict Chen Jianguo and greedy Bai Yufang sell the comatose Ling Wu to a wealthy family. During the process, Ling Hao gets injured and falls unconscious, his blood staining a jade pendant. When the wealthy family takes Ling Hao away, his sister Chen Qianyun blocks their car. Chen Qianyun is held back by her mother and brother, unable to stop them from taking Ling Hao. The wealthy family imprisons Ling Hao while waiting to harvest his organs. During this time, Ling Wu awakens his supernatural medical eye ability, regains consciousness, and gains powerful medical skills along with incredible strength and combat abilities.

2260714.title: Deep Love Never Fails (My Lucky Little Wife)
2260714.description: Qin Nianyu, a college student from the countryside, discovers on tuition payment day that all her money has been taken by her aunt's family. She learns that volunteering during a school inspection by Huo Tingshen, the powerful head of Beijing's most influential family, could earn her a scholarship. Desperate, she goes to the auditorium to try her luck, but unexpectedly ends up having a one-night stand with Huo Tingshen through a series of misunderstandings, only to have her cousin Xiao Ya take credit for it.

2260828.title: When the Dragon Warrior Awakens
2260828.description: Qin Wuyong, the Dragon Master of the True Dragon Hall and supreme leader of the Great Xia Nation with unmatched medical and martial arts skills, sent his spirit to infiltrate the Exile Lands filled with villains. Single-handedly, he eliminated countless evildoers and slayed an evil god, though many villains escaped to other regions. Meanwhile, his physical body in the real world, bearing the identity of an illegitimate son of the Qin family - the top aristocratic family in Hai City, slept for ten years. When Qin Wuyong awakens, he discovers that his first love Zhou Yan, unaware of his true identity, has cared for him for ten years and became a popular online influencer using this devoted image. However, for unknown reasons, Zhou Yan seems to be entangled with her top donor Liu Fanghao, who not only made her betray Qin Wuyong but also instigated her to harm him. Upon his return, Qin Wuyong easily defeats villains that the Dragon Claw Hall had been hunting for days, yet he deliberately takes slow revenge on Liu Fanghao, determined to uncover why Zhou Yan betrayed him.

2260922.title: Addicted to Abusing His Wife: Mr. Gu, Please Show Some Respect
2260922.description: Six years ago, Xia Yunxi rejected Gu Shenyan's marriage proposal, left him with a sick baby daughter, and disappeared, making him the laughingstock of the entire West City. Six years later, Xia Yunxi returns to West City in desperation with her son, hoping to see her daughter again. Gu Shenyan makes things difficult for her, demanding she work at a bar in exchange for seeing their daughter. Forced to accept, Xia Yunxi nearly gets assaulted by perverted men at the bar. Gu Shenyan rescues her at the critical moment and brings her home as a servant, requiring her to hide her identity from their daughter. Xia Yunxi endures everything silently, but faces constant targeting from Gu Shenyan's new fiancée, Xia Yunqian, who stole her identity as the Xia family heiress five years ago and now hates her deeply, even planning kidnapping to eliminate her. Only when Gu Shenyan is about to lose Xia Yunxi does he realize he still loves her. He risks his life to save her and confesses his feelings. At this moment, fate plays an even crueler joke: her frequent dizziness and nosebleeds are symptoms of acute leukemia, and she only has six months to live. Xia Yunxi disappears again without a word. The last news Gu Shenyan receives is that she's about to marry another man - He Qiming. Gu Shenyan uses all his power to suppress the He family. Unable to bear dragging He Qiming down, Xia Yunxi brings her son to negotiate with Gu Shenyan, offering to return the son to the Gu family if he stops attacking the He family. This makes Gu Shenyan blame her even more for being heartless, not knowing she's seriously ill. When he finally learns the truth, he deeply regrets it, but Xia Yunxi's condition can no longer withstand any shock. They agree to spend their final journey together peacefully with both children, putting aside past love and hatred. In this brief time, Xia Yunxi experiences the sweetest moments of her life and marries Gu Shenyan. But this is just the beginning of another conspiracy...

2260990.title: The CEO's Personal Doctor
2260990.description: Yang Tian, heir to ancient medical arts, descends from the mountains to complete his master's mission. He encounters his arranged fiancée whom he has never met before. She immediately wants to break off their engagement. Watch how he wins her heart.

2261078.title: Daughter, I Was Wrong
2261078.description: Lin Xiaoran and her mother are in a car accident, and her mother is injured. The ambulance Lin Xiaoran called is secretly taken by her father Lin Yang for his first love and her child, causing Lin Xiaoran's mother to die. As a helpless child, Lin Xiaoran tells her father the truth about her mother's death, but Lin Yang refuses to believe it. He continues to favor his first love's child and blames Lin Xiaoran. Through repeated grievances, Lin Xiaoran decides to seek justice for her mother.

2261210.title: Little Genius from Seven Years Later (Super Baby's Perfect Match)
2261210.description: Jin Chenyan's biggest wish is for his parents to spend time with him together, as his father is always busy with work and neglects the family. During his birthday, an accident sends him back seven years to when his parents hadn't met yet. Jin Chenyan decides to find a new father, but unexpectedly becomes the perfect matchmaker for his parents. The family of three works together to fight against villain hackers and saves dad's company. In the end, the family lives together in sweet and loving harmony.

2261311.title: Dragon Lord Judge
2261311.description: Xiao Yuntian is a divine doctor's disciple with unmatched medical and poison skills. To master a powerful technique, he must endure seven years without using his medical abilities. As this period nears its end, his evil mother-in-law wants to kick him out and remarry his wife Su Man to another man (Chu Shao). However, when Su Man is being sent to the Chu family, an accident occurs. A car crash nearly kills Su Man, but Chu Shao only wants to play around and doesn't plan to save her. Instead, he teams up with a corrupt doctor to sell Su Man's heart and kidneys. When this news reaches Xiao Yuntian, he becomes furious and saves his wife at the critical moment while punishing the villains. Meanwhile, a prestigious family selection competition is about to begin. Xiao Yuntian lets his wife represent the Su family in the contest. In fact, Xiao Yuntian once saved the respected Elder Qi with his medical skills, and the decision power for this highly coveted family selection actually lies in Xiao Yuntian's hands. In the end, Xiao Yuntian defeats all those who looked down on him and helps his wife become the new head of the prestigious family.

2261368.title: The Dragon in the Jianghu
2261368.description: A Le spent his whole life in the underworld. Out of loyalty, he took the fall for his boss, Dongguan‑Zai, and ended up in prison for over twenty years. When he got out, Dongguan‑Zai welcomed him back as promised—and bluntly told him that A Le’s daughter, Tongtong, was getting married that very day. Only at the hotel entrance did A Le realize the man who’d pledged to look after his daughter was actually planning to marry her. In the ensuing clash, Dongguan‑Zai shamelessly confessed that he had also been responsible for A Le’s wife’s death. Fueled by rage, A Le tried to turn him in, but Dongguan‑Zai stabbed him to death. With his eyes wide open, he watched the scoundrel marry his daughter and murder his wife. Consumed by hatred, A Le inexplicably found himself reborn, back on the day he drew the fatal lot—already marked to take Dongguan‑Zai’s place in prison.  Pretending to agree, A Le rushed home to grab his wife and daughter and flee, only to be cornered by Dongguan‑Zai. To force his compliance, Dongguan‑Zai ordered his men to kidnap the two women, threatening A Le into going to jail. With his family in peril, A Le suddenly remembered that Dongguan‑Zai, in league with Qinglong Gang’s deputy leader Qi Xiaoqiang, had murdered the gang boss’s sister‑in‑law. Determined to bring Dongguan‑Zai to justice and rescue his wife and child, A Le single‑handedly blocked a Qinglong Gang vehicle and exposed Qi Xiaoqiang’s plot.  The sister‑in‑law was due to attend the biennial Wanlong Assembly, where she would return the Dragon‑Head Staff—the symbol of unifying the underworld—and choose the next holder of the staff. Fearing further assassination attempts, she and the gang’s strategist concocted a ruse: they announced her “death” and appointed A Le as the new Qinglong Gang boss, entrusting him with the Dragon‑Head Staff. In exchange, she promised to send men to save A Le’s wife and child.  At the gang assembly, A Le squared off against Dongguan‑Zai. Facing the confrontation, he chos

2261435.title: Honey, I'm Really a Master Chef
2261435.description: A cooking master's disciple completes his training and is ready to leave. The master arranges a marriage for him before he goes down the mountain. Just as he leaves, beautiful CEO Su Qingqiu (the disciple's fiancée) comes up the mountain asking the master to come out of retirement. The master says he has hung up his knife and introduces his disciple Lin Yang instead. Su Qingqiu immediately orders a citywide search for him.

2261566.title: Love Across Time
2261566.description: (Fictional history) Prince Li Chengqian of the Great Qian Dynasty escapes the capital with his guard Duan Wuming to avoid an arranged marriage by hunting bandits. However, they are ambushed by thieves and while fleeing into a dense forest, they accidentally travel through time.

2261697.title: The Supreme Dragon Lord
2261697.description: Chu Ge rules supreme in the criminal realm, known as Dragon Lord. Following his master's orders, he descends the mountain to help the Ouyang family patriarch. However, upon returning to his family, he is suspected of being a fake divine healer and faces rejection from his father and cousin. Staying true to his principles, he uses his extraordinary medical skills and clever strategies to navigate conflicts within and outside his family, proving his worth through the Ouyang family crisis. In this complex situation, he continues to grow, using fearless courage and unwavering determination to break through obstacles and resolve crises. He must not only clear his name but also achieve greater ambitions in the vast world, writing his own legendary story.

2261846.title: Nine Stars Seal the Sky: The Five Elements Contract
2261846.description: Xinyi is sent down the mountain by his master to find the holders of the Five Elements Contract in Jiangzhou to rebuild the seal and prevent the awakening of the dark dragon Xuanchi. He becomes involved in the fierce struggle between the three remaining major forces in Jiangzhou. All factions want to control Xinyi to gain power from Xuanchi's spiritual energy. Xinyi maneuvers between the different clans, trying to form an alliance against the strongest City Lord's Mansion, while searching for the contract and clues about the missing Yunmu Hall.

2261978.title: King Kong vs Giant Python
2261978.description: Boss Gou from Shang Group hears about mysterious creatures called wild men living in Dragon Mountain, who reportedly live over 120 years on average. To unlock the secret of longevity and achieve new business success, he decides to find the perfect person for this task - biologist Bai Xue, who inherited her father's profession. Soon after, Bai Xue's father Bai Yuxia dies from a serious illness, warning her before his death never to go to Dragon Mountain. In fact, without her father's obstruction, Bai Xue can finally fulfill her wish to go to Dragon Mountain, thus embarking on a dangerous journey to hunt for the wild men.

2262106.title: The Heir
2262106.description: Wei Yang, heir to the Wei Group, suffers a serious "car accident" orchestrated by her sister Wei Yuxi's power grab. After surviving, Wei Yang pretends to have amnesia while secretly planning her counterattack. As Wei Yuxi continues her schemes and pressure, Wei Yang, with help from undercover agent Xia Liang, exposes Wei Yuxi's many crimes. In the end, Wei Yuxi breaks down and confesses at their father's grave before being arrested, while the severely injured Xia Liang miraculously recovers.

2262181.title: Contract Wedding in Progress
2262181.description: Bankrupt heiress Lin Xia signs a contract marriage with wealthy CEO Lu Chen: she helps him escape an arranged marriage, while he pays off her debts. Together they face Xu Muran who covets Lu Chen and Ma Sen who framed the Lin family. Through misunderstandings and schemes, the two work together to uncover the truth and discover the mastermind behind the Lin family's bankruptcy. Eventually, they turn their contract into true love, breaking the agreement with genuine feelings.

2262313.title: Diary of a Rich Heiress (The Rich Heiress Falls in Love with Me)
2262313.description: Before awakening, she was completely obsessed with love. For He Chen, she distanced herself from her family, dropped out of school to marry him, endured endless torture, but still forgave him in the end! After awakening, she returned to age 20, determined to escape the scumbag, change her introverted personality, reconcile with her family, and use her memories to defeat enemies and gain true happiness in love.

2262409.title: Husband's Plot for Family Fortune (A Stunning Mistake)
2262409.description: Set in the Republican era, Xie Wanning loved the wrong person in her past life. She was deceived by Ye Chuqin and Chu Muyao, leading to her family's destruction. After being reborn, she awakens to the truth and vows to protect her family, make their schemes fail, and make them pay the price. Xie Wanning, 20 years old, is the eldest daughter of the prestigious Xie family in Jiangning City. Despite her noble background and elegant demeanor, she fell in love with the superficial Ye Chuqin. In her past life, blinded by love, she was humiliated by the Ye family and fell from a proud noble lady to a resentful wife, ultimately bringing disaster to her family. After rebirth, Xie Wanning learns from her pain, punishes the unfaithful man and scheming woman, and uses her wisdom to form strong alliances that make the villains lose everything.

2262478.title: The Taoist Descends the Mountain: Five Marriage Contracts
2262478.description: This drama tells the story of Xinyi, a young man who lived in the mountains with his master. When he arrives in Jiangzhou, he seeks clues from five marriage contracts left by his master to uncover the mystery of his birth. Despite facing constant threats from villains, he never gives up his brave exploration. Through many challenges, Xinyi grows from a playful boy into a responsible young man. The story shows how even ordinary people can fight for justice with kindness and honesty, defeating evil schemes and proving that good always triumphs over evil. Through his persistent spirit of exploration, the drama presents themes of sacrifice, growth, and salvation. It fully demonstrates the traditional virtues of Chinese people and their awakening consciousness. In each conspiracy, though born in the wilderness, Xinyi never stops seeking truth and helping others, bringing inspiration, healing, hope and a sense of heritage.

2262531.title: The Boss's Woman Is Not to Be Messed With
2262531.description: In this ever-changing world of power and wealth, bosses stand at the top of the pyramid, commanding respect and fear. However, the women by their sides are often overlooked by the public eye. Don't underestimate them - the boss's woman is truly not to be messed with. They are far from being mere decorative accessories dependent on their powerful partners. Each boss's woman possesses unique charm and exceptional wisdom. Behind the boss's dazzling spotlight, they work quietly, accumulating their own strength. They attend high-end events, witness luxurious banquets and cruel business battles, experiencing countless storms that have forged their incredibly strong minds. When difficulties come like raging tides, they don't retreat like fragile flowers but choose to face all challenges head-on. On the surface, they may appear gentle and elegant with warm smiles, giving an impression of peaceful serenity. But beneath their seemingly delicate exterior lies a blade-sharp resilience. Once someone dares to cross their bottom line or threatens their cherished family, friends, and beliefs, they will strike back without hesitation. In complex social networks, they move like skilled chess players, using wisdom and strategy to navigate with ease. They can provide perfect support and gentle companionship in the boss's busy career, becoming a sanctuary for his soul, while also handling tough problems independently when needed. Don't mistake their gentleness for weakness, or their smiles for compromise. The boss's woman has unshakeable principles and admirable pride. They are not to be underestimated, because they know that only by being strong enough can they stand shoulder to shoulder with the boss and carve out their own place in this turbulent world.

2262671.title: Super Mission: The Big Villain
2262671.description: Ordinary man Zhou Yang accidentally travels to a novel world and receives a mission to win the true love of the female protagonist Su Ling'er. However, he discovers that his reborn body is actually Su Ling'er's father's killer. After several encounters, he meets Yao Na, daughter of the War God Hall master, who forcibly takes him as her boyfriend, leading to touching emotional entanglements. Later, he discovers that the real killer of Su Ling'er's father is Nan Aotian, who has awakened self-awareness and plans to create a novel world where villains rule supreme. The battle begins...

2262755.title: Oh No, That Vampire Lives Again
2262755.description: Sheng Languan suffers from a vampire disease that burns her skin in sunlight. Despised by everyone since childhood, she endures constant bullying from Sheng Lanxiang, who repeatedly drags her into sunlight, leaving her face scarred and forcing her to wear a veil. Her low self-esteem makes her easy prey for the scheming Shen Congwen, who marries her only to steal her grandfather's fortune. On their wedding day, Shen Congwen and Sheng Lanxiang conspire to kill her by sunlight exposure, revealing their greedy plot. As Sheng Languan dies, she curses them both. Miraculously, nine generations of vampire ancestors grant her three chances to return to three days earlier, along with supernatural vampire powers. Reborn with these abilities, she begins her revenge against the scoundrels while finding love with Gu Siyan, her husband's enemy.
2262755.originName: 不好，那个吸血鬼又活了

2262864.title: Red Spider Lily
2262864.description: Three years ago, the Shen Group went bankrupt. The eldest daughter Shen Mengchen underwent plastic surgery to become Lin Nan and secretly worked as an assistant beside Gu Yantang. The younger daughter Shen Mengxi returned with the help of Lu Anliang. The two sisters launched a revenge plan, but gradually discovered the true culprit behind the massacre three years ago.

2262921.title: Run, Yingzi
2262921.description: In a remote mountain village, Li Yingzi finally fulfills her parents' expectations through her relentless efforts and exceptional talent by getting accepted into her dream university. The whole family is filled with joy and pride. However, fate plays a cruel joke on this determined girl. Just before Yingzi is about to embark on her new life journey, a sudden earthquake breaks the village's tranquility and completely changes her world.

2263047.title: Billionaire
2263047.description: The protagonist receives an expensive delivery order in the middle of a quiet night. Curious and puzzled, he goes to the designated location, but this trip unexpectedly leads him into deep trouble. This accident causes his fate to swap with another person. During this difficult and challenging process, destiny arranges for him to meet a beautiful wealthy lady. Together, they embark on a journey to fight evil spirits. With courage and wisdom, they battle various evil forces and work to break conspiracy after conspiracy, moving forward step by step in this thrilling and magical adventure.

2263172.title: My Domineering Senior Falls in Love with Me
2263172.description: Fresh graduate Tian Xiaotong faces harassment from her weird boss during her internship and quits her job. Things get worse when she catches her boyfriend cheating and moves out immediately. Surprisingly, her new roommate turns out to be the person she hated most during her school days. As their daily life together unfolds with hilarious situations, she unexpectedly falls in love with Jiang Chuan.

2263313.title: Love You Forever
2263313.description: Eight years ago, unknown actor Su Tong met and fell in love with kind makeup artist An Cheng on a film set, creating sweet memories together. However, to protect Su Tong's budding career from her gambling-addicted and greedy father An Jianguo's harassment and blackmail, An Cheng heartlessly broke up with him, enduring her father's troubles and inner pain alone. Eight years later, Su Tong has become a top celebrity. At a new drama launch event with his co-star Zi Jin, he unexpectedly spots An Cheng working as staff, stirring up emotions within him. The reunited Su Tong, still hurt by the "truth" of their breakup, treats An Cheng coldly and even mocks her "broken rich family dreams." An Cheng avoids discussing it and silently bears his misunderstanding and her own struggles. Meanwhile, Su Tong can't control his protective instincts toward An Cheng, repeatedly defending her from Xu Ya's bullying while accidentally discovering the bitter truth behind their breakup. When Zi Jin accidentally discovers their relationship, this lost and found love no longer needs to be hidden, and their years of misunderstanding finally resolve. Cast: Liu Lingcan as An Cheng, Ma Jiaming as Su Tong.

2263454.description: (Sub ID) To the past, using modern science to make regions prosperous, and then…

His culinary prowess combined with the restaurant's convenient location will have customers returning for more!

2264155.description: After a one-night stand, they rushed into marriage; only to discover after tying the knot that he had once saved her life—and now, out of nowhere, he’s the big CEO!

2264236.description: Because of a misunderstanding, she divorced the man she loved. After the divorce, she lost her memory and ended up marrying her ex-husband’s brother.
