2266672.description: I signed a fake marriage contract, only to find out my husband is my own older brother? He’s handsome, rich, and absolutely dotes on me…

2266794.title: After the divorce, my ex-husband broke down (Thai dubbed version)
2266794.description: He used to treat her with indifference, and now she can’t even look his way? No—she’s the one; he’s been going to great lengths to win her back!

2266855.title: What Can You Do When the Boss Demands a Marriage of Convenience (Thai Dubbed Version)
2266855.description: Seated in a wheelchair, he tossed down the contract: “Marry me, and I’ll give you everything you need.” After we were married, he would hold me close every night until dawn.

2266995.title: Cooling Love
2266995.description: Su Wan and Lu Ze develop romantic feelings during a work project, but their relationship gradually cools down due to Lu Ze's passive nature and Su Wan's sensitivity, leading them to quietly part ways. A year later, they reunite through work and discover they still care for each other. While working together on a new project, they are forced to communicate openly and realize their breakup was based on misunderstandings. They work hard to get close again, rekindling their cooled romance and finally finding happiness together.

2267063.title: Wild Tenderness
2267063.description: At eighteen, Xu Xing's mother died tragically and her father forced her to give her heart to save her stepsister. She escaped to a mountain village where she met Wen Qiu, who adopted and protected her. Wen Qiu helped her overcome her trauma, but on the day Xu Xing confessed her love after graduation, they were separated by a landslide. To find her beloved, Xu Xing changed her major to geology and waited four years. When they reunited, Wen Qiu had exiled himself due to his own trauma. Through Xu Xing's persistence, he finally admitted his feelings. As they healed each other, their fierce protection transformed into lasting tenderness.

2267173.title: Legendary Beauty in War
2267173.description: During the chaotic Republic of China era, female warlord Su Ningshuang uses her courage and strategy to establish herself in wartime, showing her legendary grace. She allies with patriotic general Gu Yanshen to fight foreign enemies. Though they initially clash over tactics, they come to appreciate each other's patriotism through battles together. They protect each other in gunfire, balancing duty to country with personal feelings, ultimately joining hands to defend their homeland and finding love in troubled times.

2267265.title: The Lady's Clever Schemes
2267265.description: Mrs. Shen, Su Wan, appears gentle but is actually sharp-minded and loves to scheme. Facing her husband Gu Yanchen's tests and family plots, she uses clever strategies to solve problems and gradually makes Gu Yanchen fall deeply for her, winning his true heart.

2267381.title: She Conquers All Opposition
2267381.description: Su Wan, wife of Fuyan Group CEO Fu Yanchen, has a bold personality. She gains respect from skeptical senior employees with sharp business decisions and counters scheming rivals by exposing their plots against the company. Her fierce approach to 'conquering opposition' amazes everyone. Fu Yanchen, far from being upset, is deeply attracted to her strength and wisdom. He publicly supports his wife as they fight together in both business and love, creating explosive sweetness.

2267441.title: Young Master Fu's Childhood Sweetheart is Bold and Beautiful
2267441.description: Su Wei, the childhood friend of Fu Yanchen, head of Fu Group, enters the business world with her design talent. Facing plagiarism and harassment from competitors and opponents of the Fu family, Su Wei never backs down. She fights back with her original works and wins countless fans with her bold and beautiful style. Fu Yanchen has protected her since childhood and now becomes her strongest support, helping her overcome all obstacles. Their childhood friendship blossoms into love through their partnership and they finally find happiness together.
2267441.originName: 傅爷的小青梅又飒又美

2267559.title: The Palace Maid Fuyao's Rise
2267559.description: Fuyao, a lowly palace maid, uses her wit and resilience to survive in the imperial palace, repeatedly escaping the traps of competing concubines. She meets Prince Xiao Jingyuan, who has great ambitions but little power. Seeing his potential, she secretly helps him by passing messages and resolving crises. In return, the prince protects her and helps her escape her menial duties. Together they support each other through palace intrigue, and Fuyao transforms from a nameless servant into a capable ally who can stand alongside the prince as his trusted partner and soulmate.

2267763.title: Ultimate Sweet Talk
2267763.description: Shen Yan and Su Yu work at the same company. When Su Yu is questioned over a mistake, Shen Yan steps in to help her. Whenever Su Yu gets upset, Shen Yan uses his 'ultimate sweet talk' to cheer her up: working overtime with her on projects, taking her to eat her favorite desserts, and telling heartwarming jokes. During office conflicts, Shen Yan protects her while Su Yu helps him through crises. Through countless moments of comfort and support, their feelings grow stronger, and they eventually get married. Shen Yan's company also develops steadily.

2267878.title: A Summer Love Story
2267878.description: Art student Lu Ze travels to the seaside for inspiration and meets Xia Wan, a girl working at a local inn. Together they watch sunrise over the ocean and paint sunset scenes on the beach, spending a sweet and innocent summer vacation. When summer ends, Lu Ze must return to school while Xia Wan stays home to care for her grandmother. The distance forces them apart, but this "summer love story" becomes a light in both their hearts. Years later when they meet again, they run to each other without hesitation.

2268017.title: Thirty Percent Obedient
2268017.description: She maintains a "thirty percent obedient" gentle image in front of her family, but is actually independent and daring. After falling in love with cold CEO Gu Yanchen, she gradually reveals her true personality: standing firm on principles at work and occasionally showing her temper in life. However, Gu Yanchen prefers her "disobedient" side and appreciates her independence and liveliness. The two find harmony through understanding and acceptance. Beneath the "thirty percent obedient" facade lies a deep connection between two matching souls.

2268149.title: After Flash Marriage, Mr. Fu Can't Hide His Secret Identity
2268149.description: Jewelry designer Meng Ning enters a flash marriage with Fu Tingxiu to escape arranged dates, thinking he's just an ordinary employee. When Meng Ning faces career obstacles, Fu Tingxiu secretly helps by arranging interviews and clearing workplace barriers, gradually exposing his true identity as a multinational corporation CEO. From shock to understanding, the couple navigates between secrets and honesty. Eventually, Fu Tingxiu drops his disguise and protects Meng Ning's dreams and their love with his true heart.
2268149.originName: 闪婚后，傅先生马甲藏不住了

2268262.title: Tender Pursuit
2268262.description: Business tycoon Gu Yanchen falls in love at first sight with designer Su Wan. Due to their social gap, he doesn't dare express his feelings directly, so he launches a 'tender pursuit' plan: secretly securing project resources for her, bringing late-night snacks when she works overtime, and staying by her side through difficult times. Su Wan gradually notices his care, moving from initial confusion to understanding. During a project crisis, Gu Yanchen steps forward to publicly protect her, finally breaking through their barriers and beginning a mutual love story.

2268360.title: Secret Treasure
2268360.description: Business tycoon Gu Yanchen falls for designer Su Wan at first sight. To protect her from family conflicts, he keeps her as his 'secret treasure' - arranging a private studio for her, blocking all harassment, and quietly planning their future. Su Wan initially doesn't understand his possessiveness, but later discovers his 'protection' is pure love - he remembers her preferences and helps fulfill her design dreams. Eventually, Su Wan understands his deep affection and responds to this love hidden in every detail.

2268411.title: Torn Night
2268411.description: After catching her boyfriend cheating, she breaks up with him after a painful night of heartbreak. She throws herself into her career and meets Gu Yanchen, her ex-boyfriend's business rival. Gu Yanchen admires her strength and helps her when her ex seeks revenge, staying by her side through countless healing nights. With his support, Su Wan recovers from her heartbreak. Through their business partnership, they grow closer, and the pain of dark nights finally transforms into the love of dawn.

2268527.title: Breaking Rules for Love
2268527.description: Arrogant race car driver Lu Ye constantly "breaks his rules" after meeting intern reporter Su Xiao. He deliberately slows down his car for her to take photos, stands up for her when she's bullied, and these actions that go against his principles reveal his hidden feelings for her.

2268586.title: He's Too Wild
2268586.description: Jiang Ye is the school's rebellious bad boy known for being "too wild," yet he pays special attention to transfer student Su Wei. When Su Wei faces troubles in her new environment, Jiang Ye secretly protects her in his seemingly domineering way: blocking harassers and helping her with studies. Behind his rebellious actions lies tender affection. Su Wei gradually sees his true heart, and they develop a love story that blends wildness with gentleness amidst the bustling campus.

2268712.title: Hard to Tame
2268712.description: Shooting champion Lu Ye and strong-willed girl Su Wei first met in high school and developed deep feelings. When Lu Ye proposed at the peak of his career, Su Wei suddenly left due to family pressure and obstacles, creating misunderstandings between them. Four years later, fate brings them together again. Facing past wounds and new challenges, Lu Ye's rebellious nature clashes with Su Wei's resilience, creating sparks. Eventually they resolve their misunderstandings, overcome obstacles, and find their true love again.

2268837.title: Oops! My Sugar Boy Is Actually a Big Boss
2268837.description: To spite her cheating ex, Su Wan "adopts" the seemingly gentle Gu Chen as her "sugar boy." While Gu Chen appears meek and obedient, he's actually a retired business tycoon. When Su Wan's family faces a business crisis and bankruptcy, Gu Chen reveals his true identity, easily defeating their rivals and saving the company. Su Wan realizes she "picked the wrong person" to support, but has already fallen for him through their daily interactions, ultimately transforming their contract relationship into true love.
2268837.originName: 完蛋我养的小白脸是大佬

2268965.title: The Rouge Blade
2268965.description: During the Republic of China era, female spy Su Ninghuang disguises herself as a rouge shop owner, using ruthless methods like a 'rouge blade' to carry out secret missions. Warlord Gu Yanshen encounters her while investigating an arms case. Initially testing and confronting each other, they later discover a common goal - fighting against foreign enemies and traitors. Torn between national duty and love, Su Ninghuang's wisdom complements Gu Yanshen's courage. Together they complete their mission and find love in turbulent times.

2269080.title: Bite the Pear
2269080.description: A young girl named Qingli accidentally meets a mysterious boy named A'yao. Though A'yao appears cold, he always protects Qingli when she's in danger. As they spend time together, they gradually uncover A'yao's special identity and the secrets of Qingli's past. Their feelings grow stronger through moments of testing and protection.

2269217.title: The Seventh Night
2269217.description: Mystery novelist Su Wan discovers that the murder details in her book 'The Seventh Night' match real crime cases. Detective Lu Chen notices something strange and approaches her, and they decide to work together to catch the real killer. Every night, they analyze clues by comparing them with chapters from the novel. During their investigation, Lu Chen's steady nature complements Su Wan's sharp instincts, and romance blooms amid danger. 'The Seventh Night' becomes not only the key to solving the case, but also the beginning of their love story.

2269359.title: Sleeping with the Dark
2269359.description: Movie star Shen Yang accidentally enters a book and becomes a wealthy villain who abused the male lead Jiang Jin. At this time, Jiang Jin is imprisoned by the original character. To avoid the tragic fate of being destroyed, Shen Yang takes the initiative to be kind to Jiang Jin. Jiang Jin switches between being crazy and deeply humble. The two go from testing each other to working together to break free. Through self-redemption and mutual devotion, they break the script's destiny and complete a redemptive love that crosses book boundaries.

2269414.title: Love at First Sight
2269414.description: Su Qing and Gu Yanchen meet by chance at a coffee shop and feel instant attraction, but a misunderstanding causes them to part ways. Three years later, Su Qing starts at a new company only to discover her boss is Gu Yanchen. Their old feelings remain strong, and frequent work interactions help clear up the misunderstanding. Gu Yanchen actively pursues Su Qing, and they transform their initial spark into lasting love.

2269540.title: The Fake Heiress and the True Phoenix
2269540.description: Song Fu is reborn to the time when she was first adopted by the Song family. In her previous life, she was poisoned by her adoptive sister Song Mingzhu. In this new life, she watches coldly as Song Mingzhu fights for the wealthy family's identity, then turns to seek protection from the Yun financial group. Using her intelligence, Song Fu defeats Song Mingzhu's conspiracy with foreign capital at financial summits and underground auctions, and takes over the merger case of her former enemy Qi Junye. Qi Junye is attracted by her resilience and transforms from rival to ally. Eventually, Song Fu uses evidence to expose the truth, defeats Song Mingzhu, and gains both career success and love.
2269540.originName: 朱门假千金，寒门真凤凰

2269677.title: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss
2269677.description: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss

2269798.title: The Poor Girlfriend Turns Out to be a Rich Heiress
2269798.description: Lin Xiaomeng, from a poor family, meets Lin Tianxiang at a party and mistakes him for an ordinary college student. They quickly fall in love. During their relationship, Lin Xiaomeng accidentally discovers that Lin Tianxiang is actually the son of the richest family, while she also uncovers her own true identity as a "fallen heiress," leading to anxiety about their social gap. However, Lin Tianxiang has known everything all along and values her sincerity and kindness, always staying by her side. Together they overcome external doubts and family obstacles. With Lin Tianxiang's support, Lin Xiaomeng adapts to her new identity and finally achieves perfect love and a happy life.
2269798.originName: 落魄女友竟是首富千金

During an unexpected overtime, Su Qing helps Lu Ze resolve an urgent crisis, breaking their stereotypes and discovering each other's hidden gentleness and resilience. As they spend more time together, love quietly blooms. Through facing workplace competition and life challenges together, they transform from bickering rivals to soulmates, showing that true love begins with understanding.

2271553.title: Marry to Become Stronger and Conquer the Northern Barbarians
2271553.description: Lin Feng, a young man from humble origins, accidentally discovers that his power increases dramatically after marriage. To protect his homeland, he marries a brave and intelligent general's daughter. With the strength gained from marriage, he leads his army into battle, overcoming all obstacles, and finally conquers the northern barbarian enemies.

2272967.title: Deadly Marriage
2272967.description: Housewife Su Yao lives a seemingly perfect life on the surface, but secretly endures psychological control and hidden domestic abuse from her husband Lu Yuanshan. Lu Yuanshan appears to be a refined financial elite in public, but privately uses tools like fountain pens to control her, manipulating Su Yao's life through incidents like the 'shopping cart event.' After repeated suppression and awakening, Su Yao transforms from trembling when signing documents to confidently writing divorce papers, gradually breaking free from his control. The drama uses dual narratives to expose power struggles and human dilemmas in marriage, showing Su Yao's journey from dependence to independence.

2273069.title: Reborn in the 80s: The Fierce Wife Takes Charge
2273069.description: Jiang Niannian is reborn back to the 1980s and begins her journey to rewrite her destiny. Using her advanced knowledge, she first makes cola to earn her first fortune, then uses electronics knowledge to fix old appliances and build wealth. She later takes over a failing textile factory, introduces modern design concepts to transform it into a successful clothing company. With the support of her husband Shen Tianyou, she uses her brilliant business mind and courage to become a famous local businesswoman and one of the richest women, writing a legendary story of female entrepreneurship in the 1980s.

2273212.title: Bringing the Nation's Husband Home
2273212.description: Ordinary office worker Su Qing accidentally gets caught up in dating rumors with top star Gu Yanchen. To calm the scandal, Gu Yanchen suggests they sign a 'contract romance' agreement, letting her 'bring the nation's husband home.' During their fake relationship, Gu Yanchen maintains a loving act in front of cameras but is gradually touched by Su Qing's sincerity. Su Qing also discovers his gentle side behind the glamorous image. Through fan doubts and media pressure, their fake love becomes real, and they finally confess their true feelings to find genuine love.

2274652.title: To Bend the Waist
2274652.description: Adapted from Peng Laike's novel of the same name, set in a fictional chaotic world during the late Eastern Han Dynasty. The Wei and Qiao families are enemies due to past grievances. After the Qiao family's decline, they betray their eldest daughter and marry Xiao Qiao to Wei Shao. Wei Shao, harboring hatred for his father and brother's tragic deaths, coldly sends Xiao Qiao back to her hometown in Youzhou the day after their wedding. However, using memories from her past life and her own wisdom, Xiao Qiao overcomes the Wei family's difficulties and Empress Su E's repeated schemes. During times of crisis, she and Wei Shao support each other. Wei Shao is gradually moved by her gentleness and courage, lets go of his hatred, and begins pursuing his wife. Eventually, they work together to resolve their family conflicts. Wei Shao becomes emperor, Xiao Qiao becomes empress, and together they protect the peace of the realm.

2287302.description: During a ball, Scarlet's fiancé, Kyle, abruptly ends their engagement. She is wrongfully referred to as a "Villainess" and falsely accused of bullying. She is condemned by all the great families and aristocrats. She endured years of his foolishness and cruelty, but she can't stand it any longer! At the end of her rope, she requests one final favor: to punch him in the face. Scarlet's tale of retaliation against Kyle and his associates begins here! A fantasy about a fighter who is both elegant and defiant, and who refuses to be used!

2287409.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 3 (Dub Thailand)
2287409.description:
Everybody has a side they keep hidden from others—

During this era, nations across the world were locked in fierce, covert struggles for information. For over a decade, the Westalis and the rival nation of Ostania had been entangled in a relentless cold war.

Twilight, an elite spy working for WISE—the Western Intelligence Agency’s East Division—was assigned a top-secret mission: to monitor the movements of Donovan Desmond, the leader of Ostania’s National Unity Party and a looming threat to fragile East-West peace.

The mission carried a code name: Operation Strix.

2287674.title: A Mortal's Journey(Thai Dub)
2287674.description: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

2287773.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End (Season 2)
2287773.description:
The account of the day after the heroic troop defeated the Demon King - the "after that" story.
Frieren, being a magician, is an elf who is distinct from the other three.
I have a different perspective on what it's like to live and feel in the "after" world...
Beginning with "The End of the Adventure," the remaining people in the world weave stories of funerals and prayers.

2287888.title: B.King
2287888.description: This is the tale of a well-known cartoonist who rose to fame thanks to his comic book.B.K. But after several years, he ran out of ideas and had to rely solely on abandoning his characters in order to draw attention. He was drawn into the realm of B. King as Wang Xiaoming after receiving an enigmatic phone call one day. As a result, Wang Xiaoming, who now possesses the ideas of the "creator," sets out on a fantastical journey that might be summed up as "God's shortcut, one step to heaven."

2287991.title: SPY x FAMILY Season 3 (Dub Indo)
2287991.description:
Everybody has a side they keep hidden from others—

During this era, nations across the world were locked in fierce, covert struggles for information. For over a decade, the Westalis and the rival nation of Ostania had been entangled in a relentless cold war.

2288120.title: One-Punch Man Season 3 (Dub Indo)
2288120.description:
For fun, Saitama turned into a hero. He developed unstoppable power via three years of specialized training, and today he is a hero who can defeat any foe with a single blow (One Punch).

Saitama starts official hero activities at the Hero Association alongside Genos, who happened to be his apprentice.

When the Monster Association unexpectedly shows up and kidnaps the executives' children, the Hero Association is forced into a crisis. In order to free the hostages, the S-Class Heroes band together and plan to raid the Monster Association's hideout.

At the same time, the "human monster" Garou awakens inside the Monster Association's lair.

2288197.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN The Culling Game Part 1
2288197.description:
October 31, 2018. During the Halloween celebrations, a mysterious barrier suddenly sealed off the Shibuya Station area, trapping countless civilians inside.
The strongest sorcerer of the modern era, Gojo Satoru, entered the scene alone—unaware that cursed users and cursed spirits lay in wait, plotting to seal him away. As Itadori Yuji and other jujutsu sorcerers converged on Shibuya, the most devastating curse conflict in history erupted: the Shibuya Incident.
Yet the tragedy did not mark the end of the chaos. Instead, it gave rise to a deadly game of mutual slaughter orchestrated by the worst sorcerer in history, Kamo Kenjaku—the Culling Game. Ten barrier colonies became hellish battlegrounds, and amid the carnage, the special-grade sorcerer Okkotsu Yuta emerged as Itadori’s appointed executioner.
As the curses grew ever more frenzied, two students trained by the same master were forced into a lethal confrontation.

2288339.title: Sentenced to Be a Hero
2288339.description:
In this world, a so‑called “hero” is nothing more than the cruelest form of punishment. Those burdened with grave sins are branded with the title “Hero” and condemned to the punishment of battling the Demon King. Even if they fall in combat, they are forcibly resurrected—death itself is not permitted.
Zaylo Forbatz, the former captain of the Holy Knights, was subjected to this “Hero Punishment.” Now he leads a punitive hero squad composed of twisted, convicted criminals, fighting and bleeding on the front lines of the battlefield.
In this bleak despair, Zaylo encounters one of the strongest living weapons—The Sword Goddess, Teolita. Her words to him were chilling yet strange: “When you have slain every last enemy, be sure to praise my name… and then pat my head.”
To survive, and to avenge those who framed him, Zaylo makes a pact with the “Goddess.” With that bond forged, he throws himself into this desperate world—a storm of brutal slaughter and sinister conspiracies.

2288405.title: You and I Are Polar Opposites
2288405.description: This is a romantic comedy that tells the story of Suzuki, an outgoing and cheerful girl who is overly conscious of others’ opinions, and Tani, a quiet and reserved boy who isn’t afraid to speak his mind honestly. Despite their completely opposite personalities, the two consistently respect each other while navigating a series of misunderstandings and miscommunications, gradually deepening their understanding of one another. The story also depicts their everyday school life spent together with friends.

2288502.title: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
2288502.description:
Already at his wit's end, 29-year-old corporate slave Seiichirou Kondou suddenly witnesses the ground opening up and swallowing a woman. Amid his efforts to save her, the two are transported to another world. He soon learns that the people in this world summoned a saint to save their kingdom from a plague. As compensation for dragging Kondou into the mess, the kingdom assures him that they will provide him with a comfortable life and fulfill any of his desires. To everyone's surprise, Kondou asks for a job.

After successfully becoming an accountant at the Royal Palace, Kondou devotes himself to his new post. His accurate and thorough work catches the attention of various high-ranking officials and knights, especially Aresh Indolark, the cold-hearted Knight Captain. As Kondou adjusts to his new exhausting and dangerous environment, he begins to find solace in the company of Aresh, whose icy demeanor may be just a facade.
2288502.originName: 異世界の沙汰は社畜次第

2288556.title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village Into the Strongest Fortified City
2288556.description: At the age of two, Van, the fourth son of a powerful aristocrat, recalls his previous existence as a Japanese salaryman. He is regarded as a child prodigy since he has an adult brain in a young body—that is, until he demonstrates the "Production Magic" ability when he reaches eight. This crafting ability is deemed useless in combat by a family that prefers offensive magic, and Van is exiled to manage a small rural village in shame. Can Van make this small village—and himself—better with just his personal maid, his recollections of his former life, and his "worthless" magic?
2288556.originName: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛

2288703.title: Dead Account
2288703.description:
What would happen to a deceased person’s social media account?
The accounts left behind by the departed — the so‑called dead accounts — ultimately come back to life in the present world as digital ghosts, disguised to look like ordinary profiles… 
Soji Enishiro, in order to earn money for his sister Hiiro’s medical treatment, broadcasts every day under the controversial streamer name “Ageringo.”
However, through a certain turn of events, Soji awakens the power of electricity and is brought to the peculiar Yaden Academy, a school where spirits digitized by the spread of the internet are purified and where a new generation of spirit mediums is trained! 
Burning, striking, purifying — the modern‑style spirit medium action game begins!

2288932.title: Tamon's B-Side
2288932.description:
Utage Kinoshita is a high school student and a devoted fan of Tamon Fukuhara, a member of the immensely popular idol group F/ACE. One day, while working her part‑time job, she is unexpectedly sent to Tamon’s house as part of her work! And to her surprise, Tamon’s true personality is completely opposite to his sexy and wild idol image… a gloomy, introverted young man with low self‑esteem. 

“Tamon is a god!!”
“Say it again!”

No matter what he’s like in private, Tamon is still Tamon — and Utage is determined to support him with all her strength! But even this gloomy, introverted Tamon begins to stir her heart…? 

An intense online‑to‑offline interaction ×
The idol‑fan romance comedy begins!

2289079.title: The Daily Life of a Part-Time Torturer
2289079.description:
This is a world where killing and torture are legalized. Among the many torture outsourcing companies that operate in this society, Spirytus, Inc. stands out as a top‑tier “white company” dedicated exclusively to dealing with evil people. 

Four part‑timers work there: Cero, the thoughtful senior who’s skilled at everything and can make friends with anyone; the legendary veteran of the torture world, Shiu; the energetic, cute, hard‑working newcomer Miche; and the earnest, kind‑hearted college student Hugh. 

In their warm and friendly workplace, they go about their duties with relaxed camaraderie every day. 

There are also ragmen and cleaners… and, unexpectedly, even assassins!? A cast of fun and reliable specialists keeps showing up, and life with these colorful coworkers turns out to be surprisingly cozy. 

A slightly dark but lighthearted workplace comedy begins now!
2289079.originName: 拷問バイトくんの日常

2289171.title: Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None
2289171.description:
“I’ll never let anyone call me a shortcut taker again! One day, I’ll become a legendary adventurer known as a ‘Jack‑of‑All‑Trades’!”

Then one day…

The captain of the Hero Squad I belonged to — and my childhood friend, Oliver — cast me out, claiming my strength was inadequate.

To support the party, I had even changed my class from Swordsman to Enchanter and used my own original magic to aid my comrades — something I, Orn Doura, could never accept as insufficient. 

Yet those who were supposed to stand by my side mocked me as a shortcut taker, and had already chosen my successor.

In utter despair, I bade farewell to the Hero Squad. With renewed determination, I struck out alone as an adventurer…

Lost memories…
Power to defy injustice…
One after another, brand‑new encounters began to reshape my fate.

To protect the companions who matter most,
I will make use of the ultimate shortcuts on my journey toward becoming the strongest Jack‑of‑All‑Trades.

Thus begins this epic isekai fantasy of dramatic reversals and grand adventure!
2289171.originName: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏 ～パーティ事情で付与術士をやっていた剣士、万能へと至る～

2289319.title: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
2289319.description:
When Yuuki wakes up in an unfamiliar manor wearing a maid uniform, she recognizes this as the start of a new death game. After assessing the situation, Yuuki begins to wander before discovering a room with five other maids. Each one is visibly anxious, and she learns from them that they are all new players who joined this lethal game for the prize money.

But Yuuki is different: she is a death game veteran whose only goal is to achieve 99 consecutive wins. Tasked with navigating a manor filled with countless instruments of murder, Yuuki takes point as the only experienced player in an environment that is designed to actively work against her. Despite this, she is determined to reach the end of the game with as many people as possible—if it coincides with her final goal.

2289383.title: DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR Original By DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR WITH ENHYPEN
2289383.description:
In the beautiful seaside city of Riverfield stands the prestigious night school Decelis Academy. There, seven boys carry secret pasts hidden behind their ordinary school lives. Though they appear normal on the surface, they are actually vampires living among humans. 

One day, a female student named Sooha transfers to Decelis Academy. Having lost her friend in childhood, she harbors a deep hatred of vampires — yet the boys find themselves inexplicably drawn to her. 

Then a shocking series of incidents rocks the city, slowly revealing the boys' forgotten histories. As truths come to light, their world begins to change… and everything they thought they knew is turned upside down.

2289458.title: Kaya-chan Isn't Scary
2289458.description: Kaya-chan has a notorious reputation at kindergarten for causing all sorts of mischief. However, when Ms. Chie is put in charge of her, she quickly uncovers Kaya’s hidden talents. Brace yourself for a thrilling horror-action adventure right in the heart of the kindergarten!
2289458.originName: カヤちゃんはコワくない

2289611.title: Rooster Fighter
2289611.description: The fiercest rooster on this street isn’t just any ordinary bird — he’s humanity’s mighty guardian! His opponents may tower as high as ten stories, but nothing can match his iron‑strong heart and his terrifying battle cry — Cock-a-doodle-doo! Even louder!

2289667.title: There was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her
2289667.description:
Having been reincarnated into another world, Yuki, a former human turned demon, serves under the Demon Lord in a position that’s neither here nor there, tasked with defeating the hero.

Soon after, Yuki finds himself facing off against the very hero party that’s attacking the Demon Lord’s castle…

“…Wow, it’s so scary — like a blizzard.”

Unexpectedly, he falls in love at first sight with the hero party’s priestess, Cecilia!

Her earnest determination, her gentle manner — everything about her is so cute! She’s like an angel!
And so, Yuki resolves to confess his feelings — but then…?

A pure‑hearted yet slightly chūnibyō
fantasy romantic comedy about humans and demons!
2289667.originName: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her

2289748.title: Chained Soldier Season 2
2289748.description: Yuuki Wakura observes the destruction of Earth by opposing supernatural forces. Mato serve as entry points to alternate dimensions and as routes for dangerous monsters to flee. Women are given peaches as resources, which endows them with abilities. Kyouka Uzen, the chief of the Anti-Demon Corp's Seventh Unity, shows in to save Yuuki from a monster. Unexpectedly, Yuuki has the ability to boost the Peaches' potency. However, Yuuki has to be prepared to serve Kyouka both at home and on the battlefield if she is to save the planet.

2289875.title: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power

Gifted with an infinite level cap and a cheat ability that lets him inherit the skills of those under his command, he stands unrivaled. 2290065.title: The Holy Grail of Eris
2290065.description:
Constance Grail, a plain viscount’s daughter whose only real strength is honesty, finds herself trapped in a desperate situation after being set up at a banquet by the woman who stole her fiancé. As she faces imminent judgment and seeks help from those around her, not a single soul stands up to testify for her — even those who know the truth are utterly disappointed in her. 

Just when all hope seems lost, a whisper echoes in Constance’s ear: “I’ll help you…”
The voice belongs to Scarlet Castiel, the duchess who was executed ten years ago and is known as the infamous wicked woman. 

Though their meeting should have been impossible, the gears of fate begin to turn. As Constance and Scarlet join forces, they confront the sprawling conspiracies that run through aristocratic society. 

Soon, a vast plot that has remained hidden beneath the surface of noble society starts to come to light…

2290283.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart

Years later, Arisu is now a second-year high school student, determined to track down Apollo, driven by something he needs to tell her. He has no idea what she looks like or even her real name, yet he manages to uncover a few clues through his school’s broadcasting club. There, he encounters four girls who all aspire to careers that fully utilize their voices. Who exactly is Apollo, and how will the dreams of these four girls unfold?

In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people. 2300947.title: My Medical Immortal Life
2300947.description:
“My Life as a Medical Immortal” tells a tale brimming with fantasy and heartfelt warmth. The protagonist, Lin Xiao, is an ordinary hospital nurse—kind-hearted yet somewhat timid—who often shrinks from life’s many pressures. One day, she unexpectedly saves a mysterious man named Su Yang, only to discover that he is, in fact, a “Medical Immortal” banished to the mortal realm. Possessing extraordinary healing skills, Su Yang has lost most of his divine powers for violating heavenly law and must now live as an ordinary human. To regain his strength, he is forced to conceal his true identity and practice medicine among mortals, saving lives along the way.

However, Su Yang’s arrival shatters Lin Xiao’s peaceful existence. She not only becomes entangled in a web of life, death, and fate but also finds herself gradually moved by his kindness and unwavering dedication. Meanwhile, a wealthy heiress named Ye Qingyao develops a keen interest in Su Yang, attempting to win him over and bring him under her control. Faced with intricate relationships and sudden crises, Lin Xiao must summon her courage, stand side by side with Su Yang, and unravel the truths hidden behind destiny.

The story’s appeal lies in how an ordinary girl grows alongside the Medical Immortal, transforming from initial timidity into ultimate bravery. At the same time, the series blends modern medicine with ancient mythological elements, offering both gripping plot twists and heartwarming, healing emotional arcs, presenting viewers with a moving narrative that is at once fantastical and deeply relatable.

2302595.title: Xiao Hao's Carefree Life
2302595.description: “Chen Hao’s Carefree Life” tells the story of Chen Hao, a young man who appears easygoing and unfettered but harbors a sensitive inner world, as he strives to strike a balance between his career and personal life. A designer at a renovation company, Chen Hao is cheerful and uses humor to defuse stress, yet his laid‑back attitude often leaves the team in a bind. Project deadlines are repeatedly missed, clients grow impatient, and his boss becomes increasingly frustrated with him. Still, Chen Hao is far from irresponsible; he is simply coping with complex interpersonal dynamics and a high‑pressure work environment in his own way. Meanwhile, his close friend and colleague, Xiao Li, offers quiet support, forging a bond marked by both understanding and occasional friction. As the story unfolds, Chen Hao gradually realizes that his tendency to avoid challenges not only undermines the team but also robs him of opportunities for growth. Will he ultimately rise to meet those challenges and prove himself through action? With a light‑hearted, witty tone, the series captures the confusion and transformation experienced by today’s young professionals, while its nuanced portrayal of emotions invites viewers to reflect on their sense of self‑worth and the choices they make in life.

2302786.title: Xiao Qiang's Adventure in Flower City
2302786.description:
“Xiao Qiang in the City of Flowers” tells the story of a young man from a remote small town who, filled with dreams of urban life, ventures alone into a bustling metropolis to make his mark. Fresh in the “City of Flowers,” Xiao Qiang is both thrilled and disoriented. He rents a modest little apartment and scrapes by delivering food. Yet life proves far less rosy than he had imagined; confronted with the city’s coldness and cutthroat competition, he repeatedly hits walls and even finds himself in dire straits.

By chance, Xiao Qiang meets Lin Xiao, a forthright, successful career woman, though their first encounter begins with a misunderstanding. Impressed by his sincerity and hard work, Lin Xiao offers him a helping hand, easing some of his everyday struggles. As they grow closer, however, Xiao Qiang gradually discovers that behind her glamorous façade lie unseen pressures and conflicts. Meanwhile, his landlady, misinterpreting his situation, treats him as an unwelcome intruder, making his life even more difficult with constant harassment.

At its core, the story revolves around how Xiao Qiang carves out a place for himself in this complex urban landscape, while also exploring themes of trust and mutual understanding. The drama captures both the struggles of ordinary people in the big city and the warmth of human connection, with a tightly woven plot full of dramatic tension that leaves viewers pondering long after the credits roll. Audiences not only feel the fast pace and pressures of urban life but also experience the power of friendship, love, and personal growth. With its authentic, finely drawn portrayal, the series vividly depicts the bittersweet realities faced by today’s young generation on their journey to chase their dreams—a work that blends profound social relevance with deep emotional resonance.

2305423.description: In the office drama, my wealthy beautiful landlady brings warmth to my bed every day!

2305559.description: A forbidden secret hidden in romance - one word could ignite explosive passion!

2305645.description: The factory girl wants to run away? The CEO spoils her until she begs for mercy and calls him husband!

2305765.title: Factory Love Story
2305765.description: A poor factory worker rises up and wins the heart of the factory beauty - so sweet it will keep you up all night!

2305880.description: The ambiguous daily routine of 9 to 6 work life. Working overtime just to be alone with her late at night, sparks will fly!

2305980.title: Innocent Security Guard and Pretty CEO
2305980.description: An innocent security guard spoils the pretty CEO like a little woman, leaving the whole company stunned!

2306059.title: The Tycoon's Youngest Son
2306059.description: White Stone, an ordinary security guard, turns out to be the kidnapped youngest son of a financial tycoon. After returning to his family, he faces constant targeting from his half-brother White Haoyu. Together with his assistant Lin Shuang, he investigates the truth behind his mother's death and fights for inheritance rights. Eventually, he makes a comeback to become a financial tycoon himself and finds true love.

2306200.title: The Elite CEO Became My Canary
2306200.description: Xiao Qingcheng carries her family's old grudge after her mother was schemed against by the elite Cen family and died in resentment. When she learns that Cen Yu, the Cen family heir, has gone 'bankrupt and fallen from grace,' she dominantly 'keeps' him as her sugar baby and signs a canary contract with him. In reality, Cen Yu has long changed his name to Duan Qianjie and is plotting revenge against his biological father, while secretly loving Xiao Qingcheng for years. He pretends to be weak and stays by her side. As they spend time together, business wars intertwine with romantic feelings, misunderstandings coexist with protection, and the two gradually discover their true hearts in this emotional story of love and hate.
2306200.originName: 顶级豪门总裁成了我的金丝雀

2306276.title: Mr. Huo, She Is Your Wife
2306276.description: To help her best friend Ye Yun complete a secret investigation, Shen Wanxing takes her place to meet business tycoon Huo Sichen. A drunken night leads to an unexpected encounter that intertwines their fates. The next morning, Huo Sichen finds Ye Yun's work ID in the room, planting the seeds of misunderstanding. While searching for the 'truth', Huo Sichen finds himself drawn to Shen Wanxing and develops feelings for her. When he finally finds Ye Yun, their destinies take another turn.

2306422.title: Finding a Daughter Led Me to Life's Peak
2306422.description: Jiang Niannian is reborn with regret and decides to be a better person in this life. First, she makes homemade cola to earn money, making her first fortune from it. Then she uses this money to fix old appliances, using the electronics knowledge she learned during her years in prison to repair and resell them for big profits. Later, when a textile factory faces closure, Jiang Niannian takes it over and uses her advanced fashion sense to wholesale clothing, successfully becoming the richest woman.
2306422.originName: 捡了个女儿我走上人生巅峰了

2306555.title: Three Beautiful Women Dote on Me After Divorce
2306555.description: The story follows Ning Xiaoyao, heir to the Medical Immortal Pavilion, who comes down from the mountain to marry He Yutong, a woman with a pure yin constitution, and prepares medicinal meals to treat her illness. At the crucial stage of treatment, his junior sister Su Jianwei uses their engagement and the affairs of the Medical Immortal Pavilion to pressure him, forcing Ning Xiaoyao to make a difficult choice between protecting love and taking responsibility. The emotional relationships between the three gradually fall into crisis due to personal conflicts.
2306555.originName: 离婚后三个美女爆宠我

2306682.title: Little Treasure Sees All Things
2306682.description: The story revolves around Little Lucky Star, a cute baby with special abilities. She uses her power to see the true value of all things to help her mother Lin Momo run a pawn shop. Together, they solve crises involving fake antique scams and expensive art deals, and team up with Gu Jingyan to handle a jade mine crisis.

2306761.title: Tempting Love
2306761.description: A chance encounter throws her into a whirlwind of desire and reason. He's a dangerous stranger who seems destined to enter her life. By day, she's a calm and independent career woman; by night, she's lost in his burning gaze and teasing touch. As secrets slowly surface, is this tempting relationship a gift from fate or a carefully planned trap? Torn between logic and emotion, she must make a choice.

2306885.title: Flash Marriage Husband Gives Me Money Every Day
2306885.description: Gu Luo enters a flash marriage with a blind husband to inherit family wealth. After marriage, she discovers her husband isn't actually blind and is the CEO of Jiangye Group, the richest company in the city. Gu Luo and Fu Chen work together as a married couple to defeat scumbags and reclaim their family fortune, finding happiness in their lives. To find her missing brother, Qi Simin ventures alone to Hong Kong, where she saves the injured Fu Yaoyang, head of the Fu family, on a rainy night. To get clues, she risks stealing his expensive watch in exchange for information, and gets caught up in the bloody power struggle of the Fu family.
2306885.originName: 闪婚后老公天天给钱花

2306951.title: The Regent Princess is Beautiful and Fierce
2306951.description: A 21st century female agent accidentally travels back in time and becomes Yan Wushuang, the foolish eldest daughter of a duke's mansion. Right after arriving, she saves Prince Pei Yan, a war god who was being hunted down. Money-loving Yan Wushuang can't resist the prince's generous payment and agrees to escort him back to the capital. Their feelings gradually warm up through their chaotic interactions. Facing the crown prince's conspiracy, what fate awaits them?

2307098.title: The Poisonous Saint
2307098.description: In her past life, Jiang Huining was a saint who exhausted her fortune to heal the Third Prince, General, and Prime Minister, only to be abandoned after they drained her value, leading to her tragic death and rebirth. In this life, she shows no mercy and plots her revenge step by step—orchestrating conflicts between scumbags, exposing the fake saint Jiang Qianyue, and supporting the Fifth Prince Shen Xing to claim the throne. Those who once sucked her blood will repay her a hundredfold in this life! Su Wuming, a county constable for ten thousand years, encounters a series of mysterious kidnapping cases from the past created by the enigmatic Han Tang, known as the 'Nine-Story Tower Blood Case.'

2307238.title: She Rose from the Abyss
2307238.description: When Cen Yuan was 8 years old, her mother passed away. After her father remarried, he sent her to live with her grandmother in the countryside, leaving her to fend for herself. Fortunately, blessed with good looks, Cen Yuan successfully entered a top national arts academy and fought her way through the entertainment industry to win the Best Actress award. Just as she happily prepared a candlelight dinner to celebrate with her boyfriend and agent Song Dongyang, she caught him in the act with her stepsister Cen Huan! Only then did Cen Yuan realize that Song Dongyang had been secretly involved with Cen Huan all along. Not only did Song Dongyang show no remorse, he even belittled Cen Yuan's background, saying that no matter how hard she worked her whole life, she could never match Cen Huan's starting point!

2307347.title: Sweet Substitute Wife: Mr. Gu's Ultimate Love
2307347.description: At a modeling show, Gu Junbai accidentally sees his wife "Xu Yaying" and realizes that Xu Yaying and An Xiaomin are not the same person. He discovers that An Xiaomin has a kind personality and good heart, gradually falling for her. After solving the Gu family crisis, Gu Junbai reveals his true feelings. An Xiaomin explains the real situation behind her substitute marriage, and they both find their perfect happy ending.

2307421.title: I Am My Cold Boss's First Love
2307421.description: The story follows the romance between Xu Qinghuan and Fu Yanshi. Xu Qinghuan is an ordinary employee at Fu Corporation who has secretly loved Fu Yanshi, the company president, since high school. During a business trip, they enter into a contract marriage. As they live together, Xu Qinghuan gradually falls in love, but misunderstands that Fu Yanshi has feelings for someone else. Fu Yanshi doesn't give up and pursues her more determinedly, caring for her at work. Their business trip brings them closer, but back at the office, their relationship becomes complicated due to Xu Qinghuan's doubts. Finally, through Fu Yanshi's persistent efforts, Xu Qinghuan lets down her guard, they clear up their misunderstandings, and walk toward their future together.
2307421.originName: 我竟是冷脸上司的白月光

2307497.title: She Returns with Triplets After Five Years
2307497.description: Song Yunchu's mother dies in a car accident but is wrongly blamed for drunk driving. The real culprit is the second master of the Fu family. Her father sends her to the second master to settle the matter, but she accidentally has a one-night stand with Fu Jingzhan instead. After seeing her father and stepsister's true nature, Song Yunchu flees while pregnant. Five years later, she returns with triplets to seek revenge after uncovering the truth. Fu Jingzhan doesn't know he's the father of the triplets, who secretly work together to test him. Their fates become intertwined once again through the children and their shared past.
2307497.originName: 五年后她带三宝回国飒疯了

2307569.title: My Inner Thoughts Are Overheard, Family Changes the Story with Me
2307569.description: The drama tells the story of Shen Xingxing who is reborn as the newborn daughter of the male and female leads in a book. Due to her special ability, anyone who touches her can hear her inner thoughts. Her parents, Shen Junshan and Yun Lan, learn about family crises through their daughter's thoughts, gradually changing the plot direction, exposing conspiracies and saving the nation's heir. In the end, Shen Xingxing is unexpectedly named the country's saint.
2307569.originName: 心声被偷听，全家跟着我改剧情

2307653.title: Love Like a Shooting Star
2307653.description: After a fallen heiress Tang Ruoxing has a one-night stand with wealthy heir Gu Shiming, her cruel parents sell her to a business tycoon. Refusing to accept this fate, she pretends to lose her memory and becomes a maid for the Shi family, where she meets Gu Shiming again. Due to a necklace being taken by Shi Yun'er, Shi Jing's sister, she repeatedly misses her chance with Gu Shiming, while being pursued by the second and third young masters. In the end, Tang Ruoxing and Gu Shiming recognize each other, and the lovers finally unite.

2307783.title: Mr. Bo's Hundred Attempts to Win Miss Jiang's Heart
2307783.description: After being betrayed by her fiancé Yan Feng and his mistress Xia Ling, fake heiress Jiang Ciyu becomes heartbroken and supports the mysterious Bo Jinxiu for three years, unaware that he is actually a powerful prince of Beijing's elite circle. When Yan Feng returns with Xia Ling, Jiang Ciyu tries to cut ties with Bo Jinxiu by leaving him money, but Bo has already fallen for her and begins pursuing her relentlessly. Jealous Xia Ling repeatedly schemes against Jiang Ciyu, but Bo always protects her and exposes the plots. Through Bo's protection and persistence, Jiang's frozen heart gradually melts. After overcoming many obstacles and being honest with each other, they finally find happiness together.
2307783.originName: 薄爷求爱百次姜小姐请手下留情

2307855.title: No More Pretending, I'm the Heiress
2307855.description: The series tells the story of wealthy heiress Sheng Yelan who is reborn after being betrayed by her fiancé Qin Shaoyu and stepsister Song Siyue. She unexpectedly meets Gu Yanzhou, known as the "biggest playboy" in Yun City. The two are drawn to each other during their revenge journey and work together to turn their lives around. Sheng Yelan begins to reclaim her mother's inheritance that she had given to Qin Shaoyu. Gu Yanzhou is moved by her strong character and secretly helps her. Together, they overcome workplace crises and emotional entanglements to rewrite their destinies.

2307906.title: The Time-Traveling Doctor Who Doesn't Understand Romance
2307906.description: The story follows Yi Xian, who uses modern medical skills to cure the king's diabetes and is mistakenly crowned as a divine healer and royal advisor. He becomes entangled in complex relationships with three women including Luo Ningshuang, and faces palace conspiracies created by villains Li Chengqi and Wu Ziyu. Through the clash between modern thinking and ancient civilization, the story shows the protagonist's transformation as he adapts to his new identity and grows emotionally.

2309998.description: Qin Lan has been searching for her son, Qin Tian, for twenty years, unaware that he is her branch company's employee, Zhang Chen. When Qin Lan inspects the branch, she catches Zhang Chen sleeping. She mistakes him for a slacker, not knowing he's a top-tier hacker. Influenced by the villain Yu Liang, she fires Zhang Chen. After being fired, Zhang Chen is hired by Ren Qingshan, the CEO of RongSheng Group, with a high salary!

2310064.title: Marriage by Mistake, Love by Chance: The CEO Can't Live Without Me
2310064.description: “Wrong Marriage, True Love: The CEO Won’t Let Me Go” tells the story of a marriage that is forced to begin through an unexpected “arrangement.” The female protagonist, Lin Xiaoxia, is an ordinary girl whose life is simple yet filled with the warmth of everyday living. She and her grandmother rely on each other, running a small shop in their hometown. One day, in order to improve their financial situation, her grandmother unilaterally “sells” her to a wealthy aristocratic family she has never even met—their grandson happens to be a super‑rich heir—on the condition that they pay a huge bride price. Faced with this sudden turn of events, Lin Xiaoxia feels both angry and helpless, and she can’t help but wonder whether the other party is hiding some dark secret.  Meanwhile, the male protagonist, Gu Chenzhou, as that “wealthy young master,” appears gentle and refined, with every advantage at his disposal, but he too harbors untold hardships. Against their mutual reluctance, the two are drawn into this marriage, and from initial resistance to gradual understanding, their feelings for one another steadily deepen. However, the intricate web of intrigue behind the high society world and the ruthless struggles for family interests make their relationship fraught with challenges and trials. The story unfolds with a light, humorous touch, while weaving in the bittersweet realities of life, showing how two very different people navigate misunderstandings and learn to compromise, ultimately finding their own kind of happiness.
2310064.originName: 错婚对爱：总裁他非我不可

2310127.title: Misplaced Revenge
2310127.description: Genius hacker Su Baiyu and her best friend Ye Wangshu were involved in a car accident while Su Baiyu was trying to save Ye Wangshu. After waking up, Su Baiyu found herself in Ye Wangshu's 'foolish' body, while Ye Wangshu's true soul was dormant in Su Baiyu's heavily injured body. Faced with the culprits who murdered the Ye family – the hypocritical husband He Hongshan, the malicious mother-in-law Zhao Guixiang, and the venomous mistress Lin Mantang – Su Baiyu decides to play along. Under the guise of a 'fool', she secretly plans and uses her hacking skills to expose their true colors. Just whe...

2310207.title: After Cutting Ties, Sister Restarts a Brilliant Life
2310207.description: After the break, my older sister began a brand-new, beautiful life.
2310207.originName: 断亲后，姐姐重启灿烂人生

2310299.title: Crazy Beauty Sets a Trap for Herself
2310299.description: Wen Ning and Su He vie for the CEO position of Huadu Group. Wen Ning uncovers Song Yiran's scheme to approach her deceptively and buy time for Su He. She plays along, secretly securing a crucial project to successfully take office. At the inauguration ceremony, Chairwoman Qiao Yan reveals the truth, and Su He is expelled from Huadu. Afterward, Su He repeatedly interferes, colluding with others to disrupt press conferences and instigating Wen Ning's parents to falsely accuse her of impiety. Wen Ning counterattacks each time, revealing the truth and turning public opinion around. Song Yiran, rea...

2310366.title: Rejected After Confessing, Why Are You Crying When I'm Gone?
2310366.description: Su Yunshi's shares were forcibly taken by her uncle at the mourning hall, and Shen Yanchi saved her. During their time together, she fell for him and confessed her feelings, only to be met with his rebuke and his announcement of engagement to someone else. Shen Yanchi mistakenly thought the kidnapper's call was a prank and verbally abused Su Yunshi. Desperate, Su Yunshi jumped off a cliff. Shen Yanchi regretted it deeply upon learning the truth.
