2310444.title: Humble Origins, Noble Son-in-Law: Returning to Repay His Wife's Kindness
2310444.description: Village beauty Xu Ningxia married the poor but determined Xie Chengan despite her parents' objections. Xie Chengan swore to give her a good life. Three years later, Xie Chengan was recruited by the Lin Group as a dock designer. The CEO, impressed by his character, intended to pass on the company to him. Just as he was about to tell his wife, he was in a car accident and lost his memory, mistakenly believing the villainous Lin Qiao to be his wife, Xu Ningxia.
2310444.originName: 寒门贵婿：携诺归来偿妻恩

2310564.title: The Empress Arrives: The Villainess Persona Can't Hold Up
2310564.description: Transmigrating into the villainous empress, Su Wanyi originally planned to follow the plot: undermine the beloved noble consort and scheme against the indifferent emperor. However, every time her 'mischief' backfired spectacularly. The 'laxative' she gave the noble consort turned out to be a tonic, making her look even more radiant. When she set a trap for the emperor, she fell into it herself, only to be rescued by him, then stubbornly claimed, 'I was just testing you.' Even more absurdly, the emperor, who was supposed to despise her, started smiling at her flustered reactions. The noble cons...
2310564.originName: 皇后驾到：反派人设崩不住了

2310643.title: Living Your Best Fifties
2310643.description: Li Huijuan never imagined that her son, Zhou Pingan, whom she had raised herself, would force her to marry an old cripple to buy a house for his marriage. He even forced her to take the blame for his daughter-in-law, who murdered her employer. She died filled with regret for having sacrificed everything for her son. Reborn, Li Huijuan decides not to sacrifice for her son anymore. She refuses to marry the old cripple to buy her son a house. She returns to the Song family, who took her in after her son kicked her out in her previous life, to care for Old Master Song and repay his kindness. Her s...

2310722.title: General, Let's Divorce
2310722.description: Ye Churan fell in love with Lu Li at first sight. When Ye Churan came of age, her family encountered a misfortune, and her father was wrongly imprisoned. To protect his only daughter, he entrusted Ye Churan to Lu Li's care. Ye Churan thus unexpectedly married her beloved Lu Li. However, for five years of marriage, he treated Ye Churan coldly and hurt her repeatedly. Unfortunately, Ye Churan also fell seriously ill because of this. Ye Churan had no choice but to comply with Lu Li's request, leaving behind a letter of divorce and a will, and divorcing him. However, all of Ye Churan's actions wer...

2310834.title: You're Supposed to Hasten Herbs, What Are You Hastening?
2310834.description: In this play, the protagonist unexpectedly gains a mysterious ability. They are meant to use this ability to hasten the growth of herbs, but through a series of coincidences, they constantly hasten strange and peculiar things, from unusual plants to mysterious objects. This leads to a series of hilarious stories. Along the way, the protagonist meets a group of diverse characters. Together, they embark on adventures, solve one mystery after another, and gradually uncover the truth behind the mysterious ability. The plot is full of fantasy and fun.
2310834.originName: 叫你催熟药材，你在催熟什么

2310908.title: Sister Smashes the Conspiracy with One Strike
2310908.description: Fifteen years ago, sisters Song Zhiqin and Song Zhixue were separated due to a conspiracy by the Sakura Kingdom. The elder sister returns as a protective general, rescuing her younger sister from a sacrificial fire pit and exposing the 'divine' power as a deception orchestrated by the Sakura Kingdom. The sisters join forces to fight evil, rescue their mother, avenge their family, and ultimately end the sacrificial customs of Damin Village. This is an epic tale of female growth blending martial arts, suspense, and family bonds, showcasing a warrior's passionate legend of using martial arts to s...

2311023.title: This Morning, A Daughter Repays Your Kindness
2311023.description: Today, my daughter will repay your kindness.

2311171.title: Emergency Help, Not Poverty Relief
2311171.description: Lin Xiaoman runs an 'Emergency Shop' at the old alley entrance, sticking to the strict rule: 'Help in emergencies, not with poverty.' She's helped a pregnant woman caught in the rain without an umbrella, lent money to a university student whose wallet was stolen, but always gives a cold shoulder to Chen Mo, who frequently asks to borrow 500 yuan. It's not until she sees Chen Mo carrying his critically ill mother to the hospital that she realizes this 'lazy man' works three jobs a day, with all his money going towards a dialysis machine. When her rigid rule clashes with the deep affection hidde...

2311248.title: Gold Digger Mistakes Aunt for Mom-in-Law
2311248.description: A materialistic woman comes to the door to apologize to her mother-in-law.

2311335.title: My Wife's 'First Love' Stole My Parking Spot, I Divorced Her Immediately
2311335.description: Ye Lang's Audi was maliciously blocked in the garage, and he was subjected to extreme humiliation. Ye Lang discovered that the other party was his wife's affair partner, not only driving the luxury car he bought for his wife, but also wearing the expensive watch his wife bought with his money. The three-year marriage instantly crumbled. When his wife arrived, she arrogantly protected her lover, pushing Ye Lang's boundaries step by step. Until Ye Lang, unable to bear it any longer, revealed himself, his wife panicked, crying for forgiveness. Facing his unfaithful wife and her lover, Ye Lang dec...
2311335.originName: 老婆白月光抢我车位，我直接离婚

2311425.title: Impersonating My Daughter-in-Law? Watch How I Expose You
2311425.description: A sudden storm turns the peaceful life of the Lu family upside down. The new daughter-in-law, Bai Mo, is sweet and charming, loved by everyone in the Lu family. However, as time passes, some discordant notes quietly emerge: inconsistencies in her words, a subtle distance in her actions, and a familiar look in her eyes... Mother Lu, a shrewd and decisive woman with sharp instincts, senses something amiss. She decides to investigate secretly. A game of 'hide-and-seek' driven by wits officially begins. What is Bai Mo's true identity? What is her purpose in impersonating the daughter-in-law? Can M...
2311425.originName: 冒充我儿媳？看我怎么揭穿你

2311550.title: Five-Year-Old Prodigy Cultivates Qi, Shocks the Capital Circle
2311550.description: To help Xiao Jiu overcome her heavenly tribulation and ascend, Master Qinghui sent her down the mountain to find a solution. Along the way, Xiao Jiu coincidentally saved the Lu brothers and became embroiled in the conflicts of various prominent families. Xiao Jiu always believed she was just a novice in Qi cultivation, but after repeatedly being provoked, she realized she had long been invincible.
2311550.originName: 萌宝五岁半，练气无敌震京圈

2311667.title: Mischievous Grandson Strikes, Leading Mommy to Life's Peak
2311667.description: From the moment he could understand, 5-year-old Xiao Hetao knew that his mommy, Gu Wanning, gave up her admission to a top design academy to pay for his surgery. For three years, she'd been a 'jack-of-all-trades' at a third-rate company. Until he found an old notebook hidden at the top of her closet – on the first page was a yellowed photo: mommy leaning in the arms of a man in a black suit, her eyes sparkling with laughter. Xiao Hetao spent three days confirming that the man was Li Jingshen, the CEO of 'Jingshen,' a global top design group! To get mommy back to drawing, Xiao Hetao launched a ...
2311667.originName: 萌孙出击，带着妈咪走上人生巅峰

2311756.title: You Were My Full Heart's Delight
2311756.description: Lin Xi and Lu Chen were once the most envied couple on campus, with every glance between them full of sweetness. However, a sudden misunderstanding before graduation tore them apart. Five years later, Lin Xi becomes a renowned designer, while Lu Chen reappears as the president of a collaborating company. Old feelings resurface, new conflicts arise, and the two re-examine their past amidst business competition and emotional entanglement. When the truth comes to light, can they still find the pure heart's delight they once shared?

2311905.title: Why provoke her? Her husband is a top boxer.
2311905.description: Su Yue's husband, Jiang Si, is a boxer. Due to his excellent skills, he is noticed by Chen, the owner of a boxing gym, who wants to recruit him to solidify the gym's position. However, by an unfortunate coincidence, Chen's daughter, Chen Shuyao, sees Su Yue and Jiang Si being intimate. Mistaking Su Yue for a mistress sent by another boxing gym to seduce Jiang Si, she takes Su Yue and bullies her.
2311905.originName: 你惹她干嘛，她老公是顶级拳击手

2311979.title: Revenge of the Heiress: The CEO Begs Me to Love Him
2311979.description: Three years ago, Lu Zesheng and Lin Xingnuo were a couple. One day, Lu Zesheng saw Lin Xingnuo get into an old man's luxury car, misunderstanding her as a greedy person, and angrily disappeared. For three years, Lin Xingnuo waited for Lu Zesheng, but he never returned. Until a class reunion three years later, the two met again. This time, Lin Xingnuo found that Lu Zesheng not only hated her to the bone but also had someone by his side. Lin Xingnuo's heart was full of bitterness with no one to confide in, so she could only hide her love deep in her heart. Lu Zesheng constantly hurt and humiliat...
2311979.originName: 逆袭千金：霸总求我爱上他

2312051.title: After Daughter Awakens, She Tears Apart the Script 'In the Name of Love'
2312051.description: Filial daughter Ruan Tangfei, to save her father Ruan Chengzhi, risks everything. But at a banquet, she stumbles upon a shocking secret: her peasant father is actually Jiangcheng's richest man! And he has a mistress and an illegitimate daughter! Years of poverty were just a 'poor upbringing' scam orchestrated by Ruan Chengzhi himself!
2312051.originName: 女儿觉醒后，手撕以爱之名的剧本

2312193.title: One Who Abandons Their Mother Shall Not Prosper!
2312193.description: Cui Xiufen, a single mother and dormitory supervisor, is assaulted by Wang Hu, a bachelor security guard. Despite her trauma, she insists on reporting the crime. Her three sons, however, see it as an embarrassment and try to stop her, urging her to settle privately to avoid affecting their futures, even threatening to disown her. What these unfilial sons don't know is that their mother is actually the long-lost older sister of Cui Dalong, a billionaire. Her wealthy brother and a hundred billion dollar fortune are on their way.

2312320.title: The Heiress's Grand Turnaround
2312320.description: Shen Yue is the eldest daughter of the Shen Group, but she has never felt her father Su Jianfeng's love. Instead, she has suffered endless torment from her stepmother Su Lili and stepsister Su Shanshan. When Su Jianfeng plans to rename the Shen Group to the Su Group, attempting to completely erase the traces of Shen Yue's mother, Shen Yue's years of suppressed tolerance finally erupt. She will no longer be silent, vowing to reclaim everything that belongs to her mother, and thus begins a battle of counterattack.

2312395.title: The Heiress's Counter-Hunt
2312395.description: Shen Xingwan, the heiress of the Shen Group, fakes being a new employee to escape a business marriage, hiding in a small company. But she falls into the trap of Gu Jingshen, a 'master of investment banking seduction' – he sees through her disguise instantly and deliberately pursues her to uncover her true identity. Shen Xingwan refuses to be tricked, using her 'commoner persona' to fight back: pretending to be poor and eating instant noodles, complaining about her stingy boss, and completely fooling Gu Jingshen. However, as feelings grow between them during their games of cat and mouse, Shen X...

2312473.title: Beyond the Endless Night, a Warm Sun Rises
2312473.description: Wen Qinghe and Wen Xingyao are reborn on their wedding day. Wen Xingyao snatches her sister's marriage to a wealthy family, pushing the poor security guard Gu Xun onto Wen Qinghe. Wen Qinghe calmly accepts, knowing the Lin family is a pit of fire and only seeking peace. Unexpectedly, Gu Xun's identity is mysterious, even earning respect from business tycoons. Meanwhile, after marrying into the wealthy family, Wen Xingyao's husband cheats. She tries to seduce a wealthy man from the Gu family, only to find he looks identical to Gu Xun.

2312550.title: Beginning with Love, Ending with Heartbreak
2312550.description: Shen Qingru, to support her husband Lin Zheyu, gave up her position as CEO of Chuangxing Technology. Five years later, she discovers his affair with assistant Meng Yao. Heartbroken, her high school classmate, Jiang Yichen, CEO of Jiangyu Group, becomes her ally and lover, helping her seek revenge. Shen Qingru meticulously gathers evidence and exposes their infidelity at a press conference, ruining their reputations. She reclaims her company and finds happiness with Jiang Yichen, starting a new chapter.

2312662.title: Escape from the Mountains
2312662.description:
“Escape from the Mountains” tells a poignant, tragic tale set in a remote mountain village. Xiao Mei, the Zhou family’s daughter-in-law, is branded a “jinx” by her husband and in-laws for being barren, and she endures cold neglect and abuse. Faced with her family’s indifference and oppression, she must endure not only physical pain but also profound emotional torment. Yet fate seems unwilling to spare her: after an accidental miscarriage leaves her permanently infertile, she is forced to marry into another family and become someone else’s “daughter-in-law.” Her young daughter, Yaya, witnesses her mother’s plight, filled with helplessness and anger, yet powerless to change it.

Meanwhile, Yan Yan, the village widow who once saved Xiao Mei’s life, learns of her friend’s plight and is overwhelmed with mixed emotions. She resolves to offer help, though her own life is far from easy. As the story unfolds, the fates of these two women become inextricably entangled as they struggle to survive their hardships and seek a way out. With its delicate portrayal of emotion and its exploration of pressing social issues, the narrative illuminates the plight of women caught between traditional customs and the pressures of reality, while also conveying a powerful call for human warmth and hope.

2312753.title: Unveiling at the Broken Engagement Feast: The White Moonlight Regrets
2312753.description: Su Wan is publicly dumped by her fiancé, Chen Mo, who claims they are 'not a good match.' Unexpectedly, top executives from the high-end jewelry brand 'Imperial Seal' crash the engagement feast—they've come to beg 'Master Jiyue' for a collaboration! Everyone is stunned to discover that Su Wan is actually the incognito genius designer 'Jiyue.' Meanwhile, Chen Mo's 'white moonlight' Lin Xia has been faking her status as a 'design star' by plagiarizing 'Jiyue's' manuscripts. When Lin Xia sees Su Wan pull out patent certificates signed 'Jiyue,' she remembers how she once mocked Su Wan for 'only re...
2312753.originName: 退婚宴上掉马甲，白月光悔不当初

2312940.title: I Went to the Northwest to Restore Cultural Relics, CEO Gu Can't Sit Still Anymore
2312940.description: Cultural relic restorer Su Xiao, due to her insistence on participating in the restoration of Mogao Grottoes murals, had a quarrel with her investment bank CEO boyfriend Gu Jingshen. After blocking him, she rushed to the desert. CEO Gu, who always prioritized "efficiency first," surprisingly turned down a multi-million dollar project and quietly took his team to the Northwest—while outwardly claiming to be "inspecting cultural tourism projects," he secretly helped her solve the shortage of restoration materials. When Su Xiao found the box of mineral pigments labeled "Dunhuang Special Supply" i...
2312940.originName: 我去西北修文物，顾总再也坐不住了

2313076.title: I am the Young Marshal of Tianwu / The King Returns, My Sister is Imprisoned at the Start
2313076.description: Su Chen, the young marshal of the Tianwu army, returns to find his wife Liu Ruyan's betrayal and his sister Su Que being humiliated by Cao Guang and Liu Ruyan. The Cao family has committed numerous evil deeds. Su Chen no longer hides his identity, annihilates the Cao family and their protectors, and restores peace to Ye City. Later, he single-handedly wipes out the remnants of the Yamada group and the colluding CEO Shen, earning praise. Ye Sheng develops feelings and kisses him forcefully. Su Chen eventually stays with her.

2313202.title: I'm Raising the Flag for My Daughter-in-Law, Who Dares to Be Her Enemy?
2313202.description: When her son, Xue Zhengyang, gets married and establishes his career, Zhao Rongying plans to hand over the company to him and his wife, Meng Jingqiu. However, the arrogant mistress Qin Shuangshuang shows up. Qin Shuangshuang uses her pregnancy to force Meng Jingqiu and Xue Zhengyang to divorce. Zhao Rongying then realizes her son has betrayed her daughter-in-law. Zhao Rongying plays along, extracting useful information from Qin Shuangshuang, and stands up for her daughter-in-law! Zhao Rongying and Meng Jingqiu work together to expose Qin Shuangshuang's true intentions.
2313202.originName: 我为儿媳举大旗，看谁敢与她为敌

2313294.title: Married into a Rich Family by Mistake: Picking Up a CEO as a Husband
2313294.description: After top celebrity Liang Xia catches her boyfriend Lu Shaoze with Zhao Ke'er, Zhao Ke'er mocks her for relying on Lu Shaoze for success. Liang Xia decisively terminates her contract with Lu's company and curses him for infidelity, leading to a public outcry. In the chaos, she is mistaken by wealthy CEO Meng Tingfei and asked to accompany him for drinks. With his help, she overcomes her difficulties and returns to her career peak, as their emotional entanglement gradually unfolds.
2313294.originName: 误嫁豪门：捡个总裁当老公

2313418.title: Married to the Pilot: Genius Baby Comes Knocking
2313418.description: Jiang Xingyou, who has been named an excellent pilot for two consecutive years, was envied by a colleague. She was set up to have a one-night stand with Li Ciyan, and gave birth to Hangbao. Five years later, to fulfill Hangbao's wish for a father, she agreed to a blind date. Unfortunately, she was scammed and almost forced into marriage by a middle-aged man! At the critical moment, the adorable Hangbao hugged Li Ciyan's leg, asking him to marry her mommy. However, she didn't know that her impromptu husband was not only the man from her one-night stand five years ago, but also the heir to Asia'...
2313418.originName: 误嫁机长：天才萌宝找上门

2313485.title: After Descending the Mountain, Peach Blossoms Bloom Everywhere
2313485.description: Lin Xiaoman, the only female disciple of Xuanqing Temple, is ordered by her master to go down the mountain to find the “most precious thing in the world.” As soon as she enters the city, she is entangled by three men – a cold CEO claims she is his missing fiancée, a sunny young man recognizes her as his lifesaver, and a clear-minded painter insists on painting a hundred peach blossoms. But behind these encounters lie a crisis of the temple's treasure being coveted, a secret about her master's hidden past, and someone's decade-long true feelings. Lin Xiaoman uses the temple's unique skills to r...

2313538.title: Filial Descendants
2313538.description: Granny Zhou, a lonely elderly woman, suddenly finds her old house expropriated, receiving a million yuan in compensation. Unexpectedly, her distant nephew, her former housekeeper's son, and her long-absent grandson all show up, vying to be 'filial descendants.' The nephew offers tea and water, aiming to borrow money after his business failed. The housekeeper's son provides companionship, but secretly harbors a gambling debt. The grandson shows warm concern, solely for a down payment on a wedding house. Granny Zhou appears muddled, but in reality, she has set up a 'test': she hides her passbook...

2313684.title: Starlight Pales in Comparison to You
2313684.description: Fu Siyan, a renowned actor and business tycoon, sensationally announced his desire to be a father at the Huashen Awards, setting the entertainment industry ablaze. Unbeknownst to many, he had secretly married Bai Qingqing, an acclaimed actress, during their studies abroad. Upon their return, she pursued her career with dedication, while he discreetly invested in projects to support her. Their sweet, yet understated 'secret marriage' thus began.

2313764.title: Inviting the Wolf into the House: I Raised My Husband's Childhood Sweetheart's Son
2313764.description: Su Wan and Ye Yuanchen once shared a loving relationship, but he betrayed her with her best friend, Lin Weiwei. After their affair, they caused the death of Su Wan's father and ex-husband, conspired to swap children, and coveted her company. Su Wan endured for twenty years, first feigning a setup to lull them into a false sense of security, then making a powerful comeback with Ye Nianen. She used business tactics to expose their conspiracy, brought them to justice, reclaimed everything, and lived happily ever after with her son.
2313764.originName: 引狼入室：我帮老公的白月光养儿子

2313866.title: Moonlight Crowns Me
2313866.description: Peng Huiling becomes the central figure in a meticulously planned baby-swapping conspiracy, which completely intertwines the destinies of two girls, with the truth hidden beneath a web of lies. When the truth is finally revealed, the audience will witness the moving moment when the real young lady breaks down in tears. This drama profoundly explores the complexities of human nature and the capriciousness of fate, prompting viewers to consider human relationships and the struggle between morality and desire. 'Moonlight Crowns Me' is not only a work that reveals human nature but also a deeply mo...

2313946.title: Oh no, I'm surrounded by three beautiful sisters!
2313946.description: This is terrible—I’m surrounded by three beautiful women!
2313946.originName: 糟糕，被三个美女姐姐包围

2314013.title: Reborn: Repaying the Suffering from My Previous Life
2314013.description: Killed by her husband's family in her previous life, the female lead is unexpectedly bound to an 'Exchange Pain for Riches' system upon rebirth. She resolves to seek revenge, manipulating her husband's sister into encountering and binding the same system. She then exploits her in-laws' greedy and cruel nature to torment the sister. Simultaneously, the female lead intelligently conceals her own system, ultimately ensuring her husband's entire family faces retribution and successfully escaping this 'demonic den'.
2314013.originName: 重活一世，前世受的罪还回去

2314120.title: Reborn, I Reversed Life-and-Death Desperation
2314120.description: Lin Xinyao was murdered by a masked figure the night before her college entrance exam. Reborn, she's determined to find the killer, but the killer is shrouded in mystery. After three reincarnations, she finally identifies her stepmother as the murderer. But just when she thinks it's all over, the real mastermind emerges, and a new crisis descends.
2314120.originName: 重生后，我逆转了生死绝境

2314262.title: Reborn to Protect My Daughter-in-Law and Rectify the Family
2314262.description: Su JinHui, CEO of Su Group, was murdered by her best friend, Ye ZhenZhen. Before dying, she discovered her son wasn't her biological child, and her daughter-in-law had also been killed by Ye ZhenZhen due to Su JinHui's coldness. The Su family's everything had fallen into Ye ZhenZhen's hands. Su JinHui regretted it. She was reborn to the night her daughter-in-law, Lu Ling, was murdered. This time, she vows to protect her daughter-in-law and expose the true face behind Ye ZhenZhen's hypocrisy.
2314262.originName: 重生后我守护儿媳，整顿家风

2314339.title: Starlight Redemption on Tiptoes
2314339.description: Out of jealousy, Lin Xiulian swapped her daughters at birth. Twenty years later, Lin Xi, who was swapped into the Lin family and whose passion for dance was hindered, meets Ji Yingying, who became a dancer in the Jiang family, at a selection competition. As the mystery of their birth unfolds, Lin Xi, with her resilience, overcomes obstacles and is reunited with her birth mother. Lin Xiulian and Ji Yingying, however, pay the price for their actions.

2314641.title: Ex-Wife Returns: Mr. Lu's 99 Marriage Proposals
2314641.description: Shen Qixia, the daughter of the richest man in the country, helped Lu Sigui overcome difficulties three years ago. She not only married him but also fully supported him, even faking work to go abroad for three years to give him time. However, Lu Sigui thought she was humiliating him. He ignored her for those three years, and even when she suddenly returned and appeared at tonight's banquet, he didn't recognize her. At the banquet, the oblivious Lu Sigui was once again attracted to her and said some absurd things, which left Shen Qixia speechless, especially when he asked her to sign a divorce ...

2314706.title: Love at Thirty Thousand Feet
2314706.description: Meng Liyue developed a secret crush on Li Fuzheng after he helped her in high school. Learning that he wanted an air traffic controller as a partner, she worked hard to become an approach controller. Years later, they unexpectedly reunited as blind date partners and quickly married. After marriage, their paths crossed more often in civil aviation work. Beneath Li Fuzheng's cold exterior lay a gentle heart, and Meng Liyue became more confident. Despite obstacles from people like Xu Moti, they trusted each other. Their love grew stronger through incidents like stormy flights, eventually evolving...

2314805.title: Divine Doctor's Adorable Child, Mad Mom is Super Cool
2314805.description: Genius divine doctor Su Jiuge unexpectedly transmigrates, finding herself a notorious 'mad villainess' with an adorable son to boot. Facing vengeful enemies, she uses silver needles to save lives and poisons to take down渣. Her adorable son constantly plays matchmaker for his mom: 'Uncle Prince, my mom is sweet and cool, would you consider her?' Watch how this 'mad mom' and her adorable child stir up trouble and rock the city!
2314805.originName: 神医萌宝，疯批娘亲飒爆了

2314878.title: Reborn, Mom Reclaims Her Stolen Life
2314878.description: 38-year-old Lin Wan died in resentment. In her previous life, her best friend Su Qing plotted against her, stealing her fiancé, alienating her daughter with misunderstandings, and even seizing the company left by her parents. Reborn at 25, her daughter Xiaotang is just 5 years old, and Su Qing's schemes are just beginning. This time, Lin Wan will not only expose Su Qing's 'innocent facade' but also reclaim company shares using her past life memories. More importantly, she will try her best to mend her relationship with her daughter—in her previous life, Xiaotang never called her 'Mom' until he...
2314878.originName: 重生后，妈妈夺回被偷人生

2315020.title: The President's Puppet Wife
2315020.description: Yan Yuxuan and Li Beiting have been in a stable relationship for three years. One night, Yan Yuxuan returns home to find all her belongings thrown out. A strange woman is cuddling with her boyfriend, Li Beiting, and she is suddenly told to break up and is kicked out. At the same time, Yan Yuxuan receives a notice to work at Li's company. Her ex-boyfriend, Li Beiting, becomes her boss, and he even announces to the entire company that Su Yina is his fiancée. Before Yan Yuxuan can react, Li Beiting pulls her out to block drinks. She gets so drunk that she passes out and wakes up in the same room ...

2315070.title: After the Love-Struck Me Died, I Returned to My Peak
2315070.description: Ye Hanqing, for love, abandoned her career to support her husband Shen Wenjing's family business, only to be betrayed. After their divorce, she revealed herself to be the true head of the commercial empire, Gloria Group. She began her revenge by reclaiming investments, exposing the mistress Ruan Tang's plagiarism scandal, and bankrupting the Shen family. Ultimately, Shen Wenjing went mad, Ruan Tang was imprisoned, and Ye Hanqing regained her freedom, finding happiness with her long-time protector and business partner, Li Juechen.
2315070.originName: 恋爱脑死后，我重回巅峰

2315131.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Season 2 (Thai Dub)
2315131.description:
The account of the day after the heroic troop defeated the Demon King - the "after that" story.
Frieren, being a magician, is an elf who is distinct from the other three.
I have a different perspective on what it's like to live and feel in the "after" world...
Beginning with "The End of the Adventure," the remaining people in the world weave stories of funerals and prayers.

2315270.title: Aliens Among Immortals
2315270.description:
Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception.

However, neither is aware that the other is also an alien survivor whose home was destroyed by the "Void." This destined couple forms an alliance amidst suspicion and testing, not only searching for the treasures transformed from a lost spaceship but also confronting the ever-watchful cultivation world, seeking hope to defeat the "Void" amidst perilous circumstances.

2317741.title: Deep Love, Hard to Realize
2317741.description: This drama focuses on the forbidden love between Qin Luo and her nominal uncle, Gu Sijun. Due to their family generational difference, their relationship has long been hindered. After Qin Luo returns from studying abroad and reunites with Gu Sijun, their feelings rekindle, and they must face multiple tests: family ethics, social opinion, and their internal moral dilemmas.

2317876.title: So, We Loved Each Other
2317876.description: This drama tells the story of a beautiful encounter that made Xia Qinghuan fall in love with Xiao Zhuran at first sight. To curry favor with Xiao Zhuran, who had helped Xia Qinghuan and could save the struggling Xia family, Xia Anyu willingly offered Xia Qinghuan to him.

2317945.title: Love Was Always There
2317945.description: This series focuses on marital difficulties and a life-and-death struggle, with emotional entanglement as the main narrative. It tells the story of Su Chenxi, who, after being diagnosed with advanced liver cancer during her pregnancy, confesses to her husband, He Chenyi, that she discovered his betrayal with Lin Yuexin four years prior. During her illness, Su Chenxi endures the pain of treatment alone, as He Chenyi fails to provide companionship. Ultimately, Su Chenxi passes away due to unsuccessful resuscitation, never receiving her husband's understanding before her death. Upon receiving the...

2318045.title: It Was Always You
2318045.description: Zhang Xiaomai, a country girl, visits her sister Zhang Xiaobei in the city, only to discover Xiaobei has been impersonating her to climb the social ladder. Without any support, Zhang Xiaomai takes a job at a restaurant under the Gu Group. Despite facing deliberate difficulties from her superior, her resilience, sincerity, and hard work gradually earn her the appreciation of Gu Junze, the CEO of the group, and Director Shen. Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaobei repeatedly tries to frame Zhang Xiaomai and sabotage her relationship with Gu Junze to maintain her false identity. Eventually, their adoptive moth...

2318124.title: Moonlight Falls on My Hand
2318124.description: This drama revolves around Huo Tingshen (Huo Qingze) being rescued by Lin Xi during his blindness. After regaining his sight, a mistaken identity leads to emotional entanglement: Huo Tingshen mistakes Lin Xi's sister, Lin Man, for his fiancée, causing Lin Xi to quietly leave and raise their daughter, Xingxing, alone. As the truth is revealed, Huo Tingshen begins his pursuit to win her back. With the intertwining relationships, including the attending physician Jiang Yukan, the two gradually resolve their misunderstandings. The plot showcases pivotal moments like 'surgical care – sight restorat...

2318195.title: Love and Farewell Above the Clouds
2318195.description: The story revolves around a couple's five-year relationship and three-year marriage. Lu Nanyi suddenly proposes divorce without explanation. While handling flight missions, Shen Shuangning discovers her husband with a new diamond ring and signs of a third party, while also enduring emotional abuse. Ultimately, under the dual blow of career grounding and emotional betrayal, she signs the divorce agreement. The series portrays the collapse of trust and self-reinvention in a marital crisis from the perspective of a career woman.

2318261.title: Secrets in the Clouds
2318261.description: Chu Yunmu and Shen Guiyu grew up together in the same compound. Chu Yunmu was particularly fond of Shen Guiyu, her capable and elite-spirited 'brother'. When Shen Guiyu became a pilot, she diligently studied to become a flight attendant, just to fly with him. After graduating from college, Chu Yunmu finally gathered the courage to confess her feelings to Shen Guiyu, but an accident caused them to miss four years. Chu Yunmu always thought Shen Guiyu was avoiding her because he didn't want to accept her. Four years later, they meet again. Shen Guiyu is now her colleague in the same flight crew, ...

2318339.title: Goodbye, I Wish You Happiness
2318339.description: Mu Yunxi and Fu Hanzhou have been in love for seven years. On their wedding day, Fu Hanzhou abandons her for his childhood friend 'sister' Su Xin, and their long-awaited wedding is canceled because of Su Xin. Mu Yunxi begins to doubt if she will truly be happy with Fu Hanzhou. However, her thoughts of leaving quickly vanish when Fu Hanzhou gives her a gift. Later, she discovers the gift was something Su Xin liked, and she was merely an afterthought; Fu Hanzhou never truly cared about her. Mu Yunxi collapses and faints, only to wake up and find she has stomach cancer. Frightened, she instinctiv...

2318478.title: Love That Will Eventually Return Home
2318478.description: Wen Yinchu married into a wealthy family, believing it was the beginning of happiness, but unexpectedly fell into an endless nightmare. Her husband, Song Yanci, was cold to her, her mother-in-law was constantly difficult, and there was also Ye Qingya, a mistress, coveting her position. Just as Wen Yinchu was struggling to cope, the Wen family's pharmaceutical company suddenly faced a crisis, on the verge of bankruptcy. A struggle within a wealthy family, a heartbreaking yet warm love story, is slowly unfolding.

2318562.title: The Bride with No Name
2318562.description: Su Mo and Lu Jinyu were high school sweethearts. After Lu Jinyu lost his memory, Su Miao manipulated him into believing she was his girlfriend. Su Mo was forced to marry into the Lu family in her sister's place and suffered emotional abuse for three years. When Su Miao returned, Lu Jinyu forced the terminally ill Su Mo, who had late-stage stomach cancer, to donate blood for him, worsening her condition. Eventually, Su Mo's mother, overcome with guilt, jumped to her death, and Su Mo committed suicide by taking pills. Upon learning the truth, Lu Jinyu, suffering from heart disease, refused treat...

2318669.title: Reborn as a Rookie
2318669.description:
“Reborn as a Rookie” tells the story of an unexpected second chance at life. After a bizarre death, the protagonist finds himself returning to the world as a complete stranger—and what’s even more shocking is that he has been reincarnated into the body of a young office newcomer, a nobody who is constantly scolded by his boss, Shen Yang, and bullied by his colleague, Zhang Feng. This new body not only forces him to endure the pressures of the workplace but also saddles him with a tangled web of complicated romantic entanglements: his former host apparently had an ambiguous relationship with team leader Shen Yang, while Zhang Feng, backed by his “patron” Cheng Fang, relentlessly closes in, determined to crush him once and for all.

As the plot unfolds, the protagonist gradually realizes that this rebirth is no accident—it is the work of some mysterious force. He must navigate the cutthroat battles of office politics while unraveling the mystery of why he ended up as a “rookie.” At the same time, his feelings for Shen Yang grow increasingly complex: he is grateful for her care yet senses that she harbors secrets. Meanwhile, the unlikely duo of Zhang Feng and Cheng Fang only make his life even more unbearable. In the end, will the protagonist be able to carve out his own path amidst this double‑pronged assault of career and heart? And what is the truth behind it all? An adventure of growth, revenge, and redemption begins.

2318738.title: The Furthest Distance
2318738.description: This drama is set against the backdrop of an earthquake, using multi-linear storytelling to explore the profound themes of family trauma and emotional conflict. The story revolves around a mother, Su Man, who is forced to abandon her daughter, Ye Xi, to save her son in the earthquake rubble. Ye Xi survives and is adopted. Years later, as an adult, she reunites with Su Man when her company is acquired by Su Man's, uncovering long-held truths. The plot intertwines blood ties, identity, and emotional entanglement, revealing conspiracies and misunderstandings to explore the choices individuals mak...

2318843.title: Solo Act of Love
2318843.description: This drama centers on the emotional entanglement of figure skating queen Ji Yuheng. She endured an eight-year slump after her ex-husband, Gong Chen, proposed divorce, dedicating herself to figure skating and reclaiming her championship title. At the moment of her triumph, she unexpectedly reunites with Gong Chen, only to face a double blow: Gong Chen is about to marry her former best friend, Yin Ke. The story interweaves competitive scenes with emotional narratives, showcasing the protagonist's struggle between career pinnacle and emotional abyss. It features the elegance of ice spins and the ...

2318953.title: Loving You Was Never a Temporary Decision
2318953.description: This drama tells the emotional journey of childhood sweethearts Ye Zhen and Mu Tingyan, from a marital crisis to rediscovering their true love. Ye Zhen, an airline co-pilot, persists in maintaining her marriage despite her husband's indifference. She tries to resolve misunderstandings through birthday surprises and daily care. The appearance of Su Jinxi breaks the stalemate, leading them to gradually recognize their past mutual secret affection. They ultimately overcome family conflicts and emotional obstacles to reconcile. The core theme is 'My love for you wasn't a sudden whim, but a long-he...

2319058.title: Love You Until the Sunset of the Next Life
2319058.description: This drama is set against the backdrop of the e-sports industry, telling the story of e-sports player Ye Ci. After a car accident leaves her paralyzed and forces her to retire, her marriage with her husband Gu Yanqi falls into crisis due to the intervention of a third party, Lin Zhixia. Gu Yanqi gradually distances himself from Ye Ci and focuses his energy on team training. After experiencing emotional betrayal and the torment of illness, Ye Ci attempts suicide, but fails. Reborn, Ye Ci assumes the name Lin Qian and returns to the e-sports world, continuing her professional career with a new i...

2319173.title: Love Starts with Marriage
2319173.description: This drama tells the story of Wen Jiajia and her overbearing boss, Qi Si'ang, whose destinies intertwine after an accidental one-night stand. The Qi family's ring, a symbol of destiny, accidentally ends up on Wen Jiajia's finger, leading them to sign a marriage agreement and become a contract couple. However, a wooden turtle reveals a past childhood incident: when Qi Si'ang fell into the water, the visually impaired Wen Jiajia saved him. But Fan Xiaoxiao impersonated Wen Jiajia, getting close to Qi Si'ang and stealing six years of his time and love. The relationship between the three becomes e...

2319292.title: Love in the Abyss
2319292.description: This drama tells the story of a group of young people who, when faced with difficulties in life, love, and career, support each other in the abyss, experience emotional entanglements and growth, and ultimately find love and self-worth.

2319393.title: Love Before the Summer Sunset
2319393.description: Orphan Wu Chenzi and wealthy young man Meng Haonian are childhood sweethearts. However, Meng Haonian's mother disapproves of Wu Chenzi and prefers Chen Yao, who is a better match for her son. Chen Yao has had a crush on Meng Haonian since childhood, and to get closer to him, she befriends Wu Chenzi. Chen Yao forges Meng Haonian's handwriting to lure Wu Chenzi out, intending to harm her. But then, Meng Haonian appears...

2319500.title: Love Above the Clouds
2319500.description: Set against the backdrop of Jincheng Airlines, this series follows flight attendant Shen Xinghui and pilot Lu Yanchuan, whose three-year marriage suddenly faces a crisis. Lu Yanchuan's attitude drastically changes, and he is eager for a divorce, with his behavior seemingly linked to Lin Wan. While dealing with emotional pressure, Shen Xinghui insists on uncovering the truth behind their broken marriage. As the story unfolds, the two engage in a power struggle amidst intertwining professional and emotional conflicts.

2319649.title: Half a Lifetime's Affinity
2319649.description: Ji Yumu is diagnosed with late-stage liver cancer, only to discover her husband, Yan Ziqian, has been using her as a pawn for his own gain. At the same time, her beloved grandmother passes away. Faced with provocations and a kidnapping attempt by Yan Ziqian's ex-girlfriend, Liang Cheng, Ji Yumu falls into despair after her husband chooses to rescue Liang Cheng instead of her.

2319779.title: The Ten Years of Stolen Love
2319779.description: Zhang Shuyan and Shen Jiaye have been married for three years, but their marriage crumbles with the appearance of Zhao Jinxuan. On the day Shen Jiaye is to marry Zhao Jinxuan, he learns about the identity switch between Zhang Shuyan and Zhao Jinxuan, and that Zhao Jinxuan is not the daughter of his savior. Shen Jiaye flees the wedding to find Zhang Shuyan, only to discover she has already left. Two years later, Zhang Shuyan returns to the country with her boyfriend Su Yusheng. After a series of pursuits by Shen Jiaye, they resolve their misunderstandings and reconcile.

2319914.title: Imperfect Love
2319914.description: This drama tells the tragic marriage story of Mrs. Gu, Xia Yixi, and the CEO of Gu Group, Gu Jingye. The main plot revolves around Xia Yixi's marriage to Gu Jingye, detailing her six years of emotional trauma after marrying into the Gu family, including her husband's infidelity and a miscarriage caused by emotional abuse during pregnancy. The story's conflicts unfold around key events such as the wedding ring changing hands, witnessing infidelity at the hospital, and the mistress moving in. It showcases the protagonist's journey from endurance to awakening. Ultimately, Xia Yixi chooses divorce...

2320033.title: The Lover Hidden Deep in Time
2320033.description: On their wedding night, the groom, Cheng Hanchuan, wanted to leave. Xu Zhiyi knew this was a marriage of family interests and she suffered from amnesia, yet she still hoped for love. When Xu Zhiyi missed his grandfather's birthday banquet, Cheng Hanchuan was displeased, creating the first conflict. Xu Zhiyi's amnesia was a ticking time bomb, affecting her life and judgment. She tried to survive in the complex Cheng family, win Cheng Hanchuan's heart, and deal with the amnesia, which often left her passive and confused in the marriage. 2320177.title: Super Female Security Guard
2320177.description: This drama tells the story of Liu Piaopiao, the esteemed Queen of North City, who loses her memory after a car accident. She is rescued by company security guard Shen Si'an but mistakenly thinks he's a hooligan. After losing her memory, Liu Piaopiao's behavior becomes erratic. Despite many suitors, she and the vastly different Shen Si'an accidentally get married. As they fight against a conspiracy, Shen Si'an, maintaining his kind nature, helps Liu Piaopiao regain her memory, ultimately resolving the misunderstandings and conflicts caused by their class differences.

2320228.title: Love Can Be Sent, Dreamingly Confused
2320228.description: Lan Yu has been in love with Qin Silin since childhood. After repeated rejections and hearing rumors of Qin Silin's marriage to his ex-girlfriend Ding Xu, she was disheartened and left Qin's company. By chance, she participated in a dating reality show, where she reunited with Qin Silin and met Gu Zhizhou, a triple Golden Award-winning actor who was smitten with her. The intimate interactions between Lan Yu and Gu Zhizhou on the show unexpectedly forced Qin Silin to confront his true feelings. After many twists and turns, and once Qin Silin resolved the troubles caused by his identity, he fina...

2320312.title: Mistaken Love
2320312.description: This drama tells the story of Lu Yucheng, the young master of the Lu Group, and Rao Siman, a key member of the group, who have been in love for eight years. On the night their parents were to meet to arrange their marriage, Lu Yucheng abandoned his fiancée and her future mother-in-law, Zhang Xueying, on a snowy street after receiving a distress call from his childhood sweetheart, Su Luo. Rao Siman broke up with Lu Yucheng and left with her mother's ashes, causing the company's stock to plummet...

2320413.title: Cute and Clumsy Wife: President, Please Control Yourself
2320413.description: This drama tells the story of Jiang Meng and Lu Yiting, whose contractual marriage begins after Jiang Meng drunkenly mistakes his room and they have an encounter. 2320521.title: Empress of the Imperial City
2320521.description: Li Xueyan, the sole heir of the Li family in the Imperial City, married into the Xie family to find her true love. For three years, she worked tirelessly and endured humiliation, yet she was mistreated by her in-laws and never truly respected. Until she saw the true colors of her in-laws and realized her love was misplaced. 2320598.title: Falling in Love with You a Second Time
2320598.description: This drama tells the story of Su Weilan, who traveled through time and only has three days left to live. Due to a misunderstanding, her husband Lu Beiting detests her. 2320681.title: Can't Say Goodbye to You
2320681.description: This drama centers on the marital crisis between Gu Mian and Li Huaihan. Frequent arguments erupt due to Li Huaihan's excessive care for his mentor's daughter, Xia Yao, leading to their relationship's breakdown. Gu Mian leaves a divorce agreement and goes abroad. Under the sabotage of Sui's mother and Sui Yiwei, Lin Yueyin eventually divorced Sui Yan. Heartbroken, Lin Yueyin returned to the Lin family. But her first task upon returning to take over the family business was to acquire the Sui Group!

2320946.title: The Villainess's Revenge
2320946.description: This drama tells the story of Mili, who, to avenge her sister, enters Lin's company under her sister's identity. 2321013.title: The Daughter-in-law's Awakening
2321013.description: After marriage, Lin Huirong dutifully cares for her mother-in-law with dementia as a housewife, enduring all her difficult behaviors. 2321144.description: This drama focuses on flight attendant Mu Wanqing and her husband Xiao Yucheng, who maintain a respectful but distant marriage for three years after an accidental marriage. 2321251.title: The Wind Speaks My Love
2321251.description: This drama tells the story of a female protagonist who is diagnosed with esophageal cancer and has only three months left to live. While enduring the pain of her illness, she re-evaluates her unfinished emotional ties with her ex-husband. She was diagnosed with esophageal cancer, with only 3 months left of her life. 2321384.title: Landing in My Heart: The Pilot’s Regret
2321384.description: This drama centers on the entangled relationship between airline captain Gu Chengyi and his ex-wife Tang Muran. 2321533.title: Mr. Gu: My Wife Has Been Dead for Three Years
2321533.description: A modern urban romance short drama about the tumultuous love story of Gu Lanzhou and Jiang Yin. After the Jiang family falls on hard times, Gu Lanzhou still chooses to marry Jiang Yin. However, on the eve of their wedding, Jiang Yin's half-sister, Jiang Tian, drugs Gu Lanzhou and records it, using the video to threaten Jiang Yin into calling off the wedding. To protect Gu Lanzhou's reputation, Jiang Yin reluctantly agrees, and from then on, their fates change dramatically.
2321533.originName: 顾少：夫人已经死了三年了

2321662.title: Regarding Love, Do You Have Any Regrets?
2321662.description: The series focuses on Jian Ning'an and Jiang Jinxiu's marital crisis. Jian Ning'an discovers her husband's cold infidelity but still tries to save their marriage. 2321800.title: The Rich Family's Sweet Pet: The Ex-Wife Shines Brighter
2321800.description: Ji Ge has been married for three years, but her husband disdains to touch her. He's happily involved with a mistress who is now pregnant. Ji Ge is so delighted she doesn't know what to do. However, Ji Ge feels a bit different about this CEO; it's as if he's known her ...

2322014.title: The God of War’s Revenge: Three Years of Silence
2322014.description: This drama centers on Ye Chen's identity reversal. 2322074.title: The Peerless Master in the City
2322074.description:
“The Supreme Expert in the City” tells the story of how an ordinary security guard, Ye Lingtian, rises to power in the urban jungle. Once a nobody, Ye Lingtian is unexpectedly drawn into a life‑and‑death conspiracy. Deep within him lies sealed a formidable cultivation realm, and his fate becomes inextricably bound with that of a mysterious woman named Shen Jiangyue. Shen Jiangyue possesses the “Supreme Yin Body,” while Ye Lingtian bears the “Supreme Yang Body”; by destiny, they are each other’s saviors. Yet Ye Lingtian’s arrival upends the plans of Wang Meng, the overbearing young master of the mighty Wang Clan, who, determined to claim Shen Jiangyue for himself, sets countless traps in her path.

As the plot unfolds, Ye Lingtian must not only withstand the Wang Clan’s relentless pressure but also unravel the mysteries of his own origins and the secrets of the seal within him. Relying on his extraordinary wit and unwavering resolve, he climbs step by step through a city fraught with danger, ultimately uncovering a shocking truth hidden beneath the surface. The tale blends elements of fantasy, urban life, and romance, offering both pulse‑pounding action and deeply moving emotional entanglements that keep readers spellbound.

2322221.title: Unparalleled Pampering: The Black Emperor's Adorable Wife
2322221.description: "Unparalleled Pampering: The Black Emperor's Adorable Wife" tells the story of the Black Emperor and his adorable wife, from their first meeting to falling in love. The Black Emperor dotes on his wife boundlessly, and after enduring twists, turns, and challenges, they finally walk towards happiness together, showcasing a sweet and genuine love story.
2322221.originName: 绝世盛宠，黑帝的呆萌妻

2322304.title: Peerless God of War
2322304.description: Gu Ming, the Underworld Marshal who has been living in seclusion for five years, is about to make his official comeback. 2322364.title: No If Only

This emotional entanglement not only plunges the three into a deep abyss of pain but also forces them to make difficult choices between love and reality.

2322466.title: Too Late to Say I Love You
2322466.description: Set in a turbulent era of war, a speeding train carries Yin Jingwan, a wealthy young woman from the ancient city of Wuchi, and Murong Peilin, the arrogant and spirited young marshal of the Cheng Army. 2322582.title: The Light That Falls into Life
2322582.description: This drama revolves around the male lead, Gu Jinshen, who, the day after his divorce, learns that the plane his ex-wife, He Wanluo, was on has crashed. It wasn't until Ni Xue returned that Gu Jinshen's passionate gaze at her made He Wanluo realize the truth: she was just a substitute. 2322646.description: This drama tells the story of Li Qian and Wen Yao's emotional entanglement spanning five years, depicting their journey from intimate lovers to a broken relationship. 2322781.title: You Love Me Too
2322781.description: This drama tells the story of Song Anning and Fu Tingshen, who have been married for five years through a business arrangement. After an unexpected health incident, Song Anning meets Dr. Fu Jinyan, and her condition gradually improves. Mea...

2322881.title: Wife-Seeking Game: The CEO's Late-Night Visits
2322881.description: This drama tells the story of Lin Qian, the female lead, who is forced into a contract marriage with the mysterious CEO Lu Jingchen due to a family crisis. As the plot progresses, Lin Qian discovers Lu Jingchen has ulterior motives for approaching her, while Lu Jingchen is gradually moved by Lin Qian's kindness and resilience during their time together. Over 108 episodes, the tw...

2322954.title: Those Years, The Love We Missed
2322954.description: This short drama centers on the marriage of university professor Qi Mochen and kindergarten teacher Song Ruannuan. 2323056.title: You Are My Destiny
2323056.description: This is a story about Wang Xiyi and Chen Jiaxin, two young people whose lives were like parallel lines, having no intersection. Due to an accidental love, they are destined to meet again and again.

2323108.title: You Are My Whole World
2323108.description: Five years ago, Lu Yiqian's girlfriend, Cheng Cheng, broke off their engagement and married a rich businessman. Lu Yiqian was very good to Tong Xingchen, but refused to acknowledge their relationship publicly and wouldn't let Tong Xingchen mention it to outsiders. 2323242.title: You Are My Grand Flight
2323242.description: This drama tells the story of female pilot Xia Chuyun and her husband Shen Tingzhou, set against the backdrop of a commercial marriage. During a sudden aircraft malfunction, Xia Chuyun expresses her love for Shen Tingzhou via radio, then chooses to sacrifice herself to save the lives of the passengers. After his wife's death, Shen Tingzhou gradually recognizes his true feelings and is consumed by regret. Through the critical scenario of an aviation accident, the work depicts the emotional conflicts and growth of the characters in life-and-death choices.

2323332.title: You Are My Joy for the Rest of My Life
2323332.description: This drama tells the story of Nan Chuxia and Gu Beizhao's contract marriage, showcasing the characters' choices amidst emotional entanglements and family responsibilities. The plot revolves around the main conflict of the three-year marriage contract ending prematurely.

2323382.title: You Are the Stars, Beyond Reach
2323382.description: This series is based on a romantic and touching tone. Specific plot details may vary depending on the episode. As of November 24, 2024, the overall style of the series is romantic and touching.

2323521.title: Our Unexpected Encounter
2323521.description: Fifteen years ago, An Ran was rescued from the snow by Shen Hezhi. Since then, she has been working for him, following his every step. A high fever caused her to lose memories before the age of seven, and she was also diagnosed with a genetic disease, needing Shen Hezhi's medicine for relief. An Ran believed that Shen Hezhi only gave her half a month's supply of medicine at a time because he feared her betrayal. But she would never betray him, for she had fallen in love with him at first sight fifteen years ago.

2323619.title: You and the Sky, Both Fall into My Heart
2323619.description: This drama is set against an aviation workplace background, focusing on the emotional entanglement between co-pilot Luo Xingyun and Shen Qingze after their divorce. The plot revolves around Luo Xingyun's seven years of marriage where her efforts went unreciprocated emotionally. After their divorce, she applies for a department transfer to avoid her ex-husband Shen Qingze, but is instead assigned to fly one last route to the place where they got engaged. During the flight mission, Qin Muqian suddenly proposes to Luo Xingyun, while Shen Qingze publicly asserts his claim by calling her 'wife', le...

2323716.title: Unforgettable Memories in the Twilight
2323716.description: This drama tells the story of Li Chenyan, who married Luo Nian after an accidental encounter three years ago, but never truly loved her. When his ex-girlfriend returns, he immediately proposes divorce. Luo Nian, having exhausted her courage in their three-year marriage, faces the pressures of depression, family debt disputes, and emotional betrayal. She ultimately chooses to let go and undergoes a personal transformation. The series focuses on the protagonists' emotional entanglement, showcasing the dilemmas of contemporary urban marriage and personal growth.

2323792.title: Accompany You Until the End of Time
2323792.description: The story centers on the emotional conflict between the protagonists, depicting the remorse and entanglement that arise from their disregard for each other's feelings, through the conflict setting of 'not cherishing someone when they're alive, only to regret it after their death.' The drama intensifies its dramatic tension through fierce dialogues like 'shedding crocodile tears' and 'scumbag.'

2323900.title: Mrs. Pei, You Can't Escape
2323900.description: This story primarily follows the emotional entanglement between Jiang Yuling (formerly Jiang Zhihan) and the wealthy heir Pei Jingyi. Their three-year-old overseas agreement broke down, leading to their separation. They reunite at a friend's wedding and later encounter each other in the workplace. Faced with Pei Jingyi's current girlfriend, Jiang Yuling feels a sense of resentment. The plot revolves around conflicts such as the struggle for inheritance and controversies surrounding single-parent backgrounds. It portrays the protagonist's struggles in workplace competition, emotional games, and...

2324010.title: My Heart Beats Only for You
2324010.description: Wen Yirou has been married to Lu Jinshen for five years. In this marriage, Wen Yirou endured Lu Jinshen's coldness and her sister-in-law's bullying, living like a puppet. One day, Wen Yirou accidentally discovered that Lu Jinshen had a mistress and that she was merely a substitute. After repeated blows, Wen Yirou became disheartened and agreed to go abroad with Song Ze for her mother's treatment. After losing Wen Yirou, Lu Jinshen found out that the person he was looking for all along was Wen Yirou. After many twists and turns, Lu Jinshen began his journey to win back his wife.

2324084.title: Seven Years of Deep Love, Gone in a Day
2324084.description: This drama tells the story of Ye Nanxing and Gu Lingchuan's seven-year marriage, showcasing the emotional entanglement of urban men and women and a woman's journey of self-awakening. Due to long-term separation, a cold and abusive marriage, and frequent accusations from Gu Lingchuan, Ye Nanxing discovers a strange perfume scent on her husband's clothes and files for divorce. Despite Gu Lingchuan's attempt to reconcile with a million-dollar alimony, she still chooses to sign the divorce agreement, eventually breaking free from emotional distress to restart her life. Through the detailed portray...

2324197.title: Love Across a Thousand Years
2324197.description: This drama tells the story of Lu Siyu, a high priest, and Chu Nianran, an ordinary girl, who fell in love in the ancient Yelang Kingdom but met a tragic end. Carrying the emotional ties from their past lives, they face numerous obstacles in this life, including family interests and mysterious dealings, yet they persistently pursue their love. The series showcases an emotional entanglement that transcends time and space.

2324278.title: Love in the Blue Sky
2324278.description: Cen Xia has been secretly in love with Gu Nanchen since university, and she chose a career in aerospace because of him. Cen Xia stayed by Gu Nanchen's side for years and finally became his girlfriend. However, she always knew that Gu Nanchen was only with her because his first love, An Fei, had left. Yet, she believed that one day she could melt Gu Nanchen's heart and that he would eventually propose to her. Unexpectedly, three years later, An Fei suddenly returned to China, making Cen Xia and Gu Nanchen's already precarious relationship even more fragile. The concern from her colleague Xie Ha...

2324424.title: Glory and Dreams to the End
2324424.description: The theme is "Dream Return" and making new choices. After living a life in a dream, Yan Miao realizes that there are higher pursuits in life beyond love. From then on, Yan Miao strives hard and eventually achieves the pinnacle of success in her career.

2324493.title: If Love Could Be Rewound
2324493.description: Smoking, drinking, fighting – things usually associated with boys, Tang Fei excelled at them. She's willing to do anything to get the love she desires. One is her nominal older brother, the other is Yu Han, a persistent rich second-generation suitor. How will Tang Fei choose?

2324602.title: If the Clouds Knew
2324602.description: Two years ago, Shen Xinglan and Lu Jinyun were lovers. However, Shen Xinglan's father, fearing the power of the Yan family, threatened Lu Jinyun's mother's life to force Shen Xinglan to marry Yan Lin. Shen Xinglan had no choice but to painfully break up with Lu Jinyun.

2324710.title: Glass Slippers of the Abyss
2324710.description: The Crystal Shoe in the Abyss

2324787.title: Time Once Looked Back
2324787.description: This drama centers on Tang Yunyi, a wealthy heiress who has loved actor Gu Nanxuan for five years. At Gu Nanxuan and Li Yuanyuan's wedding, she faces emotional betrayal and discovers she was merely a substitute. Simultaneously, Tang Yunyi faces the crisis of a broken engagement. Through the double predicament of shattered love and a dissolved engagement, the story explores her journey of self-identity and emotional belonging. The main plot focuses on the protagonist's choices and growth when confronted with emotional truths and entangled interests.

2324871.title: Ex-Wife, Let's Remarry
2324871.description: She accompanied him for five years, gaining neither his heart nor his affection. When she finally gave up, leaving a divorce agreement, that cold-hearted man suddenly realized: he couldn't live without her. Watching his ex-wife become more and more radiant, he whispered pitifully in her ear, 'What did I do that you disliked so much? I'll change everything from now on, please come back?'
2324871.originName: 时机长，夫人开飞机跑了！

2324950.title: He Is Like Stars in My Dream
2324950.description: This drama focuses on An Zhu's 18-year unrequited love for Shi Nian since childhood. An Zhu always keeps her feelings hidden. In college, witnessing Shi Nian fall in love with senior Cen Ling, she chooses to study abroad. She reunites with Shi Nian as a translator. After An Zhu leaves, Shi Nian gradually realizes that his habit has turned into love. Eventually, they face life's challenges together and confirm their feelings for each other. The plot revolves around the core question: "How long was the longest unrequited love you've experienced?" incorporating elements of unrequited love narrati...

2325024.title: He's Like a Star in the Sky
2325024.description: During college, Yu Qing had a crush on her senior, Fu Yunting. But with so many girls around him, Yu Qing could only send him a love letter that went unanswered, and then watched as their paths diverged. Five years later, Yu Qing became a makeup artist. One day, right after breaking up with her boyfriend Tang Yi, whom she'd met through a blind date, she unexpectedly runs into Fu Yunting, who was escaping reporters and jumped into her car. At this point, Fu Yunting has become a celebrity. Though they were once worlds apart, their destinies intertwine again due to this chance encounter.

2325145.title: The Actor’s Secret: Goodbye, My Unborn Child
2325145.description: After Ji Lichuan wins Best Actor, he becomes evasive about marrying Ruan Sihan. When rumors surface, he's quick to distance himself. His agent recommends a film for a prestigious award, and Ji Lichuan is ambiguous about going public with their relationship. Ruan Sihan then becomes pregnant, but Ji Lichuan, prioritizing his rising career, demands she abort the child and denies their relationship. Their conflict escalates, leaving Ruan Sihan in a painful dilemma.

2325259.title: The Chosen Noblewoman of Beijing
2325259.description: This drama tells the story of He Wanqing, a wealthy young lady, who is sent by her father to live with a common family for experience. After five years of hardship from her in-laws, she rises to become the殿主 of the Imperial Phoenix Sanctuary. She uses her power to take revenge on her ex-husband and wicked mother-in-law, and gradually takes control of the three major families in Beijing. As she grows up with her childhood sweetheart, she overcomes various challenges from different forces and eventually takes on the responsibility of bringing well-being to all living creatures.

2325372.title: Forbidden Ties: Falling for My Ex’s Uncle
2325372.description: Sheng Nanxing breaks up with her boyfriend after he cheats. She then reunites with Ji Beiwang, her 'uncle' whom she had previously confessed to and been rejected by. Through work, their feelings for each other grow. During this time, Ji Beiwang enters a commercial marriage with Lin Zhiyan, leading Sheng Nanxing to decide to give up on their relationship. Ji Beiwang later realizes his mistake and begins to pursue her. The story explores the conflicts and turns in urban relationships through workplace disputes and emotional struggles.

2325510.title: Crying for Her Until Dawn
2325510.description: Luo Qingwan and Si Jinyuan have been married for five years. Due to a misunderstanding caused by the death of Si Jinyuan's sister, Si Jinyuan begins to take revenge on Luo Qingwan. Si Jinyuan blackmails Luo Qingwan into giving up her career by threatening divorce. Her father's company is also given to Ning Feifei by Si Jinyuan, which infuriates Luo's father into a vegetative state. Unable to bear Si Jinyuan's revenge any longer, Luo Qingwan signs the divorce agreement. After Luo Qingwan leaves, Si Jinyuan suddenly realizes that his sister's death was an accident and that he had misunderstood h...

2325644.title: I Won't Wait for You Here
2325644.description: This drama tells the story of Su Manxue bravely making choices when facing marriage difficulties. The main storyline revolves around Su Manxue's marital crisis: her relationship with her husband undergoes a change, and although she has prepared divorce papers, she struggles with the decision. Under the continuous打击of indifference, she finally awakens and chooses to actively change her life's trajectory. The series showcases Su Manxue's journey of re-evaluating life and making choices through her awakening process.

2325739.title: I Can't Fall in Love with You
2325739.description: The cheerful and outgoing Jiang Beixing likes Gu Shenchuan. Through persistent effort and relentless pursuit, they finally become a couple. However, due to their significant family differences and social class disparity, Yang Lirong secretly pressures Jiang Beixing to leave Gu Shenchuan. Ultimately, they overcome numerous obstacles, walk down the aisle, and spend their lives together.

2325797.title: My Love, Never Returns
2325797.description: Han Jia Ai has been Lu Yun Zhou's co-pilot for five years and his wife for five years. However, Lu Yun Zhou always believed she was indirectly responsible for his parents' deaths, leading him to treat her coldly. Their marriage remained a secret, never disclosed to the public. Han Jia Ai was informed that Mu Yi Yi was Lu Yun Zhou's fiancée, and she also discovered Lu Yun Zhou was willing to violate his principles to help Mu Yi Yi.

2325918.title: My Bodyguard is a Big Shot
2325918.description: This drama tells the story of Zhang Qian, who is drugged and kidnapped in a bar, and is rescued by Young Master Long Ze of the Long family. She then discovers that he possesses advanced martial arts skills. To cope with subsequent crises, the Zhang family sets up a trap under the guise of recruiting bodyguards. Long Ze disguises himself as a retired driver to apply, deliberately hiding his strength but still passing the assessment, becoming Zhang Qian's personal bodyguard. During their time together, Long Ze repeatedly thwarts assassination attempts, and his true identity is gradually discover...

2326004.title: I Eloped with My Secret Crush
2326004.description: On a blind date, Wen Yixiao met a weird guy. Her former campus crush, Pei Lingyun, appeared to save the day and asked her if she would marry him. Wen Yixiao agreed, but unexpectedly, it was a nightmare. Pei Lingyun didn't love her; he married her only to get a bone marrow transplant for his nominal sister, Zhou Qinqi. After discovering the truth, Wen Yixiao agreed to donate bone marrow to Zhou Qinqi and left resolutely on the day the surgery was completed. Pei Lingyun only realized he loved Wen Yixiao after she left him. Years later, they met again, but this time, Wen Yixiao was about to becom...

2326137.title: I'll Wait for You at the End of the Starlight
2326137.description: I'll Wait for You at the End of the Starlight is a web drama starring unknown actors, a refreshing short story. If the stars have an end, I'll be there waiting for you. In this destined to fall world, I am destined to go to the end of the starlight to fight for a glimmer of hope for you and for this world. If I succeed, I will wait for you there.

2326233.title: I Say I Love You in the Clouds
2326233.description: Chu Yunxi and Fu Yechen were in a business marriage. For five years, Fu Yechen had been cold towards Chu Yunxi. Fu Yechen was a captain at Yunting Aviation, and Chu Yunxi was his co-pilot. Chu Yunxi was diligent and responsible at work, and meticulous in her care for Fu Yechen, yet he still disliked her. Fu Yechen's ex-girlfriend Ye Shanshan instigated conflict between Chu Yunxi and Fu Yechen. Chu Yunxi proposed a divorce to Fu Yechen and then moved out. After Chu Yunxi left, Fu Yechen realized he couldn't live or work without her. He forced Chu Yunxi to return, only to learn she had passed aw...

2326300.title: The Unreachable Starry Sky
2326300.description: This drama follows the growth journey of the protagonist, Xue Hewan, showcasing the spirit of contemporary youth in upholding their original aspirations amidst adversity. The story begins with Xue Hewan's humiliation on her wedding night, after which she signs a divorce agreement and embarks on an independent life, facing societal pressures and achieving self-breakthrough. Along the way, Xue Hewan meets Chi Xiwei, who shares her ideals. Under the witness of the starry sky, their emotions deepen and their careers advance, ultimately achieving success in both love and career.

2326429.title: The Tenth Year of Liking You
2326429.description: Ye Ruishu has secretly loved Mo Ziqian since college, a secret crush lasting ten years. Ye's father accrues gambling debts, and the creditors find Ye Ruishu at her company. Mo Ziqian lends her money to pay off the debt, asking her to pretend to be his girlfriend to deceive his mother. Mo Ziqian has been entangled with his ex-girlfriend, Xu Tong. Xu Tong is arranged to marry Lu Sian, the young master of the Lu Group. On their wedding day, Lu Sian flees. Mo Ziqian takes Xu Tong away, helping her out of a difficult situation. The media reports that Xu Tong and Mo Ziqian are together. Ye Ruishu go...

2326539.title: Village Storm: I Want to Be Village Chief
2326539.description: Rural Turmoil: I Want to Be the Village Chief
2326539.originName: 乡村风云之我要当村长

2326626.title: The Price of Love
2326626.description: Three years ago, Jiang Xinli was forced by her father to marry in her sister's place. Since then, she has endured countless torments from her husband, being misunderstood as an imposter, humiliated, and witnessing her grandmother fall critically ill due to her situation. To save her grandmother, she suffered silently, but still lost her beloved relative. Heartbroken and despairing, she walks towards the rooftop, her fate tragic, with both love and family ties ending in sorrow.

2326685.title: Love is a Thing of the Past
2326685.description: This drama tells the story of Su Man and Huo Jinyu, who have been married for three years. Although they are respectful to each other as husband and wife, they have no children. Su Man longs for a complete family. She hopes that the arrival of a new life will make this home warmer, and she is full of beautiful dreams for future family life, working hard to manage this marriage.

2326827.title: Starlight Journey, Endless Love
2326827.description: This drama focuses on the marital crisis between Leng Qiu and Han Chen, who have been married for eight years, due to fertility issues. Leng Qiu, a chief judge in a singing competition, uses her veto power to eliminate contestant Han Shuangshuang, further escalating the couple's conflict. Through a dual narrative of workplace power struggles and family emotional entanglements, the series portrays the trust dilemma and emotional choices in modern marriage.

2326970.title: I Promise You a Brilliant Life
2326970.description: Tang Yue and Yan Yichen were college sweethearts. By chance, Tang Yue discovered she looked strikingly similar to Yan Yichen's ex-girlfriend, Meng Ning, and realized she was just a substitute. Heartbroken, Tang Yue broke up with Yan Yichen and went abroad as an exchange student. Five years later, they meet again, but one is a surgeon who has returned home after completing her studies, and the other is a patient with paralyzed legs. Facing her former lover, a junior colleague who secretly admires her, and Meng Ning lurking in the shadows, Tang Yue and Yan Yichen's path to reconciliation is frau...

2327097.title: A Lifetime of Deep Affection for You
2327097.description: I promise you a lifetime of deep affection.

2327168.title: Unwavering Love, This Eternal Life
2327168.description: This drama tells the story of An Yan, a doctor at Tongcheng First People's Hospital, and Fu Jingchuan, a young entrepreneur, who are estranged due to past emotional entanglements. Their rift deepens when Fu Jingchuan sponsors a charity event, donating one hundred ECMO artificial heart-lung machines to a hospital in his hometown. Meanwhile, An Yan is diagnosed with advanced cancer and faces threats from her brother demanding money, forcing her to make difficult choices amidst her illness and family pressure.

2327265.title: My Life Can't Be Without You
2327265.description: This drama tells the story of Bai Qianci, the daughter of the Bai family, who is forced to marry Jiang Chenying, the head of the Jiang family, in place of her runaway sister Bai Shuangshuang, due to the scheming of her stepmother and stepsister. On her wedding night, she is uneasy in front of her cold husband. However, in her married life, she shows her kind and resilient nature, gradually touching Jiang Chenying's heart. Although Jiang Chenying appears distant, he secretly protects his wife. As the conspiracy is uncovered, the two, after experiencing twists and turns, finally confirm their fe...

2327398.title: Twilight with You
2327398.description: For three years, Chi Wanyan was a good wife to Qi Beichuan, but she could never melt his icy heart. After an unexpected diagnosis of ALS and facing a series of blows—Qi Beichuan's demand for divorce, a miscarriage, and her worsening condition—Chi Wanyan's heart turned to ashes. She begged Gu Chiyan to take her away. After losing Chi Wanyan, Qi Beichuan finally realized his mistakes and deeply regretted his actions, beginning a difficult journey to win her back.

2327650.title: The Unprecedented Downpour
2327650.description: Things first went wrong when the heavy rain continued for a month, and experts were still refuting it as merely a rare weather phenomenon. But flights were grounded, communication was cut off, and the entire city lost water and electricity. My downstairs neighbors fought tooth and nail over a box of mineral water. I knew the sky had fallen. My name is Lin Zhou, an ordinary office worker, and the only skill my job taught me was to sniff out the most dangerous signals from a flood of information.

2327747.title: My Husband Let an Intern Kill My Patient
2327747.description: I woke up and found myself back to the day the governor was rushed into the operating room for a heart transplant. My husband, unaware of the patient's identity, was letting an intern with nail polish perform the surgery to gain experience. Midway through, he abandoned the patient on the operating table to play games with his intern mistress. In my previous life, they effectively killed the governor and framed me. Little did they know, I had diligently studied medicine and was 30 years ahead of them.
2327747.originName: 老公让实习生带美甲做手术

2327822.title: I Gave Birth to Five Cats
2327822.description: Desperate for an heir, I ventured into the mountains, where a spirit tiger gifted me a pearl. After entering a cave, I became pregnant. Upon returning to the palace, nine other concubines and I were diagnosed with pregnancy. However, Concubine Liu, who had recently given birth, was executed along with her entire family for 'adultery.' When it was my turn to give birth, I delivered five狸猫. My maid quickly hid them in a privy bucket. The Emperor pushed open the door, asking about our child. I lied, claiming that Imperial Physician Xue (who had been executed and was close to the displeased Concub...

2327969.title: The Prime Minister's Spoiled Daughter
2327969.description: Feng Yuqin, daughter of the Prime Minister, comes from an illustrious background — her father is the beloved Prime Minister, her mother is a general's嫡女 (direct daughter of the main wife), and her elder brother is a first-rank imperial bodyguard. She was mischievous from a young age but much loved. Her father and elder brother indulged her every whim, even allowing her to skip imperial rituals with her father's tacit approval, making her well-known in the capital. On her fifteenth birthday, a new heaven worship ceremony approaches. She, who has always disliked entering the palace, is asked by ...

2328086.title: This Crazy Dynasty Needs to Be Destroyed
2328086.description: He was the Crown Prince, yet he lived in an absurd dynasty every single day. His father, the Emperor, was obsessed with body double literature, with all three thousand concubines sharing the same face; the General was a love-struck fool, slaughtering an entire city for one person; the Prime Minister's family was plagued by an endless drama of true and false daughters, constantly pondering the art of favoritism; his mother, the Empress, was mad, muttering about 'the legitimate empress selling off the illegitimate emperor.'
