He finally endured until his ascension, only to find that both his empre...

2328160.title: The Twin They Called a Curse
2328160.description: When my elder sister and I were born, a sorcerer predicted that one of the Song family's twins would bring about the family's downfall. Because I was quiet and didn't cry after birth, I was deemed the ill-fated one. My father, determined, prepared to drown me. My mother, unable to bear it, threatened to take her own life, declaring, 'She is also my daughter; no one is to kill her.' I survived, but I was sent to the most secluded courtyard in the Song family's back house, with only a nanny to care for me.

2328297.title: The Fallen Noble's Revenge
2328297.description: Lin Yangyang, the esteemed daughter of the Lin family in the capital, was once a pampered young lady. However, due to political upheaval, she became the daughter of a disgraced official, her family ruined overnight. Her loyal servant helped her escape, but for survival, sold her into the Rong Manor as a maid. There, she met the cold young master Rong Yan, and an unexpected bond formed. She endured humiliation, serving her masters while secretly harboring a desire for revenge. Beneath the facade of a maid, lay a heart unwilling to succumb, determined to rise again!

2328400.title: Dreaming of Deep Love
2328400.description: When I was fifteen, I had the same dream every day. In the dream, a man was critically ill, on the verge of death, always looking at me with pleading eyes. To uncover the truth, I drew his portrait and had people search the land. Eventually, I found him in the Kingdom of Liang. It turned out he was the unloved Prince Rui of Liang. To escape this dream, I went incognito as a female physician, approached him, and treated his illness.

2328482.title: Dawn of the Apocalypse
2328482.description: Things started going wrong when my rental agent updated his WeChat Moments with a video. When I clicked it, I could hear his thick Northeastern accent saying, 'I don't know what's going on at Chang Gung Hospital, but the police and medical staff are here!' I was on the subway and had just commented, 'Must be a confirmed case,' when I refreshed and the post was gone. Immediately after, a message from the agent came in, a voice note saying, 'Bro, I was just about to reply to you, how did that post disappear? I didn't delete it. I don't know if it's a confirmed case, but it looks pretty scary.'

2328532.title: Dawn of Ruin
2328532.description: I spent 300 million to buy a cruise ship. I plan to hide at sea, avoiding the zombie crisis. Because I know that no matter if it's the countryside or the mountains, as long as it's land, it definitely won't work. Who knows how long the zombie outbreak will last? If it lasts a long time, capitulation is only a matter of time. When I opened my eyes, I saw myself lying on my bed in pajamas. There were no zombie groans around. I carefully checked my whole body and then looked at the time. I'm sure I've been reborn. Reborn two months before the zombie outbreak.

2328651.title: Z-Day: My Family and Our Ark
2328651.description: Reborn two months before the zombie outbreak, I, along with my similarly reborn parents, team up with the long-standing family friend the Song family. We sell assets, buy a cruise ship, and hoard supplies to prepare for survival at sea. During this time, we expose my brother's love-struck girlfriend. Everyone overcomes challenges like operating the ship and transferring supplies. The zombies break out early. Song Wenjie is bitten but unexpectedly doesn't turn into a zombie, and also confesses his long-standing crush. Everyone escapes on the cruise ship, enduring crises like sea waves and ship ...

2328729.title: My Bunker, My Sanctuary
2328729.description: When I came out of the hardware store, I found that the sun-drenched day had turned into a heavy downpour. The authorities didn't seem to be taking it seriously enough. I glanced at the time; it was already the 20th. I rushed back to the car, knowing I only had about seven days. I needed to quickly figure out how to move all the expired supplies out of the bunker, but how was I going to move my newly purchased supplies in? By myself, it would probably take ten to fifteen days. Plus, the car couldn't get to the villa entrance; the typhoon-induced storm would directly trigger a tsunami, engulfin...

2328844.title: The Lucky Koi of the Apocalypse
2328844.description: I spent five million on a koi fish, only to be ridiculed as a spendthrift. Little did I know, when the high-temperature apocalypse arrived, the koi suddenly swelled into a humanoid behemoth, continuously spitting out gold coins, allowing my family to survive the crisis. When the koi reached its highest beast-level form, it not only provided pure water but also controlled the temperature. Even with outside temperatures soaring to fifty degrees, the house remained cool. My family was overjoyed, thinking they could rely on the koi to get through the apocalypse. But the koi only obeyed me. So, beh...

2328950.title: Rebirth in the Apocalypse
2328950.description: On the day the zombie apocalypse broke out, my husband cheated on me with his 'first love' and cruelly locked me out while I was pregnant. Eaten by zombies, while they lived happily in a luxurious shelter, I was unwilling and miraculously reborn half a month before the zombie apocalypse. In this life, I decide to use my father's factory to hoard supplies and build a fortress, making my ungrateful husband's family pay a heavy price.

2329052.title: The General's Daughter Chose Love
2329052.description: Shen Qinghuan, daughter of the Duke of Zhenguo, comes from a family that has guarded Liangzhou for generations. Her father and brothers died in battle. She took over as the female general of Liangzhou, fought against the Huns, pacified border troubles, and achieved many military successes. During this time, she fell in love with Yun Zhan, a former monk, and they made a two-year pact. In the capital, after Murong Heng ascended the throne, he both relied on and suspected her, eventually ordering her to be his empress. However, Shen Qinghuan's heart belonged to Yun Zhan, and she upheld their prom...

2329128.title: Ink Stained Pure Heart
2329128.description: My only friend is a transmigrator. She said her mission in this world was to save me. She believed in me, protected me, and even helped my husband ascend to the throne. Originally, she could have returned after completing her mission, but she said she found her beloved soulmate here; she wanted to stay in this world. But later, I rushed back from the border…

2329219.title: My "Dead" Husband Visits Every Night
2329219.description: Gu Han is forced to marry the spirit tablet of the deceased Mo Ran by her father. Unexpectedly, her 'dead husband' is actually a war god who secretly descended to the mortal world, returning every night to sleep with her. She goes from burning paper offerings to communicating with him and growing accustomed to his presence. During this time, she encounters exorcisms, heavenly investigations, and challenges from romantic rivals. Mo Ran, in an effort to keep her, freezes heavenly soldiers and empties the heavenly treasures, fully embracing his 'useless god' persona. Just as their life begins to ...

2329352.title: The Scheming Heiress
2329352.description: When the imperial decree of marriage came down, I was watering my father's precious ink orchid. My father, Jiang Shan, the Grand Tutor of the current dynasty, known as Chancellor Jiang, had been taken from his study by the imperial guards half an hour earlier, accused of colluding with the enemy and betraying the country. The yellow silk unfurled before my eyes, and a sharp voice, word by word, hammered into my ears: Gu Miaoyu, daughter of a treacherous official.

2329474.title: The Princess Who Survived the Fall
2329474.description: After the fall of the Southern Tang city, the nine-year-old princess was rejected by the Southern Emperor Wang Qian for her ugliness. To save face, her father married her off as a slave. The princess was locked in an iron cage and forced to eat pig slop. Concubine Liu risked her life to secretly bring her food and protect her survival. In a dark room, the princess secretly studied military strategies and martial arts, her fingertips developing hot blood blisters but she persevered through the nights, eventually becoming a strong young woman skilled in both literature and martial arts. On the n...

2329551.title: I'd Rather Be a Maid Than Your Mistress
2329551.description: I was the king's maid, trained for 6 years. Unexpectedly, I became pregnant before the princess even entered the palace. This was the biggest taboo in the royal household. So I packed my child and the king's property and fled to the capital, unaware that the wheels of destiny had just begun to turn. I was originally a country girl who sold herself to a human trafficker because of a severe drought and crop failure at home. If I had stayed, my parents and younger siblings might have starved to death, so I sold myself.

2329663.title: The 5.2 Million Debt of Love
2329663.description: Lin Nian and high school classmate Liu Ruyan had a mutual crush but never confessed. 7 years ago, Lin Nian borrowed 520 yuan from her to pursue his dream. 7 years later, Liu Ruyan becomes a star. During an anti-fraud program, she 'borrows' money from Lin Nian, who gives her all his savings. Liu Ruyan fulfills her 5.2 million yuan promise. They reunite and fall in love, overcoming misunderstandings and family challenges. Eventually, Liu Ruyan retires at the peak of her career. They get engaged at their old high school, completing their long-awaited mutual journey.

2329794.title: The Phoenix Who Chose Wrong
2329794.description: Feng Jin (actually a golden phoenix, whose true form was sealed by a golden needle) and her senior brother Lin Duan were in love for many years. However, when both she and her senior sister Shen Li were poisoned, Lin Duan abandoned Feng Jin and chose Shen Li. In despair, Feng Jin posted a notice to find a husband. Si Mo, claiming to be a wandering soul, took down the notice, and they married to cure the poison, also dissolving the 'concentric pill' that bound Feng Jin and Lin Duan. Feng Jin, using a token given by Si Mo, became the disciple of the Sect Leader, unsealed her phoenix true form, a...

2329876.title: Family Life
2329876.description: My mother loves to play the 'good person' so everyone asks her for help. When my uncle needed a guarantor for his business loan, my mother signed without hesitation. When my cousin couldn't afford a wife, my mother arranged for my sister to marry into his family in exchange. My other uncle had a stroke from drinking and his family abandoned him. My mother declared, 'If you don't take care of him, I will.' In my previous life, my mother brought the paralyzed uncle home and made me take care of him.

2329964.title: The Prince Who Beat Me
2329964.description: I've been running a noodle stall at the foot of the Imperial City for fifteen years. One day, the Crown Prince of Duan came to the capital to meet the Emperor. He rode his horse recklessly through the streets. Unexpectedly, the horse was startled and overturned my noodle stall. Just as I was about to demand an explanation, the Crown Prince whipped me twice, acting extremely arrogant. 'You're just a commoner. Even if I don't compensate you, what can you do to me?'

2330039.title: The Alluring Princess
2330039.description: After transmigrating with a system, I made thorough preparations every night until I successfully lured the General into my room. Nine months later, I gave birth to twins, a boy and a girl, successfully completing the system's childbirth mission. I left my son behind and eloped with my daughter. After all, I had signed an agreement with the system that once I gave birth, I would be free. But just as I was confidently venturing out with my child, I discovered that this era was a chaotic world where heroes contended for power, and the common people were displaced.

2330182.title: Pregnant and Being Sold
2330182.description: The day I was diagnosed with pregnancy, I overheard the Crown Prince and his concubine discussing, 'That maid, send her to the chief eunuch.' My hand was still on my belly, but my tears had already run cold. He once gave me a golden hairpin, expressing his affection, yet now, to curry favor with an eunuch, he wants to discard me. Sixteen years of childhood companionship, but it couldn't compare to power and schemes. Since that's the case—this East Palace, this Crown Prince, and this absurd 'blessing'—I want none of it. I will escape with my child, to the ends of the earth, never again to be so...

2330321.title: The Prisoner Who Seduced the Guard
2330321.description: I was a female prisoner awaiting execution in the autumn. To survive, I decided to get pregnant. So, I set my sights on the handsome and aloof jailer. Relying on my looks, I tried every trick to seduce him. At first, he ignored me, but later he became addicted,缠着 me every night. Until the day I was diagnosed with a pregnancy, a soft sedan chair was directly carried into the dungeon.

2330371.title: The Corrupt Official's Favorite Concubine
2330371.description: I was born fertile, but my husband gave me to a treacherous official as a plaything. In my previous life, I refused and was beaten to death, my body left exposed in the wilderness. This life, I immediately nodded and happily went, because I knew the official had a cold constitution and it was extremely difficult for him to impregnate a woman. After entangling with the official and sealing the deal, I touched my belly and returned home. Two months later, my entire family knelt before me, begging for my forgiveness. I was then splashed with cold water and woke up.

2330432.title: Global Cataclysm: I Can Infinitely Upgrade My Safe House
2330432.description: Global mutation, strange beasts run rampant, human civilization reduced to ruins. An ordinary young man unexpectedly awakens a safe house upgrade system, transforming his simple shelter into an impregnable steel fortress, unlocking armories, planting grounds, and medical capsules. He guards a sanctuary, sheltering survivors, and in the apocalypse, builds humanity's last line of defense.
2330432.originName: 全球灾变：我能无限升级安全屋

2330557.title: The Three-Year-Old Genius
2330557.description: Qin Fan, a transmigrator, comes from a unique family: his father is a bandit chief, his mother is a江湖 (Jianghu) enchantress, and his ancestors were involved in rebellion and remnants of a previous dynasty. At 16, he becomes the top scholar. To clear his family's name, he convinces them to pretend to be impoverished villagers to deceive the eunuch who delivers the good news. After arriving in the capital, he mistakes the incognito emperor for 'Uncle Li.' He directly points out the root causes of the disaster and the flaws in disaster relief efforts. In court, he outsmarts corrupt officials, ear...

2330695.title: The Zombie Gate
2330695.description: Even a pig knows not to take photos randomly in a military zone, but I, camera in hand, snapped away. Little did I know, this was my only chance to contact the military. I'd awakened a compulsory interdimensional portal, just barely surviving a zombie-infested world, and soon I'd be thrown back into that gory chaos. Weak as I am, I could only seek help from the state. Now, as expected, the military has taken me in as a spy for interrogation.

2330822.title: I Came Back to Destroy Them All
2330822.description: Jiang Li is reborn back to her 16th birthday on the Lantern Festival. In her past life, she was harmed by Gu Chenchuan and his beloved Su Wanyi; her child's heart was dug out, and her family was framed, leading to their gruesome deaths. In this life, she vows revenge. She avoids Gu Chenchuan's entanglement and travels to Shengjing to seek refuge with her grandmother's family, joining forces with the Second Prince Sheng Jing to oppose the Third Prince's faction. She designs to ruin Su Wanyi's innocent image, thwarts Gu Chenchuan's scheme to cling to the Jiang family, and assists the Second Prin...

2330897.title: Who Gets It! I Waited for Zombies, But Became the Only Prophet
2330897.description: The apocalypse has arrived, with zombies running rampant and everyone plunged into chaos. An ordinary protagonist unexpectedly awakens to the power of prophecy, becoming the only one in this shattered world who can see into the future. Relying on his visions, he repeatedly guides the survivors away from deadly threats—yet this very gift makes him a target for every faction vying for control. In the face of utter despair, he must use his wits and foresight to protect those around him and uncover the truth behind the end of the world.
2330897.originName: 谁懂啊！我等丧尸，却成了唯一预言家

2331045.title: The Farmer's Daughter Became a Concubine
2331045.description: My family has been farmers for generations. In my father's generation, he firmly believed that the more children you have, the more blessings you receive. So, after my parents got married, they focused on having many children. Since I can remember, my mother's womb has never been idle. I am currently the third child, with two older brothers and three younger brothers. My mother is also five months pregnant with another. My father constantly praises my mother. In the neighboring village, there was a scholar who studied diligently for ten years and finally passed the imperial examination, becomi...

2331176.title: The Lazy Empress Only Wants to Nap (and Solve Crimes)
2331176.description: After entering the palace, Xu Chu only wanted to be a layabout. With her fortune-telling skills, she repeatedly solved mysteries in the harem, helped the emperor resolve natural disasters, man-made calamities, and crises. She was moved from a small dilapidated courtyard near the cold palace to the Qiankun Palace, and eventually crowned Empress. Adhering to her desireless, layabout nature, she entrusted the affairs of the six palaces to others, only focusing on eating and sleeping. Unexpectedly, this brought stability to both the harem and the court, allowing her to 'lie flat' and become the mo...

2331294.title: The Lamp Girl Who Listened Too Much
2331294.description: When I was fifteen, I became the candle-lighting attendant in Concubine Shu's palace. Besides always walking ahead to light her way, a candle-lighting attendant also had to guard all the candles in the palace at night, especially the long-burning lamps in each chamber, which could not be extinguished. The back hall I managed was closest to her private chambers, so I could be there instantly if Concubine Shu needed anything at night. Often, she would call me in to light the lamps, then quietly sit with her for half the night. Sometimes, she would ask me some disjointed questions.

2331344.title: The Emperor Forgot His Promise
2331344.description: Entering the palace at nine, she spent twenty years rising from tea-serving maid to head governess, experiencing both favor and indifference. She even heard the young emperor's childhood vow to 'never leave.' Yet, on the day Mingxi ascended the throne, she was on the list of those to be dismissed. Looking back at the palace walls in the falling snow, she finally understood: what she had witnessed her whole life was never 'forever,' but the inevitable departure of an old confidante in the palace's cycle of change.

2331436.title: The God-Given Power
2331436.description: At the brink of death, a young man accidentally touches an ancient altar and awakens the Power of Divine Revelation. Instantly, sacred light pours down, not only healing his wounds but also granting him the ability to converse with gods. With this power, he defeats monsters, shakes sects, and pacifies chaotic times. Yet, upon reaching the pinnacle, he horrifyingly realizes: this power is an eternal shackles laid by the gods.

2331575.title: Survival War
2331575.description: A new super flu is raging globally. Disturbing violent videos on social media are being deleted instantly, and helicopters constantly circle above the city. While everyone thinks this is just temporary panic, I, an ordinary risk assessor, sense the apocalypse approaching from scattered data and hidden abnormal events.

2331675.title: Covenant of the Sacred Sword
2331675.description: A young man, armed with a sacred sword, embarks on a path of revenge to foil a conspiracy and gather allies. The once-destitute orphan rises to become a legendary monarch, commanding the land and protecting a pure realm in the name of the covenant.

2331777.title: The Princess Who Survived the Fall
2331777.description: On that fateful day, at the age of six, I was cradled in my father's arms. He pressed a token into my hand, its meaning then unknown to me. 'Stay close to your mother, live well,' he urged before pushing me away and taking his own life. My mother found me, my small hands pressed against my father's neck, not understanding but desperately wanting him to live. Yet, she merely glanced at him, then pulled me away. As we exited the palace, I saw all my brothers lying lifeless on an open ground.

2331864.title: Who's My Husband? I Married Twins
2331864.description: On my wedding night, I bit my husband's neck, leaving a plum blossom mark. The next day, I found the mark on his twin brother. I was terrified because my kind husband had warned me before the wedding that his twin brother was a ruthless devil and I must distinguish between them, or there would be dire consequences. That night, under the flickering red candles, my usually gentle husband became extremely fierce and strong. The next morning, I woke up and turned over with difficulty, only to be met by Huo Qing's cold, elegant face.

2331993.title: My Twin Brother, My Master
2331993.description: After my mother gave birth to my twin brother and me, my father, the emperor, never visited our separate residence again. This was because twins are considered inauspicious in Northern Yan. So, my mother, Concubine Lan, sent me, the first-born, to a manor a hundred miles away, leaving only a wet nurse to care for me. When I was four, my younger brother, who was already the Ninth Prince, was almost poisoned. Concubine Lan needed someone she could absolutely trust to protect her son closely, and she remembered me. That year, Granny Wu, who had raised me since childhood, fell seriously ill, and w...

2332064.title: Thirteen Years of Revenge
2332064.description: Xia Zhi is sold as a maid to the Wen family by her brother, where she is treated kindly. Later, the Wen family is framed by Prince Zhao of Jun for illegal salt trade and sentenced to death. Xia Zhi rescues the young master, Wen Chen, and flees with him to Huaquan County. She opens a noodle shop and raises him with great difficulty. After Wen Chen passes the imperial examination and becomes an official, he collaborates with his old friend Zhao Ze. Using Prince Shen's rebellion as an opportunity, they expose Prince Zhao of Jun's crimes, clearing the Wen family's name. In the end, Xia Zhi marries...

2332192.title: The Orphan Who Became a Healer
2332192.description: After my father passed away, no one in the village dared to step into our yard. My mother died in childbirth when I was born, and my father died of the plague five years later. The village blind man declared that I was a lone star reincarnation, destined to bring misfortune to my parents and relatives, and anyone who associated with me would surely have a short life. This rumor quickly spread among the villagers. They expelled me, a mere 5-year-old, from the village and burned down my straw hut, attempting to drive away the 'disaster star'. With nowhere to go, I wandered in the bitter winter s...

2332288.title: Daddy Loves My Half-Siblings More
2332288.description: After my mother gave birth to me and my younger brother, Father never stepped into our courtyard again. This was because my grandmother had forced my mother upon him. Father and his legitimate wife were deeply in love. Ever since my younger brother and I, as concubine-born children, came into the world, Father felt his duty was done. From then on, he devoted himself entirely to his legitimate wife. I rarely saw him. When I was little, the happiest thing for me was standing at the garden gate, because Father would always pass by, holding the hands of my legitimate elder brother and sister. When...

2332342.title: My Husband Killed My Family
2332342.description: Within the Eastern Palace, schemes and intrigues simmer beneath the surface. As an unloved Crown Princess, she advances with utmost caution, struggling to survive amid the court’s power struggles and machinations. When the Crown Prince joins forces with a powerful minister to set a trap, she is dragged into the struggle for succession—only to discover that her own origins are inextricably linked to this very conflict. To protect those she holds dear and uphold the principles of her heart, she confronts the entire imperial court with a fragile, yet resolute spirit, ultimately forging her revenge and redemption through blood and tears.

2332457.title: I Refused the Crown I Waited 10 Years For
2332457.description: I had longed for the title of Princess Consort of Ning for ten years, yet when the imperial decree was read, I publicly refused the marriage. Amidst the gasps of the court officials, I lowered my head, allowing the princess consort's beaded crown, which I had dreamed of for years, to be slowly carried away by the eunuchs. This was because, in my previous life, Su Yuyao, the original candidate for Princess Consort of Ning, was unexpectedly attacked and died. I then took her place and married for ten years. My home country, to help my husband Xiao Jingchen seize the throne, exhausted its nationa...

2332551.title: Reborn in the Palace: Protecting My Palace Mom
2332551.description: The reborn female protagonist rejects the Empress and wisely chooses to be born into the womb of Consort Xiang Huayu, who is favored but struggles with infertility. The deep palace is full of dangers; the Empress Dowager and Empress covet the royal heir for power, and there's a past grudge of the Consort losing a child. The protagonist, with the help of a system, assists her mother in concealing the pregnancy and avoiding schemes. The Emperor, on the surface, dotes exclusively on the Consort, even bestowing the title of 'Consort Chen,' but secretly balances court and family power. The mother a...
2332551.originName: 胎穿深宫：贵妃娘不好惹

2332652.title: Leveling Up to Godhood Without Even Trying
2332652.description: A useless young man accidentally binds with the 'Lie Flat System'. No need to cultivate, no need to fight, he can level up and become stronger just by lying down. While others desperately strive to break through, he masters techniques after a nap; when enemies come to provoke, he just turns over and crushes them all. From an abandoned disciple of the sect to the supreme being of the Three Realms, he wins every step of the way, continuously cheating, and single-handedly transforms the cultivation world into his personal 'lie flat' paradise!

2332779.title: Reunion Where Peach Blossoms Fall
2332779.description: That year, peach blossoms fluttered in the wind as she and he made a promise, only to be torn apart by a family tragedy. Years later, fate brought them together again in a bustling metropolis. He had risen to become a rising star in the business world, while she had shed her youthful naivety and grown into an independent woman. Old misunderstandings and lingering heartaches began to unravel with their reunion, and they found themselves reexamining that unforgettable love. As peach blossoms once more drifted down, would they be able to bridge the chasm of time and rediscover the thrill of their first encounter?

2332845.title: The Maid and the Eunuch
2332845.description: Xiao Qing, a young palace maid, enters the palace and lives cautiously. She befriends the eunuch Gu Chun, and they support each other. They become entangled in palace disputes, including the Peach Blossom Poison and the miscarriage of a prince. Together, they uncover the truth, navigating events like the Empress's pregnancy and Wei Duke's rebellion. They protect each other and help Consort Jin find peace. Ultimately, Gu Chun's meritorious service in protecting the Emperor earns them permission to leave the palace. They open the 'Chun Qing Medical Clinic' in Jiangnan, far from palace strife, li...

2332936.title: Fated Beast Partner
2332936.description: In my past life, when choosing a beast partner, I was overly compassionate and picked a dying, unwanted, scoundrel snake. Little did I know, she possessed true dragon bloodline. During our bonding ceremony, she summoned heavenly lightning, transformed into a black dragon, massacred 180 lives in my sect, and even ascended to the Upper Realm with my second junior brother, who always opposed me, to look down upon all beings. When I opened my eyes again, I was back to the day I chose my beast partner. This time, I picked up a cat hiding in the bushes, watching the show. Everyone laughed at my poor...

2333001.title: Dumping My Scummy Childhood Sweetheart, I Married His Boss
2333001.description: Jiang Yunchen looked at me with tender eyes and said, 'When Xiaoyue turns sixteen, I'll marry you.' I waited and waited for seven years, only to hear that Jiang Yunchen was going to Beijing for an appointment. He told everyone but me, his fiancée. I knew he disliked me for being foolish and clingy. Later, I overheard him telling someone that his promotion was thanks to Senior Gu from Jiangzhou's recommendation, and he was going to visit him to express his gratitude. 'No need to tell Lin Xiaoyue, she's like a dog, she'll sniff her way to Jiangzhou anyway.'
2333001.originName: 退婚渣竹马，我嫁他上司了

2333108.title: My System is a Chaotic Mess
2333108.description: Guan Muxi transmigrates into an old-fashioned dog-blood novel as a fake daughter, binding to a crazy male-fantasy system. She is forced to complete bizarre tasks like humiliating the emperor and fighting in the Northern Expedition, developing immense strength and military achievements. Upon returning home, she easily overpowers the true daughter, Guan Qingyue, and is betrothed to the crown prince by the emperor. However, due to system tasks, she instead leads troops south to quell a rebellion. She eventually discovers that the system was set up by her father, Guan Mo, to escape imperial contro...

2333171.title: The Crippled Girl Who Shocked the Emperor
2333171.description: Xiao Wu, the illegitimate daughter of the Duke's Mansion, was born to a fallen dancer who died of heartbreak after losing favor. Neglected from a young age, she accidentally offended someone and was punished, resulting in a crippled left leg, preventing her from inheriting her mother's dancing skills. To survive, she hid her talents, pretending to be a timid cripple, and was raised by her stepmother. At a palace banquet, a beam adorned with nine dragons playing with a pearl came loose. Xiao Wu rushed out to save the Crown Prince, her left leg was crushed, making her the Prince's savior. Seeing...

2333222.title: My "Husband" Had a Fiancée in the Capital
2333222.description: I was married to Shen Jingyuan for five years. It wasn't until the day he was cleared of his charges and was to return to the capital that I discovered he was actually the Third Prince. He told me to pack my bags, saying he would take me to live a peaceful life in the capital, but secretly, I had already prepared my bags to leave the city. As I returned home, carrying the unsold flatbreads, Shen Jingyuan was just walking out the door. He had changed out of his usual faded blue clothes, his hair was tied with a jade crown, and he exuded a proud nobility I had never seen before. I had just learn...

2333336.title: My Husband Wants to Kill Me (Again)
2333336.description: I know Su Yanqiu wants to kill me. I could tell from the tormented look in his eyes after he emerged from seclusion. He held my hand, his voice filled with nostalgia, 'Qing Ci, how many years have we been Dao companions?' I leaned in obediently, pointing to the pear tree outside the window, 'A hundred years, husband. You planted this tree for me yourself.' A hundred years ago, he was a famous genius of the Sword Sect, and I was just a lowly cultivator. He was ambushed by the Underworld Sect and lost all his cultivation. I found him at the foot of the mountain and saved him for three years with...

2333402.title: The Little Beggar's Fishing and Cultivation Journey
2333402.description: Pointing to Su Qingyu, look at this child's spiritual root. The pressure of this ladder not only hones physical strength, perseverance, and spiritual power, but also reveals cultivation talent. The higher the spiritual power and talent, the easier it is to climb the ladder; otherwise, it's impossible to reach the top. This girl is loyal and righteous, and her steps are light on the ladder. At such a young age, she possesses extraordinary talent. Indeed, this girl has a good disposition and top-notch talent.

2333473.title: The Fourth Miss Who Refused the Emperor
2333473.description: Fang Xiaosi was an unloved concubine daughter of the Duke of Su's household. Born with an unusual condition, she was disliked by her father. Her birth mother suffered greatly to protect her and passed away when Xiaosi was ten. Xiaosi was then entrusted to her stepmother's care. During a palace banquet, she bravely pushed the Crown Prince away, but was struck by a dragon pearl, becoming lame and saving the Prince's life. Seeing this, her father registered her under his legitimate wife's name, meticulously grooming her to marry the Crown Prince for political gain. However, Xiaosi secretly strive...

2333538.title: Heartbeat Signal
2333538.description: He Qiang and his neighbor Liu Ruyan meet through a Bluetooth connection mix-up. Unexpectedly, Liu Ruyan becomes his boss and assistant. They interact frequently at work and in life, from overtime rides home to sharing meals, leading to rumors. At a team-building event, Liu Ruyan confesses her feelings, overcoming the obstacle of their differing statuses. They end up together, starting a sweet life.

2333604.title: Tale of a Heartfelt Alliance
2333604.description: After news arrived that my father had joined the army, my mother was forcibly sold to Zhang the hunter in our village by my grandmother. My mother said she wanted to take me with her, but grandmother glared and asked if the hunter would pay for me. 'Such a big girl could fetch 10 taels of silver if sold to a human trafficker,' she said. My mother squeezed my hand tighter. We both knew that once she left, grandmother would sell me off immediately, not keeping me for another day.

2333683.title: We Both Regretted Our Marriage
2333683.description: After giving up our identities to be an ordinary couple, Xiao Yi and I both regretted it. So, reborn into this life, we tacitly avoided all the miracles we encountered in our previous life. When we met again, he was already the victorious Grand General, celebrated and renowned as he entered the capital. He happened to encounter a wedding procession, unaware that the person in the palanquin was the one he had despised in his past life. When I learned that Xiao Yi did not attend the Prime Minister's flower viewing banquet, I knew he had also been reborn.

2333829.title: The Reversal of the Mystic Fox
2333829.description: My father and mother were both noble white foxes, but I was born a mixed-breed fox. My mother's face turned pale with fright, and she quickly used an ancient secret technique to dye my fur purple. I grew up pampered by my father. On the day I came of age, my father personally found excellent male foxes from our clan for me to choose a husband. But unexpectedly, after my wedding, I gave birth to the lowest-class mixed-breed fox! Meanwhile, my sister, a lower-class gray fox, gave birth to a rare purple fox for the clan...

2333880.title: The Only One Who Stayed
2333880.description: The day the Fifth Prince was demoted to a commoner, all the servants in the mansion went wild, taking anything valuable. When he was thrown back, covered in wounds, the vast mansion was left with only me, and the once beautiful and luxurious house became dilapidated. Actually, I had wanted to leave too, but I didn't know where to go. Should I go home and let my father sell me again?

2333940.title: I Picked a Loser Cat, She Got a God Bird
2333940.description: When our sect chose spirit beasts, I, naturally lazy, picked the pretty bird, thinking it would fly me around for fun. My sister, focused solely on cultivation, chose the grey cat with the strongest spiritual essence. Unexpectedly, that grey cat just sunbathed and slept all day, refusing to move when my ambitious sister called it, much to her frustration. But I envied her greatly because I had originally planned to just completely lie flat, yet I never expected the bird I chose to be the ancient mythical beast, Xuan Niao (Black Bird).

2334000.title: Pregnant and On the Run
2334000.description: Lin Xiaomiao, originally a concubine's maid to Prince Zhao Zhengyuan, fled to the northern frontier with her savings after becoming pregnant, fearing for her life once the legitimate princess entered the household. There, she gave birth to her son, Changming. Years later, Zhao Zhengyuan became the Crown Prince. Noticing Changming's striking resemblance to himself, he tracked them down in the northern frontier. A blood test confirmed their father-son relationship. After enduring trials like their son going missing, Zhao Zhengyuan passionately sought to win her back, promising to love only her f...

2334065.title: A Touch of Life
2334065.description: At 15, my mother sold me to the palace for 300 coins, ending my carefree childhood. At 17, the Imperial Noble Consort, seeing my plain looks and docile nature, sent me to be the Sixth Prince's bed-warming maid. The following year, when the Sixth Prince married, I left the palace with him. It's said that mother-in-law and daughter-in-law never get along. The Sixth Princess, having been upset by the Imperial Noble Consort, took her anger out on me. That day, she returned from the palace, found a random excuse, and ordered Nanny Liu to beat me half to death. She then instructed the nanny to sell ...

2334137.title: With a Single needle, I Became the Martial God
2334137.description: A young, good-for-nothing acquires an ancient acupuncture heritage. A single silver needle can shatter vital energy and cure chronic diseases. In a flourishing martial arts world, he uses needles as weapons, defeating powerful enemies with one needle and stabilizing the world with three. He steps on prodigies, defeats grandmasters, and ascends to the peak of martial arts under the gaze of thousands, forging an immortal legend of becoming a martial arts god through acupuncture!

2334263.title: Mom Dressed Me as My Brother to Die
2334263.description: When I was seven, a group of soldiers raided my home, searching everywhere. My mother, with red eyes, pulled me into a room, dressed me in my brother's clothes, and pushed me out. Soon, I was taken away in a prisoner's cart. All the way, I cried loudly, thinking that if my cries were loud enough, my parents would come to save me. It wasn't until I heard the escorting officers say, 'All males will be executed, females sent to the brothel,' that I realized my mother wanted me to die in my brother's place.

2334395.title: Jade Pendant Romance
2334395.description: Five years ago, I transmigrated to the Qin Dynasty and became the newly appointed magistrate of Beiliang County. This was the most remote and wild exile land in Qin. On my way to take office, I met a fairy-like woman. She was poisoned with a charm and we had a one-night stand. But the next day, she was gone, leaving only a noble-looking jade pendant on her waist. I touched the empty pillow beside me and sighed: Forget it, I'm just a small county magistrate, she and I are not from the same world. That night was just an accident, this dream has lasted for five years, it's time to wake up.

2334479.title: The Emperor Used Our Daughter to Win
2334479.description: Shen Nianqing, the Prime Minister's headstrong daughter, is saved by Prince Ningyuan, Xiao Yan, after falling into water before a celestial offering ceremony. They fall in love, and she is later decreed to marry him. After marriage, Shen Nianqing discovers her father, to support Prince Zhaoxuan, ordered Qinghe to administer the Cold Fragrance Pill to Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan, however, had known all along but kept silent. Shen Nianqing gives birth to a daughter, Xiaoli, who tragically dies from a Northern Yan蛊 poison. Investigation reveals it's linked to her father and others' past conspiracy to harm...

2334586.title: Within the Courtyard Walls: Our Apocalypse Utopia
2334586.description: My family owns a house in the city center. We missed out on a large compensation package during an old city renovation because of a small hill behind our house. Now, our property is a triangular area surrounded by commercial districts, residential complexes, and roads. Yet, in the apocalypse, this very spot becomes a natural sanctuary. A series of urgent beeps from an alarm clock jolted me awake. I instinctively turned off the alarm, rolled over, and prepared to go back to sleep. The next moment, I snapped wide awake: an alarm clock? Wasn't I at home, about to be bitten by zombies?
2334586.originName: 院墙之内：我们的末日桃花源

2334726.title: A Tranquil Courtyard
2334726.description: Thirteen-year-old Ah Ran is sold into the Li family as a concubine. She has no desire to vie for favor, focusing instead on managing her small courtyard and growing fruits and vegetables. Her innocent and straightforward nature unexpectedly wins the favor of the young mistress, and the two become close friends. The young mistress protects her from difficult situations, teaches her to read and manage affairs, and later helps her transform, take charge of the embroidery shop, and achieve self-realization. Ah Ran also unintentionally helps the young mistress and young master resolve their misunde...

2334837.title: My Secret Lover Became the Emperor
2334837.description: After returning to the capital, I secretly kept an outer mistress in the South Street. She was a poor scholar who came to the capital for the imperial examination, and her appearance was 70% similar to my beloved. After half a year, I grew tired of her and found an excuse to disappear completely. Unexpectedly, half a year later, the new emperor ascended the throne, and when my husband and I went to pay our respects, I looked up and saw my former mistress sitting on the dragon throne, wearing a bright yellow dragon robe, with dark eyes. What a coincidence, the Marquis's wife looks exactly like ...

2334923.title: The Concubine's Daughter: Sold to the Palace
2334923.description: When I was fifteen, my mother sold me into the palace for 300 coins. At seventeen, the Imperial Noble Consort, seeing me as plain and obedient, assigned me as a concubine's maid to the Sixth Prince. The following year, the Sixth Prince married, and I was sent out of the palace with him. They say mother-in-law and daughter-in-law rarely get along, and the Sixth Prince's consort, having been reprimanded by the Imperial Noble Consort, took her anger out on me. That day, she returned from the palace, found a random excuse, and ordered wet nurse Liu to beat me half to death. She then instructed the...

2335027.title: The Awakening of the True Dragon
2335027.description: As a descendant of the dragon race, it was difficult to continue the bloodline, and only by marrying into the jiao (flood dragon) race could it be done. My father was the supreme golden dragon, and my mother was a fertile white jiao. Yet, I was neither dragon nor jiao, but merely a lowly black snake. Upon seeing me, my father felt my mother had shamed him, and immediately divorced her. My mother, in turn, came to resent me.

2335083.title: The Concubine's Daughter: Same Fate as My Mother
2335083.description: When I was ten, my uncle sold me for ten taels of silver, just as my father had sold my mother. When the old madam from Yongyi Marquis Mansion came to choose, she said, 'Hmm, this one is good, you're the one.' She thought I looked proper, with red lips, white teeth, and clear eyes, so she chose me to raise by her side as a concubine for her legitimate grandson. I was destined to follow in my mother's footsteps, and thus the wheels of fate began to turn.

2335191.title: Stepping Stone? Not This Time!
2335191.description: On my wedding day, my husband kicked my sedan chair over. When I crawled out, Shen Zhaoting said disdainfully, 'Do you need three or four invitations to get out of the sedan chair? What a pretense! Is this the upbringing of the Su family?' Hearing this, I trembled all over – I had been reborn. I was originally the only daughter of the richest man in Great Wei, but on my coming-of-age day, I was sought in marriage by the Yongning Marquis's Mansion. For a merchant family to marry into the aristocracy was a great blessing, and my father even used half of his family's wealth as my dowry.

2335323.title: Reborn and Ready for Revenge
2335323.description: I was reborn. In my past life, my mother-in-law picked up a sausage from the trash and secretly added it to my and my daughter's meal, causing us both to be poisoned and die tragically. To cover up the truth, my husband's family threw us into an earthen stove and burned us to ashes. What's even more disgusting is that in less than two months, that scumbag remarried with his new love. When I opened my eyes again, I was back to the day my mother-in-law had just picked up the sausage. In a daze, I saw my mother-in-law secretly carrying two sausages into the house, and I realized I had been reborn...
2335323.originName: 重生归来：不做婆家垫脚石

2335404.title: Rewriting My Destiny: My Family's Script is Trash
2335404.description: The incense table was set in the hall. Everyone knelt down. The eunuch's shrill voice was particularly clear in the silence. The eunuch loudly read: 'The eldest daughter of the Lin family, gentle and virtuous, with a kind heart, is hereby bestowed in marriage to the Marquis of Jingbei. By Imperial Decree.' I knelt before everyone, and upon hearing 'By Imperial Decree,' my body subtly trembled. I was back, back to the very day the Emperor decreed this marriage, exactly as it was in my previous life. As soon as the eunuch finished speaking, my mother immediately rose, beaming, and slipped a bulg...
2335404.originName: 重生后，我撕碎了全家剧本

2335488.title: Twice Born, Sisters United
2335488.description: The year our family was poorest, Father laid out lots for my sister and me to choose our fate. I drew the slip for the courtesan's guild, while my sister luckily was sold into the Song family. Later, I was used as a tool by a prince to win favor, eventually suffering death by dismemberment. Two years later, my sister was also tortured to death by the Song family matriarch. When I opened my eyes again, both my sister and I had been reborn to that very day of drawing lots.

2335571.title: Reborn Concubine
2335571.description: I hardened my heart and climbed into the master's bed, transforming myself into the young lady's mother-in-law. In my previous life, the young lady and her husband were deeply in love. When she was diagnosed with pregnancy, she kindly sent me to warm her husband's bed. A few months later, the young lady indeed gave birth to a pair of twins. To prove his devotion to his wife, the husband immediately had me executed, and the two continued their loving relationship. This became a celebrated tale throughout the capital. But when I died, I was already two months pregnant.

2335621.title: Rebirth of the Princess's Revenge
2335621.description: In my previous life, Xiao Ce, the consort I loved deeply, conspired with the fourth prince, Murong Jin, in a treacherous rebellion. They personally murdered my parents, overthrew our kingdom, and this ungrateful consort severed my tendons, leaving me a cripple to be slaughtered. I ultimately died in the military camp. Before my death, I swore that if I had another life, I would avenge myself.

2335744.title: Reborn, He Remembers Everything
2335744.description: After a rebirth, she returns to the day she bought her husband. She only wants to sever ties, live peacefully, and firmly refuses to buy Lu Yanzhou. However, forced by the village chief's kindness, she can only take him in as a 'brother' and keep her distance. She never expected that Lu Yanzhou also returned with his past life's memories, obsessively trying to win everything back. Meanwhile, her childhood sweetheart and fiancé, Xie Yun, returns from rumors of his death in battle. The fates of the three are intertwined once again. Qin Shuyue navigates between two men, avoiding Lu Yanzhou's疯纠缠 a...

2335800.title: I Reincarnated as the Alpha Snake
2335800.description: I woke up to find myself a king cobra. Every time I went to the stream for a drink, my own reflection scared my scales off. But I just got here, am I crazy? As a spirit snake with human consciousness, how could I breed randomly? Yet, other spirit snakes were eyeing me for that very reason. I glanced at the short and stout pit viper next to me and warned coldly, 'Stay away from me, or I'll swallow you whole.'
2335800.originName: 重生之我在蛇界当女王

2335893.title: The Zhou Family's Three Sisters
2335893.description: Father was framed and died in prison, but Mother didn't collect his body. Instead, she turned over all family possessions and went to Qing Mountain Temple, a thousand miles away, to practice Buddhism. The Zhou family suffered, and we three sisters had nowhere to turn for help. We set out in the heavy snow to find Mother, but were caught by a troop of cavalry on the way. I fell to the ground, my body gradually losing warmth, while my elder sister silently endured the cavalry's abuse.

2336028.title: My "Dead" Husband Came Back Too Soon
2336028.description: I pretended to be a fool and married the Prince's memorial tablet, thinking I could leave Yongning Marquis Manor with a divorce paper after the three-year mourning period. But to my surprise, two years later, one afternoon, my husband, who was supposedly killed in battle, returned. Watching the excited scene at the Marquis Manor, I was stunned. Why did he come back now? I'd been counting the days on my fingers, even planning where to go and what to do for a living after leaving the manor. Couldn't you have waited until after the three years, even if you weren't dead?

2336172.title: My Sister Stole My Future Husband
2336172.description: My younger sister is pregnant with the Third Prince's child, but she is not yet married. To get what she wants, she cries, makes a scene, and threatens suicide. She even kneels, begging to use our grandfather's founding功勋 (meritorious service) to secure a marriage decree. Threatening to take her own life, she forces our father to give her more than half of the family's assets as a dowry. Later, the Third Prince ascends the throne, but my sister is not the Empress. This is because the new Emperor declared, 'Too strong an external power (relatives of the Empress) would destabilize the empire.'

2336269.title: My Sister Exposed My Secret
2336269.description: Before the imperial concubine selection, I was diagnosed with a pregnancy. My family unanimously decided to keep the news a secret to protect me. Unexpectedly, my stepsister, during a palace banquet, deliberately reached out to block a drink for me. 'My sister is pregnant and can't drink,' she blurted out. Realizing her mistake, she quickly bowed and pleaded for forgiveness. 'Your Majesty, please spare her life. My sister, drunk, was defiled by a scoundrel. She didn't intentionally lose her chastity. Please punish only the scoundrel, and spare my sister!'

2336380.title: Revenge of the Industry Queen
2336380.description: Qi Mingxiao, hiding her identity as the eldest daughter of the Zhuang family, supported her boyfriend Gu Ziyang from an unknown online personality to a top influencer. However, she was dumped after transferring money to her brother, and Gu Ziyang quickly announced his relationship with wealthy heiress Lin Weiwei. Accompanied by her brother Zhuang Moyan, Qi Mingxiao confronted Gu Ziyang's slander and humiliation at a business dinner. To make Gu Ziyang suffer the consequences, she returned to his agency, demanding repayment for her years of effort and money, while also leveraging various resourc...
2336380.originName: 转身之后，我成了业内女王

2336482.title: I Just Want to Be a Useless Senior Disciple
2336482.description: A modern office worker is unexpectedly transported to a world of immortal cultivation. Faced with ruthless competition in the martial arts, he chooses to “slack off”—neither striving nor scrambling, cultivating at his own pace, letting fate take its course. Yet fate has a cruel sense of humor: the more he slackens, the more opportunities come knocking. By chance, he acquires an otherworldly cultivation technique, becoming the object of contention among all sects. Amid a series of absurd and laugh‑to‑tears misadventures, he meets the blood‑soaked storms of the cultivation world with a laid‑back attitude, ultimately rising to legendary status.

2336587.title: Sold for Three Taels of Silver
2336587.description: In the third year of the cosmic drought, Su Qinghe was sold by her mother to a human trafficker for three taels of silver and one catty of millet. At parting, her mother didn't dare to look into her eyes, only stuffing half a hard, gritty rice cake into her hand, her voice raspy like a broken bellows: 'Qinghe, don't blame your mother.' Qinghe didn't cry. She looked at the half-cake in her hand and suddenly found it funny. So her life was actually worth so much.

2336637.title: Frozen Fortress
2336637.description: In your previous life, you were infatuated with your manipulative ex-girlfriend. You lent her all your food, only for her to betray and kill you in the end. She even dug out your ribs to make soup. Boom! A violent explosion rang in your ears. Qin Feng suddenly opened his eyes, cold sweat soaking his tactical vest. In this life, you will build an impregnable doomsday fortress, hoard enough supplies to live lavishly for fifty years, and make all traitors pay the price.

2336732.title: Yandere Villain
2336732.description: She stepped into the story as the mad‑obsessed, villainous female supporting character, destined by the plot to pine for the male lead in vain and meet a tragic end. To save herself, she resolves to stay far from him and live out her days in peace. Yet the inexorable pull of the narrative keeps drawing her back to his side, and the male lead, too, grows deeply intrigued by this “different” secondary character. As she fights against fate, she gradually uncovers the truth about this world—and discovers the male lead’s hidden secrets.

2336827.title: The Fool Who Shocked the City
2336827.description: The year my elder brother was at his sickest, Mother bought him a 'joy-bride' to ward off evil. But the woman was a fool, and the whole capital waited to see our marquisate become a laughingstock. It wasn't until I was six that Ahe did something that shook the entire city. From then on, whenever she was mentioned in the capital, people would give a thumbs up. My eldest brother had been sickly since childhood, and our family searched for famous doctors just to barely keep him alive until he was eighteen. The elders all said he was too frail; if we didn't hold a wedding to bring good luck, he mi...

2336892.title: The Broken Hairpin, Continued
2336892.description: After my divorce from Cheng Suizhi, he rose through the ranks, his career soaring. I, on the other hand, opened a jewelry shop on Chang'an Street, business booming, living freely and contentedly. Three years passed peacefully. Just as I was about to consider remarrying, Cheng Suizhi visited my shop for the first time. It was drizzling outside, and after standing for a short while, his crimson official robe was drenched and turned dark red.

2336997.title: My Husband the Ghost King Forgot Me
2336997.description: Because I am the Ghost King's favorite woman, anyone who offends me in the underworld will be utterly destroyed. But on the day he returned triumphantly from slaying evil spirits in the Underworld Abyss, he tearfully embraced another woman in red. She was his childhood friend, Xiaotang, who had taken a fatal blow for him, and now had only half a month to live. Black Wuchang said that after the Ghost King was severely injured, he lost his memory, forgetting everyone except his childhood friend, Xiaotang.

2337118.title: Reborn in Crimson Flame
2337118.description: Once a top-tier agent, he was framed during a mission and lost everything. Adopting a new identity, he slipped into the city and lived an ordinary life. But his old enemies have resurfaced, threatening those he vowed to protect. Rekindling the fire within, he takes on a vast shadowy force alone. On the path of vengeance and redemption, he not only reclaims his honor but also embraces a brand-new chapter in his life.

2337253.title: Spoiling My Wife Became an Addiction
2337253.description: I married a cold CEO through an arranged marriage. To my surprise, on our wedding night, she threw a divorce agreement at me, proposing we part ways after three years. It wasn't until I was in a private room, surrounded by beautiful women, that the door was kicked open. The woman who wanted to part ways in three years now stared at my arm around a model with a frosty expression, coldly saying, "Mr. Lin, have you forgotten you're married?" Only then did I understand that the agreement was her biggest contradiction. I was ecstatic when I heard my arranged marriage partner was Bai Zhirou.

2337359.title: I Just Want to Be a Useless Master
2337359.description: It's my third year transmigrating as the cannon fodder senior disciple. I've been feigning madness, and the entire sect believes it. They sigh and lament, mourning the fall of a once-brilliant talent, unaware that the true protagonist hasn't even appeared yet. In the original novel, I was once a cloud in the sky, the most dazzling presence in the sect. But the moment the protagonist arrived, I became his stepping stone. Even the junior sister I cherished eventually fell into his arms. Who wouldn't be enraged by that? But what does any of that have to do with me now? I just want to be an ordina...
2337359.originName: 穿成炮灰大师兄的第三年

2337453.title: Help! I'm Stuck in a Horror Game with a Memelord System
2337453.description: I, along with ninety-nine other deceased individuals, entered a horror survival game, where only the final victor could be revived. While others chose powerful systems, I mistakenly selected the ridiculed 'Goofy System'. Players were locked in a room, with an axe-wielding hunter outside. In a critical moment, the system gave me three absurd options: 'Rub the hunter's arm'. This choice surprisingly made the hunter lose health and retreat. When he broke through the door, I was again forced to choose 'Jump into his arms', which unexpectedly emptied the hunter's health bar. The first round elimina...
2337453.originName: 穿进恐怖游戏：全凭沙雕系统苟命

2337538.title: I Became Ultraman to Save the World
2337538.description: Bai Luo, who traversed worlds, awakens a 'World-Saving System'. He learns that in three days, Earth will be invaded by monsters. He must collect 1000 'Light Power' points to transform into Ultraman Tiga and face the threat. To gain Light Power, he completes various embarrassing tasks while wearing a Tiga suit: confessing his love, attending welcome parties, and birthday celebrations. Along the way, he rescues a little girl, Gu Xiaomeng, from robbers, helps a child with leukemia fulfill his dream, and defeats a vampire and local thug Chen Haonan. During this time, he meets the campus belle Jian...

2337628.title: A Misunderstood Life
2337628.description: During a check-up with my wife, she was diagnosed with stomach cancer. I went home to my parents, hoping to sell the old family house to save her. However, my mother suddenly stopped me. She said, 'I can give you the deed, but on one condition: you first tell her that *you* have stomach cancer.' I didn't understand my mother's words, but to save my wife, I did as she said. That very night, my mother-in-law rushed to our house, urging me to divorce her daughter so I wouldn't drag her down. My wife also told me that if you truly love someone, you shouldn't hold them back from their life. I stare...

2337709.title: I Gave Birth to an Egg
2337709.description: I was pregnant with the Emperor's child, but on the day of delivery, I gave birth to a translucent white egg. The palace servants were terrified, kneeling and trembling on the ground. Rumors spread throughout the palace that I was a demon concubine who had bewitched the Emperor, and everyone was waiting for an imperial decree to drag me to the execution ground and burn me alive. But no one expected that when the egg was presented in the Golden Imperial Hall, the high and mighty Emperor and the Empress Dowager, who was regent behind the curtain, both teared up, their eyes red with emotion. No o...

2337844.title: The Fake Husband Is a Secret Admirer
2337844.description: Everyone says I'm foolish. When Pei Yan was down and out, I gave him everything. On the day he became the top scholar, I personally let him go. I ignored all the gossip and turned to my father, planning to find a live-in son-in-law for a stable life. Who knew, before the 'live-in son-in-law wanted' sign was even put up, Pei Yan burst in with a grand entourage. He put his arm around my waist, a smile in his eyes, and asked, 'I heard you're looking for a live-in son-in-law, why didn't you ask me first?' The day Yuan became the top scholar, I was kneeling in the ancestral hall, kowtowing to the a...
2337844.originName: 得知我要招赘后，状元郎他不装了

2337930.title: My Baby Was Switched
2337930.description: The female lead had no idea that I had dabbed rouge behind my daughter's ear right after she was born. So when I woke up and found the rouge behind my daughter's ear gone, my heart sank. My daughter had indeed been swapped by her. I immediately called my confidante, Xiao Xiao, and whispered, "Quick, get some cooking oil and sprinkle it around the house, then hide those money boxes." Although Xiao Xiao was bewildered, she immediately nodded, "Yes, Miss." She swiftly brought the oil can and carefully poured it along the base of the walls. The cooking oil had barely been spread when, the next sec...

2338060.title: The Empress Lives Twice
2338060.description: After two years of recovering from illness, my childhood sweetheart, Zhao Mingxuan, was going to marry my adopted sister, Lin Yurou. He held our betrothal dragon and phoenix jade pendants, and with a face full of tenderness, he excused my adopted sister from the selection process for the imperial concubines, saying that after marriage, he would take me as a noble concubine, and if I bore him a son, he would elevate me to a co-wife. Who knew that on the wedding day, when he saw my sedan chair arriving, he abandoned his new bride and frantically blocked my sedan chair, his eyes red as he begged ...

2338146.title: Sister, I Choose the Cold One
2338146.description: My father asked my sister and me to choose between our legitimate mother and Concubine Liu. My sister, Sheng Yunzhu, was quick to pick Concubine Liu, a former criminal's daughter who was the favored one in the household. This left me with our legitimate mother, a cold and stern woman from a military family. In my previous life, my sister, who followed our legitimate mother, spent her days calculating and reciting household rules, never learning how to please a husband, living a dry and boring life. I, on the other hand, who followed Concubine Liu, not only mastered singing and dancing but also...
2338146.originName: 嫡谋双姝-重生后我选了冷面主母

2338211.title: The Concubine Divorces Her Husband
2338211.description: Late at night, I was vomiting incessantly. The estate physician came to examine me. The result left me speechless: "Madam, you are pregnant." I immediately sent someone to the study to inform the Prince, only to find he was nowhere to be seen. The next day, I learned the Prince had not returned all night. Rumors were rampant in the city that Prince Lu had spent ten thousand taels of gold at the Hundred Flowers Brothel, just to make a beauty smile. That beauty, I knew her, of course.

2338267.title: The Concubine They Discarded
2338267.description: Since I was six, I've been raised alongside the Crown Prince, serving as a maid and a study companion. Until the Empress Dowager hastily sent me to his bedchamber a month before his wedding, instructing me to initiate him. He quickly grew fond of it, never leaving me idle. The day the Crown Princess entered the East Palace and was diagnosed with pregnancy, I excitedly ran to find the Prince. But I overheard the Crown Princess discussing with him that 'that maid is quite charming; you could take her as a concubine to ensure heirs for the royal family.'

2338366.title: The Tofu Girl Who Raised a General
2338366.description: Chun'er, an orphan girl, sells tofu for a living. She unexpectedly finds an infant boy, Yuanbao, and raises him. Eight years later, Yuanbao's older brother, Wang Shu, comes looking for him. He entrusts Chun'er with Yuanbao's care before joining the army. Wang Shu is actually Jiang Song, the second son of the Jiang family, whose entire family was executed. He secretly plans his revenge, steadily rising through the ranks. During this time, Chun'er endures a turbulent era, protecting Yuanbao, and gradually develops feelings for Jiang Song. Ultimately, Jiang Song succeeds in his revenge, helps the...

2338461.title: Cutting Off My Toxic Family to Save Myself
2338461.description: After earning money, the protagonist invites her family to a seafood dinner. However, her mother's frugality and favoritism cause conflict. Her mother, along with her brother Jiang Mingzong and sister-in-law Liang Yue, conspire to seize her property under the guise of 'doing what's best for her.' They not only demand her salary but also try to force her into marrying a hoodlum, and even secretly steal her assets behind her back. Jiang Mingzong and his wife even covet her house...

2338518.title: The Echo of Malice
2338518.description: He Man unexpectedly gets a second chance at life, returning to the turning point of her fate: the day her mother-in-law moved in with her husband. In her previous life, she mistook her mother-in-law's constant groans of 'headache, stomach ache, bone aches' as genuine illness, dutifully taking on all household chores and visiting numerous doctors. Ultimately, she collapsed from exhaustion and miscarried. During her confinement period, her mother-in-law falsely accused her of abuse, leading to divorce by her husband, leaving He Man with chronic illness and a tragic death.   Facing her mother-in-...

2338569.title: RV: Apocalypse Shelter
2338569.description: Seven days before the apocalypse, to escape my mother's endless nagging, I finalized a six-month RV travel plan. No one expected that this leisurely escape would suddenly be twisted into a race against death by the unexpected apocalypse, and the mother I hadn't seen in half a month.

2338694.title: Wasteland Home
2338694.description: After my divorce, I returned to my rural hometown with my daughter and became a blogger renovating old houses. Unexpectedly, the apocalypse arrived, zombies broke out, and my renovated old house became a doomsday fortress for me and my daughter. When the zombie virus erupted, I was exerting all my strength to lift half a raw pig, which I had just bought, onto the chopping board. This was the third month since I brought my daughter Xiaoyu back to our hometown to be a blogger.

2338837.title: Faked My Death, Raised His Son, Now I'm Back
2338837.description: Ah Wan, who served as a concubine to the young master of Jing'an Marquis's residence for six years, was framed by the legal wife on the eve of the young master's wedding. Imprisoned in a woodshed, she faked her death and escaped. Pregnant, she fled to Jiangnan, where she met a skilled doctor and learned medicine. She raised her son, Jing Yan, alone, opened a clinic, and became renowned. Years later, her son went to the capital for a poetry gathering, and Ah Wan unexpectedly reunited with the young master. It turned out that the young master had married his legal wife to avenge a deep-seated ve...
2338837.originName: 焚心：六年通房，烈火重生

2338954.title: The Concubine He Bought, The Family He Killed
2338954.description: That cold spring, I bought a courtesan named Liu Yan'er from a human trafficker. Three years later, because of this maid, my fiancé, the Crown Prince, slaughtered my entire Shen family. It was the third year of my marriage with Lu Chenzhou. I happily went to the side hall to find him. He had been busy with state affairs recently, sleeping in the study every day, and I hadn't had a good look at him for a long time. This was his rare initiative to summon me. I touched my still-flat belly, thinking this was a good opportunity to tell him we were having a baby.

2339050.title: Reborn: They Want My Fortune
2339050.description: Lin Wan'er, the reborn daughter of the wealthiest man in Daliang, returns. On her wedding day, she uncovers the plot by the Marquis of Yong'an's mansion to seize her family's wealth. She cleverly outwits the heir, Zhao Yu, and her childhood friend, Wang Wanqing. By donating her dowry, she gains imperial favor and uses Prince Duan, Li Chen, for protection, navigating through the Marquis's schemes and court disputes. With her business acumen and exceptional wisdom, she wins over hearts, seizes opportunities, and exposes her rivals' conspiracies. She vows to protect her family and their business,...

2339132.title: Phoenix Reverses the Immortal Path
2339132.description: Feng Li (Ice Phoenix) is reborn to the day of the two clans' marriage proposal. Her older sister, Feng Ni Xia, marries Yan Hai, the human prince possessed by a demon, who was Feng Li's nightmare in her previous life. Feng Li then marries the Heavenly Crown Prince, only to discover that the Prince has also been reborn and is the beloved she saved in her previous life. Together, they thwart Yan Hai and the First Prince's rebellion. Her sister goes mad due to blood loss and demonic corruption. Her parents lose power and are banished. Feng Li finally escapes the suffering of her past life and live...

2339206.title: The "Trash" Bird I Bought Was a Phoenix
2339206.description: After her rebirth, Xue Rou was mistaken for a black peacock and scorned by her clan. In reality, she was the legendary and noble Xuanque. She rejected Ling Xuan, a blue peacock who also reborn, and bought Mo Chen, a 'wild chicken' from the black market, to be her husband. Ling Xuan, obsessed with having noble offspring, married the green peacock Meng Meng and forced her to take a fertility herb, only to have a black peacock with a broken leg. Xue Rou and Mo Chen gave birth to a phoenix, and Mo Chen also awakened his ancient phoenix bloodline. Ultimately, Xue Rou abolished the peacock clan's hi...

2339308.title: The 8-Year-Old Empress Dowager
2339308.description: At 5, Lin Youniang enters the palace as Empress due to a prophecy predicting she will bring prosperity to the Emperor. After the old emperor dies, she becomes Empress Dowager at 8. Within the deep palace, she witnesses power struggles among princes, schemes from her older sister, and military rebellions, forming bonds with various princes. The Seventh Prince, seemingly unambitious, secretly plans his rise, eventually breaking the prophecy's hold and ascending the throne. Lin Youniang initially plans to travel to the southwest but returns after starting her journey, choosing to stay in the pala...

2339407.title: My Husband Wants to Kill Me to Prove His Love
2339407.description: I knew Su Yanqiu wanted to kill me. I saw it in his struggling eyes after he came out of seclusion. He held my hand, his voice full of nostalgia, "Qingci, how many years have we been Dao companions?" I gently leaned against him, pointing at the pear tree outside the window. "One hundred years, husband. You planted this tree for me a hundred years ago." Back then, he was the renowned genius of the Sword Sect, and I was just a low-level cultivator.

2339556.title: Scorched Earth: 100°C Survival
2339556.description: Song Xu receives a 300,000 project bonus, sparking jealousy in her best friend, Qiao Yi. Qiao Yi lies, claiming a high-temperature apocalypse will arrive in a week, tricking Song Xu into taking out a loan to hoard supplies and renovate a bomb shelter. Song Xu believes her and prepares diligently, only to discover it's a scam. Unexpectedly, the apocalypse truly descends. Qiao Yi, lacking supplies, comes for help but is rejected and ultimately perishes, while Song Xu lives safely in her bomb shelter.

2339662.title: Rumor Killer: The Payback
2339662.description: During high school, Song Anxin rejected Chen Dongdong's confession, leading him and his friends to spread malicious rumors, accusing her of promiscuity. She faced strange looks and ostracism from the entire school. After failed attempts to clear her name, Song Anxin decided to retaliate. Using her talent for writing fanfiction, she created several vulgar fanfictions about Chen Dongdong's group of four, synthesizing fake chat logs and photos to spread on social platforms, and even broadcasted related stories on the school radio. The conflict escalated, Chen Dongdong's mother came to school and ...

2339793.title: Sold for My Brother
2339793.description: When I was 7, a group of soldiers stormed into our home, searching everywhere. My mother, with red eyes, hugged me, changed my clothes into my brother's, and then pushed me out of the room. Soon, I was forced into a prisoner's cart by the soldiers. All the way, I cried very loudly. I thought if my cries were loud enough, my parents would come to save me. That was until I heard the escorting officer say that all male family members would be executed, and female family members would be sent to the Jiaofangsi (imperial music and entertainment bureau).

2339853.title: My Husband Died Before I Could Tell Him
2339853.description: I joyfully left the palace, ready to tell my husband that I was two months pregnant, only to see the Marquis's residence draped in white mourning cloth, and the steward in tears. He stumbled to my sedan chair, "Young Madam, the Young Master… he is gone." The world spun. Shishu quickly grabbed my arm, "Princess, be careful." Ignoring everything else, I staggered into the mansion. The mourning hall was set up in the Marquis's ancestral temple. The entire residence was enveloped in grief.

2339936.title: The Black Lotus' Revenge
2339936.description: Through the cracks of a secret compartment, I witnessed with my own eyes my Shen family, 128 souls, slaughtered completely, blood flowing like a river. Leading them was a refined man in white, whom I knew as Lu Yuan, the Grand Secretary of Daliang. He slowly wiped the blood from his sword, a mere lowly commoner, yet he dared to shake a century-old noble family, overestimating his own strength. So later, his Lu family also deserved to die at the hands of this 'ant' like me. That year I was 5, and for the first time, I knew what hatred was. I crawled out of the Shen mansion through a dog hole, o...

2340000.title: Apocalypse Lies: My Best Friend Destroyed Me
2340000.description: After Tang Xiaoyou received a 300,000 project bonus, her best friend Lin Zhixia, out of jealousy, lied that a high-temperature apocalypse was coming. She tricked Tang Xiaoyou into spending all her savings, taking out loans to hoard supplies, and converting an air-raid shelter. Unexpectedly, the apocalypse did come. Lin Zhixia, lacking supplies, brought her boyfriend and tried to force her way into the air-raid shelter. Tang Xiaoyou used an electric fence and other means to stop them. Ultimately, Lin Zhixia died in the high heat, while Tang Xiaoyou survived in the air-raid shelter, awaiting off...

2340088.title: The Marquis's Legitimate Daughter
2340088.description: Grandma held Chen Zhilan's hand and smiled, 'Your grandmother and your eldest aunt have discussed it, and we'd like to transfer the marriage alliance with the Marquis of Dingyuan to you. What do you think?' 'Since ancient times, marriage has been decided by parents and matchmakers, Zhilan will obey Grandma's decision.' 'Miss, this is great fortune!' 'Zhilan, your mother-in-law has wronged you!' Junchen didn't injure his back while practicing martial arts, but was paralyzed after falling from a horse.

2340147.title: My Best Friend Stole My Husband
2340147.description: Su Qingyue is reborn. Faced with her sister Ling Wei, who suffers from Hanahaki Disease and needs her brother-in-law Gu Yanchen's treatment, Su Qingyue no longer repeats past mistakes and readily agrees. She redeems the male courtesan Xie Jingci for her own use while secretly taking control of the family-run business. As Ling Wei and Gu Yanchen become entangled and plot to seize property, Su Qingyue decisively divorces and establishes her own business. The Su family falls apart due to Ling Wei's hypocrisy and poor management, and Gu Yanchen and others face the consequences. Ultimately, Su Qing...

2340253.title: The Concubine Who Escaped
2340253.description: When I was eight, Shen Moyan raided my home. The men were imprisoned, and the women were sold. Later, he secretly bought me back to his mansion as his concubine. He gave me a life of luxury, constantly reminding me that he was my only support. Finally, I became pregnant with his child. He thought I would stay by his side, but I escaped.

2340395.title: One Point Per Year: Grinding to Godhood
2340395.description: Heaven granted you endless life, but denied you the ability to defend yourself. However, it gives you one upgrade opportunity each year. You understand Heaven's intention: if you live long enough, after tens of thousands of years, you will surely become invincible. To survive in this chaotic world, you have no choice but to pour all your points into strength. And just this slight increase in strength allows you, who just arrived here, to effortlessly crack stones with your bare hands.

2340491.title: Mom, Your Kindness Killed Me
2340491.description: My mother was a renowned 'living Bodhisattva'. She vouched for my uncle's loan, forced my sister into a marriage exchange for my cousin's wedding, and took in my paralyzed grand-uncle. No one knew that in my previous life, she dumped my paralyzed grand-uncle on me. I was then given to creditors as collateral by him, suffering torment and dying miserably. Yet, she excused my killer, saying he had no choice. I open my eyes, back to the day the loan guarantee was signed. Looking at my hypocritical uncle and my foolishly kind mother, I smirk. Since she loves to take on everything and pretend to be...

2340553.title: We Got Revenge on the Men Who Used Us
2340553.description: Lu Shuhe and her best friend, Yun Yuean, transmigrated into a redemption novel.
