They were tasked with conquering the Buddhist disciple Shen Xubai and the Hong Kong circle prince Bai Yanzhou, respectively. After five years of devotion, both were betrayed by their loved ones, their crushes' 'white moonlight' (true love) and 'canary' (mistress). Yun Yuean suffered a miscarriage, developed cancer, and passed away. Lu Shuhe, heartbroken, completed her mission and returned to reality. Unexpectedly, due to a system glitch, their former targets followed them into the real world. They retaliated agains...

2340675.title: The Girl Who Poisoned Her Way to Revenge
2340675.description: At the age of six, Su Ning (later known as Su Jin) witnessed the massacre of 132 members of her family by Qin Henian. Orphaned, she endured being sold and forced to test poisons before vowing revenge. She infiltrated the Qin mansion as a maid for Qin Henian's daughter, Qin Wanqing. Using her knowledge of poisons and her wit, she meticulously dismantled Qin Henian's power. During this time, she met the Fourth Prince Xiao Che, and a romance blossomed between them as they faced hardships together. She also allied with her childhood friend, Crown Prince Xiao Yu, to fight against the powerful arist...

2340822.title: The General is Dead, Your Majesty
2340822.description: Three years after my death, the border war reached the capital. Xiao Jingxuan came to Xie Manor through thick snow, demanding I go to war. He stood before the empty main hall, his voice stern, "Summon General Xie, immediately accompany Us to the front lines." Xuejian, a maid sweeping snow, heard the commotion and came out from the inner room, calmly replying, "Your Majesty, General Xie is no longer among the living."

2340897.title: My Niece Framed Me for Stealing
2340897.description: After my sister passed away, I took over sending living expenses to my college-aged niece. Fearing she'd be too shy to ask, I'd always send an extra 1001 yuan. Two years later, she and my daughter both got into graduate school. But on the day the results came out, she posted a video that went viral. The first toast was to her mother, who died of cancer, and to herself, who had to work part-time while studying because her aunt embezzled the inheritance. The second toast was to her aunt, who was about to steal her house and use her car, and who was being sued. My niece was sympathized with acros...
2340897.originName: 姐姐去世后，由我来给上大学的外甥女发生活费（亲恩两断）

2341010.title: My Twin Sister Stole My Wedding Night
2341010.description: My twin sister and I were once the Phoenix Emperor's beloved twin princesses. But my sister was jealous of my love for the Heavenly Prince. When I wasn't looking, she used despicable means to harm me, then took my place in the bridal chamber. By the time I woke up, they had already done everything. Mother held my hand, persuading me to yield and accept my sister. For the glory of the Phoenix clan, I had no choice but to grit my teeth and agree. The Heavenly Emperor was overjoyed upon hearing this and publicly promised that whoever bore a royal grandson first would be named the Crown Princess. ...

2341112.title: The Wife Who Didn't Sleep with Her Husband
2341112.description: Before I married into the Marquis's Residence, I knew my husband had a very favored concubine. But I was marrying into a prominent family as the principal wife, so naturally, I had to be magnanimous. After marriage, I managed the Marquis's Residence flawlessly, and my reputation for virtue spread throughout the capital. That concubine, perhaps lacking common sense, spread the news that my husband and I had not consummated our marriage. She intended to mock me and make me a laughingstock, but she never imagined that this act would compel my mother-in-law to make the Marquis knock on my door lat...

2341261.title: I Became the Evil Princess
2341261.description: The first time I saw Shen Yan, he was dressed in black, sitting in a wheelchair, his face almost transparently pale, yet the face beneath his long hair was stunningly beautiful. I stared at him blankly, but his eyes were full of disgust. “What new trick does the Princess have to torment me today?” Only then did I remember that my current identity was Princess Li Lingyue, and this was a romance novel. After dying from an illness, I had become the extravagant Princess in the book.

2341351.title: The Poisoned Empress
2341351.description: By imperial decree, Gu Beichen and I became the most famous bickering couple in the capital. He hated me for ruining the innocence of his beloved Su Wan'er, causing her to die tragically on the way to her arranged marriage. I resented him for betraying his past vows, not even sparing me a glance. For ten whole years, we tormented each other until I was terminally ill. He finally came to my bedside and personally fed me poisoned lychees. "Wei Yue, don't you love lychees the most? Open your mouth. Don't hate me. If you hadn't poisoned Wan'er, how could she have died so miserably? We were both wr...

2341450.title: The Bride Who Was Blindfolded
2341450.description: I married the eldest son of the General's Mansion, but the one who consummated the marriage that night was the current Emperor. They all thought I didn't know the truth, because my eyes were always covered with a silk ribbon. The crimson bridal veil swayed gently before my eyes. Several hours passed, and my eyes were already sore, but still no one came to pick me up. Only at亥時 (Hài Shí - 9-11 PM) did the laughter and well wishes outside gradually fade from noisy to silent.

2341505.title: Desperate Escape
2341505.description: My name is Chen Mo, and I'm the owner of this outdoor gear store. It's the biggest and most comprehensive in the city, selling everything from climbing ropes to compressed biscuits. My motto is simple: 'Only a fool doesn't make money.' But lately, business has been strange. Canned goods, radiation suits, and even hand-crank generators that sat for three years have sold out. And the customers who come in are all very odd.

2341651.title: Stockpiling for Survival in Desperate Times
2341651.description: Future soul transmigrates into a little girl named Jiang Lan during a famine. Her hometown, Huaihuawa, suffers a severe drought, leading to starvation and death. Villagers are forced to flee. Jiang Lan, using the supplies in her personal space, convinces her injured brother Jiang Feng and sister-in-law Liu Yue to abandon the perilous escape route and hide in the depths of Panlong Ridge. The three rely on space provisions, hunting skills, and simple traps to avoid dangers from displaced people in a hidden cave. Later, seeking stability, they trek deeper into the mountains towards a valley with ...

2341767.title: The Beginning After the End Season 2
2341767.description: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale. Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone. One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby. Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends. But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...
2341767.originName: 最強の王様二度目の人生は何をする？

2341961.title: Walking the Way all alone
2341961.description:
Luo Li was born and raised in the spiritless land of the Silver Continent, where he rose to become the top assassin of the Tianjue Killing Hall.
At the cost of his own life, his father, Master Ciyun, secures a slim chance of survival for him—allowing Luo Li to escape Silver Continent and set out for the Central World.
There, he will seek the true path of cultivation… and the destiny that awaits him.

2342017.title: Farming Life in Another World 2
2342017.description:
Once a frail and lonely young man, Hiraku is reincarnated into another world through the blessing of a god.

Deep within the forest, the small farm he built gradually grows into a lively settlement known as the “Great Tree Village,” as all kinds of companions gather—vampires, elves, beastfolk, angels, and more.

Tending the fields, raising livestock, and sharing laughter with friends, Hiraku enjoys a peaceful life.

But with a constant stream of visitors arriving one after another, the village is busier than ever!
2342017.originName: 異世界のんびり農家 ２期

2342192.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4
2342192.description:
Demon Lord Rimuru moves one step closer to his vision of uniting humans and monsters. As Tempest continues to flourish, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel, come into conflict with Rimuru, driven by their belief that humanity must be protected through control and domination.

Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon quietly pursues his own ambitions. And as tensions rise, the awakening of a new Hero draws ever closer.
2342192.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第四期

2342276.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
2342276.description:
From Hiromu Arakawa, the author of Fullmetal Alchemist—a masterpiece beloved by fans around the world—comes her latest work, now serialized to great acclaim in Monthly Shonen Gangan.
With over 4 million copies in circulation, the series is finally getting a long-awaited TV anime adaptation!

A brand-new “Tsugai” battle fantasy where mystery and the supernatural intertwine.
A relentless, otherworldly tale is about to unfold.

2342380.title: MARRIAGETOXIN
2342380.description:
For centuries, the "Users" have honed the art of killing. Among them, the most powerful and influential are the Five Great Families—most notably, the "Poison Users." Hikaru Gero, a young man born into this lineage, lives as a professional assassin, having spent his life avoiding any ties to women. To him, marriage has always been a distant concept.
But when the head of the Gero family declares that his sister will be forced to bear an heir to preserve their bloodline, everything changes.
Amidst this crisis, Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler—and his latest target.

Determined to protect his sister and resolve the succession issue, Hikaru comes up with an unexpected solution: he will marry himself. On the spot, he asks Mei to help him find a wife.
"That’s the first time I’ve ever heard a proposal like that."
Thus begins an unlikely partnership: an elite assassin and a master con artist. With Mei as his advisor, Hikaru embarks on the most difficult mission of his life—finding a bride.

His goal: the perfect marriage. A high-stakes “marriage-hunting” battle action unfolds, as this deadly duo takes on the toughest mission in the world!
2342380.originName: マリッジトキシン 前半

2342439.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4
2342439.description:
After narrowly claiming victory in the fierce battle at the Water Gate City of Pristella, Subaru and his companions are left to bear a devastating cost. Rem remains trapped in an endless sleep by the Authority of Gluttony, Crusch has lost her memories, and Julius has had his very name taken from him.

In search of a way to save them, Subaru learns of the legendary "Sage," Shaula—said to possess boundless knowledge and the ability to see all.

Their next destination: the Pleiades Watchtower, where the Sage resides. It stands at the far edge of the world, deep within the Augria Sand Dunes—a vast desert so perilous that even Reinhard, the mightiest "Sword Saint," has failed to conquer it.

Amid relentless natural forces, unknown beasts, and unimaginable threats, Subaru sets out on a perilous journey with his companions—risking everything to reclaim what was lost.
2342439.originName: Re：ゼロから始める異世界生活4

2342498.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester
2342498.description:
At first glance, Koudo Ikusei Senior High School appears to be a perfect paradise. Students are granted extraordinary freedom, and the school enjoys a prestigious reputation across Japan. In truth, however, things are far from ideal. The student body is divided into four classes—A through D—ranked strictly by merit, with only the top classes receiving preferential treatment.

Kiyotaka Ayanokouji finds himself assigned to Class D, the section reserved for the school’s most problematic students. There, he encounters Suzune Horikita, a distant and unapproachable girl who believes she was wrongly placed in Class D and is determined to rise to Class A, as well as Kikyou Kushida, a friendly and popular class idol whose goal is to befriend everyone around her.

While students remain in their assigned classes, the rankings themselves are fluid. Those in lower classes can climb the ladder by outperforming those above them. In Class D, there are virtually no restrictions on the methods students may use to advance.

In a school governed by ruthless competition, can they overcome the odds and fight their way to the top?
2342498.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ４th Season 2年生1学期

2342582.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4
2342582.description:
Hiding the fact that he is human, Iruma Suzuki continues his life at the Demon School, Babyls. As he makes more demonic friends, he gradually begins to enjoy life in the Netherworld, shining in various school events and steadily climbing the ranks—becoming the center of attention both inside and outside the academy.

Now, Iruma faces a new challenge: the Music Festival, where the unity of his class will be put to the test.

The entire Misfit Class—all 13 students—has been given an unprecedented task: to achieve Rank 4 together. With the festival serving as their final chance for promotion, victory is an absolute requirement.

However, among them is one classmate—a demon who is forbidden to stand out…

Can all thirteen of them make it onto the stage together?
2342582.originName: 魔入りました！入间くん 第4シリーズ

2342649.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season2
2342649.description: In order to keep a promise to his childhood friend Elfaria, Will, a washout student at a magical institution who is incapable of using magic, wants to become a member of the Magia Vander, the highest class of mages. He uses a sword rather than a wand, and the academy gradually acknowledges his powers. A mysterious wizard ambushes Lihanna and the other top students of his year as they are participating in an all-student Praxis dungeon training. They barely make it through the onslaught together, but they still have to take the exit test. Is Will able to get to the girl in the tower who is waiting for him?
2342649.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア Season 2

2342788.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too TVSP
2342788.description:
After fending off the attack of Yuti—a girl who, despite being a disciple of the "Holy," harbors the power of the "Evil"—Yuuya and his companions manage to reach an understanding with her.

But what awaits them next is completely unexpected…
a shared life with Yuti in the real world!?

Meanwhile, in the other world, the "Fist Saint" who has fallen into darkness emerges, along with a sinister presence lurking behind the scenes…

The life-reversal fantasy returns in full force!
2342788.originName: 异世界でチート能力を手にした俺は、现実世界をも无双する ～レベルアップは人生を変えた～SP

2342908.title: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
2342908.description:
"Agents of the Four Seasons."
Gifted with powers bestowed by the gods of the seasons, they travel the land to bring the cycle of seasons to life.
But ten years ago, when the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Hanaba, vanished without a trace, spring itself disappeared from this country—never to return.
For a decade, Sakura Himetaka, the Spring Guard, searched tirelessly for her missing master. Then, one day, without warning, Hinagiku finally returns—and with her, the story begins to move once more.

Together, Hinagiku and Sakura set out on a journey to restore spring to the world.

—To reclaim the precious time that was unjustly taken from them.
—To convey long-held feelings to the one they have yearned for.
—To protect the one they hold dear, even at the cost of their lives.

This is the story of living gods who bring forth the seasons, and the guardians who stand beside them—
a tale of loss and renewal.
No matter how many times they are wounded,
this is a story of prayer, dedicated to those who still choose to live.

2343020.title: Always a Catch!
2343020.description:
From an early age, Maria—the youngest daughter of a duke—was recognized for her great potential and raised as the heir to her family. However, everything changes with the birth of her baby brother, which frees her from those responsibilities. Now expected to marry, she rushes to find a suitable match—only to discover that all the eligible bachelors in her duchy are already taken. At this rate, she fears she'll be left a spinster!

Determined to change her fate, Maria decides to study abroad in Rubini in hopes of finding a husband, with the help of her distant relative, Aida. But just as she sets her plan in motion, an unexpected twist occurs: the Crown Prince suddenly calls off his engagement to her—despite the fact that the two have never even met!
2343020.originName: 逃がした魚は大きかったが釣りあげた魚が大きすぎた件

2343133.title: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
2343133.description: This story follows Botan Kamiina, a 20-year-old freshman, and her dorm life as she bonds with her seniors through shared drinking sessions and gradually builds meaningful friendships. The anime showcases a wide range of real-world alcoholic beverages—such as Japanese sake, whiskey, and wine—while also exploring music, films, and other cultural elements that pair naturally with drinking. Each drink and activity is thoughtfully connected to the characters' personalities and emotions, creating a distinctive and immersive atmosphere.
2343133.originName: 上伊那ぼたん、酔へる姿は百合の花

2343216.title: AOTU WORLD REBORN
2343216.description:
The Creator God of Aotu World is a whimsical and unpredictable being, who shaped a world filled with inequality—yet granted its people a chance to defy their fate.

That chance lies in the Aotu Tournament, where participants wield system-given special abilities and fight through brutal rounds of trials to claim ultimate victory.

Now, after a hundred years, the tournament begins once more.

Our protagonist, Jin, enters the competition—to change the fate of Dengeluo Planet and to find his missing sister…

2343522.title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy
2343522.description:
A bewitchingly beautiful demon who devours human souls descends upon the world—!

Kanan, the Demon of Gluttony, arrives at a human high school in search of young, sweet souls to feast upon. Her first chosen prey is a boy named Youji Kyougi.
"To be eaten by me is a great honor. You should be grateful, inferior creature."
However…
For some reason, she ends up entering a relationship contract with him instead!?
Having lived for thousands of years without ever experiencing first love, the pure-hearted Kanan is thrown into a whirlwind of unfamiliar emotions!
Walking home together!? Holding hands!? Going on dates!?
A first—wait, what!?
"Curse you… inferior creature!!"
A clumsy yet adorable demon's first-love rom-com begins!
2343522.originName: カナン様はあくまでチョロい

2343630.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten2
2343630.description:
After discovering they were next-door neighbors, Amane Fujimiya and Mahiru Shiina grow closer—and following their second-year sports festival, they finally begin dating.

From homemade meals to yukata dates, their days feel almost like newlyweds—yet their hearts still race with every moment together.

As they face new experiences and begin to overcome their pasts, their bond continues to deepen…

Their sweet and tender love story goes on.
2343630.originName: お隣の天使様にいつの間にか駄目人間にされていた件 2期

2343716.title: MAO
2343716.description:
Mao, a young man from the Taisho era, is a mysterious onmyoji cursed to live for 900 years.

Nanoka Kiba, a middle school girl from the present-day Reiwa era, once survived a tragic accident that claimed her entire family.

One day, as Nanoka passes through the gate of the shopping district where the accident occurred, she is suddenly transported to the Taisho era—a world overrun with supernatural beings.

There, she encounters Mao…

"You… you're a yokai, aren't you?"

Confronted with his words, Nanoka begins to realize that something within her has changed…

2343894.title: KILL BLUE
2343894.description:
Juzo Ogami is a legendary hitman known for completing even the most impossible missions.

One day, after wiping out an entire organization, he is stung by a mysterious bee and loses consciousness. When he awakens, he finds himself transformed—from a 39-year-old man into a 13-year-old boy!

Before he can process what's happened, his boss issues a new order: infiltrate a middle school in that very form.

Awaiting him there is an unexpected life filled with eccentric classmates—and a full-blown school youth experience.

But can Juzo ever return to his original body?
And as if that weren't enough, assassins are already closing in on him…

2343947.title: Petals of Reincarnation
2343947.description:
The "Branch of Reincarnation" is a mysterious power that allows one to gain the talents of a past life—at the cost of severing one's own head.

Touya Senji has long lived in the shadow of his gifted older brother, burdened by a deep inferiority complex over his own perceived lack of talent. Determined to rely on academics as his last stronghold, he consistently ranks within the top 100 nationwide in mock exams—yet still finds no satisfaction.

One day, Touya unexpectedly witnesses his classmate, Haito le Buffet—one of the "Reincarnators" who has obtained past-life abilities through the Branch—engaged in a deadly battle with a serial killer.
2343947.originName: リィンカーネーションの花弁

2344089.title: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
2344089.description:
A fluffy, slow-life fantasy with the gods begins!

Minato Kusunoki, a young man tasked with managing a newly built countryside house, soon discovers that the property is supposedly overrun with evil spirits…

But with his extraordinary purification powers, he unknowingly wipes them all out in no time!

Drawn by the now peaceful and comfortable atmosphere of the Kusunoki residence, a colorful cast of deities begins to gather—
a sweet-loving mountain god and their followers, the wind and thunder gods, as well as divine beasts such as the Spirit Tortoise, Kirin, Yinglong, and Phoenix.

Before long, even a modern-day onmyoji, Saiga Harima, pays a visit, seeking Minato’s unique abilities…

What awaits him in this life among the gods—
pure healing… or total chaos!?

2344309.title: Five years of warfare, the daughter yearns for her father’s heart (Thai dubbed version)
2344309.description: Five years ago, he fought bloody battles day and night, clinging to nothing but the hope of returning home alive to see his beloved little daughter. Five years later, having achieved fame and glory, he had become the supreme idol of a million soldiers in the Great Xia. With his heart full of anticipation at the prospect of seeing that once‑tiny bundle of joy again, he was stunned to discover that the little coat she once was had grown leaky with time.

2344374.title: Holding the Brush, Severing the Mortal World (Thai Dubbed Version)
2344374.description: In the early years of the Republic, war raged and the world was in chaos. Yan Qingyi, born into a noble family, was framed by her cruel stepsister. Even more heartbreaking, her own brother believed the slander and, with his own hands, consigned her to a death cell. Harsh and bitter days in prison seemed endless; just as her life force was ebbing away, she unexpectedly awakened the legacy of Ye Hongyu. In an instant, the powers of the three realms converged within her, life and death held at the tip of her brush, and the fleeting years of mortal existence could be severed with a single stroke. The moment she opened her eyes, the flames of the prison seemed to tremble. That day of awakening would also be the day when her stepsister and her cold‑hearted brother would pay in blood for their debts!

2344509.title: Just giving up a seat—how did that turn into being a “happy dad”?(Thailand)
2344509.description: Just one year out of college, Zhao Fan was accosted by Qin Shufen, a 50‑year‑old pregnant woman, after he gave up his seat for her on the bus. She falsely accused him of being the father of her unborn twins, brandished a paternity test, and forced him to break up with his girlfriend. Everyone believed Qin Shufen, certain that Zhao Fan was the father—except Zhao Fan himself, who knew full well he’d never had any involvement with her. Driven to the brink and forced to jump, the first thing Zhao Fan does upon being reborn is refuse to give Qin Shufen his seat.
2344509.originName: 只是让个座怎么喜当爹了

2344636.title: At this point, even the flying birds no longer meet (Thailand)
2344636.description: To honor her promise to her deceased friend, Ye Shiyan devoted herself for years to caring for the friend’s husband and daughter, all the while neglecting the needs of her own husband, Gu Sijue, and their biological daughter, Gu Xiyue. Unable to endure such a life, Gu Sijue ultimately filed for a compulsory divorce and left with their daughter, later building a new family with his admirer, Liang Xingyue. Upon learning the truth, Ye Shiyan was devastated, consumed by regret.

2344754.title: After winning the lottery, my son cut off all ties with me.
2344754.description: Gu Fanghua, a rural sanitation worker, toiled her whole life to raise her son, Gu Wentao. After unexpectedly winning a billion‑yuan lottery prize, she joyfully headed to the city to give him the money, hoping to secure a better life for him. But she was met with relentless humiliation from her daughter‑in‑law and mother‑in‑law. Rather than standing by his mother, Gu Wentao scorned her lowly status and accused her of disrupting his life, cruelly driving her away and severing their bond. Devastated, Gu Fanghua bore the pain of betrayed亲情 alone. Upon learning that his mother had won the enormous jackpot, Gu Wentao suddenly came to his senses, filled with remorse, and set out to find her, begging for her forgiveness. In the crucible of金钱, mother and son once again embraced the warmth of family.
2344754.originName: 中奖后，儿子和我断绝关系

2344863.title: Mid-Autumn Moon: She Only Plots the Scheme, Not the Outcome (Thai Dubbed Version)
2344863.description: Upon returning from abroad, Xia Yan discovered that her private office had been taken over by her assistant, Su Momomo, yet her husband, Chu Mu, accused her of making a mountain out of a molehill. Determined, she fired Su Momomo and halted a crucial project—only to be guilt-tripped by Chu Mu. Faced with his repeated favoritism toward outsiders and his efforts to undermine her authority, Xia Yan stripped him of his chairmanship at the board meeting and filed for divorce. It was too late for Chu Mu to regret his actions; Xia Yan had already embarked on a new chapter in her career.
2344863.originName: 中秋月她只谋局不谋圆

2344917.title: In the end, we follow the wild geese, each heading west or east. (Thailand)
2344917.description: Ni An and Cheng Xi have relied on each other since their youthful days. To fund Cheng Xi’s education, Ni An gave up her own dream of attending university, taking on multiple jobs and devoting everything she had; meanwhile, Cheng Xi skipped grades all the way, becoming the youngest professor at Tsinghua or Peking University.

2344982.title: Returning to University, I Ruled the Business World with My Foreknowledge (Thai Dubbed Version)
2344982.description: Reborn at the very moment his college entrance exams ended, Zhao Jin’an resolves to break free from the fate of his past life and make amends for his regrets—failing to fulfill his filial duty and achieving nothing in his career. Drawing on his foreknowledge of the future, he seizes the opportunities of the times, starting with selling fish and betting on the World Cup to rapidly amass wealth. He then ventures into mineral water, smartphone operating systems, and other fields, gradually building a business empire. Along the way, he wins the favor and support of women like Muyao, Yufei, and Zhao Zhilan, while steadfastly refusing the persistent advances of his former wife, Chen Qingya, and fending off numerous plots to ruin him orchestrated by Ou Qiang and others. In the end, Zhao Jin’an establishes himself firmly in the cutthroat world of commerce, rises to become the nation’s richest man, secures a prosperous life for his family, and achieves both a remarkable comeback and the fulfillment of his true worth.
2344982.originName: 重返大学我靠先知横扫商界

2345080.title: Back to 1989 (Thai Dubbed Version)
2345080.description: In his previous life, Shen Qiusheng’s relationship with Yao Yujia was discovered by Yao Jianguo. During their ensuing struggle, Shen accidentally became the village’s notorious murderer and was sent to prison. His parents, shamed by the scandal, were ridiculed and unable to hold their heads high. After being reborn and released from prison, Shen Qiusheng was consumed by remorse. To make amends for his past regrets, he shed his old persona and took full responsibility, offering a sincere apology. In the end, the Zhao family’s wicked deeds were exposed and they were brought to justice. Relying on his own strength, Shen Qiusheng won over Yao’s father and finally married Yao Yujia, beginning a new chapter in his life.

2345225.title: Reincarnated in the 1970s and Disowned at the Start (Thai Dubbed Version)
2345225.description: Chen Weinan is reborn in 1977, only to have his eldest uncle, Chen Jianguo, seize the opportunity to force a family split for personal gain. Armed with his past-life memories, he protects his wife and children, stands up to his despicable relatives, and leads his family out of poverty through innovative pig‑raising techniques, charcoal burning, and cooking for banquets—ultimately humiliating his uncle’s household and securing both a harmonious family life and a successful career.

2345323.title: After Reincarnation, Mom’s Little Piggy Bank Can’t Hold On Anymore (Thai Dubbed Version)
2345323.description: In his previous life, the male lead, Fang Hao, as the richest man in Jinghai, was deceived by his biological father, Fang Yiming, and wrongly turned against Lin Ruoxue, the mother who had raised him with great hardship, severing their bond. On his deathbed, Fang Hao was reborn and transported back to the very day his parents divorced when he was a child. Seizing the chance, he promptly had Lin Ruoxue sign the divorce papers and vowed to give both her and his daughter a wealthier, happier life. Soon after, he made a splash on Antique Street and even took Jinghai’s young master, Lu Xiao, under his wing!
2345323.originName: 重生后，老妈的小金库绷不住了

2345575.title: She Turns the Tables Against All Odds, Returning to the Day Her Husband’s Wedding Took Place (Thai-Dubbed Version)
2345575.description: The only daughter of the richest man in the land, Yun Zheng, is reborn, returning to the night of her wedding—when her husband and his long‑lost love humiliated her. She kicks over the candlestick and refuses to enter the marquis’s mansion, vowing to take her revenge and reclaim everything that is hers. Along the way, she comes to know and stand by the Ninth Young Master, Li Wuyang, ultimately bringing down the marquisate, securing her place on the imperial register, and sharing a lifetime of happiness with Li Wuyang.
2345575.originName: 重生回夫君大婚时她逆风翻盘

2345723.title: Reincarnated as the Son of a Noble Clan (Thai Dubbed Version)
2345723.description: Zhou Xing was reborn and instantly became a top-tier rich second-generation heir, with 3 billion in cash deposited into his account and the “Life Optimization System” bound to him. He strategically positioned himself for financing and, as a premier rich kid, enrolled at the Shanghai Conservatory of Music. Along the way, he splurged on Lafite, snapped up legendary cars, wooed an internet-famous flight attendant, and threw money at every problem—relishing the thrill of lavish spending while nimbly riding the waves of every emerging trend. Money, connections, beautiful women, and career—all four aspects of his life are running on overdrive.

2345943.title: Poor parents give up their adopted son, Chinbaw (Thailand)
2345943.description: After being diagnosed with advanced gastric cancer, college‑graduate Xu Ciyuan took on three jobs at a hotel to save up retirement funds for his cleaning‑worker parents—only to discover by chance that they were far from destitute. When he tried to tell them about his illness, a misunderstanding arose due to remarks made by Xu Jingyan; by the time the truth was finally revealed, it was already too late to undo the harm.

2346009.title: After Pretending to Be Blind, I Accidentally Seduced the Paranoid Boss (Thai Dubbed Version)
2346009.description: The Lu family was struck by a devastating fire, leaving them all burned. Lu Zhi’ning’s eyes were blinded by the smoke, and the old butler, Feng Zhen, took her in and cared for her. Feng Chao colluded with the caregiver, Hua Ping, to engineer a liaison between Lu Zhi’ning and Bo Wang, resulting in a pregnancy as part of a scheme to extort money. Yet Lu Zhi’ning ended up marrying into the Bo family. Her sight eventually returned, but she continued to feign blindness, devoting herself to amassing wealth and striving to restore the Lu clan.
2346009.originName: 装瞎后误把偏执大佬攻略了

2346100.title: Zhuomu (Thailand)
2346100.description: In her past life, Shen Youning, a college student in the Republic of China era, was duped by her scoundrel fiancé, Zhao Muyun, into handing over all her wealth to him for nothing—only to discover that Zhao had long since conspired with her father, Shen Daxiong, her stepmother, Jin Ling, and her stepsister, Shen Meiyan, to seize her fortune. Betrayed by the four of them, Shen Youning was murdered and her death staged as a suicide. Her soul lingered in the mourning hall, seething with hatred yet powerless to act. Just then, Song Xiancheng, the obsessive warlord who had once forcibly taken her and treated her as little more than a plaything, burst into the hall, slew the four perpetrators, and drank poison to follow her in death. It was only then that Shen Youning realized she had always believed Song Xiancheng merely used her for his own pleasure, never guessing that he had been utterly consumed by love for her.

2346246.title: The Secret on the Table (Thai Dubbed Version)
2346246.description: After ten years in prison, Chen Ping mastered the art of conning. Upon his release, he discovers his son has been lured into a rigged gambling scheme. He steps in to outwit the swindlers and bring his son to his senses, only to have his wife kidnapped and used as leverage to force him into another high-stakes game—uncovering a decades-old case of his father’s wrongful death in the process. Driven by vengeance, Chen Ping once again turns the tables, winning two consecutive matches and wiping out his opponents. In the end, the police bring the killer to justice, his son breaks free from gambling, and the family is reunited.

2346303.title: The Capitalist Young Mistress, After Her Awakening, Chases Her Husband While Pregnant (Thailand)
2346303.description: Wei Yuxuan awakens to her role as the story’s expendable character, learning that she will be framed by her step‑sister Wei Yuan, a book‑crossing intruder, leading to the downfall of her former husband Xie Yanzhi’s family and her own tragic death by miscarriage. Resolute, she forsakes a promising future and, defying all opposition, sets out for the northwest, pregnant, to find Xie Yanzhi. Confronted by Xie Yanzhi’s coldness, Xie Chengxi’s hostility, and Wei Yuan’s relentless scheming, Wei Yuxuan warms the Xie household with her culinary skills, prepares for the teaching exam to fulfill herself, and uses her wit to thwart Wei Yuan’s plots and false accusations.
2346303.originName: 资本家小姐觉醒后揣孕肚追夫

2346418.title: From then on, mountains and rivers shall never meet (Thai dubbed version)
2346418.description: Fu Jingxuan and Chu Qingxue, a couple who had shared eight years of love, once dreamed together and successfully founded the Muxue Group, a brilliant enterprise that bore witness to their journey of love and struggle. In those days, their affection was as fervent and genuine as the blazing summer sun, with every glance between them brimming with deep affection and unspoken understanding. Yet, as the years passed, Fu Jingxuan became increasingly lost in the torrent of his career, growing ever more indifferent to Chu Qingxue’s delicate and sensitive heart. Faced with this love that had grown steadily colder, after countless sleepless nights of tossing and turning, Chu Qingxue finally made the painful decision to leave Fu Jingxuan and accept a marriage arranged by her family—a farewell to eight years of devotion and a chance at a new beginning.

2346566.title: The CEO’s Wife Works a Side Job (Thai Dubbed Version)
2346566.description: Ye Yijing stood before the elevator doors as they were about to close, her body trembling with anger. She could hardly fathom how there could be such arrogant, rude people in the world; their sheer snobbery left her cold. Meanwhile, behind Chad’s easy smile lay a sardonic mockery of those who pretended to conduct business while secretly engaging in deals of power and sex. He thought to himself: to act wild and carefree yet still cling to an image of nobility—where in this world could one find such a contradictory kind of perfection?  Ye Sangnian’s world was turned upside down by an unexpected arrangement. Through a blind date, she quickly married Shen Tingbai, only to discover after the wedding that her husband was the president of the Shen Group. Faced with this sudden disparity in status, Ye Sangnian chose to conceal her true identity and continued working at the company under the guise of an ordinary cleaning lady.

2346769.title: This Bodyguard Is Too Self-Disciplined (Thai Dubbed Version)
2346769.description: Chen Yundong is a residential‑community security guard who, by sheer chance, acquires a self‑discipline system. As long as he sticks to his daily regimen of self‑control, he grows stronger with each passing day. Completing the system’s tasks unlocks master‑level martial arts for him, and during a routine patrol, he unexpectedly rescues the kidnapped female CEO, Su Li. From that moment on, he leaps into the role of her personal bodyguard—only to find himself swept up in a series of unforeseen twists and turns. Along the way, his bond with Su Li deepens, and in the end, he wins her heart.

2346843.title: The True Dragon Emerges, Astonishing the World (Thai Dubbed Version)
2346843.description: While fulfilling his marriage contract, Su Yi endures the scorn of his fiancée, Shen Qingyue, and everyone else. With his peerless medical skills, he effortlessly cures even the most perplexing ailments and bests his rivals—yet his accomplishments are all too often dismissed as mere boasting. Amidst wave after wave of doubt and challenge, the truth slowly comes to light. Relying on nothing but his own prowess, Su Yi proves himself, unmasking hypocrisy and completing the legendary journey of a true dragon rising from obscurity.

2346942.title: The Real Rich Girl’s Secret Identity Has Gone Viral (Thailand)
2346942.description: At six, Sang Ning was misdiagnosed as intellectually disabled and had her identity usurped by Sang Li. Fifteen years later, she was reclaimed by the elderly matriarch of the Sang family, returning with a string of prestigious titles to deliver a resounding slap in the face to all who doubted her. To her surprise, Fu Xiuyuan, the iron‑fisted patriarch of the capital’s wealthiest clan, turned out to be her ex‑boyfriend. Known for his ruthless decisiveness, he transforms into a pouting, affectionate husband in front of Sang Ning, insisting she take responsibility for their past. As Sang Ning’s many layers are peeled away, the truth about her childhood abandonment is gradually revealed: the real reason why Liu Wanyu abandoned her own daughter to raise Sang Li is far more complex than mere disdain for her “low IQ.”

2347003.title: The Real Young Lady Comes from the Villain’s Village (Thailand)
2347003.description: Born a true heiress, Su Lingyun grew up in Villain Village. To raise a billion to rebuild the village’s ancestral hall, she had no choice but to return to the Su family—only to be met with hostility from the fake heiress, Su Xuerou, and her two brothers. Treating her as an unworldly country bumpkin, the three siblings planned to force her into giving up and leaving, but they soon reaped what they sowed. Still somewhat clueless, Su Lingyun, now the sole heir, insists she just wants that one billion.

2347090.title: The real heiress is a top student.
2347090.description: Lin Siwang, a top student from Shanhe Province, was unexpectedly brought back to the capital’s elite circles. Undeterred by her family’s hostility and the snubs of a fake heiress, she remained focused on her studies. After securing a Beijing household registration, she seized every opportunity to push herself even harder, ultimately earning admission to a world‑class university through sheer merit and forging a brilliant life of her own.

2347178.title: The Real Young Lady Enforces the Law with Her Words (Thailand)
2347178.description: Shen Zhao, once a young lady raised on the kindness of many, was instead made to serve as a substitute bride, wedded off as a mere tool to the paralyzed fifth young master of the Fu clan. Yet Shen Zhao was born with the extraordinary gift of her words carrying the force of law. Recognizing the true nature of her kin, she resolutely severed ties with them; from that day forward, the Shen family lost its fortune and fell into ruin. Meanwhile, Shen Zhao was graciously welcomed back into the illustrious Fu household, becoming a cherished guest. She outwitted the old matriarch who had once scorned her, revived the dying ancestral patriarch, and with a casual gesture, cured the paralytic Fu Jiuxing.

2361430.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King 5 (Thai Dub)
2361430.description: Wang Ling, a dry noodle-loving immortal king, now faces his greatest challenge yet! With a novelist dad, a mysterious mom, a brand-new little sister, and the sudden arrival of a powerful little sister, Wang Nuan, the Wang family’s ordinary life is turned upside down. And figuring out how to be a good older brother becomes the latest challenge for the mighty immortal king. Surprisingly, Wang Nuan’s extraordinary power doesn’t shock the Wang family. Wang Ling starts early, teaching his sister to control her immense abilities. But her power catches the attention of the sinister organization Ye Kui and Bai Zhe, a top-tier prisoner from Enchanted Prison. Faced with threats from evil cultivators, Wang Ling makes a decision that defies tradition: he’ll take his sister along to teach these villains a lesson! This season, join the immortal king and his little sister as they dive into a life filled with humor and unexpected adventures!
2361430.originName: 仙王的日常生活 第五季（泰配版）

2361551.title: The Story Between a Dumb Prefect and a High School Girl with an Inappropriate Skirt Length
2361551.description:
Sakuradaimon is a member of the school's disciplinary committee, checking students' appearance at the school gate every morning.
Poemu, on the other hand, is a high school girl who gets stopped by him daily for her “improper” skirt length.

Like oil and water, the two couldn't be more different—until one day, they unexpectedly run into each other during remedial classes.

The serious and strict Sakuradaimon turns out to be… completely hopeless at studying?!

Though total opposites at first, the distance between them begins to close as they get to know each other better.

From their chance encounter, a youthful story of awkward charm and growing bonds begins.
2361551.originName: ポンコツ風紀委員とスカート丈が不適切なJKの話

2361672.title: Dorohedoro Season2
2361672.description:
A man with no memories and the head of a lizard—Caiman was transformed by magic, his true face stolen from him.

Together with his partner Nikaido, he searches for clues to reclaim his identity. But as they dig deeper, the pasts once shrouded in mystery begin to unravel…

Hunted by the En Family, while the Cross-Eyes organization awaits the return of its boss, the conflict spirals ever further out of control—dragging everything into an even greater vortex of chaos.

From 2000 to 2018, Q Hayashida’s Dorohedoro (23 volumes) captivated fans worldwide with its one-of-a-kind, grotesque yet mesmerizing world.

First adapted into anime in 2020, the series pulled viewers into its chaotic madness—
and now, after six long years, a new season is finally set to begin!

2361752.title: I Want You To Show Me Your Panties With a Disgusted Face Returns
2361752.description:
A concept proposed by Shimahara (40hara) of the doujin circle “Animal Machine,” later developed into a series of situational illustrations.

The works center on various character archetypes—such as maids, gyaru, office ladies, nurses, and shrine maidens—often portraying a contrast between aloof or disdainful expressions and provocative, teasing presentation. By blending these seemingly opposing elements, the series establishes a highly niche style that delivers a strong, distinctive appeal.

First published as doujin works in 2015, the series will celebrate its 10th anniversary in 2025.
An anime adaptation debuted in 2018, with this title marking the fourth installment in the animated series.
2361752.originName: 嫌な顔されながらおパンツ見せてもらいたいR

2361893.title: Love Under the Clear Sky
2361893.description: Jiang Ning has loved Gu Chenyin since high school. She hid her true identity and devoted herself to him, even pursuing a career in aviation for his sake. Eventually, she marries him, but Gu is cold and emotionally distant, never valuing her feelings. Meanwhile, Lu Zheying, a genius painter from a poor family, is bullied by her stepmother and brother, and is forced to marry an old official as his ninth concubine.

2362008.title: President Bo's Runaway Bride
2362008.description: To escape an arranged marriage, Jian Xi hides her identity and becomes a secretary at the Bo Group. Little does she know, her boss Bo Jingxing is the very man she's supposed to marry. Meanwhile, Jingxing met Jian Xi by chance on the night she fled and became interested in her. Desperate to cancel his unwanted engagement, he has no idea that the woman he loves and his fiancée are the same person. As the two scheme to call off the wedding, they must navigate a hilarious game of cat and mouse while trying to keep their true identities a secret.

2362146.title: The Cleaning Lady is a Hidden Billionaire
2362146.description: Lu Beichen and Jiang Wanning have been married for twenty years. To protect Lu's pride, Jiang hid her identity as a wealthy heiress and worked as a cleaner while secretly supporting his company. Contemptuous of her 'lowly' job, Lu demands a divorce. After catching him with a new lover, a heartbroken Jiang agrees and returns to her wealthy roots. Following a successful surgery to remove a brain tumor, she reveals her true identity as the heiress of the Jiang Group at a grand banquet to fight for custody of their son. Lu deeply regrets his actions and tries to win her back, but Jiang refuses him and chooses to travel the world with her son instead.

2362248.title: Insulted by a Star: My Hidden Hero Identity Revealed
2362248.description: Lin Mo appears ordinary, but he is actually a top-tier national expert working on secret state projects. After being publicly humiliated by top star Su Qing at a charity event, his true identity is revealed when he appears as the chief expert at a national tech summit. The truth shocks the world, completing his ultimate rise to glory.
2362248.originName: 被明星侮辱，我的国士身份曝光了

2362394.title: Dumping Him, My Heiress Identity Revealed
2362394.description: Lin Xingnuo was arranged to marry Lu Zesheng but rejected him due to his arrogance, declaring herself the real tycoon. Meanwhile, her ex, Jiang Haoran, returns after three years to humiliate her. Unbeknownst to her, he is faking amnesia to plot against the Lu family. Amidst emotional turmoil and business wars, Lin remains sharp. After many twists, she reunites with Lu Zesheng at a gala, falling into a new web of romance and mystery.
2362394.originName: 被甩后，首富千金身份曝光了

2362503.title: Secrets Revealed: My Mom is the Richest Woman
2362503.description: Shen Yu was sold to a village chief’s son by her father and brother. Ten years after escaping, she returns as a powerful CEO and the wealthiest woman. Finding her father trying to force her younger sister into the same miserable fate, Shen Yu uses her wealth and wisdom to crush the schemes, save her family, and transform from a victim into a master of her own destiny.

2362579.title: Addicted to Doting on My Wife: Mr. Mu is Jealous Again
2362579.description: Betrayed by her fiancé and best friend wasn't enough. Ning Qianyu also had her medical license revoked due to a surgical accident, while her mother urgently needed heart surgery. Under such immense pressure, Mu Shengchen appeared, offering help on the condition that Ning Qianyu enter into a contractual marriage with him. After some hesitation, Ning Qianyu agreed, starting her married life with this stranger. However, Ning Qianyu gradually discovered that Mu Shengchen would boil brown sugar water for her during her period, act as her personal heater, and even help her apply for her dream postgraduate professor position, doting on her meticulously. Wasn't this supposed to be a contractual marriage? Wasn't he supposed to be impotent after a car accident?
2362579.originName: 宠妻上瘾：慕少又吃醋了

2362672.title: Transmigrated as the "Fake" Heiress of a Wealthy Family
2362672.description: Zhou Nian, an ordinary office worker, suddenly transmigrates into a novel as a "fake" heiress. Just as the real heiress kicks her out, her three billionaire biological brothers find her. Seeing the villa where she lived for 20 years, they feel heartbroken that their sister "suffered" in such a modest place. They immediately start spoiling her excessively to make up for lost time. While the real heiress continues to cause trouble, she has no idea that Zhou Nian is actually the long-lost daughter of the Lu family—a hidden powerhouse far wealthier than the Zhou family.
2362672.originName: 穿成了团宠文里的“假”千金

2362758.title: Stepping Out of His World
2362758.description: This drama revolves around the protagonist's choice between love and self-growth, telling the story of her gradual awakening from a complex emotional relationship, bravely stepping out of his world, and realizing her self-worth. The play delicately portrays the character's inner struggles and transformation, showcasing the perseverance and courage of contemporary young people in facing emotional dilemmas. It is a thought-provoking emotional drama.

2362907.title: Love Under False Pretenses
2362907.description: Jiang Lai's family was ruined by the Lu family fifteen years ago. Now, she returns under the alias Xun Zhen to seek revenge. Disguised as a jewelry designer, she approaches the heir, Lu Yanxing, planning to reclaim her family's legacy by winning his heart. However, as they get entangled in family conspiracies, Jiang Lai finds herself torn between her thirst for vengeance and her growing feelings for the enemy.

2362976.title: Misplaced Heartbeat
2362976.description: Two years into their marriage, Jiang Yanshen divorced Bai Shuyu after a misunderstanding. Three years later, they unexpectedly reunite on a film set where Jiang is the director and Bai is an actress. As the truth behind their past divorce comes to light, the two must face their lingering feelings and decide if their misplaced love deserves a second chance.

2363084.title: The Mistress of the Palace
2363084.description: In her past life, Su Luoli was hunted by enemies and thought she was dead. Instead, she wakes up as the new bride of the 'foolish' Prince Murong Qi. Armed with a high-tech smartphone from the future, the former female CEO refuses to be bullied by arrogant servants and quickly takes control of the household. However, chaos ensues when the butler runs away with the treasury, leading to a guard mutiny. Meanwhile, Magistrate Su Wuming faces a mysterious serial kidnapping case known as the 'Nine-Story Building Blood Case'.

2363219.title: The Ultimate Marriage
2363219.description: Ye Qingran and Gu Chenzhou were childhood sweethearts in love, but news of Chenzhou's death arrived on their wedding day. Gu Hanshan took this chance to force Qingran into a relationship. Refusing to believe her lover was dead, Qingran hired a detective and became convinced Chenzhou was alive because of a specific scar on the body. Hanshan later caused the death of Qingran's mother and forced her to sign a prenuptial agreement. On the eve of the wedding, Chenzhou returned and rescued her. He made Hanshan and his accomplice Wu Yuyan pay for their crimes, finally reuniting with Qingran for a happy life.

2363306.title: The God of War's Quest for His Wife
2363306.description: Seven years ago, Qin Feng, the God of War, was poisoned and saved by a mysterious girl during a camping trip. She left him a son and disappeared. Now, while on a blind date with his son, Qin Feng discovers his date, Zhang Kexin, is the child's mother. However, she has lost her memory. As they uncover the secret behind her pendant, a journey of family reunion and hidden truths begins.

2363362.title: Replacing My Twin to Rule the Wealthy Family
2363362.description: Shu Yuexi and her twin sister Shu Yueqin were separated at birth, with Yuexi raised abroad. One day, Yuexi learns that Yueqin has been attacked and is in a coma. To find the culprit, Yuexi returns and takes over her sister’s identity as the Madam of the Qin family. The Qin family is shocked to find that the once-meek 'Yueqin' has returned from her disappearance as a powerful force to be reckoned with.
2363362.originName: 顶替双胞胎姐姐整顿豪门

2363498.title: Urban Supreme War God
2363498.description: This series follows the protagonist's dual identity in urban society, showcasing their heroic image using extraordinary abilities to fight crime and protect the weak, while also deeply portraying their emotional journey to uncover hidden family secrets. The plot features multiple visual conflict scenes and logical twists, creating a fast-paced narrative style.

2363627.title: Let Go, Mr. Gu: Madam Wants Her Independence
2363627.description: Xiao Nanyin has long loved Gu Yanting, but their wedding day turns into a nightmare that destroys her family. Seeking revenge for a misunderstanding, Gu Yanting tortures her ruthlessly. Manipulated by Gu Qiyuan, she watches her loved ones die one after another. To prove her father's innocence, she nearly loses her life, until the truth finally surfaces and his name is cleared.
2363627.originName: 放手吧顾总，夫人她想独自美丽

2363711.title: The Romantic Servant
2363711.description: Wang Yuan was an overworked corporate drone. On his birthday, he caught his ex-girlfriend with his boss, Lu Ye. Heartbroken, he suddenly received a text showing a balance of one billion dollars and met his sister, Wang Yu, discovering that the Wang family is actually the world's richest secret dynasty. Amidst this reversal, the story also follows a mysterious woman living as a beggar who rises from the bottom with courage and wisdom. Her relationship with Wang Yuan evolves from pity to deep love as they face challenges together.

2363859.title: The Playboy CEO Pursues His Heiress Wife
2363859.description: Three years ago, Fu Yanci left after wrongly accusing Ye Wanti of being a gold digger. After three years of waiting in vain, Ye Wanti reunites with him through a business deal, only to find he hates her deeply and has someone else. Despite her attempts to reconcile, she is met with insults and realizes the root of the problem: he never trusted her. Heartbroken, she agrees to an arranged marriage, only to discover the groom is Fu Yanci himself.

2363950.title: CEO Feng's 100 Ways to Dote on His Wife
2363950.description: Shi Ying, the CEO of a fashion group, seeks an arranged marriage to save her company from a financial crisis. After a heated argument with Fu Nian, she accidentally injures Feng Yan, the CEO of Shengshi Group, who is disguised as a delivery man for a blind date. The two end up in a flash marriage. When her original investment plans fail, Shi Ying visits Shengshi Group to seek help, only to stumble into a meeting and discover her new husband's true identity.

2364077.title: Revenge of the Mad Heiress
2364077.description: Su Yunmiao was once drugged and humiliated at her engagement party. Reborn one month before the incident, she refuses to be a victim again. She is determined to tear off the masks of her enemies and make them pay for their crimes.

2364180.title: The Phoenix Returns
2364180.description: Special agent Ye Muxin dies during a mission and is reborn as her 20-year-old self. With her memories intact, she vows to change her tragic fate. Navigating through palace power struggles, she punishes traitors, exposes her hypocritical family, and finally achieves her revenge and redemption.

2364273.title: The Phoenix Rises
2364273.description: Qi Shuyin and Chu Jingxuan have been married for five years. After recovering her lost memory, she returns to the Qi family and helps Chu become the Vice President of the Yan Group. On the day she plans to reveal her true identity, Yan Shengxue brings her divorce papers. Faced with Chu’s disdain and insults, Qi Shuyin decisively divorces him and returns to inherit her family empire. Chu didn't truly want a divorce; he only meant to provoke her into being more ambitious, but his plan backfires. After the divorce, Chu sees Qi with other men and burns with jealousy, assuming they are her lovers. Little does he know, one is her brother and the other is her assistant—and Qi Shuyin herself is actually the wealthiest person in North City.

2364343.title: Empress of Revenge: Marrying the Imperial Advisor as My Queen
2364343.description: Princess Yun Qing, adored by the Imperial Advisor Ye Jichen, married him. Three years later, afflicted with a 'Concentric Gu' (love-binding parasite), she was met with Ye Jichen's coldness. Emperor Yun pressed for an heir. Ye Jichen's junior sister, Ji Shen'er, who closely resembled Yun Qing, repeatedly framed Yun Qing, leading to the public flogging and death of Yun Qing's maternal grandfather, Chu Tian'ao. Yun Qing then swallowed a 'Heartbreak Gu', gathered her grandfather's former troops, and marched on the capital to usurp the throne. After their reunion, Yun Qing sought revenge on Ye Jichen. Ye Jichen explained the misunderstandings and truth. Just as they began to rebuild trust, Luo Lingtian's interference caused them to become strangers once more.
2364343.originName: 复仇女帝：拐个国师做皇后

2364483.title: Mr. Fu's Beloved Wife, Escapes with Child
2364483.description: This drama tells the story of Fu Chengxiao and Ye Zhixi's arranged marriage. Ye Zhixi is treated coldly by Fu Chengxiao. Due to Lin Luofei's schemes, Fu Chengxiao misunderstands Ye Zhixi and even wants to abort her unborn child. Later, Ye Zhixi escapes while pregnant. After discovering the truth, Fu Chengxiao finds Ye Zhixi, apologizes, and wins her back. They reconcile and welcome a happy family of three.

2364606.title: Gu Lü, Your Wife Asks You to Take Your Medicine
2364606.description: This drama tells the story of Su Yuyan, who learns during psychological counseling that her marriage has caused her great harm and that she has a serious tendency towards depression. Her husband, Gu Lingcheng, is entangled with his lover, Han Yaxin. After Han Yaxin falls ill, she blames Su Yuyan, who states that she has fulfilled her responsibilities towards her. Gu Lingcheng, however, verbally abuses Su Yuyan, plunging her into deep pain. Their marriage teeters on the brink amidst her husband's misunderstanding and his lover's provocation.

2364724.title: Young Master Gu's Heiress Maid
2364724.description: Mu Wanwan, the heiress of the Mu family, has been betrothed to Gu Jingli, the heir of the Gu family, since childhood. Seeking independence, she sneaks away to the capital to find evidence of his infidelity to cancel their engagement. On her first day, she accidentally runs into him and is forced to disguise herself as a maid to infiltrate his home, planning to seduce him herself to test his character.

2364821.title: Mrs. Gu, Your Secret is Out
2364821.description: Xu Mumu joins her family's company at the entry level to inspect things discreetly, only to find someone else impersonating her. As the imposter's actions begin to affect her family and husband, Gu Beichen, Xu Mumu decides to fight back. Through their confrontation, her true identity is revealed, and she works with Gu Beichen to resolve the crisis and protect their family.

2364875.title: My Ex-Husband Found Out I Am His True Love
2364875.description: Bai Shengxing and Gu Yu married in haste due to an elders' agreement without ever meeting. Returning from abroad, Shengxing prepares for a divorce, only to meet Gu Yu under a different identity. From misunderstanding to falling deeply in love, he realizes the woman he adores is the ex-wife he just divorced. Now, his journey to win her back begins.
2364875.originName: 和前夫离婚后，他发现我是心上人

2365024.title: The Only Man in the Harem
2365024.description: An unlucky guy travels back in time and ends up as a discarded female concubine in the 'Cold Palace.' Surrounded by predatory women like Tang Sanzang in the spider's den, his life becomes a hilarious mess. The Imperial Noble Consort sends poisoned cakes and assassins, but he defeats them all using modern knowledge. A proud female general claims she’ll kill him, yet fights the Empress Dowager to protect him. Even the most ruthless head maid gets influenced by his antics, turning a serious palace drama into a chaotic daily comedy.

2365111.title: Under the Absurdity
2365111.description: In high school, You Nian and the campus heartthrob Lu Qingze had a passionate romance. Lu Qingze was perfect except for being poor, while You Nian was a rich and beautiful girl. Their relationship was looked down upon due to their different social statuses. Five years later, they broke up. On the day of the breakup, the usually gentle Lu Qingze lost control for the first time. When they meet again, Lu Qingze has become a rising star in the tech world. Sharp-featured and elegantly indifferent, his mature charm is undeniable. Years later, 25-year-old You Nian finds herself once again captivated by his looks...

2365230.title: Back to 1999: Reborn as a Tycoon
2365230.description: Shi Wu travels back to 1999, the very day his wife, Yan Shang, committed suicide. Armed with memories of the future, he dives into the business world, seizing every opportunity to become the richest man alive. Along the way, he heals his wife's heart and mends their broken marriage. Facing both fierce competition and family struggles, he stays true to himself and eventually achieves both immense wealth and true love.

2365345.title: The Road Home
2365345.description: Lin Su, a college student, is tricked by her boyfriend, Chen Jingran, and taken to a remote village. After realizing the danger, she tries to escape with another victim, Li Fang, but they are caught by the villagers. Her father, Lin Changhe, faces many obstacles while searching for her. To make matters worse, Chen Jingran sells Lin Su to an old bachelor. Although her father arrives to save her at the last moment, Chen Jingran kidnaps her again to cover up his crimes.

2365412.title: Mr. Huo, Don't Get Carried Away by Marriage
2365412.description: This drama tells the story of Lin Niansheng, who is falsely accused of murdering Huo Sichen's first love, Su Shuyan, on her wedding day, leading to marital conflict. As the plot unfolds, the two experience misunderstandings over the murder and emotional entanglements, gradually resolving their grievances and undergoing an emotional transformation. The entire series is presented in short drama episodes of about one minute each, showcasing marital conflicts and emotional entanglements.

2365475.title: Unexpected Mrs. Lin
2365475.description: Lin Jiaxu, a young woman working at an auction house with dreams of becoming a jewelry designer, finds her life turned upside down when she is suddenly appointed as the CEO's wife. Caught in a web of power, money, and identity struggles, she must navigate high society while staying true to her heart and her pursuit of real love.

2365572.title: The Secret Billionaire's Son
2365572.description: Lin He, a boy from a poor rural family, faces constant bullying while studying in the city. However, at a high-end auction, he is shocked to see a common item from his home sell for a fortune. He soon discovers that his father, Lin Zhiqiang, is actually the world's richest man, who hid his wealth to teach his son a lesson. After facing many challenges, Lin He overcomes his insecurities and completes his ultimate comeback.

2365712.title: My Darling Wife, Don't Even Think of Escaping
2365712.description: Song Yanran was sold into the Shen family by her own father, forced to marry Shen Yichen, the eldest young master of the Shen family who was paralyzed in both legs. After marriage, Song Yanran suffered humiliation from the Shen family, but gradually fell in love with Shen Yichen during their time together. Shen Yichen, too, developed feelings for her through his repeated manipulations. When Shen Yichen's secret activities were exposed, Song Yanran stepped forward to take the blame for him. She was then kicked out of the Shen family by Mrs. Li Mei, who also demanded she repay 500,000. Shen Yichen, needing to proceed with his plans, had to endure and chose to divorce Song Yanran to sever ties. Song Yanran was left to work various jobs to pay off her debt. One night, Song Yanran was returning home late and was in an alley...
2365712.originName: 娇妻别想逃：沈少的漫漫追妻路

2365805.title: Spoiled Love
2365805.description: Cheng Qianqian and Pei Yuan were engaged without ever meeting. Returning from abroad, Qianqian goes undercover at Pei Group to investigate her fiancé, only to find that the male model she had a one-night stand with looks exactly like him! Meanwhile, intern Cheng Xi steals Qianqian's identity as a wealthy heiress to snatch her fiancé. In a separate twist, desperate to save her paralyzed father, Lin Mian accidentally calls gynecologist Shi Lin instead of an egg-selling agency.

2365932.title: The Jinyiwei's Substitute Bride
2365932.description: Mu Yan's sachet was stolen by her sister Mu Xi, leading Commander Shen Tinglan to believe Mu Xi was his savior. He requested an imperial decree to marry her, but Mu Xi fled before the wedding, fearing rumors that Shen was ugly. Mu Yan was forced to take her sister's place. Believing Mu Yan is a scheming woman who stole her sister's marriage, Shen treats her with cruelty and coldness, eventually causing Mu Yan to fall gravely ill and cough up blood.
2365932.originName: 锦衣卫大人的替嫁新娘

2366075.title: Bought a Billionaire Husband for $9.9
2366075.description: Lu Chiyuan, the powerful head of the Lu family, was listed for sale online by his grandfather for just $9.9 as a prank. Xiang Nuan, a shopping enthusiast, accidentally snagged this "special offer" husband during a flash sale. The two rush into marriage without knowing each other's true identities. Due to a system glitch, Xiang Nuan mistakes the cold Fu Xingzhou for her husband, while Lu Chiyuan mistakes Xiang Nuan's greedy stepmother, Lin Se, for his new bride. Amidst these layers of misunderstanding, can they find their way to true love?
2366075.originName: 九块九网购老公，他竟是豪门大佬

2366176.title: Nine Provinces Dragon Lord
2366176.description: “Nine Provinces Dragon Lord” is a historical fantasy short drama set in the fictional continent of “Nine Provinces.” In 2024 AD, the “Nine Provinces” continent enters a new era—the “Dragon Lord Era.” In this age, the legendary Four Divine Dragons reawaken, each guarding the dimensions of earth, ocean, sky, and time, bestowing upon new heroes the responsibility of guardianship. The story revolves around a young woman named Yun Ge, who was abandoned in the mountains as a child but unexpectedly gained the ability to communicate with the Four Divine Dragons. As the plot unfolds, Yun Ge gradually uncovers the secrets of her own identity and learns of an ancient prophecy: only four true guardians can awaken the Four Divine Dragons and together resist the impending dark force—the Underworld Legion. To protect the Nine Provinces continent from disaster, the characters in “Nine Provinces Dragon Lord” embark on a journey full of challenges and adventures. Along this journey, they must not only confront powerful external enemies but also overcome their inner fears and doubts. Through a series of thrilling stories, Yun Ge and the other guardians gradually grow into true heroes, ultimately joining forces to defeat the Underworld Legion and save the continent. “Nine Provinces Dragon Lord” has won the audience's favor with its rich fantasy worldview, diverse character settings, and gripping plot design.

2366246.title: Help! The Abandoned Medical Wife is Actually the Eldest Princess
2366246.description: Lin Shuyun and Lu Zixuan have been married for three years, but he has never truly looked at her. When her guards urge her to return to the palace, her true identity is revealed: the Eldest Princess of the Great Liang Dynasty. Choosing love over her throne, she stays, only to see Lu Zixuan bring home another woman, Lin Xizhao, who subjects her to constant humiliation. At a grand banquet, Shuyun is forced to reclaim her royal power. Meanwhile, Su Jinyu is betrayed by her husband Xu Mingli and his mistress, who plot to sacrifice her to an ancient mountain fox.
2366246.originName: 救命，医女弃妇竟是长公主

2366343.title: The Rise Begins After Marrying the Female CEO
2366343.description: In an era of opportunities and challenges, everyone strives for their dreams. Lin Yi, an ordinary young man, marries CEO Su Qing after an unexpected event. His life changes completely, and his journey to the top begins.
2366343.originName: 崛起从和女总裁结婚开始

2366405.title: Rise of the Rebel: Conquering the Empress
2366405.description: Chu Yang, a modern-day programmer, accidentally travels to a matriarchal dynasty and becomes a lowly servant to the cold Empress Feng Jiuge. When he discovers the world operates on his own game code, he decides to use system bugs to change his fate. From schemes in the imperial garden to power plays in the royal court, Chu Yang shakes the Empress’s iron rule through rebellion and seduction. As power clashes with true feelings, a romantic coup begins—who is really the one being conquered?

2366462.title: Open the Coffin! Mr. Mu Says His Wife Can Still Be Saved
2366462.description: Luo Youran has long loved Mu Zexuan, but he despises her. They are forced into marriage to keep Mu's father on life support. After being framed by An Lingmeng and suffering through misunderstandings, the truth is finally revealed with Lan Zheyu's help. As Mu Zexuan regrets his actions and tries to win her back, Luo Youran falls into a coma after an accident. Mu Zexuan must now do everything he can to make amends for his past mistakes.
2366462.originName: 开棺！慕少说太太还有救

2366587.title: Starting as a Security Guard, I Became an Heir to a Tycoon
2366587.description: Jiang Fan became a security guard at a property management company to save his mother. On his engagement day, he caught his fiancée having an affair with a rich young man. When he confronted them, he was humiliated by the rich young man and his fiancée. Disheartened, Jiang Qingluan appeared and told him that he was the next master of the Cloud霄殿. Jiang Fan acquired the largest financial group and peerless martial arts, striking back at his materialistic fiancée and everyone who looked down on him.
2366587.originName: 开局当保安，我成了神豪继承人

2366647.title: The Invisible Lover
2366647.description: Lin Youyou, a well-known beauty blogger with many fans, offends a rival due to her upright personality. Fortunately, her boss, Gu Yu, secretly protects her. Unexpectedly, her rival, Jiang Yue, schemes an accident out of jealousy. Lin Youyou and Gu Yu both transmigrate into a novel world while escaping the danger. To return to reality, Lin Youyou must complete tasks given by the system. In the novel world, she and Gu Yu become classmates and face challenges together. Lin Youyou, with her agile and resilient character, solves problems. In this adventure, she not only gets closer to returning home but also gains a love that transcends dimensions.

2366745.title: Kunlun God of War
2366745.description: Five years ago, Ye Fan was framed and lost everything. Now, he returns as the Kunlun God of War, vowing to avenge his parents. His former fiancée, Li Pan'er, conspired with the young master of the Jiang family, Jiang Ruilong, not only to kill Ye Fan's parents but also to seize the Ye family's property. Facing their upcoming engagement banquet, Ye Fan decides to attend in person to expose the truth. Can Ye Fan successfully avenge his family and reclaim everything that belongs to him? A thrilling drama of revenge is about to unfold.

2366858.title: My Wife Cheated, Then a Beautiful CEO Fell for Me
2366858.description: An ordinary middle-aged man at his lowest point unexpectedly meets a cold and beautiful female CEO. From a one-night encounter to a twist of fate, their lives become intertwined in a story of love and success that defies class and age.
2366858.originName: 老婆出轨后我被美女总裁看上了

2366969.title: Revenge Love: Marrying My Ex-Husband's Rival
2366969.description: Luo Yanxi's marriage to Su Yucheng was a nightmare hidden behind a glamorous facade. Believing her family killed his parents, Su ruined her family business and drove her parents to their deaths. Just as he imprisoned her in despair, an unexpected pregnancy changed everything. As the dark truth behind the past is finally revealed, can they face the love and hate between them?
2366969.originName: 离婚后，她嫁给前夫死对头

2367022.title: After Divorce, She Married a Billionaire CEO
2367022.description: Qin Nian and Shen Luo were married for three years, but Qin Nian never received Shen Luo's true affection. After numerous setbacks, Qin Nian was heartbroken. Shen Luo forced Qin Nian to divorce him and had her committed to a mental hospital. Qin Nian managed to escape and accidentally met Fu Xiyu. After being rescued, she unexpectedly got engaged to him. Shen Luo plotted to destroy Qin Nian and Fu Xiyu's relationship, but Fu Xiyu was determined to marry Qin Nian. The relationship between Qin and Fu grew stronger. Later, Qin Nian accidentally discovered that the death of Fu Xiyu's first love was related to her. Qin Nian, feeling guilty, began to push Fu Xiyu away, but Fu Xiyu remained devoted to her. It was then that Qin Nian realized Fu Xiyu had loved her for three years.
2367022.originName: 离婚后，她转身嫁了千亿总裁

2367095.title: Beyond the Divorce: My Rise as an All-Powerful Mogul
2367095.description: Su Xia, CEO of Xiasheng Group, divorces her husband Zhao Cheng after discovering his true nature. As she investigates the truth behind a mysterious accident from five years ago, she reveals her hidden talents to the world. Along the way, she reunites with Fu Jinchuan, CEO of Fu Group, only to discover he was the true savior who saved her life years ago. Together, they unravel the mysteries of the past and find love again.
2367095.originName: 离婚后，我成为了全能大佬

2367207.title: After Divorce, I Married a Billionaire CEO
2367207.description: After her divorce, Lin Ruoqi thought she could finally start her life anew—only to find herself unexpectedly drawn into a tangled web of high-society feuds. One day, a mysterious man mistakes her for the “Lady Xichuan” who vanished ten years ago, subjecting her to interrogation and threats. At the same time, she discovers she’s been ensnared in a secret plot involving the billionaire CEO, Bai Lisheng. Cold and ruthless on the surface, Bai harbors a hidden past, and his connection to the “Lady Xichuan” remains shrouded in mystery. Faced with this sudden chaos, Lin Ruoqi must not only unravel the truth but also fend off relentless pressure from all sides. In this clash of power and passion, can she carve out her own path? And why does Bai Lisheng remain so fixated on the “Lady Xichuan”? The story opens with a meticulously crafted scheme within a scheme, brimming with suspense and interwoven destinies, capturing the love-hate entanglements of modern urban life while blending elements of mystery and unexpected twists that leave readers utterly hooked.
2367207.originName: 离婚后，我嫁给了亿万总裁

2367285.title: Mr. Li's First Heartbeat
2367285.description: "Mr. Li's First Heartbeat" tells the story of CEO Li's emotional journey. The plot revolves around his intricate emotional entanglements, showcasing complex relationships and the process of falling in love. As the story unfolds, the relationship between CEO Li and the female lead undergoes several twists. Audiences will discover that the female lead's identity seems to hide a secret, and CEO Li faces various difficulties and challenges in his pursuit of her.

2367433.title: Two Years of Misplaced Love, A Love Lost to the Water
2367433.description: Lu Xiaoxiao marries Ou Ditian, CEO of Ou Group, to save her mother, but he only does it to fulfill his mother's dying wish. For two years, she dutifully loves him, yet he remains cold, his heart set on his childhood friend, Bai Bei'er. When Bai Bei'er returns and slanders Lu Xiaoxiao, Ou Ditian demands a divorce. Pregnant, Lu Xiaoxiao is suspected of carrying Ou Jiayi's child and forced to have an abortion. Heartbroken, she signs the agreement and leaves. A month later, Ou Ditian learns the child was his. He forces her back, claiming the agreement was unsigned and threatening her mother's life. Bai Bei'er schemes again, forcing their divorce. Desperate, Lu Xiaoxiao attempts suicide. After being rescued, she discovers she is the eldest daughter of the Bai family, uncovers the truth, leading to Bai Bei'er's imprisonment, and then marries Ou Jiayi.

2367518.title: Divorced and Favored: My Six Powerful Backers
2367518.description: Once seen as a discarded wife, she endured years of humiliation in a loveless marriage. Little did everyone know, she has six powerful tycoons secretly protecting her. After filing for divorce, the hidden truth is revealed. With the help of her six mysterious guardians, she transforms from a humble wallflower into a legendary queen. Watch her crush her enemies, reclaim her glory, and find true love in this epic tale of revenge and empowerment.
2367518.originName: 六个大佬的心尖宠，终于离婚了

2367568.title: President Lu, Stop Pretending to be a Gigolo!
2367568.description: Fifteen years after her family was ruined by the Lu family, Jiang Lai returns home under the pseudonym Xun Zhen to seek revenge. Disguised as a jewelry designer, she approaches Lu Yanxing, the heir of the Lu family, to reclaim her family's assets and steal his heart. Amidst family conspiracies and power struggles, the two find themselves entangled in a web of love and hate. Jiang Lai, who lost everything and saw her grandfather commit suicide, has returned from abroad with one goal: to make the Lu family pay for their betrayals.

2367656.title: My Down-and-Out Girlfriend Is a Billionaire Heiress
