2367656.description: A misunderstanding three years ago tore Gu Siheng and Xia Shiqiao apart. When they meet again, she realizes that her three years of waiting was nothing but a joke.
2367656.originName: 落魄女友竟是首富千金

2367763.title: Don't Mess with the Fierce Mom
2367763.description: Famous actress Su Li accidentally travels back in time and becomes an abandoned wife in a Marquis's manor. Armed with modern thinking and martial arts, she starts her revenge. Faced with her husband's neglect and a concubine's schemes, she punishes villains while raising her child. She runs ancient shops using livestreaming strategies and shocks the nobility with her hardcore parenting. When the Marquis finally realizes her value, she throws a divorce paper at him: 'You can't afford what I want!'

2367879.title: Cute Baby to the Rescue: Mommy, Daddy is Looking for You
2367879.description: Ye Xiao, the heiress of the Ye Group, was ruined by her stepmother and stepsister. Five years later, she returns as the CEO of Huamei Group for revenge. Meanwhile, to save her paralyzed father, the desperate Lin Mian accidentally calls gynecologist Shi Lin instead of an egg donation agency. Shi Lin becomes her benefactor and protector, and feelings begin to grow between them. However, when Lin Mian discovers that Shi Lin has a fiancée, she ends the relationship in heartbreak.
2367879.originName: 萌宝助攻：妈咪，爹地在找你

2367929.title: God of War: Heaven's End
2367929.description: Xiao Mietian, the Master of the Mietian Temple, returns to Haicheng three years after his family was massacred. Now the most powerful leader abroad with mastered divine arts, he seeks revenge against the Chen family. However, he discovers he has a biological daughter with his wife, Ye Wanting, whom he once misunderstood as a traitor. To make up for his three-year absence, he helps her become the head of the Ye family. He eventually uncovers the true mastermind behind his family's destruction, the Jiang family, and destroys them to finally achieve his revenge.

2368056.title: The Outcast Heiress: The Overbearing Prince’s Beloved
2368056.description: Su Wan'er, a noble daughter, was exiled after her family's betrayal led to her mother's tragic death. Five years later, she saves the cold Prince Ling Han, who falls for her and takes her as his favorite concubine. While pretending to be submissive, Wan'er secretly plots to destroy her family. As their love deepens, it's revealed that she is Ling Han's long-lost childhood love. Together, they face their enemies, proving that the deepest love can rise from the most painful betrayal.
2368056.originName: 名门弃女：霸道王爷心尖宠

2368167.title: Bright Moon Shines on Her Return
2368167.description: Su Jin, the secret heiress of the Hill Group, hid her identity to marry Shen Su for love. For three years, she endured mistreatment from her mother-in-law while secretly using her family's power to boost Shen Su's career. However, she was eventually divorced and discarded for a famous star. After being cyberbullied by the star's fans, Su Jin finally reclaimed her status as the powerful heiress. When Shen Su desperately tries to meet the mysterious new head of the Hill Group, he is shocked to discover she is the ex-wife he once threw away.

2368285.title: Homecoming by the River
2368285.description: Chen Gui returns to his quiet riverside hometown and discovers a water pollution crisis. He leads the villagers in a fight to protect the river and meets Xiao Ya, a young environmental volunteer. Together, they solve the pollution problem and rediscover their love for their home. However, a sudden rainstorm triggers a flood that threatens the river once more. Facing the danger, Chen Gui, Xiao Ya, and the villagers work together to fight the flood and finally save their village.

2368376.title: Target: Winning My Flash-Marriage Boss
2368376.description: Qiao Xinger is betrayed by her boyfriend and best friend, losing her home and falling into a coma after a brutal beating. After waking up, she happens to save the kidnapped Mrs. Lu. Impressed by her kindness, Mrs. Lu introduces her to her son, Lu Chengyu, who falls in love at first sight and proposes. After marriage, Qiao Xinger joins Lu’s Group as an intern while hiding her identity. When her ex and former friend bully her at work, Lu Chengyu steps in to protect his wife and invites the entire company to their wedding, leaving everyone shocked to discover that the mysterious bride is Qiao Xinger.

2368481.title: Mr. Mu, Don't Hold Back on Me
2368481.description: This drama tells the story of An Yueshu. Due to her father's preference for sons, she was swapped at birth with Mu Jinchan by her mother and has suffered long-term abuse from her adoptive parents. After being injured, she was rescued by Mu Jinchan and an unexpected intimacy occurred between them. Later, she married him because of pregnancy. Mu Jinchan's childhood friend, Lin Qinghe, who harbored affection for him, orchestrated a miscarriage and faked a mountain fall accident, framing An Yueshu, leading to the deterioration of their marital relationship. An Yueshu consistently strives to resolve misunderstandings and maintain their marriage.

2368549.title: Twilight Can't Compare to Your Unforgettable Presence
2368549.description: “Twilight Cannot Compare to the Unforgettable You” tells the story of a seemingly loving yet deeply troubled marriage between Han Zhou and Miss Su, whose complex emotional entanglements unfold against a backdrop of hidden danger. Four years of married life have left them outwardly calm, but their hearts are already in turmoil. One day, Miss Su unexpectedly discovers she is pregnant. What she believes to be the beginning of happiness soon triggers an explosive reaction from her husband, Han Zhou. Far from rejoicing, he demands that she go to the hospital for an abortion immediately, hinting that he has long known she was not taking her prescribed birth control. Faced with her husband’s coldness and controlling nature, Miss Su is plunged into deep confusion and anguish. She sets out to uncover the truth, only to find that this marriage harbors unspeakable secrets.  As the plot unfolds, Miss Su gradually realizes that Han Zhou’s ruthlessness is not merely selfishness, but stems from the fear and inner struggle within him. Meanwhile, the sudden appearance of a mysterious figure further shrouds the situation in mystery. The story unfolds as a tense tug-of-war of emotions, weaving together subtle psychological games between husband and wife with the helplessness and choices imposed by fate. In the end, will Miss Su be able to break free from her constraints and find her own truth? And why is Han Zhou so fixated on “loss”? With its suspenseful twists and delicate portrayal of human feelings, the narrative invites audiences on a poignant journey of love, trust, and redemption.

2368609.title: Uncontrollable Love
2368609.description: This is a urban emotional short drama about the complicated love story between Lin Qian and Gu Chen, who missed each other due to a misunderstanding. Lin Qian was forced to separate from Gu Chen due to family changes. Years later, when they reunited, their statuses were vastly different. Gu Chen had become a business elite, while Lin Qian was struggling in life. In the 64-episode series, they go from tentatively interacting to gradually resolving misunderstandings, enduring family objections and career crises, and finally finding a balance between love and responsibility. The drama portrays the struggles and growth of urban men and women in love through delicate emotional depiction and a compact plot.

2368679.title: The Jinyiwei Commander Falls for the Girl in Disguise
2368679.description: To save her mother, Chu Wanqing disguises herself as a man to enter an academy, where she ends up as roommates with Fu Jingxiu, a high-ranking Jinyiwei commander. As they spend every day together, Fu Jingxiu starts to develop feelings, unaware of her true gender. When her identity is on the verge of being exposed, how will she protect herself? How will Fu Jingxiu choose once he learns the truth? Amidst power struggles and true love, can Chu Wanqing save herself and keep her hard-won romance?
2368679.originName: 女扮男装后，锦衣卫大人爱上我

2368770.title: Loving You in Silence
2368770.description: Su Nanxue secretly loved He Sicang. She saved him during an avalanche, but He Sicang mistook Su Manting for his savior and always believed Su Nanxue was a liar. Su Nanxue worked hard to become He Sicang's co-pilot, and later they married due to a family alliance. He Sicang continued to despise Su Nanxue after their marriage. Three years into the marriage, Su Nanxue discovered she had cancer. Coinciding with Su Manting's return, Su Nanxue began to want to end the marriage. He Sicang accidentally learned of Su Nanxue's illness and proposed delaying the divorce, and their relationship began to improve. Su Manting provided evidence that Su Nanxue faked her illness, infuriating He Sicang, who then divorced Su Nanxue. After the divorce, Su Nanxue's health deteriorated, and she eventually succumbed to her illness and died. At this point, He Sicang learned the whole truth and rushed to the hospital, only to receive the news that Su Nanxue had passed away. He Sicang lived a life of guilt and solitude, but two years later, after a flight, he unexpectedly saw Su Nanxue's figure.

2368882.title: Mr. Pei, My Wife Says She Doesn't Need Two Husbands
2368882.description: Zhou Shuli has been married to Pei Jingxuan for five years. On her birthday, she witnesses Pei Jingxuan and her best friend Song Yaqi having an affair in a hotel. Heartbroken by what she sees, Zhou Shuli proposes a divorce. However, to her surprise, no matter what she says, Pei Jingxuan refuses to agree to the divorce. Song Yaqi, unwilling to give up, repeatedly sends people to kidnap and harm Zhou Shuli. Fortunately, Shen Yubai comes to her rescue, and Zhou Shuli narrowly escapes danger. The entanglement of these four people's grievances begins, and where will these four unrequited lovers ultimately go?
2368882.originName: 裴总，夫人说她不需要两个老公

2368991.title: Seven Powerful Brothers Dote on Their Lost Sister
2368991.description: Lu Mingsheng, the richest man in Jiangcheng, offers a massive reward to find his daughter, Luo Yuan, who has been missing for 15 years. Before being found, Luo Yuan was betrayed by the boyfriend she supported through school. At her lowest point, her true identity is revealed. Lu Mingsheng summons his seven sons home, led by the eldest, a billionaire CEO. Together, the seven brothers rescue Luo Yuan from her misery and shower her with unconditional love.
2368991.originName: 七个大佬哥哥独宠落魄小妹

2369106.title: The Heiress Returns: Get Out! Don't Touch Me!
2369106.description: "The Heiress Returns: Get Out! Don't Touch Me!" tells the story of Su Muxue, who marries into the Gu family for love, only to be betrayed by her husband Gu Yexi and best friend Xu Xiaoman. After suffering a miscarriage, she is also asked by the Su family to divorce and return to take control of the family business. From pain and despair, she struggles to rise, determined to fight back, reinvent herself, and start a new chapter in life amidst the dual whirlpools of family and emotion.
2369106.originName: 千金归来：滚！别碰本小姐

2369249.title: The Ex-Wife's Trap
2369249.description: Jiang Yao's happy life is shattered on her wedding anniversary when her husband, Qin Zimo, and her best friend, Lin Mengqi, betray her. They cause her to lose her unborn child, disfigure her, and attempt to imprison her to steal her family's fortune. Saved by the mysterious Xu Huaian, Jiang Yao returns with a new identity to seek revenge. Her goal is to find the hidden ledgers and expose Qin Zimo’s crimes. However, as Qin Zimo grows suspicious and Xu Huaian’s true identity remains a mystery, Jiang Yao must navigate a web of revenge and hidden truths.

2369355.title: Ex-Wife Returns: Mr. Lu's 99 Proposals
2369355.description: A story of love and hate between Shen Qixia, a wealthy heiress, and Lu Sizhou, a powerful CEO. Shen had loved Lu for ten years. When his family faced bankruptcy, she sacrificed her own family business to save him and insisted on marrying him. However, Lu resented being forced into the marriage. He skipped their wedding and neglected her, leading a heartbroken Shen to flee abroad. Now, she is back.

2369419.title: Imprisoned Love: Mr. Nie, Stop Chasing, Madam Just Wants to Escape
2369419.description:
The story revolves around a wedding that appears blissful on the surface but harbors hidden dangers. Shen Yue, the heiress of a wealthy family, is determined to marry Nie Jingchen in a desperate bid to win him back. Yet Nie Jingchen coldly rejects her, even bluntly declaring that he never promised to marry her. To make matters worse, he reveals that Shen Yue’s fiancée—his childhood sweetheart, Manman—chose to take her own life because of Shen Yue’s interference and remains in a coma, fighting for her life in the hospital. Faced with his accusations and mockery, Shen Yue is left speechless, forced to endure it all in silence.

At the wedding venue, Nie Jingchen’s assistants heap scorn upon her, dismissing her as a “desperate” woman and seeking to humiliate her. Furious yet helpless, Shen Yue struggles to escape this maelstrom of lies and betrayal. But Nie Jingchen presses ever closer, showing no sign of letting her go. What lies at the heart of their tangled relationship? Is Shen Yue truly, as Nie Jingchen claims, the root cause of this tragedy? And why does he harbor such deep‑rooted hatred for her?

With its tense, gripping plot and intricate web of emotions, this short drama explores the interplay of love and revenge, weaving a tale of passion, resentment, and redemption. Shen Yue’s struggle and defiance, Nie Jingchen’s icy indifference and obsessive fixation, and the truths lurking beneath the surface will deliver an emotionally charged storm that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. The story’s central appeal lies in how a misunderstood love spirals toward ruin, and how two souls must choose between hatred and salvation.
2369419.originName: 囚爱罪妻：聂总别追了，夫人只想逃

2369524.title: Middle-Aged and In Love: The Ice Queen CEO Falls for Me at First Sight
2369524.description: Wen Xu, a lawyer from Beicheng, travels to Hong Kong to heal from a career setback. There, she meets Zhou Lie, a guesthouse owner, and they agree to a three-month fling, only to fall deeply in love. When Wen Xu returns home early to help a friend, Zhou Lie follows her north to protect her. Together, they overcome long distance, workplace drama, and family pressure. In a twist of fate involving a passionate night with a female CEO at a bar and the return of a first love after three years, he decides to win them both over and turn a chance encounter into a lifelong romance.
2369524.originName: 人到中年，冰山总裁对我一见钟情

2369643.title: If Love Has an End
2369643.description: As the only daughter of the Wen Group, Wen Bai has loved her childhood sweetheart, Pei Liyan, since she was young. For him, she became an air traffic controller at Pei Liyan's airline. Her persistent pursuit, however, pushed Pei Liyan further away. Her extreme tactics led to him breaking up with his girlfriends, causing Pei Liyan to resent Wen Bai's extreme control and possessiveness, making him distance himself even more. Later, Pei Liyan accepted an arranged business marriage from his family and rejected Wen Bai's confession. The two even regressed to the point of being strangers, where even a greeting at the company was a luxury. Wen Bai initially believed Pei Liyan had never loved her, but a piece of gossip revealed a photo of Pei Liyan secretly kissing her. She confronted him, only to receive an even more heartbreaking answer. Finally, at his engagement ceremony with someone else, she chose to let go.

2369769.title: If You Are Willing to Wake Up
2369769.description: Years ago, Gu Qingqian was kidnapped due to her brother Gu Jing's mistake and sold. To save his daughter Jian Xiaoyao through a blood transfusion treatment, Jian Yuanming bought Qingqian and brought her back. For 18 years, Qingqian endured Xiaoyao's abuse while longing for her family. Now a powerful CEO, Gu Jing comes to find his sister, but Xiaoyao steals her identity. Just as Gu Jing is about to sacrifice Qingqian's life to save the imposter, he discovers the truth and rescues his real sister.

2369898.title: My Flash Marriage Wife is a Boss
2369898.description: Xia Ruoruo, the eldest daughter of the Xia family in the capital, enters a flash marriage with Yan Jue, the young master of the Yan family, to investigate her mother's death. After returning from abroad, she is immediately forced by her father to marry Yan Jue. This plays right into her hands, as her secret investigation reveals that her mother's passing is closely linked to Yan Jue's father. She hopes to use this marriage to enter the Yan family and uncover the truth.

2369980.title: The Regent's Hidden Love
2369980.description: Su Wanwan was offered to the powerful Regent Fu Xiao by her father. To avoid scandal, Fu Xiao adopted her instead. He tried to win her heart, but his overbearing nature and the Crown Prince's schemes led her to hate him. Even after discovering the Prince was using her, Su Wanwan still chose to sacrifice everything for the Prince.

2370100.title: Betrayed and Targeted: The Scholar's Secret Wife
2370100.description: In the late Qing Dynasty, Princess Yun Jing was abandoned by her husband, Shen Yifu, on their wedding night and died of grief six months later. She is reborn ten years later as a young woman named Lin Yunzhi. Determined to control her own fate, she moves to Shanghai for school, only to cross paths with Shen Yifu again, who is now a university supervisor. Suspicious of her familiar behavior, Shen begins to test her identity. Meanwhile, Yunzhi is drawn into the Lin family's dark secrets: her brother’s oil research is being hunted by rivals, and her sister’s mysterious death hides a shocking truth.
2370100.originName: 身为国士家属的我却被疯狂针对

2370247.title: The Tycoon Beggar Son-in-Law
2370247.description: Qin Chuan, the Godfather of Black Gold, was framed and expelled by the elder branch of the Qin family. He ended up in Haicheng, becoming a live-in son-in-law for the Su family. While being scorned and ridiculed by the Su family, he secretly investigated the truth of what happened years ago. Once the truth was uncovered, the Godfather of Black Gold made a powerful return to the Qin family, reclaiming his position as head of the family.

2370332.title: The Abandoned Healer: Peerless and Unmatched
2370332.description: Ye Wushuang, a concubine's daughter abandoned by her family, accidentally gains an ancient medical scripture. Five years later, she returns as a peerless divine doctor, saving lives with silver needles while seeking revenge with deadly toxins. As her cruel father begs for medicine and princes offer their kingdoms to marry her, she places her hand on the pulse of a rival war god. 'To cure you, Your Highness, we need the blood of my enemies,' she smiles coldly. Behind her, the man who slaughtered her clan is now her shackled slave. Meanwhile, Qi Tian, a fallen immortal cast down from heaven, finds himself entangled in this massive conspiracy.

2370421.title: Did Mr. Shen Take the Bait Today?
2370421.description: Lin Xiaolu uses all her charms to set a sweet trap, while Shen Mo's biggest daily headache is whether he should finally take the bait. A hilarious office romance of cat-and-mouse unfolds. Meanwhile, a mysterious diary predicts the future. The protagonist follows its prophecies, only to find a deeper mystery. Ten years after being framed and exiled, Shen Qingtang, the daughter of a general, returns to the capital as a merchant. While running a rouge shop, she secretly investigates her family's massacre, crossing paths with the investigator Pei Jingchen.

2370536.title: The Prosperous Age as You Wished
2370536.description: Song Jinxi, a 21st-century botanist who developed super rice, travels back in time after dying from overwork. She awakens in the body of her namesake during a severe three-year drought in the Great Chu Dynasty. Her stepmother tries to sell her to an old wealthy man for five bushels of rice to act as a 'luck-bringer' bride. Caught between her memories as a modern scientist and the harsh reality of famine, Jinxi struggles to survive as her past and present collide.

2370606.title: The Double-Faced Housewife
2370606.description: Housewife Ni Jia is forcibly committed to a mental asylum after witnessing her husband, Zhou Xubai, push her father off a cliff. By feigning illness and hiding her true intentions, she gathers evidence to expose his crimes. Engaging in a dangerous battle of wits, she eventually uncovers the truth with the help of the real Zhou Xubai.

2370731.title: Regret After Her Fake Death
2370731.description: Jiang Nianjin was married to Mu Ke, the commander of the Imperial Guards, for six years. Her devotion was taken for granted by Mu Ke and his mother. After six years of unrequited love, Mu Ke bluntly told her he didn't love her. Suffering from a terminal brain illness and emotional exhaustion, Jiang Nianjin requested a divorce. After she left, Mu Ke realized he couldn't live without her and understood how his selfishness drove her away. However, just as he realized his feelings, he received news of her death...

2370876.title: President Song, She’s the Real Miss Yan!
2370876.description: Twin sisters Yan Chu and Yan Xiao were abandoned as children and struggled to survive. The elder sister, Yan Chu, went to prison after saving a wealthy heir named Song Xun, while her younger sister, Yan Xiao, stole her identity to live a life of luxury. Years later, Yan Xiao falls mysteriously ill, and Song Xun finds Yan Chu to save her. Misled by Yan Xiao’s lies, Song Xun treats Yan Chu cruelly, only to realize the truth when it’s too late. Ultimately, Yan Chu leaves for good, and a vengeful Song Xun is imprisoned for five years after attempting to kill Yan Xiao.
2370876.originName: 宋总，她才是你要找的颜小姐！

2371001.title: Mr. Su! Your Wife Wants a Divorce
2371001.description: The story revolves around the marital crisis between Mr. Su and his wife. It depicts their journey from deep misunderstandings to gradual understanding, and finally to the difficult decision of divorce. Interspersed with family disputes, emotional entanglements, and personal growth, the drama showcases the complex emotions and realistic challenges in modern marriage, making it captivating.

2371098.title: Stop Working So Hard, Madam: Your Husband is the Richest Man
2371098.description: Five years later, to save an orphanage from demolition, Shen Wu deals with real estate tycoons only to reunite with He Yanxiu, now the richest man in Yun City. Driven by past resentment, He Yanxiu forces her into a "24-hour personal assistant" contract, keeping her trapped by his side. However, her resilience slowly turns his hatred into love. When the truth behind their past breakup is revealed, He Yanxiu is overcome with regret. Breaking free from family constraints, he begins a desperate journey to win her back and make amends.
2371098.originName: 太太别卷了，你老公是首富

2371179.title: The Mute Scapegoat Wife: The Prince Fails to Recognize His Love
2371179.description: After her family was ruined and her love was rejected by Qi Jingyue, Zhu Nanxi’s mind became twisted. She bribed a doctor to swap her face with Sang Zhi’s and poisoned Sang Zhi mute, stealing her identity. Just as Sang Zhi was near death, the Emperor ordered the 'disgraced daughter' Zhu Nanxi to marry Qi Jingyue. Sang Zhi married him wearing Zhu Nanxi’s face, but Qi Jingyue failed to recognize her and hurt her repeatedly. Meanwhile, Wu Shuangping, after divorcing due to domestic violence, raised two daughters alone, going from a workshop director to unemployed, before eventually heading south to start her own business.
2371179.originName: 替罪哑妻：王爷不识心上人

2371261.title: Genius Baby the Matchmaker
2371261.description: Qiao Shiwan, an orphan, marries Cheng Zehui, the grandson of a wealthy tycoon, and receives 10% of the company's shares as a gift. Cheng Zehui marries her only to get the shares and eventually abandons her, causing her to be separated from her son. Their son is adopted by lawyer He Yanchen and renamed Keno. Using his high intelligence, Keno tries to find his mother while playing matchmaker for He Yanchen, creating romantic encounters for them.

2371315.title: The War God's Wrath
2371315.description: The story follows Xiao Tian Ce, the God of War from the Northern Realm, who rushes back to Jiangcheng to save his critically ill mother. However, he discovers that his uncle, Qin De, is constantly making things difficult for and bullying his sister, Xiao Qing, even going so far as to try and sell her off to pay debts. Enraged, the God of War retaliates with his immense power and prestige to protect his family.

2371446.title: Supreme Commander: No Mercy
2371446.description:
“The Supreme Sovereign of Tian Ce” tells the story of Qin Tian, a loyal general who, three years ago, was forced to abandon his wedding to his fiancée, Wang Muxue, in order to defend the nation’s borders. Unbeknownst to him, while he was away on campaign, the Wang family, driven by greed, poured all their resources into a new venture, recklessly endangering Muxue’s life. When Qin Tian triumphantly returns, he finds Muxue clinging to life, only to discover that the mastermind behind it all is a conspiracy hatched within the Wang household itself. Consumed by rage and grief, Qin Tian resolves to stand his ground no longer. He leads the Tian Ce Army into Longcheng, establishes the Tian Ce Group, and wields an iron fist to bring the Wang family to heel, vowing to expose every villain and deliver justice for Muxue.

At its core, the narrative revolves around power, betrayal, and love. Qin Tian transforms from a devoted patriot into a cold‑blooded avenger; his metamorphosis is not merely personal but a quest to uphold justice and dignity. Meanwhile, Wang Muxue, sacrificed to her family’s ambitions, becomes the linchpin of the plot. The series blends thrilling military clashes with intricate psychological struggles, all while probing deeply into themes of kinship, romance, and duty. As Qin Tian pieces together the truth step by step, audiences will witness a man rise from ruin, reshaping his destiny with wisdom and strength, and ultimately achieving both personal redemption and his family’s resurgence.

2371514.title: Metamorphosis
2371514.description: An Yansi grew up in an orphanage and works as a delivery rider, but she hides a secret identity as Maria, a world-class fashion designer. After reuniting with her grandfather, she discovers she is the true heiress to Jiangdu's wealthiest family. Joining the family group as an intern, she faces bullying from colleagues. Meanwhile, she resists an arranged marriage with the Yan family because she still misses her childhood friend. In another twist, Lu Zheying, a brilliant but poor painter, is being mistreated by her stepmother and brother, facing a forced marriage to an old man in a month.

2371608.title: Late Return with the Stars
2371608.description: Jiang Wanxing and Gu Huaian have been in a long-distance relationship for four years. To protect the pride of her poor boyfriend, Wanxing hid her identity as a wealthy heiress, claiming she was studying abroad on loans. She believed in their love until she returned home for a class reunion, only to find Huaian holding hands with Jiang Yueyan. Yueyan, the family's adopted daughter, has been posing as the true heiress for profit. At the party, Yueyan and her classmates try to humiliate Wanxing, but Wanxing calls her three powerful brothers to reveal the truth and take her revenge.

2371744.title: Hearts Toward the Evening Star
2371744.description: After dying in a fire, Gu Wanwan is reborn into the past with her memories intact. Determined to change her fate, she sheds her weak persona to take revenge on her cruel sister and hypocritical relatives. As she uncovers dark family secrets, she fights to reclaim what is hers and protect those who truly care for her.

2371817.title: Five Years of Secret Research! Top Scientist's Identity Exposed by a Superstar!
2371817.description: Lin Chao, a top scientist who spent five years in secrecy developing the 'Quantum Lithography Machine,' is pushed by a superstar’s bodyguard at the airport. After facing online bullying from her fans, his true identity as a national hero is finally revealed, earning him the respect of the entire nation.
2371817.originName: 为国科研五年！国士身份被大明星曝光！

2371930.title: The CEO's Hidden Regret
2371930.description: This drama tells the story of Gu Xining's emotional entanglement with Jin Beichuan and Yu Nanchuan. Gu Xining loved Jin Beichuan for ten years, but had to go abroad after her family went bankrupt. Upon returning, she faces the dual crises of Jin Beichuan's impending marriage and her mother's serious illness. She gets engaged to Yu Nanchuan, but on their engagement day, Jin Beichuan crashes the event and tries to 'steal' her. The three characters' relationships are repeatedly pulled between the pressures of reality and past memories, showcasing the complexity of choices in love.

2372077.title: My Imperial Guard Officer
2372077.description: Set in a fictional ancient world, the story follows Shangguan Zhiluo, who grew up in an orphanage until she was adopted by the Shangguan family at twelve. At seventeen, she marries Pei Junze, the commander of the Imperial Guard. Three years into their marriage, their relationship is cold, and the constant harassment from Pei's mother escalates family conflicts. During Pei Junze's tour of duty, he is injured, and female constable Jiang Xuanyan's excessive concern sparks an emotional crisis. Later, Jiang Xuanyan steals Shangguan Zhiluo's jade pendant and impersonates a princess, using her new identity to force a divorce and orchestrate the Shangguan family's destruction by the imperial court. After Shangguan Zhiluo witnesses Pei Junze leading the troops to wipe out her family, the fates of the three become entangled in a love triangle of abuse and identity reversals.

2372159.title: My Beautiful CEO Wife
2372159.description: Xu Ping'an sacrificed everything for the Lin family, even taking the blame for all the mistakes of his brother-in-law, Lin Xiaobei, and enduring imprisonment. However, this misfortune turned into a blessing, as he became the sole disciple of a legendary old man. The moment he regained his freedom, he vowed to help his wife, Lin Qingyu, reach the pinnacle of the business world. But upon returning home, he was met with accusations and insults from his mother-in-law and brother-in-law. His wife even asked him to sign divorce papers. Hearing that Hu Shuo, who had always pursued Lin Qingyu, had joined the company, Xu Ping'an was heartbroken and disappointed, signing the divorce agreement. His adoptive mother's dying wish constantly echoed in his ears, so he had to follow her will and work at Lin Qingyu's company. Hu Shuo would stop at nothing to get Lin Qingyu, and Lin Qingyu's best friend, Tao Mengmeng, disparaged Xu Ping'an at every turn. However, Xu Ping'an, relying on his own abilities and connections, repeatedly turned danger into safety. In the end, Lin Qingyu saw the truth and was filled with regret.

2372280.title: Accidental Love with the CEO
2372280.description: A contract marriage leads to real love, but a ruthless pursuer stands in the way. When his secret identity as a sovereign king is revealed, can he win her heart and face the upcoming challenges? Meanwhile, Gu Qinghan, an ancient master of relic restoration, travels to the modern era as a despised daughter. Facing family scorn and a market full of fakes, she uses her elite skills to turn the tide, winning respect and unexpected romance. Can she protect her heritage and solve the mystery of her birth? Elsewhere, Lin Xiaohua spends three years posing as the girlfriend of Yan Chen, the crown prince of Beijing's elite circle, for 30 million. After facing kidnappings and dangers, she finally disappears as planned.

2372330.title: Marriage First, Love Later, Mr. Gu, Don't Be Tsundere
2372330.description: Xia Nuan's father is critically ill, and her stepmother controls the company. Xia Nuan desperately needs to secure an investment opportunity for her boyfriend and reclaim the Xia Group. Gu Jingze, CEO of the Gu Group, has had three girlfriends, two of whom died and one was injured, leading to him being labeled a 'wife-killer'. He now needs a woman for a marriage of convenience to appease his uncles. Thus, Xia Nuan and Gu Jingze sign an agreement to be nominal husband and wife for one year. Heartbroken after signing, Xia Nuan plans to seek comfort from her boyfriend, only to catch him cheating with his lover, Su Niannian. Devastated, Xia Nuan breaks up with him. However, the agreement is signed and cannot be revoked. For the sake of the Xia Group, Xia Nuan decides to proceed with the marriage contract. Due to Gu Jingze's 'wife-killer' reputation, Xia Nuan's married life begins with 'perilous challenges'. Initially, Gu Jingze has a poor impression of Xia Nuan, believing her to be promiscuous. But through their interactions, Xia Nuan and Gu Jingze gradually fall in love.

2372468.title: The Unfettered Divine Healer in the City
2372468.description: Three years ago, Ling Han was forced into a divorce by the arrogant Ye Chuchu. At his mother's plea, the Ye family agreed to a duel: if Ling Han wins, the engagement stands; if he loses, he becomes their slave. After training under the Jiuxiao Sect for three years, Ling Han returns to fulfill his promise. He meets his fated love and begins his legendary journey in the modern city.

2372617.title: Caged Heart
2372617.description: Ye Nanqi was Zhao Fanyi's fiancée, but his family treated her as a human 'blood bag' for another woman, Xu Peishan. They even forged a medical report claiming she had terminal cancer to keep exploiting her. Despite the diagnosis, Zhao Fanyi still forced her to donate blood. Heartbroken, Nanqi broke up with him. Later, Fu Zhenting, a wealthy tycoon, discovered she was his long-lost daughter. With her true identity revealed, Nanqi escapes the abuse and begins a new life of power and justice.

2372752.title: Supreme Dominance
2372752.description: Five years ago, Jiang Bei was framed and imprisoned before ending up in the North. After five years of hardship, he emerged as the leader of the powerful Tiance Organization. Returning to Qingzhou with the declaration that all power lies in his hands, he faces family doubts and business conspiracies. Using his wit and strength, he uncovers the truth and vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him.

2372820.title: Asura Mad God
2372820.description:
“The Frenzied God of Asura” is a fiery fantasy drama brimming with political intrigue and vengeance. The story centers on the protagonist, Xiao Xiu, who was born with extraordinary talent but was forced to wander among the common folk after his family was brutally wiped out. Five years earlier, his mother, in order to protect her family’s secrets, was driven to the brink by an evil force and died in agony, leaving behind only a wisp of wolf‑sign smoke as her sole clue. Determined to avenge his mother and his clan, Xiao Xiu vows to reclaim the glory that is rightfully his.

Five years later, biding his time in the shadows, Xiao Xiu finally seizes his chance for retribution. By then, the Dragon‑God Clan, which rules the capital, is beset by troubles both within and without: internally, factions scheme against one another, while externally, old enemies have returned, intent on annihilating the clan once and for all. Taking advantage of the chaos, Xiao Xiu rises with a cool head and formidable strength, stirring up storms as he gradually uncovers the truth behind the massacre and engages those who betrayed his family in a heart‑pounding showdown.

The series’ highlights lie in how Xiao Xiu transforms from an obscure youth into the awe‑inspiring “Frenzied God of Asura,” and in the wisdom and courage he displays throughout his quest for revenge. At the same time, the intricate web of familial grudges, power struggles, and emotional entanglements lends the narrative a rich dramatic tension. As layer upon layer of mysteries are unveiled, audiences will bear witness to an epic clash of love and hatred, life and death, and choices that define destiny.

2372888.title: Xuan Tian War God
2372888.description:
“The Divine War God” unfolds in a fantastical world brimming with political intrigue and emotional entanglements. The story centers on Mu Zichen, the most beautiful woman of the Mu clan—radiant and brilliant yet plagued by misfortune. She is coveted by the ambitious Peng Cheng, who abducts her by force. Peng Cheng is a ruthless bully from the Xuantian Sect, driven by an unyielding thirst for power and desire, and to him, Mu Zichen is the perfect prey. Meanwhile, her husband, Mu Zichen, may appear weak and ineffectual, but he harbors untold strength and wisdom. Faced with his wife’s peril, he awakens from his initial passivity and resolves to protect his family in his own way.

At the heart of the conflict lies Peng Cheng’s bid to claim Mu Zichen and Mu Zichen’s counter‑attack, alongside the intricate power struggles within the Xuantian Sect. As the plot thickens, Mu Zichen’s true identity is gradually revealed: he not only commands formidable martial prowess but also bears the sacred duty of safeguarding his family and upholding justice. Meanwhile, Mu Zichen demonstrates unwavering resilience and shrewd resourcefulness in the face of adversity, becoming a pivotal force in driving the narrative forward. The series is packed with pulse‑pounding action, gripping emotional twists, and profound reflections on loyalty, courage, and self‑growth, leaving audiences utterly captivated.

2372981.title: The Wrong Brother’s Bed
2372981.description: Yu Man, Jiang Wenzhou, and Jiang Yelin have known each other since childhood. Yu Man has loved Jiang Wenzhou for years, even traveling thousands of miles to the capital for him. However, on the day of her arrival, she learns that Jiang Wenzhou was killed by his own brother, Jiang Yelin. Yu Man disguises herself as the fiancée of Jiang Yelin's arch-rival, Dong Shujie, and is brought into Jiang Yelin's mansion as a concubine. Jiang Yelin gradually becomes infatuated with the woman before him, yet he feels that Yu Man is always looking at someone else through him.

2373073.title: A Kiss to Remember
2373073.description: Bai Mantang, a girl with terrible luck, must marry before age 24 to inherit her grandfather's guesthouse. One night, while drunk, she is saved from a car accident by CEO Wen Chiyu, and they share an accidental kiss. To save the guesthouse, she mistakes him for a repairman and proposes a contract marriage.

2373158.title: The Medical Consort's Rise
2373158.description: The eldest daughter of the General's Mansion was born with a divine destiny, but her life was ruined by a cruel stepmother after her mother died and her father went to war. Drugged into idiocy and abused to death, she is reborn with her medical skills and sharp wit. Abandoning her former love for her fiancé Jiang Chengan, she seeks revenge, finds true love with the male lead, and uncovers the dark conspiracy behind her mother's mysterious death.

2373234.title: Love Threads: The Emperor's Secret Heart
2373234.description: Su Zhiqing accidentally transmigrates into a novel as a minor character, Lu Yuanyuan. After spending a night with the lead, Chu Shiyuan, she loses her memory and mistakenly believes he is a eunuch. Amused by the misunderstanding, Chu Shiyuan protects her and helps her defeat her enemies. When she is framed and faces execution, Chu Shiyuan reveals his true identity as the Emperor. He punishes the villains and spoils Su Zhiqing, transforming her from a side character into his most precious treasure.

2373346.title: I’m Done Being the Princess
2373346.description: Shen Jianxin, the daughter of a general and Princess Consort of Prince Jing, is neglected by her husband Xiao Jinglan. On her birthday, servants steal her gifts and mock her openly. When Xiao Jinglan returns from war after three years, he brings back a woman named Wanning, lets her stay in the main courtyard, and even gives her the gift intended for Shen. He further allows Wanning to provoke and burn Shen, pushing her to her breaking point.

2373480.title: Real vs. Fake Moonlight: CEO Fu, You've Loved the Wrong Person
2373480.description: “The Real and the Fake White Moonlight: Mr. Fu, You’ve Loved the Wrong Person” is a contemporary romantic drama brimming with emotional entanglements and suspenseful tension. The story centers on the female protagonist, Xiao Ran, once the wife of tycoon and CEO Fu Yichen. Four years of marriage plunged her into a complex web of feelings. Yet, when she chooses to walk away and flee to a distant land, she unexpectedly discovers that her husband still harbors deep affection for another woman—Qiao Qing. At the same time, Xiao Ran learns she is carrying Fu Yichen’s child, leaving her torn between two paths. Meanwhile, the mysterious Xuan Weiyi upends the status quo, her past with Fu Yichen shrouded in secrets. A sudden kidnapping binds the three of them together, as long-buried truths begin to surface. Confronted with betrayal, deception, and difficult choices, Xiao Ran must make a final decision between love and dignity. And Fu Yichen finally realizes whom he truly holds dear. Beyond its gripping plot twists, the series explores themes of loyalty and self‑redemption in love, leaving viewers both reflective and deeply moved.
2373480.originName: 真假白月光：傅总你爱错人了

2373563.title: Shocking: The Target of Online Outcry Is Actually a National Hero
2373563.description: Yun Jing, a princess of the late Qing Dynasty, was abandoned by her husband Shen Yifu on their wedding night and died of grief six months later. She is reborn ten years later as Lin Yunzhi, a young girl in the Republic of China era. Determined to control her own fate, she travels to Shanghai to study, only to reunite with Shen Yifu, who is now a university supervisor. Shen becomes suspicious as Yunzhi’s behavior deeply resembles his late wife. Meanwhile, Yunzhi is caught in the Lin family's turmoil: her brother’s oil research is targeted by rivals, and the truth behind her sister’s death remains a mystery.
2373563.originName: 震惊，网爆对象竟是国士大人

2373646.title: Finally Found You
2373646.description: Siblings Chen Yao and Chen Pan'an were orphans raised by their adoptive father, Chen Yong. Their lives were hard but they relied on each other. Chen Yong sold Pan'an, but Chen Yao managed to escape. Fifteen years later, Chen Yao is working at a KTV under the name Lin Yinuo, while Pan'an has become Fu Qiancheng, the CEO of Fu Group. While celebrating her birthday, Yinuo is drugged by a scoundrel and nearly raped, but Qiancheng arrives just in time to save her. After a series of crises, the two finally recognize each other and reunite.

2373698.title: Reborn: The Crown Princess Runs Away
2373698.description: "In my next life, I'd rather be a plant than meet you!" A young girl's first love led to her family's execution. Ordinary office worker Wang Cuihua unexpectedly travels into a brainless novel as the cannon-fodder villainess, Yu Wanyin. To avoid her fate of being killed by the original female lead, she decides to seek protection from the big villain, the tyrant Xiahou Dan. Little does she know, the tyrant is also a transmigrator.

2373828.title: The CEO's Multi-Talented Wife
2373828.description: Shen Zhenzhu and Xu Zhixing were childhood friends in an orphanage. Years later, Zhixing, now the heir to a wealthy family, seeks to marry Zhenzhu to repay her kindness. However, due to a name swap between Zhenzhu and her sister Shen Du, Zhixing proposes to the wrong person. The real Zhenzhu, now a struggling genius painter named Lu Zheying, suffers abuse from her stepfamily and is forced to marry an elderly man as his ninth concubine in a month.

2373949.title: My Wild CEO Wife
2373949.description: Shen Qinghuan's father, manipulated by her stepmother, tries to force her to marry an older man under the guise of saving the family business. In reality, the stepmother wants to seize the company left by Shen's late mother. On her wedding day, Shen Qinghuan escapes and encounters Fu Yuancheng, a man with disabled legs who was her patient five years ago when she was an intern. She stays by his side through his darkest times. (The story also follows Lu Zheying, a talented but poor painter bullied by her stepfamily and forced to marry an old official as his ninth wife.)

2374076.title: Saying I Love You for the Last Time
2374076.description: Lu Zheying, a gifted but poor painter, is bullied by her stepmother and stepbrother, and is forced to marry an old official in a month. To change her fate, she disguises herself as a frail noblewoman to seduce Lin Mo, the youngest son of the influential Lin family, hoping to use his power to enter the Imperial Art Academy. However, she draws the scorn of Lin Mo’s powerful elder brother, Nangong Yi, who sees her as a social climber. While facing constant bullying from a real princess, Zheying executes a complex plan to win Lin Mo over. But a twist of fate binds her to Nangong Yi through a magical 'Seven Emotions' love curse.

2374158.title: The Fallen Queen is Dead, the Emperor Kneels Till Dawn
2374158.description: Princess Wen Yueyan helped Xia Houyuan seize the throne, only to be betrayed by his suspicion after he became Emperor. While she was weak from childbirth, he indulged with others and later banished her to a lonely temple based on a concubine's lies, leading to her death. Reborn as the maid Wen Shuangshuang, she returns to the palace for revenge. Haunted by regret, the Emperor treats her as a substitute for his late wife, slowly realizing that the woman he wronged has returned.
2374158.originName: 罪后已死，陛下跪到天亮

2374218.title: After the Guilty Wife is Released: CEO Shen Kneels for Reconciliation
2374218.description: Three years ago, a sudden tragedy cast a shadow over the love between Shen Jinnian and Song Yuwan. Accused of murdering Shen Jinnian’s fiancée, Nuanyang, Song Yuwan was sent to prison. Now, having served her sentence, she returns to the Shen family with hope, determined to clear her name and reclaim her happiness. Yet what greets her is Shen Jinnian’s coldness and blame. He not only refuses to believe in her innocence but also threatens the lives of her family, forcing her to kneel before Nuanyang’s memorial and confess to a crime she did not commit. Faced with the betrayal of her once‑beloved and the harshness of reality, Song Yuwan plunges into despair—yet she secretly resolves to uncover the truth and vindicate herself. Meanwhile, behind Shen Jinnian’s seemingly ruthless exterior lies a secret no one knows. As their entangled fates unfold, a tale of love, revenge, and redemption slowly takes shape. The story’s highlights lie in how Song Yuwan clings to her integrity and unravels the truth against all odds, why Shen Jinnian remains so fixated on the past, and whether their bond can reignite amid countless trials. With its suspense‑filled twists and intricate web of relationships, the narrative promises viewers a gripping emotional battle.
2374218.originName: 罪妻出狱后：沈总下跪求复合

2374287.title: The Return of the Hidden Heiress: Madam Shocks the City
2374287.description: Shen Suihuan dropped out of school to marry Gu Nanhua for love, only to find her marriage a living nightmare. Treated as a replacement and a family 'blood bank,' she decides to escape after getting pregnant. Facing Gu's constant obstruction and endless misunderstandings, she struggles for her dignity. When she finally finds the courage to leave, the news of her pregnancy drags her into a deeper whirlpool. A battle for love, pride, and freedom begins.
2374287.originName: 携宝归来后，夫人她惊艳全城

2374358.title: Love So Deep, Until We're Old and Gray
2374358.description: At eighteen, Fu Beixing moved next door to Xu Nuo. Fu Beixing's excellent grades and charming personality constantly attracted Xu Nuo, who gradually fell for him. However, Liu Yue's repeated interventions made Xu Nuo mistakenly believe that Fu Beixing had always loved Liu Yue. Just as Xu Nuo was about to give up, Fu's father unexpectedly passed away, and Fu's family airline, Nanmu Aviation, was on the verge of bankruptcy. Liu Yue went abroad, avoiding Fu Beixing. Under the matchmaking of Xu's father and Fu's mother, Fu Beixing and Xu Nuo entered into a commercial marriage. Xu Nuo was full of joy and anticipation for her married life with Fu Beixing, but unexpectedly, Fu Beixing used a prenuptial agreement to demand that Xu Nuo not disclose their relationship to outsiders. Xu Nuo didn't know why, but still agreed to Fu Beixing's request. Thus, the two began a three-year hidden marriage. During these three years together, Fu Beixing gradually softened towards their relationship. On their wedding anniversary, Xu Nuo suggested to Fu Beixing that they make their relationship public. Fu Beixing refused unhappily, but unexpectedly, the two...

2374411.title: Love at the Dead End
2374411.description: Li Molan, a playboy who loves "tending flowers," falls into a trap set by Chen Xi, who uses "Empathy Flowers" to manipulate his emotions. To protect her, he leaves his rose garden to join the Li Group. Chen Xi fakes her death to help him, leading Li Molan to realize his true feelings. Meanwhile, Shen Yanqiu flees after a night with He Jingxing. Seven years later, she returns with quadruplets to seek revenge at the He Group. Her genius children are now planning to take over their "scumbag" father’s company.

2374510.title: The Unreachable End of Love
2374510.description: This drama tells the story of Xia Wange, whose younger brother is critically ill, and she scrambles to raise money for his surgery. Su Jinchen, after misunderstanding Xia Wange, went abroad. Now, he reunites with her in a nightclub while looking for a girl, leading to further misunderstandings. Xia Wange is in financial distress, and Su Jinchen surprisingly offers to marry her for thirty million. The two are entangled in numerous misunderstandings and a complex relationship, colliding between love and reality.

2374659.title: Dorohedoro Season1
2374659.description:
Hole—a decaying, lawless slum where the strong devour the weak and death is routine—lives up to its name. Cut off from law and morality, it serves as a playground for magic users, who reign at the top of the hierarchy. To them, the residents of Hole are nothing more than expendable test subjects—killed, disfigured, and experimented on without hesitation, their bodies filling the hospital day after day.

With unrestricted access to this hellish place and little opposition to their power, magic users seem nearly untouchable—except to a rare few. One of them is Caiman, a man with a reptile’s head. Armed with a pair of bayonets and immune to magic, he relentlessly hunts magic users in search of the truth behind his curse and lost memories. Haunted by nightmares and driven by instinct, he fights to reclaim his former self.

At his side is Nikaidou, owner of the Hungry Bug, whose support—and cooking—keeps him going as he carves his path through chaos.

2374804.title: Swimming Through the Sea of Love
2374804.description: Liu Zhongyan, the son of the capital's top lawyer, is a witty and rebellious genius who prefers helping the poor over following his father's shadow. Though his father arranges a marriage with the city's most beautiful woman, Chu Jun, Zhongyan has no interest in her. Instead, he finds himself in a secret, fiery romance with the rebellious Princess Xiaorou after a rocky first meeting. As their love unfolds, court secrets threaten to change everything.

2374974.title: Sailing Away With You
2374974.description: Lin Qing worked part-time for four years to build a future with her boyfriend Gu Feng, only to be betrayed by him and her best friend. Decisively dumping the cheater and reclaiming her home, she focuses on her career. Unexpectedly, she enters a flash marriage with Ye Rongtian, a pilot for Qinglan Airlines. While her father-in-law spoils her, Ye Rongtian also falls for her through their daily interactions, protecting her time and again.

2375035.title: Missing You When the Clouds Rise
2375035.description: To save her sick grandmother, Jiang Nian enters a flash marriage agreement with Cheng Yunchuan, but he disappears right before the wedding. For three years, Jiang Nian devotedly cares for her mother-in-law. When she applies for a job at a top law firm and is bullied by an old classmate, Cheng Yunchuan suddenly reappears as the firm's partner and hires her as his assistant. As they work together, feelings grow, but their secret marriage leads to a complicated emotional struggle.

2375146.title: Finding You After the Storm
2375146.description: Xu Nuo, an airline doctor, has been secretly in love with Captain Zhan Jinnian for ten years and transfers to Ansheng Airlines just for him. On the eve of her first day, Zhan Jinnian is involved in a flight accident. Xu Nuo breaks the rules by borrowing the identity of flight attendant Gu Qiaoqiao to go search for him. After saving him alone in a remote wilderness, Zhan Jinnian promises to make her his fiancée.

2375292.title: Loving the Right Wife
2375292.description: To pay for her children's medical bills, Li Xiuying borrowed money from her entire village. Her selfish daughter, Ye Sangsang, pushed her own brother off a cliff just to steal his chance for treatment. Despite the hardship, Li Xiuying raised Sangsang and sent her to college, only for her ungrateful daughter to be ashamed of her and ban her from attending her wedding.

2375422.title: Only Her Light Remains
2375422.description: Lin Ke, a single mother, was mistreated by her son, Lin Chengfeng, after she tried to stop him from marrying a manipulative pregnant woman. Reborn and back at the beginning, Lin Ke chooses to cut ties with him. Lin Chengfeng gets his wish to be with the woman, only to end up losing everything and living on the streets.

2375494.title: Revenge at Midwinter: I Ruined the Family Feast
2375494.description: On Mid-Autumn Festival, Li Pan'er fled to her parents' home to escape her abusive husband, Liu Qi. There, she discovered her brother, Li Yaozu, had stolen her university spot. Tragically, Pan'er was eventually beaten to death by Liu Qi. Reborn, Pan'er fights through obstacles to reclaim her education. Meanwhile, without a degree, Yaozu is lured by Liu Qi into a fraudulent investment, ending up in massive debt to loan sharks.
2375494.originName: 中秋夜我掀了这桌团圆饭

2375559.title: Restarting Life: A Mother's Strength
2375559.description: During a devastating earthquake, Sheng Hualan loses her memory while saving her daughter. She is rescued by an orphan named Xiao Xiao, and the two live together as mother and daughter for fifteen years. Later, Xiao Xiao joins the Sheng Group through her own merit but faces mistreatment from the Sheng family, who are unaware of her true identity. Inspired by her mother’s resilience, Xiao Xiao proves her worth at work. As she uncovers clues about her past, a complicated reunion between the amnesiac Hualan and her biological family begins to unfold.

2375658.title: Reborn in the 90s: When the Flowers Bloom and the Moon is Full
2375658.description: In her past life, Song Tang's obsession with marrying Gu Zhongye led to her family's ruin and her own tragic death on the streets, all orchestrated by Sun Xiaocheng. Reborn into a rainy night in 1990—the same night she lost her child—Song Tang looks at her dying son, Gu Yuan, and vows not to repeat her mistakes. She finds Gu Zhongye and asks for a divorce, thinking she is setting him free. To her surprise, the cold man she could never win over suddenly changes and refuses to let her go.
2375658.originName: 重生九零：那年花开月正圆

2375732.title: Sunset Love
2375732.description: Li Suxin and Lu Jianhua's meeting is as warm and beautiful as a sunset. They marry for happiness, but their peace is threatened by her ex-husband Zhou Yong and rival Jiang Li. During a job interview at the Lu Group, Suxin is humiliated, unaware that she is actually the CEO's wife. Upon learning of the mistreatment, Lu Jianhua steps in to protect her, revealing her true identity and shocking everyone. However, the villains continue to plot to steal Suxin's property. Can the newlyweds overcome these challenges and secure their future together?

2375836.title: Stars and Winds of Yesternight
2375836.description: Adopted by the Chen family at age five, Ruan Weiwei ends up pregnant after a one-night stand with Fu Yuanshen, the CEO of Fu Group. Neither knows the other's true identity, leaving only a bracelet as a clue to find each other. After a series of misunderstandings and missed connections, Fu Yuanshen finally realizes the truth and begins a desperate journey to win back his wife.

2375934.title: Love Rises with the Wind
2375934.description: Su Wan is a free-spirited photographer who loves capturing life's beauty. Lu Suifeng is a talented music producer who hides a deep past behind his cold exterior. After a misunderstanding brings them together, fate slowly draws them closer to each other.

2376078.title: Married for Years, Strangers Forever
2376078.description: Jiang Tong, the daughter of a wealthy tycoon, loses her baby due to her husband Gu Cheng's revenge over a misunderstanding. After being reborn, she strives to change her destiny.

2376133.title: Sea of Sorrow
2376133.description: After saving his sister Lu Xingyue, Lu Mingfei is framed as the arsonist and forced to break ties with his family. As the patriarch Lu Shenting uncovers the conspiracy and the truth behind the fire, he tries to make amends, only to find a note left by Mingfei on the rooftop: 'Dad, in these eighteen years, have you ever been proud of me for even a second?'

2376204.title: Regret of the Three Brothers After Kicking Me Out
2376204.description: Jiang Zhaozhao, the heiress of the wealthy Wang family, returns to her biological Jiang family only to be despised by her three brothers and framed by their adopted daughter, Jiang Wanyi. After being kicked out, Zhaozhao starts a pastry business in the West Market using her skills. As her business flourishes, she discovers that Wanyi is an impostor. Meanwhile, the Jiang family falls into crisis due to Wanyi’s schemes. Realizing the truth and seeing Zhaozhao’s success, the brothers are filled with regret and desperately seek her forgiveness.
2376204.originName: 被赶出家门后，三个哥哥后悔了

2376309.title: Winter Begonia: The Fire of Truth
2376309.description: Three years ago, a fire broke out in the pear orchard. Huang Jinyun risked his life to save his brother, Jinyun, but his stepmother falsely accused him of starting the fire, causing a rift with his father. After years of struggling in poverty and despair, Jinyun jumped from a city wall to end his life. Only then did his father, Huang Yanchi, realize the immense injustice his son had endured.

2376436.title: Sorry, This Time I'm the Villain
2376436.description: Lin Wan, a kindhearted office newcomer, is forced into a wealthy family's power struggle and must play the role of a 'villain.' Using her wit and courage, she navigates the cutthroat business world to expose conspiracies and protect justice from the shadows.
2376436.originName: 不好意思，这次我要当反派

2376584.title: The Unforgivable Him
2376584.description: In a dimly lit noodle shop, Ai Xiaoyue runs into her ex-husband, who was rumored to be dead. It turns out he faked his death to escape massive debts, only to live a lavish life with a secret mistress. Meanwhile, County Sheriff Su Wuming faces a mysterious series of kidnappings known as the 'Nine-Story Building Case' orchestrated by the elusive Han Tang.

2376686.title: The Light Not Meant for Me
2376686.description: Twenty years ago, Zhao Huirong swapped her baby with the daughter of the wealthy Lyu family. To stay close to her biological daughter, she became a nanny in the Lyu household, treating her own child with love while abusing the true heiress. Twenty years later, the two girls unexpectedly become best friends, just as the shocking truth about their birth begins to surface.

2376786.title: Blossoms of the South
2376786.description: Childhood sweethearts Cheng Xin and Fu Linshen were separated for four years after Fu fled to Dubai on their wedding day. Now, Cheng Xin is a top divorce lawyer, and Fu Linshen has returned as a billionaire. Meeting again over a legal case without recognizing each other, they rediscover their love. Despite misunderstandings and schemes from villains, they eventually resolve their past and find true love again.

2376851.title: The Swallow's Gratitude: Return of the Emperor
2376851.description: During a royal rebellion, Empress Yun sends her infant son away for safety. He is found and raised by a kind-hearted woman who names him Chen An. However, her biological son, Chen Ping, constantly bullies him. At age twenty, Chen An is taken back to the palace. Years later, the mother travels to the capital to seek help from Chen Ping, who has become a top scholar, but he cruelly disowns her. Meanwhile, Chen An, now the Emperor, begins an urgent search for his foster mother to repay her kindness.

2376946.title: Flowers Bloom in Time
2376946.description: Lu Jiacheng and Jiang Fenglin have been married for twenty years. To protect her husband's pride, Fenglin hid her status as a wealthy heiress and worked as a cleaner while secretly supporting his company. However, Jiacheng looks down on her, thinking she is just a useless housewife, and demands a divorce. After discovering he has a new lover, a heartbroken Fenglin agrees to the divorce and returns to her true identity as the powerful heiress of the Lingyun Group.

2377086.title: Country Belle's City Adventure
2377086.description: Luo Xiaoying moves to the city to earn money for her grandmother's surgery. In a twist of fate, she enters a flash marriage with Fu Yanchen, a powerful tycoon. While the Fu family dotes on her, Yanchen also falls for her. Just as Xiaoying achieves success in both her career and love life, Yanchen's 'first love' appears, claiming to be his true soulmate!

2377211.title: When Love Knocks
2377211.description: He Yunzhou's dreams of building a life in Yan City with his girlfriend Liu Ruyan are shattered by her betrayal. Turning his focus to his career, he unexpectedly enters a flash marriage with CEO Lin Ruoxi. While Lin's mother fiercely protects her new son-in-law, Lin Ruoxi herself begins to fall for him. Just as He Yunzhou achieves success in both work and love, an impostor claiming to be Lin's husband emerges. Meanwhile, Lu Zheying, a brilliant but poor painter, is tormented by her stepfamily and faces being forced to marry an old official as his ninth concubine.

2377291.title: Light Me Up, Warm Your Heart
2377291.description: Lin Xia, closed off by childhood trauma, finds her heart melting while working at Gu Chuan’s community cafe through his small gestures like latte art and handwritten notes. Gu Chuan, a former orphan who finds meaning in helping others, joins Lin Xia as they heal each other and face real-world challenges like workplace bullying and family pressure.

2377426.title: Only Children are Kin
2377426.description: A controlling mother forces her daughter, Wen Jiahui, to marry Xu Jie, an abusive man. Jiahui suffers and loses everything, yet her mother still sides with Xu Jie. After her mother’s abuse leads to Jiahui's death, she is reborn. Jiahui decides to break free from her mother’s control and reclaim her life.

2377528.title: Shine Bright, Miss Qiao
2377528.description: Qiao Wanli, the daughter of the richest man, returns from abroad only to catch her boyfriend cheating. In a twist of fate, she enters a flash marriage with Qi Yue, a deliveryman who is secretly the President of the South China Chamber of Commerce. Both hide their true identities and don't believe each other's claims. As they face challenges together, their secrets are revealed and their contract marriage turns into real love.

2377669.title: The Phoenix Returns Home
2377669.description: After the death of the Emperor of the Dayun Dynasty, Princess Yun Zhiyi and Prince Yun Zhiling are betrayed by a corrupt official, leading to the Princess's abduction. Fifteen years later, Zhiling ascends the throne and discovers his sister is still alive. He travels in disguise to find her. Meanwhile, Zhiyi, rescued by a wealthy merchant but suffering from memory loss, is known as Nangong Zhiyi. She is set to marry her childhood friend, He Zhizhou, but he betrays her by having an affair, which leads to her grandfather's death. During a family ceremony where she is being publicly humiliated, the Emperor finally arrives to reclaim his long-lost sister.

2377728.title: Parents' Twilight Love
2377728.description: Twenty years ago, Zhao Jianghe's wife and daughter were kidnapped by traffickers at a market. Since then, he raised his son, Zhao Kangjian, alone while searching for them. Years later, Jianghe sells his old house to buy a new home for Kangjian and moves in with him. However, his daughter-in-law, Pan Yunshu, mistreats him and threatens divorce to force him out. Caught between family and his wife, Kangjian chooses his wife and kicks his father out of the house.

2377847.title: Married by Fate, Loved by Law
2377847.description: Shen Nian's legal internship turns into a nightmare due to workplace bullying and her boyfriend's betrayal. In her darkest hour, she meets Grandma Gu, who is disguised as a cleaner. Impressed by Shen Nian's sense of justice, the grandmother plays matchmaker, leading Shen Nian into an accidental marriage with the legendary legal giant, Gu Chi. Now, Shen Nian must navigate workplace hostility and face off against Gu Chi’s prestigious socialite suitor.
2377847.originName: 顾律师，夫人告你芳心纵火

2377915.title: When Love Fights Back
2377915.description: Su Sa, a powerful woman from the financial world, unexpectedly inherits a rural martial arts gym. To save the property, she is forced into a fake marriage with Han Ye, a Sanda champion. From rivals to partners, this bickering couple gradually discovers each other's hidden soft sides while running the gym. When Han Ye's ex-girlfriend returns with a business conspiracy, the contract couple must face their true feelings and use real kung fu to protect their love and legacy.

2378049.title: The Years Between Us
2378049.description: Lin Xiaoxiao and top student Song Hansheng met in a high school study group. After navigating growth misunderstandings and academic setbacks, they finally reunite in university.

2378104.title: The Scholar's Return: Top Scorer Comes Home
2378104.description: Lin Hao goes to the capital for exams and wins first place, becoming a high-ranking official. However, a rumor spreads that he became a eunuch. Ma Wenbo, the magistrate's son, tries to seize Lin Hao's wife, Su Muyue. Even the clan elder blames Su Muyue and tries to punish her at the ancestral hall. Just in time, Lin Hao returns in glory. Meanwhile, to save her paralyzed father, a desperate Lin Mian accidentally calls a gynecologist named Shi Lin while trying to sell her eggs.

2378227.title: A Mother's Painful Sacrifice
2378227.description: To save her two sick children, Li Xiuying borrows money from the entire village, but it's still not enough. Her selfish younger daughter, Ye Sangsang, pushes her own brother off a cliff to secure the medical treatment for herself. Li Xiuying works tirelessly to raise Sangsang and send her to college, only for her ungrateful daughter to feel ashamed of her and ban her from attending her wedding.

2378299.title: Romance After Flash Marriage
2378299.description: After calling off her wedding, Lin Xiao enters a flash marriage with Shen Xiuchen, the heir of Dihao Group who is posing as a security guard. Together, they navigate family pressure and marital conflicts, exploring modern love and personal growth.

2378427.title: Amazing Mother
2378427.description: Wang Liyun collects trash to support her daughter Tang Youyou's education. Her gambling husband, Tang Zijian, tries to force Youyou into a marriage for a dowry to pay his debts. Liyun gives Youyou all her money and tells her to flee. Five years later, Youyou has married into a wealthy family, while Liyun still suffers from Zijian's abuse. When Liyun is beaten for secretly calling Youyou, her adopted daughter Jiang Yue intervenes, saves her, and kicks the gambler out of the city.

2378490.title: Long Road, Deep Love
2378490.description: To fulfill her grandmother's wish, Lu Xi enters a flash marriage with Gu Qingze. After being separated for three years while Gu was abroad and enduring schemes by Xia Muwan, Lu Xi builds her own career. When Gu returns, the two reunite in the business world, sparking a complex romance filled with both cooperation and competition.

2378581.title: Trapped in Starlight
2378581.description: Xu Manxing, a rising star and fiancée of Movie King Zhou Hongguang, finds herself trapped in a fictional drama as a brainless supporting character destined for tragedy. Just as her life begins to spiral, she gains fragments of future memories, foreseeing her own downfall. Awakened by this revelation, Xu Manxing vows to break the curse of the script and take control of her own destiny.

2378691.title: Fallen Leaves, No Roots
2378691.description: He Yuchuan was forced to leave home after his father wrongly accused him of harming his half-brother, He Xingchuan. During his internship, his brother's schemes worsened the rift with his father. However, a car accident eventually brings the truth from three years ago and hidden family secrets to light.

2378780.title: Mommy, You Married the Wrong Man
2378780.description: Five years ago, Meng Xin was framed by her half-sister and spent a night with a stranger, later giving birth to a child who was taken away. To escape her stepmother's cruelty, she fled abroad. Now, she returns as a powerful CEO. To reclaim her mother's inheritance, she agrees to a blind date, only to end up in a whirlwind marriage. To her surprise, a cute toddler calls her 'Mommy.' Only after the wedding does she realize she has married into the Feng family—the richest family in Kyoto—and her husband is the eldest young master.

2378919.title: The Long Way Home
2378919.description: Fifteen years ago, Song Jingnian was abandoned due to her father's debt and was adopted by the Jiang family after losing her memory, renamed Jiang Sining. Twenty-five years later, an impostor named Jiang Haining pretends to be the lost daughter of the Jiang family. After her scheme is exposed, she frames Sining and forces her to leave. Meanwhile, Song Man and her son search for their lost relative, leading Haining to realize Sining's true identity. Haining tries to take over the Song family's wealth and frame Sining, but she is eventually exposed by Song Man and her son. After a failed attempt to harm Song Shiwen, Haining is finally brought to justice.

2379058.title: The Cute Mrs. Gu is a Secret Metaphysics Master
2379058.description: The story of Mu Wanqing and Gu Tingxiu begins in their childhood. In the mysterious world of metaphysics, their elders arranged a marriage for them. As time passed, Mu Wanqing became the heir to the mysterious sect, bearing the mission of its revival. Meanwhile, Gu Tingxiu grew into a brilliant business leader. Their childhood bond blossoms as their two worlds collide.
2379058.originName: 萌妻顾太太，竟是玄学真大佬

2379111.title: A Mother's Silent Love
2379111.description: Shortly after giving birth to her daughter, Lin Hanxin was kicked out of her home because her son, Huang Zimo, made an innocent remark that led her husband and mother-in-law to wrongly accuse her of infidelity. Eighteen years later, Zimo meets Hanxin again but fails to recognize her. Upon discovering his identity, Hanxin chooses to hide the truth despite Zimo’s bullying and mistreatment. When Zimo finally learns the truth, he is overwhelmed with regret.

2379163.title: Final Bell: Kill or Die
2379163.description: A group of high school students is forced into a deadly game started by a mysterious figure named 'Admin.' They must find and eliminate a target following the rules, or face death. As the game continues, trust fades and betrayal takes over, turning their innocent school days into a bloody nightmare of life and death.

2379284.title: You Are My Everything
2379284.description: Six years ago, Zhan Xu was framed by his stepbrother and a classmate of Su Ye, leading to an accidental encounter that left Su Ye pregnant. Unaware of the truth, Su Ye moved away with her sister's help and gave birth to a son. Years later, as she spends time with Zhan Xu, she finds herself falling for him. Along the way, she discovers his hidden secrets and uncovers the truth about her child's 'death'—a secret her sister had kept from her for years.

2379345.title: You Are My Unforgettable Time
2379345.description: To inherit her family fortune, Su Jinge seeks a fake marriage. She accidentally mistakes her rival, Fu Sinian, for the partner her friend recommended and marries him. Believing he is gay, she causes a series of hilarious mishaps on their wedding night. Their true identities are only revealed when they meet at a real estate bidding gala. It turns out Fu Sinian fell in love with her seven years ago after she saved his life. Now, he begins a devoted journey to win her heart.

2379417.title: Lost You and Your Love
2379417.description: Xia Chu donated a kidney to her husband Fu Nancheng, only to be betrayed when he publicly proposed to the conniving Xu Yiyi. Xu Yiyi not only stole Xia Chu’s designs to become famous but also mocked her for the weight gain caused by post-surgery medication. After hitting rock bottom, Xia Chu decides to transform herself. As she rises from the ruins of her marriage, Fu Nancheng is left filled with regret.

2379491.title: Nirvana: Rebirth for Revenge
2379491.description: Betrayed and murdered by her husband Jiang Tianci and her best friend Zhong Qing for her inheritance, Shu Yan is reborn into her college graduation days. Seeking revenge, she teams up with the mysterious Jiang Yibai to uncover the dark conspiracy. As her enemies face justice, she finds herself falling for the man who helped her rise from the ashes.

2379569.title: Crystal Boys
2379569.description: After being expelled from school for a same-sex scandal, Li Qing is kicked out of the house by his father, who had high hopes for his military career. He wanders into the "New Park," a hidden world for outcasts. There, he meets Little Jade, who longs to find his father in Japan; the gentle Wu Min; and the street-smart Mouse. Under the guidance of Master Yang, these young boys survive as male escorts while hearing legends of the park's past, especially the tragic love between Dragon Prince and A-Feng. When Dragon Prince returns after ten years, the fates of these "youthful birds" remain forever intertwined.

2379704.title: The Errand Boy is a Secret Tycoon
2379704.description: On her way home, Nalan Yanran feels she is being followed, but she can't find the stalker no matter how many times she looks back. Upon reaching home, she is kidnapped by men in black and drugged. In her moment of greatest peril, Chu Fan appears like a ray of light to save her.

2379787.title: Thorns and Roses: Love Against All Odds
2379787.description: Su Yanxi, a wealthy heiress and top scientist from Jiangdu, travels to Yue City to solve food safety issues. After being betrayed, she enters a contract marriage with Qi Wenjing, the head of the powerful Qi family. Keeping their true identities secret, they work together to overcome crises and uncover the truth about their past while falling in love.

2379899.title: A Safe Return
2379899.description: Eighteen years ago, Liu Yanfang's son was kidnapped due to her negligence. She has since kept her noodle shop open, waiting for his return. When the shop faces a forced buyout, she meets Su Yunchen, who helps her. Through a long-life lock pendant, they finally reunite. Although Su Yunchen is the CEO of a major group, he is mistaken for a security guard. Relatives who once mocked Liu Yanfang are left in deep regret after discovering his true identity.

2380022.title: The Wife's Revenge
2380022.description: Song Ci and Lu Hao met in college. Despite her wealthy background, Song Ci was attracted to Lu Hao's hardworking nature and didn't mind his humble origins. After marriage, she endured six rounds of IVF over three years due to his infertility, finally conceiving twins. Following a car accident, a pregnant Song Ci was rushed to the ER. Her husband, Lu Hao, a doctor, appeared briefly before abandoning her to save his first love, Zhu Xueli, and her daughter. Separated only by a hospital curtain, Song Ci watched Lu Hao dote on Zhu Xueli’s minor scratches while her own amniotic fluid ran dry, unable to bring him back to her side.

2380137.title: Kiss My Baby
2380137.description: Shen Jiayi was drugged by her sister Shen Yanran, leading to a one-night stand with Si Heng, the CEO of Si Group, and the birth of their son, Xiaobao. To ensure the child grows up healthy, Jiayi agrees to let her sister claim the child while she stays by his side as his 'aunt'. To see her son, Jiayi joins Si Group as an intern and meets Si Heng again. As they spend time together, Si Heng becomes suspicious of her identity and finally discovers the truth after multiple tests.

2380282.title: Tilted Motherly Love
2380282.description: Xu Nian was a brilliant student, but her brother Xu Songhe framed her, making their parents believe she failed her middle school exams. Feeling ashamed, her parents sent her to the countryside without checking the facts. Despite this, Xu Nian never gave up and earned a spot at Jinghua University through a competition. However, she chose to decline the offer, aiming to become the top scorer in the college entrance exam to fulfill her grandmother's wish. After returning to the city, she faced constant sabotage from her brother and neglect from her parents. Their endless denial and misunderstanding eventually left her completely heartbroken.

2380365.title: Flash Marriage with My CEO on Day One
2380365.description: To avoid an arranged marriage, top designer Nan Qiaomu tries to hire a male model to fool her family, but accidentally flash-marries Han Siyan, her new boss who is posing as a job seeker. Neither knows the other's true identity: she doesn't know he's the powerful CEO, and he doesn't know she is his star designer and the 'gold-digger' he dislikes. Their relationship unfolds through secrets and misunderstandings.
2380365.originName: 让你上班你第一天闪婚总裁

2380461.title: If Love Can't Go Back
2380461.description: Bai Chuxi and Li Jingshen were once a perfect couple, but a cruel misunderstanding tore them apart. Three years ago, they planned to meet, but Li had a car accident on the way while Bai was nearly assaulted and photographed by thugs. When Li woke up, he saw the compromising photos and misunderstood her. Three years later, just as Bai is about to get engaged to her savior, Xu Hao, Li suddenly reappears in public to reclaim her.

2380565.title: Don't Mess with the Boss Lady
