2380565.description: Ye Qian, the wife of the Lu Group CEO, returns to her hometown after learning her mother is being bullied, only to have her identity stolen by her cousin, Ye Xi. Addicted to the power of the status, Ye Xi plots to eliminate Ye Qian, but her scheme fails when CEO Lu Jinye arrives. Just as everyone assumes Ye Qian's status is restored, Lu's matriarch, Lu Qing, arrives and refuses to recognize her. Instead, Lu Qing announces that Lu Jinye must marry the daughter of Ye Tiancheng, the richest man in the city, declaring she will only accept the tycoon's daughter as her daughter-in-law.

2380666.title: Flash Marriage: No More Pretending
2380666.description: After being betrayed by her boyfriend, Jiang Ningyue, the chairwoman of Fengying International, enters a flash marriage with Gu Xingheng, a CEO who is disguised as a painter. While hiding their true identities, they face family pressures and business rivalries together. As they take down villains and workplace enemies, they gradually uncover each other's true status.
2380666.originName: 闪婚后我和老公都不装了

2380736.title: The World is Gentle with You
2380736.description: Zhan Yuan was framed and had a one-night stand with intern Su Yan, resulting in pregnancy. Su Yan gave birth with her sister's help, but Zhan's mother took the baby for 5 million. Years later, Su Yan flash-marries Zhan Yuan, a retired soldier, on a blind date. Zhan Yuan recognizes her but hides his CEO identity to avoid her resentment. Su Yan thinks he's just an ordinary man and married him to escape her sister's pressure. As they live together, she falls in love and gradually discovers the truth about his secrets and their 'deceased' child.

2380832.title: The Fierce Heroine's Dual Life
2380832.description: Chu Jiangli, a modern doctor with a hidden dark side, dies and transmigrates into the body of a general’s wife in ancient times. Finding her husband, General Qin Jingyu, mentally impaired by poison and her young son bullied, she begins a double life. By day, she uses her medical skills to treat her husband; by night, she secretly strikes down enemies and resolves court crises. While protecting her family, she gradually uncovers the dark conspiracy behind the battlefield tragedy.

2380886.title: Twin Flowers
2380886.description: Twin sisters Nanxing and Beiyue both get into Peking University. On the day results are released, their father dies in an accident. Nanxing gives up her education to support Beiyue. Five years later, Beiyue returns as the CEO of Xingyue Group, eager to reward her sister. However, she finds that Nanxing, a gifted painter, is being bullied by her stepmother and stepbrother, and is forced to marry an old official in a month.

2381035.title: She Shines Like Early Dawn
2381035.description: An Lan, the eldest daughter of the An family, is forced by her selfish stepsister An Xue to marry the playboy Chen Yan in exchange for her mother's medical fees. On the wedding day, Chen Yan escapes to a car race. An Lan chases him in her wedding dress and wins the race with her elite driving skills, forcing him to complete the marriage. Despite their initial conflicts, the two grow closer as they face family pressures and An Xue's schemes together, eventually finding true love.

2381091.title: She Is Like the Rising Sun
2381091.description: An Nuannuan, the eldest daughter of the An family, marries Chen Xu, Jiangzhou's most notorious playboy, as a surrogate bride. On their wedding day, she tracks him down at a race track, defeats him in a race, and forces him to attend the wedding based on their bet. While Chen Xu tries to resist her, he finds himself increasingly drawn to her. Through their daily bickering and rivalry, the two eventually fall for each other.

2381156.title: Showdown: I'm Done Pretending!
2381156.description: Yun Wan hides her identity as a wealthy heiress to marry her boyfriend Chu Ze, only to be betrayed by him. In the midst of her heartbreak, her wealthy brothers find her and ask her to return and inherit the family's billions. Yun Wan decides to start a new life, leaving the pain behind to shine in high society and write her own legendary story.

2381228.title: The Unexpected Heiress
2381228.description: After losing her parents and inheritance to greedy relatives, Qi Simin lives as a bullied outcast. At 18, she saves a woman named Jiang Mian, who wants to adopt her despite accusations of being a gold digger. To find her missing brother, Simin travels to Hong Kong alone, where she rescues Fu Yaoyang, the powerful head of the Fu family, during a heavy storm.

2381370.title: The Beloved Junior Sister Descends the Mountain
2381370.description: Zhao Wanwan is a martial arts prodigy who knows nothing about romance. She accidentally beat her fellow disciples into disability while trying to 'practice.' To save the sect's future, her master and senior brother trick her into descending the mountain to experience 'emotional trials.' There, she meets Jiang Shuchen. Zhao Wanwan constantly challenges him to magical duels, but Jiang Shuchen mistakenly believes she is a pervert lusting after his body. A hilarious game of cat and mouse begins between the oblivious girl and the misunderstood CEO.

2381442.title: The Beloved Junior is a Secret Boss
2381442.description: Li Qian meets Shen Yuchu through a proposal mix-up but is framed by her best friend and boyfriend, losing her job. After saving Shen's grandmother, she enters a contract marriage with him. As they spend time together, they discover each other's true character. The grandmother fakes an illness to push them together, leading to a turning point. With childhood misunderstandings resolved, they finally confirm their feelings and find true love and redemption.

2381539.title: The Rising Daughter
2381539.description: Sun Mei has long been oppressed by her husband, Lin Jianguo, for not giving birth to a son. Their daughter, Lin Shengnan, becomes a top pharmacist and returns to her hometown to build a factory to help her mother and neighbors. However, her cousin Lin Xu steals her credit and spreads malicious rumors. Believing the lies, Lin Jianguo joins the villagers in bullying Sun Mei and her daughter, claiming Shengnan's wealth is illegal and even accusing her of theft when she presents the factory plans.

2381626.title: The Alluring Smile of Qingwei
2381626.description: Lu Qingwei, the wealthy heiress of the Lu family, abandoned her life of luxury for a poor man named Lin Chusheng. She hid her identity and fought in underground arenas to support him, only to realize he was a gold-digger who cheated on her with a fake heiress. After securing funding from Qingwei's own brother, Lin dumped her at their engagement party. Having finally seen his true colors, Qingwei reveals her true identity and begins her journey of revenge against the treacherous couple.

2381679.title: Walking Through the Storm Alone
2381679.description: The story follows a brave and resilient woman navigating the fierce competition of the workplace and the ups and downs of life. Refusing to give up on her dreams, she rises after every fall and faces every storm with courage. Driven by firm belief, she grows stronger through adversity. This drama highlights the power of women striving for self-discovery, inspiring every viewer to pursue their own dreams and write their own success stories.

2381770.title: Regret After My Death
2381770.description: Tang Shi, a dedicated housewife for over a decade, discovers she has a terminal illness with only three months to live. When she tries to tell her beloved husband, she is met with cold indifference. Even her son mocks her, thinking she is faking it for sympathy. Facing her husband's neglect, her mother-in-law's blame, and her son's insults, Tang Shi finally realizes her 'happy' life was nothing but a painful illusion.
2381770.originName: 我死后渣男老公后悔了

2381824.title: Gone with the Wind
2381824.description: Jiang Ruyi leaves the mountains to visit her family and investigate her father's missing inheritance. Upon her arrival, she saves Fu Sinian using her medical skills. After returning home and teaching her uncle Lin Haotian a lesson, she teams up with Fu Sinian to reclaim her father's estate using her diverse talents, eventually falling in love with him.

2381918.title: Fifty But Fabulous
2381918.description: Twenty-one years ago, Tian Xiumei gave birth to twins. Led to believe her daughter had died, she left with her son, only to be treated as a free nanny by him. Forced by her son to go on a blind date with Jiang Jianguo, she ends up in a flash marriage with Gu Weimin, the Chairman of Gu Group disguised as a security guard. As their feelings grow, Gu plans a gala to reveal her true identity. However, Xiumei discovers his deception and asks for a divorce. Just then, her son gets into a car accident. During a blood transfusion, the shocking truth from twenty-one years ago finally comes to light!

2382014.title: A Perfect Summer for Marriage
2382014.description: Su Wuming, a local official, is drawn into a series of kidnappings linked to an old mystery known as the 'Nine-Story Pavilion Case' by a mysterious man named Han Tang. The three victims—a jade merchant, a concubine, and an old pear seller—all once testified that Liu Rong, the wife of Official Han, murdered her husband. Su Wuming and the original judge, Du Chong, are drugged and taken to a creepy underground palace that replicates the Nine-Story Pavilion. Confronted by Han Tang and his twin brother Han Di, Su Wuming must unravel the trap, expose the flaws in the old testimonies, and finally uncover the truth.

2382104.title: Love, Lies, and a Fallen General
2382104.description: Three years ago, Gu Xia, the female commander of Great Cang, was injured and fell in love with Chen Shijie, mistakenly believing he was her savior. She hid her identity to live a simple life as a market vendor with him. However, to pay off his gambling debts, Chen Shijie and his mistress Jin Meilian plot to sell Gu Xia to a local bully.

2382298.title: Heartbroken Reunion: The Long Road Home
2382298.description: Seventeen years ago, Zhang Xiulian's three children were kidnapped and sold by her gambling-addict brother. Now, those children have grown up to be the CEO and heirs of the powerful Pei Group. While searching for them, Zhang accidentally becomes a nanny in the Pei household. However, due to the schemes of a villain, she struggles to reveal the truth and reunite with her long-lost children.

2382379.title: My Blind Date is My Boss
2382379.description: On her seventh blind date, Li Qianqian meets a man who is perfect in every way. Not ready for marriage, she turns him down, only to discover he is her new boss, Qiao Yishen! As they grow closer, she begins to fall for him, but tragedy strikes when she learns her mother has terminal bone cancer. Meanwhile, Lu Zheying, a gifted but poor painter, is bullied by her family and forced to marry an old official as his ninth concubine a month later.
2382379.originName: 相亲对象竟是顶头上司

2382484.title: Love Meets Again
2382484.description: Four years ago, Fu Jiasheng fled abroad on his wedding day to avoid an arranged marriage with Shen Xin. Now, he returns and hires a divorce lawyer to end that very marriage, unaware that the lawyer is actually his wife, Shen Xin! Coincidentally, Shen Xin doesn't recognize him either and takes the case, leading to a series of hilarious and unexpected events.

2382626.title: Warm Sun in the High Sky
2382626.description: After four years of working hard, Sheng Nuan is betrayed by both her boyfriend and her best friend. Choosing to move on, she focuses entirely on her career. By chance, she enters a flash marriage with Gu Mingchen, a top pilot at Qinglan Airlines. After the wedding, her mother-in-law showers her with love, and Gu Mingchen is drawn to her resilience, falling deeply for her and protecting her whenever she faces trouble.

2382753.title: Happiness to the Distance
2382753.description: Ren Zhuoyuan, a young man from the countryside, opens a tea restaurant to change his fate and lead his fellow villagers to prosperity. Despite facing setbacks in both his career and family, he finds the strength to start over with the support of his loved ones.

2382875.title: Promise You a Lifetime
2382875.description: Fang Xuxu is forced to give birth to a child for her stepsister in exchange for a chance to marry into a wealthy family. Her childhood friend, Qin Zhouchuan, discovers the truth and gives her seven days to decide if he should cancel his engagement to her sister. Resigned to her fate, Xuxu starts calling him 'Brother-in-law.' However, a medical emergency during childbirth reveals the child's true identity. Facing family pressure and an unwanted marriage, Xuxu decides to fight back for her child. Amidst the chaos, Zhouchuan’s true feelings for Xuxu emerge. Can they overcome the obstacles and find a future together?

2383010.title: Cuddles with My Mystic Wife: Mr. Li, Let Me Borrow a Kiss
2383010.description: Gu Manman, a young Taoist master, accidentally breaks her master's treasure and must find her 'destined one' to ward off evil spirits and survive a deadly ordeal. Guided by her compass, she finds Li Xiujin, a disabled CEO known as the 'Star of Misfortune.' Despite his initial skepticism and coldness, the two enter a contract marriage to save each other. As Manman uses her mystic powers to heal his legs and protect him, the cold CEO finds his heart melting. What started as a business deal turns into a deep, supernatural romance.
2383010.originName: 玄学甜妻求贴贴，黎先生，借个吻

2383129.title: The Long-Lost Daughter
2383129.description: Haitang Group builds Wangxing Tower to find their missing third daughter, Qin Zixing. The project manager, Zhang Yang, cuts corners and frames Yu Daqiang for the malpractice. Driven by desperation to find his sister, Qin Zihao takes his anger out on Yu Daqiang, leading to the latter's suicide. Meanwhile, Huang Shuya steals Yu Huan's jade pendant to fake her identity as the missing daughter and attempts to murder the real Yu Huan. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and the Qin family rushes to save Yu Huan.

2383206.title: A Special Kind of Fate
2383206.description: He Youyou, an orphan from Dahe Village, is adopted by Jiang Caiyun, the richest woman in Jiangcheng, after a chance encounter. Moving to the city and attending a top school, Youyou feels grateful but worries her humble background might burden her new family. Despite constant bullying from her fellow villager Li Jinfeng, Youyou finds strength through the protection of Jiang Caiyun’s son, Jiang Sheng, and the secret support of Jiang Caiyun herself.

2383263.title: Waiting for the Rain to Stop Together
2383263.description: Five years ago, Xu Manxing suffered heart failure while saving her sister, Xu Manyue. Five years later, Manyue has become a top lawyer, but a rift grows between the sisters on Manxing's 18th birthday. After a series of setbacks, Manxing lures Xie Zihao to a hotel and kills him in retaliation to prove her innocence to her sister.

2383390.title: The Hidden Heiress Fights Back
2383390.description: Luo Shuyao, the daughter of the richest man, hides her identity to be with her ordinary boyfriend, Gao Zixuan, even cutting ties with her family. When she is framed by Chen Shumei and Tang Yan, the manager of a luxury store owned by her family steps in to save her at the critical moment.

2383499.title: Unbreakable Love
2383499.description: To secure her position, the mistress Bai Yanyan manipulates Cheng An'an, the daughter of the original wife Zhong Li, into persuading her parents to divorce. Unable to accept the truth, An'an runs away and gets hit by a car. To keep the husband, Cheng Yi, by her side, Bai Yanyan hides the accident and keeps him focused on her and her own daughter. Ultimately, An'an passes away, and Zhong Li vows to seek revenge.

2383551.title: The Banquet
2383551.description: After a car accident wipes out her family, Fang Xinyan is left all alone. But the crash was actually caused by a power struggle over the Jiang family inheritance. She teams up with Jiang Jichuan, the neglected illegitimate son of the Jiang family, and goes undercover to infiltrate the family and uncover the truth. Jiang Jichuan works behind the scenes to help her avoid danger, while Fang Xinyan helps him fight for power. After many twists and turns, they expose Jiang Li as the mastermind behind the accident, only to discover there is an even bigger culprit pulling the strings. At critical moments, Jiang Jichuan saves Fang Xinyan again and again. In the end, the Fang family's blood debt is avenged, and Fang Xinyan comes to understand her own heart, finding happiness with Jiang Jichuan.

2383679.title: Cousin's Secret
2383679.description: Fang Han, a fresh graduate from a traditional Chinese medicine college, only wanted to be a quietly handsome doctor, marry a beautiful wife, and earn a chief physician title before retirement. But he unexpectedly became the youngest master of traditional Chinese medicine. This is a story of a young doctor growing with the help of a system! This is a story of an ordinary person growing into a great healer for all! Reborn as the only son of the prime minister, Liu Quan's only goal is to ruin his own reputation as much as possible and become a despised villain, so that the emperor can rest assured and spare his family. So he beats people, flips tables, and forcibly harasses noble ladies, trying to cement his reputation as a bully.

2383774.title: My Sister-in-Law is a Streamer
2383774.description: After being humiliated by her ex-boyfriend, the female lead decides to marry his older brother for revenge and to save her family business. At a masquerade ball, she unexpectedly sleeps with the brother, only to discover that the two are actually identical-looking brothers.

2383884.title: Reap What You Sow: Trapping My Fake Husband
2383884.description: In her past life, Lin Ye married Su Lingyue just to use her resources to become a famous influencer. He illegally used her identity to sell fake 'anti-cancer' creams, leading to Su's death by cyberbullying. Reborn, Su Lingyue decides to give him a taste of his own medicine. She exposes Lin Ye's lies and teams up with Zhou Chi, another victim of his scams, to make Lin Ye pay for his crimes.
2383884.originName: 种因得果，冒牌老公请入局

2383954.title: Back to 1990: Building a Fortune with My Daughter and Sister-in-Law
2383954.description: Zhou Qingshan devoted his life to his 'goddess' Chen Yueru, only to be kicked out when he became paralyzed in his old age. After failing to exploit his biological daughter, Tingting, Chen’s family pushed him into traffic to claim his life insurance. Dying in regret for being a neglectful father, Zhou Qingshan begs for a second chance. He wakes up to find himself back in 1990, twenty years in the past.
2383954.originName: 重回1990：带女儿和小姨子致富

2384016.title: Back to the Business World: Ruling the 90s
2384016.description: Ye Ming is reborn to the night before his daughter Nini's fatal car accident and is determined to change her fate. He saves Nini in the rain but is mistaken for a kidnapper, until tycoon Ma Huahao steps in to help. Using his memories of the future, Ye Ming seizes business opportunities and partners with CEO Shen Qianshuang to help her overcome a family crisis.
2384016.originName: 重回商界，执掌九零年代

2384162.title: Reborn to Revenge: Crushing My Ex and His First Love
2384162.description: Betrayed and murdered by her boyfriend Gu Chen and his mistress Xia Qing, Lin Wei is reborn with a thirst for revenge. No longer blinded by Gu Chen’s lies, she starts her payback by refusing to pay for his luxury auctions and exposing their schemes to steal her family heirlooms. With the loyal support of Zhou Che, Lin Wei uncovers their crimes, bringing them to justice. She eventually rises as a business tycoon and starts a new life with Zhou Che.
2384162.originName: 重生后，男友和白月光每秒被我打脸

2384311.title: Rebirth: 100 Ways for the Fake Heiress to Die
2384311.description: Before her rebirth, Shi Ranran was bullied by Li Zhusui, despised by Li Shuoguang, and neglected by her biased parents. Now reborn, she is determined to take revenge. When the Li Group begins searching for their long-lost daughter, Ranran confirms her true identity through a DNA test. Despite Li Zhusui’s constant schemes and Li Shuoguang’s blind protection of the imposter, Ranran begins her ultimate counterattack.
2384311.originName: 重生后：假千金的100种死法

2384452.title: Reborn Heiress: No More Love Brain
2384452.description: Song Jianing was betrayed by Lu Zicheng, losing her family business and dying in the arms of her childhood friend, Shen Youze. Waking up ten years in the past, she finds herself back when she and Lu Zicheng were interns at the Song Group. This time, Jianing refuses to be his puppet. She breaks up with him decisively and vows to teach him a lesson he’ll never forget.
2384452.originName: 重生后大小姐拒绝恋爱脑

2384566.title: Mr. Zhou, Please Leave My Future
2384566.description: After seven years of dating and three years of marriage, Yu Qingge is left scarred by Zhou Shengyan's cold indifference despite her devotion. Heartbroken, she moves to Switzerland for healing and meets Luo Xingen. With the support of her best friend Xiong Xiaolan and the care of Luo Xingen, she reclaims her honor and finds a truer, more beautiful love.
2384566.originName: 周先生，请离开我的未来

2384683.title: Hidden Identity: After Winning the CEO’s Heart
2384683.description: Lu Fan, a fresh graduate, starts a job at a high-end car dealership surrounded by beautiful colleagues. Through a twist of fate, he enters a contract relationship with his stunning and intelligent boss, Su Wanyi, but real feelings soon emerge. As Su’s wealthy suitor, Wang Chengyuan, tries everything to sabotage him, little does everyone know that Lu Fan is actually the heir to a legendary hidden family!
2384683.originName: 追妻成功后，他亮出了底牌

2384830.title: Love Lost in Reincarnation
2384830.description: Five years ago, Jiang Yining ended up in a coma after a car accident. To survive, she had to complete a mission to win Li Xunyu's heart. She succeeded and fell deeply in love, even giving up her chance to return to her original world. However, when Li Xunyu’s childhood friend Ning Xia returned, Yining realized she was never truly loved. Heartbroken, she committed suicide by jumping into a river. Given a second chance by a mysterious system, she returns with a new identity to stop Li Xunyu’s wedding, only to find herself falling for him all over again.

2384964.title: Love Wandering at the Start
2384964.description: Tang Jiaojiao is harassed in a bar, and Shi Yanchuan's rescue only deepens their misunderstanding. After learning the truth from Meng Yan, she rushes to explain, but Shi Yanchuan insults her instead. Devastated, Tang Jiaojiao gives up on their relationship and seeks revenge by revealing her true identity at his engagement party.

2385113.title: The Blessed Matriarch of the 80s
2385113.description: In a time of extreme poverty, a mother and daughter struggle to survive by gathering wild plants. Chen Fang, a hardworking and wise mother, never loses hope. Despite the hardships, she remains dedicated to finding a cure for her son-in-law's leg injury.

2385226.title: Filial Piety Above All
2385226.description: Jiang Shiyue is diagnosed with terminal brain cancer. Her mother, Zhou Shuping, is determined to save her and insists on selling their house for treatment. In a fit of rage, Shiyue tears up the property deed to stop her mother and vows to sever their relationship. After realizing the depth of her mother's love and the truth of her condition, Shiyue is consumed by regret for her actions.

2385366.title: Free from the Moocher! Embracing the Elite Tycoon
2385366.description: Lin Wan was once trapped in a marriage with a 'freeloader.' Her husband, Zhou Hao, was handsome and charming but lazy and manipulative, living entirely off her resources. After her career hit a low point and she became exhausted, she decisively divorced him to start a new, independent life.
2385366.originName: 摆脱软饭男后！我抱住了世家大佬

2385422.title: Can a Nanny Truly Care for the Elderly?
2385422.description: In a peaceful neighborhood, Ye Xin’s happy family life is shattered by a wicked nanny. Initially hardworking, the nanny soon reveals her true face and begins abusing his mother, Zhang Chunlan. Being kind and timid, Zhang Chunlan suffers in silence. However, the observant and filial Ye Xin senses something is wrong. By gathering evidence and installing hidden cameras, he exposes the truth and brings the nanny to justice.

2385515.title: Report to Captain Mu: Miss Ye is Flying Solo
2385515.description: Ye Qingli gave up her dream of flying for Mu Huaiyuan. After seven years of marriage, she witnesses his intimacy with a flight attendant and is hit with a divorce request. To make matters worse, she is diagnosed with stomach cancer. This double blow awakens her, leading her to divorce him, seek treatment, and reclaim her life. Only after losing her does Mu Huaiyuan realize her worth and try to win her back, but she firmly refuses. Ultimately, Ye Qingli breaks free from her past to live as a strong, independent woman.
2385515.originName: 报告慕机长：叶小姐单飞了

2385650.title: Mayday: No Way Home
2385650.description: During a flight over a remote sea, pilot Li Ming suffers a sudden engine failure. Desperate, he calls his brother-in-law Zhang Wei: 'Report, I can't make it back!' In the face of death, Li Ming confesses his involvement in a smuggling ring and his role in the death of Zhang Wei’s sister ten years ago. As Zhang Wei, an engineer, races to save him, he discovers a family enemy is orchestrating the crisis for revenge. Amidst betrayal and a ticking clock, Zhang Wei must choose between forgiveness and justice in this high-stakes emotional storm.
2385650.originName: 报告小叔，我已无法返航

2385793.title: The Yandere's Guide to Taming
2385793.description: In her past life, Jiang Yunling loved the wrong man, lost everything, and was murdered by her family and her lover. Before dying, she learned that her cousin's family killed her father, and the one who actually saved her was Qin Yue—the man she hated most but who died for her. Reborn, she dumps the scumbag, embraces Qin Yue, and schemes to reclaim her inheritance and punish those who wronged her.

2385916.title: No More Stepdad: My Life Takes Off
2385916.description: He Qingjun spent his entire life supporting his crush’s family, only to be kicked out after a stroke. Before dying, his biological daughter’s resentment and her scarred face broke his heart. Reborn twenty years in the past, he vows to leave those ungrateful people behind and live only to love and protect his own daughter.

2386030.title: Unmasked: Ms. Su is Not to be Messed With
2386030.description: Su Qingyan, the heiress of Xinghan Entertainment, conceals her identity to work as an assistant for Lin Zheyu, a struggling actor she wants to repay. She secretly uses her resources to make him a star, only for Lin to cheat on her with an investor’s daughter, Zhang Manni, and humiliate her after finding fame. With the secret help of Fu Yun, CEO of Nancheng Media, Su Qingyan clears the misunderstandings and finds true love again.
2386030.originName: 藏不住了，苏小姐她不好惹

2386148.title: Warm Tea, Warm Years
2386148.description: Huo Tingjun, the 50-year-old chairman of a top black tea company, enters a flash marriage with tea shop owner Hu Xiaojuan after being set up by his daughter. Initially, both resist the union as they still harbor feelings for their past loves. However, daily life spent over tea and business gradually dissolves the barriers between them. When Huo’s company faces a brand crisis, Hu helps him with her traditional tea-making skills and local reputation. Through the aroma of tea, they finally find true love, turning a forced marriage into a warm, lifelong bond.

2386271.title: The Year I Finally Forgot You
2386271.description: Su Yao and Chen Feng once shared a deep and passionate love, making many beautiful promises. However, as time passed, Chen Feng focused more on his career and began to neglect Su Yao, leading to constant conflicts and an eventual breakup. Heartbroken, Su Yao struggled to move on, haunted by memories of the past. But with the support of her family and friends, she decides to face her pain and finally learns to let go.

2386400.title: Revenge of the Surrogate: Raging in the Wealthy Family
2386400.description: Song Li is forced to act as a surrogate for her sister, Song Qingyue, to save her kidnapped mother. While serving as a substitute for CEO Huo Jinheng, she discovers the shocking truth: her mother was murdered by Song Qingyue. Devastated and fueled by rage, Song Li stops enduring the abuse. Using her position in the wealthy household, she begins a calculated revenge to make the Song family pay for their crimes.
2386400.originName: 成为替身后，我在豪门杀疯了

2386476.title: Almost Famous
2386476.description: Song Ya, a talented rookie singer, is betrayed by her boyfriend and manager. He steals her resources and gets her banned from the industry. At her lowest point, she doesn't give up. Instead, she changes her identity and works hard to refine her singing and songwriting, preparing for a powerful comeback.

2386576.title: Professor Chu, Say You Love Me
2386576.description: After an accident, famous actress Jiang Xu travels into a mini-drama world as the villainess Xu Zhaoyu. She tries to woo her crush, Chu Guanqiu, but he is obsessed with his career and hides a secret first love. As she uncovers his true identity, the mysterious connection between the drama world and reality begins to unfold.

2386660.title: Embrace You Through the Clouds
2386660.description: Shen Jiayi and Gu Yanchen promised to stay together and dedicate their lives to aviation. However, due to opposition from Gu's mother, they drifted apart. Seven years later, destiny brings them together again. The true reason for Jiayi's departure and the secret of their daughter gradually surface. Can Jiayi keep these secrets hidden, and where will her relationship with Gu Yanchen go?

2386740.title: The Villainess Wants to Slack Off, but the CEO is Hooked
2386740.description: After dying from debt and exhaustion, Su Ying transmigrates as a villainess in a CEO novel. Knowing the plot, she saves her family business with the help of her 'husband,' Qin Yihan. To avoid a tragic end, she suppresses her feelings and tries to set him up with the original heroine. However, after saving each other repeatedly, they fall in love and rewrite their destiny together.

2386843.title: Spring Breeze and Lingering Regret
2386843.description: At a high-end gala, Lin Wan unexpectedly meets Xie Chenzhou, the powerful leader of the mysterious Xie Group. As a tycoon who controls the city's destiny, he is calm and reserved. From initial testing to mutual understanding, Xie Chenzhou admires Lin Wan's clarity and resilience. With his support, Lin Wan restarts her career and builds her own design brand. Ultimately, she achieves financial independence and finds a relationship built on respect and equality.

2386935.title: Heart to Heart: The Author's Survival Guide
2386935.description: Chu Wanqiu transmigrates into her own tragic novel as the villainess. With her 'God's eye' view, she plans to make money through fortune-telling and retire early. However, the main characters start hearing her inner thoughts, forcing her to join them in changing their doomed fates.

2387057.title: Exposing My Scheming Junior: The Stolen Soul of Art
2387057.description: Talented painter An Yiruo breaks traditional boundaries by creating a revolutionary masterpiece in just 36 hours. Despite being initially overlooked for her avant-garde style, she faces plagiarism accusations from her deceptive junior. Choosing to prove herself through pure talent, Yiruo creates a stunning new work live at the National Art League, exposes the industry's dark secrets, and ultimately wins the international championship with her genuine skill.
2387057.originName: 打脸偷画魂的绿茶师妹

2387145.title: Running to Your Heart with My Secret Baby
2387145.description: Mu Qingqing, a former heiress, loses everything after a family crisis and has a one-night stand with CEO Gu Linchuan, resulting in a daughter. Misunderstandings lead Gu to seek revenge, making her life a struggle as she protects her child and mother. After she flees with her baby, Gu is consumed by guilt and longing. Eventually, the truth comes to light, and the two reconcile to find their happily ever after.

2387216.title: Marrying into Wealth with My Adorable Son
2387216.description: After her divorce, Lin Meng lives with her son, Juanjuan. To solve the household registration issue, she enters a marriage of convenience with Pan Yi, CEO of the Pan Group. Pan Yi suspects Juanjuan is his biological son and begins an investigation. Meanwhile, Zhao Qian tries to profit by falsely claiming to be the father, but he is eventually exposed and punished by law. In the end, the family of three reunites.

2387341.title: When Love Fades, She Leaves Quietly
2387341.description: To repay the Lin family's kindness, Mu Ci endured three years of fertility treatments, only to catch her husband Lin Jintian cheating with Liu Qiyi. After learning Mu Ci is pregnant, Lin Jintian begs for her return while still letting a fake-pregnant Liu Qiyi cause trouble. When Lin Jintian discovers he is infertile and Liu Qiyi's child belongs to another man, he drags her into a car accident in a fit of rage, leaving both in a vegetative state.
2387341.originName: 当爱意冷却后，她悄然谢幕

2387458.title: Sharp-Tongued Daddy: I'll Pamper My Mommy
2387458.description: Genius designer Su Mo returns home with her five-year-old son, only to discover that the father is the sharp-tongued business mogul Li Yunchen. When the cold CEO meets the single mother, a custody battle begins, filled with witty bickering and sweet romance. Li Yunchen realizes the boy's artistic talent is just like his own, and he secretly protects Su Mo when her studio faces plagiarism allegations.
2387458.originName: 爹地太毒舌，团宝妈咪我来宠

2387660.title: Heartbreak at the Wedding: My Husband Sings for His First Love
2387660.description: Jiang Ningyue once gave everything for Shen Haozhe, only to be betrayed and die in Lu Yuchen's arms. Unexpectedly, she is reborn ten years back to the day before her wedding. This time, Ningyue decides to stop being a desperate lover and cherish the right person. Meanwhile, her fiancé Shen Haozhe still thinks she is his loyal follower. At the wedding, he confesses his love to another woman, Ye Qingyao. Ningyue exposes him on the spot, the wedding is canceled, and the Shen family faces bankruptcy due to the scandal.
2387660.originName: 婚礼上，老公深情献唱他的白月光

2387778.title: Marriage on Trial
2387778.description: Gu Luo is a dedicated housewife who gave everything to her family, only to be met with her husband's affair and her in-laws' ingratitude. After receiving another job offer from Paris Fashion Week, she finally decides to divorce Qin Xiangchuan and take her daughter to conquer the fashion world in Paris. Three months later, she returns to Yuncheng, making her scumbag ex-husband deeply regret his actions.

2387925.title: Mr. Huo, It’s Your Turn to Fall
2387925.description: Yu Zhixia, once a musical genius, watched her husband, Huo Linchuan, give her original works to his ex-girlfriend, Su Ying, 99 times. After seven years of dating and three years of marriage, Yu Zhixia is left heartbroken. She always chose Huo Linchuan over her dreams and fame, but he always chose his first love over her. Now, it is time for him to pay the price.

2388044.title: Mr. Ji, I Have No Intentions Toward You
2388044.description: Shen Jianxia, a commoner girl, lost her chance at college after her brother destroyed her admission letter and her mother showed favoritism. However, she eventually graduated with help from Ji Yanzhou’s scholarship and joined his company. During a blind date on behalf of a friend, she meets Ji Yanzhou, who discovers she is the only one who doesn't trigger his physical aversion to contact, making her his target for a forced marriage. After her identity is revealed, the two fall in love as she becomes a top designer and breaks ties with her family. Following a misunderstanding involving Ji’s first love and a kidnapping ordeal, Ji Yanzhou rescues her, and they live happily ever after.
2388044.originName: 季先生，我对您绝无非分之想

2388157.title: The Heiress Strikes Back After Inheriting Billions
2388157.description: Meng Erniang, the city's top physician, was killed by Imperial Concubine Li after discovering a dark secret during childbirth. Five years later, her daughter Meng Xuezhao enters the palace as a maid to seek justice. Having allied with other families harmed by the Concubine, Xuezhao begins her revenge. She uses her wit to create a stunning crystal hairpiece to trap the Concubine, only for it to be stolen by the greedy Nanny Kong, who seeks to take the credit.
2388157.originName: 继承千亿遗产后小姐杀疯了

2388256.title: Bringing Home a Lucky Star: Prosperity Flows
2388256.description: Li Xuecheng rescues a baby girl named Fuxing from a fire. Despite village rumors that she is a jinx, Li and his mother decide to adopt her. As Fuxing’s magical powers emerge, she helps Li and the villagers overcome great challenges, eventually leading the village to a future of wealth and happiness.
2388256.originName: 捡个福星进家门：遇水则发

2388328.title: Bringing the Trafficker to Justice
2388328.description: Tao Guijia was abducted by human trafficker Mei Renxin as a child and grew up through many hardships away from her family. Years later, while working in a restaurant, she recognizes Mei Renxin on the news after he is sentenced to eight years for child trafficking. Determined to seek justice for herself, she gathers evidence and sues him again. In court, Mei Renxin arrogantly denies his crimes due to a lack of evidence, but Guijia brings forward a surprise witness to expose his hidden evil deeds.

2388384.title: Lord Jiu, It’s My Turn to Love You
2388384.description: In her past life, Luoyang married the illegitimate son Li Songyuan and became an envied CEO's wife. However, Li was a secret pervert who forced her to raise his mistress's son. After being reborn, Luoyang’s sister, Luo Jinyu, snatches Li Songyuan for herself, while Luoyang chooses to marry the mysterious Huai Jiuying instead.

2388510.title: Awakening in the 90s: Leaving Wrong Love Behind
2388510.description: In 1991, Xiangxin Town, doctor Su Wanqing is about to marry Wu Yiheng, a factory vice director. However, Wu's first love, Xiao Xiaorou, returns with a son and uses schemes to drive a wedge between them. Facing Wu's lack of trust and Xiao's malice, Wanqing loses hope and decides to start over in Beijing. By the time Wu realizes his mistakes, it is already too late.
2388510.originName: 觉醒九零，挥别错爱向前行

2388573.title: Broken Dreams in the Golden City
2388573.description: Years ago, Jiang Shiyi, the only survivor of her massacred clan, married the poor scholar Zhen Wuchi. Seven years later, she helps him become the top scholar, only for him to bring another woman, Lin Ruoruo, home to take her place. Heartbroken, Shiyi divorces him and punishes the mistress with the help of Zhen Changfeng. Together, they fight for the people and protect the kingdom.

2388641.title: The Desperate Housewife's Fiery Revenge
2388641.description: Yin Moli, the heiress of the Yin Group, devoted everything to supporting her husband Lin Hao's career and family. But right after giving birth, she discovers his affair with Lu Mingming. Heartbroken by his betrayal, Moli decides to fight back. She gathers evidence and stages a bold public exposure to burn down his lies, seeking justice for herself and her young daughter.

2388767.title: Embracing the Moon in Late Winter
2388767.description: Wen Wan secretly loved Qin Zimo for eight years. After finally getting married, she discovered he only wed her to escape family pressure and inherit the business. Despite her efforts to boost his reputation through secret charity work, she faced rejection from his family and indifference from him, leading to their divorce. A year later, just as Qin achieves great success and learns the truth, he discovers that Wen Wan has already passed away.

2388899.title: A New Bond: Grandma's Little Savior
2388899.description: Zhang Huimin, a rural grandmother, is kicked out by her son and daughter-in-law after giving them her life savings for a house. Homeless, she rescues and adopts a lost boy named Anan, who has amnesia after escaping a kidnapping. She renames him Xiaozhi, and they live happily until Xiaozhi is diagnosed with leukemia. Although Huimin is a bone marrow match, she cannot afford the surgery. At her lowest point, the wealthy Huo Zheng intervenes to save the boy and change their lives.

2388987.title: Cold Pilot's Flash Marriage to His Sweet Country Wife
2388987.description: Reborn with memories and vengeance, he returns to engage in a life-and-death battle. Using his wits and the environment, he outsmarts a fugitive to protect his parents. No longer a victim, he sets a deadly trap to make the murderer pay in blood.
2388987.originName: 冷面机长闪婚农村小甜妻

2389115.title: Reborn for Revenge: The Grand Scheme
2389115.description: In the gentle March breeze, Xu Qinghe dreams of a night stained with blood. During three years of secret marriage, Xie Lin and Qu Xia conspired to take everything from her—her freedom, her family, and even her unborn child. Forced into a painful miscarriage, she vowed never to love him again. Now, she wakes up in a hospital bed to find them by her side once more. Will she face her scars or run away? The pain of her past life still burns in her soul.

2389214.title: Regretful Ex-wife: My Husband is a Billionaire
2389214.description: Xiao Tiance, the heir to the nation's top conglomerate, hid his massive wealth to live a simple life with his wife. Just as he plans to reveal his identity after helping her career take off, he discovers her betrayal. Disappointed, Xiao Tiance reclaims everything he gave her and reveals his true status. Realizing what she has lost, the ex-wife is consumed by regret.

2389274.title: Miss Li, Forget Those Three Brothers!
2389274.description: Li Mo was adopted by the Li family, but they never treated her with sincerity. At a business conference, Li Mo exposes Li Zhizhi's betrayal and successfully reclaims her wealth and status. After breaking ties with the family, she decides to use her own resources and advantages to fight for the rights she deserves.
2389274.originName: 黎小姐，这三个哥哥不要也罢！

2389348.title: Lawyer Li's Flash-Marriage Wife is a Hidden Goddess
2389348.description: Lin Zhaoye has only three days to live after her life-source, the Mystic Blood Pearl, shatters. She descends the mountain to find her fated husband, Li Huaizhou, and accidentally saves his sister. As they spend time together, Li Huaizhou falls for her protective nature. On their wedding day, Lin learns she can only be cured if Li says 'I love you.' However, Li's former flame suddenly appears to reclaim her position as his wife.
2389348.originName: 厉律师的闪婚娇妻是传世帝尊

2389406.title: The End of Burning Love
2389406.description: Seven years of marriage turn into a nightmare when Ji Yunshu's husband brings his mistress home on her birthday. He drugs his pregnant wife just to have an affair on their wedding bed. After catching them, Ji Yunshu is pushed off a building and loses her baby. Miraculously surviving, she finds her biological son only recognizes the mistress as his mother. With the help of a mysterious system, she embarks on a cold-blooded path of revenge.

2389521.title: Spirit Baby Descends: Mr. Shen's Metaphysical Helper
2389521.description: Little Taoist Shen Youyou is kicked off the mountain by her master after accidentally roasting a phoenix during its rebirth. Tasked with finding her birth parents, she discovers that Shen Yu and Li Wan have no idea she exists. The divorced couple is forced to work together on a new project, while Youyou uses her supernatural powers to resolve crises, defeat villains, and try her best to reunite her parents.
2389521.originName: 灵宝下山，沈先生的玄学小外挂

2389581.title: The Tiny Master: Saving the Family with a Baby Bottle
2389581.description: Fu Zhenting sends his son, Hongyu, to welcome their 'Great-Grandmother,' only to find a toddler. Skeptical but compliant, Hongyu takes her home. Using her past-life mystical powers, little Chaochao saves Hongyu from a fatal accident with a lucky charm. Despite his disbelief, she later exposes a nanny's scheme to steal the family fortune. These miraculous acts finally convince Hongyu of her divine powers.
2389581.originName: 灵宝下山之叼个奶瓶救全家

2389683.title: Lingbao’s Descent: Justice Served
2389683.description: Lu An'an, an ancient Taoist master reincarnated as a young girl, uses her mystical powers to navigate the modern world. From exposing conspiracies to saving those in need, she uses her supernatural skills to create a legendary urban tale.
2389683.originName: 灵宝下山之善恶终有报

2389771.title: Stop Chasing Me, Honey! I'm Coming Home
2389771.description: Li Mo, a regular office worker, hiddenly buys a lottery ticket and wins 5 million! But in his excitement, he accidentally sends the ticket to a client inside a folder. During a wild chase to get it back, the client’s rich daughter teases him: "Want the ticket? Be my fiancé." Just then, his wife arrives with a wooden laundry board and a cold smile: "Honey, do you want the money or your life?" Li Mo breaks down: "I was wrong! The money is yours, my life is yours, and I'll take the laundry board!"
2389771.originName: 领证当晚，植物人老婆睁开眼

2389861.title: Captain Lu, Heartbeat Warning Ahead
2389861.description: Li Surong married Captain Lu Zheng to repay a debt of gratitude. After three years of secret marriage, she discovers he is still in love with his first love—who happens to be her half-sister, Lin Zhenzhen. Deciding to set him free, she files for divorce. Only then does Lu Zheng realize his ex-wife is actually a brilliant aerospace safety engineer.
2389861.originName: 陆机长，航线前方有心动预警

2389925.title: Captain Lu, Miss Jiang Soars to the Top
2389925.description: Three years later, she returns to the stage with a new identity, stunning everyone in a music competition with her original hits. Once a dismissed "washed-up singer," she rises to become a global "New Diva," proving her critics wrong. Finally, she stands on the international stage, completing a magnificent journey from rock bottom to the peak of stardom.
2389925.originName: 陆机长，姜小姐乘风而行

2390034.title: I Slashed the Tires, Only to Realize It Was My House on Fire
2390034.description: Bai Xiaolan leaves her child home alone to go gambling, leading to a fire started by the child playing with a lighter. When fire trucks arrive, they are blocked by her car illegally parked in front of a hydrant. She returns late and curses at the crowd, only to discover the burning house is hers—and her son is trapped inside.
2390034.originName: 轮胎我都扎完了，你说着火的是我家

2390159.title: The Cute Commander: Mommy and Daddy, Let's Reconcile
2390159.description: After a heartbroken one-night stand with Lu Siqi, Jiang Qingyu leaves and raises their daughter, Xiaotang, alone. Five years later, Xiaotang's rare blue eyes lead a friend to suspect she is Lu Siqi's child. While searching for the mystery woman from his past, Lu Siqi encounters the mother and daughter and falls in love with them without realizing their true identity. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and the family reunites.
2390159.originName: 萌系指挥官：爹地妈咪请和好

2390300.title: You Stole My Identity, I Destroy Your Life
2390300.description: Heiress He Yitong is kidnapped at her engagement banquet, but luckily saved by Mu Qiubai. While unconscious, her soul leaves her body and she discovers that her best friend, Liu Banxue, is the mastermind behind it all. After waking up, Yitong decides to reclaim her life. With Mu Qiubai's help, she weakens Banxue's power through strategic schemes. However, a desperate Banxue kidnaps Yitong's father to blackmail her. Tragically, He's father loses his life during the incident, and Banxue perishes in a fire. In the aftermath, everything begins to improve as Yitong and Qiubai's relationship grows deeper.
2390300.originName: 你抢我身份，我毁你一切

2390404.title: Beautiful Time With You
2390404.description: Lin Xingchen is an ordinary transfer student who seems to be a magnet for bad luck. Her new school life starts with a series of disasters: a misunderstanding with her cold top-student seatmate, Lu Yibai; getting hit by a falling plaque during her introduction; and even her chair breaking in class. Despite being labeled the school's "Jinx," Xingchen remains optimistic and kind-hearted. Her warmth and resilience eventually melt the icy heart of Lu Yibai.

2390465.title: The Saleswoman's Secret
2390465.description: To sell a luxury mansion, saleswoman Bai Xue targets Huang Yurui, a businessman with a failing marriage. As they grow closer, a dark secret emerges: it is all a trap set by Huang's wife, Li Qing. To be with her lover, Li Qing hired Bai Xue to seduce Huang and force him into a divorce with no assets. Discovering the plot, Huang teams up with Bai Xue to turn the tables. In the end, Li Qing pays the price for her treachery.

2390612.title: Charming Bad Boy Senior: Who Needs a First Love Anyway?
2390612.description: In high school, Tang Shuang mistook Lu Jianxing for her crush, Lin Yi, starting a misplaced obsession. Though she tried to stay away from him, her mother ended up renting a house from Lu's family. Living under the same roof, the two went from constant bickering to falling in love. But just as their romance blossomed, their parents suddenly announced they were getting married.
2390612.originName: 痞帅学长真香，谁还要白月光

2390721.title: Betrayed by In-Laws, Elevated by My Childhood Sweetheart
2390721.description: Li Ai is a hardworking wife, but her mother-in-law despises her for giving birth to a daughter. Her husband is a gambler and a cheat. Driven to the brink by her in-laws' extreme cruelty to force a second child, Li Ai finally files for divorce and fights back. During her journey, she reunites and falls in love with her childhood sweetheart, Shen Yichen. Together, they drive her brother-in-law out of the city and ensure her ex-husband and mother-in-law face the legal consequences of their actions.
2390721.originName: 婆家虐我千百遍，竹马扶我上青天成片

2390816.title: Mother-in-law Critically Ill, Husband Reunited with His First Love
2390816.description: Xiao Yu's peaceful life falls apart when her mother-in-law is hospitalized with a serious illness. Instead of helping, her husband, Jason, is busy rekindling his romance with his first love, spending his time at fancy restaurants and ignoring his family's crisis. Left to shoulder the burden alone, Xiao Yu feels abandoned and exhausted. Finally, she decides she can no longer endure it and confronts Jason, demanding he choose between his past flame and his family.
2390816.originName: 婆婆病危后，老公忙着和白月光一家团圆

2390965.title: The Villainous Mother-in-Law's Great Comeback
2390965.description: An Qionghua accidentally travels into a TV drama as a mean mother-in-law during her son An Lyuxin's wedding. She steps in to protect the bride, Qin Qing, from bullying, only to discover that her son is being manipulated by his friend, Bai Zhenzhen, to harm Qin Qing. An Qionghua soon uncovers a shocking truth: An Lyuxin is actually the secret child of Bai Zhenzhen and Zhao Moqian, while her real biological son is an employee named Zhang Shuwen. At the company’s annual gala, she exposes the plot and punishes the villains. She helps Qin Qing grow into a strong woman, and together with Zhang Shuwen, they take over the An Group. In the end, An Qionghua wakes up on her sofa in the real world, seeing that the drama has reached a happy conclusion.

2391033.title: The Heart Beyond Wealth
2391033.description: He Shuyun, a young widow, worked tirelessly to raise her son, Lu Junying, into a successful man. When she travels to the city to meet her daughter-in-law, Qian Xixi, she is mistaken for a mistress. Her daughter-in-law tears up their family photo and destroys her late husband's memento. Despite the humiliation, the kind mother-in-law endures it all. However, upon discovering the truth, the wicked daughter-in-law attempts to kill her to protect her social status. Little does she know that every evil deed has its consequences.

2391147.title: My Ex-Husband Regrets After the Divorce
2391147.description: Chen Xiao and Duan Yi's marriage began when the Duan Group was at its lowest point. Four years ago, the company was on the brink of bankruptcy. Chen Xiao gave up her beloved design career to save the business. With her sharp business sense and expert negotiation skills, she resolved crises and optimized management, leading the Duan Group back to the top of the industry.
2391147.originName: 签完离婚协议后，前夫后悔了

2391243.title: No Turning Back on the Misty Path
2391243.description: Yu Miao and Lu Zhuolin have been married for seven years. To save her husband's life, Yu Miao donated her bone marrow, leaving her own health in ruins. Despite her sacrifice, Lu Zhuolin heartlessly brings his pregnant mistress home and demands a divorce. After enduring relentless physical and emotional abuse and watching her world crumble, Yu Miao eventually ends her life in total despair.

2391391.title: Miss Qiao’s Heart is Gone
2391391.description: Qiao Yu-ning and Jiang Jian-chuan were separated by a family tragedy. Five years later, they meet again, but Jiang seeks revenge, believing she betrayed him. To save her sister, Yu-ning falls under Du Bin's control until Jiang’s grandmother helps her escape. When Du Bin and Liu Zhen-zhen plot against her, the truth is revealed, and Jiang rushes to her rescue. After facing life and death together, the villains are punished, and the two finally reunite.

2391474.title: The Cold Uncle's Obsessive Embrace
2391474.description: Born in the Imperial Academy of Music, a stunning beauty is sent to the Qi family as the eldest son's concubine to steal a secret document. While the eldest son is kind and her only comfort, she is terrified of the second son—the ruthless Commander of the Northern Court. Her mission is caught red-handed by him, forcing her to give up. However, despite her surrender, the cold commander refuses to let her go, keeping her under his constant and suffocating watch.

2391570.title: Faded Love: The Deep Regret
2391570.description: On her wedding day, Mu Wanqing was abandoned at the altar. Her only relative was imprisoned, and her family went bankrupt. She then discovered that her fiancé, Fu Yunshen, had stayed by her side only to destroy her family. Having lost everything, she finally woke up and chose to leave. Once she withdrew her love, Fu Yunshen realized his grave mistake, but it was already too late.

2391677.title: Family Overhears the Villain's Heart: I'm Editing the Script
2391677.description: In her past life, Song Tingshu was too naive and was framed to death by the fake heiress, Song Zhuoran. After being reborn, Tingshu binds with a 'Heart-Voice Cheat System.' By cleverly modifying Song Zhuoran’s inner thoughts, she exposes her lies to the entire family. Winning back her family's love, Tingshu dismantles Zhuoran’s schemes and embarks on a journey of revenge to rewrite her destiny.
2391677.originName: 全家偷听反派心声，我负责篡改

2391780.title: Surrounded by Villains, but I Have a Mental Illness
2391780.description: Song Qiao, recently released from a mental hospital, buys a new home only to find her neighbors are a family from hell. They enforce ridiculous rules in the group chat, banning all noise and pets, while dumping trash at her door and letting their bratty child urinate there. When Song Qiao tries to reason with them, she is met with insults and deliberate midnight noise. As she teeters on the brink of a mental breakdown, her emotional support dog becomes her only hope for staying calm.
2391780.originName: 全员恶人，但我有精神病

2391844.title: Back to the 80s: A Second Chance at Love
2391844.description: In his youth, Zhang Chuan was a gambler and a drunkard who abused his wife. After losing a heavy debt, he decided to sell his daughter, An'an. Driven to despair, his wife Lin Chunhua fled with their daughter but died in a landslide that night. Years later, Zhang Chuan dies in an accident and wakes up back on the very day his family died. This time, he vows to change their fate and protect his wife and child from ever suffering again.

2391933.title: If I Leave, It's Forever
2391933.description: With the full support of Mu Yao and her family, her childhood sweethearts graduated from top universities and became successful. After completing her secret mission, Mu Yao gave up the chance to return to her original world to marry Gu Jiarong. However, just as she becomes pregnant, the Mu family finds their long-lost biological daughter, Mu Lizhu.

2392032.title: Spring Flowers Bloom Again
2392032.description: Xu Hongmei, a wealthy heiress fleeing family conflict, is rescued by Zhang Dashan and his daughter, Ziwei. To repay them, Hongmei risks her life to save the sickly Ziwei and stays to raise her, eventually falling in love and marrying Dashan. Years later, after Dashan passes away, Ziwei grows up to be a talented but poor painter named Lu Zheying. Bullied by her cruel stepmother and brother, she is forced to marry an old official as his ninth concubine in just one month.

2392089.title: Karma: Good and Evil
2392089.description: Li Weiwei, a single mother, provides free noodles to migrant workers to pray for her sick daughter. While her kindness is initially welcomed, the workers soon begin to take it for granted. Manipulated by Cao Zhehua for petty gains, they turn on her, accusing her of being a greedy merchant and forcing her stall to close. Seeing their true ungrateful nature, Weiwei finds peace and decides to make a fresh start.

2392299.title: Requesting Landing, Please Approve
2392299.description: Captain Lu Nanming and Air Traffic Controller Zhou Shuzhan entered a contract marriage through an introduction, agreeing to divorce after one year. They pretend to be strangers at work while secretly flirting with each other. As the contract's end nears, Shuzhan struggles with her growing feelings, unaware that this entire marriage was actually Lu Nanming's long-planned scheme.

2392421.title: Faded Marriage
2392421.description: Shen Qingyu gave up her design dreams for her family, only to face her husband's affair, her in-laws' contempt, and her son's hatred. While everyone favored the mistress Meng Yun, only her daughter stayed by her side. After a decisive divorce, she returns to the design world as the top designer 'Mu Bai.' Winning a prestigious international award, she takes revenge on her ex-husband and his mistress, starting a new life with her daughter.

2392556.title: Unmasking the Lies of Love
2392556.description: Housewife Xue Long has been married for eight years, dedicating herself to her family only to be met with betrayal. After discovering her husband's affair and his theft of their marital assets, she embarks on a journey of revenge to protect her child and reclaim what is hers. With the help of her childhood friend, Wen Yu, she faces a dangerous path, proving that justice eventually prevails.

2392656.title: He Once Promised Forever
2392656.description: After his first love Su Le goes abroad, Qi Minrui marries Shen Shiqing for business. Shen is a devoted wife, but when Su Le returns, Shen steps aside. Tragedy strikes when Su Le kills Shen’s child. After uncovering the truth, a heartbroken Shen commits suicide. Realizing the truth too late, Qi sends Su Le to prison and ends his own life by jumping into the sea.

2392778.title: The Purpose of Our Marriage
2392778.description: Alvina is a gentle and naive girl, while Alex is a cold and mysterious man. When they get married, Alex shows no sign of happiness. Everything changes when a secret is revealed: Alex didn't marry Alvina for love, but as part of a carefully planned revenge.

2392878.title: Loving a Stranger Who Won't Return
2392878.description: Song Xien suffers from paranoia and obsessively chases Jiao Junyu, but he only sees her as a younger sister. After her confession becomes a burden, she decides to give up. Jiao Junyu realizes his true love for her and wins her back, but they are targeted by enemies. Following a dangerous incident, Xien's condition worsens and she tries to leave. Jiao Junyu gets into a car accident; Xien returns to help his law firm before leaving again. Eventually, Jiao Junyu finds her once more.

2392987.title: Miracle Baby from Heaven: Street Vendor Mommy, Please Sign for Delivery
2392987.description: Six years ago, Shen Yuwei, a part-time KTV worker, had a one-night stand with CEO Gu Huai. She gave birth to a daughter, but her father stole the baby and sold her to human traffickers. Shen Yuwei also lost her memory due to her father's domestic violence. Years later, Gu Huai has found their daughter, Gu Niannian, but could never find the mother. Believing she was a heartless woman who abandoned her child, he gave up the search.
2392987.originName: 天降萌宝：摆摊妈咪请签收成

2393075.title: Sweet Heartbeats
2393075.description: When intern Lin Xiaxia joins the Cardiology department, she discovers a mysterious sound through her stethoscope—the racing heartbeat of the cold genius surgeon, Gu Beichen. Every time she gets close, his heart skips a beat. Forced to partner up after a medical incident, Xiaxia discovers Gu's hidden warmth and a secret connection from ten years ago. Meanwhile, a mysterious diary predicts the future. As Xiaxia follows its lead, she realizes the truth is far more complex than it seems.

2393183.title: Perfect Entanglement
2393183.description: After being dumped by her boyfriend of ten years and framed by a classmate, Jiang Jinshu seeks revenge by dating her ex's uncle, Han Shangyan. During their time together, Han Shangyan falls in love with her and uncovers the truth about her past. At their wedding, Jiang Jinshu clears her name and realizes that Han Shangyan was her true childhood playmate all along.

2393311.title: The Fatal Trap
2393311.description: On a rainy night, Lu Yuan killed An Yao and framed his drunk girlfriend, Song Yan, leading to her five-year imprisonment. After her release, An Yao’s brother, An Yang, and her fiancé, Ji Congzhou, sought revenge on Song Yan. While trying to make amends, Song Yan discovered that Lu Yuan was the true killer. Despite his attempts to obstruct and humiliate her, she teamed up with Ji Congzhou to expose the truth. They eventually lured Lu Yuan into a trap where he confessed his crimes. With justice served, Song Yan and Ji Congzhou found healing and redemption in each other's arms, starting a new life together.

2393440.title: I Once Met You in the Wind
2393440.description: The emotional struggle between assistant Yu Ning and her boss Shen Chengmin begins after an accidental night together. A loan for her mother's illness leads to a misunderstanding, and despite their secret marriage and child, Yu Ning is framed by a rival and driven away due to a fake paternity test. Years later, Yu Ning returns with her son while suffering from a terminal illness, as the long-hidden truth slowly comes to light.

2393551.title: Riding the Waves in the 90s with Massive Hits
2393551.description: In her past life, Xu Meng abandoned her family for fame, becoming a music diva but dying alone of cancer. Reborn with deep regret, she vows to make amends to her husband, Qin Hao, and their daughter. Discovering that Qin Hao once took out high-interest loans to support her dreams, she sets aside her pride and works as a bar singer to pay the debt. Using her knowledge of future hit songs, she is discovered by record labels, rewriting her tragic past while chasing her dreams once more.
2393551.originName: 我带着海量金曲在90年代乘风破浪

2393616.title: My Peerless Sister
2393616.description: Wen Qin, the legendary War God of Daxia, is feared by enemies at home and abroad. On her sister Wen Yiqiao's birthday, Wen Qin decides to pay her a surprise visit after years of separation. However, she arrives only to find her beloved sister being bullied and humiliated. Infuriated, Wen Qin takes swift action to crush the oppressors and protect her family.

2393726.title: I'm Already Dead, So Who Is Your Affection For?
2393726.description: The story follows the failing marriage of Shang Nianci and Xi Nanyuan. After mistress Lin Qingwan intervenes, Nianci suffers through domestic cold violence while battling brain cancer. Following a series of tragedies—including being forced to kneel in apology and her father’s death in a car accident—she finally passes away after giving birth to her daughter post-divorce. Only then does Xi Nanyuan discover the truth and fall into a pit of regret.
2393726.originName: 我都死了，你深情给谁看

2393863.title: Burying My Love in the Deep Sea
2393863.description: The love story of designer Peng Huiling and marine biologist Lin Yuxuan is like an epic painting. While Huiling's inspiration is as powerful as a tsunami, Yuxuan's knowledge is as vast as the ocean. They meet by fate and fall deeply in love, but misunderstandings soon tear them apart. Huiling is left to struggle in her career alone, while Yuxuan feels lost in his scientific research.

2393942.title: Lucky Queen: Rising with My Flash-Marriage Husband
2393942.description: Xu Zhiwei supported Lu Sinian for seven years, only to find he secretly married another woman and plotted to steal her company shares. Little did he know, his success came from her extraordinary luck. Leaving him behind, she enters a flash marriage with his rival, Shen Yan. As Shen’s business flourishes, Lu’s empire crumbles, leaving him in deep regret.
2393942.originName: 我用气运带飞闪婚老公

2394091.title: Reborn Before the Massacre
2394091.description: I was reborn just ten minutes before my family was murdered. Three fugitives have already broken into our home while my father, a forest ranger, remains unaware. In my past life, I watched my family die and spent the rest of my life disabled and filled with regret. This time, I will save them.

2394141.title: Once Like Snowflakes
2394141.description: Zhao Xuehua discovers she has a massive inheritance. Worried that her family won't be able to inherit it after her death, she asks her husband, Li Minglang, to officially register their marriage. Instead, he insults her and refuses to let her spend money on a life-saving surgery. After seeing the true colors of her husband and children, she decides to give up on them. When the family finally learns about the fortune, they are filled with deep regret.

2394223.title: Descendant of the Mountain: The 4-Year-Old Lucky Star
2394223.description: Saved by a Taoist priest at age one, Gu Zhizhi descends the mountain three years later to find her father and change her fate. She reunites with her father, Gu Tingyuan, but faces a conspiracy from her stepmother and stepbrother, who swap DNA tests and use a blood curse on her great-grandmother. Initially expelled, Zhizhi is brought back after a true test proves her identity. Returning to the family, she uses her powers to solve crises and uncover a shocking secret.
2394223.originName: 下山改命，四岁萌崽竟是满级锦鲤

2394369.title: The Little Temple Master Is Not to Be Messed With
2394369.description: Old Master Qin is in a coma, and no medical treatment can wake him. Seeking help, the family turns to Qingyun Temple. The Grand Master senses that little Dingbao's fate is tied to the Qin family, so he sends her there to break her deadly curse. Meanwhile, the butler conspires with Qin Weihao to seize the family fortune. At the critical moment, Dingbao uses her powers to save the Qin family.

2394477.title: Don't Run, School Beauty! I Have a Request
2394477.description: After dying in the streets, Lin Hao travels back to the past. In his previous life, he was framed for sleeping with the school beauty Ye Shuying, leading to his family's ruin by the Ye family. This time, he saves her and wins her heart. Meanwhile, his wife from his past life, Shen Qingge, enters his life again and unexpectedly falls for him once more. Caught between the pursuit of two beautiful women, Lin Hao finds himself in a mix of pain and joy.

2394560.title: False Alarm! You're Done, Mr. Pei!
2394560.description: Qiao Xi is a struggling actress neglected by her husband and bullied by her mother-in-law. After being diagnosed with terminal leukemia with only 3 months to live, she decides to stop being a doormat and starts getting even with everyone. Surprisingly, her sudden transformation catches her cold husband's eye. Little does she know, the life-altering medical report was actually her husband's doing.
2394560.originName: 虚惊一场！姓裴的你完了

2394697.title: Shh! The Adorable Baby is in Charge
2394697.description: Lin Yi gives birth to the eldest granddaughter of the Shen family. According to tradition, the third-generation granddaughter inherits 50% of the Shen Group's shares. Jealous of the infant’s wealth, the adopted daughter Shen Xiyao and the powerless Father Shen plot to seize the inheritance. Amidst the danger, the newborn baby discovers she can communicate telepathically with Lin Yi. Using this power, Lin Yi, her child, and Mother Shen escape every trap, eventually exposing the villains and sending them to prison to protect the family’s happiness.

2394768.title: My Mystic Wife Arrives: Hubby, Catch Me!
2394768.description: Ye Susu, a long-lost heiress raised in an orphanage, was trained by a master in the mountains. After mastering mystical arts, she returns home to find her family. To survive a fated curse, she must marry Huo Jinxiu, a man with a 'Pure Yang' body. Despite an initial misunderstanding, Jinxiu eventually falls for her and helps find her long-lost brother. Together, they defeat the villain Huo Xingzhi, securing the family’s peace and living happily ever after.

2394830.title: Senior, Can I Be Your Co-pilot?
2394830.description: Wen Nuan is the youngest female captain at Yunxiao Airlines. A tragic plane crash ends her life prematurely. In her final moments, her only regret is never confessing her love to Song Huaiqian, the man who adopted her. Having grown up under his care, she developed deep feelings for him, but their fate was destined to be a missed connection.
2394830.originName: 学姐，我可以做你的副机长吗

2394892.title: Coming Home with Pear Blossoms
2394892.description: Xia Xueli, a wealthy heiress, was betrayed by her adoptive family and imprisoned. After her release, she joins forces with Shao Rongxuan to seek revenge. While uncovering the truth behind her mother's death and reclaiming her family business, she falls in love with Shao and starts her new life as a top designer.

2394992.title: Bond of the Heart
2394992.description: As Shen Yanqiu and Lin Manyan prepare for their wedding, Shen's adoptive mother, Shen Fang, travels to the city to attend. On her way, she is mistaken for a thief by Lin's parents. To avoid ruining the wedding, Shen Fang stays silent. During the ceremony, the Lin family humiliates her, but Shen Yanqiu witnesses the abuse. Amid the argument, a fallen phone reveals the truth, changing everything.

2395085.title: No One Told Me a Female CEO Would Chase Me After Being Dumped
2395085.description: Security guard Chu Han and female CEO Ning Keke accidentally swap bodies, leading to a hilarious role reversal. While Chu Han deals with workplace bullying in Ning's shoes, Ning uses her corporate power to protect him, and the two gradually fall in love. When Ning’s company faces a major financial crisis and land grab, Chu Han uses mystic arts taught by his grandfather to defeat business rivals, save the company, and prove his true worth.
2395085.originName: 也没人说被甩之后会有女总裁倒追啊

2395230.title: Healing Grace: Nanxing's Journey
2395230.description: Wang Nanxing was mistreated by her uncle's family since childhood. After a kind gesture, she is adopted by Chen Guizhi and joins the Ling family's medical clinic to study and promote imperial medical culture. In the clinic, she faces jealousy and framing from her cousin and a colleague, Huang Qin. However, Ling Xiao, the son of the family and chairman of the clinic, firmly supports and protects Nanxing, helping her clear her name and fixing the clinic's internal issues.

2395373.title: Into the Trap
2395373.description: While in critical condition during labor, Ren Shuyu calls her husband, Mai Yanzhe, for help, only to overhear him flirting with another woman. He heartlessly reveals he has stolen her company's assets and leaves her to die. After dying in despair, Ren Shuyu is reborn and begins a cold-blooded plan to make them pay for their betrayal.

2395510.title: Cherished as a Treasure
2395510.description: Old Qiao, a bachelor from Dahe Village, found an abandoned baby girl in a scrapyard and named her Qiao Xin. He raised her with love and supported her education. Twenty-five years later, Qiao Xin has become a successful CEO. As Old Qiao’s memory begins to fail, he travels to the city to find her, only to be bullied by fellow villager Lin Yuanshan and his daughter. Qiao Xin steps in to protect him, revealing her powerful status to her father. Just as they begin to enjoy a peaceful life together, Qiao Xin’s biological father suddenly appears...

2395582.title: Lantern Night: A Taste of Justice
2395582.description: To seek justice for her late husband Shi Qin, Yan Xiangyu overcomes countless hardships to expose the greed and power struggles within the Shi family. What began as a quest for revenge ends in forgiveness and liberation. Instead of being consumed by anger, she chooses to let go and honor Shi Qin's memory through the culinary arts he loved, spreading a message of love and peace.
2395582.originName: 元宵节当夜，我以绝味还夫愿

2395664.title: Thorns of the Cloud Rose
2395664.description: Feng Yuchen broke up with Shen Anran due to a misunderstanding in college. Three years later, they reunite at Haisheng Airlines, where he treats her with coldness and humiliation. Heartbroken, Anran is pursued by her childhood friend Jiang Yaochen. When the truth finally comes to light, a regretful Feng Yuchen tries to win her back. Despite the schemes of his contract ex-girlfriend Li Suyan, including cyberbullying and a kidnapping crisis, Feng Yuchen risks his life to protect Anran, eventually leading to their reconciliation.

2395807.title: Clouds Fade into Rain: My Deep Love for Him (Formerly: The Wicked Supporting Actress Loves the Hero Too Much)
2395807.description: Famous actress Gu Nansheng discovers in a dream that she is the villainous supporting character in a novel. In the story, she pesters her husband, Mo Jingyi, and eventually dies in poverty after her family's ruin. She didn't believe it until Mo Jingyi met the story's true heroine and asked for a divorce.

2395920.title: Crash Landing into Your Heart
2395920.description: An Ran worked hard to build a life in Beijing, but was betrayed by her boyfriend and sister at the peak of her career. She decided to cut ties with them and focus solely on her work. After saving the mother of Lu Chen, a famous pilot, the two entered a flash marriage. Lu Chen is a responsible and caring husband who secretly protects her. Just as An Ran finds success in both love and career, Lu Chen’s "fiancée" appears, uncovering the secret of An Ran’s true identity.

2396047.title: Biased Father Favors Illegitimate Son, So I Left Home
2396047.description: Xiao Yu grew up in a seemingly happy family, but lived in the shadow of her father's neglect. Her father openly favored his illegitimate son from an affair, leaving Xiao Yu feeling ignored and unloved. After years of being sidelined at family gatherings, she finally reached her breaking point. One late night, she packed her bags and left home to start her own journey and find her true self.
2396047.originName: 渣爹偏心私生子，我叛出家门

2396128.title: The Husband's Cat and Mouse Game
2396128.description: Wealthy Jin Yufei married the beautiful Li Shuying two years ago. Despite his deep love, he discovers she is having an affair with her college sweetheart, Wan Li, meeting him secretly in a basement. Consumed by a desire for revenge, Jin Yufei hires a girl named Xia Hua to seduce Wan Li. While Xia Hua is attempting to lure Wan Li at his home, Jin Yufei arrives with his wife. The obvious familiarity between Jin Yufei and Xia Hua leaves Li Shuying deeply unsettled. Trapped in a web of desire and human nature, the four find themselves lost in an emotional vortex with no clear way out.

2396245.title: My Husband's Double Life
2396245.description: Dongxin Company is on the verge of bankruptcy due to outdated technology. Zhao Jingxuan, a company veteran, believes that only technical innovation can save the firm. He hears of Meng Shu, the world's top hacker, and decides to recruit him. After discovering Meng Shu's interest in niche art, Zhao frequents art exhibitions and eventually wins his heart. Following their marriage, Meng Shu joins the company as R&D Director, leading the team to overcome technical hurdles and successfully taking the company public.

2396322.title: Fortune's Arrival: The Little Lucky Star Crashes In
2396322.description: As Shen Yanqiu and Lin Manman prepare for their wedding, Shen's adoptive mother, Shen Fang, travels from the countryside to attend. On her way, she is mistaken for a thief by Lin's parents. To avoid ruining the wedding, Shen Fang hides the truth. However, at the ceremony, Lin's family bullies her. Shen Yanqiu witnesses the abuse, and during the confrontation, a fallen phone reveals the evidence that will bring the truth to light.
2396322.originName: 招财进宝，小小福星闯进门

2396526.title: Just Two Minutes Short
2396526.description: On his way to work, Li Zheng tries to save Madam Wu, who has suffered a sudden medical emergency. However, his exit is blocked by a luxury car owner, Zhao Xiaoxia, who refuses to move and demands $88,000 for a minor scratch. Ironically, the woman dying in Li's arms is actually Zhao's own mother-in-law. Although Zhao eventually realizes the truth through her mother's weak cry, the two-minute delay puts everyone's conscience on trial.

2396650.title: No Family Feast for Mid-Autumn
2396650.description: Qian Xiaomei, owner of a housekeeping company, has spent her life being exploited by her birth family to pay off her brother's gambling debts. At the Mid-Autumn family dinner, faced with her sister-in-law's mockery, her brother's betrayal, and her father's coldness, she finally sees the truth. With her children's support, she cuts ties, focuses on her career, and starts a new life.

2396768.title: Kissing My Sweet Wife 99 Times
2396768.description: To escape her marriage to the eldest young master of the Chu family, the eldest daughter Su Yuexi forces her sister Su Qingning to marry in her place. On her wedding night, Su Qingning encounters the second young master Chu Jinghuai, leading to a complex web of family feuds and emotional conflicts.

2396820.title: One Thought of Marriage
2396820.description: Qin Shuwan, a talented film director, married her long-time crush Jiang Chen through an arranged business marriage. After years of a cold, respectful marriage, she finally gave up when his first love returned. Faking her death while battling cancer abroad, she returns years later with a prestigious international award and a new identity, only to become entangled with Jiang Chen once again.

2396951.title: Solo Fishing in the Autumn Mist
