2396951.description: Three years ago, the Fishing God Wu Gang was saved by Jiang Yuyan. To repay her, he worked as a handyman at her club. Now, the Flying Fish Club is on the brink of bankruptcy. Jiang Yuyan tries to secure investment but is sabotaged by three masters sent by Jiang Yulang. In the end, Wu Gang helps Yuyan win the 'Dragon-Fish Battle,' saving the club and revealing his true identity as the Fishing God, shocking everyone.

2397057.title: Chasing the Moonlight to You
2397057.description: Xia Nanwei, a legendary doctor, dies unexpectedly while catching her cheating husband. She is reborn in ancient times as an overweight wife with five clever children. Trapped in a greedy General’s mansion, she plans her escape, only to run into the Regent—the biological father of her kids and the man who once wanted her dead! How will Xia Nanwei use her wit and medical skills to turn the tides and conquer her new life?

2397151.title: CEO Husband, Please Remarry Me
2397151.description: To pay for her mother's surgery, Gu Nansheng enters a 5-year contract marriage with CEO Ouyang Sen. After their divorce, Ouyang Sen tries to win her back, but they face constant schemes from Lin Wenxu, who caused a car accident years ago to frame her. Ouyang Sen divorced her to protect her from these threats. Now, as they face public humiliation and danger, Gu Nansheng must navigate the conspiracies while Ouyang Sen secretly protects her.

2397202.title: Rebirth of the Guilty Wife
2397202.description: Shen Yan, a domineering CEO, and his beautiful wife, Wen Luan, were meant to be a perfect couple. However, due to the schemes of another woman who loves Shen Yan, misunderstandings grow between them. As Wen Luan suffers from these false accusations, her love for him fades as they drift apart. When the truth finally comes to light, Shen Yan is filled with regret, but he finds it nearly impossible to win back the love he once had.

2397280.title: Drunk in Love with You
2397280.description: After getting drunk and stumbling into the wrong room, Yue Qing meets a mysterious stranger. The next day, she is shocked to find that her new handsome boss is the very same man! Fearing for her job, she is called into his office after a meeting. Instead of being fired, the CEO asks her with a hurt expression, 'Why have you been ignoring me?'

2397337.title: Little Happiness of Love
2397337.description: Xia Chuyi, an orphan who grew up in a foster home, regards Director Su Lin as her own mother. During college, she was saved from thugs by Qi Yuchen and fell deeply in love with him. Later, she was framed and spent a night with him while drunk, with photos taken as evidence. Believing she climbed into his bed for money and used the photos to blackmail him, Qi Yuchen enters a relationship with her only to torment her. Out of love, Chuyi endures his repeated hurt and cruelty.

2397433.title: The Fourth Winter Night of Loving You
2397433.description: After his girlfriend of three years, Su Jingyi, left him without a word, Gu Hanchen married Ye Wanqiu out of spite. Wanqiu hoped her tenderness would eventually melt his heart. Even though she was treated like a servant by the family and received no affection from him, she remained without regret. However, the return of his ex-girlfriend completely shatters her last bit of hope.

2397529.title: Love Fades with the Wind
2397529.description: Su Yao is an artist who lost her direction due to the pressures of life. By chance, she meets Lin Yuxuan, a passionate musician dedicated to his dreams. They form a deep bond through their shared love for art, but fate and misunderstandings eventually drive them apart.

2397601.title: Love in a cloudless sky
2397601.description:
“Love in a Clear Sky” is a heartwarming urban romance brimming with emotional entanglements. The female lead, Chen Yin, is a gentle yet resilient woman who maintains a respectful and harmonious relationship with her husband. Yet, after three years of marriage, the couple remains childless, gradually straining their marriage and family dynamics. Her mother-in-law’s constant urging, her father’s worry, and her husband’s silence all weigh heavily on her. Meanwhile, Chen Yin’s father—a successful but somewhat stubborn man—has long harbored dissatisfaction with his daughter’s marriage, believing she should not have sacrificed the future of the family business for love. Still, the bond between father and daughter runs deep: they care for each other deeply yet find it hard to let go of their grievances.

At the heart of the story lies Chen Yin’s struggle to balance family, marriage, and personal growth. She must confront the pressures from her in-laws, navigate the emotional distance with her husband, and work to mend her relationship with her father. As the plot unfolds, Chen Yin comes to realize that true happiness does not lie in endlessly catering to others’ expectations, but in learning to listen to her own heart. The series blends delicate emotional portrayals with lighthearted, everyday moments, offering profound reflections on family, love, and personal choices in modern urban life. Audiences will follow Chen Yin as she seeks answers in the face of adversity and discovers the true meaning of love in the ordinary rhythms of daily life.

2397666.title: Please, Mr. Gu, Stop Loving Me
2397666.description: Gu Jinmo and Xia Yunxi fell in love in college, but his mother forced them apart. To save him, Yunxi left with harsh words. Years later, she returns as a professional, only to find her first client is Gu Jinmo. Harboring deep resentment, Gu seeks revenge while caught in scandals with another woman. Heartbroken by his coldness, Yunxi leaves again. Only then does Gu discover the hidden truth behind her departure, leaving him in deep regret.

2397728.title: Stuck with the Wealthy Heir
2397728.description: Su Xiaonuan, an ordinary girl, accidentally saves the wealthy heir Lu Tingchen, only to be mistaken for a business spy. Forced into a contract marriage, she discovers that the cold CEO is actually her long-lost childhood sweetheart. As family feuds entwine with childhood bonds, they grow closer while testing each other, unaware of a bigger conspiracy hidden behind their marriage.
2397728.originName: 被豪门哥哥看上怎么办

2397833.title: Escaping Love to Inherit My Family's Billions
2397833.description: Fu Yuanchuan blames the Ning family for his parents' suicide following their bankruptcy. Seeking revenge, he adopts Ning Mengmeng, the daughter of his 'traitor' Ning Tianyu, and raises her for thirteen years. As they grow closer, Mengmeng falls deeply in love and becomes his secret lover. However, Fu Yuanchuan soon betrays her by getting engaged to Ning Ziyan. Labeled as a mistress and subjected to endless humiliation, Mengmeng is determined to escape his control while searching for her true biological parents.
2397833.originName: 不谈恋爱，回家继承亿万家产

2397963.title: Never Let Your Love Down
2397963.description: Chi Jiayue has harbored a secret crush on Qi Jianshen for five years. Inspired by him, she enters the entertainment industry, only to cross paths with him at a banquet where he is drugged. In her attempt to save him, they spend an accidental night together. Forced by public pressure after their photos leak, Qi Jianshen enters a contract marriage with her. Though he initially treats her with cold contempt, her kindness begins to melt his heart. However, due to the schemes of the villainous Qin Wei, the misunderstandings deepen, leading a heartbroken Jiayue to a tragic miscarriage and death. Only then does Qi Jianshen discover the painful truth and the depth of his misunderstanding.

2398017.title: The Imperial Daughter
2398017.description: Modern actress Tu Cha accidentally travels into a book as a 5-year-old princess in a cold palace. Bound to a 'Child Rearing System' with only 7 days to live, she uses her sharp tongue and acting skills to survive the harem. She outsmarts the noble consort, saves the eldest princess, and heals the Emperor, turning him into a doting father. From a forsaken child to a national guardian, she uncovers the secrets of her birth and protects her loved ones.

2398085.title: The Return of the Dragon Son
2398085.description: After leaving the wealthy Chu family due to a fallout with his father, Chu Xiu marries Jiang Ruxue and becomes a son-in-law. Three years later, Jiang's ex-fiancé, Cai Baofa, returns to sabotage the family business. Chu Xiu steps up to resolve the internal power struggles and external threats, saving the company and eventually reclaiming his true identity to take over his family's empire.

2398216.title: The Stunning Return of My Ex-Girlfriend
2398216.description: Three years ago, he was a poor boy; now, he is a powerful CEO seeking to humiliate his 'gold-digging' ex-girlfriend. However, her true identity is actually a wealthy heiress! Lu Zheying, a genius painter from a humble background, was bullied by her family and nearly forced to marry an old man. To change her fate, she disguises herself as a fragile noblewoman to seduce young Master Lin Mo, hoping to reach the Imperial Art Academy. But her plan draws the suspicion of his powerful brother, Nangong Yi, who views her as a calculating social climber. Meanwhile, a real princess constantly targets and bullies her.
2398216.originName: 分手后，前女友惊艳归来

2398331.title: Hidden Billionaire's Rise
2398331.description: To avoid pressuring Shu Qing, Ren Xiaoyao hides his true identity and supports her behind the scenes until she becomes a star. Believing her success is entirely her own, Shu Qing divorces him. Ren Xiaoyao then returns to his powerful family. Hearing the news, heiress Ye Jiaxin flies to him to propose. As Ren Xiaoyao uncovers the truth behind his mother's death, Ye Jiaxin stays by his side, helping him take revenge on the Lei family and revealing his extraordinary true status.

2398402.title: Phoenix Above the Nine Heavens
2398402.description: Su Shiwan, the noble 9th Princess of the Zhou Dynasty, escapes the palace to find her lover, Qin Yuchuan, who disappeared three years ago. However, when they reunite, he insults her as a gold-digger who sold her body for money. With the support of her brother, the Crown Prince, Shiwan proudly reveals her identity as a princess, leaving Qin Yuchuan filled with deep regret.

2398499.title: Madam, President Lu Has Fallen
2398499.description: Lu Yanting blames Song Guan for the death of his ex-girlfriend, Su Ran, and subjects her to long-term mental torment and revenge. Despite Song Guan's claims of innocence, she is left isolated and endures both physical and mental suffering. As the truth gradually comes to light, their relationship undergoes a dramatic turning point.

2398599.title: The Madam's White Moonlight
2398599.description: Fu Mingchuan is haunted by the memory of his first love, Qu Chenxi, who died in a plane crash. When he meets An Qinyi, who looks exactly like her, he uses money and marriage to keep her by his side. Over time, he truly falls for An Qinyi. To push her away, he fakes an affair to force a divorce, yet she refuses to leave. After an argument leads to a near-miscarriage, a guilt-ridden Fu Mingchuan decides to reconcile. However, a mysterious recording surfaces, revealing hidden secrets about An Qinyi's true motives for being with him.

2398731.title: A Father's Mission
2398731.description: Yu Beiping is an ordinary but resilient father whose life is turned upside down when his daughter suddenly goes missing. To save her, he must plunge into danger and face off against powerful forces. In this battle of wits and courage, Yu Beiping must overcome dark conspiracies while facing a crisis of identity and the ultimate test of family bonds.

2398812.title: The Scheming Adopted Daughter
2398812.description: Jing Yu works as a maid in the Mu family to avenge her parents, enduring their disdain. When the eldest son, Mu Lingfeng, returns, they become romantically involved and sleep together after she is drugged. Meanwhile, Madam Mu is having an affair, poisoning Master Mu, and plotting to marry the second daughter to her lover. At the wedding, Jing Yu exposes the evidence. Lingfeng intervenes, revealing he is not the biological son of the Mu family. In the end, Lingfeng and Jing Yu get married.

2398931.title: The Mask of Lies
2398931.description: Lu Yao thought marrying into a wealthy family would bring her happiness, but her husband, Gu Mingcheng, soon revealed his twisted nature. Traumatized by his mother's death, he controls and abuses Lu Yao under the guise of love. Desperate, Lu Yao escapes and undergoes plastic surgery with the help of Dr. Huo Chen. However, she soon discovers that her new face is the exact likeness of the doctor's deceased wife, Shen Shuya.

2398984.title: Dark Moonlight
2398984.description: Song Wanqing and Luo Hao were high school sweethearts who built a happy marriage. However, everything changed when Luo Hao’s sister, Luo Xue, moved in. Their intimacy felt more like lovers than siblings. To uncover the truth, Wanqing installed hidden cameras, only to discover a shocking secret: Luo Hao married her just to use her as a surrogate to have a child. He planned to kick her out with nothing to make way for Luo Xue. Heartbroken and betrayed, Wanqing begins her cold-blooded revenge.

2399132.title: Captain, Please Sign the Divorce Paper
2399132.description: Ling Zhimo treats his wife Qiao Nianchu coldly after his first love, Su Jinyue, returns to the country. Su Jinyue sabotages Qiao's career, but the truth is she is pregnant with Ling's brother's child—a secret Ling keeps, leading Qiao to demand a divorce. During a flight, Qiao survives a crash but loses her unborn baby. When Ling leaves her again for Su at her lowest moment, they finally divorce. Eventually, Su's schemes are exposed, and Ling desperately chases Qiao back until they reconcile.

2399230.title: Mr. Ji Realizes His Mistake
2399230.description: Five years ago, to save his family business, Mr. Ji married a woman who loved him at first sight in exchange for funding. After five years of her devoted care, their peaceful life is shattered when Mr. Ji's ex-girlfriend returns. Her constant schemes lead to deeper misunderstandings and pain between the couple.

2399376.title: Back from the Dead: The Sinner Shocks the World
2399376.description: Su Wantang, the brilliant leader of the powerful Qianji Alliance, fell in love with Xie Yun while defending her country. To protect him, she married him under the alias Shu Wan. However, on their wedding day, she was framed for murdering the Alliance Leader (herself) by a jealous rival. Betrayed by Xie Yun and despised by the public, she endured horrific abuse. When she finally reveals her true identity, the world is stunned to learn that the "sinner" they mistreated is actually the legendary leader they revere.
2399376.originName: 假死归来，罪妇惊艳了全天下

2399426.title: Innocent Wife
2399426.description: When wealthy socialite Su Wan is accused of murdering her husband, all evidence points to her. Top lawyer Lin Mo takes on the case, but as he digs deeper, he uncovers shocking secrets hidden beneath Su Wan's gentle exterior. With the real killer still in the shadows, who is truly innocent in this battle of love and law?

2399550.title: Shock! My Gold-digging Girlfriend is a Chaebol Heiress
2399550.description: Yun Shuang, the granddaughter of Asia's richest man, is a hopeless romantic despite her elite background. To find her missing ex-boyfriend Qin Ye, she rejects an arranged marriage and secretly returns home. Disguised as an ordinary employee to inspect a branch office, she draws the suspicion of her colleague Yuan Tian. Her grandfather, Yun Maosheng, is furious upon learning of her escape and vows to bring her back, while her coworkers gossip incessantly about her true identity.
2399550.originName: 惊！拜金女友竟是财阀千金

2399635.title: Dragon Lord of Kyushu
2399635.description: Lu Jiu, a struggling antique dealer, awakens the ancient Dragon Lord bloodline after discovering a mysterious jade pendant. Forced into a thousand-year supernatural war, he discovers that the cold female CEO, Su Mingyue, is the reincarnation of his sworn enemy. As they navigate a complex bond, they uncover a conspiracy threatening to destroy the world. Will their reunion repeat a tragic past or rewrite the fate of the three realms?

2399702.title: The Puppet Wife
2399702.description: On her wedding day, Su Yuan is betrayed by her sister and fiancé, becoming a laughingstock. In despair, she marries a mysterious security guard, unaware that he is actually Lu Chenzhou, the wealthiest man in Hong Kong! Can she complete her revenge, reclaim what is hers, and find true love? Meanwhile, a girl of lowly birth poses as the Crown Princess, getting caught in a power struggle. Who is the mastermind behind the scenes? An epic palace drama of a fake princess is about to unfold!

2399753.title: Regret After Divorce: My Ex-Husband's Remorse
2399753.description: The story begins with a tragic wedding incident involving Shu Ran and Lu Jingchen. On their wedding day, Lu Jingchen's brother falls to his death, and Shu Ran is wrongly accused of murder. Forced to kneel and repent in the mourning hall, she discovers she has terminal heart failure and is pregnant. However, she cannot keep the baby due to her condition, and she has only two months left to live.

2399823.title: Destitute Girlfriend 2: Bound by Marriage
2399823.description: Xu Ye, a modern young man, accidentally travels back in time to the Jing Dynasty and becomes the son-in-law of the wealthy Bai family, marrying the heir, Bai Qingmeng. Caught in a feud between the Bai and Lu families, Xu Ye uses innovative modern business ideas to foil the Lu family's schemes and stabilize the Bai family's business. Despite being pursued by Lin Caiwei, the Prefect's daughter, Xu Ye and Bai Qingmeng's relationship deepens, evolving from a marriage of convenience into a true connection of hearts.
2399823.originName: 落魄女友二之已婚相许

2399914.title: Max-Level Metaphysics Master: Divine Predictions Online
2399914.description: After failing her cultivation tribulation, a metaphysics master transmigrates into Sang Feiwan, a girl heartlessly abandoned and framed as a stalker fan by her superstar ex-boyfriend, Zhang Chengye. Upon awakening, she uses her profound powers to expose Zhang’s hypocrisy and gather evidence of his betrayal. By live-streaming her precise predictions, she becomes a viral 'Lucky Goddess,' clearing her name and making her ex pay for his cruelty.
2399914.originName: 满级玄学锦鲤，在线神预测

2400038.title: When the Jasmine Blooms
2400038.description: Song Moli discovers she is merely a substitute for Li Shaohua's childhood sweetheart, Xu Yingxia, and decides to divorce him. Li Shaohua realizes he has already fallen in love with Moli and feels deep regret. Driven by hatred, Xu Yingxia attempts to harm Moli, but Shaohua is injured in a car accident while saving her. Eventually, Xu Yingxia is imprisoned, and Moli chooses to move abroad with her son, Li Jin.

2400170.title: Stop, Mr. Mo! Your Wife is Gone
2400170.description: After the death of his wife Su Wan, business tycoon Mo Chenzhou falls into a life of despair and alcoholism. One day, a woman named Lin Xiaoman appears, looking exactly like his late wife. As he frantically searches for the truth, he falls into a revenge trap. He discovers that the car accident three years ago was no accident, and Su Wan’s 'return' hides a shocking secret. In a game of love and hate, who will be the final winner?
2400170.originName: 墨先生别这样，夫人她死了

2400290.title: A Mother's Regret
2400290.description: Qin Lan has searched for her son for 20 years, unaware that he is Zhang Chen, an employee at her own branch office. During an inspection, she catches him sleeping and, misled by a villainous coworker, fires him as a slacker, not knowing he is a genius hacker. When the truth finally comes out, she is devastated to realize she failed to recognize her own son.

2400355.title: The CEO's Hidden Billionaire Husband
2400355.description: Su Chen, a live-in son-in-law mocked by his family, is secretly a legendary billionaire. His wife, CEO Lin Ruoxue, faces a business crisis caused by the villainous Wu Xin, who covets both her beauty and the family wealth. While Ruoxue neglects Su Chen due to work, he eventually reveals his immense power and connections to crush his rivals, save the business, and protect their marriage.

2400472.title: Obsessive CEO, Let Me Go
2400472.description: Mu Xiyan and Fu Jingyi were deeply in love and set to marry when Fu's family business faced bankruptcy. Lu Huaishen, Fu's rival, offered Xiyan 50 million to save the company on one condition: she must dump Fu and cut all contact for two years. Knowing how much the business meant to Fu, Xiyan sacrificed her love and agreed to leave him.

2400544.title: Seven Years of Love: A Long Road
2400544.description: Xiao Mengxi, a top female pilot, and movie star Zhou Jingan have been together since high school. They have been secretly married for seven years while pursuing their dreams. Due to their secret, colleagues believe Mengxi is with Captain Jiang Lingyuan, while Zhou is constantly surrounded by scandals. Despite her sacrifices and devotion, the distance and suspicion of the 'seven-year itch' take a toll. When a scheming woman named Qin Kexin interferes, their marriage hits a breaking point. Taking off her ring, Mengxi says, 'Zhou Jingan, let’s end this.'

2400656.title: Billion-Dollar Bride: Mr. Shen, Don't Run Away
2400656.description: In her past life, Yun Jingran was betrayed by Song Yanche and Lin Wanyi, losing both her fortune and her life. After being reborn, she pretends to transfer her assets to Song, but secretly marries Shen Mucheng and secures her wealth with him instead. Left with nothing, Song and Lin attempt to kidnap her for ransom, only to be outsmarted and handed over to the police. Through their daily life together, Yun Jingran falls for Shen Mucheng, realizing he has loved her for many years. The two eventually find their happily ever after.

2400719.title: Ex-Wife's Revenge: Stop Chasing Me, Mr. Si
2400719.description: Chu Youxia, the CEO of Chu Group, gave up her career for a three-year marriage to Si Lvheng, only to face mistreatment from her mother-in-law and neglect from her husband. When Si's first love returns, he demands a divorce. Heartbroken, Chu Youxia returns to the business world, transforming into a powerful rival that Si can't defeat. As Si begins to regret his past actions, Chu Youxia already has a new man, Mu Xiao, by her side. This is a story of love, career, and the complicated paths of life.

2400842.title: My Sweet Little Wife
2400842.description: After the Xia family went bankrupt, Xia Xiaotian worked multiple jobs to pay for her critically ill mother's medical bills. Driven to desperation by the high costs, she decided to seek help from her betrothed fiancé, Ji Yunci, the CEO of Ji Group. After a chance encounter where Ji Yunci saved her from a difficult situation, Xiaotian mistook him for her arranged partner. Following a series of misunderstandings, the two quickly got married, beginning a sweet life of love after marriage.

2400920.title: Deep in the Heart of Memory
2400920.description: Lu Zheying, a talented but poor painter, is bullied by her stepfamily and forced to marry an old official as his ninth concubine. To change her fate, she disguises herself as a frail noblewoman to seduce Lin Mo, the young master of the influential Lin family, hoping to use his status to enter the Imperial Art Academy. Her schemes catch the attention of Lin Mo’s powerful brother, Nangong Yi, who views her as a social climber. Amidst harassment from a real princess, Lu Zheying’s plan to capture Lin Mo's heart takes an unexpected turn when she becomes magically bound to Nangong Yi by the 'Seven Emotions and Six Desires' curse.

2400990.title: The Almighty Madam at Work
2400990.description: Jewelry master Qiao Yue, using the alias Qiao Yanxin, marries tycoon Li Ruohan and joins a jewelry company as an intern. Despite helping a newcomer named Su Yan, the two become rivals. Su Yan often poses as the "new CEO's wife," leading to constant conflict. Qiao Yanxin relies on her professional design skills to overcome workplace challenges with the support of her husband. The story follows her journey of personal growth and professional success.

2401095.title: Boss, Stop It! I Just Want to Avoid Marriage
2401095.description: Lin Shangyu, the secret heir to a top wealthy family, was raised poor and has no idea of his true status. To stop his family's nagging, he looks for a date on a 'rent-a-girlfriend' app. Meanwhile, CEO Nangong Xue wants a child to escape an arranged marriage. When they meet, her arrogant fiancé clashes with Lin, sparking a series of hilarious events.
2401095.originName: 上司别闹，哥只想应付催婚

2401214.title: Prodigy Descends: Mommy, Your Best Days Are Coming
2401214.description: After stealing from a merit box, child prodigy Yuan Bao is sent down the mountain by a Daoist to find his mother. While writing Spring Festival couplets with his father, Chu Tianjiao, they are extorted by the Axe Gang, only to be saved by Song Qingci, who turns out to be Yuan Bao's long-lost mother. Song's brother tries to kidnap Yuan Bao to curry favor with a wealthy heir but is punished by the boy’s magic. To solve the family's financial crisis, Song Qingci enters a fake marriage and takes them to a jade gambling event, where Chu Tianjiao protects Yuan Bao from bullies.
2401214.originName: 神童下山，妈咪你的好日子来了

2401266.title: Mr. Shen, Please Repent
2401266.description: Gu Yaoyao and Shen Yunchen have been married for eight years. Shen only married her to fulfill his grandfather's wish, forcing his true girlfriend, Ye Qiangwei, to become his mistress. Resentful and cold, Shen even brings a pregnant Ye into their home. After Ye frames Gu for a staged miscarriage, Shen's retaliatory actions lead to Gu losing her own baby. While Shen publicly celebrates his relationship with Ye, a heartbroken Gu attempts suicide but is saved by Lin Xi. When the truth finally comes to light, a regretful Shen breaks up with Ye and begins a desperate journey to win Gu back.

2401319.title: The CEO's Pampered Wife
2401319.description: Tang Chuyi is forced to take her son to find his biological father, Zhan Jingxi, for help. They strike a deal: he helps her avoid a forced marriage, and in return, their son helps him dodge an unwanted political union. At a family banquet, when an aunt tries to bully Tang Chuyi, Zhan Jingxi steps in to protect his wife at the critical moment.

2401417.title: In the Depths of Time
2401417.description: Ten years ago, Shen Haonan entrusted his daughter, Shen Nanyi, to his junior, Gu Yungong. Over the decade, Gu’s devoted care led Nanyi to fall in love with him. Fearing he would lead her astray, Gu repeatedly pushed her away and even lied about having a fiancée. A heartbroken Nanyi left, leaving Gu to realize his feelings were far more than just family affection. Three years later, they meet again. The once innocent girl is now a successful career woman, and she has someone else by her side.

2401502.title: The Strongest War Emperor Ever
2401502.description: War Emperor Ye Wanping returns home in glory, only to find his wife and daughter brutally abused by powerful families. Enraged, he unleashes his supreme power and iron-fisted revenge to crush the corrupt elite, reshape the world order, and stage an epic 'one-man army' comeback.

2401601.title: The Grand Secretary's Deep Regret
2401601.description: Chu Qingqing, the daughter of a Duke, married Grand Secretary Lu Yunting against her parents' wishes through an imperial decree. Despite her efforts to be a perfect wife, her life is ruined when Lu’s childhood friend, Princess Jiang Muxue, returns. Jealous of their bond, the Princess frames Qingqing for poisoning and infidelity. Believing the lies, Lu Yunting divorces and torments Qingqing, only to later discover the heartbreaking truth.

2401723.title: Mr. Su's Runaway Bride
2401723.description: On the wedding day of Su Huaijin and Luo Qiuhan, Qiuhan runs away. Her father forces her sister, Luo Wanxing, to take her place, even though Wanxing already has a boyfriend. Wanxing also decides to flee, but on her way, she bumps into Su Huaijin, the CEO who is also trying to escape the marriage. Su Huaijin falls in love with her at first sight. Later, Wanxing is heartbroken when her rival, Tang Xueman, tricks her into seeing her boyfriend, Gu Zechuan, confessing his love to Tang. As Tang and Gu insult and humiliate Wanxing, Su Huaijin steps in to rescue her.

2401804.title: Through the Years, My Love Remains
2401804.description: The marriage of Su Mohan and Fu Yicheng, built on a misunderstanding, is now on the verge of collapse. When their daughter, Nannan, is diagnosed with leukemia, Su Mohan stops at nothing to save her. However, Fu Yicheng refuses to help, mistakenly believing Nannan is not his child. Faced with her husband's coldness and family hostility, Su Mohan fights for her daughter's life. As the truth is about to be revealed, an accident separates them once more. Can Su Mohan save her daughter and rescue her marriage?
2401804.originName: 岁月漫长，我仍爱你如初

2401869.title: The Crown Princess Revealed Her Secrets
2401869.description: Yun Qingci, the powerful Sect Leader of Cangshan, was betrayed and lost her power. At her lowest point, Shen Hechuan saved her with a bowl of porridge in exchange for three years of her devotion. However, once he brought his true love home and handed her a divorce letter, she realized it was all just a transaction. After secretly helping him countless times and giving him her heart, she paid back his kindness with a bowl of her own blood. Stepping out of the mansion, she fired a signal flare: the Sect Leader of Cangshan has returned, and the Crown Princess is no more.

2401947.title: Escape Bride: CEO, Stop Chasing Me!
2401947.description: Ning Lu and Qi Linshen, the CEO of Qi Group, have been secretly married for three years without ever meeting. A chance encounter leads to a misunderstanding where Qi Linshen fails to recognize Ning Lu as his wife, instead mistaking her for his nephew's girlfriend. Caught in a whirlwind of emotion and morality, the two navigate through hilarious conflicts, eventually clearing the air as their feelings for each other grow.

2402023.title: Warm Light
2402023.description: Five years ago, Sheng Jianing, the true heiress, was framed by her ex-boyfriend and her fake sister. After a one-night stand with CEO Lu, she gave birth to a son, but her sister stole the baby and lied that he was stillborn, forcing Jianing to flee abroad. Five years later, she returns with a plan for revenge. She is determined to punish those who hurt her and take back everything that belongs to her.

2402117.title: Falling for Your Tenderness
2402117.description: Lin Xiaobei, an ordinary delivery man, accidentally discovers he is the long-lost heir to a billionaire. Facing sudden wealth and a family conspiracy, he must learn to play the money game with the help of his bodyguard, Su Wan. As sparks fly between them, a shocking secret about a 20-year-old bloodbath surfaces... Meanwhile, a once-mighty general, who lost everything in defeat, now wanders the streets.

2402217.title: My Wealthy Ex-Wife
2402217.description: Li Siyan and Su Xingran met in college and have been married for five years. Because Li Siyan came from a poor background, Su Xingran hid her identity as a wealthy heiress and worked as a fish seller just to protect his pride. When Xingran discovers she has a brain tumor, she wants to spend her remaining time caring for him. However, Siyan begins to look down on her, feeling she is no longer good enough for him, and demands a divorce. His mother, Fang Ruolan, claims Xingran is an embarrassment and helps Siyan kick her out of the family.

2402345.title: I’m Dead, Why Are You Crying, Cold CEO?
2402345.description: Lin Mo fell in love with the proud Song Qingge at first sight and eventually married her. However, she never loved him. When her true love, Fu Pingchuan, faked his death, she blamed Lin Mo. She not only divorced him but also sent him to prison.
2402345.originName: 我死了，冰山总裁你哭什么

2402468.title: Wrongful Fate: A Test of Love
2402468.description: In the late Qing Dynasty, Princess Yunjing was abandoned by her husband, Shen Yifu, on their wedding night and died of a broken heart six months later. She is reborn ten years later in the Republic of China as a young girl named Lin Yunzhi. Determined to control her own fate, she moves to Shanghai for studies, only to reunite with Shen Yifu, who is now a university supervisor. Suspicious of her familiar behavior, Yifu tests her repeatedly. Meanwhile, Yunzhi is caught in the Lin family's turmoil: her brother's oil research is targeted by many, and the mysterious death of her eldest sister remains unsolved.

2402617.title: Love After Marriage
2402617.description: Abandoned by her cheating ex-boyfriend at their wedding, Dai Mengyan meets CEO Gu Yuyang, whose bride also ran away. They decide to marry on the spot. After marriage, Dai Mengyan faces various challenges at work and with family, while her bond with Gu Yuyang grows. Eventually, following a heartfelt confession and proposal from Gu, the two truly fall in love and receive their parents' blessings.

2402758.title: Return of the Underworld King
2402758.description: Bored with his dull rule in the underworld, the King of Hell escapes to the mortal world, causing chaos in a modern city. Unfamiliar with high-tech life, he gets lost in the subway and scares citizens with his powers, leading to a series of hilarious blunders. Meanwhile, strange events threaten the order of both realms, and his return makes him a prime suspect. After meeting a kind girl, they team up to uncover a plot by a mysterious force to overthrow both worlds. As conflict rises and feelings grow, he must choose: return to save humanity or give up immortality for love?

2402867.title: Step Up, Mr. Ye: My Wife Wants a Divorce Again
2402867.description: After an outsider causes a misunderstanding between the couple, Gu Anran endures the hardships of her marriage and uses her wealthy grandfather's influence to help her husband's career. Following many emotional ups and downs, the two finally resolve their conflicts and cherish their relationship together.
2402867.originName: 叶少给力点，少夫人又要离婚了

2402975.title: Night Life
2402975.description: After Xu Qiang's mother left and his father turned to alcohol, he was raised by his aunt, Rou. To support him, Rou worked at a bar where she was often bullied. Vowing to give her a better life, Xu Qiang starts working at a nightclub. Despite facing sabotage and rivalry due to his popularity, he skillfully navigates the nightlife industry, eventually finding success and ensuring a comfortable life for the woman who raised him.

2403071.title: The Spoiled Heiress is So Docile After Marriage
2403071.description: Shen Rongyue, a willful heiress, causes a scandal by running away from an arranged marriage, only to lose a race to a mysterious man, Lin Hao. Forced to marry him to honor a bet, she makes life difficult for him at every turn. However, Lin Hao uses his exceptional fighting skills and calm demeanor to win everyone over. Despite her resistance, Shen Rongyue finds herself drawn to his charm. When she demands a divorce, how will Lin Hao respond? Can this bickering couple find true love amidst a power struggle?

2403127.title: Unmasked: Ms. Qiao's True Identity Shocks the World
2403127.description: After hiding her wealth for love, Qiao Ruoli is betrayed and humiliated by her boyfriend, Lin Zijiao. At his engagement party to his new flame Su Nuannuan, Ruoli makes a stunning entrance to reveal her true identity as the heiress of the Qiao Group. Accompanied by Shen Xiuheng, the CEO of a top global architecture firm and her childhood friend, she turns the tables on her ex. The revenge of the real heiress begins now!
2403127.originName: 分手后，乔小姐身份震惊全球

2403234.title: Reunion of Love: The Heiress Ex-Wife's Revenge
2403234.description: Xia Yunchu, the heiress of Jishi Hospital and a genius doctor, severed ties with her family three years ago to marry Gu Peiming. She sacrificed her career to become a housewife, only to be despised by him for not working. On their third anniversary, during a devastating earthquake, she watched him save another woman while leaving her behind. Heartbroken by his coldness and his tenderness toward others, Xia Yunchu finally files for divorce.
2403234.originName: 复婚成宠：千金前妻轻点虐

2403352.title: Wealthy Romance: Ex-husband, Please Behave
2403352.description: Gu Shengsheng was married to Pei Yu for three years without any intimacy. When her mother-in-law forced her to divorce with nothing, she slept with Pei Yu in a rage and fled the country while pregnant. Six years later, Shengsheng returns, leading to a dramatic game of cat and mouse with her persistent ex-husband.

2403479.title: Dazzling the World After Divorce
2403479.description: Five years ago, genius physician Du Ruosheng and Commander Fu Shiqi fell in love. Fearing that Fu Shiqi would feel inferior, Du Ruosheng hid her true identity as a legendary divine doctor and the only daughter of the wealthiest family in the capital, pretending to be an orphan to marry him.
2403479.originName: 和离后，夫人惊艳了世界

2403582.title: Wedding Vows: My Wife Confesses to Her True Love
2403582.description: Elderly Gu Tingsheng discovers his son isn't his biological child and is subsequently murdered by his wife, Jiang Xinran, and her lover. Reborn twenty years ago on the eve of his wedding, he uses his knowledge of the future to expose their affair at the ceremony. This leads to the downfall of the Jiang family as Gu Tingsheng embarks on a journey of revenge and protecting his loved ones.
2403582.originName: 婚礼宣誓，老婆表白她的白月光

2403643.title: Deeply in Love
2403643.description: To escape her parents' pressure and a toxic ex-boyfriend, Jiang Sui enters a flash marriage with Tan Siyan. Initially cold, Tan Siyan’s attitude changes after seeing Jiang Sui being harassed. He helps her escape her troubled family, and through their shared struggles, they find mutual redemption and lasting happiness.

2403787.title: Love in the High Sky
2403787.description: Lin Man and Fu Yuanchuan married after an accidental one-night stand at a party. For three years, they lived as a polite but distant couple. Fu Yuanchuan never spoke of his love, making Lin Man feel insecure. When Fu discovers Lin Man is suffering from a brain nerve condition caused by overwork, he orders her to stop flying and replaces her with Xia Weian, who secretly loves him. This leads Lin Man to believe Fu loves Xia instead. Further misunderstanding arises when Lin Man sees Xia flaunting a ring that Fu had actually bought for Lin Man but accidentally left in Xia’s car. Heartbroken, Lin Man decides to go on one last trip with Fu before letting him go. During the trip, Fu leaves for work, and Lin Man collapses in the hotel, only to be saved by her doctor, Lu Ze. As Lu Ze cares for her, a worried Fu Yuanchuan rushes back to find them together.

2403901.title: Don't Tease Me, I'm Just a Guard / The Legendary Guard Who Won the Beautiful Owner
2403901.description: Qin Feng, a neighborhood security guard, accidentally gets involved with the beautiful owner Gu Qingcheng and is used by her as a fake boyfriend to escape an unwanted marriage. Dragged into a whirlpool of trouble, Qin Feng uses his wisdom and courage to resolve crises. As they face challenges together, his relationship with Gu Qingcheng heats up, and his bond with two other women, Zhou Ruonan and Li Xian'er, undergoes subtle changes.

2404039.title: The Little Matchmaker’s Perfect Assist
2404039.description: Su Anqiao, the eldest daughter of the Su family, faces a failing marriage and a harsh mother-in-law. Amidst the crisis, she reunites with Mu Lingshen, a steady man who becomes her emotional sanctuary. Haunted by a rainy night separation and a lost child from five years ago, the two must face their past. Their son, Gu Sinan, teams up with his uncle to secretly play matchmaker. Through their clever help, Mu Lingshen finally wins back Anqiao’s heart in a unique way.

2404091.title: Revenge of the Heiress: Fate's Return
2404091.description: Sixteen years ago, Fu Zhenye murdered his brother and sister-in-law in a staged car accident to seize their wealth. Now, their daughter Fu Fei returns under the alias Han Lu to seek revenge. She first tries to ruin Fu Zhenye's marriage by becoming his mistress, but he uses a fortune to maintain his public image with his wife. Changing tactics, Han Lu targets his only son, Fu Junyan. While she treats him as a pawn in her game of vengeance, Junyan falls for her deeply and sincerely. As the powerful Fu Zhenye faces his downfall, Junyan is seriously injured while protecting Han Lu. After all the blood and lies, is there any hope left for their love?

2404179.title: Flash Marriage: The CEO Wants It for Real
2404179.description: Shi Ning, a rich heiress, disguises herself as a delivery girl to escape an arranged marriage, only to stumble into the room of billionaire CEO He Wenjue. To avoid his own family's blind date pressure, He Wenjue hires her as a fake girlfriend, leading to a quick marriage where both hide their true identities. As Shi Ning starts interning at He's company and they live together as roommates, genuine feelings begin to spark amidst their web of lies.
2404179.originName: 闪婚后：总裁他想假戏真做

2404280.title: Mrs. Shen, Your Secret is Out
2404280.description: What was supposed to be a happy marriage into a wealthy family became a nightmare for Chu Yin. Hiding her identity as the world-class medical expert, Qianyue, she suffers from cyberbullying and the cold indifference of her husband, Shen Shaoqing, after being framed by the famous star Qiao Yiyi. Unable to reveal the truth, Chu Yin endures the pain until she decides to step out as Dr. Qianyue. A shocking comeback and revenge are about to begin.

2404349.title: The Midsummer Promise
2404349.description: Fifteen years ago, Li Yue saved Pei Yanshen's life, and they promised to marry when they grew up. However, Pei fled abroad on their wedding day, and they haven't met for five years. After returning home, Pei wants a divorce, unaware that the doctor he fell for at first sight is actually his wife. Neither of them recognizes the other. Due to a phone mix-up, Pei mistakes Li Yue's colleague, Li Xiaoyue, for his wife. Discovering Xiaoyue's affair makes him loathe his "wife" even more, fueling his desire for divorce. Meanwhile, he finds himself falling for the real Li Yue during their interactions as doctor and patient.

2404404.title: The Deadly Marriage
2404404.description: Lu Changling's first four wives all died mysteriously on their wedding night. To uncover the truth behind her best friend's death, the brave An Ranran becomes his fifth bride. Is she marrying into a wealthy family or walking into hell? In this high-stakes gamble where one wrong move means death, she discovers that the previous wives' deaths hide a dark, unspeakable secret.

2404476.title: The Richest Heiress: Conquering the Office
2404476.description: Tang Ling, the granddaughter of a billionaire, returns from her studies abroad and joins the Shenghong Group under a hidden identity. However, she faces bullying from an imposter and misunderstandings from her colleagues. By sharpening her professional skills and showcasing her leadership, Tang Ling gradually adapts to the high-pressure environment and finds true friendship. When the Chairman exposes the imposter at a major meeting, Tang Ling not only advances her career but also completes her transformation from a wealthy heiress to a professional elite.

2404568.title: It Must Be You
2404568.description: A stoic CEO and a charming beauty star in this visual feast! Starring Liu Ning and Wu Ruoxi, and directed by Cui Shuanhui, the story follows a pair introduced by the CEO's grandfather. Despite their intense chemistry and sweet moments, constant misunderstandings plague their relationship. Will their romance lead to a happy ending, or a shocking discovery that they are actually siblings?

2404634.title: My Beautiful and Badass Captain
2404634.description: Cheng Ran gave up her dream of becoming a pilot to raise a family with Jiang Yuezhi. In the seventh year of their marriage, she discovered his affair and his vows to another woman. Heartbroken, she died in a plane crash, only to be reborn before the tragedy. This time, she vows to change her fate and reclaim her dreams.

2404741.title: My Dearest Mother
2404741.description: Chen Shuzhen wanders the streets alone after being diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer. Her daughter, Zhou Qingyu, was once a good child but has been manipulated by her scheming husband, Xu Hui. Believing she no longer belongs to her birth family after marriage, Qingyu constantly stirs up trouble between her mother and her brother, Zhou Chang'an, leading to deep family misunderstandings.

2404873.title: Married First, Love Later: CEO Fan's Endless Pampering
2404873.description: Grandma Fan and Zhao Sitian's grandmother were best friends. After her friend passed away, Grandma Fan finds Sitian and fakes an illness to force her grandson, Fan Yiming, into marrying her. Yiming reluctantly agrees but misunderstands Sitian as a gold-digger, while Sitian dislikes him too. When they both refuse to marry, Grandma Fan uses her 'illness' again to guilt-trip them. Sitian eventually gives in, further fueling Yiming's prejudice. Sitian vows to never see him again, only to discover that her new boss is none other than Fan Yiming.
2404873.originName: 先婚后爱：范总的花样宠妻

2404969.title: The Divine Farmer in the Wild
2404969.description: Li Mu, a city youth, gains the legendary Divine Farmer's inheritance and returns to his village. Using his magical medical skills and farming powers, he leads the villagers to wealth, but attracts greedy bullies and corporate giants. While protecting his home and childhood sweetheart, he must fight off conspiracies in this rural action drama.

2405087.title: The Wild Girl Spoil by Her Six Brothers
2405087.description: After losing her parents at a young age, Jiang Xiaoyue lived a miserable life but remained bright and kind. At eighteen, she was adopted by Xu Ruoyun after saving her life. Upon entering her new home, Xiaoyue is shocked to discover she now has six extraordinary brothers. The once unloved 'wild girl' has now become the little princess cherished by them all.
2405087.originName: 野丫头被哥哥们宠坏了

2405191.title: Karma's Revenge: The Blind Beggar's Return
2405191.description: Shen Xiao, a blind beggar, encounters his supposedly dead wife, Su Qing, on the street. After a brutal beating from her and her lover, Lu Chen, he realizes it was all a scam: Su Qing faked her blindness to steal his corneas for Lu Chen. While they lived happily, Shen Xiao died in misery. Reborn before the surgery, Shen Xiao is determined to reclaim his life and make the treacherous couple face the ultimate retribution.

2405309.title: Roses and Moonlight for You
2405309.description: Yu Miao and Lu Zhuolin have been married for seven years. To save Lu Zhuolin's life, Yu Miao donated her bone marrow, leaving herself terminally ill. Instead of being grateful, Lu Zhuolin brings his pregnant mistress home and demands a divorce. After suffering endless physical and emotional abuse, Yu Miao loses everything and eventually commits suicide in despair.

2405453.title: Back to the 90s: Only Pampering My Wife
2405453.description: Zhang Yunfeng is reborn on the day his wife faces a life-threatening labor. Recalling how his blind filial piety led to her death in his past life, he rushes her to the hospital and cuts ties with his toxic family to save her. Starting by selling marinated shrimp using his future knowledge, he eventually becomes a business tycoon, protects his family, and takes revenge to rewrite his destiny.
2405453.originName: 重生九零，不宠老婆我宠谁

2405518.title: Whispers of the Wind: My Unexpected CEO
2405518.description: After the Xia family went bankrupt, Xia Lan worked multiple jobs to afford her mother's rising medical bills. Desperate, she decides to seek help from the man her grandfather betrothed her to years ago at the Ji Group. Unexpectedly, she is rescued by the CEO, Ji Yanchi, whom she mistakes for her fiancé. The two end up getting married on the spot!

2405658.title: Love Blooms When Winter Ends
2405658.description: Six years ago, Qin Chuan, heir to the Qin Group, had a one-night stand with intern Tang Yao. Forced to part with her child, Tang Yao enters a flash marriage six years later with Qin Chuan—who is posing as an ordinary man—to escape a forced marriage trap. When their son, Tongtong, appears with a DNA test, the six-year conspiracy is finally exposed. On New Year's Eve, the CEO fulfills his promise with a grand wedding.

2405767.title: Still Sharp
2405767.description: Jin, a legendary mob boss who retired years ago, is forced back into the underworld when his only son is kidnapped by a rising new gang. Facing a changed criminal world and aggressive young rivals, the nearly 60-year-old legend must use his wisdom and remaining strength to prove he is still a force to be reckoned with. During the rescue, he discovers the kidnapping is linked to a 30-year-old grudge, and the most dangerous enemy is someone he trusts most.

2405837.title: Heart Spied, Villainess Loved
2405837.description: Transmigrated as the wealthy and powerful Young Sect Leader of Tianxuan, Jiang Wu just wanted to live a life of leisure. However, bound by a system, she’s forced to play the role of a villainess or face punishment. The 'innocent' heroine is actually a scheming mastermind, the 'sunny' hero helps her bury bodies, and the 'cold' male lead keeps watch while she kills. Jiang Wu offended them all as ordered and waited for her death—only to find herself pampered instead. Why is the heroine suddenly so clingy? Why does the hero treat her like a sister? And what’s wrong with the cold male lead?
2405837.originName: 被偷听心声后，恶毒女配成了团宠

2405965.title: Super Dad: The Ultimate Turnaround
2405965.description: Lu Ziqian, an elite investment banker, is forced to become a stay-at-home dad to three eccentric kids. When he discovers his ex-wife’s parenting notes contain hidden business secrets, he must use his new dad skills to crack the code and stop a global merger conspiracy within 48 hours. Between diapers and corporate warfare, can this rookie dad win both at home and on Wall Street?

2406090.title: Marriage Out of Place
2406090.description: Wang Guixiang and Yu Jianjun lived in peace for half their lives. But on their 40th wedding anniversary, the long-enduring Guixiang suddenly asks for a divorce in front of the whole family. Jianjun is furious, scolding her for acting like a reckless youth at her age, and their children are shocked. As the house descends into chaos, the couple begins living separate lives.

2406229.title: Hero of the Nation: Forging the Great Sword!
2406229.description: After years in the desert, Li Rongguang completes the final chip for the 'Qingtian-1' spacecraft, only to find his comrades have all passed away. Returning home for his honors, he discovers his brother Li Yong lost both hands saving lives. While at the hospital, they are harassed by a celebrity, Yao Han, who cuts the line. Yao's fans cyberbully Rongguang and even storm Li Yong’s ward to cause trouble. Finally, General Nie Hong arrives with his team to bring the culprits to justice.
2406229.originName: 大国功臣：我为大夏铸剑！

2406345.title: The Dutiful Son
2406345.description: Zhang Ming, a wealthy heir, fakes being a 'filial son' to secure his inheritance. But as he cares for his paralyzed father, his heart begins to melt. When a secret in the will is revealed, he must choose between money and his conscience. Meanwhile, a voice recorder hidden under his father’s pillow has captured every secret conversation.

2406483.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too TVSP (Thai Dub)
2406483.description:
After fending off the attack of Yuti—a girl who, despite being a disciple of the "Holy," harbors the power of the "Evil"—Yuuya and his companions manage to reach an understanding with her.

But what awaits them next is completely unexpected…
a shared life with Yuti in the real world!?

Meanwhile, in the other world, the "Fist Saint" who has fallen into darkness emerges, along with a sinister presence lurking behind the scenes…

The life-reversal fantasy returns in full force!
2406483.originName: 异世界でチート能力を手にした俺は、现実世界をも无双する ～レベルアップは人生を変えた～SP 制作公司:*

2406557.title: KILL BLUE (Thai Dub)
2406557.description:
Juzo Ogami is a legendary hitman known for completing even the most impossible missions.

One day, after wiping out an entire organization, he is stung by a mysterious bee and loses consciousness. When he awakens, he finds himself transformed—from a 39-year-old man into a 13-year-old boy!

Before he can process what's happened, his boss issues a new order: infiltrate a middle school in that very form.

Awaiting him there is an unexpected life filled with eccentric classmates—and a full-blown school youth experience.

But can Juzo ever return to his original body?
And as if that weren't enough, assassins are already closing in on him…

2406685.title: The Beginning After the End Season 2 (Thai Dub)
2406685.description: Grey, the strongest king in history, is the protagonist of the tale. Despite his unrivaled fame, fortune, and power, nobody supports him... and he doesn't trust anyone. One day, Grey dies unexpectedly and is reborn in a magical world as Arthur, a helpless baby. Arthur begins to discover joys in this new life that he was unaware of in his old one, surrounded by a loving family and friends. But his family is assaulted by bandits while traveling...
2406685.originName: 最强王者的第二人生 第二季（泰配版）

2406797.title: I Got a CHEAT SKILL in ANOTHER WORLD and Became UNRIVALED in the REAL WORLD, Too TVSP  (Dub Indo)
2406797.description:
After fending off the attack of Yuti—a girl who, despite being a disciple of the "Holy," harbors the power of the "Evil"—Yuuya and his companions manage to reach an understanding with her.

But what awaits them next is completely unexpected…
a shared life with Yuti in the real world!?

Meanwhile, in the other world, the "Fist Saint" who has fallen into darkness emerges, along with a sinister presence lurking behind the scenes…

The life-reversal fantasy returns in full force!
2406797.originName: 在异世界获得超强能力的我，在现实世界照样无敌～等级提升改变人生命运～TVSP篇（印配版）

2406869.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester (Thai Dub)
2406869.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Development High School—so legendary that it boasts a 100 percent rate of students going on to higher education or securing employment, and even hands out points each month worth the equivalent of 100,000 yen. Yet beneath its glittering facade lies a ruthless meritocracy where only a select few high achievers enjoy preferential treatment. After being promoted to C‑Class in their first year’s third term, Ayakoji and his classmates narrowly lost out to A‑Class in the final special exam of the grade, plunging them back down to D‑Class. Their second year would begin all over again from the bottom.  Following spring break, Ayakoji entered into a romantic relationship with Karuizawa, while Horikita finally broke free from the shadow of her brilliant older brother, Manabu. As their relationships gradually shifted, they moved up to the second year. For Ayakoji and his new classmates, their first special exam was a written test conducted in pairs with incoming freshmen. But among the newcomers lurked an assassin dispatched by Tsukishiro from White Room—and so, as cross‑grade bonds began to form, the question remained: would this new chapter bring storm or calm? The curtain rises once more on their second year of school life.
2406869.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ４th Season 2年生1学期

2406948.title: Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester (Dub Indo)
2406948.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Development High School—so legendary that it boasts a 100 percent rate of students going on to higher education or securing employment, and even hands out points each month worth the equivalent of 100,000 yen. Yet beneath its glittering facade lies a ruthless meritocracy where only a select few top performers enjoy preferential treatment. After being promoted to Class C in their first year’s third term, Ayakoji and his classmates narrowly lost the final special exam of the grade and were demoted back to Class D. Their second year would begin all over again, starting from the bottom.  Over spring break, Ayakoji entered into a romantic relationship with Karuizawa, while Horikita finally broke free from the shadow of her brilliant older brother, Manabu. As their relationships gradually shifted, they moved up to the second year. For Ayakoji and his new classmates, the first special exam was a written test taken in pairs with incoming freshmen. But among the newcomers lurked an assassin dispatched by Tsukishiro’s White Room—and so, as cross‑grade bonds begin to form, one can’t help but wonder: will this year bring stormy upheaval, or calm? The curtain rises once more on their second year of school.
2406948.originName: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ４th Season 2年生1学期

2407027.title: Farming Life in Another World (Thai Dub)
2407027.description: Having died of sickness at 39 years old, Machio Hiraku is given the opportunity to go to another world. When asked what his wish is by God intends to give him strength, he requests to have a healthy body, offered a second wish, and he chooses to live peacefully. The third wish is to be able to know the local language, and the final wish is to be able to be a farmer.

2407117.title: Farming Life in Another World 2 (Thai Dub)
2407117.description:
Once a frail and lonely young man, Hiraku is reincarnated into another world through the blessing of a god.

Deep within the forest, the small farm he built gradually grows into a lively settlement known as the “Great Tree Village,” as all kinds of companions gather—vampires, elves, beastfolk, angels, and more.

Tending the fields, raising livestock, and sharing laughter with friends, Hiraku enjoys a peaceful life.

But with a constant stream of visitors arriving one after another, the village is busier than ever!
2407117.originName: 異世界のんびり農家 ２期

2407257.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 (Thai Dub)
2407257.description:
Demon Lord Rimuru moves one step closer to his vision of uniting humans and monsters. As Tempest continues to flourish, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel, come into conflict with Rimuru, driven by their belief that humanity must be protected through control and domination.

Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon quietly pursues his own ambitions. And as tensions rise, the awakening of a new Hero draws ever closer.
2407257.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第四期

2407392.title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4 (Thai Dub)
2407392.description:
Hiding the fact that he is human, Iruma Suzuki continues his life at the Demon School, Babyls. As he makes more demonic friends, he gradually begins to enjoy life in the Netherworld, shining in various school events and steadily climbing the ranks—becoming the center of attention both inside and outside the academy.

Now, Iruma faces a new challenge: the Music Festival, where the unity of his class will be put to the test.

The entire Misfit Class—all 13 students—has been given an unprecedented task: to achieve Rank 4 together. With the festival serving as their final chance for promotion, victory is an absolute requirement.

However, among them is one classmate—a demon who is forbidden to stand out…

Can all thirteen of them make it onto the stage together?
2407392.originName: 魔入りました！入间くん 第4シリーズ

2407494.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season2 (Thai Dub)
2407494.description: In order to keep a promise to his childhood friend Elfaria, Will, a washout student at a magical institution who is incapable of using magic, wants to become a member of the Magia Vander, the highest class of mages. He uses a sword rather than a wand, and the academy gradually acknowledges his powers. A mysterious wizard ambushes Lihanna and the other top students of his year as they are participating in an all-student Praxis dungeon training. They barely make it through the onslaught together, but they still have to take the exit test. Is Will able to get to the girl in the tower who is waiting for him?
2407494.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア Season 2

2407563.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season2 (Dub Indo)
2407563.description: In order to keep a promise to his childhood friend Elfaria, Will, a washout student at a magical institution who is incapable of using magic, wants to become a member of the Magia Vander, the highest class of mages. He uses a sword rather than a wand, and the academy gradually acknowledges his powers. A mysterious wizard ambushes Lihanna and the other top students of his year as they are participating in an all-student Praxis dungeon training. 2407563.originName: 杖と剣のウィストリア Season 2

2407653.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm (Thai Dub)
2407653.description:
From Hiromu Arakawa, the author of Fullmetal Alchemist—a masterpiece beloved by fans around the world—comes her latest work, now serialized to great acclaim in Monthly Shonen Gangan.
With over 4 million copies in circulation, the series is finally getting a long-awaited TV anime adaptation!

A brand-new “Tsugai” battle fantasy where mystery and the supernatural intertwine.
A relentless, otherworldly tale is about to unfold.

2407711.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm (Dub Indo)
2407711.description:
From Hiromu Arakawa, the author of Fullmetal Alchemist—a masterpiece beloved by fans around the world—comes her latest work, now serialized to great acclaim in Monthly Shonen Gangan.
With over 4 million copies in circulation, the series is finally getting a long-awaited TV anime adaptation!

A brand-new “Tsugai” battle fantasy where mystery and the supernatural intertwine.
A relentless, otherworldly tale is about to unfold.

2407790.title: MARRIAGETOXIN (Thai Dub)
2407790.description:
For centuries, the "Users" have honed the art of killing. Among them, the most powerful and influential are the Five Great Families—most notably, the "Poison Users." Hikaru Gero, a young man born into this lineage, lives as a professional assassin, having spent his life avoiding any ties to women. To him, marriage has always been a distant concept.
But when the head of the Gero family declares that his sister will be forced to bear an heir to preserve their bloodline, everything changes.
Amidst this crisis, Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler—and his latest target.

Determined to protect his sister and resolve the succession issue, Hikaru comes up with an unexpected solution: he will marry himself. On the spot, he asks Mei to help him find a wife.
"That’s the first time I’ve ever heard a proposal like that."
Thus begins an unlikely partnership: an elite assassin and a master con artist. With Mei as his advisor, Hikaru embarks on the most difficult mission of his life—finding a bride.

His goal: the perfect marriage. A high-stakes “marriage-hunting” battle action unfolds, as this deadly duo takes on the toughest mission in the world!
2407790.originName: マリッジトキシン 前半

2407935.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 (Thai Dub)
2407935.description:
Demon Lord Rimuru moves one step closer to his vision of uniting humans and monsters. As Tempest continues to flourish, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel, come into conflict with Rimuru, driven by their belief that humanity must be protected through control and domination.

Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon quietly pursues his own ambitions. And as tensions rise, the awakening of a new Hero draws ever closer.
2407935.originName: 転生したらスライムだった件 第四期

2408024.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 (Thai Dub)
2408024.description:
After narrowly claiming victory in the fierce battle at the Water Gate City of Pristella, Subaru and his companions are left to bear a devastating cost. Rem remains trapped in an endless sleep by the Authority of Gluttony, Crusch has lost her memories, and Julius has had his very name taken from him.

In search of a way to save them, Subaru learns of the legendary "Sage," Shaula—said to possess boundless knowledge and the ability to see all.

Their next destination: the Pleiades Watchtower, where the Sage resides. It stands at the far edge of the world, deep within the Augria Sand Dunes—a vast desert so perilous that even Reinhard, the mightiest "Sword Saint," has failed to conquer it.

Amid relentless natural forces, unknown beasts, and unimaginable threats, Subaru sets out on a perilous journey with his companions—risking everything to reclaim what was lost.
2408024.originName: Re：ゼロから始める異世界生活4

2408143.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 (Dub Indo)
2408143.description:
After narrowly claiming victory in the fierce battle at the Water Gate City of Pristella, Subaru and his companions are left to bear a devastating cost. Rem remains trapped in an endless sleep by the Authority of Gluttony, Crusch has lost her memories, and Julius has had his very name taken from him.

In search of a way to save them, Subaru learns of the legendary "Sage," Shaula—said to possess boundless knowledge and the ability to see all.
