Amid relentless natural forces, unknown beasts, and unimaginable threats, Subaru sets out on a perilous journey with his companions—risking everything to reclaim what was lost.
2408143.originName: Re：ゼロから始める異世界生活4

2408234.title: MARRIAGETOXIN (Dub Indo)
2408234.description:
For centuries, the "Users" have honed the art of killing. Among them, the most powerful and influential are the Five Great Families—most notably, the "Poison Users." Hikaru Gero, a young man born into this lineage, lives as a professional assassin, having spent his life avoiding any ties to women. To him, marriage has always been a distant concept.
But when the head of the Gero family declares that his sister will be forced to bear an heir to preserve their bloodline, everything changes.
Amidst this crisis, Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler—and his latest target.

Determined to protect his sister and resolve the succession issue, Hikaru comes up with an unexpected solution: he will marry himself. On the spot, he asks Mei to help him find a wife.
"That’s the first time I’ve ever heard a proposal like that."
Thus begins an unlikely partnership: an elite assassin and a master con artist. With Mei as his advisor, Hikaru embarks on the most difficult mission of his life—finding a bride.

His goal: the perfect marriage. A high-stakes “marriage-hunting” battle action unfolds, as this deadly duo takes on the toughest mission in the world!
2408234.originName: マリッジトキシン 前半

2408332.title: Your Ladyship, His Majesty Has Run Away with the Baby Again
2408332.description: I was a bedchamber maid trained by the Prince for six years. Unexpectedly, I got pregnant before the Princess Consort even arrived—a major taboo in the manor. To survive, I fled to the capital with the child and the Prince's wealth. Little did I know, the wheels of fate were just beginning to turn. I was once a simple village girl who had even sold herself to human traffickers.
2408332.originName: 娘娘，陛下又带着球跑了

2408393.title: The Survivor Consort
2408393.description: The female lead transmigrates as the fourth concubine in a Prince's palace. Having been bullied by her stepmother and stepsister in her past life, she developed a cautious and timid personality. Now a daughter from a humble family, she learns about the tragic fates of previous transmigrated women in the palace. To survive, she becomes even more determined to stay low-profile and play it safe.

2408484.title: You Are My Forever
2408484.description: At age three, I became the 'Luck-Bringer' Crown Princess, destined to be buried with the sickly Crown Prince. To survive, I hid in the Eastern Palace with a hidden bone of meat. But the powerful boy prince, coughing blood, wiped my face and said, 'Xin-xin, you are my lucky star, not a curse.' In this cruel palace, the Empress seeks my life and the Emperor treats me as a pawn. I played the fool, unaware that my cold, moon-like Prince had already planned a ten-year death trap to protect me. 'I failed to protect my family in this life. In the next, once I am whole again, I will find you.' A sweeping epic of protection, betrayal, and reincarnation.

2408552.title: Deep Love, Hidden Scheme
2408552.description: To secure an heir, an infertile Emperor gathers women known for their fertility into the palace. He decrees that whoever gives birth to the first prince will become Empress. One year later, ten concubines give birth to princes one after another.

2408674.title: Across the Three Realms: Searching for My Mother
2408674.description: A celestial nine-tailed fox gives birth to a human child, but her chaotic parenting leads to her accidentally abandoning the baby on a mountain while chasing a dark cloud. Immortal Lord Cangxuan rescues the dying infant and embarks on a journey across the three realms to find the mother, joined by Fairy Shuanghua. They eventually find the fox mother in the mortal world, only to be hunted by the Demon Overlord Molo Ji. During the battle, the child unexpectedly awakens his dual celestial-fox bloodline. Together, they destroy the Soul-Devouring Banner and defeat the Demon Overlord. The child then stays in the celestial realm to cultivate with his mother, waiting three hundred years to fully eradicate the remaining evil forces.

2408752.title: Sweetheart Egg Master
2408752.description: I’ve turned into a snake—a King Cobra, to be exact. Every time I go to the stream for a drink, I’m so intimidated by my own reflection that my scales stand on end. I'm just too majestic and terrifying! Before I could even get used to this new life, the breeding season has arrived.

2408816.title: Evening Star and the Abyss
2408816.description: In 2027, the 2D game 'Star Abyss' is about to launch. Ding Han, an unemployed graduate and top beta tester, plans to make a living through the game. On launch day, a mysterious gift code sucks him into the monitor. Instead of a 2D world, he finds a terrifyingly realistic battlefield: giant beasts, power-armored soldiers, orbital strikes, and massive starships. Faced with this chaotic reality, Ding Han must use his gaming skills to survive and become a legendary traveler of the Star Abyss.

2408951.title: Raised by Wolves: The Beast Tamer's Rise
2408951.description: Kidnapped and abandoned on Wolf Mountain at age three, I discovered a shocking secret: I can understand the language of wolves. Rescued by a pair of silver and gray wolves, I was taken back to their den and cared for like one of their own. While the curious wolf cubs wondered if I was food, the pack leaders protected me, marking the start of my legendary journey as the beloved master of beasts.

2409092.title: The Seduction System
2409092.description: Everyone calls me a flirt, saying I love nothing more than seducing men. Even the Master of the Meng family, whom I’ve chased for seventeen years, left me, claiming I was too promiscuous. Little do they know, I am bound to a 'Touch Men or Die' system. After he fled, I suffered day and night, until finally...

2409206.title: The Beacon
2409206.description: Inside a dimly lit subway station, over twenty survivors huddle in a corner, the air thick with the smell of sweat and despair. Lin Mo stands in the center of the crowd, palms sweating as he tightly grips a palm-sized metal detector...

2409296.title: Star City: Beast Slayer
2409296.description: I am the world's only 6S-rank awakened hero. After protecting humanity for five years, I was heartlessly dragged to a military court. Now, countless people have signed a blood petition to seal my powers and throw me in prison.

2409395.title: Final Redemption
2409395.description: In a world where everyone awakens a class upon reaching adulthood, Su Yao becomes a Priest and awakens a Mythic-level talent: [Final Redemption]! This talent amplifies all Priest skills by 10,000 times! Healing: Heals a target (Effect x10,000!). Blessing of Strength: Grants a strength buff (Attribute boost x10,000!).

2409508.title: Reborn Princess: My Baby is Not to Be Messed With
2409508.description: The Palace is buzzing—the Princess has finally spoken! The Emperor rushed over and held me tight, begging me to call him 'Your Majesty.' But I refused and called him 'Daddy' instead. The more he insisted, the more I stuck to 'Daddy.' He saw my defiance as brilliance, thinking I was playfully teasing him. Overjoyed, he showered me with countless treasures.
2409508.originName: 重生长公主：朕的崽崽不好惹

2409626.title: Rebirth: Swapping Lives
2409626.description: On the eve of Lunar New Year, the gates of the Jing'an Marquis Mansion are burst open. A woman in elegant clothing enters with her servants and loudly declares that she is the true Fifth Young Mistress of the household.

2409722.title: Married to a Spirit Tablet: My Cold God Husband Dotes on Me
2409722.description: A century-old promise bound the Ling and Jiang families. Eighteen years later, General Ling Xiao dies in battle, and Jiang Zhi is forced to marry his spirit tablet. On her wedding night, she discovers her 'ghost husband' visits her every night, only to realize he is a powerful Frost God undergoing a mortal trial. Once his identity is revealed, Ling Xiao pampers her endlessly, fending off rivals and bringing heavenly blessings. The widow becomes the most beloved woman in the world in this sweet and humorous divine romance.
2409722.originName: 错嫁牌位后，我被上神宠疯了

2409788.title: Crimson Case
2409788.description: Recent graduate Lin Yu hits on what he thinks is a bar hostess, only to realize she is undercover cop Su Yourong. His casual mention of 'good stuff'—referring to vintage wine—nearly gets him arrested for drug dealing. The situation turns dire when they discover the bar owner's body in a freezer, making Lin Yu the prime suspect. To clear his name, he teams up with Su Yourong to uncover the truth. They stumble upon a web of secrets involving drugs hidden in spices and a 'death wish' curse, with the chef, the victim's ex, and a mysterious Mr. L all under suspicion. Amidst the danger and constant twists, Lin Yu falls for the brave officer as they race to catch the real killer.

2409860.title: Phoenix in the Golden Hall
2409860.description: On her coming-of-age ceremony, she was framed and ruined by Gu Yanzhou. Her parents forced her into a lowly marriage, while her fake elder sister enjoyed all the glory. After being tortured to death three years later, she is reborn back to that fateful day. This time, she uncovers her sister's drugging plot, swaps the wine cups, and lures Prince Jing into her chamber. She is determined to reclaim everything and steal the man her sister loves most.

2409932.title: Roommate Reunion
2409932.description: On the day we broke up, I stole Shen Yinghuai's underwear and left a bold message in lipstick, promising to deal with him once I inherited my family business, before running away. To win a 500,000-dollar bet with my father and avoid an arranged marriage, I accidentally fell for a cheap rental scam and ended up living in Shen's house. Just as I tried to stay low, we met again at a family match-making dinner where he revealed himself as my blind date. My escape plan has failed, and our chaotic love-hate life begins.

2410033.title: The Empress Only Wants to Farm
2410033.description: As a princess sent for peace, I entered the palace knowing the Emperor's reputation for being a cold-blooded killer of beauties. To survive, I planned to only farm and raise chickens. Unexpectedly, the Emperor fell deeply in love with me, pampering me until I became his Empress.

2410257.title: Misty City
2410257.description: Upon returning home, my adopted sister, Su Wan, dressed like a princess, pointed at me and said pitifully, "Sister, I know you just got back, but the yacht Dad customized for me arrives next week. You won't take it from me, will you?" She is a year younger than me. I looked at her calmly and said, "It's just a yacht." If she wants it, she can have it.

2410325.title: Doomsday Romance: Winning with a Love System
2410325.description: To prove that humans and zombies can have babies, I kidnapped a cute female zombie! Reborn in the apocalypse, I started by dating a zombie. Little did I know, completing love missions grants me infinite supplies!
2410325.originName: 末日狂想：恋爱系统带我躺赢

2410454.title: Doomsday Survival: Starting with a Steyr Heavy Truck
2410454.description: A month before the zombie outbreak, I was delivering a billionaire's supplies—military rations and medical stocks enough to fill a hospital. Overhearing a satellite call about a 'global infection' and 'purification protocol,' I didn't wait for my pay. Instead, I drove my 14-wheel Steyr heavy truck straight into the city to prepare for the end.
2410454.originName: 末日求生：开局一辆斯太尔重卡

2410567.title: Reborn in the Apocalypse: The Magic Crayon
2410567.description: A catastrophic rainstorm has submerged 90% of the world! Having prepared supplies in advance, I hide on the top floor of my building, quietly waiting for the end to come...
2410567.originName: 末世重生 蜡笔显灵

2410703.title: LINK CLICK 3
2410703.description:
After the Li Tianchen case comes to a close, peace appears to return to Time Photo Studio—until the disappearance of Xia Fei draws everyone back into a web of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's newfound abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang begin uncovering the truth behind the mysterious Bahati fire.

As the investigation deepens, hidden connections emerge between the case and Cheng Xiaoshi's parents. Meanwhile, Liu Xiao, a member of a mysterious organization, sets his own plans in motion, while the intervention of Inspector Jae introduces new uncertainties. As secrets buried in the past resurface, the search for truth becomes more dangerous than ever.
2410703.originName: 时光代理人 第三季

2410830.title: Crowned in a Hundred Days
2410830.description:
Driven to the brink of despair, restaurant owner Ming forms an unlikely bond with the soul of the true King Lie after swallowing it to save his loved one. Bound together by fate, the two embark on a perilous journey to challenge the tyrant who has usurped the throne.

With only one hundred days to change their destiny, Ming uses his extraordinary memory to master long-lost magic, gathering allies and winning the support of the people along the way. As their strength grows, so does their resolve to overthrow a corrupt regime, reclaim the rightful king's throne, and restore peace to the realm.

2410921.title: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao
2410921.description:
Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew.

Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.

2411030.title: FALSE MEMORY
2411030.description:
In his desperate quest to return to the past, Guan Chao scours the world for "Pyrolite" — the energy source capable of powering the Time Gun. But his search takes an unexpected turn when he accidentally falls into the Memory Bureau.
To find his way back to reality, Guan Chao must join forces with memory administrators Fangtang, Bai Zhong, and others, clearing BUG beings layer by layer through the strata of memory. Yet as battle after battle draws to a close, what awaits him is far more than corrupted data… The deepest truth buried within memory itself is beginning to stir.

2411218.title: There Are Fabulous Beasts: Season 6
2411218.description:
Pipi, a mythical Pixiu from ancient times, has arrived in the human world. To evade capture, he takes refuge in the Deer Shop — a sanctuary for mythical beasts run by his good friend, the one-of-a-kind "Sibuxiang."
There, Pipi meets a colorful cast of divine creatures from all walks of life, each with their own quirks and personalities. Far from the chaos of civilization, a cozy, laid-back daily life among mythical beasts begins!

2411543.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2
2411543.description:
After awakening in another world as his MMORPG avatar, Arc finds himself trapped in the body of a Skeleton Knight—an imposing suit of armor hiding nothing but bones beneath. If his true nature is discovered, he could easily be mistaken for a monster and hunted down.

Determined to keep a low profile, Arc takes up life as a mercenary. But with a strong sense of justice, he can never ignore those in need. Joined by the elven warrior Ariane, the beastfolk ninja Chiyome, and the spirit beast Ponta, Arc embarks on an adventure filled with battles, friendship, and unexpected encounters.
2411543.originName: 骸骨騎士樣、只今異世界へお出掛け中 第2期

2411609.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3
2411609.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.
2411609.originName: 無職転生Ⅲ ～異世界行ったら本気だす～

2411725.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
2411725.description:
"You worthless son! You were destined to inherit our family's legacy, yet you ended up with that class!"

In a world where every fifteen-year-old receives a class through the Ritual of Divine Blessing, Elymas is expected to follow in the footsteps of his renowned swordsman family. Instead, he awakens as a Heavy Knight—a class widely dismissed as weak and useless—and is stripped of his status before being cast out.

But Elymas knows something no one else does: this world is the very game he once played in a previous life, and the supposedly worthless Heavy Knight is actually one of its strongest classes. Armed with knowledge from the future, he sets out to surpass all expectations and reshape the world itself.
2411725.originName: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する

2411817.title: The World’s Strongest Rearguard
2411817.description:
After dying in a bizarre bus accident, overworked salaryman Arihito Atobe is reincarnated into a fantasy world as a Seeker. There, he discovers a rare class known as the Rearguard, a support specialist capable of boosting his party's offense, defense, and healing abilities.

As if that weren't enough, his unique position at the back of the formation naturally increases his companions' affection for him. Free from the grind of corporate life, Arihito sets out on a brand-new adventure with an all-female party and a second chance at happiness.
2411817.originName: 世界最強の後衛　〜迷宮国の新人探索者〜

2411889.title: KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE
2411889.description:
Kuroe Akaishi is a shy, withdrawn high school girl who has long grown used to being alone. But when the kind and popular Arata Minami reaches out to her, her quiet world begins to change—and so do her feelings.

There's just one problem: whenever Kuroe becomes embarrassed or flustered, she starts transforming into a terrifying kaijuu. As her emotions intensify, so does her monstrous form, threatening everyone around her. With a giant monster looming over Japan and first love stirring in her heart, Kuroe must face the biggest challenge of all: confessing her feelings before they bring the world to ruin.
2411889.originName: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ

2412591.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season2
2412591.description:
Sasaki’s new pet turns out to be a renowned sage reincarnated from another world. He names the adorable bird “P-chan” and begins a new life with him. Thanks to P-chan, Sasaki gains magical powers and the ability to travel between worlds. He enjoys a more fulfilling life by trading goods from Japan, running a restaurant, and learning magic, escaping the grind of corporate life. 

But after encountering people with supernatural abilities, Sasaki is recruited by a government agency. His peaceful new life is about to become anything but ordinary!
2412591.originName: 佐々木とピーちゃん Season 2

2412684.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I
2412684.description:
To save his younger sister Nezuko and help her become human again, Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps. Alongside his companions, Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira, he defeats countless demons, hones his swordsmanship, and forges lasting bonds of friendship.
As the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji draws near, Tanjiro and the other members of the Demon Slayer Corps undergo intense training under the Hashiras. But when Muzan suddenly appears at the Ubuyashiki residence, the Hashiras and Tanjiro rush to rescue their Master—only to be pulled into the demons' stronghold, the Infinity Castle.
Thus begins the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons.
2412684.originName: 劇場版「鬼滅の刃」無限城編

2412873.title: Tomb Raider King
2412873.description:
Now operating deep within enemy territory, Jooheon launches his boldest scheme yet against TKBM. Stealing relics and sowing discord are only the beginning as he works from the shadows to make the organization pay for its crimes.

But the emergence of the Tower of Pride raises the stakes dramatically. Forced to manipulate and clash some of history's most powerful conquerors, Jooheon must rely on all his cunning to stay ahead. Can he outwit the legendary warlords and emerge victorious in a battle between the greatest rulers the world has ever known?

2413170.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
2413170.description:
After decades of war, the hero Dias is rewarded with a frontier domain of his own. But upon arriving, he discovers little more than endless grasslands and an empty territory with no people to govern. Having spent his entire life as a soldier, Dias has no idea how to be a lord.

Everything changes when he meets Alna, a mysterious horned girl. As new allies gather around him, Dias begins the challenging task of turning a barren frontier into a thriving land—and finding a new purpose beyond the battlefield.
2413170.originName: 領民0人スタートの辺境領主様

2413250.title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
2413250.description:
On a spring night in Tokyo, before the fireworks season begins, university student Kakeru Mano meets Koharu Fuyutsuki—a cheerful and warm-hearted young woman whose presence stands in stark contrast to his reserved nature. Though blind, Koharu faces life with unwavering optimism, making friends, joining new activities, and even dreaming of launching fireworks one day.

Drawn to her determination and kindness, Kakeru begins to question the limits he has placed on himself. As their bond deepens, Koharu's outlook on life inspires him to take his own first steps toward the future.
2413250.originName: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。

2413390.title: The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
2413390.description:
Summoned to another world as a saint, thirty-something caregiver Rin Takanashi is quickly cast aside as "useless." But thanks to her love of camping and the outdoors, she awakens the unique skills "Survival" and "Crafting", giving her everything she needs to thrive on her own.

Joined by a growing band of companions, Rin sets off on a laid-back journey across a fantasy world filled with adventure, delicious food, and unexpected discoveries. Yet as their carefree travels continue, their path begins to lead somewhere far beyond anything they imagined.
2413390.originName: 捨てられ聖女の異世界ごはん旅

2413460.title: Victoria of Many Faces
2413460.description:
Victoria's long-awaited peaceful life has finally begun. After leaving the world of espionage behind, she's determined to enjoy the quiet civilian life she always dreamed of. But escaping her past proves easier said than done, as trouble seems to follow her wherever she goes.

When Victoria encounters Nonna, a young girl with no one else to rely on, she finds herself drawn into a new challenge. Faced with a choice between protecting her hard-earned peace and helping a newfound friend, Victoria must decide what truly matters most.
2413460.originName: 手札が多めのビクトリア

2413722.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim 2: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
2413722.description:
After being reincarnated into a female-dominated otome game world, Leon uses his knowledge of the game's story to survive and rise to the rank of viscount. By befriending Olivia and Angelica and disrupting the original plot, he unknowingly throws the world off its destined course.

Now serving in the Saint's Guard under Marie, Leon finds himself caught in a growing conspiracy that threatens the Kingdom of Holfort. As the gap between reality and the game's original story widens, a new crisis begins to unfold.
2413722.originName: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です２

2413807.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
2413807.description: Narukami Ryusei is an ordinary NEET. He lives a lackadaisical existence, spending his days alone in his room playing video games. In reality, though, Ryusei was once a formidable demon king in a different realm! Why not do anything he wants with this new life? However, he wasn't the only one who had returned to life. She's an extremely adorable high school girl, and she's also the hero who knocked him down! Will Ryusei be able to withstand meeting up with his enemy in a different universe, or will he still have to battle this life?
2413807.originName: 花織さんは転生しても喧嘩がしたい

2413934.title: Clevatess Ⅱ
2413934.description:
With General Dorel defeated by the hero Alicia, the war between Heiden and Boleat finally comes to an end. Yet peace remains fragile, as attention shifts to the mysterious "Secret Room" left behind by Dorel. During a three-nation conference that includes Esrin, representatives from across the region gather at Solsane Academy in Boleat to uncover the truth behind its existence.

Among the visitors is Kuren, now serving as Luna's personal magic tutor, as new intrigue begins to unfold in the wake of the war.
2413934.originName: クレバテス-魔獸の王と赤子と屍の勇者- 2期

2414053.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
2414053.description:
Within the Maiden Court of the Kingdom of Ei, the empress and four imperial consorts are chosen from five prestigious clans. Among them, the graceful yet frail Reirin Kou is considered the perfect future empress, while the ill-tempered Keigetsu Shu is scorned by her peers and consumed by jealousy.

On the night of a rare comet, Keigetsu pushes Reirin from a balcony in a bid to take her place. Though imprisoned for the crime, Keigetsu secretly uses magic to swap bodies with Reirin before her execution. As Keigetsu struggles in Reirin's fragile body, Reirin embraces her newfound strength and freedom, determined to survive and forge her own destiny—no matter whose face she bears.
2414053.originName: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが

2414241.title: ONE PIECE HEROINES
2414241.description: Go behind the runway as style icon Nami stars in a life-changing fashion show, observe wise Robin as she helps to decipher an ancient tablet with Koala and Sabo, watch as solemn Princess Vivi receives a love letter from an unexpected admirer, and check out Ghost Princess Perona's battle over the last bottle of wine with Zoro and Mihawk!

2414293.title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
2414293.description:
Itsuki Tomonari, a high school student, becomes entangled in an abduction and finds up caring for Hinako Konohana, a young woman from one of Japan's biggest corporations.

Hinako is a lethargic girl with no life skills, despite her outward appearance as a bright and endearing girl. Hinako must, however, pretend to be the "perfect young lady" in school for family concerns. Itsuki looks after her with great care because she wants to keep her safe. After a while, Hinako starts to fall deeply in love with Itsuki.Now, I would detest it if Itsuki weren't present."

A charming young woman with a gap that goes beyond the master-servant dynamic is the starting point of this love story.

2414407.title: Grand Blue Dreaming3
2414407.description:
Several months into college life in Izu, Iori Kitahara seems to be living the dream—sharing a home with his cousin Chisa and surrounded by friends. In reality, most of his days are spent in the diving club Peek a Boo, where diving often takes a back seat to outrageous drinking parties and nonstop chaos.

When Nanaka asks Iori to help at a newly opened branch of the Dolphin diving shop in Palau, he and Kohei find themselves heading overseas for the first time. This summer, a brand-new Grand Blue adventure begins in paradise!

2414499.title: Tomb Raider King (Thai Dub)
2414499.description:
Now operating deep within enemy territory, Jooheon launches his boldest scheme yet against TKBM. Stealing relics and sowing discord are only the beginning as he works from the shadows to make the organization pay for its crimes.

But the emergence of the Tower of Pride raises the stakes dramatically. Forced to manipulate and clash some of history's most powerful conquerors, Jooheon must rely on all his cunning to stay ahead. Can he outwit the legendary warlords and emerge victorious in a battle between the greatest rulers the world has ever known?

2414568.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
2414568.description:
The Soul Reapers' battle against the Quincies nears its end as Yhwach breaks into the Royal Palace, shattering Squad Zero's Bankai and reaching the Reio Greater Palace. Ichibe entrusts Ichigo to protect the Soul King, but Yhwach's trickery forces Ichigo to strike down the King with his own blade. The Soul King's death triggers the collapse of the Three Worlds, as distortions and omens spread across all realms. 

The Thirteen Court Guard Squads join surviving Quincies to retake the Royal Palace—now transformed into the Wahr Welt by the Wandenreich—where the Royal Guard await within an ominous castle towering against the sky.
2414568.originName: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-禍進譚-

2414682.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I (Thai Dub)
2414682.description:
灶门炭治郎为了让成为鬼的妹妹祢豆子变回人类，加入狩猎鬼的组织「鬼杀队」。
入队之后，他与伙伴我妻善逸以及嘴平伊之助跟各式各样的鬼战斗，在成长的同时加深友情与羁绊。
然后，炭治郎与「鬼杀队」最高阶的剑士「柱」一同战斗，在《无限列车》跟炎柱炼狱杏寿郎、在《游郭》跟音柱宇髓天元、在《刀匠村》则是跟霞柱时透无一郎以及恋柱甘露寺蜜璃一起展开激烈的战斗。
其后，为了面对与鬼即将到来的决战，队员们集体参加「柱」所举行的联合强化训练《柱训练》。此时，鬼舞辻无惨却出现在「鬼杀队」的大本营产屋敷府。虽然「柱」们与炭治郎连忙赶去营救陷入危机的主公大人，却在无惨的操纵之下落入了充满谜团的空间。
炭治郎等人落下的地方，正是鬼的大本营「无限城」──
「鬼杀队」与「鬼」的决战，序幕就此揭开。
2414682.originName: 剧场版「鬼灭之刃」无限城篇」泰配版

2414781.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I (Dub Indo)
2414781.description:
In order to turn his demonized younger sister, Nezuko, back into a human, Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps, an organization dedicated to hunting down demons.
After joining, he fights alongside his comrades, Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira, facing all manner of demons. As they battle, their bonds of friendship grow ever stronger. Later, Tanjiro teams up with the “Pillars,” the Demon Slayer Corps’ highest-ranking swordsmen: on the Infinity Train, he fights alongside Flame‑Pillar Rengoku Kyojuro; in the Entertainment District, with Sound‑Pillar Urokodaki Sakonji; and in the Swordsmith Village, with Mist‑Pillar Himejima Gyomei and Love‑Pillar Giyu Tomioka, engaging in fierce battles each time.
With the decisive showdown against the demons looming, the corps members gather for the “Pillar Training,” a joint intensive regimen led by the Pillars. Yet just then, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Demon Slayer Corps’ headquarters, the Ogata Residence. Though the Pillars and Tanjiro rush to rescue their lord, who is in dire peril, they are drawn—under Muzan’s control—into a mysterious realm.
The place where Tanjiro and the others find themselves is none other than the demons’ lair: the Infinity Castle.
Thus, the curtain rises on the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons.
2414781.originName: 剧场版「鬼灭之刃」无限城篇」印配版

2414903.title: Cute Wife, Food God
2414903.description: Ye Jiayao is a young and talented cook who dreams of becoming a renowned chef one day. As luck would have it, she's magically transported back in time to Imperial China, and in the body of an extremely useless girl. Ye Jiayao is immediately kidnapped and held for ransom, but she manages to use her wits (and her sense of humor) to get whatever she wants.

2415004.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects (Thai Dub)
2415004.description:
After decades of war, the hero Dias is rewarded with a frontier domain of his own. But upon arriving, he discovers little more than endless grasslands and an empty territory with no people to govern. Having spent his entire life as a soldier, Dias has no idea how to be a lord.

Everything changes when he meets Alna, a mysterious horned girl. As new allies gather around him, Dias begins the challenging task of turning a barren frontier into a thriving land—and finding a new purpose beyond the battlefield.
2415004.originName: 从领民0人开始的边境领主生活（泰配版）

2415108.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 (Thai Dub)
2415108.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.
2415108.originName: 无职转生 第三季 ～到了异世界就拿出真本事～（泰配版）

2415215.title: Skeleton Knight in Another World Season 2（Thai Dub）
2415215.description:
After awakening in another world as his MMORPG avatar, Arc finds himself trapped in the body of a Skeleton Knight—an imposing suit of armor hiding nothing but bones beneath. If his true nature is discovered, he could easily be mistaken for a monster and hunted down.

Determined to keep a low profile, Arc takes up life as a mercenary. But with a strong sense of justice, he can never ignore those in need. Joined by the elven warrior Ariane, the beastfolk ninja Chiyome, and the spirit beast Ponta, Arc embarks on an adventure filled with battles, friendship, and unexpected encounters.
2415215.originName: 骸骨騎士樣、只今異世界へお出掛け中 第2期

2415300.title: The World’s Strongest Rearguard (Thai Dub)
2415300.description:
After dying in a bizarre bus accident, overworked salaryman Arihito Atobe is reincarnated into a fantasy world as a Seeker. There, he discovers a rare class known as the Rearguard, a support specialist capable of boosting his party's offense, defense, and healing abilities.

As if that weren't enough, his unique position at the back of the formation naturally increases his companions' affection for him. Free from the grind of corporate life, Arihito sets out on a brand-new adventure with an all-female party and a second chance at happiness.
2415300.originName: 世界最強の後衛　〜迷宮国の新人探索者〜

2415404.title: Yang Jian: Shatter Illusions
2415404.description: When Yang Jian split the mountain to rescue his mother, Yaoji was abducted by Chaos. He was framed and hunted by the Heavenly Court. Sun Wukong formed an alliance with him. The two traversed myriad realms chasing clues, only to face repeated setbacks, dead‑end leads, and betrayal by their sworn brothers that landed them in mortal peril. Yang Jian awakened his vital seal to shatter the Realm Beyond Heaven. Together with his companions, he survived three life‑and‑death tribulations, broke through his cultivation realm, and uncovered the secrets of his origin. Gradually he realized all of this was a man‑made scheme. He finally discovered Zhen Yuanzi was the mastermind behind everything and resolved to confront the final doom of fate.

2415517.title: Daughter’s Scheme: Capital’s Supreme Lady
2415517.description: Shen Jingzhu, the legitimate daughter of a merchant family, was schemed against by her fiancé and stepsister in her past life. Her family fortune was seized, and she perished in a raging fire. Reborn on her wedding day, she publicly tore up the marriage contract and instead proposed marriage to Xiao Yanjue, the formidable powerful minister, striking a pact of mutual benefit. Side by side, she uses her wit to settle scores with her enemies and thrive in business, while he lends covert support from within the imperial court. As her revenge unfolds, long‑buried old cases and court conflicts surface one after another. The two stand together against the tempests and jointly pursue the truth.
2415517.originName: 嫡女谋：换亲后我成了全京城的祖宗！

2415644.title: Taste of Immortal Realm
2415644.description: Lin Wei, an ordinary girl from the streets, meets an immortal amid her lowest point in life and inherits the legacy of the God of Cuisine. With heartfelt cooking, she dispels worldly karmic obsessions stirred by food. She crosses paths with Fu Yunshen, a catering tycoon trapped in inner turmoil who has lost his sense of taste. The two heal each other. They stand side‑by‑side to fight capital forces profiting from pre‑made dishes and break through numerous plots and frame‑ups. Upholding traditional Chinese culinary craftsmanship, Lin Wei competes in renowned food contests at home and abroad. She even travels to the Immortal Realm to spread the philosophy of good food. In the end, she returns to mortal street‑side life, stays with Fu Yunshen, and interprets the true essence of gastronomy through mortal worldly warmth.

2415754.title: KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE (Thai Dub)
2415754.description:
Kuroe Akaishi is a shy, withdrawn high school girl who has long grown used to being alone. But when the kind and popular Arata Minami reaches out to her, her quiet world begins to change—and so do her feelings.

There's just one problem: whenever Kuroe becomes embarrassed or flustered, she starts transforming into a terrifying kaijuu. As her emotions intensify, so does her monstrous form, threatening everyone around her. With a giant monster looming over Japan and first love stirring in her heart, Kuroe must face the biggest challenge of all: confessing her feelings before they bring the world to ruin.
2415754.originName: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ

2416010.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You (Thai Dub)
2416010.description:
Rentarou Aijou has it all: looks, intelligence, athletic skill, and popularity with peers and mentors alike. Unfortunately, none of these qualities help Rentarou with his love life. On the day of his middle school graduation, he is once again turned down by a girl he confesses to, earning his one-hundredth rejection in a row. Down on his luck, he goes to a matchmaking shrine and wishes to finally get a girlfriend in high school.

When the god of the shrine suddenly appears before him, Rentarou is told he will meet an astronomical total of one hundred soulmates in high school. Though Rentarou initially does not take this foretelling seriously, his doubts disappear when, on the first day of school, he meets two of these soulmates—Hakari Hanazono and Karane Inda—who both confess to him. With fated encounters and love confessions galore, Rentarou's life is about to get a lot more exciting.
2416010.originName: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女

2416095.title: I Ruined My Family’s Mid‑Autumn Reunion
2416095.description: On Mid‑Autumn night, Gu Fan returns home from prison, only to find his family celebrating in joyous reunion — with no place for him. Five years ago, he took the blame for adopted son Gu Chen and went to prison, only to get betrayal, idea‑stealing and even a murder plot from his family. Reborn, he no longer holds back. Using AI technology for secret schemes and allying with the young miss of the Zhou family, he publicly exposes Gu Chen’s theft of “Star‑River AI” at the Mid‑Autumn banquet, and retakes everything that belongs to him step by step. Family conspiracies, corporate shadow wars and twisted family bonds — a grand revenge drama ignites on Mid‑Autumn night!
2416095.originName: 亲情入土，我以微凡立世间

2416243.title: Bow To Me
2416243.description: Chen Lian, a noble’s legitimate daughter, suffers after her father brings home a concubine and her illegitimate daughter Chen Ying. Framed by them, her birth‑mother dies and she is expelled. Adopted by Minister Zhao, she renames herself Zhao Dai. Years later, she enters the palace to find Chen Ying is a favoured imperial concubine. Biding her time, she stirs conflict between Concubine Ying and Noble Lady He to weaken both, then draws close to the emperor. To get revenge, she chases the emperor’s favour, aiming to replace Concubine Ying and ruin the Chen clan. She vows to rise to the top of the harem. Bloody palace strife unfolds.

2416371.title: The Whole Village Acts, I’m the Killer
2416371.description: Famed Wang Yang returns home with his girlfriend. He accidentally hits and kills a stranger. To protect his fame, he hides the body and attends his mentor’s funeral. Desperate, he stashes the corpse in his mentor’s coffin. His son insists on opening the coffin, a fraud priest presses hard, and old friends offer suspicious help. Everyone harbors secrets. When the coffin opens, he realizes he has fallen into a huge trap set for him.
2416371.originName: 全村都在演，只有我是凶手

2416511.title: Snake Dance
2416511.description: Eighteen‑year‑old Lin Ze was raised by Lin Qiuyue from childhood, yet never knew her true identity. In a dream, he saw a dancer who looked exactly like Lin Qiuyue seducing him repeatedly. When he woke up, Lin Qiuyue made him drink the mysterious “Carefree Elixir” as usual and left in a hurry. Out of curiosity, Lin Ze tailed her, only to discover she entered Yichun Tower, the city’s famed pleasure house. Rumour spread that the top courtesan “Rose” would perform that night, drawing countless men. Lin Ze snuck in at risk, but fainted amid chaos. Upon waking, he spotted ambiguous marks on Lin Qiuyue. Furious and getting no answers from his questioning, he imprisoned her, determined to uncover Yichun Tower’s secrets himself. Yet when he went there again, his body suddenly malfunctioned. It turned out he had to take the “Carefree Elixir” every month to survive. On the brink of death, “Rose”, the top courtesan of Yichun Tower, appeared to save him — and her face was identical to Lin Qiuyue’s…

2416645.title: The Regent’s Princess Consort
2416645.description: Song Qing, a fallen‑kingdom princess, enters the palace as a concubine of her foe Emperor An Yinzhou for revenge. Her beauty arouses the Noble Consort’s jealousy, and she gets no chance to meet An Yinzhou after entering the palace. Song Qing devises a plot using a temple fire to win the emperor’s favour and fights back against Noble Consort Su Huayu. Enraged by Song Qing’s rising favour, Murong Yue and Su Huayu frame her many times. Yet Song Qing escapes every trap and gains An Yinzhou’s full trust. Gradually she develops feelings for him, torn between hatred and love. When she finally resolves to kill An Yinzhou, she discovers everything is Chu Yucheng’s conspiracy…

2416787.title: I’m a Math Genius, No More Hiding
2416787.description: Jiang Ni fails to get into high school due to persecution from relatives. Yet she reveals her talent for mathematics in technical secondary school. To fulfil her dream and her mother’s expectations, she plucks up her courage amid others’ disdain and joins the Global Mathematics Competition, transforming into a better version of herself.

2416903.title: Mother‑in‑Law’s Thoughts, I Crush Everyone
2416903.description: Miao Rui and Jiang Yu have been happily married for years with a lovely young‑school‑age daughter. Her parents‑in‑law suffer a severe car accident out of the blue, and the mother‑in‑law loses her ability to speak. They bring the couple home to take care of them. Miao Rui discovers she can hear her mother‑in‑law’s inner thoughts. Tricked by these mental voices, Miao Rui ends up dying together with her daughter. Unwilling to accept this fate, Miao Rui is reborn to the moment her mother‑in‑law first frames her. This time she will protect her small family, expose the plot, and make the villains pay.
2416903.originName: 听见婆婆心声后，我创飞所有人

2416953.title: Public Trial
2416953.description: Emotional entanglements among five siblings. A globally‑streamed public trial. Is it breaking‑point anger or hidden truth? A review of family bonds. Childhood memories flash by. What the elder brother sees as protection feels like obstruction to his sisters. He bears everything to let his four sisters live brilliant lives, realizing how precious life and family affection can be.

2417017.title: My Weak Fiancé, I’ll Protect Him This Life
2417017.description: Liang Wange and Meng Chen'ou were attacked on the night of the proposal, and Meng Chen'ou was killed on the spot. After learning Chen Jiayun believed Meng Chen'ou was not her biological son, Liang Wange was tortured to death by assailants. Reborn on the fateful night, she vows to protect Meng Chen'ou and embarks on a path of revenge. She first exposes Meng Yuekuang’s corruption and sends him to prison, then uncovers the true blood relationship between Meng Chen'ou and Chen Jiayun. However, Chen Jiayun has already launched a second assassination attempt, leaving Meng Chen'ou comatose. When Liang Wange presents the kinship proof to Chen Jiayun, the latter collapses and goes insane in disbelief. Having completed her revenge, Liang Wange decides to marry the unconscious Meng Chen'ou in the ward. Midway through the wedding, Meng Chen'ou wakes up, and the two finally live a happy life together.
2417017.originName: 未婚夫太菜此生我来保护他

2417067.title: Promise You Dusk‑Tide Vessel
2417067.description: Xu Qinghuan, a student‑teacher at Hope Primary School, misinterprets a pupil’s ambiguous comment during a composition class and mistakenly believes the boy’s brother Lu Chenzhou works as a male model. Concerned for the student’s mental and physical well‑being, Xu Qinghuan decides to persuade Lu Chenzhou to quit “being a duck”. Little does she know the “duck” refers to roast duck, merely one of many businesses owned by Lu Chenzhou, CEO of Dusk Group. Xu Qinghuan keeps misunderstanding Lu Chenzhou, yet gradually falls for him amid all these mix‑ups.

2417122.title: Love As Blade, Flee the Abyss
2417122.description: Ji Nian, eldest daughter of the Ji family, grows up haunted by her mother’s death. Her step‑father’s false affection and step‑brother’s malicious covetousness drag her deep into the wealthy‑family turmoil. To uncover the truth behind her mother’s death, she spins a careful web, setting her sights on Lu Yanzhou, the mighty capital’s top heir. She feigns compliance, moves among three men, and tries to leverage his power to break free from her predicament.

2417189.title: Back to the 90s, Meet My Ex‑Husband
2417189.description: On their divorce day, Tang Guo and her ex‑husband Mu Bai get into a car crash while arguing outside the civil affairs bureau. They are accidentally transported back to their youth in the 1990s. Tang Guo returns to the day her father Tang Zhiqiang died in a factory explosion. She rushes to the factory to stop the disaster, but is blocked outside the workshop by Bai Wei, the factory director’s daughter, and the explosion happens. Devastated by failing to save her father, she spots Mu Bai showing up with Tang Zhiqiang alive. Tang Guo figures out Mu Bai has also travelled through time, yet keeps her own rebirth a secret. To secure her family’s future income, Tang Guo uses her rebirth advantage to buy lottery tickets and runs into Mu Bai by chance. After winning a huge prize, she collects the reward in disguise, only to find another massive winner from a local lottery shop — she knows it is Mu Bai and covers for him. Tang Guo secretly opens a garment factory, planning to earn money to pursue her youthful crush Song Yu. Unexpectedly, Mu Bai opens a competing garment factory. Seeing Mu Bai’s thriving business, Bai Wei pursues him aggressively. Both silently resolve never to be together again in this life and start new romances. Yet fate draws them close once more. Through their second‑life encounters, they resolve their rifts and reunite.

2417275.title: Useless To Tycoon After Binding System
2417275.description: Foolish Chen Qiang inherits a factory after his parents pass away. Betrayed by his best friend and cheated on by his wife, he kills himself. A modern‑day man transmigrates into his body with a tycoon system. Hiding his true strength under the fool’s identity, he humiliates his wife, gets revenge on his former friend and rebuilds the factory. Powered by the system, the once‑despised fool grows into a powerful business tycoon.
2417275.originName: 绑定系统后草包变巨鳄

2417327.title: Sisters Ride the Wind
2417327.description: Domestic‑violence victim Lin Xiaojin is driven out by her husband Cheng Bin with her daughter on her birthday. She meets Bai Suyan, a hidden wealthy heiress. An accident swaps their souls. Bai Suyan joins showbiz. She defeats rivals Mo Shuhe and Xia Shiyin on variety shows with life wisdom and exposes their true faces. Lin Xiaojin uses social media to reveal Cheng Bin’s abuse. With Bai Zhiting’s help, she gets divorced. Both achieve success. Lin Xiaojin enjoys family warmth in the Bai family. Bai Suyan devotes to public welfare for troubled women. They start new lives.

2417425.title: Smooth Wedding, Torturous Divorce
2417425.description: Appearance‑obsessed Fang Shiyue falls for rational coder Jiang Feng. They love at first sight and marry in three days. Conflicting lifestyles push them to divorce in one month. But divorce appointments are fully booked. The bickering pair start their chaotic divorce marathon. Misunderstandings flare: she suspects his female coworker, he catches her with a handsome streamer. Jealousy makes everything messier. When they finally get a slot, Fang Shiyue finds Jiang Feng’s hidden posts showing his quiet love. Right after divorce paperwork, she learns she is pregnant. Standing before the operating room, the whirlwind‑marriage farce faces its big twist. Can they cancel the divorce? This funny marital tug‑of‑war teaches the stubborn pair about love, tolerance and growth.
2417425.originName: 结婚零阻力离婚马拉松

2417508.title: You’re Tough, But My Squad Has My Back
2417508.description: Kind‑hearted Su Su has innate divine power. She saves electric‑bodied He Ran and pregnant Huang Wei in a car crash. Back home, vicious neighbors seize the corridor and force a house swap. When a brat ruins her mother’s relics, Su Su nearly loses control, saved by her mother’s recording. He Ran helps her trap the neighbors into heavy mortgage debt and expose cheating. The vengeful family blocks an ambulance, causing the child’s death. They get arrested. Huang Wei gives birth safely. He Ran confesses, and they live happily.
2417508.originName: 你不好惹可我有病友团撑腰

2417576.title: I Must Pluck This Wild Rose
2417576.description: At a secret high‑stakes underground auction, young master Feng Wuque loses control from wolf poison and bursts into Su Wanyi’s room. Drinking her blood restores his sanity. Gentle‑looking Su Wanyi inherits divine Shennong blood, trapped by her family. She schemes to have Feng Wuque bid huge money for her blood. She foils the Shen family’s plot and escapes her clan’s control. She uses Feng Wuque’s power to break her engagement with the Shen family, yet freezes in shock when his true identity is exposed.

2417650.title: A Chinese Ghost Story: Enchanted Lanruo Temple
2417650.description: On moonlit night, scholar Ning Caichen trips over bones in dark woods and spots a white‑fox spirit Nie Xiaoqian. Fleeing from her, he finds an injured imperial guard lieutenant. Demon hunter Yan Chixia arrives and saves them. They take shelter in Lanruo Temple. The dying lieutenant writes a blood letter for Ning Caichen to deliver to Zhuge Jing. Yan Chixia repels Nie Xiaoqian, leaves a scripture and departs. Wounded, Nie Xiaoqian reports to Locust Spirit Lord, who orders her to seize Ning Caichen’s pure heart. Ning Caichen heads for the imperial guard office. The scripture draws disciple Zhiqiu Yiye’s attention. With his help, Ning Caichen sneaks in and hands over the blood letter, yet gets imprisoned for trespassing. Zhuge Jing grants him a chance for redemption: find the lieutenant’s corpse. Back at his lodging, a breathtaking lady’s painting floats in. Inside the painting, Nie Xiaoqian watches him by the window…

2417767.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System(Thai Dub)
2417767.description:
"You worthless son! You were destined to inherit our family's legacy, yet you ended up with that class!"

In a world where every fifteen-year-old receives a class through the Ritual of Divine Blessing, Elymas is expected to follow in the footsteps of his renowned swordsman family. Instead, he awakens as a Heavy Knight—a class widely dismissed as weak and useless—and is stripped of his status before being cast out.

But Elymas knows something no one else does: this world is the very game he once played in a previous life, and the supposedly worthless Heavy Knight is actually one of its strongest classes. Armed with knowledge from the future, he sets out to surpass all expectations and reshape the world itself.
2417767.originName: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する

2417986.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System (Dub Indo)
2417986.description:
"You worthless son! You were destined to inherit our family's legacy, yet you ended up with that class!"

In a world where every fifteen-year-old receives a class through the Ritual of Divine Blessing, Elymas is expected to follow in the footsteps of his renowned swordsman family. Instead, he awakens as a Heavy Knight—a class widely dismissed as weak and useless—and is stripped of his status before being cast out.

But Elymas knows something no one else does: this world is the very game he once played in a previous life, and the supposedly worthless Heavy Knight is actually one of its strongest classes. Armed with knowledge from the future, he sets out to surpass all expectations and reshape the world itself.
2417986.originName: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する

2418071.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 (Dub Indo)
2418071.description:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.
2418071.originName: 無職転生Ⅲ ～異世界行ったら本気だす～

2418319.title: The World’s Strongest Rearguard
2418319.description:
After dying in a bizarre bus accident, overworked salaryman Arihito Atobe is reincarnated into a fantasy world as a Seeker. There, he discovers a rare class known as the Rearguard, a support specialist capable of boosting his party's offense, defense, and healing abilities.

As if that weren't enough, his unique position at the back of the formation naturally increases his companions' affection for him. Free from the grind of corporate life, Arihito sets out on a brand-new adventure with an all-female party and a second chance at happiness.
2418319.originName: 世界最強の後衛　〜迷宮国の新人探索者〜

2418459.title: My Treasure Mermaid Prince
2418459.description: Others keep fish, but she keeps the Dragon Palace’s prince in her fish tank!

2418757.title: The Silent Truth
2418757.description: Ten years ago, Li Da Qiang was killed after exposing a construction scandal. Witness Lin Jian Guo was forced into silence to save his sick son. Haunted by guilt, he adopted Li’s daughter Xiaoxiao and secretly sought the truth—until it cost him his life.

2418827.title: I Refuse to Become a Zombie King
2418827.description: The apocalypse hits, and zombies overrun the world. Betrayed by his fiancée Ye Wenjie, Wang Miao dies and wakes up one week before doomsday. This time, he dumps the simping life and goes all-in on stockpiling supplies. After the apocalypse returns, he awakens superpowers and gains control over zombies. When three rival survivors attack for his supplies, Wang Miao sets a deadly trap and takes them all down. At last, he builds a safe haven with Zhang Yun, Hua Lili, and Xu Wuhui—a home for the survivors.
2418827.originName: 末世降临：我努力不变成丧尸王

2431878.title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
2431878.description:
Having survived fierce battles in Kyoto and Nerima, Shiki and his fellow students at Rasetsu Academy gradually grow stronger. But Yaoroshi rebels against Mudano’s teachings on the importance of comradeship. Drawn to the Kikoku Unit‘s captain Hayate Todoroki and his creed of “eradicating all Momotaro,” he leaves Rasetsu Academy.

But the Kikoku Unit’s ideology goes beyond fighting enemies—they target even non-combatants. Realizing the danger, Shiki, Mudano, and the other students set out to bring Yaoroshi back.

Their search leads them to Nikko, where Kegon Falls have mysteriously stopped flowing and a massive research facility has appeared. Inside, horrifying experiments are underway…
2431878.originName: 『桃源暗鬼』～日光・華厳の滝編～

2431959.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
2431959.description: Fia, a swordswoman with no talent, nearly dies and recalls her past life as a powerful Saint. Three hundred years ago, she was killed by the Demon King's right hand, who vowed to kill her again if reborn. She regains her powers but hides them. However, unable to ignore others in need, she often uses her power. Can she keep her identity secret?
2431959.originName: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひたかくす

2432099.title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2
2432099.description:
Fran, the young cat-eared girl who was mistreated as a slave, encounters a sentient sword known as Teacher and becomes its wielder. After joining the Adventurers’ Guild in the fortified city of Alessa, Fran takes on quests and steadily makes a name for herself as an adventurer.

Determined to achieve the “Evolution” that lies beyond strength, Fran sets her sights on fulfilling her greatest wish. Teacher, eager to help her achieve it, decides that their next destination will be the port town of Dars.

Along the way, they discover the Floating Island in the sky and meet Jean Du Vix, a necromancer seeking to conquer its labyrinth. Accepting his request, Fran and Teacher join him on the expedition. But the labyrinth is crawling with terrifying undead beasts!

A new adventure begins for the cat-eared girl and her doting sword!
2432099.originName: 転生したら剣でした　2期

2432178.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
2432178.description:
Rein Garland is an Enchanter specializing in enhancement magic. One day, he is suddenly expelled from his guild. Rather than despair, he reclaims the vast amount of bonus points he once bestowed upon the guild members’ gear and sets out on a new path as an adventurer.

Those who gather around him are all scarred by the past: a genius adventurer who lost her entire party, a warrior who had his family taken from him, and an assassin raised to kill. Yet Rein never denies their past or wounds, welcoming them with unwavering optimism.

In this extraordinary fantasy world where magic coexists with modern technologies, the more people rely on technology, the weaker their magic becomes. As intelligent monsters run rampant and outlaw scheme in the shadows, these outcasts fight with nothing but their magic and convictions.

This is the story of those who lost their place in the world and found a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, carefree second life begins!
2432178.originName: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する

2432255.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3
2432255.description: Ars Louvent, reincarnated in another world with the unique ability to assess people’s skills and stats, has earned recognition for his achievements in the war-torn region. With other sides driven by their own convictions, a new battle begins. Join Ars and his new companions as they enter a thrilling new chapter!
2432255.originName: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる③

2432333.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
2432333.description: Ray White is the Iceblade Sorcerer who is one of the Seven Grand Sorcerers. He vanished from the battlefield after struggling with his overwhelming power and deep emotional scars. Three years later, he enrolls at Arnold Academy of Magical Arts and wants to live an ordinary life. Initially looked down upon by nobles, Ray gradually proves his abilities and earns the trust of his classmates while confronting a mysterious organization targeting elite mages. Having found true friends and a place to belong, Ray now faces a new challenge…
2432333.originName: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べる 2期

2432495.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season2
2432495.description:
The Shadow World is a mysterious dimension that constantly encroaches upon the world, and threatens humanity with its deadliest disaster: the Shadow Labyrinth.

To prevent its destruction, Desir Arman returns 13 years ago and begins his life at the nation’s finest magic academy. There, he is reunited with his precious friends and is trying to change the past to save them. Desir’s battle to rewrite the future unfolds!
2432495.originName: 帰還者の魔法は特別です 第2期

2432615.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party. I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
2432615.description:
In a world where “Gifts” bestowed by the God of Creation shape one’s destiny, Lent, a kind-hearted young man receives the rare support ability, allowing him to lend his mana to his companions.
Together with his childhood friends, he forms a team and sets out on an adventure. But deemed a burden for remaining weak, Lent is mercilessly cast out.
Fueled by anger and a thirst for revenge, his Gift evolves, awakening its true power: the ability to forcibly reclaim the vast mana he has lent out.
Now, Lent will collect his mana from those who betrayed him and use it to grow stronger. His journey of revenge begins now!
2432615.originName: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収

2432745.title: Firefly Wedding
2432745.description:
In the Meiji era, women were regarded as little more than assets of their families…

Satoko Kirigaya, was born into privilege and gifted with exceptional beauty. Yet she has been told that she has only a short time left to live. Her greatest desire is to marry into another distinguished family to fulfill her father’s wish for her happiness.

But one night, she is abducted as part of a sinister plot.

With her life hanging in the balance, Satoko comes face-to-face with Shinpei Goto, an assassin who happens to be at the scene. In a desperate attempt to save herself, she blurts out a lie:

“Let’s get married. If you’re with me, you’ll have everything you could ever want.”

Convinced that Satoko is his destined partner, Shinpei becomes obsessively devoted to her. Meanwhile, Satoko finds herself torn between her own mission and the feelings she has begun to harbor for him.

This is the story of a twisted and all-consuming love.

2432827.title: The World's Strongest Witch
2432827.description:
Rona was cast out after awakening what was believed to be the weakest skill of all. But little did anyone know that her seemingly useless ability was actually an SSS-rank cheat skill called “Internet”, which lets her access this world’s very own online strategy guides!

Determined to live a free and peaceful life, Rona, the “world’s strongest witch,” sets off on a journey of her own. But with an absurdly overpowered skill at her fingertips, her adventures are anything but ordinary. Now, her chaotic and hilarious journey finally unfolds!
2432827.originName: 世界最強の魔女、始めました。

2432940.title: Black Clover Season 2
2432940.description:
In a world where magic is everything, Asta is the only person without any magical power. What he possesses is Anti-Magic, a power capable of nullifying other forms of magic. And now, Dark Triad, the rulers of the Spade Kingdom wield the power of devils from the Underworld and have begun to ravage the world.
As their invasion intensifies, the Heart Kingdom’s princess and ruler Lolopechka, and even Yami and William Vangeance, the captains of the Clover Kingdom’s Magic Knights are captured. The battlefield seems hopeless, yet there are still those who continue to rise.
To take everything back, Asta steps into a forbidden path, seeking to obtain the power of “true devil”! To rescue his comrades and fulfill his promise to his rival, he is willing to risk everything!
2432940.originName: ブラッククローバー Season 2

2433041.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
2433041.description:
On the outskirts of town stands a prestigious private school, Fujinari Academy.

First-year high school student Ume Mizunoe excels in literature, having won numerous literary awards and the like. However, his grades in science and mathematics are so abysmal that they could actually prevent him from advancing to the next year. In order to avoid repeating a year and improve his school record, he decides to join the student council.

However, the student council he joins is filled with some rather unusual characters. With such a wonderfully odd assortment of personalities all gathered in one place, what kind of story will unfold...?

2433174.title: RAKSHASA STREET 5
2433174.description:
The storm rises once more on Rakshasa Street as all factions stir into motion. The combined forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu are unstoppable, leaving the Hall of Heroes gravely damaged. Amid the chaos, heroes rise one after another, while the Kingdom Organization's ambitions brew a new crisis.

On Rakshasa Street, no one dares to say "No" . From this moment on, Cao Yanbing's path to becoming king truly begins.

2433235.title: The First Order 2
2433235.description:
Nuclear winter descends, civilization collapses, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. To protect themselves, humans have built one fortress after another, while beyond the walls, survival comes only through blood and fire.

Ren Xiaosu and his younger brother Yan Liuyuan are among those left outside. Once ordinary boys of the wilderness, they have no shelter and nowhere to run. The only thing they can rely on is each other. When a massive earthquake strikes Jingshan, Fortress 113 comes crashing down, laying bare the chaos of the post-apocalyptic world. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, a military leader, and make their way into Fortress 109. A new life seems about to begin, but the real trials have only just started…

2433316.title: Kaiju No. 8 Original Short Anime "Narumi's Week at Work"
2433316.description: Kafka has been chasing his dream to join the Defense Force. The captain of the Defense Force, Gen Narumi, has a very different kind of daily battle. Between skipping meetings, dodging paperwork, and getting caught up in unexpected trouble, even the strongest warrior can't escape the chaos of everyday life. Get ready to see a whole new side of Narumi in this hilarious new chapter of Kaiju No.8!

2433441.title: I'm a Reincarnated Goblin, Any Questions?
2433441.description: Akira Yagami, a well-liked and trusted salaryman, dies from saving a child who dashed into the street. He then was reincarnated as a "goblin." Though goblins only live seven days, his skill "Octogenarian" lets him inherit countless abilities from goblins who die before him. Soon he finds himself surrounded by demons, elves, and even dragons. Thus begins the ultimate overpowered fantasy tale of a goblin!
2433441.originName: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？
